ArtifactFTUE_TutorialText03.value: Level up the artifact to complete the chain & receive a reward
Level the artifact up to complete the chain and receive a reward.

AshAmbulance_01.value: Hmm, I might as well start fixing a few things here before Ash returns!

AshAmbulance_02.value: It shouldn't be too hard, right? I've got this!

AshCharacterFinalTask_01.value: Thanks for all the hard work, Maddie!

AshCharacterFinalTask_02.value: I'm sure you- I mean my aunt will appreciate it!

AshCharacterFinalTask_03.value: Sure thing! There were some strange requests though...

AshCharacterTasks1_01.value: What do you need wax for?

AshCharacterTasks1_02.value: Oh, it's for my aunt's um... garden shed?

AshCharacterTasks2_01.value: A tape measure? Are you installing something?

AshCharacterTasks2_03.value: My aunt needs a grand display for her garden!

AshCharacterTasksIntro_01.value: Maddie, I have a bit of a favor to ask you.

AshCharacterTasksIntro_03.value: Well, see, the thing is... I might have booked another job at the same time as yours.

AshCharacterTasksIntro_05.value: Umm... more like some garden work for my aunt.

AshCharacterTasksIntro_06.value: I noticed you have a bunch of cool gardening equipment here. Mind helping me out?

AshCharacterTasksIntro_07.value: Alright. But, only because you're injured!

AshCharacterTasksIntro_08.value: You're the best! I guarantee that it'll be worth it!

Attic01_01.value: Well, this place is rather obviously an attic!

Attic01_02.value: But why was the entrance hidden like that?

Attic01_03.value: ... Who am I fooling? Nothing in this place makes sense.

Attic01_04.value: But... It has a reason and purpose!

Attic01_05.value: I’ll look around and see what I can discover.

Attic01_06.value: Grandpa wanted Grandma to come up here, after all!

Attic04_01.value: What attic wouldn’t be complete without an old tv...
What attic wouldn’t be complete without an old TV...

Attic04_02.value: And an assorted collection of VHS tapes! Hmm...

Attic04_03.value: Looks like these are some sort of music video promo tape for a band called “Cheers for Shears”.

Attic04_04.value: Well, let’s see what you guys are all about!

Attic04_05.value: Aw, shucks. No sound. But from the look of things, it seems like a music video from the late 80s!
Aw, shucks. No sound. But from the look of things, it seems like a music video from the late '80s!

Attic04_06.value: I should hang on to these, perhaps they’re worth something!

Attic06_02.value: Exactly what I’d expect mom to have had! I bet they had such a wonderful time at their wedding...

Attic06_04.value: I wonder what she would have thought about my “wedding”. Or lack thereof...

Attic06_05.value: Being devastated. Alone. Left at the altar by Arthur!

Attic06_07.value: Maybe I should listen to him...

Attic07_01.value: Hmm... This safe looks really old, but in good condition.
Hmm... That safe was really old and tricky to open.

Attic07_02.value: Must be vintage. Let’s see... Hey! The door is unlocked!
I had to use some of my lock picking skills!

Attic07_03.value: Perhaps Grandpa unlocked it! Let’s see what’s inside...

Attic07_04.value: Oh! This is dad’s birth certificate! But...

Attic07_05.value: His last name is scratched out! Why would someone do that? And why leave it in a safe?

Attic07_06.value: What does this mean?! Was he switched at birth? Ugh... Keep it together, Maddie!
What does this mean?! Was he switched at birth? Ugh... keep it together, Maddie!

Attic08_01.value: Hey... A writing desk. Perhaps I can find more answers here.

Attic08_02.value: A letter! But... Wait a minute. This doesn’t make sense!

Attic08_03.value: It looks like it’s a letter between Grandpa and Grandma. But, the C he usually signs is... Different.
It looks like it’s a letter between Grandpa and Grandma. But, the C he usually signs is... different.

Attic08_04.value: But the letter itself is even more strange! It sounds like Grandpa is angry with Grandma!

Attic08_05.value: Something about her leaving him without a word and that she should honor what they have...

Attic08_06.value: But, they were happily married?! Why does he “demand her to return or face the consequences”?

Attic08_07.value: This... Doesn’t sound like Grandpa! But... Who else could it be?!
This... doesn’t sound like Grandpa! But... who else could it be?!

Attic11_01.value: Hmm... An old cassette tape. Wait... Something is written on it.
Hmm... an old vinyl. Wait... something is written on it.

Attic11_02.value: “Becky and Mike final tape”... Mom and dad were in a band?!
“Becky and Mike's final record”... Mom and dad were in a band?!

Attic11_03.value: This tape also looks like it came from the music studio...
This vinyl also looks like it came from the music studio...

Attic11_04.value: Did that mean that mom and dad met in the mansion as singers?!
Did that mean that mom and dad met in the Mansion as singers?!

Attic11_05.value: I got to find a cassette player!
I see some cassettes as well. I've got to find a cassette player!

Attic12_01.value: Ah good, a player, and it even has batteries!

Attic12_02.value: Here we go! Mom. Dad. Don’t let me down!

Attic12_04.value: Hearing mom and dad sing a love song to each other wasn’t quite what I was expecting...

Attic12_05.value: It’s... So odd. I know those voices. And... I know this song! I think they sang it to me as a lullaby!
It’s... so odd. I know those voices. And... I know this song! I think they sang it to me as a lullaby!

Attic14.2_01.value: It worked, and it looks like it held a key. Now... let’s open this door.

Attic14.2_02.value: Oh, wow! It looks like an elevator!

Attic14_01.value: Hmm... It looks like it needs a numeric key code.

Attic14_02.value: Most of the things up here are about mom and dad. Their music, the wedding dress, and the other thing...
Most of the things up here are about mom and dad. Their music, the wedding dress...

Attic14_04.value: It worked, and it looks like it held a key. Now... Let’s open this door.
It worked, and it looks like it held a key!

Attic14_05.value: Oh wow! It looks like an elevator!

Attic15_01.value: I guess it’s convenient to have an elevator up here, but it sure is odd to have one lead to the attic.
I guess it’s convenient to have an elevator up here, but it sure is odd.

Attic15_02.value: Well... Might as well fix it up all the same. Perhaps later I can get an engineer to fix it properly.
Well... might as well fix it up all the same. Perhaps later I can get an engineer to fix it properly.

Attic15_03.value: Maybe I can find out where it leads and see what it was truly used for...

Attic16_01.value: Well... That’s the attic, done and dusted.
Well... that’s the attic, done and dusted.

Attic16_03.value: But I think this part of the mansion is complete! I should probably head on over to the western part.

Attic16_04.value: I understand the office over there needs some work!

AtticCharacterTask1_01.value: Well... time to get rid of all this old junk.

AtticCharacterTask1_02.value: Junk?! Dearie, if I thought it was just junk, I wouldn’t have put it in the attic, would I?

AtticCharacterTask1_03.value: Grandma! You snuck up on me! Well, most of this stuff is worthless. Besides, I wouldn’t mind never seeing some of it again!

AtticCharacterTask1_04.value: I understand, dearie. But perhaps, instead of just throwing it away, you might find it a new home?

AtticCharacterTask1_05.value: Everything deserves a second chance, right?

AtticCharacterTask1_06.value: I... I guess you’re right Grandma.

AtticCharacterTask2_01.value: Grandma, a lot of these things are just broken pieces!

AtticCharacterTask2_02.value: Ah, I remember this... It belonged to your mother. She kept the pieces, hoping to make a necklace one day.

AtticCharacterTask2_03.value: I guess she never got around to it...

AtticCharacterTask2_04.value: Well, I’m sure someone will! Let’s make sure these get donated! They are very pretty, after all!

AtticCharacterTask3_02.value: Ha! That devilish thing! Your grandpa spent months building that little ship.

AtticCharacterTask3_03.value: Never seen him work so hard in his life! Hahaha. Michael loved it and couldn’t believe how it fit.

AtticCharacterTask3_04.value: Aaaw. Maybe this will bring the same joy to someone else?

AtticCharacterTask4_01.value: Oooh, that’s a nice dress! Was it yours?

AtticCharacterTask4_02.value: Yes, it was, in fact! Cut a fine figure too.

AtticCharacterTask4_03.value: I wonder if it still fits?

AtticCharacterTask5_01.value: This rug has been barely touched! It’s almost brand new!

AtticCharacterTask5_02.value: Oh, crumbs! So he was right!

AtticCharacterTask5_04.value: Your Grandpa swore he bought a carpet on one of our holidays, but I never believed him! I guess he was right!

AtticCharacterTask6_01.value: There we go. That wasn’t so bad now, was it, dearie?

AtticCharacterTask6_02.value: Ha! You sure know how to make attic cleaning fun.

AtticCharacterTask6_03.value: And I admit... Going through all these memories with you was really nice.

AtticCharacterTask6_04.value: Now, I’ll just chuck this box of opened envelopes away and-

AtticCharacterTask6_05.value: Oh no, dearie. Not those! I might need them!

AtticPOI_BlanketFortress_01.value: I'm slowly starting to remember how I would come up here as a child and have picnic here!

AtticPOI_BlanketFortress_02.value: That's probably why setting up this blanket fort came back to me so easily.

AtticPOI_BlanketFortress_03.value: It was my perfect little escape! Especially during hide and seek.

AtticPOI_BlanketFortress_04.value: And this blanket! Dad bought it for me on one of his work trips. The little airplanes always reminded me of him...

AtticPOI_CheersForShears_01.value: Oh, look, there's a little write up on "Cheers For Shears".

AtticPOI_CheersForShears_02.value: It's probably something related to Eddie from the Music Studio.

AtticPOI_CheersForShears_03.value: I was right! It mentions that Eddie was a part of this band but as a producer.

AtticPOI_CheersForShears_04.value: The band was led by a couple who-

AtticPOI_CheersForShears_05.value: The rest is all smudged. Ugh. Guess I'll have to dig around these old boxes to find out more...

AtticPOI_Mirror_01.value: Ooh! I almost wiped this smudge off while I was cleaning until I realized...

AtticPOI_Mirror_02.value: It's mom's handwriting! B+M for Becky and Michael!

AtticPOI_WeddingBouquet_01.value: I don't believe it! It's mom's original wedding bouquet from their special day!

AtticPOI_WeddingBouquet_02.value: I think I see carnations and pink roses... how lovely!

AtticPOI_WeddingBouquet_03.value: I adore that they saved so much of their wedding here.

AtticPOI_WeddingBouquet_04.value: It deserves a special place. I'll make sure to honor their wedding day and their love!

AtticPOI_WeddingShoes_01.value: I just saw mom's bridal shoes so this must be dad's wedding shoes...

AtticPOI_WeddingShoes_02.value: The very same shoes that they walked down the aisle in.

AtticPOI_WeddingShoes_03.value: I bet they had a beautiful first dance in these shoes!

AtticPOI_WeddingShoes_04.value: And I hope they continue to dance wherever they are...

BabyChair_01.value: Grandma, why is there a baby chair here?

BabyChair_02.value: Don't you remember, dearie? This was yours when you were little.

BabyChair_03.value: No way! But, come to think of it, I do have some vague memories of this room...

Backgammon_01.value: Backgammon? This seems a bit out of place...

Backgammon_02.value: But then again, I've seen people gamble over a game of backgammon in the movies...

Band_02.value: Judging from the instruments, I think they used to play jazz.

Band_03.value: I wish I could have been a fly on the wall.

Banned_Description.value: Your account has been temporarily suspended.
Your account has been permanently suspended.

Banned_Duration.value: Your account has been suspended for {0}

Bathroom02_01.value: Boy, you weren't kiddin'! You got a gusher here!

Bathroom02_02.value: I know! You must be Ash. Is there anything you can do?

Bathroom02_03.value: Of course there is! They don't call me The Plumber for nuthin'!

Bathroom02_04.value: Now, let's take a closer look!

Bathroom02_05.value: ...Oww! I'm okay, I'm okay! But, just in case, could you call an ambulance?

Bathroom03_02.value: Are you sure you're alright? That fall looked painful. And your leg...

Bathroom03_03.value: Oh this? Pfff... This always happens! There ain't a bone in my body I haven't sacrificed for the line of duty!

Bathroom03_05.value: Come to think of it, not really, no. Funny that! Aaanyhoo, let's get to work!

Bathroom04_01.value: Oh no! Another leak! But, explain to me again why I'm doing all the work?

Bathroom04_02.value: It's like this, see... I offer a different type of service. While other plumbers FIX your problem, I do something far more valuable.

Bathroom04_03.value: Offer knowledge! While we, meaning you, fix the problem, you will learn at the same time how to fix future problems. It's my guarantee!

Bathroom04_04.value: I see... So, if this springs a leak again, I'll be able to fix it on my own?

Bathroom04_05.value: Exactly! Of course, I'll send you a small bill afterward, for using the knowledge I've given you...

Bathroom04_07.value: Ha! Just kidding! Pass me the wrench, will ya? Let me help you out a bit...

Bathroom05_01.value: You know... I'm a HUGE fan of Skatie Katie!

Bathroom05_03.value: Yeah, I love skateboarding, so she's sort of an idol to me. She invented them after all.

Bathroom05_04.value: So, when you called, I couldn't pass up the chance to visit the old home of Skatie Katie!

Bathroom05_05.value: If you want, after all this, I can show you her beach house?

Bathroom05_06.value: REALLY? That would be so cool!

Bathroom06_03.value: Maaaaggie! I'm just calling to see how things are coming along? Swimmingly, I hope?

Bathroom06_04.value: It's Maddie! Wait... Victoria!? Are you behind this?!

Bathroom06_05.value: Behind what?! Can't I be concerned for my fellow citizens? I certainly hope you're not drowning in trouble like you are in debt?

Bathroom06_07.value: I'm not! A word of advice... Don't let your time slip away! A-hahahahaa!

Bathroom06_09.value: I'm really starting to dislike her...

Bathroom06_10.value: Victoria? Oh, man, never get on her wrong side!

Bathroom07_01.value: What do you know about Victoria?

Bathroom07_02.value: This must have been about two-three months ago, right? I was at their place, installing a new guest jacuzzi and-

Bathroom07_04.value: Shhh! So I was wrenching the main pump into place again because the pressure of the water feed was too low see, and-

Bathroom07_06.value: ... AND Victoria and her husband Bruno, the mayor, were having this HUUUGE fight.

Bathroom07_08.value: Shhh! So there I was, wrenching -

Bathroom07_10.value: Oh right, the fight! She was yelling about overstepping boundaries, he went on about the credit card. It was mad. Just like on reality TV!

Bathroom08_02.value: Well, Victoria got REAL angry, started throwing stuff around. Almost hit me in the head with a cue ball!

Bathroom08_03.value: Bruno calmed her down, saying he had some sort of plan that'll get them out of trouble. Something to do with a... Buford Hall?

Bathroom08_05.value: Yes, thats it! Said he had BIG plans for it, and he's put things in motion to make sure it all works out.

Bathroom08_06.value: It took the better part of the day to fully calm her down. Once she gets going, she doesn't stop! So, watch out!

Bathroom08_07.value: Why would the mayor and Victoria have plans for our mansion?!

Bathroom09_01.value: Alright! Almost done. Just one last thing left!

Bathroom09_03.value: Well... I gotta come clean with you. My leg doesn't feel too bad anymore, but you were so eager to help that I didn't dare stop you.

Bathroom09_04.value: So, I have a surprise for you!

Bathroom09_06.value: Yeah, but it'll take some time. Come back in a few hours!

Bathroom10Outro_03.value: Sure is, luxury model of my own design! Just like the one Victoria has... Er- had.

Bathroom10Outro_05.value: Yep, and remember when I said she overspent the credit card? Well, her payment bounced and she owed me.

Bathroom10Outro_06.value: My finest work and I wasn't going to be paid?! I went over there to get what was lawfully mine. Which in turn is now...

Bathroom10Outro_07.value: Yours. Couldn't think of a more deserving person!

Bathroom10Outro_08.value: So this was what you were working on! I'm guessing there was no aunt? Ash! I... I don't know what to say?!

Bathroom10Outro_09.value: Haha! A thank you will do for now, but just don't forget to pay the bill!

BathroomIntro_01.value: There! Got the door open with the crowbar!

BathroomIntro_02.value: Now, to see where that water is coming fro-

BathroomIntro_05.value: Gosh darn it, does anything work in this mansion?!

BathroomIntro_06.value: I see you have a leak, ma'am...

BathroomIntro_07.value: Jeez, what gave you that idea?!

BathroomIntro_08.value: Sarcasm will not be of much use, I'm afraid...

BathroomIntro_09.value: May I recommend that you call a plumber instead, ma'am?

BathroomLeak_01.value: This key looks exactly like the sketch behind the photo!

BathroomLeak_02.value: It has to be the gallery key! I can't wait to open it!

BathroomLeak_03.value: Wait, do I hear water running? Oh nooo!

BeachJuiceBar02_01.value: Well, I guess this is it!

BeachJuiceBar02_02.value: Has the look of an abandoned lounge, but what else was I expecting?

BeachJuiceBar02_04.value: I can imagine people coming here, relaxing and hanging out.

BeachJuiceBar02_05.value: I bet Skatie and Casey were amazing company!

BeachJuiceBar03_02.value: I’ve always liked photography coffee table books. Wait, this one is Casey’s!

BeachJuiceBar03_03.value: It looks the be about their marine adventures. I should give it a look-see once I’ve finished up the place.

BeachJuiceBar04_01.value: These lounge chairs are quite cozy!

BeachJuiceBar04_02.value: Aah, nothing beats that fresh salt air either...

BeachJuiceBar04_03.value: I can just imagine myself, taking a break, enjoying a cold fruity drink and soaking up the sun...

BeachJuiceBar05_01.value: Let’s just spruce it up a little, shall we?

BeachJuiceBar05_02.value: A few surfboards here and there with fairy lights should do the trick.

BeachJuiceBar05_03.value: I’m sure Casey and Skatie won’t mind!

BeachJuiceBar06_01.value: This must be where the magic happened.

BeachJuiceBar06_02.value: I think in the other shack with those odd ingredients was where they experimented on different juice combinations.

BeachJuiceBar06_03.value: And that menu was probably something they were working on.

BeachJuiceBar06_04.value: But this... This is where it was supposed to happen.

BeachJuiceBar06_05.value: I’ll make them proud. And might as well try a few of their drinks while I’m at it.

BeachJuiceBar07_01.value: Ooof... Those are some hefty speakers for a small place like this...

BeachJuiceBar07_04.value: A filing cabinet? Here? That’s strange.

BeachJuiceBar07_05.value: Hmmm... These look like notes on marine biology.

BeachJuiceBar07_06.value: And a dissertation on the effects of music on marine animals! Perhaps even a way to communicate?

BeachJuiceBar07_07.value: Skatie had a marine biology degree! This is so interesting.

BeachJuiceBar08_01.value: And that is as they say...

BeachJuiceBar08_03.value: A tidy beach is a happy beach.

BeachJuiceBar08_04.value: Until the next tide rolls in, that is.

BeachJuiceBar08_05.value: I wonder if there are one of those robotic cleaners for beaches?

BeachJuiceBarIntro_01.value: Ah... Looks like I won’t be getting to the other island as easily as I thought.

BeachJuiceBarIntro_02.value: I guess I could try to risk it, but...

BeachJuiceBarIntro_03.value: I’d still come back to this and fix it up, anyway.

BeachJuiceBarIntro_04.value: So might as well start here!

BeachJuiceBarIntro_05.value: Perhaps I can grab a nice cold juice after all this from their juice bar!

BeachShackExterior02_01.value: Ungh! Finally, I got it open!
Ugh! Finally, I got it open!

BeachShackExterior02_03.value: Hmm, that’s odd. There really isn’t a message except something that looks like co-ordinates.

BeachShackExterior02_04.value: And the letters C and S! These co-ordinates point to something out at sea... An island, perhaps?
And the letters C and S! These co-ordinates point to something out at sea... an island, perhaps?

BeachShackExterior02_05.value: You know what? I’m going to check it out! You’ll hold the fort while I’m gone, right Rufus?

BeachShackExterior02_07.value: That’s a good boy! I hope this boat can get me there.

BeachShackExterior03_01.value: Oh wow! This looks like an abandoned beach shack!

BeachShackExterior03_02.value: But... Who owned it? And why did they leave co-ordinates to it in a bottle? Hmm...

BeachShackExterior03_03.value: Darn, the door’s locked. Maybe there’s a key around here somewhere?

BeachShackExterior03_04.value: Well, it won’t hurt to clean up the beach a bit, and perhaps I’ll find the key while I’m at it!
Well, it won’t hurt to clean the beach up a bit, and perhaps I’ll find the key while I’m at it!

BeachShackExterior04_01.value: These surfboards look vintage but expensive!

BeachShackExterior04_02.value: Wait... C and S. Casey and Skatie! This must be their surfboards.

BeachShackExterior04_03.value: This island must have belonged to them, but I wonder what happened?

BeachShackExterior04_04.value: Why did they send out a message in a bottle?

BeachShackExterior04_05.value: Hmm... I think I’ll find more answers inside once I find the key.

BeachShackExterior05_02.value: Quite an odd place to be in, though... I don’t think this was deliberately hidden.

BeachShackExterior05_03.value: More like cast aside. And looking at the state of the place, with everything boarded up...

BeachShackExterior05_04.value: Someone must have come here afterwards to do it.

BeachShackExterior05_05.value: Well... Let’s get inside and figure this out!

BeachShackExteriorIntro_01.value: It’s nice to take a break once in a while!

BeachShackExteriorIntro_05.value: What is it, boy? Did you find something?

BeachShackExteriorIntro_06.value: Hmm... Looks like a glass bottle! No... A message in a bottle!

BeachShackExteriorIntro_08.value: Let’s see if we can get it open!

BeachShackInterior02_02.value: And that ship’s wheel as a mirror is pretty unique as well.

BeachShackInterior02_03.value: Casey and Skatie sure did like a nautical theme!

BeachShackInterior02_04.value: And using packing crates as a sofa is a nice touch.

BeachShackInterior03_02.value: Grandma used to tell me a bedtime story about two kids being attacked by a shark!

BeachShackInterior03_03.value: And how they escaped on a half eaten surfboard!

BeachShackInterior03_04.value: It must have been about Casey and Skatie! And this must be the surfboard!

BeachShackInterior04_02.value: This spice rack looks really interesting!

BeachShackInterior04_03.value: Cajun blend, tzatziki mix, sumac... Dried cloudberries? Quite the eclectic mix.

BeachShackInterior04_05.value: I guess there’s no harm in trying some... spices are pretty safe.

BeachShackInterior04_08.value: Make.. It... Stop...! I gotta eat something else to neutralize this!

BeachShackInterior04_09.value: What’s this? Army rations?! I can’t eat that! How old is it?!

BeachShackInterior04_10.value: Ugh! How does that taste keep lingering?!

BeachShackInterior06_02.value: I wonder how often Casey and Skatie would sit here and just...be.

BeachShackInterior06_03.value: Not a care in the world... So far away from everything stressful.

BeachShackInterior07_01.value: Aaw... There they are... Casey and Skatie.

BeachShackInterior07_03.value: I wish I had a relationship that was as strong and everlasting...

BeachShackInterior07_04.value: But it looks like my ship got lost at sea with only me as the sole passenger.

BeachShackInterior08_02.value: A juice bar menu? Casey and Skatie owned a juice bar?!

BeachShackInterior08_03.value: That must be what the other shack is about!

BeachShackInterior08_04.value: I should head over there next since this place is back in shape!

BeachShackInteriorIntro_03.value: I guess it’s more like outside, judging by the condition...

BeachShackInteriorIntro_05.value: Looks like a hurricane came through here.

BeachShackInteriorIntro_06.value: Hmmm... That could actually be the case, come to think of it.

BeachShackInteriorIntro_07.value: Well... I’m sure after I clean this place up, I’ll learn more about Casey and Skatie.

Birdcage_02.value: Must have been a big bird.

Birdcage_04.value: Or perhaps this was what passed as decor years ago.

BlueRug_01.value: The floor was pretty cold, but nothing a nice warm rug can't fix!

Bonus_BlackCard_01.value: I got this as a present for my birthday. I was told to only use it for emergencies.

Bonus_BlackCard_02.value: I think fixing up this mansion qualifies as an emergency!

Bonus_BlackCard_03.value: Try dragging it onto any item with a lightning symbol on it.

Bonus_BlackCard_04.value: That will increase the item’s level.

Bonus_BlackCard_05.value: Two Lightning Cards can be stacked together to combine their charges.

Bonus_BlackCard_06.value: Where did I put my Lightning Card? Or did I loan it to someone?

Bonus_BlueCard_01.value: I really do like the color blue...the color of the bright sky!

Bonus_BlueCard_03.value: You do? How about after trying this?

Bonus_BlueCard_04.value: Try dragging it onto any item without a lightning symbol.

Bonus_BlueCard_05.value: That will increase the item’s level.

Bonus_BlueCard_06.value: Two Blue Cards can be stacked together to combine their charges.

Bonus_BlueCard_07.value: That's nice but I still prefer orange.

Bonus_BlueCard_08.value: Darling, you will learn to appreciate blue in time.

Bonus_Booster_Description.value: TAP to activate, Doubles the speed of neighboring items.  MERGE Booster with other Booster to stack time amount of two.

Bonus_Booster_Information.value: TAP to activate, Doubles the speed of neighboring items.  MERGE Booster with other Booster to stack time amount of two.

Bonus_Scissors_02.value: Rumor has it that this will give its owner good fortune.

Bonus_Scissors_03.value: You can drag these scissors onto any item to split it into the two previous level items in the merge chain.
You can drag these scissors onto any item to split it into the two previous level items in the Merge chain.

Bonus_Scissors_04.value: Two Scissors can be merged into one to stack their charges.

Bonus_Scissors_05.value: Sometimes you just need to tear things down to build them back up again.

Bonus_Unlimited_Energy_01.value: Double tap on the Unlimited Energy item to activate it.

Bonus_Unlimited_Energy_02.value: While Unlimited Energy is active, your energy will never run out!

BoosterItems_Additional.value: Once activated with a double tap, Boosters will double the speed of the timers for items on the surrounding tiles for a limited duration. Higher-level Boosters recharge items for longer before disappearing from the Merge Board.

Once activated with a double tap, Time Chargers will double the speed of the timers for items on the surrounding tiles for a limited duration. Higher-level Time Chargers recharge items for longer before disappearing from the Merge Board.

BoosterShardItems_Additional.value: Merge Booster Shards past Level 4 to create a Booster. Boosters will double the speed of the timers for the items on the surrounding tiles when activated. Higher-level Boosters recharge items for longer.

BoultonBluePoster_01.value: What do you think of the poster, Babylon?

BoultonBluePoster_02.value: You think it is a fair representation of a Boulton Blue?

BoultonBoulevard_02_01.value: Well, this sign had seen better days, but now it’s as good as new!

BoultonBoulevard_02_02.value: And if anything would confirm that I’m in the right place, it would be a sign that says,

BoultonBoulevard_02_04.value: I should probably amend this sign a little after I’m done with the place.

BoultonBoulevard_02_05.value: It’s not really going to be a working factory anymore...

BoultonBoulevard_02_06.value: It’s going to be something MUCH better.

BoultonBoulevard_03_01.value: Such a large garden, it's not the first thing that comes to mind when I think about a tin can factory.

BoultonBoulevard_03_02.value: I wonder if Ignatius and the workers used to take their breaks sitting by the river...

BoultonBoulevard_03_03.value: And gathering secrets from any visitors.

BoultonBoulevard_03_04.value: I bet some of those secrets are still hiding in the overgrowth.

BoultonBoulevard_03_05.value: Good thing I'm here to uncover them!

BoultonBoulevard_04_01.value: Hmm... I don’t know much about this place!

BoultonBoulevard_04_02.value: Apart from what I’ve read, of course.

BoultonBoulevard_04_03.value: And that whole tin can chaos during the storm that revealed that this place was collecting people’s secrets.
And that whole tin can chaos during the storm revealed that this place was collecting people’s secrets.

BoultonBoulevard_04_04.value: But surely there’s more to it than just that! This place wasn’t just a cover!

BoultonBoulevard_04_05.value: I should give Winston a call. If anyone knows our family history the best, it would be him!

BoultonBoulevard_04_06.value: Also, he’s the only one I trust to give me a somewhat straight answer.

BoultonBoulevard_04_10.value: Yes, of course! I was wondering if you could join me at the tin can factory?

BoultonBoulevard_05_01.value: How may I be of service, Ma’am?

BoultonBoulevard_05_02.value: I’ve decided to fix up the old factory! And was wondering if you could tell me a little about it?

BoultonBoulevard_05_03.value: It’s more rust than roof right now, but there’s something about this place. It feels... Proud.

BoultonBoulevard_05_04.value: Ah. That pride comes from Agatha. Ignatius may have built this factory, but she gave it soul.

BoultonBoulevard_05_05.value: I’ll admit, this place isn’t like your typical smoke and noise factory...

BoultonBoulevard_05_06.value: Not at all, Ma’am. Ignatius believed that function didn’t exclude beauty.

BoultonBoulevard_05_09.value: That was Agatha’s domain. She inspected it daily, I believe. Not a hedge dared grow wild under her watch.

BoultonBoulevard_05_10.value: Sounds like the factory ran on more than just steam.

BoultonBoulevard_05_11.value: Despite its dubious history, Ma’am, it ran on the passion of two very powerful people in love.

BoultonBoulevard_06_01.value: Agatha's pristine garden, Ignatius' meticulous brickwork, the factory crafting the family's inventions...

BoultonBoulevard_06_02.value: Our history feels as close here as in the old mansion.

BoultonBoulevard_06_03.value: Not just the Boultons' history, Ma'am. This factory brought prosperity like Hopewell Bay had never seen.
Not just the Boulton's history, Ma'am. This factory brought prosperity like Hopewell Bay had never seen.

BoultonBoulevard_06_04.value: I believe that most residents can still name a relative or two who used to work on these grounds.

BoultonBoulevard_06_05.value: I've decided, we're turning the factory into a museum! This history deserves to be shared.

BoultonBoulevard_06_06.value: Not only fixing a factory, but rebuilding a legacy. You're a Boulton, through and through.

BoultonBoulevard_06_07.value: No pressure... I'll call Julius, he can help me get on top of the permits from the start.

BoultonBoulevard_06_08.value: Very prudent, ma'am. Given your history with the council.
Very prudent, Ma'am. Given your history with the council.

BoultonBoulevard_07_01.value: Hey! There seems to be a plaque hidden under these bushes!

BoultonBoulevard_07_02.value: Well spotted, Ma’am. That would be their time capsule.

BoultonBoulevard_07_03.value: Oh, cool! I wonder what will be inside? I guess there’s no harm in trying to dig it out!

BoultonBoulevard_07_05.value: Ugh... Nothing’s working! That thing is never coming out!

BoultonBoulevard_07_06.value: Have you tried the secret latch on the side, Ma’am?

BoultonBoulevard_07_07.value: What secret- Oh! Hey! It came loose! How’d you know that would be there?!

BoultonBoulevard_07_08.value: I didn’t. But I assumed that there’d be one. With this family, there’s always a secret latch, door...

BoultonBoulevard_07_10.value: Alright, alright, I get the point.

BoultonBoulevard_08_01.value: Oh wow! There’s so much stuff in here!

BoultonBoulevard_08_02.value: Old tin cans, newspaper clippings, even letters from residents! This is incredible!

BoultonBoulevard_08_03.value: I should give Jackie a call. This would make a great story.

BoultonBoulevard_08_04.value: It would indeed, Ma’am. This time capsule was placed here by the mayor, if I recall.

BoultonBoulevard_08_05.value: A great honor bestowed upon the Boultons for its 20th anniversary.

BoultonBoulevard_08_06.value: Ooh, there’s even a letter addressed to the future mayor and a... Wait, is this... Code?

BoultonBoulevard_08_07.value: It would seem so. Unsurprising if you ask me! Ignatius was always into secret codes.

BoultonBoulevard_08_08.value: Perhaps it has something to do with what the factory was REALLY about?

BoultonBoulevard_08_11.value: And rob you of all the fun, Ma’am?

BoultonBoulevard_09_01.value: Hmmm.. Looks like the remains of a bell.

BoultonBoulevard_09_02.value: Indeed, Ma’am. That was Agatha’s. She cast it herself, you know? Pure tin and it rang twice a day.
Indeed, Ma’am. That was Agatha’s. She cast it herself, you know? Pure tin, and it rang twice a day.

BoultonBoulevard_09_04.value: Precisely. She believed in structure. A well-run garden, a well-run household...

BoultonBoulevard_09_06.value: It was said she treated the workers like family and always cared for them like a mother.

BoultonBoulevard_09_07.value: Then let’s make sure it will ring again in her memory!

BoultonBoulevard_10_01.value: What a cute little kiosk. Was this also part of the factory?

BoultonBoulevard_10_02.value: Indeed, Ma'am. This used to be the worker's café, it was run by your cousin Cherry's great-grandmother.

BoultonBoulevard_10_03.value: I need to invite her here. Cooking must run on their side of the family!
I need to invite her here. Cooking must run in their side of the family!

BoultonBoulevard_10_04.value: What a lovely spot for a quick lunch break, right by the river.

BoultonBoulevard_10_05.value: I wouldn't blame the workers for getting lost in time before rushing back in to finish their shifts.

BoultonBoulevard_10_06.value: Luckily, the Boulton matriarch owned a rather large bell.

BoultonBoulevard_10_07.value: This will be the museum's café! I'm sure guests will love the outdoor seating.

BoultonBoulevard_10_08.value: And enjoying the boulevard at their own leisure.

BoultonBoulevard_11_01.value: The water wheel’s completely jammed. It’s just packed with leaves and debris.

BoultonBoulevard_11_02.value: It is quite unfortunate. That wheel used to power a third of the machinery inside.

BoultonBoulevard_11_03.value: I thought it was just for show!

BoultonBoulevard_11_04.value: No Ma’am. Agatha designed it herself. While coal was all the rage, she was very adamant about using the river.

BoultonBoulevard_11_05.value: Not only did it give power, but it was quiet, efficient, and self-sustaining.

BoultonBoulevard_11_06.value: Made for a more comfortable and productive work environment.

BoultonBoulevard_11_08.value: Agatha was quite ahead of her time. She believed beauty should be useful and not destructive.

BoultonBoulevard_11_09.value: I want to get it working again. Not just for display. I mean REALLY working.

BoultonBoulevard_11_10.value: I want it to run the museum and have it showcase the factory’s innovative spirit!

BoultonBoulevard_11_11.value: Not to mention being a great teaching tool about renewable energies.

BoultonBoulevard_12_02.value: Ah yes. This was donated to the factory after the fire in ‘24. A freak lightning strike, if I recall.

BoultonBoulevard_12_03.value: It had taken out half the eastern wall before they got the fire under control.

BoultonBoulevard_12_04.value: This firetruck was the one that answered the call. Afterwards, it remained here. Ever vigilant.
This fire truck was the one that answered the call. Afterward, it remained here. Ever vigilant.

BoultonBoulevard_12_05.value: Well, at least the fire didn’t take out this flag.

BoultonBoulevard_12_06.value: That banner was indeed lucky to survive. It was raised every morning. Flying bright over every shift change.

BoultonBoulevard_12_07.value: It’s going up again. A great reminder of the history of this place.

BoultonBoulevard_13_01.value: I knew this place mattered, but I didn’t realize how much until now.

BoultonBoulevard_13_02.value: Most things don’t reveal their value until someone bothers to look closely, Ma’am.

BoultonBoulevard_13_03.value: Well, I’m looking and I’m not stopping. This museum is going to tell the entire story!

BoultonBoulevard_13_04.value: The people. The Work. The legacy.
The people. The work. The legacy.

BoultonBoulevard_13_05.value: The outside is ready. Time to see what’s been waiting inside all these years.

BoultonBoulevard_13_06.value: Shall I bring the keys, Ma’am?

BoultonBoulevard_13_07.value: Bring everything. I’ve got secrets to uncover!

BoultonBoulevard_14_01.value: Hey, Julius, it's Maddie. I've decided to reopen the tin can factory as a museum.

BoultonBoulevard_14_02.value: The Boulton factory? My word! That's remarkable.

BoultonBoulevard_14_03.value: I was hoping you could help me with the paperwork and zoning permits.

BoultonBoulevard_14_04.value: I'll draft the application today! But first I must inspect the grounds, I'm on my way right now.

BoultonBoulevard_14_05.value: Thank you, Julius. But you really don't need to rush.

BoultonBoulevard_14_06.value: Understood. Let me finish my coffee and I'll be on the way with my best pen in hand!

BoultonBoulevard_14_Dialogue_01.value: Hey, Julius, it's Maddie. I've decided to reopen the tin can factory as a museum.

BoultonBoulevard_CharacterTask01_01.value: So it's true that you're renovating the old tin can factory.

BoultonBoulevard_CharacterTask01_02.value: What, the mansion wasn't enough of a headache for you?

BoultonBoulevard_CharacterTask01_03.value: Holden?! What are you doing here? I don't have time for your schemes.

BoultonBoulevard_CharacterTask01_04.value: Relax, I'm here as a photographer for The Holden Howler. No schemes.

BoultonBoulevard_CharacterTask01_05.value: Oh, right. How's your tabloid doing these days?

BoultonBoulevard_CharacterTask01_06.value: Thriving, obviously. And it's not just a tabloid!

BoultonBoulevard_CharacterTask01_07.value: Or it won't be, if you let me cover this place. Big story potential.

BoultonBoulevard_CharacterTask01_08.value: Fine. But you get limited access. And I'm watching you.

BoultonBoulevard_CharacterTask02_01.value: So, why the sudden interest in the old factory?

BoultonBoulevard_CharacterTask02_02.value: Just uncovering more of your family's infamous history, or do you have bigger plans for it?

BoultonBoulevard_CharacterTask02_03.value: You sure ask a lot of questions. But yes, I do have bigger plans for it.

BoultonBoulevard_CharacterTask02_04.value: I'm a journalist! It would be unethical for me to not ask this many questions.

BoultonBoulevard_CharacterTask02_05.value: Right... What's your interest in this, anyway? I thought your paper only covered gossip and scandals.

BoultonBoulevard_CharacterTask02_06.value: Gossip? At The Howler we call it "democratic storytelling".

BoultonBoulevard_CharacterTask02_07.value: And there's nothing wrong with covering scandals, but every now and then we need a positive story.

BoultonBoulevard_CharacterTask02_08.value: This factory has brought many people to Hopewell Bay before. If it could do it again...

BoultonBoulevard_CharacterTask02_09.value: Just think of the impact it'd have on The Holden Howler's sales.

BoultonBoulevard_CharacterTask03_01.value: Are you sure your sudden interest here has nothing to do with a certain... incident?

BoultonBoulevard_CharacterTask03_02.value: You know the one, when a storm spread cans filled with secrets all over Hopewell Bay.

BoultonBoulevard_CharacterTask03_03.value: Good try. When it comes to that, I know as much as you do.

BoultonBoulevard_CharacterTask03_04.value: Sounds like the Boultons are still keeping their cards close to their chest...

BoultonBoulevard_CharacterTask03_05.value: "SECRETS IN THE SOUP? - Infamous can factory reopens after being 'suspiciously closed' for decades!"

BoultonBoulevard_CharacterTask03_06.value: Holden... Are you sure you're not working for Victoria anymore?

BoultonBoulevard_CharacterTask03_07.value: Of course not! I'm just brainstorming headlines. I'll think of something else.

BoultonBoulevard_CharacterTask04_01.value: So, those big plans you mentioned. Anything more to share?

BoultonBoulevard_CharacterTask04_02.value: I guess the cat's out of the bag now. I'm turning the factory into a museum.

BoultonBoulevard_CharacterTask04_03.value: Brilliant! You'll want maximum buzz for this! Crowds, headlines, the works.

BoultonBoulevard_CharacterTask04_04.value: Lucky for you, The Holden Howler's got reach!

BoultonBoulevard_CharacterTask04_05.value: We could even throw in discount coupons for visitors. Partnership perks!

BoultonBoulevard_CharacterTask04_06.value: Holden, I agreed to let you cover the renovation, but that's it. No partnership.

BoultonBoulevard_CharacterTask04_07.value: C'mon, think bigger! You'll end up regretting this.

BoultonBoulevard_CharacterTask05_01.value: I took some great pictures! The whole town will be looking forward to the "Boulton's Secret World of Cans".

BoultonBoulevard_CharacterTask05_03.value: Just thought of a name for your museum, figured you could use help from a pro.

BoultonBoulevard_CharacterTask05_04.value: Holden... I'm not letting you name my museum.

BoultonBoulevard_CharacterTask05_06.value: But honestly, thank you for letting me cover this. I really needed a good scoop.

BoultonBoulevard_CharacterTask05_07.value: Thank you too, Holden. I'm sure your article will bring more visitors to the museum.

BoultonBoulevard_CharacterTask05_08.value: And even more sales to the Howler!

BoultonBoulevard_Intro_01.value: Alright! Here we are at last!

BoultonBoulevard_Intro_02.value: These two lions are familiar, so this place belongs to Boultons alright!
These two lions are familiar, so this place belongs to the Boultons, alright!

BoultonBoulevard_Intro_03.value: The infamous tin can factory. The heart of the Boulton Family fortune.

BoultonBoulevard_Intro_04.value: And some might even say it’s downfall.
And some might even say its downfall.

BoultonBoulevard_Intro_05.value: But, how about we change that, huh?

BoultonBoulevard_Intro_06.value: I have plans for you, factory...

BoultonBoulevard_Intro_08.value: And while I’m doing that, I’ll snoop around a little and learn all your dirty secrets.

BoultonBoulevard_Intro_09.value: I’m sure to find more answers here about Dad and that criminal organization.

BoultonBoulevard_POI_Dock_01.value: That's a pretty small dock. They used to ship cans from here?

BoultonBoulevard_POI_Dock_02.value: By daylight, I suppose. Other shipments were better left to the dead of night.

BoultonBoulevard_POI_Dock_04.value: The kind that preferred no paperwork, ma'am.

BoultonBoulevard_POI_FireTruck_01.value: So this old hero saved the factory, then got put on permanent display?

BoultonBoulevard_POI_FireTruck_02.value: And it was remakably preserved. The leather hose alone could tell stories.

BoultonBoulevard_POI_FireTruck_03.value: Bet it never thought it'd retire as factory mascot.

BoultonBoulevard_POI_FireTruck_04.value: Better than scrap, ma'am. Some histories deserve to keep their shine.

BoultonBoulevard_POI_Fountain_01.value: A tin can fountain? That's... oddly charming.

BoultonBoulevard_POI_Fountain_02.value: I believe this was Agatha's touch, ma'am.  She believed even humor should be structurally sound.

BoultonBoulevard_POI_Fountain_03.value: And so she plopped a giant can in the garden? I like her style.

BoultonBoulevard_POI_Fountain_04.value: I hear she measured the water arc to the centimeter. "A proper fountain shouldn't splash the begonias."

BoultonBoulevard_POI_Fountain_05.value: Let's rebuild it so perfectly, even the flowers won't know it's new!

BoultonBoulevard_POI_Kiosk_01.value: This little place kept the whole factory running, didn't it?

BoultonBoulevard_POI_Kiosk_02.value: The rhythm of the workday was set here, ma'am. Assisted by Agatha's bell.

BoultonBoulevard_POI_Kiosk_03.value: The old menu had a coffee and sandwich combo for two cents. No wonder they loved it!

BoultonBoulevard_POI_Kiosk_04.value: A strategic investment. Well-fed workers were 35% less likely to dent the production-line cans.

BoultonBoulevard_POI_Kiosk_05.value: Let's hope this also works for museum guests and exhibits.

BoultonBoulevard_POI_LeftGarden_01.value: The garden's coming together nicely, ma'am.

BoultonBoulevard_POI_LeftGarden_03.value: Without question. It has her same meticulous touch.

BoultonBoulevard_POI_LeftGarden_04.value: Then I'll make sure it thrives.

BoultonBoulevard_POI_MaintenanceDoor_02.value: Unless it was maintaining something worth hiding, ma'am.

BoultonBoulevard_POI_MaintenanceDoor_03.value: Okay, now I need to know what's behind Door Number Spy.

BoultonBoulevard_POI_Mosaic_02.value: A rather elegant homage, if I may say so.

BoultonBoulevard_POI_Mosaic_03.value: Functional made beautiful. Who knew tin cans belonged in a gallery?

BoultonBoulevard_POI_Mosaic_05.value: I guess they inspired more than just factories.
