CBE_AmeliaBoulton2024_AmeliaBust_Dialogu.value: Only a couple dozen of this bust were ever made. It is the crown jewel of my collection!
She's very impressive, I give you that. Do you think there's a family resemblance?
Hmmm... In the mystery department, at least!

CBE_AmeliaBoulton2024_AmeliaMedallion_Di.value: I love all this old kitsch! You need to be like a super fan to collect all of these things!
Ahem... This medal is particularly valuable, my dear - VERY sought after by people who know about these things.
Err... Of course. It's very nice!

CBE_AmeliaBoulton2024_Bookcase_Dialogue_.value: I can see that Amelia did a lot for the town. She founded a hospital, a school, even a shelter for the poor...
It seems like she appeared here out of thin air... without a past or a family.
Where did she come from, and what made her do all of that work for the town?

CBE_AmeliaBoulton2024_ClosedTrunk_Dialog.value: This little compartment is locked... with a combination lock!
It looks old, but I'm sure they didn't exist back in Amelia's day!
Hmm... Someone WAS trying to hide something -- but they weren't expecting to have me on the case!
I'll show this to Julius. He'll be able to help - I know it!

CBE_AmeliaBoulton2024_CompleteCamera_Dia.value: There's a whole box of old glass squares, labeled "The Amelia Riot." What are these?
Ah! They are dry plate photographs! But these seem to be undeveloped...
I didn't see anything about the "Amelia Riot" in the books you showed me.
Is there a way to develop these photographs?? There could be something important in them!

CBE_AmeliaBoulton2024_Decoration_Slot02_.value: She was well-traveled... later in life, that is. We don't really know anything about her life from before her arrival here in Hopewell Bay.
There must be something at the library - they have a whole section about her!
I am always up for some good old-fashioned detective work. To the library!

CBE_AmeliaBoulton2024_Decoration_Slot05_.value: Do you remember all those old racing trophies we found in the attic?
They were all Amelia's! She was a race car driver, and a good one, too.
A race car driver? Now, she is a woman after my own heart.

CBE_AmeliaBoulton2024_Decoration_Slot08_.value: Have I told you Amelia is my hero?
Absolutely! She was a brave, daring woman, who didn't hesitate to stand up for what she thought was right.
There's something we could all learn from that, don't you think?
Thank you for putting on this exhibition about her, Maddie. I know it came at a short notice, but you really delivered.
You can thank Julius - I couldn't have done any of this without his help!

CBE_AmeliaBoulton2024_Decoration_Slot15_.value: I love Amelia's old things. Did you find anything in her old trunk?
We found the usual stuff! Bows, shoes, hats... and a secret compartment!
It turned out there was a lot more to Amelia than we first thought. She had many sides she never shared with the world.

CBE_AmeliaBoulton2024_EndPopup_Descripti.value:
Thank you for playing the Legacy Lane event!
You can claim all your unclaimed items here!

CBE_AmeliaBoulton2024_ExtendPopup_Descri.value:
The Legacy Lane event has sadly come to an end.
Event Merge Board and Merge Tasks will be closed now.

CBE_AmeliaBoulton2024_ExtendPopup_Header.value: The Legacy Lane event is about to end!

CBE_AmeliaBoulton2024_FamilyPortrait_Dia.value: That's Amelia in the photo, isn't it?
It most certainly is! The image of the man has been scratched away - on the glass plate itself...
So, she was married - or at least engaged. Something frightful must have happened to them.
I guess Amelia came here to get away from a bad situation and to build a new life.
And we can assume that she managed to escape from this man's clutches... at least for a while.

CBE_AmeliaBoulton2024_GrandMonument_Dial.value: I get it now -- you know, why she's so important in this town.
She worked so hard to make it better for everyone...
She gave everyone a chance for a new beginning - but she wanted one herself, so she hid her past.
And her descendants kept her secret.

CBE_AmeliaBoulton2024_Hat_Dialogue_01.value: I don't know anything about Amelia. What was she like? Where did she come from?

CBE_AmeliaBoulton2024_Hat_Dialogue_03.value: If you really want to find out more, ask Julius. He can answer all your questions!

CBE_AmeliaBoulton2024_Hat_Dialogue_04.value: And he has not visited for a while... Maybe you should pay him a visit and make sure he has not expired under a pile of stamps.

CBE_AmeliaBoulton2024_HighTech_Dialogue_.value: This is quite a set-up you've got here, Julius.
Are those empty energy drink cans and pizza boxes??
Errr, Herbert instructed me that they provide the best nutrition while surfing the old Web.
Errr, my nephew instructed me that they provide the best nutrition while surfing the old Web.
But to get back to Amelia, she has always piqued my interest. Famous, yet so mysterious.
I found some brand-new information that seemed questionable at first, but I cross-referenced everything and...
I think I have the answer to your problem, my girl.

CBE_AmeliaBoulton2024_HistoricalMap_Dial.value: Wow, this town has some history!
Pirates, coal mines, a tin can factory...
I bet it looked pretty different back when Amelia first arrived here.
Somehow she turned the place around and gave people hope.

CBE_AmeliaBoulton2024_InfoPanel_Decorati.value: An upgrade for the Amelia Boulton Exhibition is available!

CBE_AmeliaBoulton2024_InfoPanel_Descript.value:
The Legacy Lane event has started!
Complete Event Merge Tasks and earn Event Points.

The Legacy Lane event has started!
Merge items on the merge board and earn Event Points.

CBE_AmeliaBoulton2024_InfoPopup_Task.value: Discover the best Amelia Boulton memorabilia!

CBE_AmeliaBoulton2024_IntroDialogue_Dial.value: Pearl, hi! I'm great. How are you? You sound kinda hyper...
Amelia Boulton Day? I think I've heard something about that...
Y-yes, I know she's MY ancestor, but there's a LOT I don't know about my family...
Well, anyway... A parade? Wow, that sounds great!
Grandma will know more? I'll see what we can do. Talk to you later!
That was Pearl on the phone. Apparently, it's Amelia Boulton Day soon, and she wanted to know if we have something we could exhibit.
I suppose it is that time again... We have some of Amelia's old items - her trunk and other old luggage.
Sounds great! But... who was she? I just know she founded the town, founded the hospital and did a lot of good -- but there must be so much more!
If there is, I do not know it, dearie.
Amelia was, and still is, something of a mystery!

CBE_AmeliaBoulton2024_IntroPopup_Descrip.value: According to the town's official history, Amelia Boulton made Hopewell Bay what it is today - a thriving town where anything is possible. But where did she come from - and what did she do to earn such acclaim? Join Maddie and Julius on a quest to uncover the truth, because some stories are not told in history books...

CBE_AmeliaBoulton2024_IntroPopup_Header.value: Learn about the history of Hopewell Bay - and its great lady, Amelia Boulton!

CBE_AmeliaBoulton2024_JuliusCrazyWall_Di.value: I am terribly sorry about my appearance...
You see, my nephew, you may remember Herbert - he's still asking about you - came to visit me for the Hopeberry Harvest Festival.
You see, my nephew came to visit me for the Hopeberry Harvest Festival.
He was shocked to find that I still search for information in BOOKS! So, he kindly bought me a computer and a printer, too.
I found a great many interesting things on the Web, but I'm afraid the time got away from me...
Did you say you wanted to ask me about Amelia Boulton?
Err... yeah, I did. We have an old trunk of hers, but there's a weird locked compartment.
Do you have ANY idea who set the lock and why... and what's behind it?

CBE_AmeliaBoulton2024_LadyAboutTown_Dial.value: These are some of Amelia's old clothes.
There are plenty of old things up in the attic, but who knows which ones belonged to her!
I know! There's everything from old racing trophies to piles and piles of dusty, old books!
*Sigh* I guess I'll just start looking...

CBE_AmeliaBoulton2024_LevelUpPopup_Descr.value: Collecting Amelia Memorabilia items with green arrows allows you to Merge them one level further next time!

CBE_AmeliaBoulton2024_MemorialClock_Dial.value: Amelia is EVERYWHERE in Hopewell Bay!
She has her own street, park - even a statue - but so little is known about her.
*Sigh* Yes... The family secrets started with her and just kept on piling up...

CBE_AmeliaBoulton2024_Modem_Dialogue_01.value: Maddie, dear girl! What a pleasure. It feels like we have not met for a while...

CBE_AmeliaBoulton2024_Modem_Dialogue_02.value: No, it has been a hot minute! I wanted to see you about Amelia Boulton -- but what's happened to you??

CBE_AmeliaBoulton2024_MysteryLockCode_Di.value: After much careful research, I ended up with a strange code. I did not know what it was, but...
Could it be the code for the lock?
There is only one way to find out!

CBE_AmeliaBoulton2024_OldLetter_Dialogue.value: *Gasp!* The locked compartment contained old letters and postcards, all sent to Amelia from Veilwood and signed "BB."
One of them says, "You made a timely escape. The situation is dire, and they are looking for you."
So, Amelia came to this town because she was running from someone. VERY interesting...
Let's see what else these letters reveal!

CBE_AmeliaBoulton2024_OutroDialogue_Dial.value: Are you sure you didn't know the truth about the role Amelia played in the story of Hopewell Bay?
Having said that, I am very impressed by...
Her courage to fight the good fight?
The woman was great at keeping a secret!

CBE_AmeliaBoulton2024_RacingCar_Dialogue.value: Another one of Amelia's secrets is revealed!
She wasn't some meek, little woman. This lady was a racer!
Between Amelia's need for speed and Grandma's love of motorbikes and planes, wild hobbies seem to run in the family!

CBE_AmeliaBoulton2024_ShopProgressionPop.value: Collect Event Points by completing the Legacy Lane event merge tasks and get all the Legacy Lane decoration sets!

CBE_AmeliaBoulton2024_SmallTrunk_Dialogu.value: Aren't there any family legends about Amelia?
Apart from the things everyone knows, she was not really spoken about much...
Who knows? Maybe it would be best to leave it alone, dearie.
Why am I not surprised to hear you say that?

CBE_AmeliaBoulton2024_StampedLetters_Dia.value: This letter says, "You have completed work on your cottage, but the land behind it stands vacant..."
Are they talking about Grandma's cottage? Did Amelia build it?
"A grander house would be fitting, but it could invite unwanted attention."
They must mean the Mansion! I had no idea its history meanders so far back in our family history.
These letters do indeed shed light on Amelia's actions, but they seem to raise more questions...
Who is the writer referring to with "unwanted attention?" I think I need to return to the Web for more information!

CBE_AmeliaBoulton2024_StartPopup_Descrip.value: What brought Amelia Boulton to Hopewell Bay - and what made her so great? Help Julius and Maddie uncover the truth!

CBE_AmeliaBoulton2024_TaskPlay_Descripti.value: Merge items and discover new decorations!

CBE_AmeliaBoulton2024_TeaserPopup_Descri.value: Please reach a higher level to play the event.

CBE_AmeliaBoulton2024_TurningPoint_Dialo.value: Look at these photos! I feel like we're traveling right back in time!!
There was a riot in town... People were so angry about their living conditions and the miserable work in the mines...
And Amelia emerged from the crowd to lead the protest!

CBE_Anniversary2025_CaseOpen_01_Dialogue.value: I cannot believe you found Charlie's old suitcase! I was certain it was lost forever!
But how did you guess I had the key??
You're Charlie's friend - you just said you even helped him escape once - so you seemed like my best bet.
Very clever, Mason. But I'm afraid you will have to hand the suitcase over to Ursula.
I think she has been looking for it for a good while!

CBE_Anniversary2025_Case_01_Dialogue_02.value: Okay... So, I found something kinda weird.

CBE_Anniversary2025_Case_01_Dialogue_04.value: Well, I was fishing one day, and I thought I'd hooked a big mola mola, but it wasn't a fish at all. It was a big old suitcase!

CBE_Anniversary2025_Case_01_Dialogue_05.value: But it's locked! And I know it's important, and it has Charlie's initials on it.

CBE_Anniversary2025_Case_01_Dialogue_06.value: I've kept it a secret, but I figured someone might have the key to open it. Now I think I was right. Julius?

CBE_Anniversary2025_Clippings_03_Dialogu.value: Fine, I'll tell you a secret.
Yesss! And remember, it has to be juicy - like the one Julius told us!
Someone in my family ended up being accused of something they didn't do, and I wasn't able to help her.
I felt totally powerless, so I found a way to bring the truth into the light.
And now you're trying to do the same here, at the Mansion?
Something like that. And you all KNOW there's more than meets the eye at this place.

CBE_Anniversary2025_ExtendPopup_Descript.value:
"The Game of Five Secrets event has sadly come to an end.
Event Merge Board and Merge Tasks will be closed now."

"The Five-Year Secret Celebration event has sadly come to an end.
Event Merge Board and Merge Tasks will be closed now."

CBE_Anniversary2025_ExtendPopup_Header.value: The Game of Five Secrets event is about to end!
The Five-Year Secret Celebration event is about to end!

CBE_Anniversary2025_Furniture_03_Dialogu.value: Wow! I just saw Grandma's polishing all the best dining room furniture.
That means it's going to be a REALLY fancy dinner party - just like in the old days!
That means we're going to have a REALLY fancy dinner party - just like in the old days!

CBE_Anniversary2025_Furniture_07_Dialogu.value: The extra special table cloth, cleaned, starched and ironed, and the family porcelain all lined up.
Seems like we're invited to one of the Boultons' legendary parties!
Who knows what we're in for, but I have to admit... I'm kinda excited!

CBE_Anniversary2025_Grandma_02_Dialogue_.value: My guests, welcome! You have played my game of secrets well, and now it is your turn to ask the questions.
I will pull them out of the hat, one by one. The first one is...
"Why was the Mansion abandoned? Because of the Mafia? Why did you hide the Mansion from Maddie?"
Hrmm... There are three questions here.
But one question just isn't enough!
Fine, let's see. The costs of keeping up the Mansion are exorbitant, as you can imagine.
After Charlie... disappeared, I just could not afford it. Coming back to the old house was painful, so I kept away.
How about the Mafia? Is there a connection?
You have watched too many movies, my dear Jackie.

CBE_Anniversary2025_Grandma_05_Dialogue_.value: Next question: "What happened to Charlie and where is he now?"
I believe you wrote this one, Maddie.
The honest answer is that I believed him to be deceased, until... Well, now I do not know where he is.
I wish I could give you a better answer, but your Grandpa has always been a very secretive man.
Perhaps we will find out one day - I certainly hope so.

CBE_Anniversary2025_Grandma_08_Dialogue_.value: The third question: "Did you dress up as the Ghost on Halloween? If not, do you know who did?"
Roddy, I am aware of your feelings towards ghosts, but I did not contrive to give you a fright last Halloween.
I personally believe it was Pearl. After all, she was the one who boasted about her great ghost costume.
That is my answer, and I'm sticking to it.

CBE_Anniversary2025_Grandma_10_Dialogue_.value: On to the next one. "Did you ever receive a letter from me about 20 years ago?"
B-but, did you? Receive a letter?
Not that I remember. Should I have?
Err, I suppose not... Never mind!

CBE_Anniversary2025_Grandma_11_Dialogue_.value: "Where do babies come from?" Mason, I presume this question is yours.
My question is, can you REALLY fly a plane?
Let's just say that I have spent enough time in a Boulton T99 to know which end is up.

CBE_Anniversary2025_InfoPanel_Descriptio.value:
"The Game of Five Secrets event has started.
Complete Event Merge Tasks and earn Event Points."

The Five-Year Secret Celebration event has started.
Complete Event Merge Tasks and earn Event Points.

CBE_Anniversary2025_IntroPopup_Descripti.value: You're cordially invited to the 5th anniversary dinner party at Beaumont Hall, celebrating Maddie and Grandma's five-year journey of renovation and secrets. But be warned - the evening's entertainment might take you by surprise...

When invitations to a mysterious dinner party land on the doorsteps of five people around Hopewell Bay, it is clear there will be more on offer than just hors d'ouvres. With secrets revealed and hidden histories unearthed, the evening's entertainment will not leave a single participant cold.
The Game of Five Secrets is about to begin - and you are invited.
The Five-Year Secret Celebration is about to begin - and you are invited.

CBE_Anniversary2025_IntroPopup_Header.value: The Game Is About to Begin...

CBE_Anniversary2025_Intro_Dialogue_01.value: I've noticed that Grandma's acting a bit weird. I mean, weirder than usual!

CBE_Anniversary2025_Intro_Dialogue_02.value: Honestly, Maddie - that just sounds like Ursula being Ursula.

CBE_Anniversary2025_Intro_Dialogue_03.value: But she was rummaging around in the closets, going through the old table linens and porcelain.

CBE_Anniversary2025_Intro_Dialogue_04.value: I think I even saw her shining the silver cutlery!

CBE_Anniversary2025_Intro_Dialogue_05.value: Hmmm... Maybe she's planning a dinner party!
Hmmm... Maybe she's planning a dinner party.

CBE_Anniversary2025_Intro_Dialogue_06.value: I wonder... Could it be for the 5th anniversary?

CBE_Anniversary2025_Invitation_03_Dialog.value: Did you receive a sealed letter from Ursula?
I did - an invitation to a dinner party! Did you?
You did? The whole thing seems a bit mysterious to me...
What's so mysterious about it? She's cooking us a yummy dinner!

CBE_Anniversary2025_Invitation_07_Dialog.value: But listen to this part: "The evening will include some entertainment - a traditional Boulton party game."
"This one time, you are allowed to ask me anything at all, and I will answer any question."
"Upon arrival, please write a question on the piece of paper provided. Each guest may ask ONE question, so think carefully."
THAT is a traditional Boulton party game? You couldn't make this stuff up!

CBE_Anniversary2025_Jackie_03_Dialogue_0.value: Jackie, what is your secret? What dark history are you hiding?
No dark history here, folks. I don't have any secrets, you know that.
Really? You've been writing about the Mansion for a long time.
True, and you've done a lot of research about it.
So what? I'm telling you - I'm an open book.

CBE_Anniversary2025_Jackie_07_Dialogue_0.value: What made you want to become a journalist?
I have a hunger for the truth. I wanna believe that good journalism can right wrongs and expose lies.
What kind of wrongs? Have you been wronged?
Wow, we're really just laying it all out there!

CBE_Anniversary2025_Julius_02_Dialogue_0.value: O-oh, right. My secret is... that I really hate peas.
Mason's right. It has to be something juicy, like you hid the key to the Mansion, or burned down the Sauna, or helped Charlie disappear!
I never hid the key to the Mansion or burned down the sauna, I assure you!
Wait-- But you helped Charlie disappear?

CBE_Anniversary2025_Julius_07_Dialogue_0.value: Julius, did you help Grandpa Charlie disappear?
I-- I did help him ONCE, a long time ago.
There was an issue with... his work, and I rustled up some supplies to help him keep a low profile.
What issue?? Where did he go?
I think he already told us one secret.

CBE_Anniversary2025_Maddie_05_Dialogue_0.value: And then it's Maddie's turn. I just can't imagine what secrets you could be hiding!
Okay... This is not a total secret, but not all of you know what first brought me to Hopewell Bay.
You found out about the Mansion, right?
Yes, but only after my life had spectacularly fallen apart.
My fiancé left me at the altar. Then our house mysteriously burned down, so I was pretty much out of a home.
It was awful, but I'm fine now! The Mansion was exactly the distraction I needed to get over everything.

CBE_Anniversary2025_Maddie_05_Dialogue_1.value: And I've made great friends in the process.

CBE_Anniversary2025_MansionMysteries_05_.value: What are you going to ask her, Jackie? Are your reporter's senses tingling?
I don't even know where to begin! I have about a million questions.
I know exactly what I want to know.
Hey, the game hasn't started yet!

CBE_Anniversary2025_MansionMysteries_07_.value: Maddie, what are you going to ask? You must have so many questions...
My Grandma never gives up her secrets - and I mean, NEVER.
I've spent years - pretty much five years so far - trying to uncover the mystery of this Mansion, and Grandma.
Well, are you ready to finally hear the truth?

CBE_Anniversary2025_Outro_Dialogue_01.value: Is the game of secrets really a Boulton tradition?

CBE_Anniversary2025_Outro_Dialogue_02.value: It is, indeed. Our ancestors were masters at keeping secrets, but they also knew how to have a good time.

CBE_Anniversary2025_Outro_Dialogue_03.value: I know I am not always exactly straight-forward about everything, but I hope you got some answers you have been looking for.

CBE_Anniversary2025_Outro_Dialogue_04.value: I think I did... But it's not like you to throw dinner parties.

CBE_Anniversary2025_Outro_Dialogue_05.value: True, but I thought we were due a little bit af fun for all the hard work we have done over the last, well, five years.
True, but I thought we were due a little bit of fun for all the hard work we have done over the last five years.

CBE_Anniversary2025_Outro_Dialogue_06.value: The Mansion looks better than it has in a LONG time, and that is certainly worth a celebration.

CBE_Anniversary2025_Outro_Dialogue_07.value: I guess you're right. It's been a pretty busy few years, but I wouldn't change a thing.

CBE_Anniversary2025_Outro_Dialogue_08.value: Here's to us and the Mansion, Grandma!

CBE_Anniversary2025_Puzzle_04_Dialogue_0.value: Has your Grandma taken up a new hobby?
I saw her tinkering with an old movie projector. She had a big pile of old slides and film.
Old slides and film? What is she up to??
I think I need to do some old-fashioned snooping...
I think I need to do some good old-fashioned snooping...

CBE_Anniversary2025_Puzzle_07_Dialogue_0.value: Have you noticed anything strange about Grandma? Do you think she's been more secretive than usual?
All I know is that whenever Ursula gets very secretive, something is afoot.
That I could not tell you.
I have my suspicions, my dear, but I have an inkling we will find out soon enough.
But I have an inkling we will find out soon enough.

CBE_Anniversary2025_Questions_03_Dialogu.value: So we can ask her ANYTHING?
Sounds like it... a-and then we owe her one secret each?
Yup. This must be one of the famous Boulton party games I read about.
So we just write our questions on these pieces of paper and put them in the hat?
Then Grandma will pull them out one by one and answer them? And she'll tell us the truth about anything we want to know??

CBE_Anniversary2025_Roddy_05_Dialogue_01.value: Looks like you're going to start, Roddy! What's your secret?

CBE_Anniversary2025_Roddy_05_Dialogue_02.value: M-my secret? Do I really need to tell one?

CBE_Anniversary2025_Roddy_05_Dialogue_03.value: That's how the game works, my man. Out with it!

CBE_Anniversary2025_Roddy_05_Dialogue_05.value: Maybe you have some dark family secrets, too!

CBE_Anniversary2025_Roddy_05_Dialogue_06.value: No, no, nothing like that, but... maybe there is one thing.

CBE_Anniversary2025_Roddy_05_Dialogue_08.value: There's someone I really like, but I just can't tell her.

CBE_Anniversary2025_Roddy_05_Dialogue_09.value: Is that so? Who is it? Why can't you tell her?

CBE_Anniversary2025_Roddy_05_Dialogue_10.value: Hey, we were only asked for ONE secret!

CBE_Anniversary2025_Serving_05_Dialogue_.value: Is it your Grandma's birthday? Is that why she's organizing a dinner party?
No... and she'd never throw big party for herself anyway.
I've read about the dinner parties they used to have at Beaumont Hall.
But I think it's to do with us... and the Mansion. It's been five years since we started renovating this place.
They were lavish affairs with all the trimmings.
Five years?? Has it really been THAT long?
Yup. And that's absolutely worth celebrating!
Speaking of which, I've read about the dinner parties they used to have at Beaumont Hall.
The party games were pretty legendary, too.
Apparently, they were lavish affairs with all the trimmings.
The party games were pretty legendary, too.

CBE_Anniversary2025_Slides_02_Dialogue_0.value: Is it just the five of us?
Looks that way. The table is only set for five people.
Isn't Ursula going to join us?
And why is that projector set up at the top of the table?
Maybe we should switch it on and see what happens?

CBE_Anniversary2025_Slides_04_Dialogue_0.value: You are probably wondering why I invited you here tonight.
As it happens, this is a special occasion - and soon it will be even more special.
As it happens, today marks a VERY special anniversary - five years since Maddie and I returned to Beaumont Hall. What a journey it's been!
I asked all of you to write down one question for me, but there is a catch!
And soon, you will get to experience a true Boulton tradition.
In exchange for one of my secrets, you will have to give up one of your own.
I asked all of you to write down one question for me, but there's a catch!
In exchange for one of my secrets, you will have to give up one of your own.

CBE_Anniversary2025_StartPopup_Descripti.value: You are cordially invited to a dinner party with very special entertainment. Please arrive promptly!

CBE_BackyardBash2024_BackyardTheaterActi.value: Welcome to our Halloween movie marathon, everyone!
I'm not Maddie! I'm Grandma Ursula, dearie!
You don't look bad yourself, by the way! But be careful with those scissors...
That classic ghost costume is great, Pearl!
Let's get the movies rolling. Find a seat, grab some snacks, and enjoy!

CBE_BackyardBash2024_BoxOfBeasts_Dialogu.value: What are you dressing up as this Halloween, Pearl?
I've got a ghost costume - like a sheet. You know, I love the classics!
My costume's top secret! But I promise it will be AMAZING!

CBE_BackyardBash2024_BoxOfDecorations_Di.value: Roddy, could you get the candy cauldron?
Come on! I couldn't let a good costume go to waste!

CBE_BackyardBash2024_CandyOgre_Dialogue_.value: Who's the winner of the costume competition?
Pearl! I think your ghost costume just won the "best Halloween costume" vote.
Maddie, didn't you get my texts? My costume didn't arrive, so I've been running late...
You're right... I can see your message here.
I didn't get a chance to read it with everything going on...
So who was it in the ghost costume?

CBE_BackyardBash2024_CauldronOfCandy_Dia.value: Mason! What have I said about sneaking up on people??

CBE_BackyardBash2024_CreepyCrawlies_Dial.value: Everything is ready for the trick-or-treaters!
Enter the house of horrors at your own risk! Mwahahahahah!
I'm just joking -- it's totally safe.

CBE_BackyardBash2024_CushionedChairs_Dia.value: What's your favorite horror flick, Maddie?
I'm not sure... But nothing that takes place in a haunted mansion, that's for sure!

CBE_BackyardBash2024_DancingSkeleton_Dia.value: So what is it with you and ghosts?
Why are you scared of ghosts?
But I'm not scared of g-g-ghosts!!

CBE_BackyardBash2024_GhastlyGhost_Dialog.value: Even Ignatius got a Halloween make-over!
He looks pretty convincing, doesn't he?
I think a ghost costume is the creepiest of all.
Because you can't really know who's really hiding underneath...

CBE_BackyardBash2024_GhoulishHalloweenGu.value: Your Halloween movie marathon was an excellent idea.
I do not remember the last time I had so much fun!
Halloween in the Mansion used to be...
Well, Halloween was your Grandpa Charlie's favorite holiday.
He would always go ham with the decorations and treats - just like you did.
Do you think... Could the ghost have been Charlie??
I'm not so sure. I think he was here!

CBE_BackyardBash2024_InfoPanel_Descripti.value:
The Spooktacular Backyard Bash event has started!
Complete Event Merge Tasks and earn Event Points.

CBE_BackyardBash2024_IntroPopup_Descript.value:
On the menu: A Halloween movie marathon, creepy costumes, and good old-fashioned trick-or-treating...

...but who is the extra guest dressed up as a ghost? And who toilet papered Grandma's house??

CBE_BackyardBash2024_IntroPopup_Header.value: Grab your treats and pull up a seat - Spooktacular Backyard Bash is about to begin!

CBE_BackyardBash2024_Intro_Dialogue_01.value: The skeletons should go here... And a big, bubbling cauldron here.

CBE_BackyardBash2024_Intro_Dialogue_04.value: Just decorating the place for Halloween.

CBE_BackyardBash2024_Intro_Dialogue_06.value: Yeah, but... what's wrong with you, Roddy? You look as white as a ghost!

CBE_BackyardBash2024_Intro_Dialogue_07.value: G-ghost?? I think I need to go...

CBE_BackyardBash2024_Intro_Dialogue_08.value: What's up with him? You'd almost think he's...

CBE_BackyardBash2024_JunkDrawer_Dialogue.value: This will be a Halloween to remember!
The backyard theater will need all kinds of things.
Seating, a projector... And I can't forget about snacks!

CBE_BackyardBash2024_LevelUpPopup_Title.value: Collecting Charms with green arrows allows you to Merge them one Level further next time!

CBE_BackyardBash2024_MaddiesClothes_Dial.value: Halloween is always great, but I'd like to do something extra special this year...
I get it. Let's give everyone a chance to have a good time.
Exactly. How about... a Halloween movie marathon?
Oh, I like that! We can make it old school, with Halloween candy. And a costume competition!
The Mansion will need more decorations, too.
It's pretty scary as it is...
You send the invitations out. I'll get to work on the movie theater!

CBE_BackyardBash2024_MaddiesHalloweenGet.value: My costume could not be more perfect.
I can't wait to see Grandma's face!
What were you doing in my closet?
Wha-- Nothing, just looking for... aaaa... scarf.

CBE_BackyardBash2024_MonstrousMutt_Dialo.value: The Mansion has never looked this haunted before. It is almost... ghostly!
I know. There's something weird in the air this Halloween...
I feel like something might jump out at any mom---

CBE_BackyardBash2024_MovieProjector_Dial.value: Everything is pretty much ready. It's gonna be so much fun!
Wow, what a cool ghost costume!
Where did you put the snacks?
I guess she's really getting into her character...

CBE_BackyardBash2024_ScaryClown_Dialogue.value: I know it's Halloween, but does it feel... creepier than normal?
Funny you mention it... I've been thinking the same.
I kinda feel like someone is watching us!
Maybe we're just paranoid with all these skeletons around.

CBE_BackyardBash2024_StaircaseOfHorrors_.value: Roddy, do you want to tell us why you're so weird about ghosts?
My cousins played a trick on me one Halloween, a long time ago.
They thought it would be hilarious to surprise me, dressed up as ghosts.
I get it. I used to be scared of ghosts, too.

CBE_BackyardBash2024_StartPopup_Descript.value: This Halloween serves tricks, treats, and surprises - so join Maddie and her friends, and get ready to play!

CBE_BackyardBash2024_Supermarket_Dialogu.value: Maddie, it's really important that you don't skimp on the treats.
You need a LOT of treats.
Cause if you don't have enough treats, you might get a trick!

CBE_BackyardBash2024_ToiletPaperedHouse_.value: Masooooon! Did you toilet paper Grandma's cottage??

CBE_BackyardBash2024_UtilityKnife_Dialog.value: So, I just need the lights and the cushions...
Pheeeww, Mason, you made me jump! W-what is that outfit?
L-like it? It's great. I just...
Aaaah, I get it! You're afraid of ghosts!

CBE_BackyardBash2024_VideoStore_Dialogue.value: I'm SO excited about the Halloween movie marathon!
Please, please pick REALLY scary films!
Aren't you a little bit too young to watch REALLY scary movies?

CBE_Easter2023_AFluffleOfRabbits_01.value: That's a whole bunch of rabbits.

CBE_Easter2023_AFluffleOfRabbits_04.value: A group of rabbits is called a fluffle, dearie.

CBE_Easter2023_AFluffleOfRabbits_05.value: Oh, like a school of fish, or pride of lions?

CBE_Easter2023_AFluffleOfRabbits_06.value: Or my favorite... A murder of crows.

CBE_Easter2023_Bike_01.value: Good ol' MasonMobile! I've changed its parts so many times. I don't think it's even the same bike anymore...

CBE_Easter2023_Bike_02.value: Hey! There are some more eggs in the basket! This Rabbit is good...

CBE_Easter2023_BubbleGum_01.value: That's it for the flavor, but not for the gum!

CBE_Easter2023_BubbleGum_02.value: I have a whole PILE stashed away... Just in case.

CBE_Easter2023_Cbeeaster2023Toys_01.value: My wonderful loot! It's taken many a birthday to fill this up!

CBE_Easter2023_Cbeeaster2023Toys_02.value: Which reminds me, I should ask for bigger one. One can never have too many toys!

CBE_Easter2023_Cbeeaster2023Toys_03.value: Hey, it has eggs in it!

CBE_Easter2023_ChocolateAvenue_02.value: This'll take forever to get out!

CBE_Easter2023_ChocolateAvenue_03.value: Come to think of it, how did so much chocolate end up in the driveway?!

CBE_Easter2023_ChocolateAvenue_04.value: Maddie! Good thing I found you! Have you seen Mason? He's been at the chocolate eggs again!

CBE_Easter2023_ChocolateEggsLvl1_01.value: Hmmm... Are these chocolate eggs something I should be collecting as well? Naaah...

CBE_Easter2023_ChocolateEggsLvl1_02.value: Detective work is hard and I need the energy!

CBE_Easter2023_ChocolateEggs_01.value: How clever! But not clever enough for Detective Mason!

CBE_Easter2023_ChocolateEggs_02.value: Hiding eggs inside other eggs won't fool me Rabbit!

CBE_Easter2023_Closet_01.value: I should put my slingshot in here before my mom finds out...

CBE_Easter2023_Closet_02.value: There are more eggs in here! This Rabbit is a clever one.

CBE_Easter2023_CuteRabbitHole_02.value: I'd keep clear of that one, lady; his black beady eyes bode ill intent!

CBE_Easter2023_CuteRabbitHole_03.value: Well, I think he's adorable - wait a minute! Is that chocolate around your face?

CBE_Easter2023_DecoratedTree_03.value: The Rabbit has hung these eggs here to mock me! Just at the right height too, so I can't reach them...

CBE_Easter2023_DecoratedTree_04.value: Well... I can give you one if you want?

CBE_Easter2023_DecoratedTree_05.value: And ruin the fun?! C'mon, lady, you have no idea how to be a kid!

CBE_Easter2023_DecoratedTree_06.value: That's because I'm not a kid!

CBE_Easter2023_Decoration_21_Description.value: Proceed with caution: chocolatey treats ahead

CBE_Easter2023_Decoration_22_Description.value: Open to chicks & bunnies this season

CBE_Easter2023_EasterEgg_01.value: This is awesome! I'm like a master detective!

CBE_Easter2023_EasterEgg_02.value: I should stash these away, so the Rabbit can't steal them back!

CBE_Easter2023_EggCart_01.value: I've made sure there'll be plenty of eggs to go around!

CBE_Easter2023_EggCart_02.value: I can see that dearie, how did you get so many?

CBE_Easter2023_EggCart_03.value: You know the baker in town? She hooked me up.

CBE_Easter2023_EggCart_04.value: Cherry? Hmmm, I don't know... I don't trust her.

CBE_Easter2023_EggCart_06.value: Your pies will always be the best!

CBE_Easter2023_EggPaintingStation_01.value: Hi, Roddy! Painting some eggs I see?

CBE_Easter2023_EggPaintingStation_02.value: Yeah, I'm helping some of the kids out with their eggs.

CBE_Easter2023_EggPaintingStation_03.value: Huh... I didn't take you as an artist!

CBE_Easter2023_EggPaintingStation_04.value: Actually, before becoming an architect, I thought about being an artist!

CBE_Easter2023_EggPaintingStation_05.value: Oh please, I bet you were born with that safety hat on! But... I do like the color.

Thank you for playing the Amazing Egg Hunt! 
All your rewards have been claimed!

CBE_Easter2023_ExtendPopup_Header.value: Oh no, The Amazing Egg Hunt is about to end!

CBE_Easter2023_FlashSale_Header.value: Oh boy, what an egg hunt!

CBE_Easter2023_FleaMarket_01.value: Wow... I didn't know I'd get so much for my school desk. I'm sure the teacher won't notice!

CBE_Easter2023_FleaMarket_02.value: Hold on... My mom is calling.

CBE_Easter2023_FleaMarket_03.value: Hi Mom! Yeah, it's going great! No, I haven't done anything embarrasing yet...
Hi, Mom! Yeah, it's going great! No, I haven't done anything embarrassing yet...

CBE_Easter2023_Frog_01.value: How ya doing, little guy? Wait, what's this?!

CBE_Easter2023_Frog_02.value: Aha! Another egg stash! I'm hot on your trail Rabbit, no hiding from me now!

CBE_Easter2023_GoldenEgg_01.value: Hey... This is different from the others!

CBE_Easter2023_GoldenEgg_02.value: A golden egg! Is this part of Rabbit's plan? I should collect these as well...

CBE_Easter2023_InfoPanel_Description.value:
The Amazing Egg Hunt is on!
Find Easter Eggs and collect them to unlock decorations!

CBE_Easter2023_InfoPanel_Title.value: Oh boy, what an egg hunt!

CBE_Easter2023_IntroDialogue_01.value: So... This rabbit thinks it can outsmart me, eh?

CBE_Easter2023_IntroDialogue_02.value: Well, little does it know that it has decided to match wits with the greatest detective of all time!

CBE_Easter2023_IntroDialogue_03.value: Detective Mason Wu. ...and I will find all those eggs.

CBE_Easter2023_IntroPopup_Description.value:
"Dear Mason,

Time to put your detective skills to the test! I have hidden around your Hopewell Bay home, my most treasured secret eggs. I dare you to do your best, as I’m sure you can’t find them all! Hahahahaha…

Good luck,
The Rabbit"

"Dear Mason,

Time to put your detective skills to the test! I have hidden around your Hopewell Bay home, my most treasured secret eggs. I dare you to do your best, as I’m sure you can’t find them all! Hahahahaha...

Good luck,
The Rabbit"

CBE_Easter2023_IntroPopup_Header.value: Oh boy, what an egg hunt!

CBE_Easter2023_LaundryBasket_01.value: That's it... I've looked everywhere, under everything. Even gathered all my dirty clothes to-

CBE_Easter2023_LaundryBasket_03.value: Was this the Rabbit's plan all along? Making me unwittingly clean my room and... Organize?!

CBE_Easter2023_LeftStoneFence_01.value: Aaah, Spring... Everything feels so alive!

CBE_Easter2023_LeftStoneFence_03.value: I brought you something... Mom said I had to.

CBE_Easter2023_LeftStoneFence_04.value: Oh wow... Did you make this?

CBE_Easter2023_LeftStoneFence_05.value: Yeah... I just... If you don't like it, you can throw it away.

CBE_Easter2023_LeftStoneFence_06.value: I love it! Gonna put it right up here on the wall!

CBE_Easter2023_LevelUpPopup_Description.value: Collecting Eggs with green arrows allows you to merge them one level further next time!

CBE_Easter2023_NewIntroDialogue_01.value: I wonder if the rabbit stashed some eggs over here at the creepy old mansion!

CBE_Easter2023_NewIntroDialogue_02.value: Hello? Who is that? I have a rake and, I'm not afraid to use it!

CBE_Easter2023_NewIntroDialogue_03.value: Wow! Hold your horses, I'm just a kid!

CBE_Easter2023_OutroDialogue_01.value: Mom! Look at all the eggs I've found!

CBE_Easter2023_OutroDialogue_02.value: Oh wow... That's quite a haul you got there!

CBE_Easter2023_OutroDialogue_03.value: Yeah! ...and they were hidden in the craziest of places too!

CBE_Easter2023_OutroDialogue_04.value: I had to sell my school desk to get to some of them!

CBE_Easter2023_Plushies_01.value: Hey! My plushies! I've been looking all over for these...

CBE_Easter2023_Plushies_02.value: Wait a minute... There are eggs in here! Who knew cleaning up my room would ACTUALLY be rewarding?

CBE_Easter2023_RightStoneFence_03.value: I came up with an AMAZING idea! You know how all chocolate eggs are filled with chocolate on the inside?

CBE_Easter2023_RightStoneFence_05.value: What about real eggs covered in chocolate?!

CBE_Easter2023_RightStoneFence_07.value: Hey! It's still a surprise, right?

CBE_Easter2023_Rufus'EasterRetreat_02.value: You like your special doggy house?

CBE_Easter2023_Rufus'EasterRetreat_04.value: Remeber, don't eat any of the chocolate eggs! They're bad for you.

CBE_Easter2023_Rufus'EasterRetreat_06.value: That's why I made these specials ones, just for you!

CBE_Easter2023_Rufus'EasterRetreat_08.value: Hey... There should be five of them...

CBE_Easter2023_RufusEasterRetreat_01.value: You like your special doggy house?

CBE_Easter2023_RufusEasterRetreat_03.value: Remember, don't eat any of the chocolate eggs! They're bad for you.

CBE_Easter2023_RufusEasterRetreat_05.value: That's why I made these special ones, just for you!

CBE_Easter2023_RufusEasterRetreat_07.value: Hey... There should be five of them...

CBE_Easter2023_SchoolDesk_01.value: A lot of boring hours have been spent hunching over this thing...

CBE_Easter2023_SchoolDesk_02.value: But surprisingly, it has a lot of great little hiding places for me to stash stuff!

CBE_Easter2023_SchoolDesk_03.value: ... Just don't look at the bottom. Just... No.

CBE_Easter2023_SeasonalArchway_01.value: I used to love going on your egg hunts Grandma! You used to hide them so well.

CBE_Easter2023_SeasonalArchway_02.value: Used to? I still do, dearie... You should go find them, before they spoil.

CBE_Easter2023_SeasonalArchway_03.value: Grandma, I'm too old for that now!

CBE_Easter2023_SeasonalArchway_04.value: One is never too old to have a little fun.

CBE_Easter2023_SeasonalArchway_05.value: Besides, little Mason seems to love it!

CBE_Easter2023_ShopProgressionPopup_Head.value: Oh boy, what an egg hunt!

CBE_Easter2023_StartPopup_Description.value: What's this? A challenge from a mysterious "Mr. Rabbit" to find all his eggs! Ha, little do they know that they have just matched wits with the amazing Detective Mason Wu!

CBE_Easter2023_StartPopup_Header.value: Oh boy, what an egg hunt!

CBE_Easter2023_StartPopup_Subheader.value: The Amazing Egg Hunt is starting

CBE_Easter2023_TaskPlay_Description.value: Merge Items and help Mason find easter eggs!

CBE_Easter2023_TaskProgression_Header.value: Oh boy, what an egg hunt!

CBE_Easter2023_TeasePopup_Header.value: Oh boy, what an egg hunt!

CBE_Easter2023_TeasePopup_Subheader.value: The Amazing Egg Hunt is starting!

CBE_Easter2023_TeaserPopup_Description.value: Please reach a higher level to play the Event.

CBE_Easter2023_TheKey_01.value: I never thought it would come to this!

CBE_Easter2023_TheKey_02.value: But now is the time to use...

CBE_Easter2023_ToyCupboard_01.value: I should probably start my investigation here...

CBE_Easter2023_ToyCupboard_02.value: If I were a rabbit, I'd probably hide them where I'd least expect them.

CBE_Easter2023_ToyCupboard_03.value: The beautiful mess inside is the perfect location to hide an egg...

CBE_Easter2023_TreasureChest_02.value: Mason? Why are you digging up my lawn?!!

CBE_Easter2023_TreasureChest_03.value: Desperate times, call for desperate measures, lady!

CBE_Easter2023_TreeHouse_01.value: Mason Wu's Detective Agency. Headquarters of the best detective in the WORLD.

CBE_Easter2023_TreeHouse_02.value: Also a cool place to plan mischief!

CBE_Easter2023_UltimateEggTree_03.value: It's beautiful! And mine... ALL MINE!

CBE_Easter2025_BrokenMachine_05_Dialogue.value: Roddy, do you have a second?
A flux anomaly in the cocoa particle suspension matrix disrupts the harmonic shear resonance of the tempering coils, causing unpredictable high-velocity chocolate ejection events.
I think I know how to fix it. Can you just hold a couple of things for a minute?
It shouldn't take long, just a little twist and a minor push...

CBE_Easter2025_Can_01_Dialogue_01.value: Did you make this lollipop? Did you REALLY?

CBE_Easter2025_Can_01_Dialogue_02.value: Yep! With the brand new candy machine I just built!

CBE_Easter2025_Can_01_Dialogue_03.value: You BUILT a candy machine?! That's my greatest dream!

CBE_Easter2025_Can_01_Dialogue_04.value: I used Ignatius Boulton's old drawings - remember, the ones found in the old tin can factory?

CBE_Easter2025_Can_01_Dialogue_05.value: Oh yeah! I found more of those in some of the tin cans left lying around.

CBE_Easter2025_Can_01_Dialogue_07.value: Of course! I'll get them for you right now! Maybe you can build even more cool machines.

CBE_Easter2025_Can_01_Dialogue_08.value: Maybe a toffee machine! Ooh, or a cake machine!

CBE_Easter2025_Can_01_Dialogue_09.value: I'll see what I can do.

CBE_Easter2025_CandyMachineProducing_01_.value: My candy machine is ready! I wonder what Ignatius would think about it.
His blueprints were so detailed and full of cool little innovations. He was really ahead of his time.
I guess inventing really does run in the family!
Let's see if this little gizmo does what it's supposed to.
First, I just need to add the sugar syrup and hope for the best.

CBE_Easter2025_Character_01_Dialogue_01.value: Mason, you know how I promised you chocolates?

CBE_Easter2025_Character_01_Dialogue_03.value: What do you think about lollipops?

CBE_Easter2025_Character_02_Dialogue_01.value: Cherry, you're just the person I was looking for!

CBE_Easter2025_Character_02_Dialogue_02.value: What I can do for you, Maddie?

CBE_Easter2025_Character_02_Dialogue_03.value: Are you looking for a delicious dessert or maybe some advice? Are you baking something?

CBE_Easter2025_Character_02_Dialogue_04.value: I'm trying to get everything ready for the big egg hunt. I just don't have all the ingredients I think I need.

CBE_Easter2025_Character_02_Dialogue_05.value: Could I maybe borrow a cup - or ten - of sugar?

CBE_Easter2025_Character_02_Dialogue_09.value: Then you'll need more than just sugar!

CBE_Easter2025_Character_03_Dialogue_01.value: Roddy, I totally forgot about the epic egg hunt I promised to organize for Mason!

CBE_Easter2025_Character_03_Dialogue_02.value: Oh, crud! He's been talking about it non-stop for weeks.

CBE_Easter2025_Character_03_Dialogue_03.value: I know! I had an idea to build a machine to make chocolates and other treats.

CBE_Easter2025_Character_03_Dialogue_04.value: I've got some old blueprints and a lot of parts, but there's so much to do.

CBE_Easter2025_Character_03_Dialogue_05.value: Wow! Is there anything I can do to help?

CBE_Easter2025_Character_03_Dialogue_06.value: I know I'm not exactly an engineer, but I'm pretty good at reading blueprints.

CBE_Easter2025_Character_03_Dialogue_08.value: On one condition - I want my share of the chocolates.

CBE_Easter2025_Character_04_Dialogue_02.value: Almost! I developed an auxiliary system for the glazing and it's turning out great stuff.

CBE_Easter2025_Character_04_Dialogue_03.value: I suppose you will build a cake machine next!

CBE_Easter2025_Character_04_Dialogue_06.value: Why not? I already built a candy machine AND a chocolate machine, so why not a cake machine, too?

CBE_Easter2025_Character_05_Dialogue_01.value: Phew, inventing is hard work, and there are so many little details to take care of!

CBE_Easter2025_Character_05_Dialogue_02.value: Looking at Ignatius' blueprints and notes, it looks like he always worked alone.

CBE_Easter2025_Character_05_Dialogue_03.value: He was successful and made a lot of money, but I guess he must have been pretty lonely...

CBE_Easter2025_Character_05_Dialogue_04.value: I'm so glad I've got friends I can ask for help.

CBE_Easter2025_Character_05_Dialogue_05.value: This whole egg hunt is the perfect way to say thank you!

CBE_Easter2025_ChocoMachineProducing_Dia.value: What an impressive contraption! A chocolate machine, I presume?
You presume correctly. What do you think?
Are those parts from Ignatius' old machine?
Yes... I did borrow a couple of nuts and bolts... and hoses and levers... but it all runs great, I guarantee it.
I am sure! So, what recipe are you going to use for the chocolates?
You need a recipe to make chocolates, dearie.
I think I can help. Let's get the old family recipe book.
If I remember correctly, Agatha - that's Ignatius's wife - had a good recipe for chocolates.

CBE_Easter2025_Cupboard_01_Dialogue_01.value: I can't believe you built these machines to make candy and chocolates and... all kinds of treats!

CBE_Easter2025_Cupboard_01_Dialogue_02.value: I couldn't imagine anything better, honestly!

CBE_Easter2025_Cupboard_01_Dialogue_03.value: Is there anything I can do to repay you? I'll do anything!

CBE_Easter2025_Cupboard_01_Dialogue_09.value: Can you wear your bunny costume?

CBE_Easter2025_Decoration_Slot07_Dialogu.value: I wonder what else Ignatius' old blueprints could build.
His inventions were so progressive, and I sense he never got quite as far as he wanted.
There's still something more to discover and invent...
Well, at least the egg hunt was saved and Mason is happy!

CBE_Easter2025_Decoration_Slot10_Dialogu.value: I can't believe I had to put this costume on again...
Next year, someone else can wear it, because I'm not dressing up like a bunny AGAIN! I'm just too old and cool...
And no one else has to get dressed up for the egg hunt!
Your costume is WAY better than mine!

CBE_Easter2025_Decoration_Slot14_Dialogu.value: You know, Agatha and Ignatius always organized an annual egg hunt on the Mansion grounds.
Did they? I never knew that!
Oh, yes! It is written into the annals of the Boultons' history.
Agatha had a particular recipe for her chocolate treats, that was very popular! All the children from the town would come and have a great time.
Ha-ha, very funny. I am not quite that old, my dear!

CBE_Easter2025_EasterDecorations_04_Dial.value: Come out already. We have to take a photo of you in your costume!
I'd prefer it if you didn't.
Fine. I can't help my cuteness!

CBE_Easter2025_EasterDecorations_06_Dial.value: I think everything is finally ready for the egg hunt!
We have candy, we have chocolates, we have cakes, we have...
Painted eggs! I knew I'd forgotten something!

CBE_Easter2025_EasterEggs_05_Dialogue_02.value: What is it, dearie? The chocolate machine didn't blow up, did it?

CBE_Easter2025_EasterEggs_05_Dialogue_03.value: No... the chocolate machine is fine, but I'm in serious trouble. I forgot to paint the eggs for the egg hunt!

CBE_Easter2025_EasterEggs_05_Dialogue_04.value: Could you help me? I got so carried away with the old blueprints and the machines.

CBE_Easter2025_EasterEggs_05_Dialogue_05.value: I still need to wrap the lollipops and fix a cylinder on the candy machine and...

CBE_Easter2025_EasterEggs_05_Dialogue_06.value: Don't worry about the eggs. I will take care of everything!

CBE_Easter2025_EasterEggs_07_Dialogue_01.value: Julius, you have to hurry up. We still have dozens of eggs to paint.

CBE_Easter2025_EasterEggs_07_Dialogue_02.value: You invited me over for some apple pie. I did not sign up for all of this painting!

CBE_Easter2025_EasterEggs_07_Dialogue_03.value: How many eggs do we really need for this egg hunt, Ursula?

CBE_Easter2025_EasterEggs_07_Dialogue_05.value: What is going on, Ursula? I got your message and rushed right over.

CBE_Easter2025_EasterEggs_07_Dialogue_06.value: Deb! At the nick of time, too! Here is a brush and some paints, and there are your eggs.

CBE_Easter2025_EasterEggs_07_Dialogue_07.value: What is the meaning of this?

CBE_Easter2025_EasterEggs_07_Dialogue_08.value: We are in a hurry, Deb. The sooner you start painting, the sooner we are ready for the egg hunt!

CBE_Easter2025_EasterEggs_10_Dialogue_01.value: That HAS to be it. I simply cannot paint another egg!

CBE_Easter2025_EasterEggs_10_Dialogue_02.value: I think we are done! Thank you both!

CBE_Easter2025_EasterEggs_10_Dialogue_03.value: I think I was promised pie in return for my help!

CBE_Easter2025_EasterEggs_10_Dialogue_04.value: I think my rheumatism is flaring up...

Event Merge Board and Merge Tasks will be closed now.

CBE_Easter2025_IntroPopup_Description.value: Mason is worried - it is almost Easter, and there is no sign of chocolate, sweets or even a single daffodil. Armed with the old blueprints of Ignatius's mysterious machine, Maddie steps in to engineer a device that will create the ultimate Easter treats! Just don't mind the mess...

When Maddie and Mason head out of town, Hank and Roddy are put in charge of the chocolate machine. What could possibly go wrong? As it turns out — quite a lot. One tiny mistake quickly turns into a seriously sticky situation.

CBE_Easter2025_IntroPopup_Header.value: Will Maddie's special machines bring Easter or just make a big mess?
Can Hank and Roddy clean up their sticky mistake before it's too late?

CBE_Easter2025_Intro_Dialogue_02.value: What are you SO excited about?

CBE_Easter2025_Intro_Dialogue_03.value: D'uh! Your egg hunt, of course! And you promised to make it bigger and better than EVER before!

CBE_Easter2025_Intro_Dialogue_05.value: I bet you've got all kinds of surprises ready, right?

CBE_Easter2025_Intro_Dialogue_07.value: Maybe I'll finally get my dream - an egg hunt with not just chocolate but candy and amazing cakes, too!

CBE_Easter2025_Intro_Dialogue_08.value: Well, I'll let you back to it!

CBE_Easter2025_Intro_Dialogue_09.value: Oh, no... I completely forgot about the egg hunt!

CBE_Easter2025_Intro_Dialogue_10.value: It's way too late to get everything done now! Unless...

CBE_Easter2025_Intro_Dialogue_11.value: I have a whole stack of Ignatius' old blueprints. Maybe I could tweak them and build something.

CBE_Easter2025_Outro_Dialogue_01.value: How was your egg hunt? Did you get all the chocolate you wanted?

CBE_Easter2025_Outro_Dialogue_02.value: Oh, I did! Your chocolates were just out of this world!

CBE_Easter2025_Outro_Dialogue_03.value: Your machines were amazing - and you were like some mad chocolate scientist!

CBE_Easter2025_Outro_Dialogue_04.value: By the way... what are you gonna do with the machines?

CBE_Easter2025_Outro_Dialogue_06.value: Well, I could take them out of your hands, if you wanted.

CBE_Easter2025_Outro_Dialogue_07.value: Maybe that's not safe, considering what happened to Roddy. The machines are just prototypes with a lot of kinks!

CBE_Easter2025_Outro_Dialogue_08.value: He got covered in chocolate! That's a happy accident, if you ask me...

CBE_Easter2025_PastryMachineProducing_Di.value: You know this whole thing started with an egg hunt, right?
Yeah, but who am I to stand in the way of progress? It's been a long time since I got to build something really exciting.
Come on, you have to admit - a cake baking machine is a pretty nifty little invention.
But are you sure the pressurized extrusion manifold won't destabilize the flow equilibrium?
That's actually a good question... H-how did you...
Anyone can see that the nozzle array is not quite right. Let me show you...

CBE_Easter2025_StartPopup_Description.value: Maddie decides to engineer machines to create the ultimate Easter experience! Just don't mind the mess...

CBE_Easter2025_TaskPlay_Description.value: Merge items and discover new decorations!

CBE_EndPopup_Description.value:
Thank you for playing the event! 
All your decorations will be automatically claimed!

CBE_Flashback2025_Attic_03_Dialogue_01.value: Why would Julius insist that his story was true?

CBE_Flashback2025_Attic_03_Dialogue_02.value: It's so typical of Grandma - not admitting anything, but not offering any kind of explanation either.

CBE_Flashback2025_Attic_03_Dialogue_03.value: Sometimes she just drives me crazy!

CBE_Flashback2025_Attic_03_Dialogue_04.value: *Sigh* I need a moment of total zen right now.

CBE_Flashback2025_Attic_03_Dialogue_05.value: And that means... a visit to the Mansion attic!

CBE_Flashback2025_Attic_03_Dialogue_06.value: I could get lost up there, among all the boxes full of treasures.

CBE_Flashback2025_BoardgamesActive_01_Di.value: I wonder if I can get inside the Mansion and take a look around! Maybe I'll just try the door...
Some things don't change, it seems.

CBE_Flashback2025_Boardgames_01_Dialogue.value: Oh, man! I need to remember that I'm not Maddie here. I won't be born for a long while yet!
If Grandma sees me, it could cause some cosmic meltdown of the space-time continuum...

CBE_Flashback2025_Box_01_Dialogue_01.value: I wonder what else I might find in these boxes.

CBE_Flashback2025_Box_01_Dialogue_02.value: Grandma's got so many secrets, you never know when you're gonna discover another one!

CBE_Flashback2025_Box_05_Dialogue_01.value: Was Grandma telling me the truth about Julius' story?

CBE_Flashback2025_Box_05_Dialogue_02.value: He was so convinced it really happened. Weird...

CBE_Flashback2025_Clothes_03_Dialogue_01.value: A box of old clothes! But these aren't just any old clothes... These are from the 80s!

CBE_Flashback2025_Clothes_03_Dialogue_02.value: This is why I love this attic. You can always find something totally unexpected!

CBE_Flashback2025_Clothes_03_Dialogue_03.value: Cool shades! As if Grandma ever wore these...

CBE_Flashback2025_Clothes_03_Dialogue_04.value: I wonder if I could pull them off?

CBE_Flashback2025_Clothes_07_Dialogue_01.value: I think I've seen this jacket before. The colors are pretty awesome!

CBE_Flashback2025_Clothes_07_Dialogue_02.value: It looks about my size, too...

CBE_Flashback2025_Clothes_07_Dialogue_03.value: No one's around, so maybe I could try some of this stuff on.

CBE_Flashback2025_Clothes_07_Dialogue_05.value: Hnnng! This is... tighter... than I expected...

CBE_Flashback2025_Clothes_07_Dialogue_06.value: Oh, WOW! What a blast from the past!

CBE_Flashback2025_Clothes_07_Dialogue_08.value: This would make a great outfit for an 80s costume party.

CBE_Flashback2025_Clothes_07_Dialogue_09.value: I wonder if Pearl would be interested in throwing one?

CBE_Flashback2025_Consoles_01_Dialogue_0.value: Hey, Julius? Have you seen Charlie anywhere?
He had some business in town. You know he's been talking about getting a COMPUTER.
An intricate hi-tech machine you can use to write things and do calculations, maybe even play games!

CBE_Flashback2025_Consoles_05_Dialogue_0.value: Remind me - what does Charlie want a computer for again?
His work? Well... I suppose you could say that.
But you know we don't really talk about that.

CBE_Flashback2025_Disco_03_Dialogue_01.value: You really need to find a better place for the key.

CBE_Flashback2025_Disco_03_Dialogue_03.value: The spare key. To the Mansion??

CBE_Flashback2025_Disco_03_Dialogue_04.value: Ah, right! And where do I keep it now?

CBE_Flashback2025_Disco_03_Dialogue_05.value: Very funny. But I'm telling you, anyone could look in Ignatius' tin can and find it!

CBE_Flashback2025_Disco_03_Dialogue_07.value: Which is where I keep the key. I knew that!

CBE_Flashback2025_Disco_03_Dialogue_08.value: And yes, absolutely, you're totally right. I'll find a better place for the key!

CBE_Flashback2025_Disco_05_Dialogue_01.value: It's so strange to see Julius this young... It's like he and Grandma and Charlie all had lives and did cool stuff.

CBE_Flashback2025_Disco_05_Dialogue_02.value: I wish I could stay in the 80s for longer and meet Charlie, but I need to find a way back to the present.

CBE_Flashback2025_Disco_05_Dialogue_03.value: So how do I get back to there?

CBE_Flashback2025_Disco_05_Dialogue_04.value: This all started from the attic, so maybe I'll find a way there.
