CBE_Flashback2025_IntroPopup_Description.value: After discovering a box of Grandma's clothes from the electric 80s, Maddie has a stumble, hits her head and wakes up... in the past?? Join Maddie on a mind-bending trip back in time, meet the young Julius and learn where Grandma keeps the spare key to the Mansion!

CBE_Flashback2025_IntroPopup_Header.value: Join Maddie on a mind-bending trip back in time!

CBE_Flashback2025_Intro_Dialogue_01.value: Hey, Grandma! Julius just told me a hilarious story about you knocking over Ignatius' statue when you were younger.

CBE_Flashback2025_Intro_Dialogue_02.value: Is that so? Which story was it? Not the one about Ignatius' statue again...

CBE_Flashback2025_Intro_Dialogue_03.value: Actually yes! He said you climbed on the statue and it fell over!

CBE_Flashback2025_Intro_Dialogue_04.value: I am afraid it is not true.

CBE_Flashback2025_Intro_Dialogue_05.value: He told me you'd say that.

CBE_Flashback2025_Intro_Dialogue_06.value: Nngggh... Ignatius' statue did fall once upon a time, but I assure you I was nowhere near it.

CBE_Flashback2025_Intro_Dialogue_08.value: I was... That is not important. For some reason, Julius thinks it was me on that statue, but it could not have been.

CBE_Flashback2025_Intro_Dialogue_10.value: I promise, dearie. It NEVER happened.

CBE_Flashback2025_Music_03_Dialogue_02.value: Ahem, keytar is my instrument of choice now. I've been practicing a lot, and I think that this time I can hit the right notes.

CBE_Flashback2025_Outro_Dialogue_01.value: Maddie, I think I owe you an explanation for before.

CBE_Flashback2025_Outro_Dialogue_02.value: I am talking about Julius's story. You see, he has always insisted that I was the one who climbed...

CBE_Flashback2025_Outro_Dialogue_03.value: Oh, it's OK! You don't have to tell me anything.

CBE_Flashback2025_Outro_Dialogue_04.value: Well... I would like to explain...

CBE_Flashback2025_Outro_Dialogue_06.value: Are you sure? I know you get annoyed when I do not give you the whole story.

CBE_Flashback2025_Outro_Dialogue_07.value: This time you're off the hook. But let's talk about your old 80s clothes!

CBE_Flashback2025_Outro_Dialogue_08.value: Now they are something I have no explanation for!

CBE_Flashback2025_Slot_16_Dialogue_01.value: What's with the bandstand and the game zone?

CBE_Flashback2025_Slot_16_Dialogue_02.value: Jeepers, Ursula. You really aren't yourself today, are you?

CBE_Flashback2025_Slot_16_Dialogue_03.value: You wanted to put on a show to draw more people to the yard sale.

CBE_Flashback2025_Slot_16_Dialogue_04.value: I don't know what's with me today... Who's going to be performing?

CBE_Flashback2025_Slot_16_Dialogue_05.value: Well, Charlie skipped our last band rehearsal, but I think we can do it.

CBE_Flashback2025_Slot_16_Dialogue_06.value: I have also prepared a comedy show as a little back-up plan. I have some terrific jokes ready to go!

CBE_Flashback2025_Slot_19_Dialogue_01.value: What a cool arcade game! Grandma always says she used to be really good at these. I mean...

CBE_Flashback2025_Slot_19_Dialogue_02.value: Your Grandma played arcade games? She must be an impressive lady!

CBE_Flashback2025_Slot_19_Dialogue_03.value: Actually... I just managed to beat your high score.

CBE_Flashback2025_Slot_19_Dialogue_04.value: It only took 5 hours, and I got blisters on four fingers, but I did it!

CBE_Flashback2025_Slot_23_Dialogue_01.value: Rollerskate ramp? This is by far the best yard sale I've ever seen!

CBE_Flashback2025_Slot_23_Dialogue_02.value: That was the goal, and I have to admit it did turn out pretty well.

CBE_Flashback2025_Slot_23_Dialogue_03.value: Let's hope we get a good turnout. You really do need some cash to bring this Mansion back up to code.

CBE_Flashback2025_Slot_23_Dialogue_04.value: The council have been too harsh to you, in my opinion. How is one person expected to fix up a place this size on their own?

CBE_Flashback2025_StartPopup_Description.value: Join Maddie on a mind-bending trip back in time and experience the Mansion as it once was...

CBE_Flashback2025_TV_Active_01_Dialogue_.value: The picture is so grainy... How did people ever watch this?
What's happening on the video? Is that Grandma? Those clothes look familiar...
Eeh, that looked like a nasty fall!
Well, well, well! Julius' story was true after all.
Grandma had better have an explanation for this.
I'm gonna go get her right n-oo-ooowww... WHOAH!

CBE_Flashback2025_Tape_01_Dialogue_02.value: Looks like an old... what you do you call it... a VHS?

CBE_Flashback2025_Tape_01_Dialogue_03.value: I wonder what I need to play it? Maybe a radio or something?

CBE_Flashback2025_Tape_01_Dialogue_04.value: Oh, an old TV! This slot looks about right...

CBE_Flashback2025_TaskPlay_Description.value: Merge items and discover new decorations!

CBE_Flashback2025_Toy_03_Dialogue_01.value: Why are you having a yard sale?

CBE_Flashback2025_Toy_03_Dialogue_02.value: Ursula, it was all your idea, remember? To raise some money for the repairs the Mansion so desperately needs?

CBE_Flashback2025_Toy_03_Dialogue_03.value: Of course... It was my idea!

CBE_Flashback2025_Toy_03_Dialogue_04.value: It looks amazing! With the games and rollerskate ramp, there are so many cool things to do.

CBE_Flashback2025_Toy_03_Dialogue_06.value: I-I know that! Seems like I have lots of good ideas!

CBE_Flashback2025_Toy_07_Dialogue_01.value: Could you just remind me - what needs to be fixed first in the Mansion?

CBE_Flashback2025_Toy_07_Dialogue_02.value: You name it! The Conservatory roof is leaking, the Maze is totally overgrown, and there's something odd going on at the Lighthouse...

CBE_Flashback2025_Toy_07_Dialogue_04.value: Are you feeling OK? It's not like you to be so forgetful.

CBE_Flashback2025_Toy_07_Dialogue_05.value: And what's with the hair? The red does look good on you, but you didn't mention you were going to dye it.

CBE_Flashback2025_Toy_07_Dialogue_06.value: I just wanted a little change, I guess... so surprise!

CBE_Flashback2025_Watches_03_Dialogue_01.value: The key to the Mansion! If I find it here in the past, I can hide it somewhere for myself to find in the future!

CBE_Flashback2025_Watches_03_Dialogue_02.value: Then I can just get straight into the Mansion. Grandma will never guess how I did it!

CBE_Flashback2025_Watches_06_Dialogue_01.value: How do I get the key?

CBE_Flashback2025_Watches_06_Dialogue_02.value: Julius knows everything around here and he thinks I'm Grandma. How can I get him to tell me everything without raising his suspicions?

CBE_Flashback2025_Watches_06_Dialogue_03.value: I have to be careful, or this might end badly.

CBE_Flashback2025_Watches_09_Dialogue_01.value: I'll just have to climb up and get the key from Ignatius' tin can!

CBE_Flashback2025_Watches_09_Dialogue_02.value: Whooooah, the statue is much taller than I realized. But I have to try.

CBE_Flashback2025_Watches_09_Dialogue_03.value: I'll just climb onto the statue's shoulders and reach into the tin can. Easy peasy!

CBE_Flashback2025_Watches_12_Dialogue_01.value: What on earth is Ursula doing climbing Ignatius' statue?? Why isn't she using the ladder?

CBE_Flashback2025_Watches_12_Dialogue_02.value: The statue can't take her weight... Oh, no - it's falling!

CBE_Flashback2025_Watches_12_Dialogue_06.value: W-what's going on? Why do you look so old? And where's your Walkman?

CBE_Flashback2025_Watches_12_Dialogue_07.value: Harumph, I don't look THAT old. And I haven't had a Walkman for decades!

CBE_Flashback2025_Watches_12_Dialogue_08.value: You must have stumbled and hit your head. Why are you wearing Ursula's old clothes?

CBE_Flashback2025_Watches_12_Dialogue_09.value: I was just trying them on.

CBE_Flashback2025_Watches_12_Dialogue_12.value: Nothing... It reminds me of something. Like a strange flashback!

CBE_Flashback2025_YardSale_04_Dialogue_0.value: Oh, my head... I need to remember to be less clumsy in the future!
Oof... I feel really weird. Like something's different... What's going on?
What was I doing? Oh, yeah - looking for Grandma. I think I saw her near the Garage.
Something looks off... The Mansion looks way better all of a sudden! It's run down but not boarded up!
Actually, it kinda looks like it did in Grandma's old photos.
I must've hit my head harder than I thought!
What's that on the Driveway? A yard sale?
And who is that carrying boxes out of the Garage?
He looks like Julius, but just much, MUCH... younger??

CBE_Flashback2025_YardSale_04_Dialogue_1.value: Hang on... Did I just go BACK IN TIME??

CBE_Flashback2025_YardSale_08_Dialogue_0.value: Ursula? Is that you? Could you help me with these boxes?
What happened to your hair? Oh, never mind! Those sunglasses are EPIC!
I'm glad you noticed! I've been lifting some weights, and it's going pretty well.
Do you want to see my new Walkman? It's really neat!

CBE_Flashback2025_YardSale_08_Dialogue_1.value: This is too much... Where am I? Or - WHEN am I?
Did you bump your head? You're not making any sense!

CBE_Flashback2025_YardSale_11_Dialogue_0.value: So, Grandma was also fixing the place up. It doesn't look half bad, but it's definitely showing signs of disrepair.
Hang on... Shouldn't Grandpa Charlie be around?!

CBE_FrostySecrets2024_BackpackSupplies_0.value: Ah, the perfect tool for tinkering outdoors.
Looks like you’re packing that backpack for a zombie apocalypse!
You never know when you might need it!
Will we really need a multi-tool?
I’ve learned it’s best to be prepared, in case...
Err... you know, in case the coffee maker at the cabin needs emergency surgery!
A classic thermos flask. I'll take this, too.
There’s something in this thermos... some rolled-up papers. What are these?
Hang on! There's something inside it... Phew, it's only a wad of paper!
Oh, that’s my Grandpa Charlie’s old map.
He kept his map in a thermos mug?
Whoever packed this bag, hid these papers in the thermos, too.
He just liked to keep his secrets well hidden - like the cabin. This is a map to its location.
The Boultons have a secret to hide. What a surprise!

CBE_FrostySecrets2024_Backpack_Dialogue_.value: An old backpack! Looks like no one's touched it in years.
The first thing we need to do is get our gear together.
Someone in this family must have enjoyed outdoorsy adventures.
There's a lot of good stuff here... I wonder who packed this bag?
Or a compass, GPS, thermos mugs, and a flashlight.
I owe them a big thanks, because it has everything I need for a day outdoors.
Are we hiking all the way to the North Pole?
The only thing that's missing is the snacks!

CBE_FrostySecrets2024_CabinCodex_03_Dial.value: It's like someone's diary, with so many clippings and notes... and a MAP!
Looks like it leads to a place in the mountains near Hopewell Bay.
I can feel an adventure coming on!

CBE_FrostySecrets2024_Charlie_02_Dialogu.value: This might just prove it - paper monogrammed with "CB"!
The place is cozy and peaceful, but it's also out of the way.
And all of these old papers with coded writing...
I think Grandpa was doing more here than just chopping wood and roasting marshmallows.

CBE_FrostySecrets2024_Charlie_04_Dialogu.value: Grandma has never wanted to talk too much about Grandpa Charlie, but she said he loved clocks and watches. He'd even studied them in Switzerland.
It's not the first time I've found an old watch of Charlie's...

CBE_FrostySecrets2024_Charlie_06_Dialogu.value: Umm, Maddie... I just found a big pile of cash in one of the cabinets.
Oh, yeah - you sometimes find that kind of stuff here.

CBE_FrostySecrets2024_Charlie_07_Dialogu.value: I wonder when he was last here?
Everything has been left as if he could come back at any time, but... he's gone.
I wish I knew what happened to him.
He must have gotten mixed up with something bad.

CBE_FrostySecrets2024_DecoSlot_01_Dialog.value: Wow! Did you make these, Maddie??
Yeah, I wanted to try something new. And the Grand Drive was crying for some winter magic!
Can I try? Please? Pretty please? It looks SO fun!
Why not. But careful with the tools, Mason!

CBE_FrostySecrets2024_DecoSlot_10_Dialog.value: What do you think? It's supposed to be a carving of you.
It is... very artistic! Lovely work, Maddie. I didn't know you were so handy with a saw.
I guess I've picked up some skills while renovating the Mansion.

CBE_FrostySecrets2024_DecoSlot_15_Dialog.value: What beautiful ice sculptures! What brought on this bout of artistic expression, Maddie?
I've been doing a little bit of hiking...
Yeah, in the mountains. I discovered something and... well, it was kinda eye-opening.
Is that so? Remember to be careful when you head up there...
I know - there are bears and mountain lions. But don't worry! I'm always careful.

CBE_FrostySecrets2024_Fireplace_01_Dialo.value: Did your Grandpa Charlie build this old cabin?
I need to get a fire going while I can still feel my fingers.
Yes, and I found it by coincidence by following his old notes and maps.
This chimney starter will do the trick!
It turns out that he built the cabin as a little hideaway for himself.
Now I come here every now and again to enjoy a bit of peace and quiet.
Isn’t it a little bit too quiet, though?
You get used to it. You’ll see - this place is pretty magical.

CBE_FrostySecrets2024_IceSculptures_05_D.value: I can see why Grandpa would've liked this place.
What’s your ice sculpture supposed to look like?
Can’t you see? It’s the Mansion.
Sometimes I forget what a crazy adventure I'm on with the Mansion and all of its secrets...
Oh, yeah! You’re missing some cobwebs and the overgrown garden, but it’s pretty close.
It wasn't in my original five-year plan, that's for sure!

CBE_FrostySecrets2024_IceSculptures_09_D.value: Finding this place makes me wonder about my parents...
Do you think it’s too late for a career pivot?
I could get used to sculpting ice up in the mountains.
I feel like I'm an inch closer to finding out the truth about Charlie... Maybe I'll learn the truth about them, too.
Isn’t it too cold up here?
Not if you’re wearing enough layers. See - I’m learning!

CBE_FrostySecrets2024_IceSculptures_12_D.value: Maybe next year will bring new perspectives and opportunities.
I don't know but I have a good feeling about it!

CBE_FrostySecrets2024_InfoPanel_Descript.value: An old cabin in the mountains - full of secrets, of course. Get ready for a hike!

CBE_FrostySecrets2024_IntroPopup_Descrip.value: Maddie discovers an old journal with a map to a mysterious location in the mountains. She sets off to find out what is hidden where the X marks the spot and discovers more than she ever expected. Join Maddie on a wintery adventure!

CBE_FrostySecrets2024_IntroPopup_Header.value: An old cabin in the mountains - full of secrets, of course. Get ready for a hike!

CBE_FrostySecrets2024_Intro_Dialogue_01.value: There's nothing like a crisp winter's day to blow the cobwebs away!
What an amazing day! Don’t you just love winter?

CBE_FrostySecrets2024_Intro_Dialogue_02.value: And the garden looks so beautiful in the winter.
You get to wrap up warm and enjoy the snow and the crisp weather...

CBE_FrostySecrets2024_Intro_Dialogue_03.value: The Grand Drive needs some fresh decor, though... something fitting the season.
Give me sandy beaches, coconut drinks, and sunshine anytime. Winter is just too... cold!

CBE_FrostySecrets2024_Intro_Dialogue_04.value: There's that old shed behind Grandma's cottage... Maybe I'll peek in really quickly. Who knows - maybe I'll find the perfect thing there!
Now if there was a cozy log cabin somewhere with plenty of hot cocoa and warm blankets, I could see myself enjoying this weather.

CBE_FrostySecrets2024_Intro_Dialogue_06.value: You have a cozy log cabin?

CBE_FrostySecrets2024_Intro_Dialogue_07.value: Sort of. What do you say about heading for a little girls’ trip up in the mountains?

CBE_FrostySecrets2024_Outro_Dialogue_01.value: Where have you been? I baked an apple pie, but you were nowhere to be found!
Thank you for this little trip. Being up in the mountains wasn't anything like I thought!

CBE_FrostySecrets2024_Outro_Dialogue_02.value: Actually... I found an old map that led to a cabin in the mountains. So I hiked up there to see what I could find.
But have you changed your mind about the winter?

CBE_FrostySecrets2024_Outro_Dialogue_03.value: I think it used to be Grandpa Charlie's. Did you know about it?
It’s still cold and there's a LOT of snow, but I’m starting to see the appeal.

CBE_FrostySecrets2024_Outro_Dialogue_04.value: It's a whole vibe - refreshing and peaceful.

CBE_FrostySecrets2024_Outro_Dialogue_05.value: Well... You are right. It was Charlie's. He loved the great outdoors, so he used to go there to hike and enjoy the peace and quiet.
Completely. I mean, apart from the bears. And wolves.

CBE_FrostySecrets2024_Outro_Dialogue_06.value: I never went there with him. I don't even know its exact location.
You never told me there were bears and wolves!

CBE_FrostySecrets2024_Outro_Dialogue_07.value: Everything was still there, in perfect order. He clearly intended to go back but never did.
Well, I didn’t want to spoil the surprise - it’s part of the full winter experience package!

CBE_FrostySecrets2024_Outro_Dialogue_09.value: That's enough secrets for one day, dearie. I... I will tell you one day, but let's try that apple pie.

CBE_FrostySecrets2024_Shed_Dialogue_01.value: *Sneeze!* No one's looked in this dusty place for a LONG time!

CBE_FrostySecrets2024_Shed_Dialogue_02.value: Skis, an old sleigh... The weather looks perfect for a day in the great outdoors.
Not too far. Just a few hours by foot.

CBE_FrostySecrets2024_Shed_Dialogue_03.value: I think I'll try some of this stuff out!
I think I need to get my ears checked. I thought you said a few hours by foot!

CBE_FrostySecrets2024_Snowflakes_03_Dial.value: Maybe Grandpa Charlie came here to get away from all the drama at the Mansion... It must have been a crazy place - even back then.
I've got to admit - this place is really stunning and peaceful.
There's no sign of Grandma, so this cabin must have been just his.
Mason would really love it here too, don't you think?
The place looks so perfect! I can almost imagine him here.
But it would be a lot less peaceful.

CBE_FrostySecrets2024_Snowman_07_Dialogu.value: I'm so glad I found this place! It's good to get a little bit of distance from everything.
Look at your snowman! You’re a real pro!
And I haven't made a snowman in a looong time!
It’s not bad, is it? I’ve been so busy lately that I’ve just run out of inspiration.
This is exactly what I needed. I'm getting so many new ideas for work...
What other winter activities can we try?
We can do ice-sculpting, but that can be pretty heavy work. I have some tools, and...

CBE_FrostySecrets2024_StartPopup_Descrip.value: Join Maddie on an adventure to a cabin in the mountains and get ready to uncover a couple of big secrets!

CBE_FrostySecrets2024_Teatime_05_Dialogu.value: A hiking trip is only as good as the snacks you pack...
We have cookies, tea, and warm blankets. Is this cozy enough for you?
But they haven’t been here since your Grandpa Charlie's time, have they?
Nope! They’re fresh from Grandma’s kitchen.

CBE_FrostySecrets2024_Teatime_07_Dialogu.value: Hot tea is exactly what I need right now.
We’re out of hot cocoa. What do we do now?
Now that I've had a chance to look around, this cabin is actually pretty cozy!
We go outside and make a snowman!
The place has been set up by someone who knows what they're doing.
But... it’s so cozy in here.
Not a bad place to spend a day!
Come on, it’ll be fun. I promise!

CBE_FrostySecrets2024_WarmClothes_02_Dia.value: Let's see... it could be Grandma's, but no one has clearly been here for a long time.
Deb is not one for hiking... or cabins in the mountains.
Could this be... Grandpa Charlie's hide-out from years ago?

CBE_FrostySecrets2024_WarmClothes_08_Dia.value: If you really want to enjoy a cold winter’s day, you need to wear enough layers.
I wonder if Grandma even knew about it?
And you can’t make a good snowman without some decent gloves.
I wish I knew more about him. Finding his things makes him so much more real - not just a ghost always haunting us.

CBE_FrostySecrets2024_WarmClothes_10_Dia.value: Brrr! An extra layer would be perfect right about now.
I think I saw a big old cardigan in the closet...
"CB" - it has his initials on the label!

CBE_FrostySecrets2024_WinterGear_04_Dial.value: I've always wanted to try snowshoes!
Could we drive to the cabin?
The mountains around Hopewell Bay are a place I've never got around to exploring.
Not quite, but I’ve got some skis...
Maybe there's enough snow up there for me to try these out.

CBE_FrostySecrets2024_WinterGear_07_Dial.value: Coooool! I bet this thing goes fast.
A snowmobile -- now we're talking! How fast does this thing go?
Buuut... maybe I'll try it out first!

CBE_FrostySecrets2024_WinterTools_06_Dia.value: The weather outside is looking fickle.
Uh-oh! I think we’re snowed in! I can barely open the front door.
I think I need to head back home before I get snowed in!
Yeah, that does happen up here. We just need to get the snow shovels out and start digging.
You don’t have anything that doesn’t require digging, do you?
Well, there is an old snow blower in the shed...

CBE_FrostySecrets2025_BackpackSupplies_0.value: Looks like you’re packing that backpack for a zombie apocalypse!
Will we really need a multi-tool?
I’ve learned it’s best to be prepared, in case...
Err... you know, in case the coffee maker at the cabin needs emergency surgery!
There’s something in this thermos… some rolled-up papers. What are these?
Oh, that’s my Grandpa Charlie’s old map.
He kept his map in a thermos mug?
He just liked to keep his secrets well hidden - like the cabin. This is a map to its location.
The Boultons have a secret to hide. What a surprise!

CBE_FrostySecrets2025_Backpack_Dialogue_.value: The first thing we need to do is get our gear together.
Or a compass, GPS, thermos mugs, and a flashlight.
Are we hiking all the way to the North Pole?

CBE_FrostySecrets2025_Charlie_06_Dialogu.value: Umm, Maddie… I just found a big pile of cash in one of the cabinets.
Oh, yeah - you sometimes find that kind of stuff here.

CBE_FrostySecrets2025_Fireplace_01_Dialo.value: Did your Grandpa Charlie build this old cabin?
Yes, and I found it by coincidence by following his old notes and maps.
It turns out that he built the cabin as a little hideaway for himself.
Now I come here every now and again to enjoy a bit of peace and quiet.
Isn’t it a little bit too quiet, though?
You get used to it. You’ll see - this place is pretty magical.

CBE_FrostySecrets2025_IceSculptures_05_D.value: What’s your ice sculpture supposed to look like?
Can’t you see? It’s the Mansion.
Oh, yeah! You’re missing some cobwebs and the overgrown garden, but it’s pretty close.

CBE_FrostySecrets2025_IceSculptures_09_D.value: Do you think it’s too late for a career pivot?
I could get used to sculpting ice up in the mountains.
Isn’t it too cold up here?
Not if you’re wearing enough layers. See - I’m learning!

CBE_FrostySecrets2025_IntroPopup_Descrip.value: When things get stressful, there's nothing like a hike through the forest, right? Maddie decides to take Pearl to Grandpa Charlie's old mountain cabin for a little bit of peace and quiet, but with Pearl's outdoor skills, anything can happen...

CBE_FrostySecrets2025_Intro_Dialogue_01.value: What an amazing day! Don’t you just love winter?

CBE_FrostySecrets2025_Intro_Dialogue_02.value: You get to wrap up warm and enjoy the snow and the crisp weather...

CBE_FrostySecrets2025_Intro_Dialogue_03.value: Give me sandy beaches, coconut drinks, and sunshine anytime. Winter is just too… cold!

CBE_FrostySecrets2025_Intro_Dialogue_04.value: Now if there was a cozy log cabin somewhere with plenty of hot cocoa and warm blankets, I could see myself enjoying this weather.

CBE_FrostySecrets2025_Intro_Dialogue_06.value: You have a cozy log cabin?

CBE_FrostySecrets2025_Intro_Dialogue_07.value: Sort of. What do you say about heading for a little girls’ trip up in the mountains?

CBE_FrostySecrets2025_Outro_Dialogue_01.value: Thank you for this little trip. Being up in the mountains wasn't anything like I thought!

CBE_FrostySecrets2025_Outro_Dialogue_02.value: But have you changed your mind about the winter?

CBE_FrostySecrets2025_Outro_Dialogue_03.value: It’s still cold and there's a LOT of snow, but I’m starting to see the appeal.

CBE_FrostySecrets2025_Outro_Dialogue_04.value: It's a whole vibe - refreshing and peaceful.

CBE_FrostySecrets2025_Outro_Dialogue_05.value: Completely. I mean, apart from the bears. And wolves.

CBE_FrostySecrets2025_Outro_Dialogue_06.value: You never told me there were bears and wolves!

CBE_FrostySecrets2025_Outro_Dialogue_07.value: Well, I didn’t want to spoil the surprise - it’s part of the full winter experience package!

CBE_FrostySecrets2025_Shed_Dialogue_02.value: Not too far. Just a few hours by foot.

CBE_FrostySecrets2025_Shed_Dialogue_03.value: I think I need to get my ears checked. I thought you said a few hours by foot!

CBE_FrostySecrets2025_Snowflakes_03_Dial.value: I've got to admit - this place is really stunning and peaceful.
Mason would really love it here too, don't you think?
But it would be a lot less peaceful.

CBE_FrostySecrets2025_Snowman_07_Dialogu.value: Look at your snowman! You’re a real pro!
It’s not bad, is it? I’ve been so busy lately that I’ve just run out of inspiration.
This is exactly what I needed. I'm getting so many new ideas for work…
What other winter activities can we try?
We can do ice-sculpting, but that can be pretty heavy work. I have some tools, and…

CBE_FrostySecrets2025_StartPopup_Descrip.value: Join Maddie and Pearl on an unforgettable adventure to a cabin in the mountains!

CBE_FrostySecrets2025_Teatime_05_Dialogu.value: We have cookies, tea, and warm blankets. Is this cozy enough for you?
But they haven’t been here since your Grandpa Charlie's time, have they?
Nope! They’re fresh from Grandma’s kitchen.

CBE_FrostySecrets2025_Teatime_07_Dialogu.value: We’re out of hot cocoa. What do we do now?
We go outside and make a snowman!
But… it’s so cozy in here.
Come on, it’ll be fun. I promise!

CBE_FrostySecrets2025_WarmClothes_08_Dia.value: If you really want to enjoy a cold winter’s day, you need to wear enough layers.
And you can’t make a good snowman without some decent gloves.

CBE_FrostySecrets2025_WinterGear_04_Dial.value: Could we drive to the cabin?
Not quite, but I’ve got some skis…

CBE_FrostySecrets2025_WinterGear_07_Dial.value: A snowmobile -- now we're talking! How fast does this thing go?

CBE_FrostySecrets2025_WinterTools_06_Dia.value: Uh-oh! I think we’re snowed in! I can barely open the front door.
Yeah, that does happen up here. We just need to get the snow shovels out and start digging.
You don’t have anything that doesn’t require digging, do you?
Well, there is an old snow blower in the shed…

CBE_GemMine_Task_Portal.value: Claim the entrance to get started!

CBE_Halloween2025_CandleGhost_01_Dialogu.value: I think we've just found something. LOOK!
The candles are glowing? What is going on??
Do I really need to say it again?

CBE_Halloween2025_Clues_02_Dialogue_01.value: I don’t get how you can say there’s no such thing as ghosts. We’ve seen so many of them already!

CBE_Halloween2025_Clues_02_Dialogue_02.value: If anything, we’ve proved that I’m right and that the Mansion is haunted.

CBE_Halloween2025_Clues_02_Dialogue_03.value: There must be more to this…
There must be more to this...

CBE_Halloween2025_Clues_04_Dialogue_02.value: Ha! I was right! There’s someone playing tricks on us - and it’s no ghost.

CBE_Halloween2025_Clues_04_Dialogue_03.value: Let’s keep looking for more clues. I think we’re on to something here.

CBE_Halloween2025_Decoration_Slot_18_Dia.value: So, what do we know for sure?
Well, we don’t know that for sure.

CBE_Halloween2025_Decoration_Slot_22_Dia.value: Let's say you're right and the Mansion is haunted. Who do you think is haunting it?
Take your pick! There’s Ignatius with his weird machines, Lindsay with her spray cans, Grandpa Charlie who disappeared so mysteriously…
Take your pick! There's Ignatius with his weird machines, Lindsay with her spray cans, Grandpa Charlie who disappeared so mysteriously...
The place does have a LOT of history, but all of those people would be friendly spirits.
I’m going to show you, Mason - the Mansion is NOT haunted.

CBE_Halloween2025_Decoration_Slot_24_Dia.value: I think we should camp out here.
Great idea! Then we’ll hear if there’s anything suspicious going on and check it immediately.
You should go check it out.
Let’s just stay in the tent.

CBE_Halloween2025_Decorations_02_Dialogu.value: The place is looking great, as usual!
Thank you. We’ve been pretty busy with this ghost-hunting quest, but I’m happy with the decorations.
Ghost-hunting? Is that a new party game or something?
No, I mean actual ghost hunting!

CBE_Halloween2025_Decorations_04_Dialogu.value: You and Mason are *gulp* hunting for ghosts?
He is convinced the Mansion is totally haunted, and I want to prove to him that there is no such thing as ghosts.

CBE_Halloween2025_Decorations_07_Dialogu.value: O-oh? So you haven’t seen any ghosts so far?
We did see something kinda odd… Things glowing in the dark, moving on their own.
We did see something kinda odd... Things glowing in the dark, moving on their own.
But that’s just weird lighting and the drafty old house playing its tricks on us.
A-absolutely! Where did you see these… glowing things?
A-absolutely! Where did you see these... glowing things?
All over! The attic and the garden… But they aren’t ghosts. There is no such thing as ghosts!
All over! The attic and the garden... But they aren’t ghosts. There is no such thing as ghosts!
You’re right… I think I might still avoid the attic and the garden for now.
You’re right... I think I might still avoid the attic and the garden for now.

CBE_Halloween2025_GardenBed_01_Dialogue_.value: Let’s check the garden first. Not all ghosts like to live around dusty old dressers and corridors!
Yup, some ghosts enjoy fresh air and nice flower beds.

CBE_Halloween2025_GardenBed_03_Dialogue_.value: Oh, we can check the pumpkin harvest while we’re here and pick the best ones to carve!
Concentrate, Maddie! We’re looking for ghouls, not gourds!

CBE_Halloween2025_GhostHunting_02_Dialog.value: Is there something we could use to detect paranormal activity?
What, like a metal detector for ghosts?

CBE_Halloween2025_GhostHunting_04_Dialog.value: This contraption looks convincing, but will it detect and trap ghosts?
Well, it can detect metal, but I’m not so sure about trapping ghosts.
After all, they are not REAL.

CBE_Halloween2025_GhostHunting_06_Dialog.value: I think we are ready to catch these ghosts, Mason.

CBE_Halloween2025_Ghost_01_Dialogue_01.value: Whoooah! Maddie, are you see what I’m seeing?

CBE_Halloween2025_Ghost_01_Dialogue_04.value: Aaargh, it’s stuck in the backpack!

CBE_Halloween2025_Ghost_01_Dialogue_05.value: Quick, the ghost is getting away!!

CBE_Halloween2025_Ghost_01_Dialogue_07.value: It vanished! But I’m in pursuit!

CBE_Halloween2025_InfoPanel_Description.value:
The Haunted Halloween event has started!
Complete Event Merge Tasks and earn Event Points.

CBE_Halloween2025_IntroPopup_Description.value: Convinced that Beaumont Hall is haunted, Mason suits up for a ghost hunting quest, and determined to prove there are no ghosts, Maddie joins him. Join their quest to find out what - or who - is behind the ghostly things happening around the old house!

CBE_Halloween2025_IntroPopup_Header.value: Go ghost hunting with Maddie and Mason!

CBE_Halloween2025_Intro_Dialogue_01.value: Hey, Maddie! Do you have a minute?

CBE_Halloween2025_Intro_Dialogue_02.value: Sure, but only a minute. I've got so much to do before the trick-or-treaters come. Even the pumpkins still need to be carved!

CBE_Halloween2025_Intro_Dialogue_03.value: I just have a question. Do you think the Mansion is haunted?

CBE_Halloween2025_Intro_Dialogue_06.value: It’s just an old house that might look creepy in the moonlight, but why do you think it’s haunted?

CBE_Halloween2025_Intro_Dialogue_07.value: Hello? It’s an old abandoned place with a long history of weird mysteries? The perfect place for ghosts!

CBE_Halloween2025_Intro_Dialogue_08.value: OK, but have you ever actually seen or heard any ghosts here?

CBE_Halloween2025_Intro_Dialogue_09.value: Well, no, but that doesn’t prove anything.

CBE_Halloween2025_Intro_Dialogue_10.value: And you know, Halloween is the BEST time of the year to see ghosts!

CBE_Halloween2025_Intro_Dialogue_12.value: There's only one way to find out...

CBE_Halloween2025_Intro_Dialogue_13.value: How about a little quest, and then I’ll help you with the Halloween preparations?

CBE_Halloween2025_Intro_Dialogue_14.value: Deal! But don't be too disappointed when I prove you wrong!

CBE_Halloween2025_KnifeGhost_01_Dialogue.value: Y-yes, but-- What is going on here??

CBE_Halloween2025_Maddie_02_Dialogue_01.value: Mason’s being so silly. He’s seen way too many horror movies for his own good!

CBE_Halloween2025_Maddie_02_Dialogue_02.value: I can see why he would think that there are ghosts at the Mansion, but he’s wrong.

CBE_Halloween2025_Maddie_04_Dialogue_01.value: Do I need all this stuff? Am I overprepared?

CBE_Halloween2025_Maddie_04_Dialogue_02.value: Nah, it’s best to be ready for anything. This quest might get messy!

CBE_Halloween2025_Mason_02_Dialogue_01.value: You can’t go ghost hunting without the right equipment.

CBE_Halloween2025_Mason_02_Dialogue_02.value: Goggles and gloves are essential, since you never know what you might encounter.

CBE_Halloween2025_Mason_04_Dialogue_01.value: I think I’m ready. It’s already getting dark outside, and there’s definitely a weird chill in the air.

CBE_Halloween2025_Mason_04_Dialogue_02.value: I know Maddie wants to prove to me that ghosts aren’t real, but I think she’s the one who will be in for a surprise!

CBE_Halloween2025_Outro_Dialogue_02.value: About what? Ghosts not being real?

CBE_Halloween2025_Outro_Dialogue_04.value: Julius did get us with his awesome prank, but look around you! There’s no way this place isn’t haunted!

CBE_Halloween2025_Outro_Dialogue_05.value: Just wait until next Halloween, Mason. I won't give up!

CBE_Halloween2025_Outro_Dialogue_06.value: Neither will I, Maddie. Neither will I.

CBE_Halloween2025_Points_03_Dialogue_01.value: What are you two up to?

CBE_Halloween2025_Points_03_Dialogue_02.value: I happened to look out of the window and saw you creeping in the bushes. For a second, I thought we had burglars!

CBE_Halloween2025_Points_03_Dialogue_03.value: We're not creeping. We're ghost hunting!

CBE_Halloween2025_Points_10_Dialogue_01.value: Mason, I am sure you know there is no such thing as ghosts.

CBE_Halloween2025_Points_10_Dialogue_02.value: That's what Maddie keeps telling me, but she's wrong.

CBE_Halloween2025_Points_10_Dialogue_03.value: Oh? Why do you say that?

CBE_Halloween2025_Points_10_Dialogue_04.value: Because we've seen stuff that's haunted!

CBE_Halloween2025_Points_10_Dialogue_06.value: A pumpkin and a knife. And a bunch of candles!

CBE_Halloween2025_Points_10_Dialogue_09.value: I think I did, but it was a long time ago...

CBE_Halloween2025_PumpkinGhost_01_Dialog.value: These jack o’lanterns are looking great.
Awesome! Let’s go set up the ghost trap in the attic next.
A ghost pumpkin! This is it - the hunt is on!

CBE_Halloween2025_Pumpkin_02_Dialogue_01.value: I’ve got to hand it to you - you really are good at carving pumpkins!

CBE_Halloween2025_Pumpkin_04_Dialogue_01.value: This is getting kinda eerie… I know I said ghosts aren't real, but there is definitely something going on!
This is getting kinda eerie... I know I said ghosts aren't real, but there is definitely something going on!

CBE_Halloween2025_Pumpkin_04_Dialogue_03.value: But there must be a reasonable explanation.

CBE_Halloween2025_Pumpkin_04_Dialogue_05.value: Like… the moonlight hit that pumpkin in a weird way, or maybe Grandma used some special growing agent.
Like... the moonlight hit that pumpkin in a weird way, or maybe Grandma used some special growing agent.

CBE_Halloween2025_Pumpkin_04_Dialogue_06.value: To make it glow in the dark like a menacing veggie monster?

CBE_Halloween2025_ScaryMovies_02_Dialogu.value: We still have a lot to do to get the backyard movie theater ready.
Do you want to pick the movies?
Can I? I'll pick all the scariest ones!

CBE_Halloween2025_ScaryMovies_04_Dialogu.value: I picked the movies. They have just the right amount of scares and goo.
Yeah, a good Halloween movie should have some weird green goo!

CBE_Halloween2025_StartPopup_Description.value: Go ghost hunting with Maddie and Mason to find out what is going on at the old Mansion!

CBE_Halloween2025_TapeGhost_01_Dialogue_.value: I think your movies have too much goo! Look!!
A haunted movie tape! The ghosts must know what we’re up to.
That’s true. They’ve been following us all night.
Hmm… There’s something fishy about this!
Hmm... There’s something fishy about this!

CBE_Halloween2025_Theater_03_Dialogue_01.value: There’s nothing better than a Halloween movie marathon with lots of treats!

CBE_Halloween2025_Theater_03_Dialogue_02.value: That’s true! It’s a shame Roddy got spooked.

CBE_Halloween2025_Theater_03_Dialogue_03.value: The man just can’t handle Halloween!

CBE_Halloween2025_Theater_05_Dialogue_01.value: Thanks for doing all this, Maddie. You're a real pal!

CBE_Halloween2025_Theater_05_Dialogue_02.value: You know I’m always up for a fun project. And Halloween has always been celebrated in a big way at the Mansion.

CBE_Halloween2025_Theater_05_Dialogue_03.value: My Grandpa Charlie loved Halloween, and apparently, he loved pulling pranks.

CBE_Halloween2025_Theater_07_Dialogue_01.value: What kind of pranks did your Grandpa Charlie use to pull?

CBE_Halloween2025_Theater_07_Dialogue_02.value: Julius told me that he always planned them perfectly, and everyone always fell for them.

CBE_Halloween2025_Theater_07_Dialogue_03.value: Once, he dressed up as a mummy and scared the lights out of Deb.

CBE_Halloween2025_Theater_07_Dialogue_04.value: Classic! I wish I could’ve seen it!

CBE_Halloween2025_Tools_03_Dialogue_01.value: Are you ready to carve some pumpkins? Remember, you promised to help me.

CBE_Halloween2025_Tools_03_Dialogue_02.value: And we can make them extra scary!

CBE_Halloween2025_Tools_03_Dialogue_03.value: If you want scary, you’re asking the right person.

CBE_Halloween2025_Tools_03_Dialogue_04.value: Hand me that tool and I’ll show you how it’s done!

CBE_Halloween2025_UnlitCandle_01_Dialogu.value: The dusty old attic is haunted for sure!
If we’re gonna find ghosts anywhere in this Mansion, it’s there.
You’re probably right. There are so many weird things stored up there.
Even a pirate treasure, according to Grandma!

CBE_Halloween2025_UnlitCandle_03_Dialogu.value: See? There’s nothing here. Just old clothes and… old Halloween decorations! Let’s round them up so we can get started on the decorating.
See? There’s nothing here. Just old clothes and... old Halloween decorations! Let’s round them up so we can get started on the decorating.
Rats! The batteries in the flashlight are dead. Let’s find some candles.

CBE_Halloween2025_Unmasking_01_Dialogue_.value: Maddie, I can see some footprints!
You’re right! Hurry - don’t let him get away!

CBE_Halloween2025_Unmasking_05_Dialogue_.value: A book full of notes? Who left this here?
Whoever it was, he is bound to come back for it.
W-what, me? I have no idea what you are talking about!
Oh, I guess you got me. Guilty as charged.
I decided to play a little prank on you - à la Charlie!
This is his old book of notes. This is where he entered the details of all of his best pranks.
I had you going, didn’t I?

CBE_HolidayWorkshop2024_Art_07_Dialogue_.value: These pictures were painted by you?
Maddie, could I ask for a favor?
I really wanted to capture a more playful side of myself. What do you think?
The online store has been so much more work than I expected that I haven’t had time to bake for our holiday party.
Could you take care of the polvorones?
Maybe the mermaid speaks to me the most.
Thank you so much! Oh, by the way...
You have a lot of boxes in your garage. Are you stocking up on presents for the holidays or something?
Hmm... These boxes look kinda familiar!

CBE_HolidayWorkshop2024_BakingSupplies_0.value: How about baking? Is there some treat that makes you feel really happy?
There’s one more delivery of Bella’s packages on the way.
There are these cookies my granny used to make...
That had better be the last one - we’re running out of space!
Hmm... I think we'll need a little bit of help from someone who knows a thing or two about baking.

CBE_HolidayWorkshop2024_BedAndBrerekfast.value: Greetings, Bella! I hope you've been happy with everything at my Bed & Breakfast.
It's not very luxurious, but I try to make my guests as comfortable as possible.
I've enjoyed myself in Hopewell Bay. Even if...
I'm afraid I've made a really bad impression on everyone.
Meeting new people can be scary, and I wanted everyone to like me, but I've just made a big mess.
Maybe you can return their kindness by gifting them something -- something you've made yourself.
Err... I don't know about that...
Don't worry! I will help you. And if your intentions are good, so will the outcome be.

CBE_HolidayWorkshop2024_CandleTable_01_D.value: Should I use soy wax or beeswax?
What will you be selling in your online store?
And which essential oil would be the best?
That Maddie could use something relaxing and calming... She seemed so tense and angry!
Come on, Bella. Remember what Emilio said. It's time to be nice.
I’m selling my handmade crafts, of course! People love everything hand-made and locally produced these days, and my products are perfect for the holidays.
What is it, Roddy? I can see you have questions.
Well, not all of your crafts are... How can I put this... they’re not TOTALLY perfect.
I'm not sure what you mean...

CBE_HolidayWorkshop2024_Candles_05_Dialo.value: I might not be the best at pottery or knitting, but I'm good at making candles!
We could tell her that the server of her website crashed and took the site down, too.
I really want to express myself through these candles.
That wouldn’t work. She would just ask you to set up a new website. She’s very persuasive.
Dolphins are my favorite animals.... and octopi are always great.
We could stage a robbery and take all of her crafts...
I think I can make a really nice surprise for Maddie.
But that would be actually criminal.
With extra lavender oil for tranquility and balance...
I guess there’s just one option left.
Think about it. She puts all of her creations up on the website. We register under false names and just buy everything.
This plan is water-tight! You’re a genius!

CBE_HolidayWorkshop2024_CharacterEmilio_.value: You're doing a great job, Bella!
Another order completed. I know what we’re doing isn’t totally honest, but I want Bella to be happy.
I am? I guess I've been working pretty hard.
She has worked so hard this year to fix her relationship with Maddie, and she deserves to feel like a success.
But what are you hoping to get for Xmas?
Although I don’t know where she finds the time to produce all of these crafts!
Just peace on earth and joy to all the animals.

CBE_HolidayWorkshop2024_CharacterGrandma.value: Season's greetings, Ursula! I have a little holiday surprise for you.
I dread to ask why the postman keeps delivering boxes to the Mansion.
Yesterday morning, there were three post vans waiting at the gate.
Call it a little holiday surprise!

CBE_HolidayWorkshop2024_CharacterHank_01.value: Hank! I've been trying to find you!
Uh-oh, Hank - holiday stress hitting you hard?
Yes! What would you like to get for Xmas?
Let me guess: You're stuck trying to find the perfect present for Deb?
Is it really that time already??
You have no idea. The lady has everything you can think of - even a mini horse!
I've had two winks of sleep since Deb and I had the baby ...
There's no way to surprise her.
So, all I really, really want this year is a nice, long nap.
I think I might have the perfect thing for you. There's a brand-new online store, full of unusual and unique present ideas...

CBE_HolidayWorkshop2024_CharacterJackie_.value: Jackie! How are you doing with your holiday shopping?
Oh, hi! How are you, Bella?
That's kind of a personal question...
Great! I was just wondering about what you might want for Christmas!
The holidays are approaching fast. You really don't have any time to hesitate, because all the best stuff sells out so quickly.
For Christmas? I... Well, maybe... I don't really know.
Fine. I still have quite a lot of stuff to get... This is hands down the most stressful time of the year!
Maybe a nice pair of socks? Or a coffee mug?
I just can’t figure out what to get for Maddie. She always says she doesn't want anything, but people don't really mean that, right?
How about a scented candle? Or a quirky beanie with a personal touch?
I'll let you think about it.
Bella set up an online store for her terrible crafts, and we need to buy everything to spare her feelings.
I guess I could buy a quirky beanie to help out!

CBE_HolidayWorkshop2024_CharacterMaddie_.value: Hi, Maddie! I like your sweater. It's... cute!
Thank you for helping us with this crazy project, Maddie.
Thanks -- I guess. What's up, Bella?
Happy to help! You can never have too many scented candles.
Thank you for welcoming me here in Hopewell Bay.
You've all been so great, but I guess I haven't as nice as I could've been.
You've all been so great, but I guess I haven't been as nice as I could've been.
Now I just want to spread holiday cheer to everyone in Hopewell Bay... as a way to apologize.
Your little town is so sweet, and your projects are really quirky.
I know Emilio cares about you a lot, and I want him to be happy, so...
O-oh, sure. I-- I mean WE all care about Emilio, too.

CBE_HolidayWorkshop2024_CharacterMason_0.value: That’s a LOT of boxes. What’s in them?
Of course! I'm wishing for a bunch of goodies.
Nothing in particular... Just old holiday ornaments.
Is there anything I could help Santa with?
Roddy, do you think I was born yesterday? I can tell you’re up to something weird, so you can just tell me what it is.
Sure... Hold on. You don't mean your homemade pottery?
Let me ask you first: are you interested in some less-than-premium holiday crafts?
Maybe, maybe not. It's not very nice to make fun of other people's work, you know.
*Sigh* You're right. I would love a teapot for Xmas.

CBE_HolidayWorkshop2024_CharacterRoddy_0.value: Hi, Roddy! I bet you love the holidays.
How are you doing? I just made another order for socks and scarves.
Well... you got me. I do love this time of year!
Same. I’ve also got a dozen ceramic gnomes on the way. I think we’re doing pretty well!
Great! I've made everyone some presents and, well, I've got one for you, too.
But where are we going to put all the stuff we’ve ordered? It can’t go to my house, because Bella would find it.
I'm speechless! Thank you so much!
I wonder if Maddie could spare a shed or a secret room for it all?
It's a surprise, so you'll have to open it. Oh, I'll just tell you what it is!
Well that is thoughtful. And what a b-beautiful scarf it is!

CBE_HolidayWorkshop2024_Cookies_06_Dialo.value: Did YOU buy all of my crafts, Emilio??
These are just like the ones my granny made!
She sounds like a lovely lady.
You know, everyone always says you're so mysterious and eccentric, but I just don't see it!
I think I ordered a teapot... or five.
I ordered a fantastic set of knitted accessories for Deb. She’ll be totally amazed!
So... my online store actually was...

CBE_HolidayWorkshop2024_CraftingTable_01.value: So, what kind of presents are you planning to buy?
Roddy! Do you know a lot about computers?
I won't be buying anything -- I will MAKE presents for everyone!
I know a little bit. Why?
Ah, hand-crafted presents! I'm actually quite a dab hand with a pottery wheel, myself.
Well, I happen to have a little project I need some help with.
Just give it a rest, Emilio! I know you're good at everything.
Just a little website... Please help me, Roddy! Please???
OK, I guess I can take a look.
Pottery, knitted hats, scarves, and socks, and scented candles!
I knew I could rely on you!
And you know how to make them?
I will learn, and Kazuko promised to help.

CBE_HolidayWorkshop2024_Decoration_Slot1.value: Maddie, I'm glad I caught you!
Really? I thought you're busy with your fish and your research and... Bella.
And I've been tied up as well!
The Mansion keeps me so busy, even at this time of year.
Maybe you've misunderstood mine and Bella's relationship...
I've just delivered all of my presents. I think everyone really LOVED them!
Come on, Emilio -- you promised to help me with that thing.
That THING I told you about. Remember??
Ummm, right. See you around, Maddie!

CBE_HolidayWorkshop2024_Decoration_Slot2.value: I was just looking for a strong guy to help me with all of my shopping bags.
You wouldn't happen to have five minutes, would you?
You do have a lot of shopping bags! Are they full of holiday surprises?

CBE_HolidayWorkshop2024_Decoration_Slot_.value: Maddie, I'm glad I caught you!
Really? I thought you're busy with your fish and your research and... Bella.
And I've been tied up as well!
The Mansion keeps me so busy, even at this time of year.
Maybe you've misunderstood mine and Bella's relationship...
I've just delivered all of my presents. I think everyone really LOVED them!
Come on, Emilio -- you promised to help me with that thing.
That THING I told you about. Remember??
Ummm, right. See you around, Maddie!
I was just looking for a strong guy to help me with all of my shopping bags.
You wouldn't happen to have five minutes, would you?
You do have a lot of shopping bags! Are they full of holiday surprises?

CBE_HolidayWorkshop2024_EventOutro_Dialo.value: Thank you for everything, Roddy. You were so kind to help Bella with her website.
I'm so proud of everything you did for my friends. Your presents were so... unique and thoughtful.
And Emilio with buying my entire stock!
I'm so happy you think so. They are all important to you, I know that, and I want them to like me, too.
At least we now have enough presents to go around for the next ten years!
How could they not like you?
The holidays are never not chaotic around here, but at least they're always memorable.
It's kinda sweet how Maddie has a crush on you, though!
Don't worry - I won't tell anyone!

CBE_HolidayWorkshop2024_InfoPanel_Descri.value:
Bella's Holiday Workshop event has started!
Complete event merge tasks and earn event points.

CBE_HolidayWorkshop2024_IntroPopup_Descr.value: Full of season's cheer and feeling sorry for being rude towards everyone, Bella decides to surprise her new friends with hand-made crafts of all kinds. Her intentions are good and her heart is in the right place, but how will her surprises land?
Bursting with festive spirit, Bella opens an online store for her handmade crafts. But when everything sells out overnight, she can’t help but wonder—what’s really going on?

CBE_HolidayWorkshop2024_IntroPopup_Heade.value: Enter Bella's Holiday Workshop and enjoy the drama!

CBE_HolidayWorkshop2024_Intro_Dialogue_0.value: Don't you just love the holidays? The food, the decorations, the presents...
La-la-la-laaa! The new batch of teapots is in the kiln, and I just got the new yarn for my special beanies. The holiday season is looking up!
Of course, I do. But Bella...
I bet everyone's gonna be beside themselves with happiness when they find all of my goodies under their trees.
Do you think there will be some fun holiday activity at the Mansion?
It’s such a blessing to have the gift of making and crafting, and the ability to spread holiday cheer with my beautiful creations.
In fact... I should make them available to everyone!
I could open an online store. It’s pretty easy, right?
I've been meaning to speak with you about something.
I just need to find someone to set up the website, take some great selfies, and let my crafts do the rest.
But I don’t know anything about websites - and neither does Emilio. Biology degrees are so not transferable skills...
Maddie and her friends generously welcomed you here in Hopewell Bay, but I'm afraid you didn't make the best impression.
Who could I ask? Ah, I think I know the perfect person for the job!
I know, but I was sooo jetlagged from the flight and...

CBE_HolidayWorkshop2024_Intro_Dialogue_1.value: Fine. Maybe I could try to repay their hospitality somehow...
That sounds like a wonderful idea!

CBE_HolidayWorkshop2024_Knitting_05_Dial.value: I'm not sure how good this hat looks...
I’ve got your page up and running, but this is where the real work starts. Are you sure you’ve got it from here?
How do they make it look so easy with the knit and purl? Knitting is really hard!
Absolutely! Have I got any orders yet?
That little kid, Mason, could wear this. Kids don't really care about fashion, do they?
That’s OK. I’ll go whip up some content for social media. My followers won’t let me down!

CBE_HolidayWorkshop2024_PotteryTable_01_.value: Hi, Bella! Where's Emilio? What are you doing?
So you’re setting up an online store?
Hello... Mason, was it? Aren't you a nosy little guy!
That sounds like kind of a BIG project, and...
I guess Emilio is at work, and I'm making pottery.
Are you going to make something cool out of that lump of clay?
Have you really thought this through? Running an online shop takes up a lot of time and effort - and a lot of advertising, too.
That's a teapot I just made.
That won’t be a problem! If you could just set up the website, I’ll do the rest!

CBE_HolidayWorkshop2024_Pottery_05_Dialo.value: The pottery wheel is officially my enemy.
Hey, did Bella tell you about her project?
Of course Emilio is amazing at pottery, as well....
Maybe I could ask him to make these teapots for me?
The online store? For her crafts?
No! It's up to me to make holiday magic happen.
Now that I think about it, she did mention something about a new venture...
She asked me to set up the website, but I’m not sure how successful it will be. I mean, her teapots are a little bit... lumpy. And her beanies...
We need to do something. It would be awful if she didn’t sell anything at all!

CBE_HolidayWorkshop2024_RandomPile_05_Di.value: It’s wonderful! I’ve practically sold out of everything!
You can call it trash, or you can call it abandoned things.
And abandoned things can be made new, with a little bit of love.
Everything has been ordered to the same address in Hopewell Bay.
But I still don’t know the town very well, so I don’t know the address. I guess someone just has exquisite taste!

CBE_HolidayWorkshop2024_SocialMedia_05_D.value: I have to share all these cool new things with my followers on social media...
Bella, are the rumors true? Have you set up an online store for your crafts?
Emilio, could you help me with some photos?
I have. And I just got my first orders!
Umm, sure! What do I need to do?
R-really? I mean, congratulations! That’s wonderful.
Just snap a bunch a photos while I wrap these presents.
Just snap a bunch of photos while I wrap these presents.
Thank you. If you’re looking for the perfect presents for the holidays, there’s a 3% discount with the code PERFECTBELLA.
But remember to get my good side. And frame it right! Is the light good?

CBE_HolidayWorkshop2024_StartPopup_Descr.value: Help Hopewell Bay's new mean girl, Bella, create holiday surprises for Maddie and her friends in Bella's Holiday Workshop!
Bella launches an online store to sell her crafts to the whole world - but who is buying everything up?

CBE_HolidayWorkshop2024_TagSinkFTUE_Desc.value: Drag any Craft Creation into a Donation Box to get more Crafting Supplies for the Crafting Table. The rarer the Craft Creation, the more supplies you get.

CBE_HolidayWorkshop2024_TinCan_05_Dialog.value: Thank you for helping me with the baking stuff, Ursula!
Emilio, Code Red! Bella is onto us.
You know what I've noticed? In this town, you never know what you'll find in an old tin can!
I guess my plan wasn’t totally water-tight after all...
See! This one says "syrup", but it's an old recipe!

CBE_HolidayWorkshop2024_XmasPresents_08_.value: Look at all of these glowing reviews I’ve received!
It was a lot of work, but I've got something EXTRA special for everyone.
‘“The best teapot I’ve ever owned - it sings to my soul!”
I had no idea I was so good at crafts!
“Bella’s candles make my home smell like vanilla and adventure.”

CBE_HolidayWorkshop2025_IntroPopup_Descr.value: Bursting with festive spirit, Bella opens an online store for her handmade crafts. But when everything sells out overnight, she can’t help but wonder—what’s really going on?

CBE_JoysOfTheSea2023_Aquarium_Dialogue_0.value: Let's get started! First off, aquariums!
One can learn about aquatic life, ecosystems and the delicate balance of nature.
My first aquarium is the very reason I became a marine biologist!

CBE_JoysOfTheSea2023_Decoration_Slot01_D.value: A quaint little lily pond water feature.

CBE_JoysOfTheSea2023_Decoration_Slot04_D.value: Sometimes at night, it almost feels like you’re at the pier!

CBE_JoysOfTheSea2023_Decoration_Slot07_D.value: Used to be an old mermaid dunk tank from the county fair in the 20’s.

CBE_JoysOfTheSea2023_Decoration_Slot09_D.value: Useful things to bring along when going out to fish.

CBE_JoysOfTheSea2023_Decoration_Slot10_D.value: Need to know what a buoy is?

CBE_JoysOfTheSea2023_Decoration_Slot15_D.value: It looks like he’s ready to go out to catch a lot of fish!

You can claim all your unclaimed items here!
Thank you for playing the Joys of the Sea event!

CBE_JoysOfTheSea2023_ExtendPopup_Descrip.value:
The Joys of the Sea event has sadly come to an end.
Event Merge Board and Merge Tasks will be closed now.

CBE_JoysOfTheSea2023_ExtendPopup_Rewards.value: Get these items as a bonus!

CBE_JoysOfTheSea2023_Fish10_Dialogue_01.value: Orcas are not only smart, but they’re at the top of the food chain, making them apex predators!

CBE_JoysOfTheSea2023_Fish10_Dialogue_02.value: They live in tight-knit family groups called pods, led by their matriarch, and show highly intricate and sophisticated social structures.

CBE_JoysOfTheSea2023_Fish10_Dialogue_03.value: Orcas are some of my favorite animals in the world!

CBE_JoysOfTheSea2023_Fish10_Dialogue_04.value: And mine are horses! And dogs. AND CATS! and...

CBE_JoysOfTheSea2023_Fish10_Dialogue_05.value: Ha ha! I see you like lots of animals!

CBE_JoysOfTheSea2023_Fish11_Dialogue_01.value: And here we are! The majestic Humpback whales are some of the largest animals in the world!

CBE_JoysOfTheSea2023_Fish11_Dialogue_03.value: That they are! And excellent singers! Their songs are some of the most beautiful I've ever heard...

CBE_JoysOfTheSea2023_Fish11_Dialogue_04.value: Wait until you hear Maddie sing! That'll change your mind!

CBE_JoysOfTheSea2023_Fish1_Dialogue_02.value: They’ve even learned to adapt to desert conditions where they live in springs or pools that exceed temperatures of 90°F!

CBE_JoysOfTheSea2023_Fish3_Dialogue_01.value: Catfish are amazing hunters that can detect electric fields! But did you know they make amazing parents as well?

CBE_JoysOfTheSea2023_Fish3_Dialogue_02.value: In some species, male catfish take on the responsibility of fanning the eggs to keep them oxygenated and free of germs!

CBE_JoysOfTheSea2023_Fish3_Dialogue_03.value: Aaaw, how nice. I never knew my parents...

CBE_JoysOfTheSea2023_Fish3_Dialogue_04.value: Oh... I'm sorry to hear that Maddie!

CBE_JoysOfTheSea2023_Fish3_Dialogue_05.value: It's alright, I have a Grandma Catfish to take care of me instead!

CBE_JoysOfTheSea2023_Fish4_Dialogue_01.value: The unique defense strategies of puffer fish emphasize the importance of being careful with aquatic life!

CBE_JoysOfTheSea2023_Fish4_Dialogue_02.value: While their first line of defense is to inflate into a large and more difficult form to swallow, often with spikes...

CBE_JoysOfTheSea2023_Fish4_Dialogue_03.value: They are also incredibly toxic! Lethal to almost all predators, including humans!

CBE_JoysOfTheSea2023_Fish4_Dialogue_04.value: Th- That's right! You know your fish Mrs. Boulton!

CBE_JoysOfTheSea2023_Fish6_Dialogue_01.value: Sunfish hold the title of heaviest bony fish in the world!

CBE_JoysOfTheSea2023_Fish6_Dialogue_02.value: They can weigh up to 4,800 pounds and grow to 11 feet!

CBE_JoysOfTheSea2023_Fish6_Dialogue_04.value: I've always wished I could speak to them, so I know what they're thinking!

CBE_JoysOfTheSea2023_Fish7_Dialogue_01.value: Swordfish are incredibly fast and considered one of the fastest fish in the sea!

CBE_JoysOfTheSea2023_Fish7_Dialogue_02.value: Some can go up to 60 miles per hour!

CBE_JoysOfTheSea2023_Fish7_Dialogue_03.value: Do you think two swordfish have... Sword fights?!

CBE_JoysOfTheSea2023_Fish8_Dialogue_01.value: Dolphins are one of the most intelligent animals on the Earth! They have large brains and show complex social behavior.

CBE_JoysOfTheSea2023_Fish8_Dialogue_02.value: They also have a remarkable sense called echolocation that helps them navigate and hunt!

CBE_JoysOfTheSea2023_Fish8_Dialogue_03.value: Sometimes I wish my sister would have echolocation. She gets lost in her own backyard, sometimes!

CBE_JoysOfTheSea2023_FishBoat_Dialogue_0.value: Remember to always wear your life vests when out on a boat! No matter how small!
No need, sweetie. I’ll just count on you to save me!

CBE_JoysOfTheSea2023_FishContainer_Dialo.value: Good containers to transport fish for research is paramount.
If you take them out of their habitat for a long time, ensure that you continuously oxygenate the water!

CBE_JoysOfTheSea2023_FishHome_Dialogue_0.value: Coral reefs are often referred to as the "Rainforests of the Sea"!
About a quarter of all sea life live in coral reefs, and some are so large that they can be seen from space!

CBE_JoysOfTheSea2023_FishingClothes_Dial.value: While it may not be the most fashionable, fishing gear is extremely functional!

CBE_JoysOfTheSea2023_FishingLure_Dialogu.value: When picking your lures, make sure they are designed for catch and release!
They can be removed quickly and encourage shallow hooking.

CBE_JoysOfTheSea2023_FishingRod_Dialogue.value: Catch and release is a great conservation method!
But remember, it’s not enough to just throw them back in the water.
Take appropriate action before, during and after landing a fish!

CBE_JoysOfTheSea2023_FishingShack_Dialog.value: Instead of taking all your tackle gear back with you, renting a fishing shack for storage is very convenient.
It can also help you maintain sustainable fishing practices when near regulated fishing areas!

CBE_JoysOfTheSea2023_GrandmasBoathouse_D.value: This is a nice-looking boathouse, Mrs. Boulton!
Thank you, dearie! We originally had it for “other” reasons, but now it’ll be used to explore our wonderful seas!

CBE_JoysOfTheSea2023_InfoPanel_Descripti.value:
The Joys of the Sea event has started!
Complete Event Merge Tasks and earn Event Points.

CBE_JoysOfTheSea2023_IntroDialogue_Dialo.value: May I introduce you to Dr. Emilio Costa, Hopewell Bay’s new marine biologist! He runs the aquarium!
And, as I just recently found out, is Amy’s owner!
Please, it’s just Emilio. Only my mother insists on calling me a doctor!
A pleasure to meet you, just Emilio! How is little Amy?
She’s fine! Thank you again for finding her! And thank you, Mrs. Boulton, for letting me host my exhibition here!
Oh yes, I totally forgot, dearie! Emilio here is going to show us all the joys of the sea!

CBE_JoysOfTheSea2023_IntroPopup_Descript.value:
Emilio Costa is Hopewell Bay’s new pre-eminent marine biologist, and he has come to the Mansion to celebrate and introduce everyone to all the wonders and wildlife found in the sea!

However, he soon discovers that there may be more than fish in the waters of Hopewell Bay.

CBE_JoysOfTheSea2023_IntroPopup_Header.value: Discover the wonders and Joys of the Sea!

CBE_JoysOfTheSea2023_ItemInfo_ChainToolt.value: Claim the previous rank of this item to unlock this rank

CBE_JoysOfTheSea2023_Key_Dialogue_01.value: Now that’s what I call a lucky catch!

CBE_JoysOfTheSea2023_Key_Dialogue_02.value: I thought I had lost this during the storm. Now I can open my trunk!

CBE_JoysOfTheSea2023_LevelUpPopup_Descri.value: Collecting Fish with green arrows allows you to Merge them one level further next time!

CBE_JoysOfTheSea2023_OutroDialogue_Dialo.value: Thank you for showing us how much there is still to learn about the sea, Emilio!
And I am happy there were so many people eager to learn! However...
It seems like I also have a lot to learn about Hopewell Bay! This place is a little...

CBE_JoysOfTheSea2023_Popup_Collect_Item_.value: Are you sure you want to collect the fish?

CBE_JoysOfTheSea2023_SeaWeed_Dialogue_01.value: Seaweed is an excellent habitat for fish and other aquatic life.

CBE_JoysOfTheSea2023_SeaWeed_Dialogue_02.value: Not to mention the fact that it’s incredibly healthy too!

CBE_JoysOfTheSea2023_ShopProgressionPopu.value: The Joys of the Sea Collection
Collect Event Points by completing the Joys of the Sea event merge tasks and get all the Joys of the Sea decoration sets!
Collect Event Points by completing the Joys of the Sea event Merge tasks and get all the Joys of the Sea decoration sets!

CBE_JoysOfTheSea2023_StartPopup_Descript.value: Learn about the sea and join Emilio, Hopewell Bay’s new marine biologist, in the Joys of the Sea event!

CBE_JoysOfTheSea2023_TaskPlay_Descriptio.value: Merge items and discover the joys of the sea with Emilio!

CBE_JoysOfTheSea2023_Trunk_Dialogue_01.value: There we go! Good thing I found my key!

CBE_JoysOfTheSea2023_Trunk_Dialogue_02.value: Now I can gear up and go deeper into the waters of Hopewell Bay!

CBE_JoysOfTheSea_Decoration_Slot01_Dialo.value: I’ve always wanted to put a water feature here!
It is quite beautiful, Maddie. Although I don’t think it’ll be suitable for fish...
Don’t worry, I got a great idea for them!
Hey Maddie! How's... Uuh.. What's going on?
Perfect timing, Roddy! Let me introduce you to Emilio!
Hello! Welcome to the joys of the sea! My name is Emilio Costa, marine biologist! Have you come to learn about all the wonderful things found at sea?
Oh... Uuh, hi. I’m Roddy Took. Architect.
An honor to meet you Roddy! Please! Let me show you around!

CBE_JoysOfTheSea_Decoration_Slot02_Dialo.value: Oh, it is?! I’m sorry, I saw out by the dock and thought I’d use it to spruce up your exhibition!
It’s alright, I’ll just come here on my bicycle instead...
Phew! It is pretty, though, isn’t it?
I may have to keep the flowers when I take it back!

CBE_JoysOfTheSea_Decoration_Slot04_Dialo.value: Sorry, it’s nothing... I’ve just been finding strange things in the sea lately.
I found a bottle that had a cryptic note inside and an old suitcase!
How odd! Hopewell Bay is renowned for its pristine waters!
Exactly! One of the very reasons I decided to come here and study it!

CBE_JoysOfTheSea_Decoration_Slot06_Dialo.value: Hey, Maddie! I thought I’d bring old Buster along to help with the exhibition.
My singing fish! I got it as a gift a long time ago. He’s seen better days, sure, but I’m sure you can appreciate his uniqueness!

CBE_JoysOfTheSea_Decoration_Slot07_Dialo.value: This is pretty incredible, Maddie! How did you find such a large aquarium?!
Oh... I know a guy who knows a guy!
How did you get all the fish?

CBE_JoysOfTheSea_Decoration_Slot08_Dialo.value: So what made you decide to become a marine biologist, handsome?
Uhm... You can call me Emilio. Please...
MADDIE! Hi! I was just uuh, showing- uuh, telling your aunt... uuh, what’s her name?!
Deb. But you can call me... Anytime.

CBE_JoysOfTheSea_Decoration_Slot09_Dialo.value: I’m sorry, dearie. I thought it was junk, so I threw it in the trash!
*sigh* I guess it was junk, Mrs. Boulton. We sort of got carried away with the mystery of it all...
Did Grandma throw away your suitcase?
Yes... I guess we’ll never know if it contained a map to a treasure of untold riches, Roddy...

CBE_JoysOfTheSea_Decoration_Slot10_Dialo.value: Maybe we can use a bobby pin to open it up?
I don’t have any of those, but I have a few old fishing lures?
Look at you two, thick as thieves!
Maddie! Ha, funny you should say that. We were just wondering how to get into this old suitcase I found...
I offered to help, since I used to pick locks as a kid... As a hobby!
Oh really? Hmm, I should remember that...

CBE_JoysOfTheSea_Decoration_Slot14_Dialo.value: Me? Oh no. It isn’t even real!
Matter of fact, never caught a fish in my life!
Well... Not with a rod anyway... I like to use my bare hands.

CBE_JoysOfTheSea_Decoration_Slot15_Dialo.value: I don’t care what people say... Yellow works on everybody!
Looks like we should start calling him captain now.
Wouldn’t be the first time, dearie!

You can Merge the Fish on a camera to take a picture of it and progress in the Event

CBE_LuckyCatch2023_CameraFTUE_Subheader.value: Take a photo of your fish

The Lucky Catch Winter Event is on!
