CBE_LuckyCatchWinter2023_IntroPopup_Desc.value: Get ready to reel in that fish and land your Lucky Catch! Join Maddie and Grandma as they go out for a fun and exciting fishing trip, catching and releasing.

CBE_LuckyCatchWinter2023_Intro_Dialogue_.value: You know what would be really fun, Grandma?
A nice fishing trip! Remember - catch and release, like before.
Oh, yes! Remind me... which one of us ended up catching the biggest one?
I think it was definitely me... I have the photos to prove it!
Hmmm, so it is time for a little re-match!

CBE_LuckyCatchWinter2023_RewardPopup_Wor.value: You have beaten the current world record!

CBE_LuckyCatchWinter2023_StartPopup_Desc.value: Join Maddie and Grandma to help them land that Lucky Catch!

CBE_LuckyCatchWinter2023_TaskPlay_Descri.value: Merge items to help Maddie catch fish!

CBE_LuckyCatchWinter2023_TaskPopup_Rewar.value: You have new rewards available in your fish log!

CBE_LuckyCatchWinter2023_TeaserPopup_Des.value: Please reach a higher level to play the event.

CBE_LuckyCatchWinter2023_UltimateSwordfi.value: Whooooah, a swordfish! Can you handle it?
Phew! There is still some strength left in this old lady but... nnggh... maybe a bit of help would not hurt!
What a specimen! You definitely take the lead with that whopper.
It would make so many tasty pies…
It would make so many tasty pies...
It's time to release it, Grandma!

CBE_LuckyCatchWinter2023_VeryRareGreater.value: I think I caught a Greater Amberjack!
Did you know that it has also been called a 'donkey fish' and 'sailors choice'?
I bet it has a fascinating history.
And it props up my position in our little competition nicely!

CBE_LuckyCatch_BlueMarlin_01.value: What a struggle! She gave me quite a fight!

CBE_LuckyCatch_BlueMarlin_03.value: Female Blue Marlins are sometimes four times larger than males!

CBE_LuckyCatch_BootsLv1_02.value: It's Julius' other boot! He's been looking for that for ages! Don't throw it away!

CBE_LuckyCatch_BootsLv1_03.value: Are we seriously going to keep it?!! This thing belongs in the trash!

CBE_LuckyCatch_Dorado_02.value: I... I wasn't actually expecting to catch anything!

CBE_LuckyCatch_Dorado_03.value: That fish is almost as big as you!

CBE_LuckyCatch_EpicGoldenRod_01.value: There's no hiding from me now, big fish. This rod has your name on it!

CBE_LuckyCatch_EpicGoldenRod_02.value: I remember hearing a story once about a fisher catching something very large and rare with a rod like that...

CBE_LuckyCatch_GrandmaSuitcase_01.value: Ugh... This thing is heavy! Wait, a minute! Is this a suitcase?!

CBE_LuckyCatch_GrandmaSuitcase_02.value: OH! Well, it looks like a piece of old junk. You should throw it in the trash when we get back.

CBE_LuckyCatch_GrandmaSuitcase_03.value: Does that look like C.B. to you?

CBE_LuckyCatch_Intro_01.value: Nothing like going out for a relaxing fishing trip, right Grandma?

CBE_LuckyCatch_Intro_02.value: That's right dearie. I can't wait to make my scrumptious fish pie!

CBE_LuckyCatch_Intro_03.value: Oh no, we're not going to eat the fish Grandma; it's catch and release!

CBE_LuckyCatch_Intro_04.value: But... I bought so much butter!

CBE_LuckyCatch_Intro_05.value: This time you'll be taking a photo, and then we can frame it. Who knows what we'll catch?!

CBE_LuckyCatch_Intro_06.value: That's true, dearie. The ocean is awfully deep. You never know what secrets you might dredge up...

CBE_LuckyCatch_MaxCommonWoodenFishingRod.value: I'm sure we'll catch something with these...
Hmm, maybe you're right. We should find some better rods!

CBE_LuckyCatch_MaxFishingClothesAndGolde.value: Now nothing can stop us from catching the most epic of fish!
Good grief, dearie! You look like someone out of a fishing magazine.
That's right! The title would read, "Maddie Boulton: EPIC Fisher!"

CBE_LuckyCatch_MaxFishingToolBox_01.value: Everything is ready to catch us some big fish!

CBE_LuckyCatch_MaxFishingToolBox_02.value: Hahaha! You sound like your Grandpa Charlie.

CBE_LuckyCatch_MaxFishingToolBox_03.value: He had such big fish stories. Swore he caught the Loch Ness Monster, once.

CBE_LuckyCatch_MaxGrandmaNote_01.value: Grandma! I think I've pieced together what looks like a...

CBE_LuckyCatch_MaxGrandmaNote_02.value: A message! Or a riddle? Huh? What does this even mean?!

CBE_LuckyCatch_MaxGrandmaNote_03.value: From the depths, secrets gleam unseen, thus from porcelain's embrace, you'll will find treasures previously unseen.

CBE_LuckyCatch_MaxGrandmaNote_04.value: See? Nonsense! I wouldn't even bother asking around about it...

CBE_LuckyCatch_MaxNutsAndBolts_01.value: I think we should pick the lock!

CBE_LuckyCatch_MaxNutsAndBolts_02.value: I doubt there's anything of worth in there...

CBE_LuckyCatch_MaxNutsAndBolts_03.value: Don't be like that! Maybe this has something important inside!

CBE_LuckyCatch_RareCompetitionRod_02.value: That's a fancy-looking rod you have there. Looks complicated too.

CBE_LuckyCatch_RareCompetitionRod_03.value: The manual was over forty-eight pages long! I loved it!

CBE_LuckyCatch_RedSnapper_02.value: A very tasty fish! Can't we just keep this one at least?

CBE_LuckyCatch_RedSnapper_03.value: Grab that camera, Grandma. Remember, this is catch and release!

CBE_LuckyCatch_Roosterfish_02.value: Quick Maddie, let me take this photo before you pierce yourself!

CBE_LuckyCatch_Tarpon_01.value: Look at this fish, Grandma! Isn't it great?!

CBE_LuckyCatch_Tarpon_02.value: It's magnificent! I guess your fancy gear really helped!

CBE_LuckyCatch_TornLetterLv1_01.value: Aaw... Just a bunch of soggy paper...

CBE_LuckyCatch_TornLetterLv1_02.value: Hmm, there's some writing on them, but they're falling apart, fast!

CBE_LuckyCatch_TornLetterLv1_03.value: Old wet paper tends to do that, dearie!

CBE_LuckyCatch_TrophyLv6_01.value: You must be doing something right to win that!

CBE_LuckyCatch_TrophyLv6_02.value: Thank you, Grandma, but I think this one should go to you!

CBE_LuckyCatch_TrophyLv7_02.value: Most prolific fisher! We caught a lot of fish, after all.

CBE_LuckyCatch_TrophyLv8_02.value: I won the Master Fisher trophy!

CBE_LuckyCatch_TrophyLv8_03.value: Congratulations, dearie! You really deserve it!

CBE_LuckyCatch_Wahoo_01.value: This fish looks really fast! I'm surprised I caught it.

CBE_LuckyCatch_Wahoo_02.value: Are you sure you can pick it up? Maybe you can sit next to it?

CBE_LuckyCatch_Wahoo_03.value: No... No-... I got this! I... Ugh..  HAVE YOU TAKEN THE PICTURE YET?!

CBE_LuckyCatch_WorldRecordFish_01.value: How heavy did you say that fish was?!

CBE_LuckyCatch_WorldRecordFish_03.value: Well, according to the fish guide, you just beat the world record!

CBE_LuckyCatch_YellowfinTuna_01.value: This one was quite the battle, but I got it in the end!

CBE_LuckyCatch_YellowfinTuna_02.value: I swear I almost saw you get pulled off the side twice...

CBE_LuckyCatch_YellowfinTuna_03.value: I almost did! It was so exciting!

CBE_MaddieInJapan2025_AkihabaraLandmark_.value: I wonder what Grandma made of Akihabara. Let’s see what she wrote!
“I know now that he came here to see the railway station. It must have inspired him to build his own tracks back home…”
“I know now that he came here to see the railway station. It must have inspired him to build his own tracks back home...”
A railway? She must be talking about Ignatius!

CBE_MaddieInJapan2025_AkihabaraPostcard_.value: Is that another postcard from Maddie?
"The claw machines of Akihabara are great, and I can't wait to see more of Japan. Grandma's postcards have been a good guide."

CBE_MaddieInJapan2025_AkihabaraThings_03.value: Akihabara is so full of interesting things that I don’t even know where to begin!
Maybe it’s time I try my luck with the claw machines…
Maybe it’s time I try my luck with the claw machines...
Let's see... Where are the best ones?

CBE_MaddieInJapan2025_AkihabaraThings_05.value: This place has been a complete change of pace from the previous sights I’ve seen, but it’s so full of energy.
I would love to take a piece of Akihabara's magic home with me…
I would love to take a piece of Akihabara's magic home with me...
Maybe I could build something similar at the Mansion!

CBE_MaddieInJapan2025_Food_02_Dialogue_0.value: I thought we could have a Japanese dinner before you go away. You know, to help you get used to the local cuisine.

CBE_MaddieInJapan2025_Food_04_Dialogue_0.value: What a feast, Grandma! How did you learn to cook this?
I picked up a trick or two while I was traveling.

CBE_MaddieInJapan2025_Food_06_Dialogue_0.value: After this feast, I’ll be ready to start exploring the locations Grandma visited back in the day.
I thought I knew what Japanese food is like, but boy, was I wrong!
I remember when Roddy tried to make sushi once. Those floppy rolls were not anything like this!
Grandma's sushi on the other hand... Now I know where she got her skills.

CBE_MaddieInJapan2025_FushimiInariLandma.value: Fushimi Inari… What an amazing place!
Fushimi Inari... What an amazing place!
The Japanese really seem to have a gift for slowing down and staying in the moment.
I wonder how many of these torii gates there are along the paths… I bet there’s at least a thousand!
I wonder how many of these torii gates there are along the paths... I bet there’s at least a thousand!
Let’s see what Grandma’s postcard says about this place…
Let’s see what Grandma’s postcard says about this place...
“I followed the trail of breadcrumbs to the mountain and found the gate. He was here.”
Hmm... Who could she be talking about?

CBE_MaddieInJapan2025_FushimiInariPostca.value: Maddie writes from Fushimi Inari in Kyoto! She really is following in Ursula’s footsteps.
But will she figure out what her Grandma was up to, I wonder…
But will she figure out what her Grandma was up to, I wonder...
She writes: “I walked through a thousand torii gates, but couldn’t find the one Grandma was looking for.”

CBE_MaddieInJapan2025_FushimiInariThings.value: So many different kinds of foxes!
Grandma would love one of these kitsune masks. She has such a strange love for any kind of disguise!
It says in my guidebook that these torii gates have been donated by people and companies over the years.
I wonder if Grandma donated one?
There are just too many to check!

CBE_MaddieInJapan2025_GettingReady_02_Di.value: It is a long flight to Japan, dearie. Are you sure you’ve got everything you need?
Snacks? A warm jumper for the plane? It is always cold on a plane with the over-eager air-conditioning…
Snacks? A warm jumper for the plane? It is always cold on a plane with the over-eager air-conditioning...
I’ve got everything, but are you… fussing?
I’ve got everything, but are you... fussing?
But you’re going far away, and I just want to make sure you are prepared for everything.
Don’t worry, Grandma. I’ll be OK!

CBE_MaddieInJapan2025_GettingReady_04_Di.value: So you and Grandma met in Japan, while she was living there?
That’s right. She told me about Hopewell Bay, and it sounded so wonderful that I ended up moving here, too.
All the time! But I still visit from time to time, and I can always reminisce with your Grandma.
I’ve never been able to figure out what Grandma did in Japan. Did she work?
Yes, she worked in a number of places, from a small ramen shop to a fish vendor, and for a time, she was an English tutor.
However, I always got the feeling she was actually searching for something there. Something she had to keep secret…
However, I always got the feeling she was actually searching for something there. Something she had to keep secret...
She never told me, and I never asked!

CBE_MaddieInJapan2025_GettingReady_06_Di.value: Salutations, Maddie! Are you really traveling to Japan?
I sure am. Kazuko told me about how Grandma used to live there, and I really want to explore some of the places she used to go to.
Ah, I might be able to help you there, my dear! I have these old postcards Ursula used to send me from her travels.
They are all from famous Japanese sights. There are others, too, but I thought you could use these as inspiration for your itinerary.
Thank you so much, Julius! But where are the other postcards from?
We’ll save those for your future travels.

CBE_MaddieInJapan2025_GettingReady_10_Di.value: I sometimes have this nightmare where I’m leaving for the airport, and my bags are totally unpacked.
This time I’m so prepared. I’ve got my passport and tickets, a travel pillow for the long flight, and plenty of snacks.
Did you pack some comfortable shoes?
You never know when you might need a good disguise, dearie…
You never know when you might need a good disguise, dearie...

CBE_MaddieInJapan2025_InfoPanel_Descript.value:
The Maddie in Japan event has started!
Complete Event Merge tasks and earn Event Points.

CBE_MaddieInJapan2025_IntroPopup_Descrip.value: Pack your bags for another adventure, because Maddie is headed to Japan. Stories of Grandma's travels inspire her to embark on a journey of her own, from one legendary sight to another, but what will she discover along the way?

CBE_MaddieInJapan2025_IntroPopup_Header.value: Follow in Grandma's footsteps and travel to Japan's most famous sights with Maddie!

CBE_MaddieInJapan2025_Intro_Dialogue_01.value: Pheeew, I really need a holiday!

CBE_MaddieInJapan2025_Intro_Dialogue_02.value: I’ve been raking, digging, dusting and polishing for so long that I can’t even see straight.

CBE_MaddieInJapan2025_Intro_Dialogue_03.value: Hello, Maddie! My, you have worked hard. This Mansion is starting to look like new!

CBE_MaddieInJapan2025_Intro_Dialogue_04.value: I know - I was just dreaming about a little break to recharge my batteries and find new inspiration for the Mansion.

CBE_MaddieInJapan2025_Intro_Dialogue_06.value: Oh, I’d love to! I happened to hear once that Grandma used to live there. Is it true?

CBE_MaddieInJapan2025_Intro_Dialogue_07.value: It is. That’s where we met. You must travel there. It will be very good for you, I know it.

CBE_MaddieInJapan2025_Intro_Dialogue_09.value: It’s settled then. I’ll speak with Ursula and organize everything!

CBE_MaddieInJapan2025_JigokudaniLandmark.value: These guys are pretty spoiled, if you ask me.
“I was able to find out that he was here, searching for something. I am just not sure, whether he found it - whatever it was.”
She was following in someone’s footsteps...

CBE_MaddieInJapan2025_JigokudaniPostcard.value: Is it from Maddie? How wonderful!
Yes, indeed. She has been touring the places on Ursula’s old postcards.
She is a bright girl, Julius. You will see that she will see what her grandmother was searching for.
And that they are not that different at all!
You might be right. This is what she writes:
“The monkey onsen at Jigokudani is like nothing I’ve ever seen. But who was Grandma looking for here?"

CBE_MaddieInJapan2025_JigokudaniThings_0.value: It would be more than amazing to have a little bath like this at the Mansion.
I can imagine soaking in it after a hard day’s work.
But this holiday is already starting to take effect. I feel more relaxed than in a long time.
It’s good to have some time away, and I’m really starting to enjoy solo-travel!
I have to snap a photo of these monkeys. They are so cute!
Mason won’t believe me when I tell him about this place.

CBE_MaddieInJapan2025_Outro_Dialogue_01.value: It’s so good to be home!

CBE_MaddieInJapan2025_Outro_Dialogue_02.value: But did you enjoy your trip?

CBE_MaddieInJapan2025_Outro_Dialogue_03.value: I loved it. From the Yasaka Pagoda to the Shibuya Crossing, I learned so much - also about you!

CBE_MaddieInJapan2025_Outro_Dialogue_05.value: Did you travel to Japan to find out something about Ignatius’ past?

CBE_MaddieInJapan2025_Outro_Dialogue_06.value: It was so long ago, but… yes, I did. You see, the mystery of our family is a little bit like an onion.
It was so long ago, but... yes, I did. You see, the mystery of our family is a little bit like an onion.

CBE_MaddieInJapan2025_Outro_Dialogue_08.value: There are many layers, and we have all had to peel them back, one by one. That goes for me, too.

CBE_MaddieInJapan2025_Outro_Dialogue_09.value: So why don’t you just tell me about them?

CBE_MaddieInJapan2025_Outro_Dialogue_10.value: Some things you have to find out for yourself, dearie.

CBE_MaddieInJapan2025_Outro_Dialogue_11.value: But come now. I've made you some sushi, and you can tell me all about your trip!

CBE_MaddieInJapan2025_ShibuyaLandmark_01.value: The famous Shibuya crossing - the busiest pedestrian crossing in the world!
It sure is busy here! I’m so used to the quiet small-town life that I forget that there are places like this in the world.
It’s time to read the last one of Grandma’s postcards.
“I think I now have the full story. It has taken a lot of time and effort to put the pieces together, but I will crack this mystery.”
So she was following in Ignatius’ footsteps, trying to solve his mysteries!
I guess we have more in common than I’ve realized…
I guess we have more in common than I’ve realized...

CBE_MaddieInJapan2025_ShibuyaPostcard_01.value: Did Maddie send another postcard? Is she OK?
She is fine, and she’s enjoying Japan.
She has been following the tracks left by your old postcards.
You have kept them all these years?
Of course! And it seems Maddie has figured out what you were doing in Japan.
Well, she is a bright girl. What does she write?
Let’s see… “Finally in Shibuya. I've found what I was looking for - complete holiday mood. Grandma’s postcards make sense now.”
Let’s see... “Finally in Shibuya. I've found what I was looking for - complete holiday mood. Grandma’s postcards make sense now.”

CBE_MaddieInJapan2025_ShibuyaThings_03_D.value: I think I understand this place now. At first glance, it seems like total chaos, but it’s not!
There’s a structure and a rhythm that make the place work like a well-oiled machine.

CBE_MaddieInJapan2025_ShibuyaThings_05_D.value: Oh, this must be the statue of Hachiko, the dog who waited for his master every day at the station.
What a good dog... Always waiting for his master, even after he passed away!
I think I’m starting to get a little bit homesick.

CBE_MaddieInJapan2025_Souvenirs_02_Dialo.value: Do you know the art of origami, Maddie?
I know of it, but I can’t say I’m very good at it…
I know of it, but I can’t say I’m very good at it...
Let me show you. It is a great practice of patience and of how to calm the mind.

CBE_MaddieInJapan2025_Souvenirs_04_Dialo.value: Is there something you'd like me to bring for you?
No, dearie. I've already got everything I need.
Although... If you get a chance, you could maybe bring back some of that dried octopus.

CBE_MaddieInJapan2025_Souvenirs_06_Dialo.value: There will be so many cool souvenirs to get… How will I ever fit it into my luggage?
There will be so many cool souvenirs to get... How will I ever fit it into my luggage?
And I need to take something for my friends, too.
Maybe I should buy an extra suitcase just for the souvenirs!

CBE_MaddieInJapan2025_StartPopup_Descrip.value: Follow in Grandma's footsteps and travel to Japan's most famous sights with Maddie!

CBE_MaddieInJapan2025_Travel_02_Dialogue.value: I've got my comfy walking shoes on, my camera is fully charged, and I'm ready for an adventure.
Now I just need a travel card.

CBE_MaddieInJapan2025_Travel_03_Dialogue.value: A good old-fashioned bicycle is totally the best way to see a new place.
On a bike, I feel like I’m blending in better, and I can see all kinds of places other transport just can’t go.
Look at me, moving through Tokyo like a pro!

CBE_MaddieInJapan2025_Travel_06_Dialogue.value: I finally know where I am and where I’m going. Now I just need to hop on a train!
These old postcards Julius gave me are full of interesting stuff… but they also form a pretty good list of things to visit.
These old postcards Julius gave me are full of interesting stuff... but they also form a pretty good list of things to visit.
It’s gonna be so cool to visit some of the places Grandma loved to visit while she lived here.
And it’ll be interesting to see what might have drawn her to them.

CBE_MaddieInJapan2025_YasakaPagodaThings.value: It says here that it was originally built in 597! And it is supposed to have been inspired by a dream.
I can see why they say that!
What does Grandma’s postcard say about this place…
What does Grandma’s postcard say about this place...
“The pagoda stands tall, but no sign of him.”
What does that mean?? Who is she talking about?
So, Kyoto used to be the capital of Japan.
And it says in my guidebook that Yasaka Pagoda is over a thousand years old!
There's so much history on these streets... I can't wait to explore more!

CBE_MaddieInJapan2025_YenCoins_03_Dialog.value: Kazuko told me to always have some change in my pocket. I wonder why?
I guess she knew I’d get totally hooked on the gachapon machines.

CBE_MaddieInJapan2025__Dialogue_01.value: Some things you have to find out for yourself, dearie. But come now. You must be hungry, and I’ve made some sushi!

CBE_MaddieInParis2025_ArcDeTriomphe_01_D.value: I've got the beret and the scarf - they won't even recognize me back home!
Maybe I could get myself some perfume as a souvenir.
Cheese and crackers, this place is EXPENSIVE!

CBE_MaddieInParis2025_ArcDeTriomphe_05_D.value: Is that handsome man trying to offer me a ride in his car? Oh, no...
But it's a very nice car...
Non, merci! Err... Je ne veux pas... Sorry - I've got to go!

CBE_MaddieInParis2025_EiffelTower_01_Dia.value: I wonder if I could pull off wearing a beret?
Well, you know what they say? When in Paris, do as the Parisians do!

CBE_MaddieInParis2025_EiffelTower_05_Dia.value: The view from the Eiffel Tower is awesome!
And the parks here are so interesting.
Maybe I should build a little bit of Paris at the Mansion when I get home.

CBE_MaddieInParis2025_Food_06_Dialogue_0.value: How am I supposed to pick just one out of all these yummy treats?
Hang on... I'll take as many as I want!
Excuse me, sir. I'll have the whole platter, s'il vous plaît!

CBE_MaddieInParis2025_InfoPanel_Descript.value: [PLACEHOLDER] An old cabin in the mountains - full of secrets, of course. Get ready for a hike!
Join Maddie on an unforgettable vacation in Paris!

CBE_MaddieInParis2025_IntroPopup_Descrip.value: [PLACEHOLDER] Maddie discovers an old journal with a map to a mysterious location in the mountains. She sets off to find out what is hidden where the X marks the spot and discovers more than she ever expected. Join Maddie on a wintery adventure!

When Grandma decides to send Maddie on a little vacation to Paris, Maddie comes face to face with all of her romantic nightmares - in the city of love. Join Maddie on an unforgettable vacation in Paris - see the sights, sample the food and celebrate a solo Valentine's in style!

CBE_MaddieInParis2025_IntroPopup_Header.value: [PLACEHOLDER] An old cabin in the mountains - full of secrets, of course. Get ready for a hike!
Join Maddie on an unforgettable vacation in Paris!

CBE_MaddieInParis2025_Intro_Dialogue_01.value: Maddie! Your Grandma told me you have just returned from your vacation!

CBE_MaddieInParis2025_Intro_Dialogue_04.value: It really was amazing! I loved the food and all the sights...

CBE_MaddieInParis2025_Intro_Dialogue_05.value: It was great to have some time away, I feel like a totally new person!

CBE_MaddieInParis2025_Intro_Dialogue_06.value: You even look a little bit different.

CBE_MaddieInParis2025_Intro_Dialogue_07.value: Say, have you done something with your hair?

CBE_MaddieInParis2025_Intro_Dialogue_08.value: It's just a more elegant, Parisian version of the same old Maddie!

CBE_MaddieInParis2025_Louvre_01_Dialogue.value: Imagine having to renovate this place from ruin...
All of a sudden, the Mansion seems like a breeze!

CBE_MaddieInParis2025_Louvre_05_Dialogue.value: She's smaller than I imagined... but just as beautiful.
Her smile is mysterious, sure, but I know a certain older lady who would outdo her anytime.

CBE_MaddieInParis2025_NotreDame_01_Dialo.value: Grandma said that when she visited Paris a long time ago, she had been here for some rendez-vous...
That sounds like such a Parisian thing!

CBE_MaddieInParis2025_NotreDame_05_Dialo.value: I wonder if Grandma and Grandpa Charlie left a lock here...
This is such a romantic place... So many people professing their love. I wonder...
If I'll ever find a love like that.

CBE_MaddieInParis2025_Outro_Dialogue_01.value: So, do you want to tell me more about all the rendez-vous' you had in Paris, Grandma?

CBE_MaddieInParis2025_Outro_Dialogue_02.value: That is between me and Paris, dearie!

CBE_MaddieInParis2025_Outro_Dialogue_03.value: I got to travel to so many places when I was young, but Paris was one of the most special.

CBE_MaddieInParis2025_Outro_Dialogue_04.value: It was so easy to blend in and hide in plain sight, among the bustle of the cafés...

CBE_MaddieInParis2025_Outro_Dialogue_06.value: Never mind! I am so happy you're back safe and sound.

CBE_MaddieInParis2025_Outro_Dialogue_07.value: But did YOU have any rendez-vous' during your vacation?

CBE_MaddieInParis2025_Outro_Dialogue_08.value: No, it was just me - and it was PERFECT!

CBE_MaddieInParis2025_SacreCoeur_01_Dial.value: I think I'm lost... The place I'm looking for is S-sacre Coeur.
Is it that beautiful white building on top of the hill?
Well, I can have an ice cream at the top.

CBE_MaddieInParis2025_SacreCoeur_05_Dial.value: It's true what they say about this city.
The food, the music, the sights... It's all just wonderful!
This vacation is just what I needed to unwind.
My resolution to avoid all drama and men has worked so far, but I'm excited to see what the year will bring.

CBE_MaddieInParis2025_Slot_14_Dialogue_0.value: Why is love like the streets of Paris?
Because sometimes it sweeps you off your feet, and other times, you step in something gross.

CBE_MaddieInParis2025_Slot_18_Dialogue_0.value: What was your favorite thing about Paris, Maddie?
The whole city was just so full of... charm! It was really wonderful.
What did you do on Valentine's Day?
You know, Roddy cooked us his famous lasagna...  I guess he bought some roses, too.
I didn't know he cooks lasagna?
Oh, yeah. Some family recipe. He's very proud of it! Actually, he did this funny thing...
I'd love to hear all about it, but I'm actually in a rush to... a thing with Grandma. See you later!

CBE_MaddieInParis2025_Slot_22_Dialogue_0.value: What in the world? The place looks just like Paris!
I felt inspired to bring a little piece of Paris home with me.
Now we can all enjoy it!
This looks like the perfect setting for a romantic picnic!

CBE_MaddieInParis2025_StartPopup_Descrip.value: [PLACEHOLDER] Join Maddie on an adventure to a cabin in the mountains and get ready to uncover a couple of big secrets!
Join Maddie on an unforgettable vacation in Paris - see the sights, sample the food and celebrate a solo Valentine's in style!

CBE_MaddieInParis2025_Travel_04_Dialogue.value: It's been so long since I travelled anywhere!
The Mansion's been taking up all of my time and effort.
Let's see - do I have everything? I feel like I've forgotten something already.
Maybe I'll check the passport one more time.

CBE_MaddieInParis2025_ValentinesMerch_04.value: The sun is shining and I'm in Paris - life is good!
Maybe it's time for some souvenir shopping!
This is great! Oh... it's a heart. You really can't escape all the Valentine's junk anywhere, can you?
Why does the world seem to think that you can only be happy and fulfilled if you're a couple?
That's it! Let the radical self-love commence!

CBE_MaddieInParis2025_ValentinesMerch_06.value: Look at this... Another stuffed toy declaring love.
Maybe I'll get it for myself!
Sure, it would be nice to be here with some special person and celebrate love...
But I can celebrate myself, too!

CBE_MaddieInParis_ArcDeTriomphe_02_Dialo.value: This is such a great place for people-watching!
The streets are full of tourists in awe of this wonderful city, and Parisians busy just doing their thing.
It doesn’t matter where you look, there’s always something interesting to see.

CBE_MaddieInParis_ArcDeTriomphe_05_Dialo.value: What a journey this has been!
My “art” is maybe not up to the standard of real artists, but at least I’ve captured this trip on paper and canvas, and I have to say that I’m pretty proud of myself.

CBE_MaddieInParis_EiffelTower_02_Dialogu.value: The engineering of the Eiffel Tower really is impressive. It gets me every time!
Wow, I only just realized how many people have come here just to paint or sketch. Some people have even brought their easels!
Photos never do these sights justice... Maybe I could try to do some drawing too.

CBE_MaddieInParis_EiffelTower_05_Dialogu.value: I have no idea what I'm doing.
Since college, I've only ever drawn engineering plans.
The curved shape of the Eiffel Tower is beautiful, but my hand wants to map out forces, not feelings.
This is hard. I’m trying to create a sketch, not a blueprint!

CBE_MaddieInParis_Food_06_Dialogue_02.value: What should I have… There’s so much to choose from.

CBE_MaddieInParis_Food_06_Dialogue_03.value: I can feel the pâtisserie calling!

CBE_MaddieInParis_IntroPopup_Description.value: Maddie returns to the City of Love and decides to try her hand at recording her experiences with a brush and a canvas. Join her on an unforgettable Valentine's vacation in Paris and see the most famous sights in the city in a brand-new way!

CBE_MaddieInParis_Intro_Dialogue_01.value: I need my comfiest shoes and an umbrella… Where’s my passport?

CBE_MaddieInParis_Intro_Dialogue_02.value: Here it is, dearie. Are you sure you don't want me to go with you on this trip?

CBE_MaddieInParis_Intro_Dialogue_03.value: Thank you! I am sure, but thank you for offering. I think solo travel suits me - it gives me a chance to explore and learn. Even about myself!

CBE_MaddieInParis_Intro_Dialogue_04.value: What is on your Paris itinerary this time? Valentine's dinners and chocolates?

CBE_MaddieInParis_Intro_Dialogue_05.value: I’m just going to let the city take me where it will. There’s always something new to discover in Paris!

CBE_MaddieInParis_Intro_Dialogue_06.value: But will you be OK while I’m away? I feel bad about leaving you on your own with all the work in the garden and--

CBE_MaddieInParis_Intro_Dialogue_07.value: Hush! I will be fine - and so will everyone else - so you can go and enjoy yourself.

CBE_MaddieInParis_Louvre_02_Dialogue_01.value: I’ve always loved engineering and building things, because it’s accurate. A structure is either sound or it’s not.

CBE_MaddieInParis_Louvre_02_Dialogue_02.value: It holds true to the calculations, or it doesn’t.

CBE_MaddieInParis_Louvre_02_Dialogue_03.value: I wish life could be more like that.

CBE_MaddieInParis_Louvre_02_Dialogue_04.value: How do I know if my sketches are any good?

CBE_MaddieInParis_Louvre_02_Dialogue_05.value: Then again, who cares? I’m drawing for myself - not anyone else.

CBE_MaddieInParis_Louvre_05_Dialogue_01.value: This place needs broad strokes… and more color!

CBE_MaddieInParis_Louvre_05_Dialogue_02.value: It’s funny to think about these huge old buildings that were built so long ago.

CBE_MaddieInParis_Louvre_05_Dialogue_03.value: Here they stand after all this time, holding all of their stories and secrets. Just like Beaumont Hall back home.

CBE_MaddieInParis_Louvre_05_Dialogue_04.value: I think I need to paint it when I get home again…

CBE_MaddieInParis_Louvre_05_Dialogue_05.value: Now it's time for a visit to see the Old Masters in the Louvre to fuel my creativity!

CBE_MaddieInParis_NotreDame_02_Dialogue_.value: I HAVE to draw the Notre Dame! It’s such an iconic place - and so beautiful.
My sketches are far from perfect… Stop. Breathe. Just draw.

CBE_MaddieInParis_NotreDame_05_Dialogue_.value: This structure is so different from the Eiffel Tower where the bones are visible.
My brain wants to break it up into parts - flying buttresses, ribbed vaults, load distribution… but then I’ll miss the soul of it.
The people who built this place weren’t only thinking about the structure. They were building something that would make people amazed.
And boy, did they do a good job!

CBE_MaddieInParis_Outro_Dialogue_01.value: Welcome back, dearie! Did you have a nice trip?

CBE_MaddieInParis_Outro_Dialogue_02.value: It was wonderful! Paris was as beautiful as I remembered, and I got to experience something new.

CBE_MaddieInParis_Outro_Dialogue_04.value: Don’t give me that look! I just did some sketching and painting. It started off wobbly, but I’m pretty happy with some of it.

CBE_MaddieInParis_Outro_Dialogue_05.value: I cannot wait to see it. You have been sorely missed, by the way.

CBE_MaddieInParis_Outro_Dialogue_07.value: You have no idea. Come on - it is time for a cup of tea and some pie.

CBE_MaddieInParis_SacreCoeur_02_Dialogue.value: Montmartre used to be a hub for bohemian artists back in the day, and you can definitely still feel it.
I know I’m not a real artist, but I can’t help but feel like one here.
This looks like the perfect spot for some drawing.
Why is that old couple looking at me?

CBE_MaddieInParis_SacreCoeur_05_Dialogue.value: Someone just mistook me for a REAL artist!

CBE_MaddieInParis_Slot_16_Dialogue_01.value: Is Maddie off on her travels again?

CBE_MaddieInParis_Slot_16_Dialogue_03.value: I’ve always wanted to go, but never got the chance, you know.

CBE_MaddieInParis_Slot_16_Dialogue_04.value: If that is a dream of yours, you should make it come true. That is what Maddie is doing!

CBE_MaddieInParis_Slot_16_Dialogue_05.value: Seize the day and all that?

CBE_MaddieInParis_Slot_19_Dialogue_01.value: When is Maddie coming back from Paris? I’m asking because I, err, had a renovation-related question for her.

CBE_MaddieInParis_Slot_19_Dialogue_02.value: It seems like she has been having a lot of fun!

CBE_MaddieInParis_Slot_19_Dialogue_03.value: I do hope she's being careful, though. I read there are a lot of pickpockets there...

CBE_MaddieInParis_Slot_19_Dialogue_04.value: I am sure she is very careful. As for fun, Paris is a great city with a lot to see and do.

CBE_MaddieInParis_Slot_19_Dialogue_05.value: That’s what I hear people say. I’ve never been myself, but maybe one day.

CBE_MaddieInParis_Slot_19_Dialogue_06.value: I highly recommend it. Oh, and Roddy?

CBE_MaddieInParis_Slot_19_Dialogue_08.value: She’ll be back in just a couple of days.

CBE_MaddieInParis_Slot_23_Dialogue_01.value: Ursula, the universe is sending me the strangest vibrations. They’re making me feel QUITE uneasy!

CBE_MaddieInParis_Slot_23_Dialogue_02.value: Is Maddie back from Paris yet?

CBE_MaddieInParis_Slot_23_Dialogue_04.value: Ah, good, good. It will be nice to have her home. You never know with all the strange food and the… French-ness.

CBE_MaddieInParis_StartPopup_Description.value: Join Maddie on an unforgettable Valentine's vacation in Paris and visit the most famous sights in the city!

CBE_MaddieInParis_Travel_04_Dialogue_01.value: It’s so exciting to be in Paris!

CBE_MaddieInParis_Travel_04_Dialogue_02.value: I can’t wait to stroll along the streets of Montmartre and do some people-watching at the Louvre.

CBE_MaddieInParis_Travel_04_Dialogue_03.value: This city is so vibrant and full of life. I just want to dive in and soak it all up.

CBE_MaddieInParis_Travel_04_Dialogue_04.value: But first, I need to get changed.

CBE_MaddieInParis_ValentinesMerch_06_Dia.value: I wonder where this trip will take me!
My last trip to Paris taught me that traveling alone can be really great. Then again, spending Valentine's alone can get lonely...
Well, I can't wait to see what will happen!

CBE_MasonsEggHunt2024_BrainPuzzle_07_Dia.value: This egg hunt will be total puzzler for Maddie and the others!
My brain puzzles have turned me into a total MASTERMIND.

CBE_MasonsEggHunt2024_BunnyOutfit_08_Dia.value: I can't wear this thing! It's just too.. CUTE!

CBE_MasonsEggHunt2024_CollectableEasterE.value: But no more spots and stripes. This year, they're gonna have a different look!
Wow. The eggs are finally done!
Now I just need to hide them all...

CBE_MasonsEggHunt2024_Decoration_Slot01_.value: The place looks wonderful, Mason - great job!
Thank you! I hope you're ready for the egg hunt to end all egg hunts!
This Easter egg hunt will not be like any you've done before...
Seek high and low, turn every stone and use your wits to decode the CLUES I've left you!

CBE_MasonsEggHunt2024_Decoration_Slot03_.value: Hang on! What will the egg hunters get as a prize?
Let see... Chocolates, little toys, trinkets...
This nice ring will make a good main prize. It deserves to go in the fanciest egg.
Hmmm... It looks kinda familiar. Oh, well! In you go!

CBE_MasonsEggHunt2024_Decoration_Slot05_.value: There are so many places to hide eggs in this garden.
Not to mention all the cool little nooks and crannies inside the Mansion.
I bet Grandma Ursula and Maddie have no idea I know about ALL that secret stuff...

CBE_MasonsEggHunt2024_Decoration_Slot07_.value: I can't believe this! My ring... it's gone!
What's wrong, Hank - have you lost something?
I-- I've lost a really valuable piece of jewelry... a ring.
A ring? Maybe it fell from your finger.
Yeah, well... It's not really mine. Or... it wasn't on my finger.
OK... It's gotta be around here somewhere. Maybe Mason saw it when he set up the egg hunt!

CBE_MasonsEggHunt2024_Decoration_Slot08_.value: Mason, your egg hunt is rather challenging! I have been trying to make sense of your clues, but they are written in some strange code.
This is difficult - even with my extensive knowledge of symbols and codes.
Ha-haaah! No more mister nice bunny!
You haven't seen a ring, have you? Hank's lost one, and he's going bananas.

CBE_MasonsEggHunt2024_Decoration_Slot15_.value: This egg hunt is not what I expected!
I know! Mason really put us to work this year.
But how did he know about that hatch in the garage?
And the key card in Grandma's purse?
And the code to padlock on the purse?
I think that boy knows more than we realize...

CBE_MasonsEggHunt2024_EasterBox_05_Dialo.value: Mum made me promise I'd also decorate the place...

CBE_MasonsEggHunt2024_EasterDecorations_.value: This statue of Ignatius Boulton looks way too grim for Easter.
A little bunny makeover is just what he needs!

CBE_MasonsEggHunt2024_EndPopup_Descripti.value: Thank you for playing the Egg-cellent Adventure event!

CBE_MasonsEggHunt2024_ExtendPopup_Descri.value:
The Egg-cellent Adventure event has sadly come to an end.
Event Merge Board and Merge Tasks will be closed now.

CBE_MasonsEggHunt2024_ExtendPopup_Header.value: The Egg-cellent event is about to end!

CBE_MasonsEggHunt2024_FindingTheHatch_05.value: There's a little secret in the garage Grandma Ursula thinks no one knows about... but she's wrong!
The others will get to find it using my mystery note!

CBE_MasonsEggHunt2024_FindingTheHatch_07.value: Now I just need the key card!
Grandma Ursula is totally the most mysterious person I know.
She's got even more hiding places than me!

CBE_MasonsEggHunt2024_GoldenEgg_06_Dialo.value: What an Easter treasure! This one will be the most difficult to find.
I can't wait to start the egg hunt!

CBE_MasonsEggHunt2024_GrandmasJewelryBox.value: I know Grandma's got a really fancy egg in here somewhere...
It'll be perfect for my egg hunt. I'm sure she won't mind me borrowing it...

CBE_MasonsEggHunt2024_GrandmasPurse_08_D.value: Grandma Ursula is PRETTY sly, but she can't outfox me! I know there's something in this purse I need for my plan...
A combination lock - typical! It would stop any average person, but not me.
I'm the eyes and ears of this place, and nothing gets past m--
N-nothing at all, Grandma Ursula! Nothing at all!

CBE_MasonsEggHunt2024_Header_ExtendPopup.value: Get these items as a bonus!

CBE_MasonsEggHunt2024_InfoPanel_Descript.value:
The Egg-cellent Adventure event has started!
Complete Event Merge Tasks and earn Event Points.

CBE_MasonsEggHunt2024_IntroDialogue_Dial.value: Another Easter, another egg hunt... And of course it's my job to make it awesome - AGAIN!
That creepy bunny outfit's been hiding in Grandma's closet all year.
Doesn't everyone get that I'm too old for this childish stuff? I just got a brand new video game, too...
I guess I'm the only one around here who's not totally lame-o.
Well, if I HAVE to do it, this time I'll make it something they'll NEVER expect!

CBE_MasonsEggHunt2024_IntroPopup_Descrip.value: As Easter approaches, Mason gets dragged away from his video games to plan a truly magnificent egg hunt. Reluctantly, he puts on his bunny costume, but this time he's going rogue and creating an adventure no one will eggs-pect - hiding Hank's engagement ring in the process...

CBE_MasonsEggHunt2024_KeypadCard_01_Dial.value: Got it! My plan is coming together nicely.
They will need this key card to open the hatch and find eggs!

CBE_MasonsEggHunt2024_LevelUpMergeChainP.value: Collecting Eggs with green arrows allows you to merge them one level further next time!

CBE_MasonsEggHunt2024_MasonsBike_06_Dial.value: To pull this off, I'll need a couple of things...
The Mason Mobile will carry me all the way to adventure!

CBE_MasonsEggHunt2024_MasonsBike_10_Dial.value: I'll find all the other stuff in Grandma's secret stashes.

CBE_MasonsEggHunt2024_MysteriousClue_05_.value: This is gonna be their map - but it's all written in CODE!
They'll have to be real Easter detectives to figure this out.

CBE_MasonsEggHunt2024_OutroDialogue_Dial.value: We finally found all the eggs, Mason!
The ones hidden in the floor hatch were a nice touch... How did you find that thing, anyway?
How about my ring?? Did you find it?
Is it this one? It was the prize for the best egg hunter.
I'm sorry, Hank! I didn't mean to take your ring. I didn't realize it was yours...
That's it! Aaah, what a relief... Thanks, Mason.
Errr... I... Well, see... E-enough about me!
What a great egg hunt, Mason! It'll be hard for you to outdo it again next year.

CBE_MasonsEggHunt2024_ShopProgressionPop.value: Collect Event Points by completing the Egg-cellent Adventure event merge tasks and get all the Egg-cellent Adventure decoration sets!

CBE_MasonsEggHunt2024_StartPopup_Descrip.value: Go on Mason's magnificent egg hunt and help Hank find his missing ring in the Egg-cellent Adventure event!

CBE_MasonsEggHunt2024_TaskPlay_Descripti.value: Merge items and discover new decorations!

CBE_MasonsEggHunt2024_TeaserPopup_Descri.value: Please reach a higher level to play the event.

CBE_MasonsEggHunt2024_VideoGame_04_Dialo.value: To level up, they will have to figure out how to find all of my egg stashes.
Find the eggs, level up, and claim the prize!

CBE_PicnicConfusion2023_EndPopup_Descrip.value: Thank you for playing the Picnic Confusion event! All of your rewards have been claimed!

CBE_RecycleRunway2024_AssortedMaterials_.value: Someone donated a box of old crafting supplies. What could we do with them?

CBE_RecycleRunway2024_ClothingRack_Dialo.value: Who's gonna model all of these outfits in the show? Imagine us on that runway!
Well, Julius and Roddy couldn't make it, so...

CBE_RecycleRunway2024_CraftingDesk_Dialo.value: How's it going with Roddy? Are you two getting serious?
I don't know. It's kinda awkward with so much history...
But I really like him. I just feel like Maddie's a little jealous.
She's never had the hots for Roddy, has she?

CBE_RecycleRunway2024_Decoration_Slot17_.value: So, I found some wood left over from Mason's pirate ship and put together this... sculpture.
I think the whole thing should be on national TV!
Everything here is recycled and reused - and still fabulous. It really shows how much you can do without buying everything new.

CBE_RecycleRunway2024_Decoration_Slot18_.value: Recycled clothes don't have to look like garbage. It's all in how you set it up.
This boutique is so cute! Jackie and Maddie, you've both outdone yourselves.
It doesn't look bad, does it?

CBE_RecycleRunway2024_Decoration_Slot19_.value: What do you think about the stuff we found in the trunk? I'm not sure I'm buying the story about an old Halloween costume.
When I was a kid, people used to talk about the Boultons and their secret business.
Who knows -- maybe they were involved in espionage or something!
How do you explain the bullet holes in that old hat?

CBE_RecycleRunway2024_Decoration_Slot20_.value: This way for a recycled fashion extravaganza!

CBE_RecycleRunway2024_Decoration_Slot21_.value: I thought I was getting a little carried away.

CBE_RecycleRunway2024_Decoration_Slot22_.value: Discover a new treasure for your wardrobe.

CBE_RecycleRunway2024_Decoration_Slot23_.value: Reusing and reducing is easier than you think!

CBE_RecycleRunway2024_Decoration_Slot24_.value: This skip is a real treasure trove!
Yep. We'll be able to find all kinds of materials in here.
But we'll wash them first, right?

CBE_RecycleRunway2024_DressingTable_Dial.value: Are you ready to serve some fierce lewks?
Well, I guess it's for a good cause...

CBE_RecycleRunway2024_EndPopup_Descripti.value:
Thank you for playing the Recycle Runway event!
You can claim all your unclaimed items here!

CBE_RecycleRunway2024_ExtendPopup_Descri.value:
The Recycle Runway event has sadly come to an end.
Event Merge Board and Merge Tasks will be closed now.

CBE_RecycleRunway2024_ExtendPopup_Header.value: The Recycle Runway event is about to end!

CBE_RecycleRunway2024_FashionMagazine_Di.value: Our little project actually made it to the pages of a fashion magazine.
Who knew recycled couture would be such a hit?

CBE_RecycleRunway2024_FashionMaterials_D.value: A fashion show with recycled clothes is a great idea - but I don't know how to sew! Grandma's the only one in our family with any crafting skills.
But you're a good builder... and we need a stage for our runway show.
I bet you've got a bunch of great material from fixing up the Mansion.
More than a bunch! I'm getting SO many great ideas already - a stage, tire planters, a boutique!
I need to go make some plans... See you later!
See? This is exactly what she needed.

CBE_RecycleRunway2024_GardenWarriorCoutu.value: So... How are things, you know, since Emilio left?
Just fine! I've been concentrating on the Mansion and getting a lot done and... Yeah, it's been great!
Good to hear! You're okay with me seeing Roddy, right? I mean...
W-what -- Of course I am! You guys are so great together. Honestly, don't worry about me!

CBE_RecycleRunway2024_HatWithHoles_Dialo.value: That Mansion is full of weird secrets...
I'm pretty sure Maddie doesn't know half of her family's history.
Someone is definitely hiding something - are those bullet holes??

CBE_RecycleRunway2024_InfoPanel_Decorati.value: An upgrade for the Recycle Runway is available!

CBE_RecycleRunway2024_InfoPanel_Descript.value:
The Recycle Runway event has started!
Complete Event Merge Tasks and earn Event Points.

CBE_RecycleRunway2024_IntroDialogue_Dial.value: How's life at the newspaper, Jackie?
Actually, I'm writing a story about fast fashion. Did you know that every SECOND a truckload of old clothes is burned at a landfill somewhere?
I know! And the problem is global. The more I read about it, the more hopeless I feel...
You know what they say? Think globally, act locally. Let's do something about it!
You know how to sew, don't you?
Well, my mom taught me a thing or two years ago...
With your skills and my impeccable eye for fashion, we could put on an event to get people excited about recycling and reusing clothes.
That's not a bad idea... It would be perfect for my story, too.
And it would give Maddie something to do about after Emilio left her to go help the fish in Bolivia...

CBE_RecycleRunway2024_IntroPopup_Descrip.value: Worried about the harmful effects of fast fashion, Pearl and Jackie decide to put up a recycled fashion show. Armed with an arsenal of mixed recycling, used timber and Maddie's old gardening gloves, they get to work - but Grandma Ursula's closet reveals some eyebrow-raising surprises...

CBE_RecycleRunway2024_IntroPopup_Header.value: Discover how old junk turns into treasures!

CBE_RecycleRunway2024_JewelryCollection_.value: Ta-da! A whole collection of bespoke jewelry, all made with recycled materials.
Wow! You really are a woman of many talents.

CBE_RecycleRunway2024_LevelUpPopup_Descr.value: Collecting Photoshoot items with green arrows allows you to Merge them one level further next time!

CBE_RecycleRunway2024_LightbulbHeadpiece.value: Are those lightbulbs in that headpiece?
Yeah, I thought they made a BRIGHT choice.

CBE_RecycleRunway2024_MainStage_Dialogue.value: What a show, dearies! Your couture creations really are impressive.
But... where did you get the wig and trench coat?
We found them in an old trunk in the basement... But what are they, anyway - an old Halloween outfit?
Errr, yes... Just an old Halloween outfit!

CBE_RecycleRunway2024_MixedMaterials_Dia.value: It feels great to have a little project - to get my mind off my terrible love life and everything else.
And there's SO much wood and other material here to reuse and upcycle!
Not to mention all of my old gardening gloves...

CBE_RecycleRunway2024_NewsStory_Dialogue.value: Did you see that our fashion show's on the NEWS?
It must be a slow news day!
But we wanted to raise awareness of an important issue - and did it!

CBE_RecycleRunway2024_OutroDialogue_Dial.value: I can't believe we pulled off a fashion show AND made it to the news!
Fast fashion SHOULD be in the news more, and I think we offered a pretty inspiring solution.
Great work, everyone. I am so very proud of all of you!
But I have to ask... We found an old hat in the trunk - and it looked like it had bullet holes in it.
Maybe that old Halloween outfit of yours has some history...
Oh, the holes were made by moths!
Don't look so shocked, dearie - not everything has a secret meaning.
Come on, let's celebrate! The first round of Hopeberry juice is on me!

CBE_RecycleRunway2024_ProjectTable-Empty.value: Is there anything in the Mansion we could repurpose - old clothes, accessories... Anything?
As you know, Grandma's weird about me rooting around in the Mansion, but there's this old trunk full of stuff I just found in the basement.

CBE_RecycleRunway2024_RecycledClothes_Di.value: People throw away so much cool, usable stuff.
I had this jumper I used to love... but it had a couple of little holes in it, so I threw it away. I still think about that jumper every day!
Well, maybe not EVERY day, but you get what I mean. Mend, don't spend!

CBE_RecycleRunway2024_SewingPattern_Dial.value: What do you need to turn all this fabric into clothes?
I've drawn some sewing patterns. Now I'll just cut the fabric and start sewing!
It's a lot simpler than you'd think, huh?

CBE_RecycleRunway2024_SocialMediaPhoto_D.value: Can I post a photo of you on my social media?
Why not - it's not like this is going viral!

CBE_SweetMessA_Box_05_Dialogue_01.value: The lollipops pass my quality check with flying colors. Let’s crank up the machine so others can try some too!

CBE_SweetMessA_Can_01_Dialogue_01.value: “Thank you! Here are some parts to build more sweet machines.”

CBE_SweetMessA_Cupboard_01_Dialogue_01.value: When you need more sugar for your machine, you can find it in this cupboard - along with fun decorations!

CBE_SweetMess_Character_01_Dialogue_01.value: See, all you need to do is just keep the machine going with the ingredients. That’s all!

CBE_SweetMess_Character_01_Dialogue_02.value: But the machine is pretty complicated. What if something happens?

CBE_SweetMess_Character_01_Dialogue_03.value: You'll just ruin Easter, that's all!

CBE_SweetMess_Character_01_Dialogue_05.value: I'm just joking, Roddy! You'll be TOTALLY fine.

CBE_SweetMess_Character_02_Dialogue_01.value: How’s it going, fellas? I had to come and see the machine in action!

CBE_SweetMess_Character_02_Dialogue_02.value: Everything is great. We're just refilling the chocolate tank when the machine tells us to and keeping an eye on the pressure.

CBE_SweetMess_Character_02_Dialogue_03.value: And sampling the finished products! You want some?

CBE_SweetMess_Character_02_Dialogue_04.value: Of course I do. You're not worried that you'll accidentally do something to break Maddie's fancy machine?

CBE_SweetMess_Character_02_Dialogue_05.value: There's nothing to worry about. We're completely on top of things!

CBE_SweetMess_Character_03_Dialogue_01.value: This toffee is to die for! But my dentist won’t be happy if I have too much…

CBE_SweetMess_Character_04_Dialogue_01.value: Hey, Roddy! We just got back with Mason. How's it going?

CBE_SweetMess_Character_04_Dialogue_02.value: G-great! Totally awesome! How was the Easter Extravaganza?

CBE_SweetMess_Character_04_Dialogue_03.value: It was amazing until Mason had so much marshmallow foam that we had to leave early.

CBE_SweetMess_Character_04_Dialogue_04.value: Did you have any trouble with the chocolate machine?

CBE_SweetMess_Character_04_Dialogue_05.value: Well... you could say we did have one TEENY little mishap…

CBE_SweetMess_Character_04_Dialogue_06.value: A teeny mishap? These chocolates are HUGE!

CBE_SweetMess_Character_05_Dialogue_01.value: Is this true what I hear? Did you two break Maddie’s chocolate machine?

CBE_SweetMess_Character_05_Dialogue_02.value: Kind of… but we did fix it!

CBE_SweetMess_Character_05_Dialogue_03.value: Only, it started to make everything really huge.

CBE_SweetMess_Character_05_Dialogue_04.value: Why didn’t you come and ask me for help?

CBE_SweetMess_Character_05_Dialogue_06.value: But you stopped at the driveway.

CBE_SweetMess_Character_05_Dialogue_08.value: And instead you fixed the machine yourselves?

CBE_SweetMess_Character_05_Dialogue_10.value: And now we have chocolate eggs the size of a suitcase.

CBE_SweetMess_Character_05_Dialogue_11.value: We were just too embarrassed. And a little scared of you. Respectfully.

CBE_SweetMess_Character_05_Dialogue_12.value: Hmph. Next time, ask for help before the place fills up with giant chocolates.

CBE_SweetMess_ChocoMachineProducing_Dial.value: So this part makes chocolates! We put the chocolate here, it melts down in there and moves into the machine to make yummy treats.

CBE_SweetMess_Cupboard_01_Dialogue_01.value: Whoa… why does this cupboard look like the Easter Bunny’s storage unit?

CBE_SweetMess_Cupboard_01_Dialogue_02.value: That’s not a cupboard. That’s a full-blown seasonal command center.

CBE_SweetMess_EasterDecorations_03_Dialo.value: But what do we do with all these ornaments? There are garlands, egg wreaths, pastel table runners…
I think we’re legally obligated to decorate. It's a part of the deal.
I don’t remember signing anything about ceramic bunnies, only chocolate ones.
We have to wait for the next chocolate refill anyway. Come on, stop slouching and help me with this garland!

CBE_SweetMess_EasterDecorations_06_Dialo.value: If we put all of these ornaments up, it’s going to look like the rabbits staged a coup.
I say we just lean into it: Full Easter explosion. When Maddie and Mason get back, it’s like spring attacked the house.
OK, let's do it! Pass me that ceramic bunny.
W-what… Don’t throw it, you'll hit the mach...

CBE_SweetMess_EasterEggs_05_Dialogue_01.value: You broke Maddie’s machine with the ceramic bunny!

CBE_SweetMess_EasterEggs_05_Dialogue_02.value: You didn't catch it even though I gave you a heads-up!

CBE_SweetMess_EasterEggs_05_Dialogue_03.value: It doesn't matter who broke the machine. The question is: What do we do now??
It doesn't matter who broke the machine. The question is: What do we do now?!

CBE_SweetMess_EasterEggs_05_Dialogue_04.value: You want to go ask Ursula for help?

CBE_SweetMess_EasterEggs_05_Dialogue_06.value: Maddie said to tell her if anything happens.

CBE_SweetMess_EasterEggs_05_Dialogue_07.value: You mean tell Ursula that you threw the ceramic bunny that broke the machine?

CBE_SweetMess_EasterEggs_05_Dialogue_08.value: We have no choice! The machine is totally kaputt!

CBE_SweetMess_EasterEggs_07_Dialogue_01.value: Ursula’s house is right there. Just go to the door and knock!

CBE_SweetMess_EasterEggs_07_Dialogue_03.value: Let's just try to fix the machine first. It can't be that hard! I've seen Maddie tinkering on it.

CBE_SweetMess_EasterEggs_07_Dialogue_04.value: A little knock here, and a little twist there. I'll just adjust the levers a little bit and...

CBE_SweetMess_EasterEggs_07_Dialogue_05.value: See? Good as new. Try to start it?

CBE_SweetMess_EasterEggs_07_Dialogue_06.value: Here we go… Yes! You did it!

CBE_SweetMess_EasterEggs_10_Dialogue_01.value: Does the machine sound weird to you?

CBE_SweetMess_EasterEggs_10_Dialogue_02.value: Maybe a little… But it’s definitely working. I can see the chocolate moving.

CBE_SweetMess_EasterEggs_10_Dialogue_03.value: Let’s give it a moment. I’m sure it’s totally fine...

CBE_SweetMess_EasterEggs_10_Dialogue_04.value: Roddy, something is definitely wrong. These eggs are gigantic!

CBE_SweetMess_Intro_Dialogue_01.value: Pass me the wrench, Mason. I just need to tighten these screws, and then we’re ready!

CBE_SweetMess_Intro_Dialogue_02.value: There! The chocolate machine is good to go for another Easter. Do you want to do the honors and turn it on?

CBE_SweetMess_Intro_Dialogue_05.value: I assume I’m also responsible for quality control on the first batch...

CBE_SweetMess_Intro_Dialogue_07.value: Oh boy, Easter is the BEST!

CBE_SweetMess_Lollipop_02_Dialogue_01.value: Look, kiddo! They're putting on a new Easter event nearby.

CBE_SweetMess_Lollipop_02_Dialogue_02.value: I bet it's just a little Easter egg hunt for little kids.

CBE_SweetMess_Lollipop_02_Dialogue_03.value: Let's see what the ad says... "Bounce through a rainbow-colored egg hunt..."

CBE_SweetMess_Lollipop_02_Dialogue_05.value: ...race through an inflatable carrot obstacle course...

CBE_SweetMess_Lollipop_02_Dialogue_09.value: "...and dive into a mountain of marshmallow foam."

CBE_SweetMess_Lollipop_02_Dialogue_10.value: Please can we go? Please, please, PLEASE?

CBE_SweetMess_Lollipop_04_Dialogue_01.value: This Easter Extravaganza looks pretty cool, but what about the chocolate machine?

CBE_SweetMess_Lollipop_04_Dialogue_02.value: The main tank needs to refilled regularly, and someone needs to supervise the quality.
The main tank needs to be refilled regularly, and someone needs to supervise the quality.

CBE_SweetMess_Lollipop_04_Dialogue_03.value: Easy! We can ask Roddy and Hank to babysit.

CBE_SweetMess_Lollipop_04_Dialogue_04.value: Hmmm, I don't know about that...

CBE_SweetMess_Lollipop_04_Dialogue_05.value: They might be hopeless with buttons, but they’re grown-ups, they mean well, and between the two of them they can at least keep the chocolate inside the machine.

CBE_SweetMess_Outro_Dialogue_01.value: We're so sorry about the machine, Maddie. You entrusted it to us, and we failed you completely.

CBE_SweetMess_Outro_Dialogue_02.value: Don't be so hard on yourself, Roddy. You did fix it!

CBE_SweetMess_Outro_Dialogue_03.value: We do have a LOT of Easter treats to eat, though.

CBE_SweetMess_Outro_Dialogue_04.value: That won't be a problem! I feel like I've been training for this my whole life.

CBE_SweetMess_Outro_Dialogue_05.value: I think you two definitely messed up BIG TIME, but it's actually not that bad.

CBE_SweetMess_Outro_Dialogue_06.value: This year, the Easter egg hunt will be better than EVER.

CBE_SweetMess_PastryMachineProducing_Dia.value: I can see why Mason's always talking about this machine. It's totally awesome!

CBE_SweetMess_Peppermint_02_Dialogue_01.value: Are you sure you're able to look after the chocolate machine?

CBE_SweetMess_Peppermint_02_Dialogue_04.value: But what do we do if the output tube gets stuck again?

CBE_SweetMess_Peppermint_02_Dialogue_05.value: You just give it a little knock with this wrench.

CBE_SweetMess_Peppermint_02_Dialogue_06.value: And if the chocolate overheats? Last year, I got soaked with melted chocolate.

CBE_SweetMess_Peppermint_02_Dialogue_07.value: I've fixed the thermostat and the loose hose, so no fear of that this year!

CBE_SweetMess_Peppermint_02_Dialogue_08.value: Let's get to the important stuff. Are we allowed to try some of these treats?

CBE_SweetMess_Peppermint_04_Dialogue_01.value: Fill the chocolate tank when the gauge gets low and keep an eye on the pressure valve.

CBE_SweetMess_Peppermint_04_Dialogue_02.value: We'll be back in the evening!

CBE_SweetMess_Peppermint_04_Dialogue_03.value: And if you run into problems, you can just ask Grandma! She knows the machine, so she can help you.

CBE_SweetMess_Peppermint_04_Dialogue_04.value: Oh, there'll be no need to bother Ursula! We are 100% on top of this.

CBE_SweetMess_Peppermint_04_Dialogue_06.value: Right. Have a great time at the Easter Extravaganza and bring back some marshmallow foam!

CBE_SweetMess_Peppermint_04_Dialogue_07.value: OK, if you say so. Thanks for your help, guys!

CBE_TheGreatEscape_Act1_Dialogue_01.value: Oh dear, back again I see...

CBE_TheGreatEscape_Act1_Dialogue_02.value: I guess my last attempt didn’t go as well as I’ve hoped!

CBE_TheGreatEscape_Act1_Dialogue_04.value: This time, I promise I’ll have a better plan!

CBE_TheGreatEscape_Act1_Dialogue_05.value: First, I need to get a little collateral in this dreadful place. Nothing a case of money couldn't solve...

CBE_TheGreatEscape_Act1_Dialogue_06.value: Maybe I should make a name for myself by helping around and earn a little on the side...

CBE_TheGreatEscape_Act2_Dialogue_02.value: I still need to earn my fellow inmate’s trust and I heard this place has been having trouble with their mail...

CBE_TheGreatEscape_Act2_Dialogue_03.value: I know! I'll charm them with my baking skills and make sure their letters get sent properly.

CBE_TheGreatEscape_Act3_Dialogue_01.value: Now that I’ve gained everyone’s trust, it’ll be a lot easier for me to get out of here.

CBE_TheGreatEscape_Act3_Dialogue_02.value: My baking skills have led me to the kitchen, where I’m sure I’ll be able to impress the right people.

CBE_TheGreatEscape_Act3_Dialogue_03.value: And they’ll hopefully help me get the right “tools” for my ultimate escape!

CBE_TheGreatEscape_Cellphone_Dialogue_02.value: When they took you away, I was so worried!

CBE_TheGreatEscape_Cellphone_Dialogue_05.value: I’m in a bit of a bind right now...

CBE_TheGreatEscape_Cellphone_Dialogue_06.value: Would you be a dear and help me out?

CBE_TheGreatEscape_CleanerCart_Dialogue_.value: Hmm... I’ll use this to get around and “clean up”.
You never know what useful things people throw away.
One person’s trash is another person’s treasure!

CBE_TheGreatEscape_Grandmascell_Dialogue.value: Finally! The last bar is off. Time to go!
Good thing I found these Bolt Cutters!
But I should hide them in case I end up in here again.

CBE_TheGreatEscape_Messycell_Dialogue_02.value: How am I supposed to find what I need in here?

CBE_TheGreatEscape_Messycell_Dialogue_03.value: I guess it won’t hurt if I clean up a little...

CBE_TheGreatEscape_Oven_Dialogue_01.value: I’m sure people wouldn’t mind if we change the menu up a little.

CBE_TheGreatEscape_Oven_Dialogue_02.value: Jail food can be so bland!

CBE_TheGreatEscape_Oven_Dialogue_03.value: Perhaps I should make them our family favorite, Boulton stew!

CBE_TheGreatEscape_Paperandpen3_Dialogue.value: Hmm... Looks like some of the girls have been writing letters.
I can give Maddie a call and ask her to do it!

CBE_TheGreatEscape_Postbox_Dialogue_01.value: You want me to go through the mail?!

CBE_TheGreatEscape_Postbox_Dialogue_03.value: I don’t know how comfortable I feel about this...

CBE_TheGreatEscape_Postbox_Dialogue_04.value: The mailman owes me a few favors, so you won’t get in any trouble.

CBE_TheGreatEscape_Socks05_Dialogue_02.value: These jail outfits should contain the ID badges I need to get into the other rooms.

CBE_TheGreatEscape_Socks05_Dialogue_03.value: But I’ll need to get rid of the evidence!

CBE_TheGreatEscape_Stampthirdclass1_Dial.value: Let’s make sure these letters make their way to their destination.
Oh... These remind me of Maddie’s stamp collection!
She was really into them, too. I should probably save a few for her...

CBE_TheGreatEscape_Tools1_Dialogue_01.value: Hmm... I’m quite surprised to find these tools!

CBE_TheGreatEscape_Tools1_Dialogue_02.value: Then again, it was so messy, you could hide an elephant in here...

CBE_TheGreatEscape_Tools1_Dialogue_03.value: Well, I’m sure they won’t mind if I borrow them for a while.

CBE_TheGreatEscape_Tools5_Dialogue_02.value: These Bolt Cutters should do the trick.

CBE_TheGreatEscape_Tools5_Dialogue_03.value: Nothing like a little upper body workout in jail...

CBE_TheGreatEscape_Wardensafe1_Dialogue_.value: I bet this holds something I can use to get out of here.
I should keep working on it to get it open!

CBE_TheGreatEscape_Wardensafe_Dialogue_0.value: This should help me get some leverage in here.
Hmm... Perhaps I should send some of this to Maddie?
Hmm... Perhaps I should send some of this to Maddie?

CBE_VeilOfFate2023_ActiveSnowglobe_Dialo.value: Aaaah! The snow is falling - the veil of fate is LIFTING!
Patience! I seeee that.... the winter is coming?

CBE_VeilOfFate2023_ArmCast_Dialogue_01.value: I see... a tasty loaf of bread? No, no... It is an arm cast.

CBE_VeilOfFate2023_ArmCast_Dialogue_02.value: You should be careful in the garden, Maddie!

CBE_VeilOfFate2023_BookOfStars_Dialogue_.value: This little book tells me which way the STARS are turning!
I'm not sure it works like that...

CBE_VeilOfFate2023_CrystalHouse_Dialogue.value: The house inside your snow globe is cute!
Not cute, my child! It is mysterious and enigmatic!

CBE_VeilOfFate2023_Decoration_Slot01_Des.value: This is where the magic happens!

CBE_VeilOfFate2023_Decoration_Slot01_Dia.value: Is it true? Is Lady Voyance back to divine our futures?
Hey, Roddy! She is indeed. Are you going to ask her to tell your fortune?
She predicted something pretty interesting for me last time - maybe something romantic.
I just wonder if she meant what I THOUGHT she meant... Do you think...
Maybe you'll find someone who shares your love of hard hats and architecture!
She really is a character, isn't she!

CBE_VeilOfFate2023_Decoration_Slot04_Dia.value: Do you have time for another client, Lady Voyance?
Of course! I am here to help ALL who want a glimpse of their fate!
Great! You told my fortune last time you were here and...
You said that I've waited for a long time and that my wait would be over soon?
Did I really? Let's see what the globe conveys...
No. I think I must have read the globe upside down - it happens!
Are you sure? Could you double-check?
Hmm... I see SOMETHING powerful headed your way... Possibly indigestion...
Something to look forward to, anyway!

CBE_VeilOfFate2023_Decoration_Slot06_Dia.value: So, Maddie... You've come to hear what the snowglobe knows?
Last time you mentioned that you sensed love in my future...
I only interpret the signs in the globe... What it is telling me this time?

CBE_VeilOfFate2023_Decoration_Slot07_Dia.value: So you want to know about love! Let's me see...
Oh, sands past, present and future - show me what AWAITS my young friend!
I see... someone tall, dark and HANDSOME... and his name is ummm...
Do you KNOW someone called Emilio?
Yeah, kind of... But now what should I do?

CBE_VeilOfFate2023_Decoration_Slot08_Dia.value: ALAS, the sands of the globe have seized!
Thank you, Lady Voyance! I think I got what I wanted.
The pleasure is ALL mine, my child! Go forth and seek your happiness with Emilio!
Oh, what is this? The sands are stirring, forming a name... Arthur? It is probably nothing.

CBE_VeilOfFate2023_InactiveSnowglobe_Dia.value: Everything is ready, but the globe is still silent...

CBE_VeilOfFate2023_InfoPopup_MergeSectio.value: Peer into the past, present & future!
Peer into the past, present, and future!

CBE_VeilOfFate2023_InfoPopup_Task.value: Look into the past, present, and future!

CBE_VeilOfFate2023_IntroDialogue_Dialogu.value: Lady Voyance! How are the snows of fate swirling these days?
Destiny has steered me back to this place. My snow globe is downright VIBRATING with energy!
All the signs tell me there is something MYSTERIOUS afoot here, Ursula. Suspicious even!
Erm, suspicious? I think your snowglobe has cracked...
Maddie! You remember my dear friend, Lady Voyance?
How could I forget? Nice to see you again!
Aaah, Maddie! The signs are still STRONG with you, my child!
I have come to share with you the message of fate once more.
I also offer birth charts and homemade charm bracelets. Pretty AND well priced!
Sounds great, but first I'd like to hear about my future... And I have some questions!

CBE_VeilOfFate2023_IntroPopup_Descriptio.value: Lady Voyance is back with her mysterious snow globe, and there is more than one person who would like to get a hint about their fate... This time, the globe throws Maddie to the past, present and future - but what will Lady Voyance see in the swirling snow of her globe? Come forth and find out!

CBE_VeilOfFate2023_IntroPopup_Header.value: Lift the veil of fate and let the snow globe tell your fortune!

CBE_VeilOfFate2023_LevelUpPopup_Descript.value: Collecting Charms with green arrows allows you to merge them one level further next time!
Collecting Charms with green arrows allows you to Merge them one Level further next time!

CBE_VeilOfFate2023_LitCandles_Dialogue_0.value: The flames of my candles shed a light on paths of fate...
And they have a very pleasant scent, too!

CBE_VeilOfFate2023_MaddiesCraftingStatio.value: Wow!! I made everyone's xmas presents on that crafting table! They were... original.

CBE_VeilOfFate2023_MaddiesDrawings_Dialo.value: You were quite the artist, I see!

CBE_VeilOfFate2023_MansionKeyCharm_Dialo.value: I see a big house... a MANSION even! Does that sound familiar?

CBE_VeilOfFate2023_MotorcycleKeys_Dialog.value: Your future looks VERY interesting - you may grow a BEARD!
I hope not! Is there anything else?
Well, there might be some wedding rings and burning matches as well.
Sounds oddly familiar... Events I would rather not think about.
But why would those old events appear in my future?

CBE_VeilOfFate2023_OutroDialogue_Dialogu.value: Sooo, did Lady Voyance tell you something exciting?
She certainly did! Her snowglobe is not the most reliable thing, but I don't know...
Maybe she is right this time.
Well, at least 20% right. You never know, Maddie. You never know!

CBE_VeilOfFate2023_SnowglobeOfTheFuture_.value: The future is BRIGHT, my child! Bright purple!

CBE_VeilOfFate2023_SnowglobeOfThePast_Di.value: Well, well, well... The globe has taken me to the past!

CBE_VeilOfFate2023_SnowglobeOfThePresent.value: You must know where you ARE to see where you are GOING, my child!

CBE_VeilOfFate2023_StartPopup_Descriptio.value: Lift the veil of fate and let the snow globe show, what lies in the past, present and future - if you dare!

CBE_VeilOfFate2023_TableOfDestiny_Dialog.value: I wonder whether Ursula might let me set up shop on her driveway...

CBE_VeilOfFate2023_TaskPlay_Description.value: Merge items and discover new decorations!

CBE_VeilOfFate2023_TeaserPopup_Descripti.value: Please reach a higher level to play the event.

CBE_VeilOfFate2023_TheChef_Dialogue_01.value: Ah, the most handsome constellation in the sky!

CBE_VeilOfFate2023_TheChef_Dialogue_02.value: They say it brings good luck to those who see it.

CBE_VeilOfFate2023_ThePartnersTarotCard_.value: The cards are as right as their reader. So you have absolutely nothing to worry about!

CBE_VeilOfFate2024_ActiveSnowglobe_Dialo.value: Do you want to look into the past, present, or future?
I j-just want to know why this keeps happening to me...
A BIG question, Dearest. Let's see where the globe takes us.

CBE_VeilOfFate2024_BookOfStars_Dialogue_.value: So, if the Moon is in the second house... errrr... and Jupiter is in line with Mars...
That means... I think it was on page 124...

CBE_VeilOfFate2024_CrystalHouse_Dialogue.value: Soooo, Maddie, dear. What can I help you with today?
I've got some questions about what you told me last time.
Remind me... WHAT did I say again?
You said that I would meet someone tall, dark, and handsome!
Ah, yes... Of course I did!
I did, but he just broke my heart!
My dear, heartbreak is a PART of young lo...

CBE_VeilOfFate2024_Decoration_Slot01_Dia.value: Roddy, my boy! How can I be of service?
You won't tell anyone about this, will you?
I work under the strictest confidentiality, I assure you.
Good! I, well, would like to know if you see... any romance in my future?

CBE_VeilOfFate2024_Decoration_Slot04_Dia.value: The skeptic returns to the globe, I see.
A friend of mine said that it... Well, that the globe isn't ALWAYS wrong.
And they would be CORRECT! What do you wish to know?
Well... I just met someone and I wanna know if it's going to lead to anything.
Let's see... The globe does not give a clear answer. You will just have to have the courage to love.
The universe favors the brave, my dear!

CBE_VeilOfFate2024_Decoration_Slot06_Dia.value: The globe tells me that you have been seeing a certain young lady...
Yes, ummm, I guess that's Jackie. We've been on a couple of dates, but...
Is there someone else you are thinking about?
What -- can you see someone else??
That's OK. I already have every reason to be happy, right? Thanks, Lady Voyance.
Aaahhhh! Is that... young Maddie? What a cosmic mess!

CBE_VeilOfFate2024_Decoration_Slot07_Dia.value: How about you, Ursula? Do you want to peek into the future?
The present is just fine for me.
Have it your way. You know, I had the craziest dream the other night...
I dreamt that you used to be some kind of a spy! It felt so real...
Hilarious! You should do stand-up comedy, old friend.

CBE_VeilOfFate2024_Decoration_Slot08_Dia.value: There's a lot going on, so I thought I might seek some...
Reassuring council? I COMPLETELY understand. About what?
I wanted to ask about how the wedding with Hank will go, if my dress will fit as well as I believe, and...
Worry not. Lady Voyance never tells.
