Complete Event Merge Tasks and earn Event Points. (placeholder)

CBE_VeilOfFate2024_IntroDialogue_Dialogu.value: I can't believe this! Emilio is gone, and I'm alone... AGAIN!
I really thought it could've turned into something... real.
I always get left behind! My parents left me, I got dumped at the altar, and now this.
The universe must be against me! I need to get some answers...
Grandma won't tell me anything, I just know it!
I guess there's just ONE person who can help me...

CBE_VeilOfFate2024_IntroPopup_Descriptio.value: Maddie is angry - and she wants some answers about why the universe is against her. Again, she seeks the advice of Lady Voyance, but this time she drops a real bombshell... What does Maddie find out about her past, present and future this time?

CBE_VeilOfFate2024_IntroPopup_Header.value: Lift the veil of fate and let the snow globe tell your fortune! (placeholder)

CBE_VeilOfFate2024_LevelUpPopup_Descript.value: Collecting Charms with green arrows allows you to Merge them one Level further next time!

CBE_VeilOfFate2024_LitCandles_Dialogue_0.value: The answers are close. I can FEEL it!

CBE_VeilOfFate2024_MaddiesCraftingStatio.value: I've loved making and building things since I was little.
Maybe that's SOMETHING I got from one of my parents...
I do LOVE making crafts myself!

CBE_VeilOfFate2024_MaddiesDrawings_Dialo.value: What do you remember from your childhood, my dear?
I... I can't remember almost anything...
My parents were lovely, and I remember being with them, and then... nothing.
That is NOT very helpful, my dear.

CBE_VeilOfFate2024_MansionKeyCharm_Dialo.value: The Mansion might hold answers for you, my dear.
It just brings up more questions!
Look further into the past. Clear away the debris of history to seek the TRUTH!

CBE_VeilOfFate2024_MeltedCandles_Dialogu.value: Let's set the stage for fate!
We just need a FEW more candles...

CBE_VeilOfFate2024_MotorcycleKeys_Dialog.value: I keep dreaming of keys... like car keys. What could that mean? Is it about my parents' car crash??
Oh, my dear! It could mean an opportunity or new access - even FREEDOM!

CBE_VeilOfFate2024_OutroDialogue_Dialogu.value: Grandma, I've been looking for you!
Are you trying to hide from me?
Me? Never, Dearie. Why on earth would I do that?
Lady Voyance told me something wild... about my parents' car crash!
I know she's a little kooky, but she said I was in the car with them.
O-oh? I wouldn't believe everything she says.
Did she not also predict you'd find love with Emilio?
Hmmm, yes. I guess so. But...
Forget the ifs, ands, or buts, Maddie, dearie. It is time for some classic apple pie!

CBE_VeilOfFate2024_SnowglobeOfTheFuture_.value: I see that you are about to solve a MYSTERY!
The missing rake... It is in the SHED!

CBE_VeilOfFate2024_SnowglobeOfThePast_Di.value: You survived that awful car crash that killed them... It must still haunt you.
I-I was in the car WITH them??

CBE_VeilOfFate2024_SnowglobeOfThePresent.value: I sense some anger in you... A GREAT disturbance!
I AM angry! I finally put myself out there only to be left for some fish!
Emilio left for Bolivia to help save the fish.
But... there is no ocean in Bolivia.

CBE_VeilOfFate2024_StartPopup_Descriptio.value: Lift the veil of fate and let the snow globe show, what lies in the past, present and future - if you dare! (placeholder)

CBE_VeilOfFate2024_TableOfDestiny_Dialog.value: You know, telling fortunes requires the right equipment!
An ill-tuned globe or hastily arranged crystals can REALLY interfere with the outcome!

CBE_VeilOfFate2024_TaskPlay_Description.value: Merge items and discover new decorations!

CBE_VeilOfFate2024_TheChef_Dialogue_01.value: Who is it that sprinkles your life with magic, my dear?

CBE_VeilOfFate2024_TheChef_Dialogue_02.value: I thought it was Emilio... but I couldn't be more wrong.

CBE_VeilOfFate2024_TheLittleSister_Dialo.value: The stars COULD offer you the answer.
Alas, it is a rather cloudy night.

CBE_VeilOfFate2024_ThePartnersTarotCard_.value: What would you say is your GREATEST goal in life?
Apart from having a day off? I... I just want to find love. You know, a love that lasts.
It may be closer than you think, my dear.

CBE_VeilOfFate2024_Wallet_Dialogue_01.value: I think I see a figure EMERGING...

CBE_VeilOfFate2024_Wallet_Dialogue_03.value: He hides behind the veil of fate... Ah, I just had some taffy on my globe.

CBE_VoyancesVisions_CharacterItems_02B_D.value: Mmmm... Mmmmmmmmm... I can see you are a successful...
Event planner! I used to work in the corporate world, but I prefer small town life.
Yes, yes... And you have a special person in your life, whose name starts with... "M"?
I knew the stars are SPEAKING to me tonight!
I am MERELY a conduit, my dear.

CBE_VoyancesVisions_CharacterItems_05C_D.value: Oh, spirits of the sky, speak to meeee!
Yes, Pearl. My dear, you should get your ears checked.
She is... So there's the cosmic connection, isn't it? Nothing more to it, I am sure.

CBE_VoyancesVisions_CharacterItems_08_Di.value: I see something strange... For one so fiercely keen to uncover the truth, you seem to carry a great burden.
What family secrets YOU are hiding from the world?
*Gulp* I don't know what you mean!

CBE_VoyancesVisions_CharacterItems_09C_D.value: Hmmmmmm... Powers of the past, present and future... SPEAK!
A strange picture is forming... of Mason and Pearl, your family, the Boultons, and something else...
Alas, it is hidden from me. I sense that you are very restless. What troubles you, Deb?
There's been so much going on at the Mansion lately, that I...
I'm hoping people will start to forget about everything that happened before the holidays.
All those odd things - the strange phone calls to Cherry - no one could explain...
You forget - the stars see everything!

CBE_VoyancesVisions_CharacterItems_10B_D.value: Do you have a connection to Ursula Boulton, perhaps?
Not directly... but Ursula's sister, Deb, is my partner Charlotte's mom.
Indeed! And what does Charlotte do?
She has a top secret job with the government
She's not really allowed to discuss it, so I don't know anything else about it.
Yes, a son called Mason. I think you've met him?
I have INDEED. He tried to sneak into my caravan, once.

CBE_VoyancesVisions_CharacterItems_10_Di.value: A-ha! I see a yellow jumper.
A yellow jumper? Maddie wears a yellow jumper...
Is it Maddie you can see?
It makes total sense! All of Ursula's secrets MUST be tied to her.
Can you see something about the family? About the Mansion?
Ah, a cosmic MIST has fogged my vision...

CBE_VoyancesVisions_InfoPanel_Descriptio.value:
The Voyance's Visions event has started!
Complete Event Merge Tasks and earn Event Points.

CBE_VoyancesVisions_IntroC_Dialogue_01.value: What is that strange cosmic vibration I feel in the air tonight?

CBE_VoyancesVisions_IntroC_Dialogue_02.value: The new year is full of possibilities, but the only the stars know the truth...

CBE_VoyancesVisions_IntroC_Dialogue_04.value: Ah, it is just my phone.

CBE_VoyancesVisions_IntroDialogueB_Dialo.value: My snow globe is polished, and my Tarot cards are shuffled.
Dark clouds are gathering to hide the stars, but I can still read them.
Someone is on their way - I can FEEL it!

CBE_VoyancesVisions_IntroDialogue_Dialog.value: Aahh, the stars are SPEAKING to me tonight!
It is lucky Ursula allowed me to set up shop on her driveway.
I shall peek behind the veil of fate to see how the planets align...
...and what secrets will be spilled tonight!
For a VERY reasonable fee, of course!

CBE_VoyancesVisions_IntroPopup_Descripti.value: The stars are aligned, the magical snow globe is fully charged, and destiny awaits! Lady Voyance has set up shop once again - but who will seek her advice this time?

CBE_VoyancesVisions_IntroPopup_Header.value: Step closer and peek behind the Veil of Fate!

CBE_VoyancesVisions_LevelUp_Bubble_Descr.value: Collecting items with green arrows allows you to Merge them one level further next time!

CBE_VoyancesVisions_MalzarAActiveC_Dialo.value: Through tangled roots of kin we tread, unveiling truths long left unsaid.
Does that make sense to you? Sounds like family secrets...
Indeed... That is something us Boultons know a lot about.
But there is a secret that reaches even further.
I fear it may have been discovered...
Excuse me, but I am the one who should sound cryptic here!

CBE_VoyancesVisions_MalzarAActive_01B_Di.value: A whispered thought, a shifting glance. Plans arise as shadows dance.
Does that mean someone's been planning something? Usually that's me...
But it does sound an awful lot like a certain older lady I know.
Uh-huh. But when it comes to secrets, I must advise caution!

CBE_VoyancesVisions_MalzarAActive_01_Dia.value: A roll of film, its memories unseen, Like friendships deep, developing in between.
Patience! Let's see what else he has to say...

CBE_VoyancesVisions_MalzarBActiveC_Dialo.value: Let's hear it, Malzar - what is your cosmic message?
Buried deep, the ties that bind, a truth the bloodline must not find.
So, more of the same cryptic talk about family ties!
If I was more of a detective, I could maybe put two and two together...

CBE_VoyancesVisions_MalzarBActive_01B_Di.value: The truth revealed, yet none behold. Hidden deep within the bold.
OK, I'm lost. What does he mean?
That is for YOU to find out, dear!
In any case, I'm only right nine times out of ten.

CBE_VoyancesVisions_MalzarBActive_01_Dia.value: A book with a hollow, where trinkets reside. Is it knowledge we seek, or treasures we hide?
Is it knowledge we seek, or treasures we hide... Good question, Malzar!

CBE_VoyancesVisions_MalzarCActiveC_Dialo.value: Extremely reliable! You cannot really measure his reliability in absolute terms, of course.
It is said, however, that sometimes he does get uncomfortably close to the truth.
Are you ready for his final message?
A secret spilled, a fortune lost, a girl’s fate sealed at such a cost.

CBE_VoyancesVisions_MalzarCActive_01B_Di.value: A shadow waits as coins are weighed. In silent loss, their fortune fades.
I always knew that the people in this town have secrets, but wow...
So someone is afraid of losing their fortune and their position...
But your foreboding feeling may NOT be quite unfounded.
The stars tell me there is something strange afoot here...

CBE_VoyancesVisions_MalzarCActive_01_Dia.value: A tattered sack, fortunes play hide and seek. Grandma's knitting? Or a bank's quiet leak?
But what does it all MEAN?
You have happened upon quite the enigma, Jackie.
The Boultons are known for their secrecy, and that barrier is not easy to break through - even with my cosmic connections.
That said, your tenacious mind might be just the thing...
You mean both of my eyes?
No, your MIND'S eye, my dear.
*Sigh* Of course. Well, thank you. This was interesting, as always!

CBE_VoyancesVisions_OminousSecrets_01_Di.value: I see a roll of film...
Well, I cannot say, my dear. The ball only shows the roll...
It could well be only a symbol for something else!
Alas, I can only tell you what I see... I cannot make assumptions about its meaning.
For only a SMALL extra fee, my trusted Malzar can give you the answers you seek.
Excellent! Just insert the coin and let the magic happen!

CBE_VoyancesVisions_OminousSecrets_02B_D.value: I see someone is making plans.
Someone who has a mind for schemes...
I don't like the sound of that.
If you wish to hear more, a small extra fee allows you to consult Malzar!

CBE_VoyancesVisions_OminousSecrets_03B_D.value: The evidence for a betrayal exists...
Betrayal? So where do I look for it?
I don't have ALL the answers, my dear.

CBE_VoyancesVisions_OminousSecrets_04_Di.value: There's a book... but not an ordinary one.
This one has a hole carved inside it!
Now this is definitely giving me "mystery"!
You should be glad I didn't see a lunchbox! The universe DETESTS a lunchbox.

CBE_VoyancesVisions_OminousSecrets_05C_D.value: I seeee... something. Something that tells me your troubles involve a child.
Do you mean your peculiar mascot?
He is not a mascot! He is... MALZAR!

CBE_VoyancesVisions_OminousSecrets_06C_D.value: Some you've even tried to erase... but the traces stil lingerrrr...
They linger... Linger... W-what was I saying?
Did I just fall asleep for a second?

CBE_VoyancesVisions_OminousSecrets_07B_D.value: The cosmos reveals a MOST unsettling sign.

CBE_VoyancesVisions_OminousSecrets_07C_D.value: This one I see clearly. I see money.
But a very common theme in fortune-telling, money.
Sometimes it is a bit hit-and-miss, sometimes it is exactly what you want to hear.

CBE_VoyancesVisions_OminousSecrets_07_Di.value: Ah, now this is juicy! A bag filled with MONEY.
This one I see clearly. I see money.
Money? Like, bills or coins or what?
This tells me about wealth - or the lack of it.
But a very common theme in fortune-telling, money.
Or maybe it's about the bag...
Sometimes it is be a bit hit-and-miss, sometimes it is exactly what you want to hear.

CBE_VoyancesVisions_Outro_Dialogue_02.value: I wonder what Malzar was talking about... The ways of fate really ARE unknown!

CBE_VoyancesVisions_Outro_Dialogue_03.value: Oh, I forgot to mention I have a sale on my patented magical snow globes...

CBE_VoyancesVisions_StartPopup_Descripti.value: Embark on a journey of fate and coincidence, and unravel the signs of the universe with Lady Voyance!

CBE_VoyancesVisions_TagSinkFTUE_Descript.value:
Drag any <color=#4E8EC8>Tarot Card</color> into the<color=#4E8EC8> Tarot Table</color>.
Once you've dragged enough cards, the Tarot Table will give items in return!
Different card combinations will yield different results.

CBE_VoyancesVisions_TarotCardsC_Dialogue.value: Mmhhhhmmmmmm... I feel a restless customer approaching.
Someone is eager to consult the cards!
Who shall be lifting the veil of fate tonight?

CBE_VoyancesVisions_TarotCards_03_Dialog.value: I feel the cards have something to say!
Hmm... Something looms large in the cosmic sphere... but what is it?
Oh, cards, tell me your tale!
Now I just need a customer... Who shall it be?

CBE_VoyancesVisions_TarotTableActiveC_Di.value: First, will you keep everything we talk about confidential?
Of course - I am bound by the cosmic law. Nothing you say here will be revealed to anyone!

CBE_VoyancesVisions_TarotTableActiveNorm.value: A friend of mine said you were able to help her with a personal thing, so...
No, it was the UNIVERSE that led you here!
Now tell me... What do you SEEK?
Umm... I've just had a weird feeling - like something is going on in Hopewell Bay.
Well, this town has no doubt had its share of stormy weather lately...
No kidding! And I moved here with my family to enjoy the peace and quiet.
Now it seems like there's drama everywhere!
Then it is time to consult the stars...
Jackie, what a surprise! What brings you here?
My senses tell me you are looking for romantic advice!
No, actually I wanted to ask what the universe can tell me about Ursula Boulton.
Everyone knows she has a mysterious past, and that her family's history is full of secrets...
I'm going to find out what she's hiding, and it occured to me that you could maybe tell me a thing or two!
That's quite a request, my dear, but let's see what we can see...

CSE_Builder_IceSculpt_IntroPopup_Descrip.value: Winter has wrapped Hopewell Bay in a quiet hush, but something extraordinary is taking shape beneath the frost. Maddie has discovered a new craft, ice sculpting! And every piece she creates carries a story of hope, memory, and winter magic. As you collect tokens, you’ll help her shape each frosty block into a shimmering work of art, revealing its beauty layer by layer. Complete the full set to uncover a reward hidden beneath the ice.

CSE_Classic_RacesIntro_02.value: Never been much of a sailor myself, but your enthusiasm is inspiring.
Never been much of a sailor myself, but your enthusiasm is inspiring.

CSE_Classic_RacesIntro_03.value: Come on, Roddy! This'll be fun! The Boultons will sail the high seas again!

CSE_Classic_RacesIntro_04.value: Just watch out for the strong current! It'll drag you out to sea...

CSE_Classic_RacesOutro_01.value: Wow! What a race! Didn't I tell you it would be fun?!
Wow! What a race! Didn't I tell you it would be fun?!

CSE_Classic_RacesOutro_02.value: Yeah! That was pretty awesome! However...

CSE_Classic_RacesOutro_03.value: I should probably wear something else than a suit, next time.
I should probably wear something other than a suit, next time.
I should probably wear something other than my work clothes, next time.

CSE_Classic_RacesOutro_04.value: Well, at least your hard hat will make it easy for us to find you if you ever go overboard!

CSE_Classic_RacesRound2Win_01.value: We won another one! Let's do this!

Cabinet_01.value: Hmm, a lot of interesting equipment in this cabinet.

Cabinet_02.value: Binoculars, a grappling hook and... a bunch of folders about different people!

Cabinet_03.value: This folder is called Operation B... more military stuff?

CameraTalk_01.value: A vintage camera! I've always wanted to try one of these...

CameraTalk_02.value: This has to be the camera Lindsay used on her adventures!

Camera_Usage_Desc.value: Camera is required for scaning QR codes and creating user avatars in Supercell ID
Camera is required for scanning QR codes and creating user avatars in Supercell ID

CardDeco_02.value: These large playing cards look like they're made out of real poker card stock!

CardDeco_03.value: Must have cost a pretty penny...

CardGameMotivation_01.value: I'm really getting the hang of this!

CardGameMotivation_02.value: Well, I can't stop now! Another round!

CardMachine_02.value: Wow... Some of these look like they're in mint condition.

CardMachine_03.value: I wonder if they're worth anything?

CarpetRestoration_01.value: Restoring this carpet is hard work, but I can see why...

CarpetRestoration_02.value: It looks like it has a high knot count, and it was probably made especially for this room.

CarpetRestoration_03.value: Leonard definitely invested a lot in this lounge!

CarriageHarness_01.value: How about a little race around the Stables, Babylon?

Casino_01.value: I know some of the rooms I've worked on are rather gaudy, but this?

Casino_02.value: I can't help but think of mob movies with secret gambling dens during the prohibition... Hmm.

Casino_03.value: Maybe Leonard liked those movies too... Or... maybe this is closer to real life?

CatBox_01.value: What's in the box? More unique decor?

CatBox_02.value: Well, some of that, but there's tools!

CatBox_03.value: Tools to fix tiles and even glass! Exactly what I was looking for...

CatBox_04.value: What more could a girl ask for?

CemeteryBuildSculptureOrWaterFeature_01.value: Well?! Does this grave belong to my Grandpa Charlie?

CemeteryBuildSculptureOrWaterFeature_02.value: I don't think so! In fact, I think it belongs to Clara Boulton - she's a local legend.

CemeteryBuildSculptureOrWaterFeature_03.value: She is? What did she do?

CemeteryBuildSculptureOrWaterFeature_04.value: She fell in love with a man visiting from Europe, and defied her family wishes to marry him.

CemeteryBuildSculptureOrWaterFeature_05.value: I heard she went missing after the wedding, but this must be her grave!

CemeteryBuildSculptureOrWaterFeature_06.value: Wait, that's it?! Isn't there more to the story?

CemeteryBuildSculptureOrWaterFeature_07.value: If there is, I don't know it. Maybe you should check out the old Boulton crypt - it might have more info for you.

CemeteryCleanTombstone_01.value: Hi Roddy! Sorry you caught me in the cemetery.
Hi, Roddy! Sorry you caught me in the cemetery.

CemeteryCleanTombstone_02.value: Don't be! I think cemeteries are kind of... romantic.

CemeteryCleanTombstone_03.value: Well, uh, I'm here because I heard a rumor that the local council are really out to get you now.

CemeteryCleanTombstone_04.value: I know! They sent around a photographer, Holden, to check up on me.

CemeteryCleanTombstone_05.value: Holden, huh? I've met him. Snooty, isn't he? And his photographs aren't any good.

CemeteryCleanTombstone_06.value: Well, he seems a bit stuck up, but -- oh my goodness! Roddy, look at this gravestone!

CemeteryCleanTombstone_07.value: It's for a 'C. Boulton!' Could this be Charlie, my grandpa?

CemeteryCleanTombstone_08.value: But if it is, who called you, and who sent you on this quest?!

CemeteryCleanTombstone_09.value: This is so confusing. I'd better get Grandma back around here to talk.

CemeteryCleanUpVinesAndWeeds_01.value: Why did you never tell me about the cemetery before, Grandma?

CemeteryCleanUpVinesAndWeeds_02.value: Well, it's not exactly a fun place to hang out, is it?

CemeteryCleanUpVinesAndWeeds_03.value: I guess not. Why's it here, though? I didn't think I'd see a cemetery in our garden!

CemeteryCleanUpVinesAndWeeds_04.value: Oh, a lot of these big houses used to have cemeteries. A few of the notable Boultons were laid to rest here.

CemeteryCleanUpVinesAndWeeds_05.value: It makes me a bit sad, this place. Makes me think of your Grandpa Charlie.

CemeteryCleanUpVinesAndWeeds_06.value: Really? Did he enjoy coming here?

CemeteryCleanUpVinesAndWeeds_07.value: Uh... no. Forget I said anything, dearie.

CemeteryCleanUpVinesAndWeeds_08.value: That was weird! I'd better stick around here and see what's going on.

CemeteryClosing_01.value: Hey Maddie! Did Clara's story get you down? You look kinda sad.

CemeteryClosing_02.value: It's just that I really thought I was going to be able to clear my Grandma's name.

CemeteryClosing_03.value: But every time I think I'm onto something, I hit a dead end!

CemeteryClosing_04.value: I might be able to help... I heard a rumor today about the old Lighthouse on your estate.

CemeteryClosing_05.value: Someone in town said they thought the reclusive man who lived there might be your Grandpa Charlie!

CemeteryClosing_06.value: Then that's where I'm going next!

CemeteryClosing_07.value: I'm not sure. I've actually only heard rumors about it. Maybe you should ask your Grandma?

CemeteryClosing_08.value: I saw her going to the Tennis court on my way here.

CemeteryClosing_09.value: Aarrrgg! In order to find the Lighthouse I now need to find Grandma and before that a Tennis court?? Great.

CemeteryFlowersForTheGrave_01.value: Jackie! I wasn't expecting you. Is everything okay?

CemeteryFlowersForTheGrave_02.value: Sure! I just really enjoyed our scavenger hunt, you know?

CemeteryFlowersForTheGrave_03.value: I wondered how you were getting on with things?

CemeteryFlowersForTheGrave_04.value: I'm alright. A bit confused, to be honest.

CemeteryFlowersForTheGrave_05.value: Sorry to hear that. This is a nice old cemetery though. Who does the grave belong to?

CemeteryFlowersForTheGrave_06.value: It's a C. Boulton - do you know them? I wondered if it could be my Grandpa, Charlie...

CemeteryFlowersForTheGrave_07.value: I think I know who that is! In fact, I'm sure of it.

CemeteryIntro_01.value: I wonder why Grandpa drew a spooky old cemetery?

CemeteryIntro_02.value: And I wonder why I never noticed this place before!

CemeteryIntro_03.value: I'd better ask Grandma what she knows about it, although I should probably hide the reason I'm here.

CemeteryIntro_04.value: I think I'll tidy up while I wait.

CemeteryRepairCrypt_01.value: Why are you fixing up this old thing?

CemeteryRepairCrypt_02.value: Well I, uh, heard about Clara Boulton, and wondered if this place would tell me more about her.

CemeteryRepairCrypt_03.value: Poor Clara! She was Ignatius' second daughter and lost her heart to a sailor.

CemeteryRepairCrypt_04.value: As soon as he found out the family fortune was invested in tin cans and this estate, he left her.

CemeteryRepairCrypt_05.value: Clara died of a broken heart a few months later. Her parents were too sad to even tell people about the funeral.

CemeteryRepairCrypt_06.value: When I married Charlie my parents thought he wanted our estate, too, and were worried I'd be like Clara.

CemeteryRepairCrypt_07.value: Luckily for me, he stuck around and didn't care about money!

CemeteryRepairCrypt_08.value: Well, I'm glad it worked out for you two, unlike poor Clara here.

CemeteryRepairCrypt_09.value: And I'm glad you've given her a nicer resting place than she had before, dearie.

CharlieKit_Bubble.value: This must be Grandpa Charlie's kit! I bet I can find a lot of useful tools in here!

ChessGlobe_02.value: No, but I’m not half bad at checkers!

ChessGlobe_03.value: Grandma and I used to play it every Tuesday. She’s an amazing chess player. Always one step ahead of me!

ChessGlobe_04.value: I guess nothing has changed, huh?

ChristmasCurrency_Desc.value: Special holiday currency! Exclusive currency that can be used for different holiday items!

“Do you want to build a snowmaaaan…“
“Do you want to build a snowmaaaan..."

ChristmasEventOffer04_Description.value: Or runway lights for Santa’s reindeer sleigh?
Or runway lights for Santa’s reindeer sleigh?

ChristmasEventOffer05_Description.value: It’s penguining to look a lot like Christmas!
It’s penguining to look a lot like Christmas!

ChristmasEventOffer06_Description.value: How did your annual do-I-remember-all-my-relatives-by-name -test go?
How did your annual do-I-remember-all-my-relatives-by-name -test go?

ChristmasEventOffer08_Description.value: When it gets freezing outside, maybe these two get red noses as well?
When it gets freezing outside, maybe these two get red noses as well?

ChristmasEventOffer09_Description.value: All I want for Christmas is many many many gifts!
All I want for Christmas is many many many gifts!

ChristmasEventOffer10_Description.value: Oh now I get why the instructions said ‘shake before use’!
Oh now I get why the instructions said ‘shake before use’!

ChristmasEventOffer12_Description.value: Come on in, it’s getting cold outside!
Come on in, it’s getting cold outside!

ChristmasEventOffer13_Description.value: We'd better light up Santa’s path to the chimney.
We'd better light up Santa’s path to the chimney.

ChristmasEventOffer14_Description.value: This must be the biggest Christmas wreath ever made...
This must be the biggest Christmas wreath ever made...

ChristmasEventOffer15_Description.value: What would holidays be without wearing a Winter sweater?
What would holidays be without wearing a winter sweater?

Cinema01_01.value: Hmm... Grandpa Charlie’s journal seems to describe this area in the Mansion.

Cinema01_02.value: As far as I can tell, there seems to be something connected to it!

Cinema01_03.value: It sort of reminds me of the hidden room below the Study...

Cinema01_04.value: That is where I discovered all the strange spy stuff. Maybe there's another hidden secret in here somewhere?

Cinema01_05.value: Let's sort this place out and find out!

Cinema02_04.value: Well, it looks like this place has a lot of interesting stuff, so I’m sure to get some answers here!

Cinema02_05.value: How I miss hearing you speak to yourself...

Cinema02_06.value: Ahhh! Arthur?! What are you doing back here?

Cinema03_01.value: I’m sorry, Mads. I just had to come back and see you again.

Cinema03_04.value: Mads, I... I miss you so much!

Cinema03_05.value: Yeah, well, you shouldn’t have left me at the altar, then...

Cinema03_06.value: This again. Wait... are we in a cinema? Kinda reminds me of our first date!

Cinema03_07.value: Remember? The old movie theater next to the University?

Cinema03_09.value: But the place was in shambles, so we went back to our dorm to watch a movie instead.

Cinema03_10.value: That’s right! And I made that epic meal!

Cinema03_11.value: Epic?! We had ramen and grilled cheese sandwiches! And you used my hair iron to do them!

Cinema03_12.value: I never said I was a “good” cook...

Cinema03_13.value: Haha... no. You didn’t. And... they weren’t half bad!

Cinema04_01.value: See? This is what I’m talking about! You and me! Us. I miss... THIS!

Cinema04_05.value: Oh! I uhh... I wasn’t listening in or anything. I actually came over to talk.

Cinema04_06.value: Thank goodness! I was worried you were angry at me!

Cinema04_07.value: No, of course not! It’s just that... could we talk alone in private for a second?

Cinema04_09.value: She ain’t going anywhere alone with you, buddy. Whatever you need to say, you can say in front of me.

Cinema05_01.value: Hey! I can make my own decisions!

Cinema05_04.value: Yeah and you LEFT first too, so why don’t you do it again?!

Cinema05_05.value: Stop it! What’s gotten into you two?!

Cinema05_06.value: Maddie... I need to tell you something. Something I’ve been meaning to tell you for a long time.

Cinema05_07.value: O- Okay Roddy... Let’s go to the next room and-

Cinema05_08.value: Come on, you aren’t actually listening to this schmuck, are you?!

Cinema05_10.value: No, I’m serious! This guy is BAD news!

Cinema06_01.value: I’m telling you Mads, you shouldn’t trust him.

Cinema06_02.value: Trust me? What about you?! Quite convenient for you to turn up again, right?...

Cinema06_03.value: What are you both talking about?

Cinema06_04.value: Mads, do you actually know who he is? Where he’s from?

Cinema06_05.value: Of course I do! He’s from Hopewell Bay!

Cinema06_08.value: See? I know who he is... And where he’s from.

Cinema07_01.value: I don’t understand, what are you saying?

Cinema07_02.value: Maddie, don’t listen to him. He’s obviously trying to manipulate you.

Cinema07_03.value: Give it a rest, “Roddy”. We both know who you REALLY are.

Cinema07_04.value: If you know who I am...

Cinema07_05.value: Then you know that this is not a smart thing to do.

Cinema07_09.value: Both of you get out. I’ve had enough of your testosterone-laden fake machismo! Ugh!

Cinema08_01.value: *Sigh* Why did Arthur have to come back, NOW?!

Cinema08_02.value: And I’ve never seen Roddy like that before!

Cinema08_03.value: And here I am talking to myself again!

Cinema08_04.value: Okay... Get a grip, Maddie. You need to talk to them and get to the bottom of things.

Cinema08_05.value: For now, I need a break. And restoring the cinema is just what the doctor ordered!

Cinema09_01.value: Hmm, this projector is quite old but luckily I learned how to fix these on the dance floor!

Cinema09_02.value: Just got to adjust this wiring and voilà!

Cinema09_03.value: Hold on, there's a reel in here already. Let's see if it works!

Cinema09_04.value: Wow, that looked like a movie countdown! But there were way too many numbers...

Cinema09_05.value: It almost seems like a phone number that could be important.

Cinema09_06.value: Good thing I have a photographic memory and managed to memorize all of that!

Cinema10_01.value: Interesting, I wonder why there's a phone in here...

Cinema10_02.value: Is this more like an intercom for the actors?

Cinema10_03.value: Wait, that number I memorized earlier....

Cinema10_04.value: This feels a bit odd but maybe I should dial the number.

Cinema10_07.value: "The Curiosity Fellowship honors your curious mind"

Cinema10_08.value: "In these hallowed halls, blue stones whisper tales untold,"

Cinema10_09.value: "Each placed with purpose, a story to unfold."

Cinema10_10.value: "Follow their path as truth shows the way."

Cinema10_11.value: "For secrets deep within shall see the light of day."

Cinema10_12.value: How fascinating! I've always loved riddles!

Cinema10_13.value: This Fellowship seems to have left quite a trail of breadcrumbs for curious minds like mine.

Cinema10_14.value: I should keep an eye out for any more gems or symbols...

Cinema11_01.value: Hmm... I thought I was done renovating this room but...

Cinema11_02.value: There seems to be more behind this wall!

Cinema11_04.value: I guess it was in use when this place was a theater...

Cinema11_05.value: This room might hold clues about the performers who once prepared here!

Cinema12_01.value: This place is scattered with items from the Curiosity Fellowship!

Cinema12_02.value: There's the same masks and even some theater costumes!

Cinema12_04.value: I was hoping to get some answers...

Cinema12_05.value: But, everyone in it is wearing these masks.... Creepy.

Cinema12_06.value: These must be super important Fellowship members.

Cinema12_07.value: They really take secrecy to a whole new level, don't they?

CinemaCharacterTask02_02.value: Yes, they are still at it. I must inform you that the chandeliers have unfortunately become casualties.

CinemaCharacterTask02_04.value: I have, Ma'am! I’ve come to you.

CinemaCharacterTask03_01.value: I must admit... Roddy is quite strong for his stature.

CinemaCharacterTask03_03.value: Well, judging from the hole he left after chucking Arthur through the table, I would say he exercises!

CinemaCharacterTask04_03.value: No, they’re still at it, I’m afraid.

CinemaCharacterTask04_04.value: But they have decided to finally take it outside!

CinemaCharacterTask05_02.value: You go out there and tell them to stop, or so help me...

CinemaCharacterTask05_03.value: Ma’am! Contain yourself! I just merely wished to inform you they have stopped for the day.

CinemaCharacterTask05_04.value: I’ve controlled most of the damage, thanks to you.

CinemaCharacterTask05_05.value: Oh... I’m sorry, Winston. Thank you for taking care of it.

CinemaCharacterTaskIntro_01.value: Pardon me, Ma’am, but I would like to turn your attention to a rather surprising development.

CinemaCharacterTaskIntro_03.value: The two gentlemen who left this area moments ago have decided to have a bit of a row, Ma’am.

CinemaCharacterTaskIntro_05.value: I’m doing my best to clean up after them, but they seem quite vigorous!

CinemaCharacterTaskIntro_07.value: Certainly not! I am a butler, not a referee.

CinemaOutro_02.value: There's a ladder above! Looks like it leads to some sort of attic.

CinemaOutro_03.value: Maybe this is what the journal was talking about...

CinemaOutro_04.value: There’s something up there that could be really important.

CinemaOutro_05.value: I should go have a look.

CinemaPOIBlueStones_02.value: I think I saw them in the secret society chamber as well!
I'm pretty sure I've seen them around...

CinemaPOIBlueStones_03.value: I wonder what their meaning is?

CinemaPOIBlueStones_04.value: Could it be connected to this secret group? Perhaps their symbol?

CinemaPOIChairs_02.value: Almost regal and not really something you’d see in a cinema.

CinemaPOIChairs_03.value: They're not in great shape though. I should probably switch these out to something more cozy.

CinemaPOIControlPanel_01.value: Whoa! That control panel was for this screen!

CinemaPOIControlPanel_02.value: How cool! And... strangely modern for this place...

CinemaPOIControlPanel_03.value: But thanks to whoever set this up, I can actually have a movie night here someday!

CinemaPOIFilmReels_01.value: Looks like an interesting collection of film reels...

CinemaPOIFilmReels_02.value: Although, I've never even heard of most of these! Hey... What's this?

CinemaPOIFilmReels_03.value: "Award Ceremony - Homegrown in Hopewell Bay" Ooh... I should check this out later!

CinemaPOIGreenRoom_01.value: Wow! A green room. This must have been where the actors got ready when it was still a stage!

CinemaPOIGreenRoom_02.value: Some interesting stuff in here... Wait! Those are the same masks from the secret society chamber!
Some interesting stuff in here... like those masks. They look like they belong to some exclusive, secret group.

CinemaPOIGreenRoom_04.value: I wonder what they did here...

CinemaPOIIndyStatue_02.value: I loved these movies, and they made me want to become an archaeologist as a kid!

CinemaPOIJournalPage_01.value: Hmm... I still can't figure out the encryption in this journal! If only there were instructions an-

CinemaPOIJournalPage_02.value: Wait a minute! The mutoscope! The instructional video seemed to focus on symbols!

CinemaPOIJournalPage_03.value: Yes! They match the ones in the journal! I think they're the key! Let's use them!

CinemaPOIJournalPage_04.value: Hmm... It first mentions to "Go up to discover the secret." and then "Go down to uncover the truth!"

CinemaPOIJournalPage_05.value: What does that mean? Is there a hidden passage that leads to an upstairs area?

CinemaPOIMasks_01.value: Ah... Comedy and Tragedy. The foundations of theater.

CinemaPOIMutoscope_01.value: Wow! I know what this is...

CinemaPOIMutoscope_03.value: Instead of film, it would use a series of images, much like a flip book.

CinemaPOIMutoscope_04.value: Hmm... What an odd movie! Looks like an instructional video for spies...

CinemaPOIPopcorn_01.value: Nothing like the smell of fresh popcorn in the cinema!

CinemaPOIPopcorn_02.value: Just something so magical and special about it that it makes you forget how easily it gets stuck in your teeth.

CinemaPOIProjector_01.value: This film projector is old but...

CinemaPOIProjector_02.value: It seems to have some unique features to it. Almost like it got an upgrade...

CinemaPOIProjector_03.value: I wonder if Eddie the musician had something to do with this.

CinemaPOIProjector_04.value: I really have to host a movie night here, some day.

CinemaPOISpyDocuments_01.value: Heyy... What’s this? Documents between the seats?

CinemaPOISpyDocuments_02.value: These look old... But important. Assuming that the label “Top Secret” in big red letters is to be believed.

CinemaPOISpyDocuments_03.value: Don't think it'll hurt to open it up... Oh wow! It's from the secret society!
Don't think it'll hurt to open it up... Oh wow! It looks like it's from some kind of secret organization.

CinemaPOISpyDocuments_04.value: Hmm... Interesting! Looks like instructions on how to use the seats!

CinemaPOISpyDocuments_05.value: It seems like they used this cinema as a way to pass on secret messages, and the seating order was important!
It seems like they used this cinema as a way to pass on coded messages, and the seating order was important!

CinemaPOISpyDocuments_06.value: They passed messages either via the films themselves or the actors! Quite cunning...

CinemaPOIStage_01.value: There's an inscription on the stage floor - “All the world’s a stage...”

CinemaPOIStage_02.value: Hmm... I wonder if they ever performed Shakespeare here.

CinemaPOIStage_03.value: There seems to be some kind of control panel here as well. Maybe it's for stage lights...

CinemaPOISymbolChart_01.value: Wait, a minute... These symbols look familiar!

CinemaPOISymbolChart_02.value: They’re the same as the ones behind the old seats! But... that’s not all!

CinemaPOISymbolChart_03.value: Those confidential documents I found under the seats make sense now!

CinemaPOISymbolChart_04.value: This chart helped identify where each important individual sat. Seems quite crucial!

CinemaPOISymbolChart_05.value: This place definitely has a spy connection - just like the Library!

Coco_PremiumRewardTip_Description.value: *Squeak squeak* Nothing like soaking in the hot tub all day long!

CodexIntro_01.value: Oh, I found this dusty book while cleaning in the Garage. It has all the items I have found listed. I wonder who would do that. Let's have a look.

CodexIntro_02.value: Seems like there is a reward for discovering the whole item chain. Great!

Compass_01.value: What's this thing? A compass? No...

Compass_02.value: This thing is too complicated to be a compass... Wait a minute! Does it say longitude on it?

Compass_03.value: Incredible! This seems to be some sort of device that can calculate accurate longitude!

Compass_04.value: Why haven't I ever heard of this thing before?!

Computer_02.value: Old but reliable! We still use these at work!

Computer_03.value: You use these ancient machines at the Bugle?

Computer_04.value: Our funding has never been the greatest, but if it ain’t broke...

Computer_05.value: Hmmm... It needs a password. I wonder if...

Computer_06.value: The code in the ledger is actually the password?

ConservatoryArea_AfterFinishingRaffelsia.value: Wow! Everything looks wonderful! I'm no horticulturist, but safe to say I did a good job restoring the place.
Look at all these pretty flowers! No wonder Charlie liked it here so much. I think it's so sweet that he planted all these Boulton Lilies for Grandma.
And the scent of them almost overpowers the stink of the corpse flower. Yuck!
I still can't believe I managed to grow one... Just like my - well, someone else in the family.
One day I'll get the bottom of this. Meanwhile, I don't think I'll need the seedling kit for now.
I'll hide it somewhere here so I can use it later!

ConservatoryArea_Intro_01.value: Okay Conservatory, let's see why Grandpa sketched you!

ConservatoryArea_Intro_03.value: Argh! Get back, you fiend, or you'll feel the cold steel of my candlestick! I - oh!

ConservatoryArea_Intro_04.value: Winston? Winston the butler?! What are you doing here?

ConservatoryArea_Intro_05.value: If you're here to steal something for my Uncle Leonard, then think again!
If you're here to steal something for my great-uncle Leonard, then think again!

ConservatoryArea_Intro_06.value: I'm not! I shall tell you, Mistress Boulton, but you may not like the answer.
I'm not! I shall tell you, Miss Boulton, but you may not like the answer.

ConservatoryArea_Outro_01.value: There just has to be a way to get into the mansion without setting off the traps!

ConservatoryArea_Outro_02.value: Winston obviously knows how to get in - but I don't know where he went!

ConservatoryArea_Outro_03.value: I wonder if there are any more clues in Grandpa's notebook?

ConservatoryArea_Outro_04.value: Hmm. There's nothing much, but there is a little sketch of the Cemetery after the Conservatory.

ConservatoryArea_Outro_05.value: I'm going to go there next and see what I can find out!

ConservatoryArea_Outro_06.value: I will get into the house, and prove Grandma's innocence once and for all!

ConservatoryArea_Painting_01.value: I really want to figure out all there is about the corpse flower and who used to plant them here, but now is not the time.

ConservatoryArea_Painting_02.value: I need to get inside the Mansion in order to prove Grandma's innocence. And that means I can't stay here nurturing some stinking plant.

ConservatoryArea_Painting_03.value: But what if it dies when I'm away?

ConservatoryArea_Painting_04.value: I know! I better paint a picture of it so I'll remember what it looked like - just in case.

ConservatoryArea_Painting_05.value: I feel just like Charlie making sketches and notes. Haha! I guess the apple doesn't fall far from the tree after all.

ConservatoryArea_Scene1_01.value: Well? Why are you here, Winston, if it's not for Uncle Leonard?
Well? Why are you here, Winston, if it's not for great-uncle Leonard?

ConservatoryArea_Scene1_02.value: I can promise you that I'm not here for him. Master Leonard and I have... parted ways.

ConservatoryArea_Scene1_04.value: Master Leonard finally pushed me too far. I now find myself with no job, and no home.

ConservatoryArea_Scene1_05.value: What did he ask you to do?

ConservatoryArea_Scene1_06.value: Ah, Mistress Boulton, that remains between myself and Master Leonard.
Ah, Miss Boulton, that remains between myself and Master Leonard.

ConservatoryArea_Scene2_01.value: You said I wouldn't like the reason you're here. What is it, if it isn't to steal for Leonard?

ConservatoryArea_Scene2_02.value: I wanted to pick some of the famous Boulton Lilies! I, well. I rather missed their scent, you see.

ConservatoryArea_Scene2_03.value: Oh! I guess I can understand that since they are so lovely.

ConservatoryArea_Scene2_04.value: But umm... There's something other than the Lilies smelling here. Something... Well, not very good, to be honest.

ConservatoryArea_Scene2_05.value: I think I know what you mean, Mistress Boulton.
I think I know what you mean, Miss Boulton.

ConservatoryArea_Scene3_01.value: What is that smell? Is it coming from that huge flower?

ConservatoryArea_Scene3_02.value: I'm afraid so... That's a very special flower with a dark story.

ConservatoryArea_Scene3_04.value: Telling this makes my heart heavy, Mistress Boulton. But this flower is not a typical flower.
Telling you this makes my heart heavy, Miss Boulton. But this flower is not a typical flower.

ConservatoryArea_Scene3_05.value: It's usually referred by its latin name Rafflesia, but I've grown to know it as a "corpse flower".

ConservatoryArea_Scene3_06.value: A corpse flower? That's not a pretty name for a flower. But... it explains the smell though.

ConservatoryArea_Scene3_07.value: It's a very unusual one and very hard to grow outside of wilderness. In fact, it takes great dedication and care to keep one alive.

ConservatoryArea_Scene3_08.value: ...and, of course, these seeds. I believe these belong to you, Mistress Boulton.
...and, of course, these seeds. I believe these belong to you, Miss Boulton.

ConservatoryArea_Scene4_01.value: Take these seeds and seedling kit. However, I have my doubts as to whether you will be able to grow the corpse flower as successfully as your - oh, I've said too much.

ConservatoryArea_Scene4_02.value: My who?! Who managed to grow them? And why?!

ConservatoryArea_Scene4_03.value: That's a story for another time, Mistress Boulton. Like I said, I'm here for the Boulton Lilies.
That's a story for another time, Miss Boulton. Like I said, I'm here for the Boulton Lilies.

ConservatoryArea_Scene5_01.value: Sounds... dark. But fine! We'll get back to this later! Meanwhile, can you please tell me something Winston: Did you ever speak to my grandpa Charlie?

ConservatoryArea_Scene5_02.value: Of course, Mistress Boulton. In fact, I would say that we became rather good friends.
Of course, Miss Boulton. In fact, I would say that we became rather good friends.

ConservatoryArea_Scene5_03.value: Then you'll be pleased to hear that he's still alive! He called me recently.

ConservatoryArea_Scene6_01.value: You said you knew Charlie was alive? How would you know that?

ConservatoryArea_Scene6_02.value: Master Leonard mentioned Charles being in trouble not long before he 'died.'

ConservatoryArea_Scene6_03.value: He even said that he wouldn't be surprised if Charles went on the run!

ConservatoryArea_Scene6_04.value: Do you know what kind of trouble he was in?

ConservatoryArea_Scene7_01.value: What about the Conservatory, Winston? Do you know what's special about this place?

ConservatoryArea_Scene7_02.value: Of course. Your Grandpa built it for Madam Ursula a few years after they were married.

ConservatoryArea_Scene7_03.value: He worked hard to make the Boulton Lilies bloom in here - they are her favorite flower, after all.

ConservatoryArea_Scene7_04.value: Do you know if he hid something here? Something that might show why he left?

ConservatoryArea_Scene7_05.value: Winston?! Winston? Where did he go?! It's like he vanished!

ConservatoryArea_Scene7_06.value: Hmm. I don't have time to worry about Winston just now. I need to get back to Grandpa's clues.

ConservatoryArea_Scene7_07.value: Let's think... Winston said the Boulton Lilies were the flowers Grandpa planted.

ConservatoryArea_Scene7_08.value: Maybe if I look for clues among those flowers I'll find something!

ConservatoryArea_Scene7_09.value: Yes! Here's an old envelope with something inside! Could it be from Grandpa Charlie?

ConservatoryArea_Scene8JuliusArrives_01.value: Hi Julius! This is good timing. I was just about to read this old letter that I found...
Hi, Julius! This is good timing. I was just about to read this old letter that I found...

ConservatoryArea_Scene8JuliusArrives_02.value: "To whom it may concern. I, Charles Boulton, am alive and well."

ConservatoryArea_Scene8JuliusArrives_03.value: "If you are reading this, then it means my wife Ursula has been framed for my murder!"

ConservatoryArea_Scene8JuliusArrives_04.value: "I hereby state that Ursula is innocent, and all the proof you require can be found in the Boulton Mansion."

ConservatoryArea_Scene8JuliusArrives_05.value: I don't believe it! We can show this to the police and get the charges against Grandma dropped!

ConservatoryArea_Scene8JuliusArrives_06.value: I wouldn't be too sure about that, Maddie.

ConservatoryArea_Scene8JuliusArrives_07.value: One, there's no evidence that this note was written by Charlie. Two, there's no evidence that it was written after his presumed date of death!

ConservatoryArea_Scene8JuliusArrives_08.value: No. We'd need to take more than just this to the police. You'll need hard evidence to prove Ursula's innocence.

ConservatoryArea_Scene8JuliusArrives_09.value: Then I know just what I have to do. I need to finally get inside the mansion!

ConservatoryArea_Scene9UrsulaArrives_01.value: Grandma, I have to get inside the mansion. Do you have the key?

ConservatoryArea_Scene9UrsulaArrives_02.value: Oh, Maddie. I knew this day would come, but I can't help you. There's no way to get in.

ConservatoryArea_Scene9UrsulaArrives_04.value: About a year before he died, Charlie rigged the mansion up with traps!

ConservatoryArea_Scene9UrsulaArrives_05.value: He replaced the lock with a keycode, and set up the world's most airtight security system.

ConservatoryArea_Scene9UrsulaArrives_06.value: If you try to get in without putting in the correct code, it'll activate the traps and barriers will seal the house up.

ConservatoryArea_Scene9UrsulaArrives_08.value: I... I don't remember! Truly, Maddie. I forgot it many, many years ago.

ConservatoryArea_Scene9UrsulaArrives_09.value: You should forget about it too, dearie. Let's just get back to gardening.

DE_CompletedCollection_Dialogue_01.value: According to the catalogue, this should be everything.

DE_CompletedCollection_Dialogue_02.value: Not quite... According to some notes I found, there should still be a few more special items.

DE_CompletedCollection_Dialogue_03.value: But what we’ve found so far is more than enough to send out already!

DE_CompletedCollection_Dialogue_04.value: Well, no harm in looking for more, I suppose.

DE_GrandmaGlasses_Dialogue_04.value: Oh, dearie. Don't you worry about it.

DE_Intro_Dialogue_01.value: Hey, guys! Wh- What’s going on?!

DE_Intro_Dialogue_02.value: Hey, Maddie! Didn’t you read the newspaper? I wrote an entire article about it...

DE_Intro_Dialogue_03.value: Oh... Er. I must have missed it.

DE_Intro_Dialogue_04.value: We’re digging up the old Hopewell Bay Archaeological Museum!

DE_Intro_Dialogue_05.value: Museum?! I didn’t know we had a museum!

DE_Intro_Dialogue_06.value: We did, but it collapsed on its grand opening many years ago.

DE_Intro_Dialogue_07.value: Something about illegal mineshafts below the town...

DE_Intro_Dialogue_09.value: Oh... Well, surely you won’t find anything of worth anymore, dearie.

DE_Intro_Dialogue_10.value: We’ve already found many! Many pieces are still in great shape.

DE_Intro_Dialogue_11.value: And the best part is that we’re going to be sending them back to their rightful homes!

DancefloorCharacterTask10_01.value: Ma’am, would you happen to know anything about fixing holes in walls?

DancefloorCharacterTask10_02.value: Sure, I know how to spackle a wall.

DancefloorCharacterTask10_03.value: Ah, no... The hole is much too large for that.

DancefloorCharacterTask10_04.value: How big are we talking here?

DancefloorCharacterTask10_05.value: Well... I do believe I saw Rufus jumping into it quite freely...

DancefloorCharacterTask10_07.value: I might have gotten a little carried away in searching for cameras, Ma’am...

DancefloorCharacterTask16_01.value: Winston, why do you need all this glue?

DancefloorCharacterTask16_02.value: Ah, about that, Ma’am. Master Mason told me he is quite the expert in keeping out infiltrators.

DancefloorCharacterTask16_03.value: Many of his harebrained ideas were downright silly. But I must admit, the boy has some imagination...

DancefloorCharacterTask16_06.value: Well, let’s just say I wouldn’t recommend placing anything on the windowsills for a while, Ma’am.

DancefloorCharacterTask1_01.value: Ah, good that you’re still here, ma'am! I’m going to need your help.

DancefloorCharacterTask1_03.value: Your grandmother was very adamant about making sure that this mansion was secure!

DancefloorCharacterTask1_04.value: While she is confident that Detective Sullivan would not be breaking laws in her survailance-

DancefloorCharacterTask1_05.value: I, on the other hand, believe it is better to be safe than sorry...

DancefloorCharacterTask1_06.value: And maybe lay down a few simple traps to slow her down. Will you help me?

DancefloorCharacterTask1_07.value: To help get back at that detective? You can count on it!

DancefloorCharacterTask20_01.value: How is securing the mansion coming along, Winston?

DancefloorCharacterTask20_03.value: By the time we’re done, this mansion will be more secure than Fort Knox!

DancefloorCharacterTask20_05.value: Indeed. It’ll almost be back to its former self again.

DancefloorCharacterTask20_07.value: *Ahem* I need to get back to it...

DancefloorCharacterTask30_01.value: Ma’am, I do believe we are now done, and the mansion is secure.

DancefloorCharacterTask30_03.value: Well... I found some random surveillance equipment, old and new. But I am unsure if it was placed there recently.

DancefloorCharacterTask30_04.value: Are you saying there was surveillance equipment already? Why?!

DancefloorCharacterTask30_05.value: By now, you should have concluded that this isn’t an ordinary mansion, ma'am...

DancefloorCharacterTask30_06.value: Well, you have a point! Thanks for the good work, Winston!

DancefloorCharacterTask5_01.value: Winston! Did you drag that sofa chair up here all by yourself?!

DancefloorCharacterTask5_02.value: *Huff huff* Why- *gulp* yes! I need you to check it for microphones!

DancefloorCharacterTask5_03.value: Wouldn’t it have been easier for me to check it where it was originally?

DancefloorCharacterTask5_05.value: Okay, you sit down, I’ll give it a look!

Dancefloor_02_01.value: Wow, this is an awful lot of confetti for such a small room...

Dancefloor_02_03.value: Hmm... Judging from the look of the place, it looks like some sort of dance floor!

Dancefloor_02_04.value: They must have had one heck of a party.

Dancefloor_02_05.value: I wonder what they were celebrating?

Dancefloor_03_01.value: Ha! You think I’M the one breaking the law? Look at this place...

Dancefloor_03_02.value: An illegal casino operation if I ever saw one. And I’ve seen many!

Dancefloor_03_03.value: Never ends well for the criminal, you know.

Dancefloor_03_04.value: Show me your warrant or leave the premises, detective.

Dancefloor_03_05.value: No need to get feisty, Maddie. I have my warrant right here.

Dancefloor_03_06.value: Funny that you should ask for it now, instead of the first time we met.

Dancefloor_03_07.value: For a bunch of criminal masterminds, you all aren’t too bright.

Dancefloor_04_04.value: Still really creepy. I wonder what it’s doing here?

Dancefloor_04_06.value: Maybe there’s a lot more to this place than I originally thought...

Dancefloor_05_01.value: Criminals? Of course not. Not yet, at least...

Dancefloor_05_02.value: Innocent until proven guilty and all that.

Dancefloor_05_03.value: And proving it won’t be difficult with all the evidence I’ve gathered so far.

Dancefloor_05_04.value: Like the second gold watch of yours. Really interesting, isn’t it Mrs. Boulton?

Dancefloor_05_06.value: You didn’t tell her? My... You are a devious Grandma! Ready to throw your own granddaughter under the bus like that...

Dancefloor_05_07.value: I think it's time for you to leave, detective. Especially since you haven't even let us check this so-called warrant....

Dancefloor_05_08.value: Right. But you can expect to see me again... With friends.

Dancefloor_06_01.value: There we go! All dressed up.

Dancefloor_06_02.value: Say... I'm starting to get a clearer picture...

Dancefloor_06_03.value: This one looks like a butler.

Dancefloor_06_04.value: And this other one looks like a well-dressed gentleman.

Dancefloor_06_05.value: Hmm... Their positioning is still a bit off.

Dancefloor_06_06.value: It almost looks like they were made to interact with each other.

Dancefloor_07_01.value: Grandma, what was she talking about? A second watch? I've only seen one...

Dancefloor_07_02.value: Winston, we need to check all the windows and doors. Make sure all the locks are still in good condition.

Dancefloor_07_03.value: And maybe it wouldn’t hurt to sweep the area and telephones for bugs. Who knows how long she’s been around...

Dancefloor_07_06.value: Oh, Dearie, I’m sorry... I... I thought I could spare you...

Dancefloor_07_07.value: ... Yes, alright. I’ll tell you. But, not here. It's too risky. Meet me at the cemetery in a few hours.

Dancefloor_07_09.value: It’s time you learned the truth...

Dancefloor_08_01.value: Hmm, I think it's time to go meet Grandma and find out what she has to say...
I know I've been a bit coy with you, dearie, but now you must listen carefully...

Dancefloor_08_02.value: Grandma, did we have to meet here of all places?
Grandma, all I've ever wanted was the truth.

Dancefloor_08_03.value: Listen carefully, Maddie. The gold watch that the police have in evidence...
Maddie, the gold watch that the police have in evidence...

Dancefloor_08_04.value: It's a fake. A carefully crafted imitation.

Dancefloor_08_06.value: The watch that you found, is the original. An anniversary gift from me to your Grandpa Charlie.

Dancefloor_08_07.value: Grandma, I have to ask you an important question... Is Grandpa Charlie alive?

Dancefloor_08_09.value: Grandma! This is a life or death question!

Dancefloor_08_10.value: It's complicated, Dearie. Your grandpa was trying to infiltrate the mob.

Dancefloor_08_11.value: Get enough on them to end the organization...

Dancefloor_08_12.value: They've always been after us - they know the secret about the mansion...

Dancefloor_08_13.value: I know that look! One secret at a time, Maddie...

Dancefloor_08_14.value: It's possible that he could have been caught or that he believed it would be best to fake his death.

Dancefloor_08_15.value: One thing I know is that your grandfather has his reasons and our best interests at heart.

Dancefloor_08_16.value: T-this is a lot to take in. I'd like to believe Grandpa Charlie is still alive.

Dancefloor_08_17.value: Me too, dearie. But, Sullivan, she has it out for us. We have to protect our family.

Dancefloor_08_18.value: You're right. We've been through enough already.

Dancefloor_08_19.value: Thank you for telling me, Grandma. I'll head back inside now.
Thank you for telling me, Grandma.

Dancefloor_08_20.value: I have to be more vigilant. I'm not letting people threaten us any longer, and I won't let them take Grandma away again!

Dancefloor_09_01.value: This painting is so detailed but it's quite worn out...

Dancefloor_09_02.value: I'm not much of an artist but I'm pretty sure I can restore it!

Dancefloor_09_03.value: All I need is the right set of tools and a bit of patience...

Dancefloor_10_01.value: Wait the lamps that the butlers are holding just flashed red...

Dancefloor_10_02.value: That has to confirm that this mannequin pose is wrong.

Dancefloor_11_02.value: The mannequin pose is the key element here...

Dancefloor_11_03.value: The projector casts a shadow from the mannequins that need to match with the painting behind it.

Dancefloor_11_04.value: I just have to get them in the correct dance position!

Dancefloor_12_02.value: Roddy, hey. You caught me at a bad time...

Dancefloor_12_04.value: Well, I'm nearly done renovating this room but I can't find the exit!

Dancefloor_12_05.value: Isn't it through that door over there?

Dancefloor_12_06.value: Nope, tried that. How am I supposed to move forward if there's no door?!

Dancefloor_13.1_01.value: May I have this dance, my dear....

Dancefloor_13.1_02.value: Roddy, I don't really have the time-

Dancefloor_13.1_03.value: Oh, humor me just this once, Maddie...

Dancefloor_13.1_04.value: Or are you afraid that you're a bad dancer?

Dancefloor_13.1_05.value: Pshh! Me? A bad dancer? You wish you could keep up with these moves!

Dancefloor_13.1_06.value: Oh my goodness! Roddy! Do you see that?

Dancefloor_13.1_07.value: There's some kind of light emanating from that corner...

Dancefloor_13.1_08.value: Yeah, I think it happened when I stepped on that funny tile!

Dancefloor_13.1_09.value: It definitely unlocked something! Let's go check it out...

Dancefloor_13_01.value: You know, Maddie. Life isn't always about moving forward...

Dancefloor_13_02.value: Sometimes you have to stay in the moment and enjoy it.

Dancefloor_13_03.value: Roddy, I'm hardly in the mood for-

Dancefloor_13_04.value: You know what, I have just the remedy!

Dancefloor_13_05.value: Why don't I put on one of these vintage records?

Dancefloor_14_01.value: It's a door! Roddy, you're a genius!

Dancefloor_14_03.value: Yes! If it weren't for your dance suggestion I never would have figured this out!

Dancefloor_14_04.value: Ahem, yes of course, I suppose I am a sort of genius...

Dancefloor_14_05.value: Haha, thanks, Roddy! I can't wait to see what this next room holds...

Dancefloor_Confetti2_01.value: Is it just me or is this an absurd amount of confetti?

Dancefloor_Confetti2_02.value: Perhaps this was a new year's party...

Dancefloor_Confetti3_02.value: I never want to see confetti for a while after this!

Dancefloor_Crates_01.value: These crates are filled with some unusual stuff...

Dancefloor_Crates_02.value: But then again, what isn’t unusual in this mansion?!

Dancefloor_Crates_03.value: Hey... there are initials carved into them! W+L... The same style of writing as the swing at the side entrance!

Dancefloor_Gramophone_01.value: Wow, this thing is an antique!

Dancefloor_Gramophone_02.value: But the needle looks good and the turntable still spins.

Dancefloor_Heartballoon_01.value: How sweet! I’ve always loved shiny heart-shaped balloons.

Dancefloor_Heartballoon_02.value: Wait a minute, there's writing on them...

Dancefloor_Intro_01.value: ...and I know that YOU have something to do with it!

Dancefloor_Intro_02.value: You’re dangerously close to crossing a line, detective...

Dancefloor_Intro_05.value: I found this “detective” rummaging around the Mansion without our consent!

Dancefloor_Intro_09.value: How dare you enter my home without a warrant? What kind of detective are you?!

Dancefloor_Mannequin_01.value: These mannequins look sort of familiar.

Dancefloor_Mannequin_03.value: Are they supposed to be butlers?

Dancefloor_Minigameoutro_01.value: Wow! I think I can safely add art restorer to my profile now!

Dancefloor_Minigameoutro_02.value: Who knew it required so many different, and intricate, tools...

Dancefloor_Minigameoutro_03.value: One thing's for sure though, this has inspired me to take up painting again!

Dancefloor_Partyhat_01.value: This party hat is pretty tacky.

Dancefloor_Partyhat_02.value: Like something one would wear during New Year's Eve...

Dancefloor_Partyhat_03.value: Was that the party they were having here?

Dancefloor_Pattern_01.value: This stone floor definitely has a luxurious pattern.

Dancefloor_Pattern_02.value: Kind of like a dance floor?

Dancefloor_Pattern_03.value: Got to say though... My steps make a really satisfying sound here!

Dancefloor_Projector_02.value: Was this place also used as a cinema?

Dancefloor_Projector_04.value: This thing looks like it has a powerful light source!

Dancefloor_Records_01.value: Oooh, there are some classics in here!

Dancefloor_Records_02.value: Actually... I think one of these is another demo record from Hopewell Bay’s one hit wonder?

Dancefloor_Records_03.value: I should play it some day...

Dancefloor_Wrongdoor_01.value: A door! This has to be the exit, right?

Dancefloor_Wrongdoor_03.value: Why is this room so strange and confusing?!

DebRoomCharacterTask10.value: Oh my, how could I have forgotten about this one.

DebRoomCharacterTask11.value: It has lost it's stone. The prongs got bent.

DebRoomCharacterTask13.value: We should polish the stone. Only the brightest will do!

DebRoomCharacterTask14.value: I should have the scetches somewhere.

DebRoomCharacterTask15.value: This used to make more sense. I need inspiration!

DebRoomCharacterTask17.value: I wish I could tell her of the lavander fields.

DebRoomCharacterTask18.value: I want to keep it pristine

DebRoomCharacterTask2.value: I saw something similar in Lille.

DebRoomCharacterTask20.value: Maddie, shall we make something for you?

DebRoomCharacterTask21.value: Oh I know just the right thing for you!

DebRoomCharacterTask22.value: Some more gold to match your hair!

DebRoomCharacterTask23.value: And then to add this grand saphire.

DebRoomCharacterTask28.value: It suits you, but what's with the dour look?

DebRoomCharacterTask29.value: Oh maddie, it seems I lost track of your wishes.

DebRoomCharacterTask3.value: How about we finish it togerher?

DebRoomCharacterTask30.value: Tell you what. Let's start over!

DebRoomCharacterTask31.value: Silver huh? I guess you are a bright winter.

DebRoomCharacterTask32.value: The sharp corners are really bold. I love it!

DebRoomCharacterTask33.value: Stuck ? Think of something that screams YOU.

DebRoomCharacterTask35.value: I have only seen such creativity in Musée d'Art Moderne

DebRoomCharacterTask37.value: Try it with these on too.

DebRoomCharacterTask5.value: Let's Straighten out the jagged edges!

DebRoomCharacterTask8.value: I wonder what other pieces I forgot.

DebRoomCharacterTask9.value: What is this? It is so dusty.

DebsRoom00_Intro_01.value: I think the sound was coming from in here!

DebsRoom00_Intro_02.value: Wow! This place is a mess!

DebsRoom00_Intro_05.value: Is that someone sitting on the floor?! It's too dark to tell...

DebsRoom01_Intro_01.value: I think the sound was coming from in here!

DebsRoom01_Intro_02.value: Well, she still looks like she's breathing!

DebsRoom01_Intro_03.value: “...Deep breath in. Hold for 4 seconds. Aaaand out.”

DebsRoom01_Intro_05.value: Maddie, sweetie! Yes, yes. Everything is fine.

DebsRoom01_Intro_07.value: But... What’s going on? Why are you in here?

DebsRoom02_01.value: Well... My therapist INSISTED I do an exercise where I “face my past”.

DebsRoom02_02.value: So what better place than my old room, right?

DebsRoom02_04.value: Obviously, it didn’t look like this when I was still living here!

DebsRoom02_05.value: But I guess that’s the problem as well. I’ve been avoiding this place.

DebsRoom02_06.value: My therapist says it has something to do with my abandonment issues.

DebsRoom03_01.value: I guess, I sort of understand how you feel...

DebsRoom03_02.value: I suppose you do, sweetie. A bit tragic, don’t you think?

DebsRoom03_03.value: Us Boulton women, constantly being abandoned, one way or another?

DebsRoom03_04.value: Oh, don’t be like that! Maybe if I help you sort this place out, it’ll give you a chance to reflect on things?

DebsRoom03_05.value: I guess I would need a hand cleaning up this mess...

DebsRoom03_06.value: Trust me! I did it in my room, and it was quite cathartic.

DebsRoom03_07.value: Come on, let’s get to it!

DebsRoom04_01.value: *sigh* All this is really bringing back the memories. I won’t lie.

DebsRoom04_02.value: But I’m surprised at how angry most of it is making me feel...

DebsRoom04_04.value: Well... You know I was adopted, but did you know I was actually left here?

DebsRoom04_05.value: ...On the porch. Discarded like some unwanted pet on the sidewalk!

DebsRoom04_07.value: No, it’s alright sweetie. I’m not angry at you.

DebsRoom04_08.value: I’m just angry that for so long, no one ever told me why.

DebsRoom05_01.value: Do you think our family knew why?

DebsRoom05_04.value: *sigh* Mom and Dad were great, though. They loved me like their own.

DebsRoom05_05.value: In fact, I didn’t know I was adopted until my 9th birthday. It was a fluke, really.

DebsRoom05_09.value: Yeah, he found the adoption papers one day in Dad’s office.

DebsRoom05_10.value: Thought it would be funny to tell me on my birthday.

DebsRoom05_12.value: No... It was perhaps the best present I ever got.

DebsRoom06_02.value: Yes, of course. But at my parents for never telling me.

DebsRoom06_03.value: And even more so for doing their best to dissuade me from finding out more.

DebsRoom06_04.value: I’m sure you can understand the need to learn about your family history, Maddie.

DebsRoom06_06.value: Your grandmother said it’s one reason for my “rebellious nature”.

DebsRoom06_07.value: But maybe it’s just a Boulton trait...

DebsRoom07_01.value: I got teased for it in school; you know.
I got teased for it in school, you know.

DebsRoom07_02.value: They’d call me “Donor Deb” among other more colorful names.

DebsRoom07_04.value: Kids will be kids... But thankfully Leonard was around to have my back.

DebsRoom07_06.value: Yes, of course. He’s my big brother, after all. He made sure to remind people of that.

DebsRoom07_07.value: I... I didn’t think he would care.

DebsRoom07_08.value: You should probably give him a break, you know. He might be bad with money...

DebsRoom07_09.value: But his heart is still in the right place.

DebsRoom08_01.value: As I grew older, I knew there was more behind me being adopted than I was told.

DebsRoom08_02.value: Leonard helped me gather a few clues that led to Europe. So I began sending out letters.

DebsRoom08_03.value: How many did you send out?

DebsRoom08_04.value: Oh, I lost count. Sometimes even a dozen a day!

DebsRoom08_05.value: But one day... I got an odd reply from a small city state between France and Italy called Monte Brava.

DebsRoom08_06.value: I promised myself, when I was old enough, that I’d head there to discover the truth!

DebsRoom09_01.value: I went to Europe, but what I found there...

DebsRoom09_02.value: Was not what I was expecting.

DebsRoom09_05.value: Tell me, Maddie. You spend most of your time fixing up this old place, digging up the past.

DebsRoom09_06.value: Are you sure you WANT to find what you’re looking for?

DebsRoom10_01.value: I’m sure Deb. I want to know the whole truth.

DebsRoom10_02.value: Oh, I know that, sweetie. Everyone does. But are you willing to accept the cost?

DebsRoom10_03.value: The cost of risking everything. Possibly destroying everything...

DebsRoom10_04.value: I mean, look how I turned out when I finally discovered the truth.

DebsRoom10_05.value: A strong, no nonsense woman, who knows exactly what she wants and takes care of those she loves?

DebsRoom11_Outro_01.value: Thank you, Maddie. I guess going through these things and sorting through my past helped.

DebsRoom11_Outro_03.value: There you go! But, really. What did you discover during your time over there?

DebsRoom11_Outro_05.value: You should look into the room across the hall. You might find it interesting.

DebsRoom11_Outro_06.value: Wow! You sound just as cryptic as Grandma!

DebsRoom11_Outro_07.value: Well... We ARE sisters, after all.

DebsRoomCharacterTask1_02.value: Oh! I thought I lost these! It's some jewelry I was working on in my younger years...

DebsRoomCharacterTask1_03.value: Say... how about you help me finish them?

DebsRoomCharacterTask1_04.value: I don’t know how to make jewelry!

DebsRoomCharacterTask1_05.value: Don’t worry, I’ll teach you the tricks of the trade, sweetie!

DebsRoomCharacterTask2_01.value: Not bad, Maddie! You really have an eye for this!

DebsRoomCharacterTask2_02.value: I’m surprised myself, to be honest.

DebsRoomCharacterTask2_03.value: That’s the beauty of it, isn’t it? I guess creating jewelry was my way of sharing my own discovery.

DebsRoomCharacterTask3_01.value: Ah, this piece. This one is VERY special.

DebsRoomCharacterTask3_04.value: Why not?! She’s strong and defiant.

DebsRoomCharacterTask4_01.value: No, sweetie. Use the opal on that one.

DebsRoomCharacterTask4_02.value: But I really think citrine is the better choice!

DebsRoomCharacterTask4_03.value: Does everything HAVE to be yellow with you?

DebsRoomCharacterTask5_03.value: It is rather beautiful, isn’t it?

DebsRoomCharacterTask5_04.value: I hope you’ll wear it often.

DebsRoomCharacterTask5_06.value: Sweetie... You made it, it’s yours.

DebsRoomPOI_AlcoveBed_02.value: And fancy too! Reminds me of something I’d read in a fairytale.

DebsRoomPOI_AlcoveBed_03.value: A bed fit for a princess!

DebsRoomPOI_Bathtub_01.value: This bathtub is pure luxury and decadence!

DebsRoomPOI_Bathtub_02.value: I can only imagine sunbathing in the window's light while soaking in a warm bubble bath!

DebsRoomPOI_Bathtub_03.value: Boy... Deb sure knows how to enjoy life!

DebsRoomPOI_BirdCage_01.value: Hmm... Looks like a cockatoo cage.

DebsRoomPOI_BirdCage_02.value: I wouldn’t have thought Deb owned a pet...

DebsRoomPOI_BirdCage_03.value: Those birds can live up to a 100 years old! I wonder if it’s still around somewhere?

DebsRoomPOI_Desk_01.value: I wonder how many hours she spent sitting in front of this desk?

DebsRoomPOI_Desk_02.value: Er... I didn’t mean to make her sound vain or anything.

DebsRoomPOI_EiffelTower_01.value: Even though it’s only a scale model, the engineering is still impressive!

DebsRoomPOI_EiffelTower_02.value: Can’t believe it was almost sold off as scrap metal by a con artist...

DebsRoomPOI_EiffelTower_03.value: I wonder why that’s the only fun fact I know about it?!

DebsRoomPOI_FancyClothes_01.value: I bet these clothes could go for a lot of money at the auction.

DebsRoomPOI_FancyClothes_03.value: She’d say that they are a part of her soul or something...

DebsRoomPOI_Hat_02.value: Really stylish... I wonder if it would fit me?

DebsRoomPOI_Hat_03.value: And... Would Deb be okay if I borrowed it for a while?

DebsRoomPOI_HorsePhoto_01.value: This must have been Deb’s horse!

DebsRoomPOI_HorsePhoto_02.value: The frame has a name... Biscuit.

DebsRoomPOI_HorsePhoto_03.value: Aaw, how cute! I bet it was their favorite snack!

DebsRoomPOI_Letters_01.value: Interesting... This letter is addressed to “My Little Blossom”.

DebsRoomPOI_Letters_02.value: What’s strange is that Deb did not write this!

DebsRoomPOI_Letters_03.value: And it talks about their hopes and dreams for their little one... I wonder who they mean?

DebsRoomPOI_ParisianRoom_01.value: This entire room is definitely giving off a Parisian vibe.

DebsRoomPOI_ParisianRoom_02.value: I guess Deb’s travels in Europe left a big impression.

DebsRoomPOI_ParisianRoom_03.value: She brought it back with her!

DebsRoomPOI_Portrait_01.value: Wow! Deb hasn’t lost her touch with fashion, that’s for sure.

DebsRoomPOI_Portrait_02.value: She’s as stunning now as she was back then.

DebsRoomPOI_Portrait_03.value: I hope that’s a Boulton trait...

DebsRoomPOI_Ribbons_02.value: These award ribbons really prove it, too!

DebsRoomPOI_Ribbons_03.value: Maybe she can give me a few pointers with Babylon.

DebsRoomPOI_Soaps_02.value: I don’t think Deb will mind if I give it a whiff...

DebsRoomPOI_WeddingShoes_01.value: Ah, Deb’s shoes from her first wedding!

DebsRoomPOI_WeddingShoes_02.value: Custom made in Italy and EXTREMELY expensive.

DebsRoomPOI_WeddingShoes_03.value: I wonder if these could cover my costs of renovating the mansion?

DecorationRemoveMigrate_Description_Long.value:
As part of the ongoing renovations, Maddie is preparing some cleaning and fixes to the walls of the Mansion - which means the decorations on the windows, door and roof need to be removed.
For each decoration you will receive a specific amount of Coins.
Below you can see your total amount and collect it.
