DialogText_AntiqueDealerArrival1_Antique.value: I’m sorry I didn’t know the gear was in reverse.
I know, that’s where I came from.
I mean that is the direction I came from.
I’m sorry. Now the gate is damaged and the car is broken.
Well! That wasn't quite the entrance I intended to make, but here I am.
Goodness - Maddie, is that you? I haven't seen you since you were a toddler.
It's me, Julius! I'm an, ahem, old friend of your Grandmother. Is she around?
Oh, I'm fine. I was just a tad distracted when I saw the improvements you'd made here!
I'll go and find Ursula, if it's alright with you? I am terribly sorry about the mess I made.

DialogText_AntiqueDealerArrival1_Maddie_.value: Better make sure. My Grandma lives right around the corner.
Maybe my friend Roddy can help with that while I take you to grandma’s.
She's here somewhere - but are you alright?
Don't worry, I have LOTS to do here to satisfy the council! One more thing doesn't matter as long as you're safe.

DialogText_AntiqueDealerIntro1_Maddie_01.value: Hi Roddy. Did you get any information on the council for me?
Hi, Roddy. Did you get any information on the council for me?

DialogText_AntiqueDealerIntro1_Roddy_01.value: It’s not a big deal. Buildings that are in bad shape are my area of expertise.

DialogText_AntiqueDealerIntro1_Roddy_02.value: Would you like to get a cup of-

DialogText_AntiqueDealerIntro1_Roddy_02_.value: Do I smell cherry pie? Uh, I mean, yes. It all looks good so far.

DialogText_AntiqueDealerIntro1_Roddy_03_.value: They say you still have a lot to do, but that you're doing well. And--

DialogText_AntiqueDealerLeaves1_AntiqueD.value: Maddie, I must ask. What made you take on the repairs of this place?
You have an uphill battle ahead of you, that's for sure.
I do believe that! She convinced Ursula to return after everything that happened here, after all...
Oh, apologies. It really isn't my place to say. I must dash - it's time for my online yoga class.

DialogText_AntiqueDealerLeaves1_Maddie_0.value: I just wanted to restore the family estate to its former glory!
And I must start repairing the garage. With all of these unexpected guests coming and going it would be a good idea to have a proper garage.

DialogText_AntiqueDealerLeaves1_Roddy_01.value: The job is only halfway done. I still have to replace the gate.

DialogText_AntiqueDealerLeaves1_Roddy_02.value: Make sure your gear is not in reverse.

DialogText_AntiqueDealerLeaves1_Roddy_04.value: If anyone can do it, Maddie can!

DialogText_AntiqueDealerLeaves1_Roddy_06.value: What do you mean by that?!

DialogText_BeachRightDiscovered_Grandma_.value: This was where Skatie Katie and Hang Ten hung out. Their little slice of paradise.
Katie 'Skatie' Boulton, my dear older cousin. She fell madly in love with Casey 'Hang Ten' Schultz.
Katie "Skatie" Boulton, my dear older cousin. She fell madly in love with Casey "Hang Ten" Schultz.
Yes, very nice. Say, Maddie, how do you spell 'heist?' Is it I before E or E before I or--
Not now, honey, the cat’s waiting for her bath.
Me, rob a bank, alone?! Goodness, no. Unless... no.
Not really. I may have written about it in my old journals, though. I'll go check!

DialogText_BeachRightDiscovered_Maddie_0.value: What was this space all about? It's nothing like a grand mansion.
Hey, Grandma! Look at this cute beach house I found.
Skatie, Hang.. Grandma, are you feeling okay? This is making less and less sense.
You have a cousin? Grandma, now you have to tell me everything!
Why on earth are you trying to spell that? Planning on robbing a bank?
If I ever needed a reason to think my family was weird...
I know you're just trying to tease me, Grandma. Can we talk about this house instead? Do you know anything about it?
I hope she's not really contemplating bank robbery!

DialogText_BeachRightTotemFinished_Grand.value: That's right, sweetie. Cousin Katie always said they invented the skateboard.
I don't know about that, but every surfer who came here looking for Casey showed up with a surfboard and left with a skateboard..
I thought I'd burned all these old photos! I mean, uh, well. Yep, that's us - with Skatie Katie and Casey.
Oh my gosh! I left the bath running! And I put an extra dollop of bubbles in!
It wasn't, but Katie loved roller skating, and Casey loved surfing. So one day she put the wheels of her skates onto his surfboard, and invented the first skateboard!
The tragedy was that I was lousy at skateboarding! I fell in front of Charlie and was embarrassed for weeks. I just didn't want to tell you too.

DialogText_BeachRightTotemFinished_Maddi.value: Alright, mind blown! So he was a surfer, she was a roller skater, and they came together and made skateboards?
Grandma, I just found a photograph - of you, Grandpa, and other people on skateboards here at the beach house!
Invented the skateboard? You're kidding, right?
This makes sense after all! Grandma, for a moment I was worried about you. So, I had this question about..
I didn't realise skateboarding was popular when you were kids.
But you don’t have a bath!
Oh well, now I can at least make space in the garage by removing items that are no longer needed.
What was the tragedy, though? And why did you need to check your journals if you knew about this place?
Grandma, that's NOT a tragedy. You had me really worried!

DialogText_BeachRightTotemTaskRevealed_M.value: I need to fix up this sign, then I can finish the beach.
I need to fix up this sign, then I can finish the beach.
I'd like to find out more about Skatie Katie and Casey, too.
I'd like to find out more about Skatie Katie and Casey, too.
If Grandma won't tell me anything, then I should look around here for clues!
If Grandma won't tell me anything, then I should look around here for clues!

DialogText_BeachRightWorkshopCleanedUp_G.value: Casey was one of the most famous surfers back in the day. He was looking for big waves. He was a legend.
Katie and Casey fell in love, and she brought him here. Casey was looking for the fabled Perfect Wave that never came.
I'll take those books to my grave, Maddie!
I can’t answer that right now! Not without first pouring myself a mint julep. Back in a swish!
I... yes. I know that my dear older cousin 'Skatie Katie' built the place with her partner Casey.
She was another Boulton inventor, just like you. But her tale is really tragic.
In fact, I don't think I want to talk about it right now. Sorry, Maddie.

DialogText_BeachRightWorkshopCleanedUp_M.value: What's with all of these surfboards?
I'd love to see your journals one day, Grandma. Sounds like they're filled with family history.
But there are no waves here. This is the calmest part of the sea I know!
There must be a happy ending in here somewhere, right?
Alright, you don't need to show me! But did you find out anything about the beach house in them?
A mint julep? But Grandma doesn’t drink..
Skatie Katie?! She sounds pretty interesting.

DialogText_DrivewayGateClearedMansionSig.value: Your grandfather and I spent a lot of time in these gardens...
I don't know what you're talking about. Can we go home now?
Well, Charlie knew these grounds better than most, but they sure didn’t belong to him...
It's complicated. But I'll try - for you. I suppose the gardens are quite nice, in the right light...
Not now, sweetie, I left a pie in the oven! And it looks like you've got your work cut out for you, too!
I believe you there. You've always been good at making and fixing things. Inventing is in your DNA!
Never mind. Alright, we can stay awhile. Just - watch where you dig, won't you?
Never mind. Alright, we can stay awhile. Just - watch where you dig, will you?
Beaumont Hall? Why did Grandma keep this place a secret?
Grandma, do you know any strange stories about the estate? Are they the reason you kept me away from it?
This is home! Oh, Grandma, can't you just try? What is it with you and this place, anyway?
Grandma, what’s with all the mystery?
They're going to be beautiful when I'm finished! I will NOT let the council condemn this place.
Oh well. I guess we should get the driveway cleaned before the inspector returns.

DialogText_GarageCarFinished_Grandma_01.value: Lindsay was heartbroken when she came back to Beaumont Hall. She swore never to set foot in New York again.

DialogText_GarageCarFinished_Grandma_02.value: But canned goods were in high demand during the downturn. The family business recovered slowly but surely.

DialogText_GarageCarFinished_Grandma_02_.value: Hello dearie. You look lost in thought. Did you get rid of that ugly old watch like I asked you to?

DialogText_GarageCarFinished_Grandma_03.value: All of a sudden Lindsay had a stroke of genius. She came up with a new invention: the spray can.

DialogText_GarageCarFinished_Grandma_03_.value: Uh, yes. Of course I did. So anyway, about Lindsay Boulton - what did she do?

DialogText_GarageCarFinished_Grandma_04.value: That made the family business really boom. Business had never been so good.

DialogText_GarageCarFinished_Grandma_04_.value: Well, like I told you, her dad lost the family fortune. Lindsay came up with a great idea to get it back again, but he wouldn't listen.

DialogText_GarageCarFinished_Grandma_05.value: Oh my! I think I put my hat in the oven and my cake on the hook! Gotta go!

DialogText_GarageCarFinished_Grandma_05_.value: She went ahead and did it anyway - she came up with the very first spray can!

DialogText_GarageCarFinished_Grandma_07_.value: Yep. Her dad wasn't happy at first, but when her invention saved the estate he apologized and left her everything.

DialogText_GarageCarFinished_Grandma_09_.value: And not the first person trying to save this old estate, either...

DialogText_GarageCarFinished_Maddie_01.value: Before you have to run off again: is Lindsay the reason the mansion was sealed off?

DialogText_GarageCarFinished_Maddie_01_N.value: I keep thinking about the watch I found. I bet 'Chuck' was Grandpa Charlie! But why would Grandma say the watch was junk?

DialogText_GarageCarFinished_Maddie_02.value: Do you mean Lindsay wasn't why the mansion was sealed off?

DialogText_GarageCarFinished_Maddie_03.value: Should I tell her some of her cakes taste like hats?

DialogText_GarageCarFinished_Maddie_04.value: Okay time to clean all the left over items from the Garage.

DialogText_GarageCarFinished_Maddie_06_N.value: That's amazing! I can't believe my relatives invented tin cans and spray cans.

DialogText_GarageCarFinished_Maddie_08_N.value: It's been incredible to find out I'm not the only inventor in the family!

DialogText_GarageCarRevealed_Grandma_01.value: It belonged to Lindsay Boulton. She almost drove the family bankrupt.

DialogText_GarageCarRevealed_Grandma_02.value: Actually she made a fortune for the family. She quadrupled our family's wealth in only seven years. But then she lost all of it and then some.

DialogText_GarageCarRevealed_Grandma_02_.value: It belonged to Lindsay Boulton. That woman had real class - and had to fight hard.

DialogText_GarageCarRevealed_Grandma_03.value: I’d love to stay and chat, but I really must be off – I’ve got a costume party to go to, and I’ve got to wrap myself head to toe in bandages.

DialogText_GarageCarRevealed_Grandma_04_.value: Her father lost the family fortune in the stock market crash, back in 1929. He wouldn't listen to her ideas to recover it.

DialogText_GarageCarRevealed_Grandma_06_.value: What does it matter? Look around, kiddo. This place went to the dogs.

DialogText_GarageCarRevealed_Maddie_01.value: That's quite the car! Or was, I guess?

DialogText_GarageCarRevealed_Maddie_01_N.value: What a gorgeous car! Looks like a real classic.

DialogText_GarageCarRevealed_Maddie_02.value: We're finally getting to the meat of the story! So she was the guilty one who partied all day and night?

DialogText_GarageCarRevealed_Maddie_03.value: So is that why the mansion was sealed off?

DialogText_GarageCarRevealed_Maddie_04.value: That excuse wasn’t a patch on the last one!

DialogText_GarageCarRevealed_Maddie_05_N.value: How awful! Did she ever persuade him to listen?

DialogText_GarageCarRevealed_Maddie_07_N.value: Maybe, but I'm going to do everything I can to bring it back to life!

DialogText_GarageCarTaskRevealed_Grandma.value: Have you noticed there’s something missing from the car?
I know this old car is a beauty, but there's something missing. Can you spot it?
I'll give you a clue - look at the car hood!
I'm sure you'll figure it out, dear!

DialogText_GarageCarTaskRevealed_Maddie_.value: Car hood? Can’t you just tell me what it is I’m looking for?
Car hood? Can't you just tell me what it is I’m looking for?

DialogText_GarageTraderTableRevealed_Gra.value: Lindsay was a canny investor. She moved to New York with a bag of Boulton money to make it big on Wall Street.
She was a really successful investor. But she couldn't predict the stock market crash in 1929.
What's that you've got there, Maddie?
She lost all her money and then some. That broke her heart, and she moved back to Beaumont Hall.
Can I answer that later? I’ve got to go chase a blue jay out of the greenhouse. Darn thing keeps eating my raspberries.
Uh, nope. Never seen it. Looks horrible. I imagine it's broken too, is it?
Don't bother. Just throw that thing in the trash and forget about it. I'll go buy you a new watch!

DialogText_GarageTraderTableRevealed_Mad.value: So Lindsay made money and lost money. What did she do exactly?
Oh, wow, I found a watch! Looks old, and it's heavy too. There's an inscription - 'For my Chuck.'
Oh my gosh! I hate to sound like a broken record, but is that why the mansion was sealed off??
A gold watch. Do you know who it could have belonged to?
Well, yeah, but I'm pretty sure I can repair it.
Ok, she's definitely being strange. There must be more to this watch than meets the eye...

DialogText_GardenRightFountainFinished_G.value: They used to call Ignatius the Tin Man.
All right, Maddie. Listen up. This fountain is where your Grandpa Charlie proposed to me.
No, Ignatius had more heart than a lion.
Ask me again a little later. I can see the postman coming up the street.
I just miss him, and being here makes me think of how I lost him.
It wasn't a... I mean, oh! I hear the kettle whistling! Better go.

DialogText_GardenRightFountainFinished_M.value: Because he didn't have a heart?
Tin Man, empire... He wasn't doing anything illegal, right?
That's so romantic! Why didn't you want to talk about it before?
Is it me or is Grandma avoiding my questions?
I'm sorry, Grandma. It must be hard to be reminded of his heart attack.
Hmm. Either I'm imagining it, or she was about to say that my grandpa didn't die of a heart attack!

DialogText_GardenRightFountainRevealed_G.value: Ignatius was a self-made man. He built his empire from nothing. This fountain is one of the many gifts he received.
Now hold that thought, my dear. I've got a cherry pie cooling and a cat that will eat anything that's not steaming!
Just taking in the view. Speaking of views - what's going on with you and that Roddy guy?
The story is... that I'm going to go and bake a cake for your new friend.

DialogText_GardenRightFountainRevealed_M.value: I'm surprised to see you up here, Grandma.
An empire? An empire of what?!
Ever get the feeling Grandma bakes just to avoid difficult questions?
He's just helping me with the council, Grandma! You know I'm doing everything I can to stop them condemning the place.
Anyway, I'd love to hear about this fountain. What's the story?
Huh. Grandma's definitely deflecting, and I want to know why!

DialogText_Grandma1_0.value: It's time for you to find out what’s behind that locked door in my garden wall.

DialogText_Grandma1_1.value: Take this key and open the door!

DialogText_Grandma_02_New.value: Thanks for coming here with me.

DialogText_Grandma_03_New.value: I don't know why you wasted your savings paying the back taxes on this old wreck, Maddie.

DialogText_Halloween2021_Intro_02.value: Did you hear that the city is organising a Halloween challenge?

DialogText_Halloween2021_Intro_03.value: I did! I’m going to win that one!

DialogText_Halloween2021_Intro_04.value: City officials will do some evaluation rounds as part of that and --

DialogText_Halloween2021_Intro_05.value: And do you think they’ll also evaluate my progress with the mansion renovation?

DialogText_Halloween2021_Intro_06.value: Exactly. Better clean things up a bit.

DialogText_Halloween2021_Intro_07.value: At least those spider webs should go.

DialogText_Maddie1_0.value: You wanted to see me, Grandma?

DialogText_Maddie1_1.value: I can't believe it! How long have I been asking about that door? Twenty years?

DialogText_Maddie1_2.value: Now Grandma’s finally given me the key! Let's go open the gate!

DialogText_Maddie2_1.value: Can you open it? Little sister hands strike again – ah ha ha heh hmph.

DialogText_Maddie3_0.value: A mansion!? What other secrets are you hiding, Grandma?

DialogText_Maddie3_1.value: We can't reach the front door.

Let's see if there are more Gloves in the barrel!

DialogText_Maddie7_1_New.value: There must be another pair of gloves in here.
There must be another <color=#338DFF>pair of gloves</color> in here.

DialogText_Maddie7_2.value: Gardening gloves! First to the door gets all the marbles!

DialogText_Maddie8_2.value: What!? But we only just opened the gate!

DialogText_Maddie8_2_New.value: What kind of stories? What are you talking about??

DialogText_Maddie8_4_New.value: Sorry - you didn't. I've just got a lot to do to restore the estate so the council won't condemn it.

DialogText_Maddie8_7.value: So if we fix the place up, the city won’t tear it down?

DialogText_Maddie8_7_New.value: Why would you help me, Mr...?

DialogText_Maddie8_9.value: You heard the man – let’s get to work!

DialogText_Maddie8_9_New.value: Hmm. Well, I'm Maddie, and I may just take you up on your offer. Thanks!

DialogText_Maddie_01_New.value: Grandma, I realize you never want to see the estate again, but...

DialogText_Maddie_04_New.value: It's our family home, and as the last surviving Boulton it's my duty to be here.

DialogText_Maddie_05_New.value: Plus, someone from the local council wrote and told me that we have to restore the estate or they'll condemn it and rip it down!
Plus, someone from the local council wrote and told me that we have to restore the estate, or they'll condemn it and tear it down!

DialogText_Maddie_06_New.value: I bet they'll do it too, so I WON'T let that happen - I'm going to make this place look amazing.

DialogText_Maddie_07_New.value: This house is HUGE! Our family must have been a big deal in the past.

DialogText_Maddie_08_New.value: Looks smaller than I remembered. Messier, too.

DialogText_Maddie_09_New.value: You're right about the mess. It's no wonder the council wants to condemn it.

DialogText_Maddie_10_New.value: Let's clear this up so we can start saving the estate! First, we need tools to clear a path in...

DialogText_Maddie_10_New_IdealFTUE.value: Let's <color=#338DFF>check the garage</color> for tools to clear the path in! The estate isn't going to save itself!

DialogText_Maddie_DrivewayGateRemoveFall.value: This tree has grown through the driveway! Gosh, how long has this place been locked away?

DialogText_Maddie_DrivewayGateRemoveGrou.value: If we get rid of this dirt, we'll be done here!

DialogText_Maddie_DrivewayPlantFlower1.value: Add the flowers and – voila! – the icing on the cake!

DialogText_Maddie_DrivewayPrepareFlowerb.value: This driveway would look a lot better with some flowers. Let's prepare this flowerbed!

Let's clean the driveway before the inspector returns.

DialogText_Maddie_DrivewayRemoveLeaves2.value: So many dry leaves! It's like they've been piling up here for years...

DialogText_Maddie_DrivewayStatueHotspotO.value: It looks like there's a statue of some sort under that tarpaulin.

DialogText_Maddie_DrivewayStatueRemoveBr.value: We're almost there! We need to cut off these branches next.

DialogText_Maddie_DrivewayStatueRemoveTa.value: Who's that?! Why did they make a statue for him? Looks like the statue is missing one arm.

DialogText_Maddie_DrivewayStatueRemoveWo.value: Is that a statue under that tarpaulin? Let's take a closer look!

Looks like a treasure chest. They can take time to open, so let's start now!

This <color=#338DFF>Chest</color> takes a few minutes to open. You can <color=#338DFF>speed up Chests</color> with <color=#338DFF>Gems</color>! This time it is free!

You can also see and <color=#338DFF>complete tasks</color> here, from your garage or the mansion grounds.

DialogText_MansionDrivewayStatueFinished.value: Grandpa Ignatius hasn't looked so good since they built this place, I bet.
I'm still not happy I'm here, Maddie, but you're doing well. The council must be pleased with your progress so far.
Ignatius Boulton built an empire out of tin cans. He was the first man in America to can goods. And the customers came running.
When I was a kid, I used to think this statue of Ignatius could see you, wherever you were in the gardens.
All good questions! Now give me a moment, I can hear the cat shredding my curtains again. Mingus! Get out of those drapes!
Not likely! Just made it all the more fun. You know, your Grandpa Charlie idolized Ignatius Boulton.
He was the first person in America to can goods. It revolutionized the food industry!
An empire out of tin cans? So what happened? Why is this mansion falling apart? And why did you lock it up behind your garden wall?
Ha! Did it keep you from causing trouble?
Oh well, I guess I can at least go clean up the Garage out of excess items.
You know Grandma, I always thought I was alone in my love of inventing...
A few days ago I didn't even know I had a family legacy, and now I find out I come from a tin can empire?

DialogText_MansionDrivewayStatueRevealed.value: That there is your ancestor, Ignatius Montague Boulton, born on Christmas Day in 1802. He built this mansion.
I lived here, yes, but none of us could really claim it was ours...
Him? That's Ignatius Montague Boulton. He's the one who built this place and made the family fortune.
Hadn't you better get this fixed up for that building inspector of yours? He's kinda cute, ain't he?
Shouldn't you get this fixed up for that building inspector of yours? He's kinda cute, ain't he?
Not that there's been any money for a long time! But he had some. Think he was born in about 1802.
Don't get too used to it. But yeah. I guess I know some ancient history.
Some secrets are best left buried, Maddie. I'm off to bake.
So is this your mansion now?
But Grandma, what does that mean?!
Hey, you DO know stories about the estate! And it's good to hear one.
Great! I want to learn all about Grandpa Charlie, and my parents, and...
She's hiding something! I just wish I knew what it was - and why!

DialogText_MansionDrivewayStatueTaskReve.value: Don't worry about his history right now - worry about his stone can! It's missing!
Find it and I'll tell you, dearie.
I wonder what Ignatius Boulton did to deserve a statue?
There's so much history here, and I don't know any of it!
If he's missing a stone can, I should look for it! But why does he have one?

DialogText_MansionOpen_01.value: PLACEHOLDER if you see this please contact player support

DialogText_MansionRightFillerPoolFinishe.value: Oh my, I just remembered! I pushed your grandfather into that pool once!
You know what I like about True Crime podcasts? You really get some good cleaning tips from them.
Oh, no. It's just that I saw my mother coming. No one knew about Charlie and me back then. He was a poor carpenter's son from the wrong side of town, you see.
It did in those days. We thought if anyone caught us hanging out together, then they'd surely put an end to our courtship. That’s why we never went in the house.
Alright. I think she was based on your Grandpa's grandmother. She went off to work in Europe as a nurse during World War I.
You keep on talking, I’ll be back in a minute. I came out without my reading glasses and can’t hear a word you’re saying!
She made it home safely, and by all accounts helped a lot of people. Her parents built this in honor of her getting home safely.
Speaking of stories, what's the story with you and that Roddy guy?
Huh? Why? Were you mad at him?
Well that's disturbing. Can we talk about this statue instead?
Grandpa Charlie never went inside the mansion?!
Oh my goodness! That's incredible! Was she okay?

DialogText_MansionRightFillerStatueFinis.value: Tinned food was a miraculous invention back then. No one had fridges. Ignatius saw how much demand there was as soon as he sold his first can.
Now I can’t stand here all day gossiping. Mr. Pinkerton will be here soon. He’s taking me for a ride in his jalopy.
I'd be sad too if I had to stand in a pond all day long. Probably would be a bit damp as well.
Well, yeah. I think she's based on a relative of yours. Anyway, gotta go - my favorite True Crime podcast is releasing a new episode today!
That’s a pretty statue. Must have cost a lot. Tell me more about Ignatius and his tin cans.
What a beautiful statue. She looks sort of sad, though.
One can started this whole thing off? How did he turn it into an empire, then?!
A jalopy? Isn’t that some kind of chili pepper?
You know what I mean, Grandma!
Wait, Grandma! I want to know more!

DialogText_Pouch_Intro_01.value:
You can find your rewards in the Pouch, even when your Board is full.
<color=#338DFF>Tap</color> it to get your rewards on the Board.

DialogText_Roddy8_0.value: Hello there! I'm Roddy Took, Building Inspector.

DialogText_Roddy8_00.value: There's someone at the gate. Did we get our first guest already?

DialogText_Roddy8_0_New.value: Hello! I was passing by and, uh, thought I smelled something delicious baking.

DialogText_Roddy8_1.value: This is a wonderful old house you have here, but I’m afraid to say it has to come down.

DialogText_Roddy8_1_New.value: Are you trying to get this old place back in shape? You're brave. I've heard so many strange stories about it.

DialogText_Roddy8_3.value: I’m sorry, but the city's regulations don't allow for dangerous buildings. Health and safety first and foremost.

DialogText_Roddy8_3_New.value: Uh, just silly local tales about the reason for it being so rundown. I didn't mean to make you angry...

DialogText_Roddy8_5.value: Between you and me, I can mark you down as “improving” when I come back if you just tidy up the front here.

DialogText_Roddy8_5_New.value: Ouch! The council here is tough - especially the head of the Infrastructure Committee. She's, uh, pretty scary.

DialogText_Roddy8_6.value: That will buy you some time before the bulldozers move in...

DialogText_Roddy8_6_New.value: Maybe I can help out? I'm an architect, and I know a thing or two about getting homes through the renovation process.

DialogText_Roddy8_8.value: That’s about the size of it, yes.

DialogText_Roddy8_8_New.value: Took - Roddy Took. I've loved the look of this place since I moved into town. I'd hate to see the council rip it down.
Took - Roddy Took. I've loved the look of this place ever since I moved into town. I'd hate to see the council tear it down.

DialogText_SecondRoddyEvent_Maddie_01.value: There's someone in the driveway again. What now?

DialogText_SecondRoddyEvent_Maddie_01_Ne.value: Hi Roddy! What brings you here today?
Hi, Roddy! What brings you here today?

DialogText_SecondRoddyEvent_Maddie_03_Ne.value: Ursula's my Grandma. I don't know about any cake, but it is good to see you again.

DialogText_SecondRoddyEvent_Maddie_05_Ne.value: Yeah, I've been really worried about the council. Do you think I'm doing enough to restore the estate?

DialogText_SecondRoddyEvent_Maddie_07_Ne.value: Thank you. Now that I know about the Boulton estate, I plan to have it forever!

DialogText_SecondRoddyEvent_Roddy_02.value: When I show them at the office what you've done here, they're definitely going to want to see more.

DialogText_SecondRoddyEvent_Roddy_02_New.value: Someone called Ursula emailed me and told me that you had a cake for me?

DialogText_SecondRoddyEvent_Roddy_03.value: But this garage here. It looks ready to fall down. You have to do something about it.

DialogText_SecondRoddyEvent_Roddy_04_New.value: It is?! I'm glad to hear you say that. I can't stop thinking about y--

DialogText_SecondRoddyEvent_Roddy_06_New.value: Oh! Of course! I'm sure you are. The place looks much better already. I'll go there and see if I can dig anything up, though.

DialogText_ThirdRoddyEvent_Maddie_01.value: There's someone in the driveway. I think I know who...

DialogText_ThirdRoddyEvent_Maddie_01_New.value: Roddy! I'm glad you're here. I need to speak to you.

DialogText_ThirdRoddyEvent_Maddie_02.value: Now that you mention it... That's a good idea. It has been a lot of work!

DialogText_ThirdRoddyEvent_Maddie_02_New.value: It's, well, it's because of Ursula. My friend said people there are talking about her 'dangerous past' - and her arrest.

DialogText_ThirdRoddyEvent_Maddie_03.value: Dress to impress, right? Let's get to it, then!

DialogText_ThirdRoddyEvent_Maddie_03_New.value: Uh, just people around town, like you asked me to! Maybe, you know, the police, in case it was missing.

DialogText_ThirdRoddyEvent_Maddie_04_New.value: I see. That gold watch was the reason she was arrested, Roddy.

DialogText_ThirdRoddyEvent_Maddie_05_New.value: Oh no! Maddie, you must know I never meant anything bad to happen to her.

DialogText_ThirdRoddyEvent_Maddie_06_New.value: I think... I think you should leave, Roddy. Sorry.

DialogText_ThirdRoddyEvent_Roddy_01.value: I can see you’ve been very busy! But the more you clear, the more I can see that this place is enormous! Have you thought about calling in some help?

DialogText_ThirdRoddyEvent_Roddy_01_New.value: I need to speak to you too! I was talking to my friend in the local council earlier, and I have some bad news.

DialogText_ThirdRoddyEvent_Roddy_02.value: Anyway, one of the members of the city planning committee drives by here every day on the way into work. That’s why I’m here.

DialogText_ThirdRoddyEvent_Roddy_02_New.value: I got the impression they'll be out to get you because of everything that happened.

DialogText_ThirdRoddyEvent_Roddy_03.value: You see how it’s all overgrown behind your garage? That’s what she sees every day. You should think about tidying up over there, and soon!

DialogText_ThirdRoddyEvent_Roddy_03_New.value: Yeah, about the arrest - who exactly did you show the photo of the gold watch to?

DialogText_TinCan_SinkTutorial1.value: Drag this Number on top of the Wood Chipper to start production.

DialogText_Valentine2022_Door_Tutorial_M.value: Wow, this is not an ordinary gate! What’s behind it…

DialogText_WaterGardenStatueFinished_Gra.value: I first met Grandpa Charlie right here beneath this frog.
I was knitting a balaclava and couldn't stop thinking about this old frog statue.
He climbed the wall right there and came and sat down next to me by the edge of the pool.
I was so surprised to see his head appear over the top of the wall, I didn’t know what to say!
Other people wear them too. Anyway, listen - your Dad did get this for your Mom. Sorry I didn't tell you before.
It was like a fairy tale. He was my very own frog prince...
When Becky was a kid, visiting the estate, she really loved coming to play in the frog pond.
Michael used to say that when she first kissed him he turned from a frog into a handsome prince.

DialogText_WaterGardenStatueFinished_Mad.value: You met him in the garden?
... don't you have a pie in the oven or something?
A balaclava? You mean those masks that robbers use?!
Aww, Grandma. Thanks for telling me! It feels so good to hear about them both.

DialogText_WaterGardenStatueRevealed_Gra.value: My grandfather said it came from Japan, a gift to Ignatius.
We used to kiss it under the chin for good luck. I bet if you climb up there, you can see where we kissed it.
Now, don't go reading that. It's not important.
Oh, that question of yours. Can this wait? I have a pecan pie on a cooling rack.
I asked you not to read it, didn't I?
Whoops! I've gotta run. My online knitting club starts in a few minutes!

DialogText_WaterGardenStatueRevealed_Mad.value: Is that a giant frog?! Hey, there's an engraving on it. Let's see what it says...
Who would send him gifts from that far away?!
She is so trying to avoid my questions...
But it's my mom and dad! Look, I don't know why you never speak about them, but I really want to know--

DialogText_Xmas2021_Ladder_Tutorial_Madd.value: A Ladder?! Where do those lead...

Dialogue_BBQArea_Intro_01.value: You wanted to see me, Grandma? What's going on?

Dialogue_BBQArea_Intro_02.value: Is this about your arrest?! Are you ready to talk about it?

Dialogue_BBQArea_Intro_03.value: Uh, no. I just want to tell you some things about your family before it's too late.

Dialogue_BBQArea_Intro_05.value: Never you mind. But you see this place? Years ago it was just an empty wasteland.

Dialogue_BBQArea_Intro_06.value: Your grandfather turned it into a BBQ area for me as a gift on our tenth wedding anniversary.

Dialogue_BBQArea_Intro_07.value: We hosted a big BBQ party here then. Everyone we knew was present. Just like when we got married ten years earlier.

Dialogue_BBQArea_Intro_08.value: Well, we should fix it up! I promise that I'll make it look beautiful for you.

Dialogue_BBQArea_Outro_01.value: Maddie, you've outdone yourself! It's as if you've turned back time.

Dialogue_BBQArea_Outro_02.value: I'm glad you like it. Will you tell me something else about Grandpa Charlie?

Dialogue_BBQArea_Outro_03.value: He was a real romantic, giving me flowers, taking me out to the movies.

Dialogue_BBQArea_Outro_04.value: But then I lost him, and I've spent years missing him.

Dialogue_BBQArea_Outro_05.value: I'm sorry, Grandma. Did your arrest have anything to do with him?

Dialogue_BBQArea_Outro_06.value: I don't want to talk about that! Just... let's get back to gardening and forget it.

Dialogue_Charlie_Calling_01.value: This whole family estate is so amazing...

Dialogue_Charlie_Calling_02.value: Too bad I don't have anyone left to share it with.

Dialogue_Charlie_Calling_Outro_01.value: Uh, Grandma - I got a phone call earlier from someone claiming that they were Grandpa Charlie...

Dialogue_Charlie_Calling_Outro_02.value: Do you know who that could be?

Dialogue_Charlie_Calling_Outro_03.value: I don't want to talk about it, Maddie!

Dialogue_Charlie_Calling_Outro_04.value: Now, what else should we do here?

Dialogue_Fortress_Intro_01.value: I wish I understood why that old gold watch was so important.

Dialogue_Fortress_Intro_02.value: Why did the police use it as a reason to arrest Grandma?

Dialogue_Fortress_Intro_04.value: And I don't know who to trust anymore.

Dialogue_Fortress_Intro_05.value: I can't stop working on the estate, though.

Dialogue_Fortress_Intro_06.value: I won't lose it to the local council! I just won't!

Dialogue_Fortress_Outro_01.value: It's nice that I come from a long line of inventors.

Dialogue_Fortress_Outro_02.value: But I wonder how many of them were arrested...

Dialogue_Jailbail_intro_1.value: Julius, you told me that there might be something we can do to help grandma get out of jail. What was it?

Dialogue_Jailbail_intro_10.value: I'm sensing that Julius too has some dark secrets in his past...

Dialogue_Jailbail_intro_2.value: Unfortunately, there's not much we can do to prove her innocence. I guess she needs to do that herself.

Dialogue_Jailbail_intro_3.value: So all we can do is just wait? There must be something! Julius, think! Didn't you used to be a lawyer, can't you think of something?

Dialogue_Jailbail_intro_4.value: Well, we can bail her out. I just need to call the Bail Bondsman to make sure they will allow it.

Dialogue_Jailbail_intro_5.value: Yes! Let's do that! Once she's out she can help us proving her innocence. Thank you, Julius! I'm so happy you have your dark history as a lawyer.

Dialogue_Jailbail_intro_7.value: What do you mean? I was only joking.

Dialogue_Jailbail_intro_8.value: Umm... Eh. Nothing. Let's just get Ursula out of jail. Gives me the creeps just thinking about her in there all alone.

Dialogue_Jailbail_intro_9.value: I'll go and make the call right now.

Dialogue_JapaneseGarden_Intro_03.value: Uh, no. I just want to tell you some things about your family before it's too late.

Dialogue_JapaneseGarden_Intro_05.value: Never you mind. But you see this place? Years ago it was a beautiful garden, inspired by Japan.

Dialogue_JapaneseGarden_Intro_06.value: Your grandfather designed it for me as a gift on our tenth wedding anniversary.

Dialogue_JapaneseGarden_Intro_07.value: We spent part of our honeymoon in Japan, you see, and I fell in love with the gardens there.

Dialogue_JapaneseGarden_Intro_08.value: Well, we should fix it up! I promise that I'll make it look beautiful for you.

Dialogue_JapaniseGarden_Jackie_Intro_01.value: I still can't believe the police arrested Grandma. I wonder what evidence they have against her...

Dialogue_JapaniseGarden_Jackie_Intro_02.value: And what exactly did she mean by that weird note on her hand? "He is alive" Who is alive?

Dialogue_JapaniseGarden_Jackie_Intro_03.value: Since Grandma won't talk to me about it, I should get on with things here.

Dialogue_JapaniseGarden_Jackie_Intro_04.value: Besides, I could use a place meant for contemplation.

Dialogue_JapaniseGarden_Jackie_Intro_05.value: Wow, I really like what you've done with the grounds... Maddie, right? Maddie Boulton?

Dialogue_JapaniseGarden_Jackie_Intro_06.value: Thank you? Yes, I'm Maddie Boulton. And you are?

Dialogue_JapaniseGarden_Jackie_Intro_07.value: Jackie Martin, reporter for the Hopewell Bay Times. I'd like to ask you a few questions about your grandmother.

Dialogue_JapaniseGarden_Jackie_Intro_08.value: I know she was held for questioning due to new evidence that has surfaced in a cold case, and--

Dialogue_JapaniseGarden_Jackie_Intro_09.value: Wait, what case? What evidence? What do you know?

Dialogue_JapaniseGarden_Jackie_Intro_10.value: That's what I want to ask you about. A friend on the force mentioned something about a gold watch...

Dialogue_JapaniseGarden_Jackie_Intro_11.value: I'm sorry, but I can't answer your questions. I'd like you to leave, please.

Dialogue_JapaniseGarden_Jackie_Intro_12.value: All right, but I can give you a chance to tell your story. I'll leave you my card.

Dialogue_JapaniseGarden_Rufus_Intro_1.value: Rufus! Rufus, come home! I've got your dinner ready for you!

Dialogue_JapaniseGarden_Rufus_Intro_2.value: Well that's odd... you don't look hungry at all. Did you eat something already??

Dialogue_JapaniseGarden_Rufus_Intro_3.value: Wait a minute! Did Grandma give you treats again? I'd ask her, but I know she won't tell me anything - as always!

Dialogue_Maze_ConcreteMixer_01.value: Uh oh, it looks like I'll need some new tools to be able to fix this part of the yard...

Dialogue_Maze_ConcreteMixer_02.value: Luckily I could borrow this concrete mixer.

Dialogue_Maze_ConcreteMixer_03.value: I must remember to return it once I'm done here.

Dialogue_Maze_ConcreteMixer_Return_01.value: Good bye trusty old concrete mixer. You served me well.

Dialogue_Maze_ConcreteMixer_Return_02.value: Why does letting go of things feel always so hard...

Dialogue_Maze_Intro_01.value: Ew, those webs are so sticky!

Dialogue_Maze_Intro_02.value: Never mind the webs! Is that a... spider? They're, um, really not my thing.

Dialogue_Maze_Intro_03.value: I guess that's why you've been more of an observer on this set of tasks.

Dialogue_Maze_Intro_04.value: I prefer to think of it as advisor. But... I have an appointment to get to. I'll see you later!

Dialogue_Plaza_MaddieDog_01.value: Oh, Rufus. Things aren't looking too good around here right now.

Dialogue_Plaza_MaddieDog_03.value: Grandma always kept secrets, but I don't believe she'd do anything bad enough to get arrested for...

Dialogue_Plaza_MaddieDog_04.value: I know she wants to keep the details of her arrest to herself, but I think I need to find out more about it.

Dialogue_Plaza_MaddieDog_06.value: I'll take that as encouragement! Okay, Rufus, let's help Grandma - whether she wants us to, or not.

Dialogue_Plaza_MaddieJulius_01.value: Things might be bad with Grandma, but at least the mansion grounds are looking better.

Dialogue_Plaza_MaddieJulius_02.value: I wonder if it'll be enough to satisfy the local council?

Dialogue_Plaza_MaddieJulius_04.value: I heard about her arrest, and wondered if I could be of any help to her.

Dialogue_Plaza_MaddieJulius_05.value: Even if you can, I'm not sure she'll want help. She's refusing to talk to me about any of it!

Dialogue_Plaza_MaddieJulius_06.value: I wish I knew what was going on with her. She's always been secretive, but this?!

Dialogue_Plaza_MaddieJulius_07.value: I'm sure she'll have a good reason for her secrets.

Dialogue_Plaza_MaddieJulius_08.value: She's still your grandmother - whatever happened here. She's the same Ursula you've always known...

Dialogue_Plaza_MaddieJulius_09.value: He's right! I shouldn't give up on her. This arrest has to be a mistake!

Dialogue_PoolHouse_intro_01.value: Roddy, what do you think about this pool house? I'm considering making it into a party area.
I've been thinking about turning this old pool house into a party area!

Dialogue_PoolHouse_intro_02.value: You mean your grandmother's ready to open up the place to guests?
That sounds amazing! You're doing great things around here, Maddie.

Dialogue_PoolHouse_intro_03.value: Well, not exactly... But maybe I can convince her?
I'm not sure Grandma agrees with you.

Dialogue_PoolHouse_intro_04.value: I wish Grandma hadn't kept this whole place a secret so long. And I wish she'd open it up now.
She kept this place a secret for so long, and although she agreed to stay here with me, she doesn't seem happy about it.

Dialogue_PoolHouse_intro_05.value: Have you tried telling her what you told me, about feeling lonely as a child? She might understand...
Have you tried telling her what you told me, about feeling lonely as a child? She might understand.

Dialogue_PoolHouse_intro_06.value: You know, Roddy? You're right––I probably should have a heart-to-heart with her.
Do you think so? We've never really had a heart-to-heart, Grandma and I...

Dialogue_PoolHouse_intro_07.value: Sounds like a plan. I've got to get back to work, but good luck with Ursula, Maddie.
I don't know why she's kept secrets from you, Maddie, but it's obvious that she loves you.

Dialogue_PoolHouse_intro_08.value: I'm sure if you talk to her she'll open up - and maybe even serve you some of that delicious pie of hers!

Dialogue_PoolHouse_intro_09.value: Now is as good a time as any. I need to find my grandmother so we can have a talk...
I can only hope! Thanks, Roddy. You've inspired me.

Dialogue_PoolHouse_intro_10.value: There's no time like the present - I'm going to go and find Grandma now so I can talk to her!

Dialogue_PoolHouse_intro_11.value: Wait. Do I hear... Sirens? Yes - definitely sirens. But why are they coming closer and closer?

Dialogue_PoolHouse_outro_01.value: So, what's been going on here?

Dialogue_PoolHouse_outro_02.value: What do you mean, what's been going on?! Grandma, I just had to bail you out of the police station!
What do you mean? What's going on?! Grandma, I just had to bail you out of jail!

Dialogue_PoolHouse_outro_03.value: Seeing the place restored to its former glory really takes me back...
What happened? Why were you arrested?!

Dialogue_PoolHouse_outro_04.value: I was sure I would be the one to woo Ursula, but that Charlie...
I don't want to talk about it.

Dialogue_PoolHouse_outro_05.value: He just came in and swept her off her feet.
But I'll tell you this - someone betrayed your trust, Maddie.

Dialogue_PoolHouse_outro_06.value: But the truth is, I never stopped loving her...

Dialogue_Pool_Intro_01.value: I'm going to have to use all my skills to fix up this old pool system!

Dialogue_Pool_Intro_02.value: I have every confidence in your abilities, Maddie.

Dialogue_Pool_Intro_03.value: Thanks, Roddy! Were you able to ask people about that gold watch I found?

Dialogue_Pool_Intro_04.value: I was! A few of the older residents said they recognised it but nobody knew who it belonged to.

Dialogue_Pool_Intro_05.value: Your Grandma seemed upset about the watch, though. Is she okay?

Dialogue_Pool_Intro_06.value: I think so. She just, you know, keeps a lot of secrets.

Dialogue_Pool_Intro_07.value: She did a great job raising me after my parents died, but I was lonely as a kid.

Dialogue_Pool_Intro_08.value: Coming back here means I'm surrounded by family history - and I don't know any of it! I wish she'd tell me more.

Dialogue_Pool_Intro_09.value: I get it, Maddie. And I don't ever want you to feel lonely again. I mean... Umm. You know.

Dialogue_Pool_Intro_10.value: Thanks Roddy! You're such a good friend.

Dialogue_Pool_Outro_Maddie_06_New.value: You might have to fight for that relationship, Roddy!

Dialogue_Pool_Outro_Maddie_10_New.value: They said that while they can see you're doing good stuff, apparently you've not done enough yet.

Dialogue_Pool_Outro_Roddie_11_New.value: That's not a surprise! At least they can see I'm doing good things here. Thanks, Roddy.

Dialogue_Pool_Outro_Roddie_12_New.value: You're welcome! I couldn't help much with the gold watch, but at least I can keep you updated on the council.

Dialogue_Pool_Outro_Roddy_04_New.value: Easy there, killer. I just want to be friends.

Dialogue_Pool_Outro_Roddy_07_New.value: Some relationships are worth fighting for.

Dialogue_Pool_Outro_Roddy_09_New.value: I, uh, actually came by to let you know something. I spoke to a friend on the town council earlier...

Dialogue_fortress_unlock.value: I should fix this place next.

Dialogue_garage_unlock.value: After this incident, it feels like I should check what's inside the Garage.

Dialogue_japanesegarden_unlock.value: I wonder what I might find from this direction after I've completed the Pool House Patio.

Dialogue_maze_unlock.value: After my current tasks are done, this looks like a direction I should continue next

Dialogue_old_well_discovery.value: It seems to be coming from here... Oh, no! The dog's stuck in the well!
It's definitely a dog - and it's coming from this old well! I'd better help the poor thing out.

Dialogue_old_well_discovery_Maddie_New.value: It's definitely a dog - and it's coming from this old well! I'd better help the poor thing out.

Dialogue_old_well_intro.value: Why do I hear barking? We don't have a dog... And this one sounds like it's in a tunnel!
What's that noise? It sounds like a dog - but I can't see one around. I'd better investigate.

Dialogue_old_well_intro_Maddie_New.value: What's that noise? It sounds like a dog - but I can't see one around. I'd better investigate.

Dialogue_old_well_rescue_02.value: You don't look like you belong to anyone... Hmm... No collar or tag.
Hello boy! Do you have a name? I don't see a collar or tag on you.

Dialogue_old_well_rescue_03.value: Well, I've always wanted a dog... I guess I'll call you Rufus!
Huh. I guess you don't have an owner. Would you like to join me here? And can I call you Rufus?

Dialogue_old_well_rescue_04.value: Oo, a little dog! And you named it Rufus! How cute. As long as you don't eat my pies, we'll get along just fine.

Dialogue_old_well_rescue_05.value: I don't think dogs eat pies, Grandma.
Rufus, was it? Well, I suppose there's room here for another family member - as long as he doesn't dig anything up.

Dialogue_old_well_rescue_06.value: Yeah, well, guilty until proven innocent, if you ask me.

Dialogue_old_well_rescue_07.value: I hope not. He's cute, but I don't want him... disturbing anything.

Dialogue_old_well_rescue_Maddie_02_New.value: Hello boy! Do you have a name? I don't see a collar or tag on you.

Dialogue_old_well_rescue_Maddie_03_New.value: Huh. I guess you don't have an owner. Would you like to join me here? And can I call you Rufus?

Dialogue_old_well_rescue_Ursula_05_New.value: Rufus, was it? Well, I suppose there's room here for another family member - as long as he doesn't dig anything up.

Dialogue_old_well_rescue_Ursula_07_New.value: I hope not. He's cute, but I don't want him... disturbing things.

Dialogue_oldwell_Intro_goldwatch_Maddie_.value: I found this gold watch in the garage, and wanted to find out who it belonged to. Can you ask around?
I'd do it myself but I'm so busy here, and I don't want to take any time off in case the council comes calling!
Oh, hi Grandma! Roddy's going to ask people in town if they lost the gold watch I found.
Why shouldn't I? Is there something about this watch that you want to tell me?
She's definitely up to something. It makes me even more determined to find out who the watch belongs to!

Dialogue_oldwell_Intro_goldwatch_Roddy_0.value: Hey Maddie, I got your message. What can I do?
Of course! I'll take a photo of it and ask around in Hopewell Bay for you. We'll find the owner of the watch.

Dialogue_oldwell_Intro_goldwatch_Ursula_.value: I thought I told you to trash the thing? Why are you showing it to Roddy?
No, no. Just take my advice. You should throw it in the garbage and forget about it.

Dialogue_oldwell_unlock.value: Looks like I should investigate this area next after I'm ready with the Garage.

Dialogue_plaza_unlock.value: After my current tasks are done, this looks like a direction I should continue next

Dialogue_sideentrance_unlock.value: This is where I should head next...after this beach is done.

Dialogue_yachtpier_unlock.value: What secrets are there to be found from this direction...

DiningRoom02_01.value: I see your endeavors to reclaim the grandeur of your past home have come to a head, Ma'am.

DiningRoom02_02.value: While your efforts in restoring the other rooms are admirable, I honestly believe that this room is a lost cause...

DiningRoom02_03.value: No one will EVER be visiting Beaumont Hall again!

DiningRoom02_05.value: He means, the wonderful old days of this mansion holding amazing dinner parties are over.

DiningRoom03_03.value: Tell me more about these dinner parties.

DiningRoom03_04.value: Oh, sweetie! Some of the most influential people used to dine within these very walls!

DiningRoom03_06.value: Hmph! Ignore the old buffoon, Maddie. He's just bitter he can't serve the president like he used to.

DiningRoom03_08.value: Oh yes, sweetie! I'm sure you'll find some trinkets from then amongst this trash. It seems as if Winston here hasn't bothered to clean up.

DiningRoom03_09.value: I beg your pardon, Debbie, but while you were gallivanting across Europe and who knows where...

DiningRoom03_10.value: I have been doing MY best to take care of "YOUR" legacy!

DiningRoom03_13.value: My apologies Ma'am. I let my emotions get the better of me. Please, if you'd excuse me...

DiningRoom04_01.value: What was all that about, Grandma? Why were those two fighting?

DiningRoom04_02.value: Oh, you know my sister can be a bit "much" sometimes!

DiningRoom04_03.value: No, this seems personal. Does Winston have a grudge against her?

DiningRoom04_06.value: Dearie... I know you'll eventually find out even if I don't tell you. So, yes, he does.

DiningRoom04_07.value: *Sigh* He believes that your aunt Deb does not belong in the family.

DiningRoom05_01.value: Hi Maddie, Winston let me in and... Wait, is everything okay? You look upset.
Hi, Maddie, Winston let me in and... wait, is everything okay? You look upset.

DiningRoom05_02.value: Hi, Roddy. I... I guess not.

DiningRoom05_03.value: It's this Mansion. Ever since I've opened it, in hopes to clear Grandma's name, I've been learning... things.

DiningRoom05_05.value: Things about my family that are beginning to make me understand why Grandma kept them secret from me, for all these years.

DiningRoom05_06.value: I see... Well, I'll let you in on something; EVERY family has secrets, even mine.

DiningRoom05_07.value: Haha! Oh, Roddy!! Thank you, but I don't think our secrets can even compare.

DiningRoom06_01.value: I find it hard to believe that a president was within these very walls!

DiningRoom06_02.value: Not just any president; Abraham Lincoln was here!

DiningRoom06_03.value: He stopped in Hopewell Bay when he was on tour.

DiningRoom06_04.value: The Boultons entertained him for an evening, and he even stayed in this house overnight!

DiningRoom06_05.value: That's amazing! I wonder what they talked about, over dinner, that night?

DiningRoom06_06.value: We'll never know, but it's nice to imagine!

DiningRoom07_02.value: It's a knife! And there's something on it!

DiningRoom07_05.value: Knowing your Grandma, it's probably jelly or berries!

DiningRoom07_06.value: I hope so! Because if not, this could be more evidence against her...

DiningRoomIntro_01.value: This place is stunning! So much gold and glitz... underneath all the dust and grime, that is.

DiningRoomIntro_02.value: Good thing no food was left out, or this place would be overrun with rats.

DiningRoomIntro_03.value: Eek! I spoke too soon, I think I just saw one in the corner!

Dining_Piano_Ftue1_01.value: Hmm, this piano is quite out of tune. Tap on the piano to try and tune it!

Dining_Piano_Ftue2_01.value: Drag and drop the Metronome on the piano to activate it!

Dining_Piano_Ftue3_01.value: Tap on the piano to tune it when the pendulum is not at the center to produce pure notes.

Dining_Piano_Ftue3_02.value: Note that if you tap on the piano when the pendulum is at the center, your piano will produce bad notes.

Dining_Piano_Ftue5_01.value: Fantastic job! You're getting the hang of it!

DogAreaFeelGood1_01.value: You know, it's been really nice to have a pet, Rufus.

DogAreaFeelGood1_03.value: I always wanted a dog, but Grandma never let me. I never found out why that was.

DogAreaFeelGood1_04.value: I guess it doesn't matter - because you're here now!

DogAreaFeelGood2_01.value: Rufus, when I was a little girl I used to think I could speak dog!

DogAreaFeelGood2_02.value: I wonder if I can speak dog now if I really try? Go on, say something Rufus!

DogAreaFeelGood2_05.value: And I guess I can't speak dog at all.

DogAreaIntro_01.value: Rufus, you have way too much energy, don't you? You little fur ball... I won't get much done around here with you "helping" me.

DogAreaIntro_02.value: I need to occupy you with something... Maybe a playground would work!

DogAreaIntro_04.value: I can see you like the idea! Let's build you a nice big playground.

DogAreaIntro_06.value: I definitely need a new tool to help me out here!

DogAreaOutro_01.value: I'm not sure if you can read but look over here Rufus! I set up a sign with your name on it!

DogAreaOutro_03.value: I know, right? Nice touch, don't you think little buddy. Now everyone can see who's the real boss here.

DogAreaOutro_06.value: The place looks great. Now you can keep yourself busy playing here.

DogAreaOutro_08.value: The only thing I still need to do is give the table saw back.

DogAreaOutro_09.value: Thank you table saw! This would have been so much harder without you.

DogAreaOutro_10.value: We came, we saw, we helped a dog!

DogAreaReceiveSaw_01.value: A table saw will be perfect for the job.

DogAreaReceiveSaw_02.value: Ahh, yes. This is a cutting edge invention!

EP1_1StActivationOfTheStorageRoom_01.value: Hold it! I thought I told you that you couldn’t-

EP1_1StActivationOfTheStorageRoom_02.value: Come in without a cart? I know that, dearie, so here it is! All ready for the Storage Room!

EP1_1StTimeGraceIsTired_02.value: Oooh boy, I’m calling it a night, Grandma!

EP1_1StTimeGraceIsTired_03.value: I’ll head back to our cell...

EP1_1StTimeGrandmaIsTired_02.value: I think it’s time for me to get a little shut eye in my cell...

EP1_1StTrashBagAppears_03.value: It uh... It has some ‘other’ stuff inside, if you know what I mean. I’ll let you handle them now.

EP1_1StTrashBagAppears_04.value: But in the future, it might be a good idea if you let ME handle them.

EP1_AfterAFewTasksWorkingAlone_01.value: I've spent some time learning about the jail. Key players and routines...

EP1_AfterAFewTasksWorkingAlone_02.value: I think I've I've come up with a good enough plan that should get me out of here and back to Maddie, before she gets into trouble.

EP1_AfterAFewTasksWorkingAlone_03.value: Step 1. I need to make a name for myself. Which in turn means I need to make friends. I'll start with my cell mate, Grace Martin.

EP1_BluetoothEscapesDialogue_02.value: Well, dearie, I know you said you were willing to wait to get out of here, but what if I told you there was a faster way?

EP1_BluetoothEscapesDialogue_04.value: Then, this might sound a little strange, but... I'll need you to climb into the dummy.

EP1_Cafeteria_01.value: Eerily quiet... But I should still be able to avoid the guards for now...

EP1_Cafeteria_02.value: But I'm sure a lot of food would liven up the place!
I’m sure a lot of food would liven up the place, however!

EP1_DiscoveryOfJournal_02.value: It's a journal... Grandma's journal! Some pages seem to be ripped out... Wait...
This looks like Grandma’s journal! Hmm... Some pages seem to be ripped out...

EP1_DiscoveryOfPages_02.value: I need to find out what she was doing in there!
I need to find out more!

EP1_DropingGraceIdOnTrashBag_01.value: Grandma c’mere. I think I trust you enough to show you something.

EP1_DropingGraceIdOnTrashBag_03.value: Shhh... Okay, you know these trash bags we collect? Well, they serve another purpose.

EP1_DropingGraceIdOnTrashBag_04.value: The Warden is a tough brute, and he doesn’t allow almost anything in here. So we’ve taken it upon ourselves to bring in some more...

EP1_DropingGraceIdOnTrashBag_06.value: Thank you, dearie! These will really come in handy!

EP1_EventPopUp(NonDialogue)_01.value: Maddie has found Grandma's secret journal of her time in jail! Join Maddie as she dives into the past and learns about Grandma's time in jail.
Maddie has found Grandma's secret journal! Discover the unknown truth of Grandma's time in Jail!

EP1_Factory_01.value: I'm sure this place will be busy when they have some scrap metal to work with.
I’m sure this place will be busy when they have some scrap metal to work with.

EP1_GraceEscapesDialogue_01.value: Hi, Grandma! So what was so urgent to get me out of work?

EP1_GraceEscapesDialogue_02.value: Well, dearie, I'll be blunt. Do you want to get out of here?

EP1_GraceEscapesDialogue_04.value: Well, then there's no time to explain. Just follow my instructions and... maybe hold your breath?

EP1_GrandmaCellInOperationJailbreak_01.value: Wonderful, our cell is nice and clean for the day!

EP1_GrandmaCellInOperationJailbreak_02.value: You know, I’ve never seen it like this before. It’s down right homely!

EP1_GrandmaEscapesDialogue_01.value: I don't have time to wait here and see if I get bailed out...

EP1_GrandmaEscapesDialogue_02.value: I need to make my escape while I still have the chance!

EP1_GrandmaGetsThePie_01.value: Hmm, something smells tasty in here... What could it be?

EP1_GrandmaGetsThePie_03.value: Note: Here is the pie that you ordered. Enjoy.

EP1_GrandmaStartsKnitting_01.value: Knitting always calms me down, even in jail.

EP1_GrandmaStartsKnitting_02.value: What should I make? Some socks? Or a scarf, perhaps?

EP1_GrandmasCellInOperationJailbreak_01.value: Wonderful, our cell is nice and clean for the day!

EP1_GrandmasCellInOperationJailbreak_02.value: You know, I've never seen it like this before. It's down right homely!

EP1_Grandmatask1_01.value: I’ve spent some time learning about the jail. Important people and guard routines. This’ll help me formulate an escape plan...

EP1_Grandmatask2_01.value: Alright, I think I’ve come up with a good enough escape plan.

EP1_Grandmatask3_01.value: It won’t be easy and a lot can go wrong. But it’s nothing I haven’t handled before.

EP1_Grandmatask3_02.value: Step 1. Make friends among the cellblock population and guards. I’ll need allies in order to enact my plan and get the items I need to escape.

EP1_Grandmatask3_03.value: Step 2. I’ve discovered four key locations I need access to. The storage room, the cafeteria, the recycling room, and the library.

EP1_Grandmatask3_04.value: Step 3. Create a decoy. With the items I can get from each location and with the help of my allies, I’ll make a convincing decoy of myself.

EP1_Grandmatask3_05.value: Step 4. Create a distraction. I’ll need to create a distraction in the cafeteria to help me escape.

EP1_Grandmatask3_06.value: Step 5. Escape during the hustle and bustle of the distraction.

EP1_Grandmatask3_07.value: So let’s start with my cellmate, Grace. She seems to know her way around this place!

EP1_IzzyEscapesDialogue_01.value: Hello, Izzy! I hope I'm not intruding...

EP1_IzzyEscapesDialogue_02.value: No... It's okay. I was just seeing if I could make a calendar to see how many days I might have left.

EP1_IzzyEscapesDialogue_03.value: Well... What if I told you that the number would be zero?

EP1_IzzyEscapesDialogue_04.value: What? What do you mean by that?

EP1_IzzyHelpGrandmaToOpenSafeCode_01.value: While being locked in my solitary cell, I saw some weird number repeated many times in the corner.

EP1_IzzyHelpGrandmaToOpenSafeCode_02.value: I always wondered if they were numbers to a safe!

EP1_JailboardIntro_03.value: I've decided to keep a journal to pass the time while I sort this mess out.
I’ve decided to keep a journal to pass the time while I sort this mess out.

EP1_JailboardIntro_04.value: It's not so bad. Not like prison anyway. Those places are quite dreadful. It's more like a boarding school... Where everyone has detention.
It’s not so bad. Not like prison, anyway. Those places are quite dreadful. It’s more like a boarding school... Where everyone has detention.

EP1_JailboardIntro_05.value: So far I've been spending my time keeping to myself and cleaning my cell. It's a lonely job, but it will give me time to come up with a plan.
So far, I’ve taken the job as a cleaner. It’s lonely work, but it’ll give me time to come up with a plan and learn a bit more about this jail.

EP1_JailboardIntro_06.value: No matter how lovely things are in here, I have to leave. I need to get back to Maddie before she gets herself into trouble!
No matter how lovely things are in here, I have to leave. I need to get back to Maddie before she gets herself into trouble!

EP1_JailboardIntro_07.value: So, it's time to enact my little escape plan. I've already learned everyone's routines and potential weaknesses...
So, it's time to enact my little escape plan. I've already learned everyone's routines and potential weaknesses...

EP1_JailboardIntro_08.value: That means I now have to make a reputation for myself. I'll start with befriending my cellmate!
That means I now have to make a reputation for myself. I'll start with befriending my cellmate!

EP1_KnittingNeedleToOpenWardenOffice_01.value: Knitting is a great hobby to have! For example, one can knit open the lock... like this!

EP1_Library_01.value: Never underestimate a good library. They often contain more information than just books...

EP1_P1BiographyPopUp(NonDialogue)_01.value: Grace Martin - Doing time for theft of government property. She claims she was framed after she did a report on a city official. She knows her way around the jail and seems friendly enough.

EP1_P1Complete_01.value: I'm impressed! And that's a hard thing to do, Ur- Grandma!
I’m impressed! And that’s a hard thing to do, Ur- Grandma!

EP1_P1Complete_02.value: It was nothing, dearie! I always felt so guilty, when I saw you doing everything yourself.
It was nothing, dearie! I always felt so guilty when I saw you doing everything yourself.

EP1_P1Complete_03.value: I really appreciate it as well! Tell you what... As a thank you, I'll introduce you to some of my friends in here.
I really appreciate it as well! Tell you what... As a thank you, I’ll stick around and help you out!

EP1_P1Complete_04.value: It's always a good idea to make some friends among the population.
It’s always nice to have some company...

EP1_P1Complete_06.value: Ha! Intruding?! In here? Heaven's forbid!
Ha! Oh dearie, you are more than welcome!

EP1_P1GangUnlock_02.value: Grace and I have become fast friends. She told me about her sister who is a reporter and how she herself was one too, before being wrongfully imprissoned...
Grace and I have become fast friends. She told me about her sister who is a reporter and how she herself was one too, before being wrongfully arrested...

EP1_P1GangUnlock_03.value: I must admit... I feel sorry for her. She is a wonderful person, and this is definitely NOT a place for her.

EP1_P1GangUnlock_04.value: Thankfully, she has now introduced me to the more... Colorful members of this encarcerated society.
Thankfully, she has now introduced me to the more... Interesting members of this incarcerated society.

EP1_P1GangUnlock_05.value: Grace has also put in a good word for me with the guards. This should help me expand my plans even further...
This will help me gather the people I need for ‘OPERATION JAILBREAK’ and get me out of here...

EP1_P1GangUnlock_06.value: For now, I've been give the task to take this cleaner cart to the storage room, where a "Kitty" Palmer will be waiting for me.
Next, I should get enough respect so that I can barter my way to a cart that I can use to get into the Storage Room.

EP1_P1GangUnlock_07.value: I might have more work there!
I should also meet a “Kitty” Palmer, who works there. Perhaps she can help me get further access to this awful place.

EP1_P1IdPositive_01.value: Hey! Thanks for helping out with this! I really appreciate it!

EP1_P1IdPositive_02.value: Not a problem, dearie! I've got this handled.
Not a problem, dearie! I’ve got this handled.

EP1_P1Intro_03.value: I just wanted to apologize for my recent behavior. I'm usually quite social you know!
I just wanted to apologize for my recent behavior. I’m usually quite social, you know!

EP1_P1Intro_04.value: First time, huh? I get it. Don't worry about it.
First time, huh? I get it. Don’t worry about it.

EP1_P1Intro_05.value: Please! Let me make it right, dearie. I see you all day cleaning our cell and the others all by yourself.
Please! Let me make it right, dearie. I see you all day cleaning our cell and the others all by yourself.

EP1_P1Intro_07.value: Alright then... Try and keep up!
Alright then... try to keep up!

EP1_P1TaskA_01.value: The cells need to be in tip top shape before lunch. Remember to change the sheets and get rid of any trash.
The cells need to be in tip-top shape before lunch. Remember to change the sheets and get rid of any trash.

EP1_P1TaskA_02.value: And if you find anything... Let me know. We don't want to be making any enemies here!
And if you find anything... Unusual... Let me know. We don’t want to be making any enemies here!

EP1_P1TaskA_03.value: Don't worry dearie, this is far easier to clean, than a mansion.
Don’t worry dearie, this is far easier to clean than a mansion.

EP1_P1TaskB_03.value: But we still got a lot to do, but now I see that you can handle yourself. So...

EP1_P1TaskB_05.value: Please, call me Grandma! Everyone does.
Please, call me Grandma! Everyone does.

EP1_P2Complete_01.value: Whoo boy, you sure know how to hande the storage room!
Whoo boy, you sure know how to handle the storage room!

EP1_P2Complete_02.value: Are you sure you've never done this before?
Are you sure you’ve never done this before?

EP1_P2Complete_03.value: Anyway, most of the food is ready to be served for lunch now!

EP1_P2Complete_04.value: Why don't you take this cart to Mama? I'm sure she'll need someone like you to help her around!
Why don’t you take this cart to Mama? I’m sure she’ll need someone like you to help her around!

EP1_P2GangUnlock_02.value: Kitty is a talkative one. But that's usually a gift in disguise. She's got the scoop on everyone in jail. Including the warden and guards.
Kitty is a talkative one. But that’s usually a gift in disguise. She’s got the scoop on everyone in jail. Including the warden and guards.

EP1_P2GangUnlock_03.value: This may prove useful for my plans of escape. But I still need to make a few more key friendships if I'm to get out of here.
This may prove useful for my plans of escape. But I still need to make a few more key friendships if I’m to get out of here.

EP1_P2GangUnlock_04.value: Next up, "Mama" Kowalski, who runs the cafeteria! Finally, a chance for me to use my pie making skills!
Next up, “Mama” Kowalski, who runs the cafeteria! Finally, a chance for me to use my pie making skills!

EP1_P2IdPositive_01.value: People should call you Super Grandma!
People should call you Super Grandma!

EP1_P2IdPositive_02.value: You've been so helpful here, I might have free time for the first time in ages!
