EP1_P2Intro_02.value: Yes, dearie! But I don't mind introducing myse-
Yes, dearie! But I don’t mind introducing myse-

EP1_P2Intro_03.value: Catherine Palmer! But everyone calls me Kitty.
Catherine Palmer! But everyone calls me Kitty.

EP1_P2Intro_04.value: Kinda like everyone calling you Grandma, huh?

EP1_P2Intro_05.value: Nice to meet you! So what did you do to get thrown in with us?

EP1_P2Intro_06.value: Let me guess! You Drove over a flower garden?
Let me guess! You Drove over a flower garden?

EP1_P2Intro_08.value: Nonono! You ROBBED A BANK! Hijacked an airplane! Crashed a cruise ship into a port!
Nonono! You ROBBED A BANK! Hijacked an airplane! Crashed a cruise ship into a port!

EP1_P2Intro_09.value: People say I speak too much...

EP1_P2TaskA_01.value: So! While this isn't the most glamorous job, I bet you dollars to doughnuts that it'll beat cleaning out jail cells.
So! While this isn’t the most glamorous job, I bet you dollars to doughnuts that it’ll beat cleaning out jail cells.

EP1_P2TaskA_02.value: What we need to do is to get everything ready for the day.

EP1_P2TaskA_03.value: That means, prepping food, getting the oven working, and all the other fun stuff the warden of this fine establishment thinks he needs us to do.
That means prepping food, getting the oven working, and all the other fun stuff the warden of this fine establishment thinks he needs us to do.

EP1_P2TaskA_04.value: I know it ain't stunt work, but it's really important you know? People are counting on us!
I know it ain’t stunt work, but it’s really important, you know? People are counting on us!

EP1_P2TaskB_01.value: Wow, Grandma! You sure know how to get things going!
Wow, Grandma! You sure know how to get things going!

EP1_P2TaskB_02.value: Not my first rodeo, I know how to get around, dearie.
Not my first rodeo. I know how to get around, dearie.

EP1_P2TaskB_03.value: You know, you remind me of my Nana. She always said...

EP1_P3BiographyPopUp(NonDialogue)_01.value: Amanda "Mama" Kowalski - Awaiting trial for smuggling and counterfitting. Everyone calls her Mama, mostly because she treats everyone like her children. And like every strict parent, she keeps people in line. The de facto boss of the cell block.

EP1_P3Complete_01.value: Well, butter my backside and call me a biscuit!

EP1_P3Complete_03.value: It takes a whole lot to impress ol' Mama over here, and you impressed me a lot!
It takes a whole lot to impress ol’ Mama over here, and you impressed me a lot!

EP1_P3Complete_04.value: Truth be told, darlin'... You're starting to make me look bad!
Truth be told, darlin’... You’re starting to make me look bad!

EP1_P3Complete_05.value: Not my intention in the least, Mama!

EP1_P3Complete_06.value: Ha! I know. But if it's all the same between you and me, I'm gonna send you to Bluetooth.
Ha! I know. But if it’s all the same between you and me, I’m gonna send you to Bluetooth.

EP1_P3Complete_08.value: She's one of my girls who runs the recyclin' factory. She needs a hand and we have a lot of trash from lunch that needs to be taken there.
She’s one of my girls who runs the recyclin’ factory. She needs a hand and we have a lot of trash from lunch that needs to be taken there.

EP1_P3Complete_09.value: But don't be a stranger now!
But don’t be a stranger now!

EP1_P3GangUnlock_02.value: While I wasn't able to use my superior pie making skills in the Cafeteria, I have managed to impress the Mama enough to let me gain
While I wasn’t able to use my superior pie making skills in the Cafeteria, I have managed to impress the Mama enough to let me gain access to the recycling factory.

EP1_P3GangUnlock_03.value: access to the recycling factory. That should be the perfect place for me to find or manufacture many of the items I need to escape.
That should be the perfect place for me to find or manufacture many of the items I need to escape.

EP1_P3GangUnlock_04.value: Not surprisingly, Mama may have found me a little TOO impressive, and may see me now as some sort of rival...

EP1_P3GangUnlock_05.value: Truth be told, it may be that I need to become the head of this cell block, in order to enact my escape.
Truth be told, it may be that I need to become the head of this cell block in order to enact my escape.

EP1_P3GangUnlock_06.value: But for now, I must continue with my original plan. Next up, I must meet with this "Bluetooth" at the factory...
But for now, I must continue with my original plan. Next up, I must meet with this “Bluetooth” at the factory...

EP1_P3IdPositive_01.value: You make me happier than a dead pig in sunshine!

EP1_P3IdPositive_03.value: Ain't no other way to put it, darlin. You're a special as all get out.
Ain’t no other way to put it, darlin’. You’re a special as all get out.

EP1_P3IdPositive_04.value: Only doing what is needed, dearie.

EP1_P3Intro_01.value: Well aren't you sweeter than a cherry pie! You brought the food!
Well, aren’t you sweeter than a cherry pie! You brought the food!

EP1_P3Intro_02.value: C'mere darlin'! Let Mama give ya a big ol' hug!
C’mere darlin’! Let Mama give ya a big ol’ hug!

EP1_P3Intro_04.value: There we go! Welcome the cafeteria! Or as I like to call it, Mama's Kitchen.
There we go! Welcome to the cafeteria! Or, as I like to call it, Mama’s Kitchin’.

EP1_P3Intro_05.value: Now I heard from some of my girls that you're pretty handy to have around... That true, darlin'?
Now I heard from some of my girls that you’re pretty handy to have around... That true, darlin’?

EP1_P3Intro_06.value: Well, I'd like to think so, yes. Those poor girls really do need all the help they can get.
Well, I’d like to think so, yes. Those poor girls really do need all the help they can get.

EP1_P3Intro_07.value: Oh my, where are my manners? I'm Mama Kowalski!
Oh my, where are my manners? I’m Mama Kowalski!

EP1_P3Intro_08.value: But you can call me Mama. Everyone does!

EP1_P3TaskA_01.value: Well now. Servin' food in ol' Mama's Kitchen ain't no easy task.
Well, now. Servin’ food in ol’ Mama’s Kitchen ain’t no easy task.

EP1_P3TaskA_02.value: You got to get the portions right! Otherwise my girls might get their feathers all rufled up and you'll have fights breaking out all over the place.
You got to get the portions right! Otherwise my girls might get their feathers all ruffled up and you’ll have fights breaking out all over the place.

EP1_P3TaskA_03.value: And Mama doesn't like fightin' in the kitchen, ya hear?
And Mama doesn’t like fightin’ in the kitchen, ya hear?

EP1_P3TaskB_02.value: Thank you! If you want I could bake one of my pies for you as well?
Thank you! If you want, I could bake one of my pies for you as well?

EP1_P3TaskB_03.value: She bakes too?! You n' me are like two peas in a pod. Careful, don't want the girls to confuse you for ol' Mama now.
She bakes too?! You n’ me are like two peas in a pod. Careful, don’t want the girls to confuse you for ol’ Mama now.

EP1_P3TaskB_04.value: Not in a million years. After all, you're their Mama. So I might as well be their Grandma.
Not in a million years. After all, you’re their Mama. So I might as well be their Grandma.

EP1_P4Complete_01.value: The way you work those machines is an art form!

EP1_P4Complete_02.value: Engineering and machines tend to run in the family, dearie.

EP1_P4Complete_03.value: I guess so! Never seen such a well-oiled operation, before. We’re done for the day!

EP1_P4Complete_04.value: Tell you what, take this cart and take it back to the Library.

EP1_P4Complete_05.value: C.J.’ll be waiting for you there. She’ll need a little help in the library.

EP1_P4Complete_07.value: Taking a long needed rest, thanks to you, Grandma!

EP1_P4GangUnlock_02.value: While my time in the recycling factory was uneventful, it has gained me a valuable ally.

EP1_P4GangUnlock_03.value: Finally I should get access to the library. It is crucial to my plans and should give me more information on the guards.

EP1_P4GangUnlock_04.value: I’ve noticed that they tend to visit the same library for their reading material, so I’m guessing the inmate librarian, called “C.J.” will know a thing or two...

EP1_P4IdPositive_01.value: Maybe once I get out and start my computer company, I’ll have you run the manufacturing?

EP1_P4IdPositive_02.value: Oh, I don’t know about that, dearie. But I’ll sure make you a good Hopeberry pie!

EP1_P4IdPositive_03.value: If you can bake as well as you run machinery, you’re on!

EP1_P4Intro_02.value: Yes, dearie! But you can call me Grandma.

EP1_P4Intro_03.value: Yeah, no. That’s weird and honestly, you don’t look anything like my grandmother.

EP1_P4Intro_05.value: So, Ursula, do you have any technical skills? Do you know how to run any sort of industrial machinery?

EP1_P4Intro_06.value: I once operated the bodymaker at the family can plant.

EP1_P4Intro_07.value: Okay, I can work with that!

EP1_P4TaskA_01.value: Before I have you operate any of the heavy machinery, let’s start small. Sorting.

EP1_P4TaskA_02.value: The most important thing is to sort the trash into the various recyclable components.

EP1_P4TaskA_03.value: You think you can do that?

EP1_P4TaskA_04.value: I do this at home with my Maddie all the time!

EP1_P4TaskB_01.value: Alright. Good job! I guess I trust you enough to know what sort of trash needs to go into which machine.

EP1_P4TaskB_02.value: Now, running these things is simple. Put the recyclables in, push the button.

EP1_P4TaskB_03.value: And make sure you don’t fall in yourself. That would be...

EP1_P5Complete_01.value: And there we go! The library is ready to be used again!

EP1_P5Complete_03.value: I do what I can, dearie.

EP1_P5Complete_04.value: Just a shame you’ll be leaving soon.

EP1_P5Complete_05.value: Wh- What do you mean by that?

EP1_P5Complete_06.value: Come on, a Granny like you in a place like this? It has got to be a MISTAKE!

EP1_P5Complete_07.value: Oh! Hahaha. Yes, dearie. All a big misunderstanding.

EP1_P5GangUnlock_02.value: I’m now able to work in the library. That has been an incredible boon for my escape plan.

EP1_P5GangUnlock_03.value: I’ve already gathered a substantial amount of secret information on the guards.

EP1_P5GangUnlock_04.value: Perhaps soon I may use the information I’ve gathered to have the guards be more co-operative!

EP1_P5GangUnlock_05.value: But for now, I believe I have enough access to the jail in order to advance my escape plans.

EP1_P5IdPositive_01.value: Wow! This is more than I hoped for! Amazing work, Granny!

EP1_P5IdPositive_03.value: You even organized the library cards!

EP1_P5Intro_01.value: Ah... Grandma. Did I get that right?

EP1_P5Intro_02.value: Yes, dearie. But if that is too awkward for you...

EP1_P5Intro_03.value: Not in the least! Welcome to the library, Granny!

EP1_P5Intro_04.value: Here you’ll find a surprisingly vast collection of fiction, non-fiction, recipe books, newspapers and magazines. And my favorite...

EP1_P5Intro_07.value: Yes! You’d be surprised how much you can learn about people from the books they read...

EP1_P5TaskA_01.value: A library doesn’t stay organized by itself. We still need to go through all the returns and place them back on the shelves.

EP1_P5TaskA_02.value: Tell me... Do you know the Dewey Decimal System?

EP1_P5TaskA_03.value: I may have used the occasional library in my time, dearie...

EP1_P5TaskA_05.value: Oh! One last thing. Don’t be surprised if you find some interesting stuff in the books. People in here like to use the books as an unofficial messaging service.

EP1_P5TaskA_06.value: Even THE GUARDS like to use them from time to time, when they don’t want their conversations on the record.

EP1_P5TaskB_01.value: Now that we have returned all the books to the shelves, we can start working on tidying up the place.

EP1_P6Complete_01.value: You’re the first person to speak to me properly here, let alone help me find things.

EP1_P6Complete_02.value: May I ask what you do with them?

EP1_P6Complete_03.value: I... I like to build stuff. Little machines and contraptions.

EP1_P6Complete_04.value: Aaaw... You remind me of my Maddie.

EP1_P6Complete_06.value: Grand daughter, yes. She has a brilliant mind, like yours.

EP1_P6Complete_07.value: Thank you, Grandma. C- Can I call you that?

EP1_P6GangUnlock_02.value: I’ve come across a really interesting inmate that truly reminds me of my Maddie.

EP1_P6GangUnlock_03.value: She is brilliant, yet shy. Hopefully, her time in this dreadful place will not squash that ingenious spark in her.

EP1_P6GangUnlock_04.value: Perhaps once all this is over, I’ll try and find her again and introduce her to Maddie.

EP1_P6IdPositive_01.value: Thank you! These are exactly what I was looking for!

EP1_P6IdPositive_02.value: You know, with your help, I’m sure I could build a machine that could dig us out of here?

EP1_P6Intro_01.value: Hello, dearie. I’ve seen you around a couple of times. I was wondering if we could talk?

EP1_P6Intro_04.value: Don’t you know the rules? You don’t talk to me!

EP1_P6Intro_05.value: But you seem pretty lonely... Are you sure?

EP1_P6TaskA_01.value: You again, what do you want?

EP1_P6TaskA_02.value: I thought I might help you a bit. You seem to be always looking for things.

EP1_P6TaskA_03.value: Well, okay then. Just don’t pop out of nowhere like that again.

EP1_P6TaskB_04.value: It’s alright dearie, no need to thank me. Just helping a friend.

EP1_Storage_01.value: Hmm... Looks like a useful location, but I might need a job to give me access to it.
Hmm... Looks like a useful location, but I might need a job to give me-

EP1_Storage_02.value: Lets see if I can earn enough trust to somehow find a way into this room...
Hey! You can’t be in here unless you work here or you’re bringing in a cart!

EP1_Storage_03.value: Oh dearie me, I’m dreadfully sorry...

EgyptianCat_01.value: Wow... This is beautiful! Maybe this should belong in the gallery?

EgyptianCat_02.value: But, I don't think she'd like that...

EgyptianCat_03.value: Bastet was the Egyptian goddess of good health, pleasure and protection.

EgyptianCat_04.value: I've always had a thing for the Egyptian pantheon. Ever since I was a child.

EgyptianCat_05.value: Come to think of it, so did Lindsay, from what I've heard.
