FactoryBoulevard_Travel_01.value: Aha! My trusty, true blue, scooter! It's been a while.

FactoryBoulevard_Travel_02.value: I should really maintain it more often...

FactoryBoulevard_Travel_03.value: But luckily, I think it has just enough fuel to get me to the tin can factory!

FactoryCellar_02_01.value: There we go! The lights are back on!

FactoryCellar_02_02.value: Well, er... some of them at least.

FactoryCellar_02_04.value: What’s that hunk of metal over the pool? Is... Is that a submarine?!

FactoryCellar_02_05.value: I think this place in connected to an underground aquifer!

FactoryCellar_02_07.value: I see a second control panel... Maybe if I can fix that, I’ll get more light on the situation.

FactoryCellar_03_03.value: I’m not only below sea level, but underwater as well!

FactoryCellar_03_04.value: It’s filled with all sorts of weird contraptions... Are those more blueprints?

FactoryCellar_03_05.value: Hey... I think this must have been a secret laboratory!

FactoryCellar_03_06.value: A safe space for Ignatius and Agatha to...

FactoryCellar_03_08.value: I have no idea what they were up to in here!

FactoryCellar_03_09.value: Well, I bet it has something to do with whatever is under that cloth.

FactoryCellar_03_10.value: It looks like this place is divided in two as well. I should snoop around and see if I can figure this out...

FactoryCellar_04_02.value: I bet this leads to the tin mines!

FactoryCellar_04_03.value: Or judging by some of this ore... A Boultonite mine!

FactoryCellar_04_04.value: I remember reading in Ignatius’s journal that he discovered Boultonite while excavating his tin mine.

FactoryCellar_04_05.value: Maybe this is where he discovered it!

FactoryCellar_04_06.value: I should study this ore some more, just to be sure.

FactoryCellar_04_07.value: I’ll head over to that workbench I saw earlier and see what I can learn about it...

FactoryCellar_05_01.value: Let’s have a closer look at you, shall we?

FactoryCellar_05_02.value: Interesting! This ore is unlike anything I’ve seen before.

FactoryCellar_05_03.value: I’ve only ever seen refined Boultonite, but looking at it in its raw form is fascinating.

FactoryCellar_05_05.value: Looks like research on Boultonite by Agatha!

FactoryCellar_05_06.value: It says here that she was studying its power-generating properties.

FactoryCellar_05_07.value: WOW! If her calculations are correct...

FactoryCellar_05_08.value: A few pounds of this stuff could power most of the Eastern Seaboard!

FactoryCellar_06_01.value: Hmm... There seems to be a reaction happening.

FactoryCellar_06_03.value: It’s exothermic! The water must be reacting with the Boultonite to create electricity!

FactoryCellar_06_05.value: This could revolutionize the power industry! This could...

FactoryCellar_06_07.value: Why DIDN’T it revolutionize the power industry?!

FactoryCellar_07_02.value: What was that?! I think it came from over there...

FactoryCellar_07_03.value: Sounded familiar though. Like the startup noise of the CB-01 upstairs...

FactoryCellar_07_04.value: This reaction chamber must have given enough juice to power it up...

FactoryCellar_07_05.value: In fact, I wouldn’t be surprised if this chamber could produce enough power to run the entire factory!

FactoryCellar_07_07.value: But then again... Why the water wheel?

FactoryCellar_07_08.value: Gaah! Why keep all this secret?!

FactoryCellar_07_09.value: *sigh* Okay. Might as well head towards the sound and see if I can get answers there...

FactoryCellar_08_02.value: Hmm... Looks like it’s trying to communicate, but something is broken!

FactoryCellar_08_03.value: Maybe if I do a little rewiring to this gramophone and...

FactoryCellar_08_04.value: *Bzzt* Hello Agatha. Systems show 80+ years of inactivity.

FactoryCellar_08_06.value: OH wow! You’re not like the ticket machine upstairs! You... Are you...?

FactoryCellar_08_07.value: I am a CB-02x Research Assistant. NOT a ticket machine.

FactoryCellar_08_08.value: And as per your last instructions, Ma’am. The submersible is now ready for your next RESEARCH excursion.

FactoryCellar_08_09.value: Submersible?! You mean that thing is operational?!

FactoryCellar_09_01.value: Wow! This submarine must have been purpose-built to explore and search for Boultonite ore in the aquifer!

FactoryCellar_09_02.value: I guess it wouldn’t hurt to take out for a spin and-

FactoryCellar_09_04.value: Looks like the oxygen supply ran out a long time ago. A LONG time ago. I'll need to get some more later.

FactoryCellar_09_05.value: I guess I have to wait for that submarine ride.

FactoryCellar_09_06.value: Might as well give Julius a call on the intercom and tell him what I’ve discovered!

FactoryCellar_09_10.value: Jeepers, don’t scare me like that! Your voice came through the intercom and full volume!

FactoryCellar_09_11.value: Julius, you won’t believe what I discovered! A secret lab right under the office!

FactoryCellar_09_12.value: How fascinating, but it was good that you called.

FactoryCellar_09_13.value: Winston dropped by asking for you.
Leonard came by, said you are needed at his atelier?

FactoryCellar_09_14.value: Ah, great! Must be the key I asked him to find. Tell him to meet me on the first floor of the mansion!
His atelier, huh? Okay, thank you Julius! I'll go and find him!

FactoryCellar_Intro_02.value: I can barely make out any details...

FactoryCellar_Intro_03.value: Hmm... It’s also quite damp down here. It almost smells like a swamp!

FactoryCellar_Intro_04.value: Judging by how long it took me to get down here, roughly 3 minutes...

FactoryCellar_Intro_05.value: And I could roughly see our speed by looking outside the elevator...

FactoryCellar_Intro_06.value: I think I’m 500 feet underground! That’s below sea level!

FactoryCellar_Intro_07.value: It’s too dark for me to continue safely...

FactoryCellar_Intro_08.value: But maybe this control panel can help me restore some power to get the lights back on!

FactoryCellar_POI_AgathasDesk_01.value: Hmm... There seems to be a lot of notes and observations by Agatha here.

FactoryCellar_POI_AgathasDesk_02.value: Her musings on the properties of Boultonite...

FactoryCellar_POI_AgathasDesk_03.value: And their possible applications! She really was thinking ahead.

FactoryCellar_POI_AgathasDesk_04.value: Actually... some of these designs could have really worked!

FactoryCellar_POI_LabCoats_01.value: Hmm... These lab coats have seen a lot of action.

FactoryCellar_POI_LabCoats_02.value: So they must have spent a lot of time down here, working on their experiments.

FactoryCellar_POI_LabCoats_03.value: Ha. Putting these up here kinda makes it look like they’ll be back any minute now.

FactoryCellar_POI_LabCoats_04.value: I wonder if I should add this area to the factory tour?

FactoryCellar_POI_LabCoats_05.value: Hmm... Maybe later. Once I’ve learned everything in here.

FactoryCellar_POI_LabCoats_06.value: I should probably keep looking around.

FactoryCellar_POI_ReactionChamber_03.value: If I’d hazard a guess, it looks like some sort of reaction chamber.

FactoryCellar_POI_ReactionChamber_04.value: Judging by all the piping and dials attached to it.

FactoryCellar_POI_ReactionChamber_05.value: But what exactly were they experimenting on?

FactoryCellar_POI_RiverWall_01.value: Wow! The aquifer looks to be connected by an underground river.

FactoryCellar_POI_RiverWall_02.value: And I see fish! That means it connects out to the bay!

FactoryCellar_POI_RiverWall_03.value: I wonder how big this network is?! We’re pretty deep underground after all.

FactoryCellar_POI_RiverWall_04.value: A real honeycomb of old mine tunnels and aquifers lay under Hopewell Bay!

FactoryCellar_POI_RoundWindow_01.value: Wow! I can see a massive water cave from this window!

FactoryCellar_POI_RoundWindow_02.value: I can just about see various cave entrances as well... I wonder where they lead to?

FactoryCellar_POI_RoundWindow_03.value: I’m sure this cave network is massive.

FactoryCellar_POI_RoundWindow_04.value: I’d LOVE to go exploring them some day!

FactoryCellar_POI_RoundWindow_05.value: Who know’s what I could find in them?

FactoryCellar_POI_TravellingMerchant_01.value: Looks like Ignatius did a lot of traveling with his CB-01 prototype.

FactoryCellar_POI_TravellingMerchant_02.value: Oooh, some flyers are from the first World’s Fair in London!

FactoryCellar_POI_TravellingMerchant_03.value: He was asked to give a speech and show his invention.

FactoryCellar_POI_TravellingMerchant_04.value: Hmm... Looks like Agatha remained here to work. Not entirely fair.

FactoryCellar_POI_TravellingMerchant_05.value: He was away for a long time. Looked like he attended quite a few of these exhibitions around the world.

FactoryCellar_POI_TravellingMerchant_06.value: I wonder what was so important for her to work on that she remained here?

FactoryFloor_02_02.value: That window is broken! But there's glass fragments on the inside...

FactoryFloor_02_03.value: You think someone broke in? Why?

FactoryFloor_02_04.value: Hmm... Looking closer at this steam clock, I can see that some of the gears are missing!
Hmm... Looking closer at this steam clock, I can see that some of the parts are missing!

FactoryFloor_02_05.value: Carefully removed... Like they were stolen!

FactoryFloor_02_06.value: Who breaks into a factory to steal gears from an old steam clock?
Who breaks into a factory to steal parts from an old steam clock?

FactoryFloor_02_07.value: Maybe there's more to it, than meets the eye.
Maybe there's more to it than meets the eye.

FactoryFloor_03_04.value: Hello ma'am! Do you currently have car insurance that covers ALL foreseeable outcomes?

FactoryFloor_03_05.value: I'm sorry, now is not a-

FactoryFloor_03_07.value: Maddie?! What are you doing on the line?!

FactoryFloor_03_09.value: Gaah! I knew I should have screened those numbers!

FactoryFloor_03_10.value: Were you trying to sell me car insurance?!

FactoryFloor_03_11.value: Fine! Yes! Yes I was. Thanks to you, this is the only job that would take me in.

FactoryFloor_03_12.value: So tell me... What is your current insurance plan?

FactoryFloor_03_14.value: Dead serious. I got a quota to fill...

FactoryFloor_04_01.value: Hey! I think I found a missing gear for the clock!
Hey! I think I found the clock hands for the steam clock!

FactoryFloor_04_02.value: Hmm... Maybe they weren't stolen after all?

FactoryFloor_04_03.value: I guess not. Perhaps I can find the others around here?
I guess not. Perhaps I can find the other parts around here?

FactoryFloor_04_04.value: Good luck! This place is in shambles. I'm surprised you could recognize that it belonged to a clock.

FactoryFloor_04_05.value: Well... I'm an engineer after all, so I can pretty much identify every nut and bolt in here.

FactoryFloor_04_07.value: In fact, looking around this factory, I can see exactly how it used to operate.

FactoryFloor_04_08.value: It's very ahead of its time, in fact. And that's what I want to show when we get it up and running again.

FactoryFloor_04_10.value: As part of the museum, of course. It'll be a great display of Boulton ingenuity.

FactoryFloor_05_01.value: Ooh! I think I found another gear under this machine...
Ooh! I think I found the missing time zones part for the steam clock under this machine...

FactoryFloor_05_04.value: Looks like some sort of personal trademark or monogram etched into the side of the machine.

FactoryFloor_05_05.value: It does look familiar! That is definitely the Boulton sigil...

FactoryFloor_05_07.value: It's Agatha's! She came up with the factory process as well!

FactoryFloor_05_08.value: These machines... The entire factory line must have been based on her designs!

FactoryFloor_05_09.value: But I can see another design on it... It almost looks like. No... It can't be!

FactoryFloor_05_11.value: I think that other design in the trademark, belonged to Victoria's family!

FactoryFloor_06_01.value: Ooh, I think I found a clock gear?
Ooh, I think I found a clock part, but I'm not quite sure...

FactoryFloor_06_02.value: Well done, Julius! You got sharp eyes.
Well done, Julius! That's the cuckoo bird that pops out! You got sharp eyes.
Well done, Julius! That's the cuckoo bird that pops out! You've got sharp eyes.

FactoryFloor_06_03.value: I'm not quite sure about that...

FactoryFloor_06_04.value: Ha! Part of me thinks these are almost meant to be found.

FactoryFloor_06_06.value: Well... They're all next to important parts of the factory. I'm getting a  clear picture on how it all operates.
Well... They're all next to important parts of the factory. I'm getting a clear picture on how it all operates.

FactoryFloor_06_07.value: I'm seeing automation that is way ahead of it's time. For a cannery, it's incredible.
I'm seeing automation that is way ahead of its time. For a cannery, it's incredible.

FactoryFloor_06_08.value: Never put it past a Boulton to surprise you.

FactoryFloor_07_05.value: I'm calling again to talk about your insurance...

FactoryFloor_07_07.value: I told you already! I don't nee-

FactoryFloor_07_08.value: Oh, but you do... YOU DO.

FactoryFloor_07_09.value: Actually. I have a question. Your family didn't happen to have some history with mine, by any chance?

FactoryFloor_07_12.value: Are you telling me, that all this time you didn't KNOW?!

FactoryFloor_08_01.value: Look! I think I found an employee worksheet. Lot's of women worked here!
Look! I think I found an employee worksheet. Lots of women worked here!

FactoryFloor_08_02.value: Ah, yes. Agatha was very focused on hiring women into the workforce.

FactoryFloor_08_03.value: She was a strong advocate for equal opportunity employment.

FactoryFloor_08_04.value: Good for her! I wonder if not being able to "own" your own inventions was a part of it.

FactoryFloor_08_05.value: It wasn't fair back then, that's for sure.

FactoryFloor_08_06.value: Hey! I found another clock gear under the posters!
Hey! I found another clock piece! I think this is the fuse!

FactoryFloor_08b_03.value: It looks like a pressure checker? Huh... That's odd.

FactoryFloor_08b_04.value: The design is quite advanced for something like this...

FactoryFloor_08b_05.value: Then again, it is a steam clock.

FactoryFloor_08b_06.value: But I wonder if something else is going on here?

FactoryFloor_09_01.value: I think I found the last clock piece, Julius!

FactoryFloor_09_03.value: There's something different about this piece.

FactoryFloor_09_04.value: Amazing! It's quite beautiful in fact. Intricately designed too. What is that inscribed next to the cupid?

FactoryFloor_09_08.value: Exactly! This piece doesn't spink as part of the main mechanism, see?
Exactly! This piece doesn't spin as part of the main mechanism, see?

FactoryFloor_10_01.value: If it truly IS a key, I wonder what will happen if I move this piece so that the arrow points to the mansion?

FactoryFloor_10_02.value: Oh! Did a secret compartment just open?!

FactoryFloor_10_03.value: What's this? It looks like a pneumatic tube system!

FactoryFloor_10_04.value: I didn't see any tubes around?

FactoryFloor_10_05.value: Neither did I... They must be underground. And this one was deliberately hidden in the clock.

FactoryFloor_10_06.value: Why would something like this be hidden?

FactoryFloor_10_08.value: I've seen this before! Back at the mansion!

FactoryFloor_10_09.value: Surely this isn't connected all the way to the mansion?!

FactoryFloor_10_10.value: I'm serious, this is exact same system I saw in the bathroom.

FactoryFloor_11_01.value: I wonder if the canister in here is the same one I saw at the bathroom.
I wonder if the canister in here is the same one I saw in the bathroom.

FactoryFloor_11_02.value: I still understand WHY you saw it in there?!
I still don't understand WHY you saw it in there?!

FactoryFloor_11_03.value: There was a water accident, we thought it was used for plumbing. I saw this message stuck there.

FactoryFloor_11_04.value: Once we got it working, the message went off to it's final destination. HERE!
Once we got it working, the message went off to its final destination. HERE!

FactoryFloor_11_05.value: Well? Let's find out what's in it!

FactoryFloor_11_07.value: Let's see. We got two messages. One seems encrypted, but something I'll be able to break when I got a bit of time.

FactoryFloor_11_11.value: Ha! That's what the message says. Aaaw, how sweet!

FactoryFloor_12_03.value: I'm amazed you got it to run on the first try!

FactoryFloor_12_05.value: This place works just as I envisioned, yet the original design was incredibly intuitive to follow and expand upon.

FactoryFloor_12_06.value: Almost as if it was designed to be future proof. Really ahead of its time.
Almost as if it was designed to be future-proof. Really ahead of its time.

FactoryFloor_13_01.value: This must be the door to the office! Quite imposing.

FactoryFloor_13_02.value: Want to find out what's inside?

FactoryFloor_13_03.value: I admit, I am really excited and curious to see what's inside.

FactoryFloor_13_04.value: But I really think I should be heading back to the mansion.

FactoryFloor_13_05.value: After all, there's a whole new floor for me to explore and fix up!

FactoryFloor_13_06.value: Alright, Maddie. I'll hold the fort here. Just give me a call if you need anything.

FactoryFloor_13_07.value: Will do, Julius. Thank you for all the help so far. You've been indispensable!

FactoryFloor_CharacterTask1_01.value: Maddie! I have just had the grandest idea!

FactoryFloor_CharacterTask1_03.value: A community-driven art competition for the factory!

FactoryFloor_CharacterTask1_04.value: I'd like to call it The Canstruction!

FactoryFloor_CharacterTask1_05.value: Oooh, sounds great! Tell me more.

FactoryFloor_CharacterTask1_06.value: I'll be distributing unused cans to schools, community centers, art programs, everywhere!

FactoryFloor_CharacterTask1_07.value: Everyone is encouraged to freely participate, because the grand prize will be to have that art...

FactoryFloor_CharacterTask1_08.value: Take center stage right here in the factory floor as an exhibition piece!

FactoryFloor_CharacterTask1_09.value: That's great! Not only will it be fun, but it'll also help get the word out for the museum!

FactoryFloor_CharacterTask2_03.value: I've rarely seen such excitement! Pretty much all the schools are involved and even the art academy!

FactoryFloor_CharacterTask2_04.value: That's great Julius. I really think this will help connect the museum to the factory's history.

FactoryFloor_CharacterTask2_05.value: And it's a great way to recycle all those cans!

FactoryFloor_CharacterTask2_06.value: I can't wait to see what they make!

FactoryFloor_CharacterTask3_02.value: I guess you've seen some of the submissions already?

FactoryFloor_CharacterTask3_03.value: Yes! Some of these are really incredible! I didn't even know you could do that with cans!

FactoryFloor_CharacterTask3_04.value: I admit, I was not expecting this level of participation! I just got word for another truckload of submissions.

FactoryFloor_CharacterTask3_05.value: Truckload?! How are we ever going to pick a winner?

FactoryFloor_CharacterTask3_06.value: Don't worry. If there is a will. There is a way.

FactoryFloor_CharacterTask4_04.value: How are we supposed choose from all these amazing pieces of art?!

FactoryFloor_CharacterTask4_05.value: We should judge them on a strict criteria, I believe.

FactoryFloor_CharacterTask4_06.value: Creativity, structure and how best it reflects the heritage of the factory.

FactoryFloor_CharacterTask4_07.value: Hey! That could work! We give points for each, and the one with the highest is the winner!

FactoryFloor_CharacterTask5_02.value: Yes, the students at Hopewell High were over the moon to find out that they had won!

FactoryFloor_CharacterTask5_03.value: Hopewell High was founded by Amelia Boulton, wasn't it?

FactoryFloor_CharacterTask5_04.value: Yes indeed, Maddie, which is why their contribution so perfectly fits all the criteria.

FactoryFloor_CharacterTask5_05.value: Now all we have to do is install it in the factory floor.

FactoryFloor_CharacterTask5_06.value: Where it'll have a place of honor, tying together the community and the heritage of the factory.

FactoryFloor_CharacterTask5_07.value: After all... It belongs to everyone.

FactoryFloor_CharacterTask5_08.value: I'm sure Ignatius and Agatha would be proud.

FactoryFloor_Intro_01.value: Wow! This must be the factory floor.

FactoryFloor_Intro_02.value: There's some really impressive machinery in here!

FactoryFloor_Intro_03.value: But everything looks like it's been out of order for ages.

FactoryFloor_Intro_04.value: So I wonder where the whistling came from?

FactoryFloor_Intro_05.value: Wait! Is that an old steam clock?

FactoryFloor_Intro_08.value: It's probably still connected to the old steam line. Perhaps there was still some pressure in there?

FactoryFloor_Intro_09.value: Hmm... Good point. Maybe the heart of the factory is still beating?

FactoryFloor_MachinePart11_Description.value: The guts and arteries of the machine.

FactoryFloor_POI_Automata_01.value: Wow! These automatons came out great! They're almost lifelike! But not in a creepy way.

FactoryFloor_POI_Automata_02.value: It's always great when I get to apply my engineering skills.

FactoryFloor_POI_Automata_03.value: Especially when it comes to building and working on awesome projects like this!

FactoryFloor_POI_Automata_04.value: Hmm... Maybe I should get into making robots!

FactoryFloor_POI_ControlStation_02.value: From here I can operate and automate the entire factory line display!

FactoryFloor_POI_ControlStation_03.value: It was an easy enough retrofit. And now I can use it to give a really good demonstration of how this place worked!

FactoryFloor_POI_ControlStation_04.value: Hmm... But what if I let the visitors play with it as well?

FactoryFloor_POI_EmpowerPosters_02.value: The women on them look so strong and powerful!

FactoryFloor_POI_EmpowerPosters_03.value: Willing and able to do anything!

FactoryFloor_POI_EmpowerPosters_04.value: Agatha was very vocal and supportive of having women be part of the workforce.

FactoryFloor_POI_EmpowerPosters_05.value: Hopefully these posters will celebrate that.

FactoryFloor_POI_FireSafety_02.value: While it may look old, it's a very modern system.

FactoryFloor_POI_FireSafety_03.value: Roddy was very adamant that this was done correctly, too.

FactoryFloor_POI_FireSafety_04.value: Don't want to give anyone any ideas for shutting down the place before it's even opened.

FactoryFloor_POI_InfoPlaque_02.value: Not only will it commemorate the factory floor, but it'll convey a little history as well!

FactoryFloor_POI_InfoPlaque_03.value: Julius helped me write it, filling in some of the blanks.

FactoryFloor_POI_InfoPlaque_04.value: Hmm... I hope it's not too boring.

FactoryFloor_POI_InfoPlaque_05.value: Nah. Once this place is ready, it'll be FAR from boring!

FactoryFloor_POI_InterestingMachine_01.value: Wow... These hydraulics are really interesting!

FactoryFloor_POI_InterestingMachine_03.value: In fact, some of these should be studied closer.

FactoryFloor_POI_InterestingMachine_04.value: I think modern engineering could learn a thing or two here!

FactoryFloor_POI_InterestingMachine_05.value: But I wonder who designed them? Was it Agatha?!

FactoryFloor_POI_MetalSheets_01.value: I'm so happy we managed to salvage some of these rolls of tin sheets!

FactoryFloor_POI_MetalSheets_02.value: They were really well preserved! They knew their stuff back then.

FactoryFloor_POI_MetalSheets_03.value: The edges were still sharp, too!

FactoryFloor_POI_MetalSheets_04.value: But now that it's in its place, people can see how the tin can making process begins.

FactoryFloor_POI_ProductDisplay_01.value: There! A perfect display that shows all the types of tin cans this factory has ever made.

FactoryFloor_POI_ProductDisplay_02.value: On a cute little conveyor belt, I may add!

FactoryFloor_POI_ProductDisplay_03.value: Everything from the very first soup cans...

FactoryFloor_POI_ProductDisplay_05.value: Our entire can legacy on display.

FactoryFloor_POI_ProductDisplay_06.value: I hope this does them justice!

FactoryFloor_POI_SafetyGear_02.value: Era correct safety gear set up for display!

FactoryFloor_POI_SafetyGear_03.value: I am a bit of stickler for accuracy.

FactoryFloor_POI_SafetyGear_04.value: Julius even found this old funny safety poster from the factory!

FactoryFloor_POI_SafetyGear_05.value: Thankfully guests don't have to be worried about getting caught in the machinery!

FactoryGiftShop_02_01.value: So, how do you know about fixing stained-glass windows?

FactoryGiftShop_02_02.value: Well... A long time ago I did an antique apprenticeship in Florence, Italy.
Well... a long time ago I did an antique apprenticeship in Florence, Italy.

FactoryGiftShop_02_03.value: I learned quite a lot there. Mainly restoration work.

FactoryGiftShop_02_06.value: And I was pretty good at it too!

FactoryGiftShop_02_08.value: This'll look great for the gift shop.

FactoryGiftShop_02_09.value: Gift shop! What an excellent idea!
Gift shop! Is that your plan for this space? What an excellent idea!

FactoryGiftShop_03_01.value: So this is our Point of Sale system. Also known as the POS.

FactoryGiftShop_03_04.value: Maddie! What's wrong with an old fashioned cash register?

FactoryGiftShop_03_05.value: They work when the power is out, and if it's stuck, a bit of grease fixes it!

FactoryGiftShop_03_06.value: I understand your aversion to modern technology, but I need you to learn this.
I understand your aversion to modern technology, but I need you to learn how to use this.

FactoryGiftShop_03_08.value: Oh, alright... How do I turn it on?

FactoryGiftShop_04_01.value: Could you tell me more about your time in Florence, Julius?

FactoryGiftShop_04_03.value: Art as far as the eye could see.

FactoryGiftShop_04_06.value: But none of it compared to...

FactoryGiftShop_05_03.value: She worked in a pottery and glass workshop.

FactoryGiftShop_05_04.value: Which supplied me with the stained glass I needed for the window repairs I did.
Which supplied me with the stained-glass I needed for the window repairs I did.

FactoryGiftShop_05_05.value: She was a master, Maddie. She never threw anything away!

FactoryGiftShop_05_06.value: Reusing the broken pieces to make something even more beautiful.

FactoryGiftShop_05_07.value: Kind of like the art of kintsugi!

FactoryGiftShop_05_08.value: Exactly! She treated every broken piece with reverence. As if it was a piece of art.

FactoryGiftShop_05_09.value: She would say, "Julius, there is beauty in the broken."

FactoryGiftShop_06_02.value: Well, I was young and only on an apprenticeship.

FactoryGiftShop_06_03.value: We knew it was not meant to be, so we remained friends. I came back the following year.

FactoryGiftShop_06_04.value: Do you still keep in touch?

FactoryGiftShop_06_05.value: Oh, Maddie. It was such a long time ago... I don't think she'd remember me anymore!

FactoryGiftShop_06_06.value: Well, at least you ended things on good terms.

FactoryGiftShop_06_07.value: Unlike my own relationship. With an ex-fiancé no less.

FactoryGiftShop_06_08.value: Oh?! Is it this Arthur I've heard about?

FactoryGiftShop_06_10.value: From what I've heard of him, maybe that's something not worth fixing...

FactoryGiftShop_07_02.value: Let's set up an interactive experience where guests get to make new works of art with old scraps we find here?

FactoryGiftShop_07_03.value: That's a great idea! They could make their own jewelry, charms or keychains!

FactoryGiftShop_07_04.value: Your story about Sofia inspired me.
Exactly! Your story about Sofia inspired me.

FactoryGiftShop_08_02.value: We have a lot of empty cans here...

FactoryGiftShop_08_03.value: Maybe there's something we could do with them?

FactoryGiftShop_08_04.value: Great idea! We can make all sorts of things with them!

FactoryGiftShop_09_01.value: You're really getting into the vibe of things, Julius!

FactoryGiftShop_09_02.value: Maybe renovation is in your blood!

FactoryGiftShop_09_03.value: I must admit, I didn't realize how much I missed art and restoration.

FactoryGiftShop_09_04.value: Even though I run an antique shop, all I did was buy and sell them...

FactoryGiftShop_09_05.value: Maybe I should get into restoring old antiques as well!

FactoryGiftShop_09_06.value: If you ever need a hand...

FactoryGiftShop_09_07.value: I'll know exactly who to call!

FactoryGiftShop_10_01.value: We should all take a selfie together in the large can!
We should all take a selfie together in the large can display!

FactoryGiftShop_10_03.value: Come on Julius! Squeeze in here!

FactoryGiftShop_10_06.value: Ooh... Now I know what a sardine feels like.

FactoryGiftShop_11_02.value: Hmm... Sounded like an old steam whistle!

FactoryGiftShop_11_03.value: I think it came from behind those doors.

FactoryGiftShop_11_06.value: Alright. I'll stay and watch over the shop.

FactoryGiftShop_CharacterTask1_01.value: Ash! I'm so glad you could make it!

FactoryGiftShop_CharacterTask1_02.value: No, problem! Now, point me at the leak and I'll get to work!
No, problem! Now, point me to the leak and I'll get to work!

FactoryGiftShop_CharacterTask1_03.value: Actually, I was wondering if you could help out with something else?

FactoryGiftShop_CharacterTask1_05.value: You have a great eye for seeing "treasure" where others see junk.
You have a great eye for finding "treasure" where others see junk.

FactoryGiftShop_CharacterTask1_06.value: I want to set up a fun DIY station in this gift shop where guests can build their own treasure from old stuff!

FactoryGiftShop_CharacterTask1_07.value: Say no more, say no more!

FactoryGiftShop_CharacterTask1_08.value: But I'll need to have a look around for... Inspiration!

FactoryGiftShop_CharacterTask2_02.value: I was looking around the factory and almost fell into a hole when I spotted this under some rubble.

FactoryGiftShop_CharacterTask2_03.value: Hmm... Looks like an old bracelet. The clasp is broken... Maybe it fell off?

FactoryGiftShop_CharacterTask2_05.value: I shall fix it up and return it to its rightful owner!

FactoryGiftShop_CharacterTask2_06.value: How will you find the original owner?

FactoryGiftShop_CharacterTask2_07.value: There's a name etched on it and a plumber's contact log is vast... VAST.

FactoryGiftShop_CharacterTask2_08.value: If the owner or their relatives are still around, they're in there!

FactoryGiftShop_CharacterTask3_02.value: Oh no! Ash, are you okay?!

FactoryGiftShop_CharacterTask3_03.value: Yeah, I'm fine! Just banged my knee on the pipe that needed some care.

FactoryGiftShop_CharacterTask3_06.value: When pipes are sad, Maddie, they cry.

FactoryGiftShop_CharacterTask3_08.value: And you wouldn't be sad, living in a rundown factory at the edge of town?!

FactoryGiftShop_CharacterTask4_02.value: I even managed to find the original owner! They had thought they lost it forever.

FactoryGiftShop_CharacterTask4_03.value: That's great! And watching you work has given me some great ideas to add to the DIY section.

FactoryGiftShop_CharacterTask4_04.value: I am an artist after all...

FactoryGiftShop_CharacterTask4_06.value: I'm off to take the bracelet back!
I'm off to get the bracelet back!

FactoryGiftShop_CharacterTask5_03.value: In fact, they were so happy, I fixed their sink for free!

FactoryGiftShop_CharacterTask5_05.value: Nevermind... Thanks for all the help so far!

FactoryGiftShop_CharacterTask5_06.value: It was super fun helping out with stuff, besides plumbing. Never knew I loved making jewelry so much!

FactoryGiftShop_CharacterTask5_07.value: Why, I see the entire town of Hopewell Bay will soon be wearing tin can factory jewelry!

FactoryGiftShop_Intro_06.value: Well... There was a lot to do at the mansion and-
Well... there was a lot to do at the mansion and-

FactoryGiftShop_Intro_10.value: Now. Would need some help fixing that stain-glassed window?
Now, would you need some help fixing that stained-glass window?

FactoryGiftShop_Intro_11.value: I might know a thing or two about those!

FactoryGiftShop_POI_BoultonPic_02.value: I wonder what he would think about the changes we've made?

FactoryGiftShop_POI_BoultonPic_03.value: If anything, the man was a visionary business man. I'm sure he'd be proud.

FactoryGiftShop_POI_Chocolates_04.value: Ah! Yes they are! Ethically sourced and locally made.

FactoryGiftShop_POI_Chocolates_06.value: But you should probably get some more...

FactoryGiftShop_POI_Chocolates_07.value: Did you just eat them all?!!

FactoryGiftShop_POI_Guinness_03.value: Why, yes it is. I think it even broke the record when it was made.

FactoryGiftShop_POI_Guinness_04.value: Then we should have people take a photo with it!

FactoryGiftShop_POI_HistoryWall_01.value: Great idea, putting the history of the factory here!

FactoryGiftShop_POI_HistoryWall_02.value: Thank you. There was so much material, it would have been a shame to waste it.

FactoryGiftShop_POI_HistoryWall_03.value: I'm sure our guests will appreciate it.

FactoryGiftShop_POI_HistoryWall_04.value: Maybe we should make a photobook of these?

FactoryGiftShop_POI_PhotoSwing_01.value: There! That'll make taking the photo a lot more fun!

FactoryGiftShop_POI_PhotoSwing_03.value: Want to give it a try?

FactoryGiftShop_POI_Postcards_02.value: Great idea flattening old tin cans for them!

FactoryGiftShop_POI_Postcards_03.value: Oh well, all I thought was that these old cans had such nice designs on them...

FactoryGiftShop_POI_Postcards_04.value: Would be a shame to throw them away!

FactoryGiftShop_POI_RecycledDecor_01.value: These decorations are amazing! Did you make all of these?

FactoryGiftShop_POI_RecycledDecor_02.value: Most of them yes. After I finished with one, I had to move on to the next.

FactoryGiftShop_POI_RecycledDecor_03.value: I couldn't stop! I was possessed by the spirit of art!

FactoryGiftShop_POI_RecycledDecor_04.value: Sounds to me like you were inspired!

FactoryGiftShop_POI_RecycledDecor_06.value: Working on all of these really lit the artist in me again.

FactoryOffice_02_02.value: Thank you... That was quite. Impressive.

FactoryOffice_02_04.value: Now, if you’ll excuse me, I’ll get back to work.

FactoryOffice_02_05.value: Leonard, what are you doing here?!

FactoryOffice_02_06.value: If you MUST know, I came back to MY office to grab a few things.

FactoryOffice_02_08.value: Er... You came back for... T-shirts?

FactoryOffice_02_09.value: -in-a-can, yes. I’m in need of them again.

FactoryOffice_02_10.value: Yeah okay, whatever. Take them... Less stuff for me to sort out.
Yeah, okay, whatever. Take them... Less stuff for me to sort out.

FactoryOffice_02_11.value: Maddie, I’ll be heading back to the gift shop. I’ll also check if anything has gone “missing”.

FactoryOffice_02_13.value: Don’t worry, Julius. I’ll keep an eye on him.

FactoryOffice_03_02.value: Oh, that? Just an award I won in Milan years ago...

FactoryOffice_03_04.value: That’s right! And I was real good at it too! Not just everyone wins one of these you know.
That’s right! And I was real good at it too! Not just everyone wins one of these, you know.

FactoryOffice_03_05.value: Okay, now I’m curious! Let’s see what’s inside one of these cans.

FactoryOffice_03_07.value: Oh, my... This t-shirt is so soft! And... Really not that bad on the eyes!
Oh, my... This t-shirt is so soft! And... really not that bad on the eyes!

FactoryOffice_03_08.value: Of course it is! That’s 100% Californian Supima cotton you’re holding there.

FactoryOffice_03_09.value: Durable, luxurious, and best of all... EXPENSIVE.

FactoryOffice_03_10.value: Well... I got to hand it to you.

FactoryOffice_03_11.value: What you lack in business sense, you make up in design, that’s for sure.

FactoryOffice_04_01.value: Hmm... I wonder what these pipes are all about?

FactoryOffice_04_02.value: Do you have any idea what they were for?

FactoryOffice_04_03.value: Apart from being a hazard and trying to kill me? No idea.

FactoryOffice_04_04.value: My suggestion is to get rid of the cursed things. They were always unsightly and now down right dangerous!
My suggestion is to get rid of the cursed things. They were always unsightly and are now downright dangerous!

FactoryOffice_04_05.value: I guess... But there seems to be some sort of method to their madness.

FactoryOffice_04_06.value: But I can’t quite put my finger on it!

FactoryOffice_05_01.value: Hey! What a beautiful alcove! I wonder what it was for?

FactoryOffice_05_02.value: Oh yes! That was my favorite feature in my office.
Oh, yes! That was my favorite feature in my office.

FactoryOffice_05_03.value: I used to use this space to help me with my designs. I preferred to work with natural light if possible.

FactoryOffice_05_04.value: That’s quite clever of you, actually.

FactoryOffice_05_06.value: Thank you. It had a useless telescope before I took the office. Should be around here somewhere.

FactoryOffice_05_08.value: Leonard, I think this space was used for astronomy!

FactoryOffice_05_09.value: I don’t think Ignatius was into fortune telling.

FactoryOffice_05_10.value: Not astrology, ASTRONOMY! Observing the stars!

FactoryOffice_06_01.value: Oooh! This desk is beautiful. Quite intricate, actually! Must be an antique!

FactoryOffice_06_02.value: That desk was built from the wood of the SS Auralis.

FactoryOffice_06_03.value: Wait, I remember that name! Ignatius and Clara built a model ship of it for the hallway!

FactoryOffice_06_04.value: Very good. You know your family history.

FactoryOffice_06_05.value: This means... Ignatius must have found the ship and...

FactoryOffice_06_06.value: Built this desk in Clara’s memory. Yes.

FactoryOffice_06_07.value: How strange that something so tragic led to the creation of something so beautiful...

FactoryOffice_06_08.value: Where there is sorrow, there is holy ground.

FactoryOffice_07_01.value: Well... Off Leonard went to a new get-rich-quick scheme. Typical.
Let’s see what these blueprints are about...

FactoryOffice_07_02.value: But this time... I really hope it works out for him.
Hmm... All these look like they’re Ignatius’s, yet some of these look almost intentionally damaged.

FactoryOffice_07_03.value: Now! Let’s see what these blueprints are about...
Why would he spray paint “B” in red and tear one in half with a knife?

FactoryOffice_07_04.value: Hmm... All these look like they’re Ignatius’s, yet some of these look almost intentionally damaged.

FactoryOffice_07_05.value: Why would he spray paint “B” in red and tear one in half with a knife?
Hold on. One of these has Christine’s name on it! Agatha’s friend who helped invent the tin can!

FactoryOffice_07_06.value: It looks like Ignatius “borrowed” her designs again, but this time for the CB-01!

FactoryOffice_07_07.value: Hold on. One of these has Christine’s name on it! Agatha’s friend who helped invent the tin can!
Judging from these designs, it seems to have originally been meant for home maintenance and service...

FactoryOffice_07_08.value: It looks like Ignatius “borrowed” her designs again, but this time for the CB-01!
She really was ahead of her time and never got the recognition she deserved.

FactoryOffice_07_09.value: Judging from these designs, it seems to have originally been meant for home maintenance and service...
No wonder the Blackwoods hated the Boultons...

FactoryOffice_07_10.value: She really was ahead of her time and never got the recognition she deserved.
Maybe her husband was the one who broke in and tried to sabotage Ignatius’s operation.

FactoryOffice_07_11.value: No wonder the Blackwoods hated the Boultons...

FactoryOffice_07_12.value: Maybe her husband was the one who broke in and tried to sabotage Ignatius’s operation.

FactoryOffice_08_01.value: Hmm... These blueprints are quite intriguing.

FactoryOffice_08_02.value: They look like designs for an elevator that fits into this office!

FactoryOffice_08_03.value: But all I see is a bookshelf in the spot where it should go. Maybe he never got around to it?

FactoryOffice_08_04.value: There’s also mention of a localized power source, running off a bit of Boultonite.

FactoryOffice_08_05.value: It should be slotted into a receptacle on the wall, near the elevator...

FactoryOffice_09_02.value: And I’d bet you the mansion that it’ll fit in some spot around here and reveal a secret entrance!

FactoryOffice_09_03.value: Ignatius is always making facades to keep prying eyes away. Classic Ignatius...

FactoryOffice_09_04.value: I'll keep it safe until I'm sure where to put it...

FactoryOffice_10_02.value: Wow! It's still operational! Ignatius sure knew how to build durable machines.

FactoryOffice_10_03.value: No time like the present, Maddie.

FactoryOffice_10_04.value: Let's go see where it goes!

FactoryOffice_CharacterTask1_01.value: I wonder what he's actually up to.

FactoryOffice_CharacterTask1_02.value: It can't just be about his T-shirts-in-a-can.

FactoryOffice_CharacterTask1_03.value: I could just let him be...but what if he's plotting something?!

FactoryOffice_CharacterTask1_04.value: What are you muttering to yourself over there, Maddie?

FactoryOffice_CharacterTask1_05.value: Uhh...just....debating with myself if I should help you out!

FactoryOffice_CharacterTask1_06.value: Do you often talk to yourself out loud?

FactoryOffice_CharacterTask1_07.value: I...I do....sometimes. A...anyway, do you need help?

FactoryOffice_CharacterTask1_08.value: As a matter of fact, I could use a hand with finding some things...

FactoryOffice_CharacterTask2_01.value: Soo...who is it you're fleecing - I mean - who are you selling these cans to?

FactoryOffice_CharacterTask2_02.value: I have investors. Interested parties. Why?

FactoryOffice_CharacterTask2_03.value: You can't fault me for being a little suspicious of your 'investments', Leonard!

FactoryOffice_CharacterTask2_04.value: Oh, let it go. This is all entirely above board.

FactoryOffice_CharacterTask2_05.value: Then you won't mind telling me who exactly is your partner in this, will you?

FactoryOffice_CharacterTask2_06.value: Someone with actual business acumen. Unlike you.

FactoryOffice_CharacterTask2_07.value: If you are working with Bruno or Victoria again, I swear...

FactoryOffice_CharacterTask2_08.value: Oh pfh! Old news. No. Now - are you helping or..?

FactoryOffice_CharacterTask2_10.value: Well - I need to get ready for my product presentation, of course!

FactoryOffice_CharacterTask3_01.value: You know...this is all starting to sound suspiciously legitimate.

FactoryOffice_CharacterTask3_02.value: That is because it IS legitimate.

FactoryOffice_CharacterTask3_03.value: Someone actually wants to buy your T-shirts-in-a-can?

FactoryOffice_CharacterTask3_04.value: I was ahead of my time.

FactoryOffice_CharacterTask3_05.value: Wait - did you approach them, or did they approach you?

FactoryOffice_CharacterTask3_06.value: Not that it makes a difference...but they approached me.

FactoryOffice_CharacterTask3_07.value: Now I'm starting to wonder if YOU are being fleeced somehow.

FactoryOffice_CharacterTask3_08.value: Wh...what?! That's utter nonsense! You can't fleece a fleecer!

FactoryOffice_CharacterTask3_09.value: Aha! So you admit to being a fleecer!

FactoryOffice_CharacterTask3_10.value: I...I admit to no such thing! Ah! Look at the time!

FactoryOffice_CharacterTask3_11.value: We still have so much more to do!

FactoryOffice_CharacterTask4_01.value: This slogan...'Brand New and Vintage!' Was that your idea or theirs?

FactoryOffice_CharacterTask4_02.value: Hmm? Oh, theirs. Ridiculous, of course - t-shirts are not vintage!

FactoryOffice_CharacterTask4_03.value: I don't know...I wouldn't be surprised to find this kind of thing in a thrift store.

FactoryOffice_CharacterTask4_04.value: What?! This is the cutting edge of fashion!

FactoryOffice_CharacterTask4_05.value: Maybe it was when I was about two years old..

FactoryOffice_CharacterTask4_06.value: I...they...did use a lot of words like 'kitsch' and 'retro' but...

FactoryOffice_CharacterTask4_07.value: Oh my gosh. I think you might have attracted some honest-to-god hipsters, Leonard!

FactoryOffice_CharacterTask4_09.value: It's nothing to be ashamed of!

FactoryOffice_CharacterTask5_03.value: Yes. I...am going to have to reconsider this business deal.

FactoryOffice_CharacterTask5_04.value: I think it's a great idea!

FactoryOffice_CharacterTask5_05.value: Ah. A glowing recommendation from my grand-niece. Just what I always wanted.

FactoryOffice_CharacterTask5_06.value: Don't look a gift-horse in the mouth, Leonard. I think you were right.

FactoryOffice_CharacterTask5_07.value: Right? Of course I was right. About what, specifically, though?

FactoryOffice_CharacterTask5_08.value: I think you really were ahead of your time!

FactoryOffice_CharacterTask5_09.value: Ugh. I need to think. I'm going to my atelier.

FactoryOffice_CharacterTask5_11.value: At least we got rid of all the extra boxes of t-shirts-in-a-can.

FactoryOffice_CharacterTask5_12.value: Imagine if they might become expensive collector's items soon. Hah.

FactoryOffice_CharacterTask5_13.value: ...I should've snagged one when I had the chance...

FactoryOffice_Intro_01.value: I came as fast as I could! What’s-

FactoryOffice_Intro_04.value: Leonard?! What is he doing here?!

FactoryOffice_Intro_05.value: I heard some noise coming from the office and noticed that the door was open.

FactoryOffice_Intro_06.value: When I looked inside, there was a crash, and suddenly there were sparks everywhere!

FactoryOffice_Intro_08.value: Yes. I thought the place lacked a bit of energy...

FactoryOffice_Intro_10.value: OF COURSE I didn’t do it!

FactoryOffice_Intro_12.value: Oh, alright! Stay put while I get you out of this mess!

FactoryOffice_POI_AgathaIgnatiusPicture_.value: And done! Ignatius and Agatha, in all their glory.
This seems to have been taken to commemorate the opening of the tin can factory.
I wonder if they were really as happy as they look in this photo?
One thing is for sure: they definitely got a lot done! A real old-timey power couple...

FactoryOffice_POI_BestBossMug_01.value: What've we got here? A Best Boss Mug?!
What've we got here? A "Best Boss" mug?!

FactoryOffice_POI_BestBossMug_02.value: Leonard, why does this secret wall safe have a MUG in it??

FactoryOffice_POI_BestBossMug_03.value: Ah! I wondered where that disappeared to.

FactoryOffice_POI_BestBossMug_05.value: Ugh. And you also reminded me why I hid it. So garish. Keep it.

FactoryOffice_POI_BestBossMug_06.value: ...did they give you this, or did you buy it for yourself?

FactoryOffice_POI_BestBossMug_07.value: I can't believe you'd ask me that.

FactoryOffice_POI_Bookshelf_01.value: Right, good I got these sorted again. Alphabetically of course.

FactoryOffice_POI_Bookshelf_02.value: These all look like Ignatius's books. I'm curious about what he'd keep in his office.

FactoryOffice_POI_Bookshelf_03.value: 20.000 Leagues Under The Sea. Huh. A classic, but not what I expected.
20,000 Leagues Under The Sea. Huh. A classic, but not what I expected.

FactoryOffice_POI_Bookshelf_04.value: What's this...oh! Books on hydrology, physics and on the 'exothermic process'. Nice!

FactoryOffice_POI_Bookshelf_05.value: A lot of this stuff is just flat-out wrong, of course, but clearly Ignatius had a curious mind!

FactoryOffice_POI_BoultonCrest_01.value: Phew! That turned out pretty great, wouldn't you say, Leonard?

FactoryOffice_POI_BoultonCrest_02.value: The crest? Mmm, well, I suppose so. I think they should've let me redesign it, back in the day.

FactoryOffice_POI_BoultonCrest_03.value: Redesign...a crest? Is that something you do?

FactoryOffice_POI_BoultonCrest_04.value: Yes, when it's so uninspired! I mean, look at it! A tin can? A FROG? Is that really all we are?

FactoryOffice_POI_BoultonCrest_05.value: I mean, it's just a historical curiosity at this point...

FactoryOffice_POI_BoultonCrest_06.value: Pfah. You won't catch me dead wearing it anywhere in public, that's for certain...
Pff. You won't catch me dead wearing it anywhere in public; that's for certain...

FactoryOffice_POI_DeskWaterWheel_01.value: More water-themed gizmos. What a cute little water-wheel!

FactoryOffice_POI_DeskWaterWheel_02.value: According to the plaque it was Agatha's, gifted to her on their twentieth wedding anniversary by Ignatius!

FactoryOffice_POI_DeskWaterWheel_03.value: Aww. How sweet. I wonder if it spins or if it's just for show.

FactoryOffice_POI_DeskWaterWheel_04.value: ...oh! It does spin. And it seems to be playing a melody! It's really faint. Sounds sort of like a harp?

FactoryOffice_POI_DeskWaterWheel_05.value: I suppose the mechanism must've decayed over the years. It sounded melancholy.
I suppose the mechanism must've decayed over the years. It sounded melancholic.

FactoryOffice_POI_DeskWaterWheel_06.value: What an odd melody to put into an anniversary gift!

FactoryOffice_POI_FactoryModel_01.value: What a surprisingly detailed model of the factory.

FactoryOffice_POI_FactoryModel_02.value: This would've been useful to have while I was restoring the factory floor!

FactoryOffice_POI_FactoryModel_03.value: It has models of all the little machines and everything - and a little factory office too!

FactoryOffice_POI_FactoryModel_04.value: Except the bookshelf in the corner looks a little different. It looks sort of like an elevator...

FactoryOffice_POI_FactoryModel_05.value: ...no. Probably just something that got remodelled since Ignatius's time!

FactoryOffice_POI_FactoryModel_06.value: I wonder if we should display this down in the museum instead? I'll have to think about it.

FactoryOffice_POI_IgnatiusCorrespondence.value: Oh, old correspondence! Let's see who was on your mailing list, Ignatius.
Edison? Tesla? Looks like he was talking with the who's-who of the scientific community!
Most of these seem to be about Boultonite. They were really excited about it.
There are also some designs here - hidden compartments, moving doors...interesting.
Hah! Here's a design that looks sort of like that pedestal in the Spy Room!
Seems like quite a few of the moving parts of this mansion came from Ignatius, originally.

FactoryOffice_POI_SpyMessage_01.value: Huh...this can looks a bit different, somehow...

FactoryOffice_POI_SpyMessage_02.value: I hope Leonard won't mind if I take a peek inside.

FactoryOffice_POI_SpyMessage_03.value: Hold on - what's this? Is that a secret message?

FactoryOffice_POI_SpyMessage_04.value: It's old and faded... hm... and in some sort of code. But yep - this is definitely one of Ignatius's old secrets.

FactoryOffice_POI_SpyMessage_05.value: I suppose if there's one thing we Boultons are known for, it's keeping secrets. *sigh*

FactoryOffice_POI_SpyMessage_06.value: Luckily this one will almost certainly be way past it's sell-by date. Tin can or not!

FactoryOffice_POI_Telescope_01.value: A little bit of polishing, and it's as good as new!

FactoryOffice_POI_Telescope_02.value: Pfh, what a waste of space. There aren't even any neighbours in that direction to spy on.
Pfh, what a waste of space. There aren't even any neighbors in that direction to spy on.

FactoryOffice_POI_Telescope_03.value: This telescope is for observing our vast, amazing UNIVERSE, Leonard! You should try it someday!

FactoryOffice_POI_Telescope_04.value: Don't make me laugh, Maddie. I bet he never used it a day in his life.

FactoryOffice_POI_Telescope_05.value: Hmph. What makes you say that?

FactoryOffice_POI_Telescope_06.value: It's just a statement piece! A bit of shiny brass to show everyone how rich he was.

FactoryOffice_POI_Telescope_07.value: Then why did he build this observatory alcove for it?

FactoryOffice_POI_Telescope_08.value: ...so it wouldn't get in the way of his chair?

FactoryReception_02_01.value: Oof... This is A LOT of junk mail!

FactoryReception_02_04.value: Did he run the factory for a while?!

FactoryReception_02_05.value: Why yes, he did, Ma’am. For about 2 months.

FactoryReception_02_06.value: 2 months? I guess it didn’t go too well...

FactoryReception_02_10.value: As you can see, not his brightest idea.

FactoryReception_03_03.value: Winston told me it was Ignatius' design, but Agatha made sure it went on every single can. No exceptions.

FactoryReception_03_04.value: No wonder they had such an impact. They weren't just making cans, they made standards.

FactoryReception_03_05.value: Pioneers. Right down to the stamp on the tin.

FactoryReception_04_01.value: Oh, cool! An old employee time clock!

FactoryReception_04_02.value: This one is quite unique, actually. Ignatius designed it himself. Supposedly, it kept perfect time.

FactoryReception_04_03.value: We do like our clocks in the family.

FactoryReception_04_04.value: Ignatius always said, “Time is money.” With this, he meant it literally. He liked orderly paychecks.

FactoryReception_04_05.value: Hey! Let’s use this on the guests!

FactoryReception_04_07.value: I mean when guests come in, they can clock in their ticket!

FactoryReception_04_08.value: Then, when they leave, they can clock out!

FactoryReception_04_09.value: It'll make the experience of coming to the factory even more immersive!

FactoryReception_05_01.value: These photos must have been from the factory’s grand opening and ribbon-cutting ceremony.

FactoryReception_05_02.value: It was a grand day, Ma’am. Everyone from Hopewell Bay was there.

FactoryReception_05_03.value: I guess it was an important day for them.

FactoryReception_05_04.value: It indeed was, Ma’am. I often wish I could have seen it myself!

FactoryReception_05_05.value: Pardon me, but if you won’t be needing me anymore, I’ll be heading back to the Mansion.

FactoryReception_05_06.value: Ah yes, of course, Winston! You’ve really been a big help.

FactoryReception_06_01.value: Hmmm... Let’s fix up this refreshment corner!

FactoryReception_06_02.value: If the factory workers got to enjoy a good cup of Joe, then so shall my guests!

FactoryReception_06_04.value: And a selection of different beverages, auto frother and...

FactoryReception_06_05.value: A tasty accompaniment of baked goods and treats!

FactoryReception_07_01.value: Let’s set up a relaxing lounge as well, so that the guests can enjoy their coffee in peace.

FactoryReception_07_02.value: This couch managed to survive the elements as well.

FactoryReception_07_03.value: So, it’ll be nice for the guests to lounge on the same furniture.

FactoryReception_08_02.value: So, what do we have here...

FactoryReception_08_04.value: No way! A CB-01? I thought there was only one of these left.

FactoryReception_08_05.value: How are you holding up, buddy?

FactoryReception_08_07.value: In rough shape, huh? That beep sounded more like a cough.

FactoryReception_08_08.value: Don't worry, I'll have you fixed up in no time!

FactoryReception_09_01.value: First, let's bypass the damaged circuits... then I'll reroute power through the secondary panel...

FactoryReception_09_03.value: That's an improvement! It's missing the gemstone sensors, but the printer mechanism is intact.

FactoryReception_09_04.value: I'll give you a new life and a new job, you'll be our new ticket master.

FactoryReception_09_06.value: It's printing! Those four years of engineering school sure came in handy.

FactoryReception_09_07.value: A fresh polish and a system upgrade, you're gonna charm every museum visitor.

FactoryReception_10_01.value: What is this thing... an antique can opener?

FactoryReception_10_02.value: Not just antique, Maddie. I believe that is the very first can opener prototype!

FactoryReception_10_03.value: Julius?! I didn't hear you come in. Did you finish inspecting the grounds?

FactoryReception_10_04.value: Just did! And I'm ready to start working on the museum permits.

FactoryReception_10_05.value: Thanks for your help with this, Julius.

FactoryReception_10_06.value: But, the first prototype, huh? Makes sense that Ignatius would've thought of it.

FactoryReception_10_07.value: The grooves, the angle... This was the blueprint for everything that came after.

FactoryReception_10_08.value: It's a bit clunky by today's standards. Definitely fits better on a display counter than in the kitchen.

FactoryReception_10_09.value: Kitchen? Nonsense, this is the star of your museum!

FactoryReception_10_10.value: We'll need a plaque for our VIP: Very Important Prototype.

FactoryReception_11_01.value: A great museum starts with a great introduction. Let's give guests the full story right here in the reception.

FactoryReception_11_02.value: An infographic focusing on the history of the factory.

FactoryReception_11_03.value: Let's start bold: "The First Tin Can Factory in History!" in big letters. That'll catch their attention.

FactoryReception_11_04.value: Then the evolution: from Ignatius' very first tin cans, to Lindsay's spray cans, to...

FactoryReception_11_05.value: ...uhm, Leonard's t-shirts in a can... We'll tuck that one in the corner.

FactoryReception_11_06.value: And done! A timeline of how the Boultons packaged innovation, one can at a time.

FactoryReception_11_07.value: Wish I had one of these growing up. So much history even I don't know.

FactoryReception_11_08.value: But I'll start with what we can show.

FactoryReception_12_01.value: Chalk art and coat hooks, the guests will hang their coats in style.

FactoryReception_12_02.value: A perfect first impression! The reception is looking welcoming already.

FactoryReception_12_03.value: It's starting to feel so real, I can almost see the first guests.

FactoryReception_12_04.value: I'm looking forward to the opening myself. So much history is hiding between these walls!

FactoryReception_12_05.value: I'm learning so much as well. It's exciting to share this with the people of Hopewell Bay.

FactoryReception_12_06.value: Ignatius and Agatha Boulton would be proud. You're honoring their work beautifully.

FactoryReception_12_07.value: I hope so. They both put so much of themselves in the factory. It's sad to see it run-down.

FactoryReception_12_08.value: Well, it won't be run-down for much longer if you keep at this pace!

FactoryReception_12_09.value: Thank you for the support, Julius. It means a lot.

FactoryReception_12_10.value: You're doing a great service to the town's history, Maddie.

FactoryReception_13_01.value: That's the reception sorted. Floors waxed, displays up, and we even have a brand new ticket dispenser!

FactoryReception_13_03.value: It's remarkable, Ignatius would've been proud!

FactoryReception_13_04.value: Wait until you see what comes next! The factory floor has... potential.

FactoryReception_13_05.value: Now, that's intriguing. Anything you'd like to share?

FactoryReception_13_06.value: Not just yet, I wanna keep the mystery alive a little longer.

FactoryReception_13_07.value: Ah, yes, the good old Boulton secrecy. I'll hold down the fort here, then.

FactoryReception_13_08.value: Just don't get too comfortable! The best is yet to come.

FactoryReception_13_09.value: I'd expect nothing less from a Boulton project.

FactoryReception_13_10.value: But that's enough digging here for now. I think it's time I paid Grandma a visit.

FactoryReception_CharacterTask01_02.value: Julius, hi! Come on in. Are you here to look at the museum paperwork?

FactoryReception_CharacterTask01_03.value: In a moment. First, I need to inspect the yard. The town council is very picky about paving stones.

FactoryReception_CharacterTask01_04.value: Really? I thought this was just about the building itself.

FactoryReception_CharacterTask01_05.value: For a historical building, context is everything! Besides, I saw a few interesting pieces out there already.

FactoryReception_CharacterTask01_06.value: Okay, I'll be here. I have the structural survey papers with me if you need them.

FactoryReception_CharacterTask01_07.value: Good! That will help me cross-reference what I see out there.

FactoryReception_CharacterTask02_01.value: Welcome back, Julius. How's the inspection so far?

FactoryReception_CharacterTask02_02.value: Very good! I was glad to see that the flower beds were exactly measured.

FactoryReception_CharacterTask02_03.value: The town council is very picky about flower measurements.

FactoryReception_CharacterTask02_04.value: That's all Agatha Boulton's work! She was incredibly precise with her garden.

FactoryReception_CharacterTask02_05.value: She's also the one who planned the big water wheel by the river. Her designs were very well thought out.

FactoryReception_CharacterTask02_06.value: A remarkable woman. If her eye was on that wheel, I'm sure it would be safe for the guests.

FactoryReception_CharacterTask03_01.value: That vintage fire wagon outside is a magnificent piece! The brass work is superb.

FactoryReception_CharacterTask03_02.value: But I hope you have a more modern system installed inside?

FactoryReception_CharacterTask03_03.value: We do, state-of-the-art. Let me guess, the council is very picky about fire prevention systems?

FactoryReception_CharacterTask03_05.value: But you should be. It's your legacy you're protecting.

FactoryReception_CharacterTask03_06.value: I'm almost done with my rounds. One more and we can get started on the paperwork.

FactoryReception_CharacterTask03_07.value: Thank you for the help, Julius!

FactoryReception_CharacterTask04_01.value: Doing council paperwork is almost pleasant now that Victoria is gone.

FactoryReception_CharacterTask04_02.value: She sure liked to make it a nightmare. But I wonder what she's up to now.

FactoryReception_CharacterTask04_03.value: Well, I don't like to gossip... but I heard she joined a circus as a trapeze artist.

FactoryReception_CharacterTask04_04.value: That really doesn't sound like Victoria.

FactoryReception_CharacterTask04_05.value: The other rumor is that she's a contestant in a reality dating show.

FactoryReception_CharacterTask04_06.value: Julius... She's still married to Bruno.

FactoryReception_CharacterTask04_07.value: It's just a silly rumour. I'm sure it's nothing like that. Now, back to section 4B...

FactoryReception_CharacterTask05_01.value: The reception is looking great, Maddie. Your Grandma will love the place when she comes around.

FactoryReception_CharacterTask05_02.value: I'm not so sure, she's never happy when I go around unearthing the family's history.

FactoryReception_CharacterTask05_03.value: About that, I'm nearly finished with the museum's operating permits.

FactoryReception_CharacterTask05_04.value: Already?! You work faster than the old assembly line.

FactoryReception_CharacterTask05_05.value: Retirement suits paperwork. But I must say, this place has grown on me more than expected.

FactoryReception_CharacterTask05_06.value: Oh? Should I worry you'll start charging me antique prices?

FactoryReception_CharacterTask05_07.value: Quite the opposite! I'd like to volunteer at the reception, if you'll let me.

FactoryReception_CharacterTask05_08.value: Julius, are you actually offering to work for free?

FactoryReception_CharacterTask05_09.value: Consider it my donation to history.

FactoryReception_Intro_02.value: The reception of the Boulton Tin Can Factory!

FactoryReception_Intro_04.value: Do you actually have a key to everything?

FactoryReception_Intro_05.value: Why, of course I do, Ma’am! What kind of butler do you take me for?!

FactoryReception_Intro_07.value: Anyway, my apologies for the dire state of this place.

FactoryReception_Intro_08.value: But I’m sure you’re accustomed to this sort of thing by now.

FactoryReception_Intro_10.value: It’s actually in better shape than I had hoped.

FactoryReception_POI_CanOpener_01.value: The very first can opener, huh?

FactoryReception_POI_CanOpener_02.value: This must've sped up kitchen work by a lot.

FactoryReception_POI_CanOpener_03.value: I guess they had more counter space back then...

FactoryReception_POI_CanOpener_04.value: I mean, it takes up a lot of room, but it's got so much charm!

FactoryReception_POI_CanOpener_05.value: I wonder what Ignatius would say if he saw an electric pocket can opener.

FactoryReception_POI_CoffeeStation_01.value: These donuts and cinnamon buns are so fresh!

FactoryReception_POI_CoffeeStation_02.value: The smell alone should be enough to bring some people in.

FactoryReception_POI_CoffeeStation_03.value: I should probably try one to assure the quality.

FactoryReception_POI_CoffeeStation_04.value: Yeah, one of each. For the guests' sake, of course.

FactoryReception_POI_CoffeeStation_06.value: Perfect! A little sugar rush to fuel the history lesson.

FactoryReception_POI_Letters_01.value: I should probably go over these letters before throwing them out.

FactoryReception_POI_Letters_02.value: Hey, Winston! Check this one out: "To the Boultons, are you interested in a revolutionary new fax machine?"

FactoryReception_POI_Letters_03.value: I believe that particular revolution has come and gone, ma'am.

FactoryReception_POI_Letters_04.value: Ha! And this one is a notice for an unreturned DVD. The late fee must be huge by now.

FactoryReception_POI_Letters_05.value: Luckily for us, the rental store has been long-lost to the mists of time.

FactoryReception_POI_Letters_06.value: These letters are like a time capsule of obsolete things. I'm keeping them!

FactoryReception_POI_MysteryMachine_01.value: I knew our family was ahead of the times, but the CB-01is truly an amazing piece of engineering.
I knew our family was ahead of the times, but the CB-01 is truly an amazing piece of engineering.

FactoryReception_POI_MysteryMachine_02.value: I wonder when it was first installed here.

FactoryReception_POI_MysteryMachine_03.value: It must've been a hit with the workers!

FactoryReception_POI_MysteryMachine_05.value: I swear it feels like you can understand me sometimes.

FactoryReception_POI_Pictures_01.value: The pictures of Ignatius and Agatha at the grand opening... I can see the pride on their faces.

FactoryReception_POI_Pictures_02.value: And Winston wasn't exaggerating, it looks like all of Hopewell Bay was there.

FactoryReception_POI_Pictures_03.value: That's Ignatius giving his speech. And Agatha, making sure everything is running in order.

FactoryReception_POI_Pictures_04.value: I wish I could've been there to see the factory lit up and buzzing with life.

FactoryReception_POI_Pictures_05.value: But now I'm bringing that feeling back! The whole town, together in this place again.

FactoryReception_POI_Timetable_01.value: Winston, look! I've got the clock working. Visitors will punch in right by the main door.

FactoryReception_POI_Timetable_02.value: And are you confident about putting the guests to work? It's a rather authentic touch, I suppose.

FactoryReception_POI_Timetable_03.value: It's immersive! This makes them part of the factory's story.

FactoryReception_POI_Timetable_04.value: I just hope they won't expect a paycheck after clocking out.

FactoryReception_POI_Timetable_05.value: It'll be memorable! People love quirky, interactive things.

FactoryReception_POI_Timetable_06.value: As you say, ma'am. I'll prepare for the inevitable queue of overtime claims.

FamilyPicture_01.value: Aww! The whole family together. There's grandpa and Leonard and... wait!

FamilyPicture_02.value: Deb's missing! That's quite strange. Was it deliberate?

FamilyPicture_03.value: Hmm... I wonder if this has something to do with Winston's outburst!

FastMode_FTUEPopup_Section2_SubHeader_Ti.value: Get higher level items for 2x Energy!

FastMode_FTUE_Dialog.value:
Good job!
<color=#338DFF>Supercharge</color> has been unlocked!

Let's try it out on the Garage Board.

FieldComms_01.value: Ooh! A vintage radio, of sorts!

FieldComms_02.value: Hold on, was that someone speaking?

FieldComms_04.value: Still, someone was definitely using this to communicate with the outside.

FindKey_01.value: Hold on, something just caught my eye!

FindKey_02.value: Aha! It's a key! It must have been hidden inside the piano.

FindNorthWingKey_01.value: There! I have the key that unlocks a whole new wing of the mansion...

FindNorthWingKey_02.value: Nothing can hold me back from discovering the truth now!

Fireplace_01.value: Now that all the burnt cash has been taken out, this fireplace is actually quite lovely.

Fireplace_02.value: Surprisingly modern, considering when it was installed.

Fireplace_03.value: Well, Leonard was quite the visionary.

FirstFloorAtelier_02_01.value: Hello darlings! I thought I heard some noise back here!

FirstFloorAtelier_02_04.value: Lenny! Look at you, back at it! How long has it been?

FirstFloorAtelier_02_05.value: Since when? Since I last had a decent place to work?

FirstFloorAtelier_02_06.value: Exactly! Oh - the works of art we'd create in this place!

FirstFloorAtelier_02_07.value: Wait - did you also use this atelier, Aunt Deb?

FirstFloorAtelier_02_08.value: Oh, of course: as a model and muse, darling!

FirstFloorAtelier_03_01.value: The time I spent in front of this mirror when I was young...

FirstFloorAtelier_03_02.value: Modelling the most incredible pieces. Those were the days!

FirstFloorAtelier_03_03.value: You were indispensable whenever I needed a lady model, Debbie.

FirstFloorAtelier_03_04.value: Oh I know, Lenny. You did prefer to tailor for the gentlemen.

FirstFloorAtelier_03_05.value: Soo...have you always been interested in tailoring, Leonard?

FirstFloorAtelier_03_06.value: Since childhood, yes. I often travelled with my parents to Europe.

FirstFloorAtelier_03_07.value: They would get their clothes tailored. It was always an event.

FirstFloorAtelier_03_08.value: I suppose I picked up an interest then.

FirstFloorAtelier_04_01.value: I don't understand: why didn't you just become a tailor then, instead of the CEO?

FirstFloorAtelier_04_02.value: I DID become a tailor. In fact I apprenticed under a very famous Italian master...

FirstFloorAtelier_04_03.value: I spent years learning about fabrics, patterns, cutting and stitching.

FirstFloorAtelier_04_04.value: Oh, I remember that! You played hooky from that prestigious business school daddy sent you to!

FirstFloorAtelier_04_05.value: Hrm. I diversified my education, that's all.

FirstFloorAtelier_04_06.value: So you were actually supposed to be learning how to run a business? That explains things.

FirstFloorAtelier_04_07.value: Oh, don't be mean, darling. Lenny never had a head for numbers. Just an eye for fashion!

FirstFloorAtelier_04_08.value: But it didn't endear you to your daddy, did it?

FirstFloorAtelier_04_09.value: I've always been a misunderstood genius...

FirstFloorAtelier_05_01.value: Hmm. Looks like another hatch. Curious.

FirstFloorAtelier_05_02.value: Leonard? Why is there a hidden hatch in your floor?

FirstFloorAtelier_05_04.value: Don't you have more important things to do?

FirstFloorAtelier_05_05.value: Because I definitely do. Important phone calls, et cetera. Just put the carpet back.

FirstFloorAtelier_05_06.value: *sigh* If only I wasn't terminally curious...

FirstFloorAtelier_05_07.value: Oh! I remember this! It's an old puzzle! I wondered where it ended up.

FirstFloorAtelier_05_08.value: Do you know how to open it?

FirstFloorAtelier_05_09.value: You're going to need the missing piece, darling.

FirstFloorAtelier_06_01.value: Will you look at this Lenny? I don't think I've worn this since you got back from Italy!

FirstFloorAtelier_06_03.value: Your daddy was so angry at you when he found out you'd basically skipped all your classes!

FirstFloorAtelier_06_04.value: Hmph. I still got my degree, didn't I?

FirstFloorAtelier_06_05.value: Hah! Only because Leonardus bought the business school a new annex!

FirstFloorAtelier_06_06.value: I had no idea there was this much family drama going on!

FirstFloorAtelier_06_07.value: Although I guess I shouldn't be surprised.

FirstFloorAtelier_06_08.value: Oh, darling - this ain't nothing yet!

FirstFloorAtelier_07_01.value: You mentioned family drama, Aunt Deb?

FirstFloorAtelier_07_02.value: Oh, yes! This was after Lenny had come back from Italy a very sharply dressed disappointment.

FirstFloorAtelier_07_03.value: Do you really have to air all of our dirty laundry, Deb?

FirstFloorAtelier_07_04.value: Lighten up, Lenny. Maddie deserves to know, she's family!

FirstFloorAtelier_07_05.value: Besides, it's funny! You see, Leonardus decided Lenny here needed to get married post-haste!

FirstFloorAtelier_07_07.value: So he became a regular match-maker! Set Lenny up with this debutante or that socialite, date after date!

FirstFloorAtelier_07_08.value: He was considered quite the eligible bachelor! Remember how I'd have to come save you sometimes?

FirstFloorAtelier_07_09.value: I do. You would show up and pretend to be an angry lover. Ruined more than one silk shirt.

FirstFloorAtelier_07_10.value: The drink-in-your-face routine was absolutely central to my performance, brother dear!

FirstFloorAtelier_07_11.value: Mm. You should've been on broadway.

FirstFloorAtelier_08_01.value: As much fun as this has been, I have to go.

FirstFloorAtelier_08_03.value: The investors texted. They want to meet.

FirstFloorAtelier_08_04.value: Deb, will you be a dear and make sure Maddie doesn't turn my atelier into too much of a garish mess?

FirstFloorAtelier_08_06.value: Of course, Lennie darling. You go on! Good luck with your business!

FirstFloorAtelier_08_07.value: Hmph. I think I'm doing really well, actually!

FirstFloorAtelier_08_08.value: Don't mind your great-uncle, Maddie, he's just really excited about this deal.

FirstFloorAtelier_08_09.value: I just hope he doesn't mess it up. *sigh* That would really destroy him.

FirstFloorAtelier_08_10.value: We talked about it earlier. I don't think he will.

FirstFloorAtelier_09_01.value: You've found my hats! Aren't they stylish?

FirstFloorAtelier_09_03.value: He dabbled! These he made for me, to match my dresses he tailored.

FirstFloorAtelier_09_04.value: I had a Hepburn dress, a Grace Kelly dress...oh, my Jacqueline dress, my Bardot dress...

FirstFloorAtelier_09_05.value: You definitely had a lot of style inspirations, Aunt Deb!

FirstFloorAtelier_09_06.value: And Lennie was always ready to indulge me.

FirstFloorAtelier_09_07.value: Maybe I've misjudged him a little.

FirstFloorAtelier_09_08.value: Oh, he's far from perfect. Just keep him away from any authority. And gambling. And money.

FirstFloorAtelier_10_02.value: Heavens to Betsy! Has this been hidden here this whole time?

FirstFloorAtelier_10_04.value: That is a Butler's uniform. Like what dear old Winston wears.
That is a Butler's uniform. Tailored to fit a slightly younger Winston, I think.

FirstFloorAtelier_10_05.value: Why is it hidden like this?

FirstFloorAtelier_10_06.value: Lenny was making it as a surprise for Winston. They've always been...close. If you know what I mean.

FirstFloorAtelier_10_08.value: I think Leonard was hoping to one day be able to take Winston dancing.

FirstFloorAtelier_10_09.value: And he needed a proper uniform for that. *sigh*

FirstFloorAtelier_11_01.value: Leonard really needs to learn to take better care of his plants. At least I can reuse the soil...

FirstFloorAtelier_11_02.value: Darling, I'm afraid I need to start going. I've got to see to one of my projects.

FirstFloorAtelier_11_03.value: One of your projects, Aunt Deb?

FirstFloorAtelier_11_04.value: Yes! All of this renovating old hobbies has reminded me of one of my old flames...

FirstFloorAtelier_11_07.value: But wouldn't that require something like a...vineyard?
But wouldn't that require something like a...farm?

FirstFloorAtelier_11_08.value: Oh, look at the time! I best be going. And, Maddie?

FirstFloorAtelier_11_10.value: You really should dig deeper. Into that pot.

FirstFloorAtelier_11_11.value: ...and she's gone. But what did she mean by that? Dig deeper? Into the pot?

FirstFloorAtelier_11_12.value: I guess I could see what...oh! There's something in the soil!

FirstFloorAtelier_11_13.value: The last piece of the puzzle!

FirstFloorAtelier_12_01.value: What would Leonard consider so important he has to hide it so thoroughly?

FirstFloorAtelier_12_02.value: Blackmail? Proof of crimes? Counterfeit money?

FirstFloorAtelier_12_04.value: Oh! Oh my. PRIVATE letters. I should NOT be reading this.

FirstFloorAtelier_12_05.value: There are some pictures here too...oh.

FirstFloorAtelier_12_06.value: That's so cute! Look at them - so young and handsome and in love.

FirstFloorAtelier_12_07.value: But...hm...how did Leonard develop this photo? Did they have a photographer friend..?

FirstFloorAtelier_12_08.value: Hold on a second. What's that behind them? Is that...another door?

FirstFloorAtelier_12_09.value: I knew it! There's one more room - and I bet this key has something to do with it!
Judging by the angle of the photo...hm...the door should be...about there!

FirstFloorAtelier_12_10.value: I knew it! There's another room - and I bet this key has something to do with it!

FirstFloorAtelier_Intro_01.value: So this is what was behind this door...

FirstFloorAtelier_Intro_02.value: Maddie! Finally! Look at this absolute mess!

FirstFloorAtelier_Intro_03.value: Hello Leonard. You're still here, I see.

FirstFloorAtelier_Intro_04.value: Of course I am! I need my atelier restored, and quickly, girl.

FirstFloorAtelier_Intro_05.value: Frankly I cannot believe you've ignored it for this long!

FirstFloorAtelier_Intro_06.value: It is the most important room in the mansion, after all.

FirstFloorAtelier_Intro_07.value: Maybe I'll leave it to you to renovate then!

FirstFloorAtelier_Intro_09.value: I'm sorry. I really do need it. I want to show the investors I am serious.

FirstFloorAtelier_Intro_11.value: Let's get this atelier restored to its old glory!

FirstFloorAtelier_Outro_01.value: Hah, I did it! Another secret room revealed!

FirstFloorAtelier_Outro_02.value: I have an idea what might be in there...
It has to be something important to Leonard.

FirstFloorAtelier_Outro_03.value: ...but I have no idea why Leonard might have wanted to keep it secret!
Which must be why Leonard wanted to keep it secret!

FirstFloorAtelier_Outro_04.value: Well, he isn't here to protest, so I might as well explore.

FirstFloorAtelier_Outro_05.value: Time to find out what you're hiding, Great-Uncle...

FirstFloorAtelier_POI_DesignBoard_02.value: I guess this is where he planned his designs!

FirstFloorAtelier_POI_DesignBoard_03.value: Looks like he was going beyond just tailoring.

FirstFloorAtelier_POI_DesignBoard_04.value: These look like plans for a whole line of fashion.

FirstFloorAtelier_POI_DesignBoard_06.value: And instead of all of that, we got T-shirts-in-a-can...

FirstFloorAtelier_POI_FabricTable_01.value: So this is where the magic happened, huh?

FirstFloorAtelier_POI_FabricTable_02.value: It was! Lennie would sit cross-legged on the table, right there, to do the hand-stitching!

FirstFloorAtelier_POI_FabricTable_04.value: Yes! It's called the tailor's pose. I thought it looked ridiculous. A grown man in a suit!

FirstFloorAtelier_POI_FabricTable_05.value: But I think those times were when Lennie was the happiest...

FirstFloorAtelier_POI_HatstandEmpty_01.value: Hmmm...these are clearly hatstands...but I don't see any hats.

FirstFloorAtelier_POI_HatstandEmpty_02.value: Also - why would there be hats? Leonard was a tailor, not a...

FirstFloorAtelier_POI_HatstandEmpty_03.value: ...what is it called again? A milliner? Hmm.

FirstFloorAtelier_POI_HatstandEmpty_04.value: I better leave them empty for now.
