FirstFloorAtelier_POI_Mannequin_01.value: Sure are a lot of mannequins in here.

FirstFloorAtelier_POI_Mannequin_02.value: And these are some fancy clothes they're displaying.

FirstFloorAtelier_POI_Mannequin_03.value: That one is an early version of a wedding jacket Lennie made, for a senator!

FirstFloorAtelier_POI_Mannequin_04.value: Wow! I didn't know his clientele was so refined.

FirstFloorAtelier_POI_Mannequin_05.value: Oh, it was. His waiting list was the who's-who of Hopewell Bay!

FirstFloorAtelier_POI_PuzzleIncomplete_0.value: Now all that I need is the final piece to slot in here, and I'll finally find out what Leonard is hiding...
Good! Leave that thing alone, and get back to work!

FirstFloorDarkRoom_02_End_01.value: This definitely looks like the same counterfeit cash as the Lounge!

FirstFloorDarkRoom_02_End_02.value: Why do I feel like I'm just stacking up evidence here?

FirstFloorDarkRoom_02_End_03.value: I should probably call the police, but...

FirstFloorDarkRoom_02_End_04.value: ...that would put Leonard in serious trouble.

FirstFloorDarkRoom_02_End_05.value: I better keep looking. Maybe there's an explanation.

FirstFloorDarkRoom_02_Start_02.value: I wonder if this is where all the fake cash in the Lounge came from?

FirstFloorDarkRoom_02_Start_03.value: This isn't looking very good for you, Leonard...

FirstFloorDarkRoom_03_End_01.value: It's shut tight! I'm locked in!

FirstFloorDarkRoom_03_End_04.value: Okay, Maddie. Calm down. There's probably some way to open it up from in here.

FirstFloorDarkRoom_03_End_05.value: This red light is a little eerie, but I can still see by it.

FirstFloorDarkRoom_03_Start_01.value: What's this? Looks like meeting notes. A lot of them.

FirstFloorDarkRoom_03_Start_02.value: These are all hand-written! And the handwriting is the same as on Leonard's idea board in the Atelier!

FirstFloorDarkRoom_03_Start_03.value: Date, time, location, and who was present.

FirstFloorDarkRoom_03_Start_04.value: The names appear to be in code, though, but I bet they're mobsters.

FirstFloorDarkRoom_04_End_01.value: This must be how Leonard developed that photo of him and Winston.

FirstFloorDarkRoom_04_End_02.value: But I can't imagine him setting up this whole lab by himself.

FirstFloorDarkRoom_04_End_03.value: No. This smells of Grandpa Charlie and Grandma.

FirstFloorDarkRoom_04_End_04.value: Maybe there's some more clues around here.

FirstFloorDarkRoom_04_Start_01.value: Well, this explains the red light. This is a darkroom.

FirstFloorDarkRoom_04_Start_02.value: I wonder if these chemicals still work?

FirstFloorDarkRoom_04_Start_03.value: I did take Photography 101 in college. I bet I could still develop a photo.

FirstFloorDarkRoom_04_Start_04.value: Not that it's going to help me get out of here!

FirstFloorDarkRoom_05_End_01.value: Wait...what's this? Looks like a roll of undeveloped film.

FirstFloorDarkRoom_05_End_02.value: I think something's written on it..."CRITICAL EVIDENCE"?!

FirstFloorDarkRoom_05_End_03.value: I know I should be looking for a way out, but...

FirstFloorDarkRoom_05_End_04.value: How can I ignore a roll of film that says "CRITICAL EVIDENCE"?!

FirstFloorDarkRoom_05_End_05.value: Okay, Maddie. Time to put those college credits to use!

FirstFloorDarkRoom_05_Start_01.value: Looking at all of this is really bringing back memories of photography class!

FirstFloorDarkRoom_05_Start_02.value: Seems like everything I need is still here.

FirstFloorDarkRoom_05_Start_03.value: Developer, fixer, plastic gloves, timers, even a thermometer.

FirstFloorDarkRoom_05_Start_04.value: It just needs a little bit of organizing.

FirstFloorDarkRoom_06_End_02.value: Who's there?! I've got a garden shear and I'm not afraid to use it!

FirstFloorDarkRoom_06_End_05.value: I came looking for you, and found this strange door.

FirstFloorDarkRoom_06_End_06.value: I was trapped in here! Someone locked me in!

FirstFloorDarkRoom_06_End_08.value: I don't know - but I do know this place was used for some shady business.

FirstFloorDarkRoom_06_End_09.value: And there's something else: look at this photo I just developed-

FirstFloorDarkRoom_06_Start_01.value: Okaaay...and then the last step is hanging them up to dry...

FirstFloorDarkRoom_06_Start_02.value: Whoa. This sure is a lot of gangsters.

FirstFloorDarkRoom_06_Start_03.value: I think that one is Vincent Crutchley, the mob boss...

FirstFloorDarkRoom_06_Start_05.value: Hold on. Who's in this picture? That's Crutchley, together with...

FirstFloorDarkRoom_06_Start_07.value: Hey! Who turned on the light?!

FirstFloorDarkRoom_07_End_01.value: There's someone in the mansion, I'm sure of it.

FirstFloorDarkRoom_07_End_02.value: There are a lot of people in the mansion, Maddie!

FirstFloorDarkRoom_07_End_03.value: I mean someone who shouldn't be here.

FirstFloorDarkRoom_07_End_04.value: And you think they shut you in here on purpose?

FirstFloorDarkRoom_07_Start_01.value: Who was in the photo, Maddie?

FirstFloorDarkRoom_07_Start_02.value: I...that isn't important right now. Did you see anyone when you came back?

FirstFloorDarkRoom_07_Start_03.value: I saw Winston in the parlor. Great work fixing it up, by the way!

FirstFloorDarkRoom_07_Start_05.value: Suspicious? Maddie, what are you talking about?

FirstFloorDarkRoom_08_Start_01.value: A...are you sure we should stay here? What if they come back?

FirstFloorDarkRoom_08_Start_02.value: There might be more proof here. I have to keep looking.

FirstFloorDarkRoom_08_Start_03.value: Now you're starting to sound like Jackie.

FirstFloorDarkRoom_08_Start_04.value: That reminds me: she came to see me! She said someone was trailing her.

FirstFloorDarkRoom_08_Start_05.value: What? Why? Because of her investigation into her sister?

FirstFloorDarkRoom_08_Start_06.value: Yes! She thinks her sister might have been set up.

FirstFloorDarkRoom_08_Start_09.value: Maybe we can find something here to help her too, then?

FirstFloorDarkRoom_09_End_01.value: Most of this stuff is pretty old.

FirstFloorDarkRoom_09_End_02.value: Compared to what we found in the Spy Room, this is practically antiquated!

FirstFloorDarkRoom_09_End_04.value: Is this really the time, Roddy?

FirstFloorDarkRoom_09_End_05.value: I just don't want you to be angry with me.

FirstFloorDarkRoom_09_End_06.value: Ugh. I am a little annoyed at you. But...

FirstFloorDarkRoom_09_End_08.value: But it will pass. Who were you trying to impress anyway with your knife-juggling?

FirstFloorDarkRoom_09_End_10.value: Do you think he was impressed?

FirstFloorDarkRoom_10_End_01.value: What are we looking for anyway?

FirstFloorDarkRoom_10_End_02.value: This room was used by Grandpa Charlie and Grandma for spying on the mob.

FirstFloorDarkRoom_10_End_04.value: This is where they developed them.

FirstFloorDarkRoom_10_End_05.value: Which means they kept using this room even after upgrading.

FirstFloorDarkRoom_10_End_06.value: And then there was this list Leonard wrote.

FirstFloorDarkRoom_10_End_07.value: Look - it's meeting notes. Attendees. This is evidence!

FirstFloorDarkRoom_10_End_08.value: Maddie...it's evidence that will put Leonard away!

FirstFloorDarkRoom_10_End_09.value: Not that he wouldn't deserve it, but...

FirstFloorDarkRoom_10_End_10.value: Maybe not. Think about it. Why would he be making such detailed notes?

FirstFloorDarkRoom_10_End_11.value: Oooh. You think he wanted leverage!

FirstFloorDarkRoom_11_End_01.value: So Leonard has been gathering evidence against the mob. Incredible.

FirstFloorDarkRoom_11_End_02.value: For leverage. Don't give him too much credit.

FirstFloorDarkRoom_11_End_03.value: It explains why they never went after him.

FirstFloorDarkRoom_11_End_04.value: It's no use though if we don't know who is behind these codenames.

FirstFloorDarkRoom_11_End_05.value: I mean...look at these. 'Liberty', 'Major', 'Crown', 'Angler'...it could be anyone!

FirstFloorDarkRoom_11_End_07.value: I don't want to involve him yet.

FirstFloorDarkRoom_11_End_08.value: Okay, Maddie. Let's keep looking. Maybe there are more clues!

FirstFloorDarkRoom_12_End_01.value: I don't think Leonard ever even touched this part of the room.

FirstFloorDarkRoom_12_End_03.value: Can I take a look at Leonard's notes again?

FirstFloorDarkRoom_12_End_07.value: All the other names are just a single code-name except this one.

FirstFloorDarkRoom_12_End_08.value: This one says 'Crown Prince'. And look: there is already a 'Crown'.

FirstFloorDarkRoom_12_End_09.value: Perhaps...a son? That could be a clue!

FirstFloorDarkRoom_13_End_05.value: I'm here in the mansion with...

FirstFloorDarkRoom_13_End_08.value: I promise. Me too. Okay, bye.

FirstFloorDarkRoom_14_End_02.value: And how come she called you?

FirstFloorDarkRoom_14_End_03.value: She is staking out the mansion to see if she could spot who was following her.

FirstFloorDarkRoom_14_End_04.value: And she said she saw someone sneak in just now!

FirstFloorDarkRoom_14_End_05.value: Did she see who it was?

FirstFloorDarkRoom_14_End_06.value: No, but she said we should watch out!

FirstFloorDarkRoom_15_End_01.value: What are you really doing here, Detective Sullivan?

FirstFloorDarkRoom_15_End_02.value: Like I said, I am conducting a search. This room looks very interesting, so I think I will start here.

FirstFloorDarkRoom_15_End_03.value: Oh yeah? Don't you need a warrant for that?

FirstFloorDarkRoom_15_End_04.value: Normally, yes. But this pile of money gives me probable cause.

FirstFloorDarkRoom_15_End_07.value: Wait! Kate. There's more to this.

FirstFloorDarkRoom_15_End_08.value: There are much bigger fish to fry here.

FirstFloorDarkRoom_15_Start_01.value: Okay, let's get out of here before...

FirstFloorDarkRoom_15_Start_04.value: I have to say I am surprised - this room did not show up on any of the blueprints!

FirstFloorDarkRoom_15_Start_05.value: What are you doing here, Kate?

FirstFloorDarkRoom_15_Start_06.value: Investigating. You didn't think the case was closed, did you?

FirstFloorDarkRoom_15_Start_07.value: Hold on a second...is it YOU who has been following Jackie?

FirstFloorDarkRoom_15_Start_08.value: I can't comment on an ongoing investigation.

FirstFloorDarkRoom_15_Start_09.value: You can't just sneak in here like this.

FirstFloorDarkRoom_15_Start_10.value: Sneak in? I'm conducting a lawful search, thank you very much.

FirstFloorDarkRoom_Intro_End_01.value: Crazy to think this was hidden here this entire time.

FirstFloorDarkRoom_Intro_End_02.value: But I guess it's not the craziest thing I've found in this house!

FirstFloorDarkRoom_Intro_End_03.value: I wonder what it was used for?

FirstFloorDarkRoom_Intro_Start_01.value: What have we got here? *cough* Dusty!

FirstFloorDarkRoom_Intro_Start_02.value: Hmm. Looks like it hasn't been in use for a while.

FirstFloorDarkRoom_Intro_Start_03.value: Leonard must've known about it, it was right next to his atelier!

FirstFloorDarkRoom_Intro_Start_04.value: I wonder why he kept it hidden though.

FirstFloorDarkRoom_Outro_01.value: ...and that's how it all fits together. You have to believe us.

FirstFloorDarkRoom_Outro_02.value: You must think I was born yesterday.

FirstFloorDarkRoom_Outro_03.value: I know you're itching to catch Crutchley, after he slipped through your fingers last time!

FirstFloorDarkRoom_Outro_05.value: These are all codenames. Useless unless your great-uncle tells me who they are.

FirstFloorDarkRoom_Outro_06.value: I can use this money-printer to put the pressure on him. Make him talk.

FirstFloorDarkRoom_Outro_07.value: Kate...if the mob finds out about this, who knows what they'll do to him.

FirstFloorDarkRoom_Outro_08.value: A couple of candid photos and a list of made-up names isn't going to be enough. I need more proof than this.

FirstFloorDarkRoom_Outro_09.value: Then give us a chance to find it!

FirstFloorDarkRoom_Outro_10.value: I don't know. It's not procedure.

FirstFloorDarkRoom_Outro_11.value: This is your chance to make up for past mistakes, Kate.

FirstFloorDarkRoom_Outro_12.value: We'll work together again - without the lies.

FirstFloorDarkRoom_Outro_13.value: I'll...think about it. I guess I do owe you, Roddy.

FirstFloorDarkRoom_Outro_15.value: Now get out. I have to catalogue all of this.

FirstFloorDarkRoom_POI_Blueprint_02.value: This is a blueprint of the Spy Room!

FirstFloorDarkRoom_POI_Blueprint_03.value: I guess they outgrew this room at some point.

FirstFloorDarkRoom_POI_Blueprint_04.value: The Spy Room was definitely an upgrade!

FirstFloorDarkRoom_POI_ButlerStatue_02.value: The outfit looks like something tailored by Leonard.

FirstFloorDarkRoom_POI_ButlerStatue_03.value: Did he move this mannequin here at some point from the Atelier?

FirstFloorDarkRoom_POI_ButlerStatue_05.value: And what is up with this big red button. Should I...press it?

FirstFloorDarkRoom_POI_ButlerStatue_06.value: No. Better not. I've got enough excitement already.

FirstFloorDarkRoom_POI_Lightbox_01.value: Oh! I know what this is. We had one at the photo lab at college.

FirstFloorDarkRoom_POI_Lightbox_02.value: I bet they used it to view negatives before developing the photos.

FirstFloorDarkRoom_POI_Lightbox_03.value: Too bad I didn't notice it before...

FirstFloorDarkRoom_POI_Lightbox_04.value: Let's see what they were looking at.

FirstFloorDarkRoom_POI_Lightbox_05.value: Looks like a...beach resort? I wonder...

FirstFloorDarkRoom_POI_OldCameras_01.value: These can't possibly have been used for spying!

FirstFloorDarkRoom_POI_OldCameras_04.value: Looks like someone was a collector. Probably Grandpa Charlie.

FirstFloorDarkRoom_POI_RedCamera_01.value: Huh. I wonder what this is.

FirstFloorDarkRoom_POI_RedCamera_02.value: A camera, maybe. But what's with the red light?

FirstFloorDarkRoom_POI_RedCamera_03.value: Probably something to do with Grandpa's and Grandma's spy business...

FirstFloorDarkRoom_POI_RedCamera_04.value: I better not touch it. Might be booby-trapped!

FirstFloorDarkRoom_POI_SlideTray_01.value: What's this? Looks like a tray full of slides.

FirstFloorDarkRoom_POI_SlideTray_02.value: Hard to see what's on them.

FirstFloorDarkRoom_POI_SlideTray_04.value: Without context, these aren't very useful.

FirstFloorDarkRoom_POI_WigsShelf_01.value: Hmmm. Should I be blonde...or maybe brunette?

FirstFloorDarkRoom_POI_WigsShelf_02.value: I...I think your hair is really nice already.

FirstFloorDarkRoom_POI_WigsShelf_03.value: Thank you Roddy. Maybe I could do a fringe?

FirstFloorDarkRoom_POI_WigsShelf_04.value: Think I would fit in a mullet?

FirstFloorDarkRoom_POI_WigsShelf_05.value: I guess these wigs are a little...out of date, as far as hair-fashion is concerned...

FirstFloorHallway_02_02.value: Ah yes, The SS Auralis. Clara built this with her father, Ignatius.

FirstFloorHallway_02_03.value: They were very close, those too. Encouraging her to follow her dreams...
They were very close, those two. Encouraging her to follow her dreams...

FirstFloorHallway_02_04.value: This ship's joined the famed 1773 expedition into the arctic. It was always a source of inspiration for her.

FirstFloorHallway_02_05.value: That doesn't sound too bad, sharing some time with your daughter?

FirstFloorHallway_02_06.value: No, not at all. I sometimes wished I had a similar relationship with my father.

FirstFloorHallway_02_07.value: I'm sure Agatha was very proud of her as well!

FirstFloorHallway_02_10.value: She thought this sort of "adventurous" life was beneath a Boulton Woman.

FirstFloorHallway_03_01.value: I'm surprised that Agatha was so hard on her!

FirstFloorHallway_03_02.value: To be fair, she was only looking out for her best interests...

FirstFloorHallway_03_06.value: In fact... I don't think she ever forgave herself after Clara's passing.

FirstFloorHallway_03_09.value: When a parent loses a child...

FirstFloorHallway_03_12.value: It's alright. I know... I don't blame you.

FirstFloorHallway_04_01.value: *Sigh* You know, after you told me about Clara building that ship with her dad...

FirstFloorHallway_04_03.value: It would have been great to share some time with Dad...

FirstFloorHallway_04_04.value: Perhaps build one of his model airplanes, together?

FirstFloorHallway_04_05.value: I'm sure he would have loved that.

FirstFloorHallway_05_01.value: Well... This little reading nook came out really nice!

FirstFloorHallway_05_02.value: It really did, dearie! It's just like I remember it!

FirstFloorHallway_05_04.value: Looks like a sketch of a sailor.

FirstFloorHallway_05_05.value: This must be him! Clara's love! The one who ran away!

FirstFloorHallway_05_06.value: Yes, I believe so. I also believe she drew that!

FirstFloorHallway_05_07.value: Hmmm. Edward... That's the name at the bottom of the sketch.

FirstFloorHallway_05_08.value: She must have really loved him, to make such an intricate drawing.

FirstFloorHallway_05_09.value: Actually, she was an incredibly talented artist!

FirstFloorHallway_05_10.value: Being a marine biologist meant taking lots of sketches of your specimens.

FirstFloorHallway_05_11.value: So she had a lot of practice.

FirstFloorHallway_05_12.value: I bet she would have made an amazing marine biologist!

FirstFloorHallway_06_03.value: Just thinking about how that sailor, Edward, could just up and leave Clara like that.

FirstFloorHallway_06_04.value: Sometimes you just don't know people...

FirstFloorHallway_06_06.value: I'm reading some of their correspondence I found here and I can't help but feel like he was truly in love with her.

FirstFloorHallway_06_07.value: Truly, DEEPLY in love with her! The things he writes... What he hopes for them. For HER!

FirstFloorHallway_06_08.value: It's just weird that someone who writes like that, would just leave without a word!
It's just weird that someone who writes like that would just leave without a word!

FirstFloorHallway_06_09.value: I know, dearie. In fact, I need to leave as well.

FirstFloorHallway_06_11.value: That's okay, Grandma. I'll continue here!

FirstFloorHallway_07_01.value: Poor Clara, being ghosted like that!

FirstFloorHallway_07_02.value: I guess I can relate as well, being ghosted at the altar no less!

FirstFloorHallway_07_03.value: And now Arthur has come back, as if nothing ever happened!

FirstFloorHallway_07_06.value: Why would he do that, if it weren't real?

FirstFloorHallway_07_07.value: Like Edward with Clara in those letters...

FirstFloorHallway_07_08.value: Maybe... He really still loves me?

FirstFloorHallway_07_09.value: Maybe there's something deeper after all...

FirstFloorHallway_07_10.value: Come on, Maddie. Pull yourself together!

FirstFloorHallway_08_02.value: I'm quite surprised to find these tarot cards among Clara's things.

FirstFloorHallway_08_03.value: As a woman of science, I would have thought she didn't believe in it.

FirstFloorHallway_08_04.value: Actually... They're probably here just for fun. I might as well give them a go, then.

FirstFloorHallway_08_05.value: So, cards... What do you have in store for me? What should I do with Arthur?

FirstFloorHallway_08_07.value: The Devil and The Magician cards!

FirstFloorHallway_08_08.value: I don't know what that exactly means, but it can't be good. Maybe I should look this up?

FirstFloorHallway_08_09.value: Nah. I don't believe in this sort of stuff.

FirstFloorHallway_09_03.value: She really was into marine biology, but mermaids weren't real.
She really was into marine biology, but mermaids aren't real.

FirstFloorHallway_09_04.value: Actually, this sort of reminds me of the story of The Little Mermaid.

FirstFloorHallway_09_05.value: How she fell in love with a prince and-

FirstFloorHallway_09_07.value: I think she saw herself as the mermaid...

FirstFloorHallway_10_02.value: I managed to put together this tower, using Clara's amazing notes.

FirstFloorHallway_10_03.value: Never knew that coral made their own skeletons using limestone!

FirstFloorHallway_10_04.value: Or that they get their color from algae!

FirstFloorHallway_10_05.value: Using her notes, I'm pretty sure I got their colors accurate as well.

FirstFloorHallway_10_06.value: She really was a great marine biologist.

FirstFloorHallway_11_04.value: A plaque with what looks like latin on it...

FirstFloorHallway_11_08.value: I guess this was to display the unlimited potential of the sea?

FirstFloorHallway_11_10.value: The freedom to be whoever you want to be.

FirstFloorHallway_11_11.value: Maybe Clara didn't want to be just another socialite.

FirstFloorHallway_11_12.value: Just like Lindsay, she chose her love over what was pre-decided for her!

FirstFloorHallway_11_13.value: *sigh* I just wish it would have had a happy ending...

FirstFloorHallway_12_03.value: What's this! Looks like a hidden compartment.

FirstFloorHallway_12_05.value: It's from Edward to Clara! She... She never received it!

FirstFloorHallway_12_06.value: Oh, he confesses everything here! It was Agatha! She sent him away!

FirstFloorHallway_12_07.value: She believed Edward was not the right man for her, that Clara needed a high society man.

FirstFloorHallway_12_08.value: So she paid him off and sent him away. But he couldn't do it without telling Clara the truth!

FirstFloorHallway_12_09.value: He must have left this to Agatha to give to Clara... But she never did!
He must have left this for Agatha to give to Clara... But she never did!

FirstFloorHallway_13_01.value: Hmmm... I still don't buy it.

FirstFloorHallway_13_02.value: Even though he sent that last message to her that she never got, I feel like something is missing.

FirstFloorHallway_13_03.value: I just refuse to believe he'd just leave! Maybe there's something in the files that Holden found...

FirstFloorHallway_13_04.value: Let's see here... Some receipts, ship logs, transfer requests...

FirstFloorHallway_13_06.value: Transfer requests?! It says here that there was a high level request to transfer Edward back to Hopewell Bay!

FirstFloorHallway_13_08.value: She must have had second thoughts and asked for him back! But...

FirstFloorHallway_13_09.value: The ship that was bringing him back was the one that sunk!

FirstFloorHallway_13_12.value: AH! That rat from the dining room! It's back!

FirstFloorHallway_13_13.value: I should follow it! Maybe I could find its nest!

FirstFloorHallway_CharacterTask1_01.value: Holden? What are you doing up here?

FirstFloorHallway_CharacterTask1_02.value: Oh...Maddie. I thought you were still busy renovating the factory.
Oh... Maddie. I thought you were still busy renovating the factory.

FirstFloorHallway_CharacterTask1_03.value: Nope, I came up here to see to the first floor. The factory can wait.

FirstFloorHallway_CharacterTask1_04.value: Hmm. Well. The article was a great success. Now my readers are ravenous for more salacious Boulton secrets.

FirstFloorHallway_CharacterTask1_05.value: Wait - what? I thought you were just covering the renovation! What secrets?

FirstFloorHallway_CharacterTask1_06.value: I'm a journalist! I have integrity! I had to include a bit of background. Such as...who their daughter was.
I'm a journalist! I have integrity! I had to include a bit of background. Such as... who their daughter was.

FirstFloorHallway_CharacterTask2_01.value: The Plunderer of Hearts'. Hmm. 'Left at the Dock: An exposé of Clara Boulton's secret lover'...

FirstFloorHallway_CharacterTask2_03.value: Just thinking of titles for the piece. Everyone knows Clara's story, that's old news. But what about her sailor?

FirstFloorHallway_CharacterTask2_04.value: What dirty tricks did he use to snare her in his net? How did he begin his campaign of seduction...

FirstFloorHallway_CharacterTask2_05.value: Why are you so sure he had bad intentions? What if they just loved each other?

FirstFloorHallway_CharacterTask2_06.value: Then he wouldn't have left her at the dock, would he? Get real, Maddie.

FirstFloorHallway_CharacterTask3_01.value: I've been looking into some old records, and you wouldn't believe what I've found!

FirstFloorHallway_CharacterTask3_02.value: What? You've been doing actual research?

FirstFloorHallway_CharacterTask3_03.value: No. But the expression on your face tells me that will be a killer line in my exposé!

FirstFloorHallway_CharacterTask3_04.value: Ugh. You know there's clearly an actual story here, if you'd only pay a bit of attention.

FirstFloorHallway_CharacterTask3_05.value: Fine. I can go dig around in the archive, I suppose. But I better find something really juicy!

FirstFloorHallway_CharacterTask3_06.value: His name was Edward. But that's all I know. Except that he was a sailor.

FirstFloorHallway_CharacterTask4_01.value: Well, well, well, Maddie. Looks like I was right all along. Look what I found.

FirstFloorHallway_CharacterTask4_02.value: I'm not going to fall for that trick twice, Holden. Did you actually find something?

FirstFloorHallway_CharacterTask4_03.value: I did! It turns out the Hopewell Bay maritime museum has quite the treasure of harbor logs from times past!

FirstFloorHallway_CharacterTask4_04.value: I found a notice warning harbor-masters of avoiding one Ed Deepdale - infamous pirate, bootlegger and womanizer!

FirstFloorHallway_CharacterTask4_05.value: That can't be Clara's Edward! Read his description.

FirstFloorHallway_CharacterTask4_06.value: Hmm. 'Eye-patch. Blonde hair. Hook nose. Gold nose piercing. Tattoo of an anchor on his right cheek.'

FirstFloorHallway_CharacterTask5_01.value: Ugh. This is the last time I do actual research - all that work, for nothing!

FirstFloorHallway_CharacterTask5_02.value: Don't say that, Holden. You did good work digging up this Ed Deepdale. Even if he is not Clara's Edward.

FirstFloorHallway_CharacterTask5_03.value: I'm sure your readers would love learning about colorful characters from Hopewell's history that aren't Boultons?

FirstFloorHallway_CharacterTask5_04.value: Don't be ridiculous, Maddie. You wouldn't make it a day as editor at the Holden Howler.

FirstFloorHallway_CharacterTask5_05.value: Umm. I don't...think I ever said I want to work as editor at the Holden Howler?

FirstFloorHallway_CharacterTask5_06.value: Freelance, of course. If you think you can find something in all of this, get in touch. You have my number.

FirstFloorHallway_CharacterTask5_07.value: I....don't....uh. Great. He's gone. Now what am I supposed to do with all of this stuff...

FirstFloorHallway_CharacterTask5_08.value: Hmm. Well, this is solid research, despite everything. Maybe there really is something here about Edward?

FirstFloorHallway_CharacterTask5_09.value: Once I'm done with the rest of the room, I'll take a second look!

FirstFloorHallway_Intro_01.value: Yes! A whole new floor to explore and restore!

FirstFloorHallway_Intro_02.value: I'll be the first to admit it, dearie. You've done an amazing job so far.

FirstFloorHallway_Intro_03.value: That's why I'm looking forward to what you do here!

FirstFloorHallway_Intro_04.value: What is this place? Almost looks like a nautical museum...

FirstFloorHallway_Intro_05.value: I wonder if Clara had anything to do with it?

FirstFloorHallway_Intro_06.value: She did! This was her favorite room...

FirstFloorHallway_Intro_08.value: Then I won't let neither of you down!
Then I won't let either of you down!

FirstFloorHallway_POI_AnglerFish_01.value: Aren't you a scary pair of specimens? I wonder how Clara got a hold of anglerfish skeletons?

FirstFloorHallway_POI_AnglerFish_02.value: Ah! Says here they were found off the coast of Greenland in the 1800s. They were a great mystery to science.

FirstFloorHallway_POI_AnglerFish_03.value: To think it was another century before anglerfish like these were observed in their actual habitat...
To think it was another century before angler fish like these were observed in their natural habitat...

FirstFloorHallway_POI_AnglerFish_04.value: Hmm. Maybe I can borrow them next Halloween? They do make for spooky decorations.

FirstFloorHallway_POI_ButterflyDisplay_0.value: I now know more about butterfly taxonomies than I ever thought I would have to.
Looks like Lindsay was not the only one in the family fascinated by butterflies.
But I think that ends with me - lepidopterology is definitely not in my wheelhouse!

FirstFloorHallway_POI_CoralTowerSketches.value: Aha! I think I've figured it out!
All these notes - they're for a tower displaying all kinds of corals!
Looks like she never finished it herself. Well, Clara, I will!

FirstFloorHallway_POI_CupidStatue_01.value: Cupid! Why am I not surprised to see you again?

FirstFloorHallway_POI_CupidStatue_02.value: I wonder if things would have been better, had your arrows hit some handsome Polar-exploring nobleman...

FirstFloorHallway_POI_CupidStatue_03.value: But who's to say he would have let her join him in exploring the world? *sigh* Poor Clara.

FirstFloorHallway_POI_CurioArea_01.value: What a statement piece - a perpetual calendar. This must have cost an arm and a leg.

FirstFloorHallway_POI_CurioArea_02.value: I wonder if it's still accurate....let's see....
I wonder if it's still accurate.... let's see....

FirstFloorHallway_POI_CurioArea_03.value: Ach, doesn't look like it. But I think I can adjust it... there!

FirstFloorHallway_POI_CurioArea_04.value: Now it should be good until about...2100 or so!
Now it should be good until about... 2100 or so!

FirstFloorHallway_POI_LogArea_01.value: What's this? A log of some kind? That seems odd. Are those...glass coral replicas?
What's this? A log of some kind? That seems odd. Are those... glass coral replicas?

FirstFloorHallway_POI_LogArea_02.value: She must have read about the mapping of the Great Barrier Reef and been inspired!

FirstFloorHallway_POI_LogArea_03.value: Too bad she never did visit it. But I suppose this is as close as she could get.

FirstFloorHallway_POI_SeashellArea_01.value: Look at this thing - it's enormous! And I think it might be real, too.

FirstFloorHallway_POI_SeashellArea_02.value: I had no idea clams could grow this big. 'Sumatra, 1817' it says on the plaque.

FirstFloorHallway_POI_SeashellArea_03.value: Ignatius really did get her everything she wanted. Almost, anyway...

FirstFloorHallway_POI_SeashellSeat_01.value: Imagine if this folded together like a real seashell?

FirstFloorHallway_POI_SeashellSeat_02.value: Would've made for a good place to hide from the world.

FirstFloorHallway_POI_SeashellSeat_03.value: It looks so snug and comfy...maybe I could take a nap? Just a short one...

FirstFloorHallway_POI_SmallerShip_01.value: You're coming along nicely. Let's see who you are, mystery ship...

FirstFloorHallway_POI_SmallerShip_02.value: You are...the SS Altum! You were one of two ships sent on an expedition to the North Pole in 1773, it seems.

FirstFloorHallway_POI_SmallerShip_03.value: I wonder if a Boulton served on it? Clara would've been so jealous...

FirstFloorKitchen_02_01.value: Why is a knife stuck in the fridge?

FirstFloorKitchen_02_02.value: Hold on, there's a message! A bit excessive to use a KNIFE as a pin, if you ask me.

FirstFloorKitchen_02_03.value: Let's see if I can make out what it says...

FirstFloorKitchen_02_04.value: Hmm... Looks like the kitchen manager decided to call it quits!

FirstFloorKitchen_02_05.value: They've decided to take up the Blackwood family on their offer.

FirstFloorKitchen_02_06.value: Because, "Unlike the Boultons, they treat the staff like people."

FirstFloorKitchen_02_07.value: Hey! We treat the staff like people!

FirstFloorKitchen_02_09.value: Oh dear... Must have been bad. The knife is at least two inches deep!

FirstFloorKitchen_02_10.value: I wonder if I can find out who the Blackwoods were?

FirstFloorKitchen_03_04.value: I... I came to say sorry!

FirstFloorKitchen_03_05.value: I guess our last date didn't go so well since you haven't called me much after...

FirstFloorKitchen_03_07.value: But I admit, I'm surprised you even realized that "it" went poorly.

FirstFloorKitchen_03_09.value: I'm so sorry. Please. Let me make it up to you. I promised a meal, after all?

FirstFloorKitchen_04_03.value: Well, that's the difference between you and me, isn't it?

FirstFloorKitchen_04_05.value: Potential to make a lot of cash...

FirstFloorKitchen_04_06.value: Consider it Mads... If you sell this place, the lumpsum you'd get would be-
Consider it Mads... If you sell this place, the lump sum you'd get would be-

FirstFloorKitchen_04_07.value: You think I'd sell this place after everything I've done to keep it?!

FirstFloorKitchen_04_08.value: You have no idea what this place is worth, do you?

FirstFloorKitchen_04_09.value: I'm only looking out for your best interests... Unlike your friend, Roddy.

FirstFloorKitchen_04_10.value: What has Roddy got to do with any of this?
What has Roddy got to do with any of this?

FirstFloorKitchen_04_11.value: Besides... He'd never say the things you do.

FirstFloorKitchen_05_05.value: Mhhhh hmmm... Right, got a ballpark figure?

FirstFloorKitchen_05_09.value: I'm sorry Mads, this is important. I'll need to take this outside.

FirstFloorKitchen_05_10.value: But I'll run by the store as well, to get us something to cook. I promised a meal after all.

FirstFloorKitchen_06_03.value: Why are you always so surprised to see me in my own house?

FirstFloorKitchen_06_04.value: I... Er... You didn't happen to bump into anyone on the way here, did you?

FirstFloorKitchen_06_07.value: Alright. It's actually quite appropriate that you've started working on the kitchen now!

FirstFloorKitchen_06_08.value: Because I think it is finally time to reveal my biggest secret.

FirstFloorKitchen_07_01.value: You know, it's quite nice to do something as a family again, for a change!

FirstFloorKitchen_07_02.value: You're right dearie. We really don't spend enough time together, do we?

FirstFloorKitchen_07_03.value: Mmm... The smell of baking pies and...
Mmm... The smell of baking pies and...

FirstFloorKitchen_07_04.value: Wait a minute! This smell, this... Place?!

FirstFloorKitchen_07_05.value: Oh dearie. When you were a just a little baby, your mother would often take you down here to the kitchen.
Oh, dearie. When you were a just a little baby, your mother would often take you down here to the kitchen.

FirstFloorKitchen_07_06.value: One could call you a regular!

FirstFloorKitchen_07_08.value: Well, look at all the pies we made!

FirstFloorKitchen_07_09.value: How about I take few to the biker club?

FirstFloorKitchen_08_01.value: Hi, Maddie! I couldn't help but notice a wonderful smell coming from here and-

FirstFloorKitchen_08_05.value: Hey, cool! Is this the dumbwaiter from the dining room?

FirstFloorKitchen_08_07.value: I think with a bit of engineering, we could get it up and running again!

FirstFloorKitchen_08_08.value: Good thing there's an engineer present.

FirstFloorKitchen_09_01.value: Maybe we can install an ordering system?

FirstFloorKitchen_09_02.value: Planning on opening a restaurant, Maddie?

FirstFloorKitchen_09_05.value: No. I was just admiring the dumbwaiter.

FirstFloorKitchen_09_10.value: Of course, baby. After all, I promised to make dinner, didn't I?

FirstFloorKitchen_09_13.value: So be a good dumb waiter and fetch me some butter, will you?

FirstFloorKitchen_10_02.value: Well, whatever you call yourself, if you're not going to do your job, then you can go.

FirstFloorKitchen_10_05.value: Hey! Did I ever get to show you my INSANE knife skills?

FirstFloorKitchen_10_06.value: I was personally trained by a three star chef, you know...
I was personally trained by a three-star chef, you know...

FirstFloorKitchen_10_07.value: Some of these techniques have been kept secret since the middle ages!
Some of the techniques have been kept secret since the middle ages!
Some of the techniques have been kept secret since the Middle Ages!

FirstFloorKitchen_10_08.value: Okay... I admit, you've learned some new skills!

FirstFloorKitchen_10_09.value: Oh please... He's holding the knife all wrong!
Behold the ignorance of jealousy, Mads.

FirstFloorKitchen_10_10.value: Behold the ignorance of jealousy, Mads.
Ignorance?! I WAS trained in a Family owned restaurant!
Ignorance?! I WAS trained in a family-owned restaurant!

FirstFloorKitchen_10_11.value: Ignorance?! I WAS trained in a Family owned restaurant!
Pssh... More like a family owned hot dog stand.
Pssh... More like a family-owned hot dog stand.

FirstFloorKitchen_10_12.value: Pssh... More like a family owned hot dog stand.

FirstFloorKitchen_11_08.value: Alright, Maddie. Prepare to be amazed! I shall start by juggling these two knives!
Alright, Maddie. Prepare to be amazed! I shall start by juggling these knives!

FirstFloorKitchen_11_10.value: Don't worry! I've done this many times!

FirstFloorKitchen_11_12.value: Wow! What are you! OH NO!

FirstFloorKitchen_12_01.value: Ow... OW! No, don't touch it, DON'T TOUCH IT!!!

FirstFloorKitchen_12_04.value: He tried to kill me! YOU SAW IT, MADS! Oh sweet baby J-

FirstFloorKitchen_12_05.value: Roddy, you have to get him to the hospital! Maybe it isn't so bad!

FirstFloorKitchen_12_06.value: Bad?! IT went through my foot!

FirstFloorKitchen_12_08.value: Uh... Uh... YES, of- Of course! C'mon, I'll take you in my car!

FirstFloorKitchen_12_09.value: Aaaargh! Mads! MAAAADS! OW, don't step on it Roddy!!

FirstFloorKitchen_13_03.value: Once again, cleaning up after Arthur. Like usual.

FirstFloorKitchen_13_04.value: Although this time, it was Roddy's fault, for trying to show off.

FirstFloorKitchen_13_05.value: Sometimes I just don't understand men.

FirstFloorKitchen_13_06.value: Well... I ain't letting this fish go to waste, so I'll might as well eat it myself.

FirstFloorKitchen_13_07.value: All I need is some lemon pepper and-

FirstFloorKitchen_13_08.value: Eeek! THE RAT! Winston! Catch it!

FirstFloorKitchen_13_09.value: My apologies Ma'am, but I do believe it has managed to scurry off into the pantry before I could!
My apologies, Ma'am, but I do believe it has managed to scurry off into the pantry before I could!

FirstFloorKitchen_13_10.value: Alright, little guy... Your scurrying days are numbered! I'll find you in the pantry!

FirstFloorKitchen_CharacterTask1_01.value: Ah, Ms. Boulton! I see you have taken on the kitchen - how splendid.

FirstFloorKitchen_CharacterTask1_02.value: Somebody's gotta do it, Winston. Say, I was wondering...

FirstFloorKitchen_CharacterTask1_03.value: We truly have let this place go to ruin. Oh, you should have seen it in its heyday...

FirstFloorKitchen_CharacterTask1_04.value: ...busboys, kitchen maids, cooks and, of course...
...busboys, kitchen maids, cooks, and, of course...

FirstFloorKitchen_CharacterTask1_06.value: Uh, why did you make that sound like a villain out of a horror story?

FirstFloorKitchen_CharacterTask1_07.value: And anyway, I just wanted to know about this knife-in-the-fridge thing!

FirstFloorKitchen_CharacterTask1_08.value: You want to know where this knife is from? I will tell you, Ms. Boulton.

FirstFloorKitchen_CharacterTask1_09.value: But first...will you look at all of this? A kitchen cannot operate when it is this dirty!

FirstFloorKitchen_CharacterTask2_01.value: Phew. I had no idea you could be such a taskmaster, Winston. I mean... it gets results! But still.

FirstFloorKitchen_CharacterTask2_02.value: I do apologize, Ms. Boulton. But just thinking about Gamsey makes me want to make sure everything is spic and span!

FirstFloorKitchen_CharacterTask2_06.value: You would too, if you had known him! Just imagining him seeing his kitchen in this state makes me shiver.

FirstFloorKitchen_CharacterTask2_07.value: I haven't finished yet! What more do you want from me?

FirstFloorKitchen_CharacterTask2_08.value: You know what you need to do? You need to finish Gamsey's test dish.

FirstFloorKitchen_CharacterTask2_10.value: It is the dish Gamsey always made his new chefs make to prove they belonged in his kitchen.

FirstFloorKitchen_CharacterTask2_12.value: Yes, yes, get working, or you will be put on Gamsey's Black List!

FirstFloorKitchen_CharacterTask3_01.value: That turned out very good! Didn't it? Winston?

FirstFloorKitchen_CharacterTask3_02.value: *Sigh* I am afraid he would have thrown this straight into the bin, Ms. Boulton.

FirstFloorKitchen_CharacterTask3_03.value: What?! Why? I mean, maybe it wasn't perfect, but I would definitely eat it.

FirstFloorKitchen_CharacterTask3_04.value: That is just the thing, Ms. Boulton. Perfection was the only thing Gamsey accepted.

FirstFloorKitchen_CharacterTask3_05.value: Someone left out a garnish? Someone cooked something one minute too long? He'd instantly throw it out.

FirstFloorKitchen_CharacterTask3_06.value: He sounds like a nightmare. Why did anyone put up with him?

FirstFloorKitchen_CharacterTask3_07.value: Because he got results. His food was legendary, and the Boultons loved it - as did their guests.

FirstFloorKitchen_CharacterTask3_08.value: Even the Blackwoods would show up when invited, even though they hated the Boultons.

FirstFloorKitchen_CharacterTask3_10.value: Yes...Wait - what is all of this? Unacceptable! This needs to be scrubbed!

FirstFloorKitchen_CharacterTask4_01.value: You were saying...about the Blackwoods? Who were they?

FirstFloorKitchen_CharacterTask4_02.value: Ms. Boulton, you know very well who the Blackwoods are.

FirstFloorKitchen_CharacterTask4_04.value: Victoria Blackwood has been an unwelcome visitor to this mansion several times.

FirstFloorKitchen_CharacterTask4_05.value: Huh. So that is her maiden name, I guess?

FirstFloorKitchen_CharacterTask4_06.value: Indeed, Ms. Boulton. The Blackwoods were one of the great families in Hopewell Bay.

FirstFloorKitchen_CharacterTask4_07.value: And the two families were long-time rivals. A tradition that continues until this very day.

FirstFloorKitchen_CharacterTask4_08.value: The note said they had gone to work for the Blackwoods, now that I think about it.

FirstFloorKitchen_CharacterTask4_09.value: That is right. Oh, I remember the evening he quit...

FirstFloorKitchen_CharacterTask4_11.value: Let me just polish this first to calm my nerves...

FirstFloorKitchen_CharacterTask5_01.value: Phew. I think I know what a sous chef felt like working for Gamsey now.

FirstFloorKitchen_CharacterTask5_02.value: Not even close, Ms. Boulton. But let me tell you about this knife.

FirstFloorKitchen_CharacterTask5_04.value: Beaumount Hall had been chosen to host a state banquet, an incredible honor.
Beaumont Hall had been chosen to host a state banquet, an incredible honor.

FirstFloorKitchen_CharacterTask5_05.value: Everyone who was anyone in Hopewell Bay and beyond was attending. The pressure was on.

FirstFloorKitchen_CharacterTask5_06.value: Gamsey pushed everyone harder than ever. Tensions were mounting. He had planned it for months.

FirstFloorKitchen_CharacterTask5_07.value: And everything was going perfectly! All he had to deliver was his magnum opus - the perfect dish.

FirstFloorKitchen_CharacterTask5_08.value: It was never served. The cooks swore it was finished. The butlers swore they never saw it.

FirstFloorKitchen_CharacterTask5_09.value: The entire kitchen erupted in shouts, accusations, and chaos, as years of tensions boiled over.

FirstFloorKitchen_CharacterTask5_10.value: And then: thwack! Total silence. Gamsey had pinned his resignation into the fridge with his own sharpened knife!

FirstFloorKitchen_CharacterTask5_11.value: Whoa. And they just left it there?

FirstFloorKitchen_CharacterTask5_12.value: ...well...that was the last state dinner the Boultons ever arranged. The knife stayed, as a reminder.

FirstFloorKitchen_CharacterTask5_13.value: Do you know what happened to Gamsey?

FirstFloorKitchen_CharacterTask5_14.value: I know he went to work for the Blackwoods - who were oddly pleased with how everything had turned out...

FirstFloorKitchen_CharacterTask5_16.value: Nothing, Ms. Boulton. Merely that the feud between the Blackwoods and the Boultons is well founded.

FirstFloorKitchen_CharacterTask5_17.value: As Victoria has proved, time and again... but that shouldn't be a reason to continue it!

FirstFloorKitchen_CharacterTask5_18.value: If you should try to mend the relationship, know it wouldn't be the first attempt.

FirstFloorKitchen_CharacterTask5_19.value: But that is not my story to tell. Please excuse me, Ms.Boulton. Thank you for your help.

FirstFloorKitchen_CharacterTask5_20.value: Let me guess...Grandma would know more. *sigh*

FirstFloorKitchen_CharacterTask6_01.value: Do you know what happened to Gamsey?

FirstFloorKitchen_CharacterTask6_02.value: I know he went to work for the Blackwoods - who were oddly pleased with how everything had turned out...

FirstFloorKitchen_CharacterTask6_04.value: Nothing, Ms. Boulton. Merely that the feud between the Blackwoods and the Boultons is well founded.

FirstFloorKitchen_CharacterTask6_05.value: As Victoria has proved, time and again... but that shouldn't be a reason to continue it!

FirstFloorKitchen_CharacterTask6_06.value: If you should try to mend the relationship, know it wouldn't be the first attempt.

FirstFloorKitchen_CharacterTask6_07.value: But that is not my story to tell. Please excuse me, Ms.Boulton. Thank you for your help.

FirstFloorKitchen_CharacterTask6_08.value: Let me guess...Grandma would know more. *sigh*
Let me guess... Grandma would know more. *sigh*

FirstFloorKitchen_Intro_03.value: Hmph! Hopefully Winston can deal with it soon...

FirstFloorKitchen_Intro_04.value: Hey... This must be the kitchen! Probably the one the dumbwaiter is connected to!

FirstFloorKitchen_Intro_05.value: No surprise it came in here, then.

FirstFloorKitchen_Intro_06.value: I always believed that the kitchen was the heart of the house.

FirstFloorKitchen_Intro_07.value: So, I guess it's time to get it pumping again!

FirstFloorKitchen_POI_CastIronArea_01.value: Phew, that was an awful lot of scrubbing. Cast iron does not clean easy!
Phew, that was an awful lot of scrubbing. Cast iron does not clean easily!

FirstFloorKitchen_POI_CastIronArea_02.value: Buuut, the benefit of making something in cast iron is that it will survive anything!

FirstFloorKitchen_POI_CastIronArea_03.value: Soon, this whole kitchen will smell of pies baking again...aah.

FirstFloorKitchen_POI_DishWasher_01.value: Phew! That does it for all the dishes from our pie-baking.

FirstFloorKitchen_POI_DishWasher_02.value: I do wonder if it would break the rustic spirit of this place to install a modern dishwasher...

FirstFloorKitchen_POI_DishWasher_03.value: *sigh* Probably would, wouldn't it? Oh well.
*sigh* Probably would, wouldn't it? Oh, well.

FirstFloorKitchen_POI_DishWasher_04.value: At least doing dishes is kind of soothing. Gives you time to think...

FirstFloorKitchen_POI_DumbWaiterStart_01.value: Is this...yes it is! A dumbwaiter!

FirstFloorKitchen_POI_DumbWaiterStart_02.value: This must have gone up to the dining room!

FirstFloorKitchen_POI_DumbWaiterStart_03.value: I can't wait to show this to Roddy. He'll be so excited.

FirstFloorKitchen_POI_FishTableStart_01.value: And this must be the table used to prepare the food.

FirstFloorKitchen_POI_FishTableStart_02.value: That is an awful lot of knives. I wouldn't want to cut myself and get tetanus.

FirstFloorKitchen_POI_FishTableStart_03.value: I suppose if Arthur really is going to be making me dinner, he'll need a clean place to do it.

FirstFloorKitchen_POI_FishTableStart_04.value: And it's not like he's going to help...

FirstFloorKitchen_POI_Ingredients_01.value: So this was where they stored their ingredients, was it?

FirstFloorKitchen_POI_Ingredients_02.value: Oh - wow. This cookbook looks very vintage. Looks like there's a dog-eared page here...

FirstFloorKitchen_POI_Ingredients_03.value: Looks like the cook's favorite ways of preparing herbs and spices for various dishes!

FirstFloorKitchen_POI_Ingredients_04.value: I should try it! Who knows what culinary secrets hide in the Boulton past?

FirstFloorKitchen_POI_PieTableStart_01.value: Hmm. This table looks like it was used primarily for baking.

FirstFloorKitchen_POI_PieTableStart_02.value: They probably split baking tasks and food preparation tasks to different tables.

FirstFloorKitchen_POI_PieTableStart_03.value: Fewer fish guts in your apple pies that way. Not speaking from experience, or anything...

FirstFloorKitchen_POI_PlatesArea_01.value: I am glad I managed to restore so many of these Boulton-design plates.

FirstFloorKitchen_POI_PlatesArea_02.value: I doubt we'll be making any more of them any time soon. They seem very expensive.

FirstFloorKitchen_POI_PlatesArea_03.value: But it feels nice to put them back to use again. Just got to be careful not to drop them...

FirstFloorPantry_02_01.value: Oh, these recipe cards are really quite charming.

FirstFloorPantry_02_02.value: Old recipes can be such a lovely glimpse into the past.

FirstFloorPantry_02_03.value: Even if sometimes the recipes can be...interesting.

FirstFloorPantry_02_04.value: Let's hope the gelatin based ones are in a minority...
Let's hope the gelatin-based ones are in a minority...

FirstFloorPantry_02_05.value: Looks like a bunch of recipes for jam! Guess it's always run in the family...

FirstFloorPantry_02_06.value: ...except this one says 'Blackwood'. Looks like a family recipe.

FirstFloorPantry_02_07.value: Blackwood. Why does that name seem so familiar?

FirstFloorPantry_03_01.value: I can't make sense of these recipe cards, I wonder...

FirstFloorPantry_03_04.value: Arthur! Oh my gosh - are you okay?

FirstFloorPantry_03_05.value: The doctors said I should call...my loved ones...before my surgery.

FirstFloorPantry_03_07.value: Don't worry about me...Mads...or do...a little bit.

FirstFloorPantry_03_08.value: You don't sound so good. Do you need me to come to the hospital?

FirstFloorPantry_03_09.value: Oh! Um. No. *cough* Better not. I am...contagious.

FirstFloorPantry_03_11.value: That's not important right now! The only important thing *cough cough* right now is that...

FirstFloorPantry_03_12.value: ...I can see you again. If I make it out alive.

FirstFloorPantry_03_13.value: Of course, Arthur. And I am so sorry this happened.

FirstFloorPantry_03_14.value: It's okay Mads. I forgive you. I...I have to go. My surgery is starting. Wish me luck!

FirstFloorPantry_04_01.value: I have to call Roddy about Arthur.

FirstFloorPantry_04_03.value: Maddie! I was just about to call you!

FirstFloorPantry_04_04.value: I just got off the phone with Arthur! He said he was going into surgery?

FirstFloorPantry_04_05.value: Surgery? What are you talking about?

FirstFloorPantry_04_06.value: He said he was contagious, that he might die...

FirstFloorPantry_04_07.value: Errr. We...never even saw a doctor. A nurse put a band-aid on his toe and sent us packing!

FirstFloorPantry_04_08.value: As far as I know, he went straight home.

FirstFloorPantry_04_10.value: Anyway, I'm glad you called...I wanted to apologize for the, uh, kitchen incident. It was my fault.

FirstFloorPantry_04_11.value: Can we talk about it later, Roddy, in person? I don't really have the patience for it right now.

FirstFloorPantry_04_13.value: But thank you for telling me.

FirstFloorPantry_05_01.value: Ugh. To think I almost felt sorry for Arthur...

FirstFloorPantry_05_04.value: I've had such a day - you'd never guess what just happened...

FirstFloorPantry_05_05.value: I've found proof that Grace was framed!

FirstFloorPantry_05_06.value: Huh? Your sister? What are you saying?

FirstFloorPantry_05_07.value: After our last talk, I started looking into the article Grace was writing when she was arrested.

FirstFloorPantry_05_08.value: Someone had tried to get rid of it, but I found a draft version in her apartment!

FirstFloorPantry_05_09.value: It's missing names, but it had a list of the crimes she was investigating.

FirstFloorPantry_05_10.value: O..okay, Jackie. You're going very fast!

FirstFloorPantry_05_11.value: Aren't you hearing me? The crimes - they're the same crimes she was convicted of!

FirstFloorPantry_05_12.value: They made her the fall-gal for their own crimes!

FirstFloorPantry_06_01.value: That's an amazing find Jackie. Did you bring this to the police?

FirstFloorPantry_06_02.value: No. Not yet. I have to figure out who she was actually investigating. And this draft isn't proof enough.

FirstFloorPantry_06_03.value: But I know I am on the right track!

FirstFloorPantry_06_05.value: Because I'm absolutely sure I'm being followed!

FirstFloorPantry_06_08.value: Why are you so calm about this? You don't know who these people are! You could be in danger!

FirstFloorPantry_06_09.value: So what? I'm trying to save my family, Maddie. You if anyone should understand that!
So what? I'm trying to save my family, Maddie. You, more than anyone, should understand that!

FirstFloorPantry_06_10.value: I...I do, but this is irresponsible. You have to tell the police!

FirstFloorPantry_06_11.value: As if the police in this town have ever been anything but useless!

FirstFloorPantry_06_12.value: Oh, I see: you're probably afraid they've followed me here. I'll get out of your hair.

FirstFloorPantry_06_13.value: No, Jackie, that's not what I...and she's gone.

FirstFloorPantry_06_14.value: Ugh. Could this day get any worse?

FirstFloorPantry_07_01.value: All of these jars...they're labelled. Professionally.

FirstFloorPantry_07_02.value: This logo looks sort of like a butterfly. Two Bs, facing away from each other. Hmm.

FirstFloorPantry_07_04.value: This is definitely not a fluke. Our families had a jam business - together.

FirstFloorPantry_07_05.value: I wonder if this connects somehow to that mark of the Blackwoods I found in the factory?

FirstFloorPantry_07_06.value: ...were the Blackwoods and the Boultons business partners in more than just jam?

FirstFloorPantry_07_07.value: Ugh. This is making my head hurt!

FirstFloorPantry_07_08.value: Isn't there a single room in this mansion that doesn't have some Earth-shattering mystery in it?!

FirstFloorPantry_08_02.value: It's kind of like a garden, really. Just indoors.

FirstFloorPantry_08_03.value: I suppose greenhouses were all the rage in Agatha's time.

FirstFloorPantry_08_04.value: But this one seems to have been especially well engineered.

FirstFloorPantry_08_06.value: Fresh herbs year-round. Veggies grown right next to the kitchen!

FirstFloorPantry_08_07.value: Nothing like a solid bit of engineering to remind me to keep things in perspective.

FirstFloorPantry_09_03.value: This is Victoria calling about your car's extended warranty...

FirstFloorPantry_09_04.value: I thought you said you'd start screening the numbers.

FirstFloorPantry_09_05.value: Maddie?! Again? Argh! I am going to blacklist you from every telemarketer in Hopewell Bay!

FirstFloorPantry_09_06.value: Oh, would you? That would almost make up for all the evil you've put us through!

FirstFloorPantry_09_07.value: Ha-ha, very funny. Goodbye, Maddie! Hopefully for good!

FirstFloorPantry_09_08.value: ...actually, wait, Victoria. You're a Blackwood, right?

FirstFloorPantry_09_09.value: You really pay no attention at all, do you? I'm Victoria Golightly. It's on all of my correspondence.

FirstFloorPantry_09_11.value: Last I checked, yes. What about it?

FirstFloorPantry_09_12.value: Well - I'm holding a very interesting jar of jam here with your family's name on it.

FirstFloorPantry_09_14.value: I mean - there's a jar here with the Blackwood and the Boulton name on it.

FirstFloorPantry_09_15.value: I know what you meant. But I'm not talking about it over the phone. I'm coming there.
I know what you meant. But I'm not talking about it over the phone. I'm coming over.

FirstFloorPantry_09_17.value: Interesting. So it's not news to her, it seems...

FirstFloorPantry_10_01.value: I had almost forgotten what a horrible, run-down dump this place is.

FirstFloorPantry_10_03.value: To imagine we were going to relieve you of the burden of tearing it down. *sigh*

FirstFloorPantry_10_05.value: Eek! What was that? Was that a rat?!

FirstFloorPantry_10_07.value: In the pantry?! I am going to call the health inspectors on you!

FirstFloorPantry_10_08.value: Using the company line? Maybe you can sell them some car insurance while you're at it.

FirstFloorPantry_10_09.value: Hmph! A low blow, even for a Boulton.

FirstFloorPantry_10_10.value: Victoria, I didn't even know the Blackwoods existed before I came here!

FirstFloorPantry_10_11.value: I have no quarrel with your family - yet you seem to hate us just for existing.

FirstFloorPantry_10_12.value: How surprising. Yet another thing your dear grandma decided to keep from you.
How surprising. Yet another thing your dear Grandma decided to keep from you.

FirstFloorPantry_10_13.value: Well, I won't spare you. Get ready for some truly horrifying revelations about your family...

FirstFloorPantry_11_01.value: My great-grandmother, Christine Blackwood, was the true inventor of the tin can.

FirstFloorPantry_11_03.value: It's true! She came up with it when trying to think of ways to preserve her famous Blackwood Jam!

FirstFloorPantry_11_04.value: So it was Agatha and Christine who had the jam business together...

FirstFloorPantry_11_05.value: Oh yes - they were great friends. Christine shared her idea with Agatha in confidence.

FirstFloorPantry_11_07.value: And Agatha, of course, immediately blabbered about it to her good-for-nothing husband.

FirstFloorPantry_11_08.value: Wouldn't you know it - the very next day, a new patent was submitted - and the rest is history.

FirstFloorPantry_12_01.value: No! Agatha wouldn't do something like that!

FirstFloorPantry_12_02.value: And they kept making jam together even after Ignatius started tin can production.

FirstFloorPantry_12_03.value: Christine was too trusting - she never believed Agatha had sold her out.

FirstFloorPantry_12_04.value: But my great-grandfather, Lord Blackwood, understood all too well what had happened!

FirstFloorPantry_12_05.value: He understood that a Boulton can never be trusted.

FirstFloorPantry_12_07.value: The worst part, Maddie, wasn't even the betrayal.

FirstFloorPantry_12_09.value: It was how the Boultons squandered all of that stolen wealth! Just look at this place!

FirstFloorPantry_12_10.value: Money definitely does not buy taste. Ugh, I hate the nouveau-riche!

FirstFloorPantry_12_11.value: And what about the Blackwood wealth? Where is that, Mrs. Telemarketer?

FirstFloorPantry_12_12.value: Pah! Your family stole my family's future. And as long as I am a Blackwood, I will make sure the Boultons pay!

FirstFloorPantry_13_01.value: Victoria's finally gone...she got very worked up. I wonder...

FirstFloorPantry_13_03.value: She definitely seems to think it is. But would Agatha really do something like that?

FirstFloorPantry_13_04.value: Christine and Agatha really did seem like good friends.

FirstFloorPantry_13_05.value: There must be more to this story. Maybe Grandma knows...

FirstFloorPantry_13_06.value: Seems like this hatch is locked. I wonder...Winston?

FirstFloorPantry_13_08.value: Do you have the key to this hatch? I would like to see what's below.

FirstFloorPantry_13_09.value: Below? Oh. There's nothing below. It's a...fake hatch.

FirstFloorPantry_13_11.value: The key may be with the key to the parlor, m'am. I can take a look.
The key may be with the key to the parlor, ma'am. I can take a look.

FirstFloorPantry_13_12.value: The parlor? We have a parlor?

FirstFloorPantry_13_13.value: Yes m'am. Just across the hall, m'am.
Yes ma'am. Just across the hall, ma'am.

FirstFloorPantry_13_14.value: Hold on, I'm getting a call. Hello? Julius?
Are you just trying to distract me from this hatch, Winston?

FirstFloorPantry_13_15.value: Maddie! You have to come to the factory at once! It's an emergency!
No m'am. I will go look for the keys right away.
No ma'am. I will go look for the keys right away.

FirstFloorPantry_13_16.value: Whoa, Julius, slow down. What's happening?
Hmmm. Okay. I'll meet you there, I guess.

FirstFloorPantry_13_17.value: Someone's broken into the office and now there's sparks flying everywhere!
All right, mysterious hatch. I'll see you later.

FirstFloorPantry_13_18.value: ...unless you're just full of potatoes. Which would be a first...

FirstFloorPantry_Butterchurner_POI_02.value: If Victoria saw you now she'd blow a gasket. But I think you're rather cute, actually.

FirstFloorPantry_Butterchurner_POI_03.value: Glad you're getting some use out of this butterchurner, Ratthew.
Glad you're getting some use out of this butter churner, Ratthew.

FirstFloorPantry_Butterchurner_POI_04.value: Now, perhaps it's time for you to...wait, where did you go?

FirstFloorPantry_Butterchurner_POI_05.value: Is that something under the carpet?

FirstFloorPantry_CharacterTask1_01.value: So it's true! The pantry is back up and running again!

FirstFloorPantry_CharacterTask1_02.value: Oh, Cherry! You found your way here! Welcome! Uh - what's all this?

FirstFloorPantry_CharacterTask1_03.value: Fresh fruit, just like my mama used to bring!

FirstFloorPantry_CharacterTask1_04.value: We do need to restock! Did you see the kitchen?

FirstFloorPantry_CharacterTask1_05.value: I did! I think you missed a spot when cleaning.

FirstFloorPantry_CharacterTask1_06.value: Some red jam on the floor over by the knives - no big deal!

FirstFloorPantry_CharacterTask1_08.value: Okay! Can you help me set up?

FirstFloorPantry_CharacterTask2_01.value: So, Cherry, I found these old recipe cards when I was cleaning.

FirstFloorPantry_CharacterTask2_02.value: Vintage recipe cards? My, oh my, let me take a look at those!

FirstFloorPantry_CharacterTask2_03.value: Sure - here you go. I was thinking...

FirstFloorPantry_CharacterTask2_04.value: Maddie! Do you know what this is?

FirstFloorPantry_CharacterTask2_05.value: Uhh...a recipe for Hopeberry jam, I think?

FirstFloorPantry_CharacterTask2_06.value: Not just any recipe for Hopeberry jam! This is THE recipe for Hopeberry jam!

FirstFloorPantry_CharacterTask2_08.value: I'll tell you after we try to make it!

FirstFloorPantry_CharacterTask3_02.value: It is! So what did you mean with 'the' recipe?

FirstFloorPantry_CharacterTask3_03.value: Huh? Oh, nevermind that. This isn't it!

FirstFloorPantry_CharacterTask3_05.value: Everyone knows there's a secret Hopewell Bay Hopeberry Jam recipe. I thought this was it, but...nope!

FirstFloorPantry_CharacterTask3_06.value: You mean Grandma's recipe? I'm pretty sure these are older than her.

FirstFloorPantry_CharacterTask3_07.value: Exactly! No, I've only tasted it in jam from old jars with a special butterfly logo on them!

FirstFloorPantry_CharacterTask3_09.value: Anyway, let's continue restocking these shelves!

FirstFloorPantry_CharacterTask4_01.value: Looks like we've got everything back to its old glory, more or less!

FirstFloorPantry_CharacterTask4_02.value: You know my mother used to come here every week with fresh produce for the kitchen.

FirstFloorPantry_CharacterTask4_03.value: Of course that all stopped when they shut it all down.

FirstFloorPantry_CharacterTask4_04.value: So I'm glad I can pick up the tradition again!

FirstFloorPantry_CharacterTask4_05.value: I mean - I don't know if we're going to need to fire up the WHOLE kitchen again...

FirstFloorPantry_CharacterTask4_06.value: It's quite a lot for just Grandma and me...

FirstFloorPantry_CharacterTask4_07.value: We can use it! With all the events, parties and gatherings you've hosted here since you started renovations...

FirstFloorPantry_CharacterTask4_08.value: ...no dust will gather in this kitchen again! I promise you that!

FirstFloorPantry_CharacterTask4_09.value: Aww. That'd be nice. Speaking of dust...

FirstFloorPantry_CharacterTask4_10.value: We better clean up a little, yes!

FirstFloorPantry_CharacterTask5_01.value: So, Cherry, before you go - I found this jar when I was cleaning.

FirstFloorPantry_CharacterTask5_02.value: Is that...that's the logo! The butterfly logo!

FirstFloorPantry_CharacterTask5_03.value: Actually, that's a double B-logo. Boulton and....Blackwood.

FirstFloorPantry_CharacterTask5_04.value: Blackwood? What have they got to do with this?

FirstFloorPantry_CharacterTask5_05.value: It looks like my great-grandmother Agatha was friends with Christine Blackwood.
It looks like my great-grandmother, Agatha, was friends with Christine Blackwood.

FirstFloorPantry_CharacterTask5_06.value: They developed the recipe for this jam together.

FirstFloorPantry_CharacterTask5_07.value: Well, isn't that surprising! Did you find the recipe too?

FirstFloorPantry_CharacterTask5_08.value: Uhh, maybe. I have a lot of old recipe cards here! One of them is probably it!

FirstFloorPantry_CharacterTask5_09.value: I wish I could stay and try a few more...but maybe later!

FirstFloorPantry_CharacterTask5_10.value: Sure, Cherry! Thanks for all the help!

FirstFloorPantry_Intro_01.value: And you're gone again, little rat, lost in the mess. *sigh*
And you're gone again, little rat, lost in the mess. *sigh*

FirstFloorPantry_Intro_02.value: If I didn't know any better, I'd think you'd be trying to show me the next mess for me to clean up!
If I didn't know any better, I'd think you're trying to show me the next mess for me to clean up!

FirstFloorPantry_Intro_03.value: The pantry, huh? Geeze, this place looks worse than the kitchen.
The pantry, huh? Geez, this place looks worse than the kitchen.

FirstFloorPantry_Intro_04.value: Looks like something a lot worse than that rat went through here.

FirstFloorPantry_Intro_05.value: Well. Nothing else to it, I guess. Can't have a functional kitchen without a functional pantry!

FirstFloorPantry_Intro_06.value: And maybe I'll find you again at the end of it, Ratty.

FirstFloorPantry_Intro_07.value: Ratty? No. Hmm. I need to workshop that. You're practically part of the mansion by now.

FirstFloorPantry_POI_CentralTable_01.value: Hm! Looks like this was supposed to spin around. But I don't think it's worth fixing it.

FirstFloorPantry_POI_CentralTable_02.value: I guess they must have used this when they were making their jam - must've saved quite a bit of time too!

FirstFloorPantry_POI_CentralTable_03.value: A little plaque here says 'A.B' - so it was definitely Boulton manufactured.

FirstFloorPantry_POI_CentralTable_04.value: I wonder though...would Agatha really have come up with such a...domestic device?

FirstFloorPantry_POI_HoosierCabinets_01.value: This turned out really nice! This cabinet has...everything!

FirstFloorPantry_POI_HoosierCabinets_02.value: It's probably over a hundred years old. I bet it used to be in the kitchen until they moved it here.

FirstFloorPantry_POI_HoosierCabinets_03.value: These built-in flour and sugar dispensers are so handy, and it has space for all the spices you could ever need!

FirstFloorPantry_POI_HoosierCabinets_04.value: Hmm...what's this? Oh, a recipe card. Signed 'C.B'. I wonder who that is? Clara Boulton?

FirstFloorPantry_POI_HoosierCabinets_05.value: No...that doesn't make any sense. Clara wasn't one for the domestic arts...

FirstFloorPantry_POI_JamNook_01.value: You know what? It's not enough that I restore all of this...I should make use of it!

FirstFloorPantry_POI_JamNook_02.value: Heck, I should try making this mystery jam I got off the recipe card.

FirstFloorPantry_POI_JamNook_03.value: Maybe I'll be the clear winner in the next Hopeberry Festival...

FirstFloorPantry_POI_SpiceShelves_01.value: Finally - my very own spice shelf. Let's see...I've got...rosemary, thyme, sage...

FirstFloorPantry_POI_SpiceShelves_02.value: Parsley, of course. But then the fun stuff. Bergamot. Chamomile. And mint!

FirstFloorPantry_POI_SpiceShelves_03.value: What I need right now is a cup of home-made tea...and this shelf will give me just that.

FirstFloorPantry_POI_Start_GreenRoom_01.value: What've we got back here...? *cough cough*

FirstFloorPantry_POI_Start_GreenRoom_02.value: Judging by all the dead plants...it was some kind of...greenhouse?

FirstFloorPantry_POI_Start_GreenRoom_03.value: And now it's mostly an electrical hazard! Okay, Maddie. Time to focus...

FirstFloorPantry_POI_Start_ToolStorage_0.value: This place definitely has a lot of nooks. Hmm. Wonder what this was for?
Tools of the trade, looks like...always good to have a place to put your stuff.
Looks like a vintage coffee infuser on the top shelf there - I wonder if it still works?
And I love these scales. So much more tactile than the digital ones!
But wait...is that a butter churner...?

FirstFloorPantry_POI_WallCalendar_01.value: Done! That old calendar fits perfectly above the door.
Wow, this calendar is so out of date.

FirstFloorPantry_POI_WallCalendar_02.value: 1963. That can't have been the last time this pantry was used, can it?

FirstFloorPantry_POI_WallCalendar_03.value: Maybe it was. They probably closed off some parts of the mansion earlier than others...

FirstFloorParlor_02_01.value: A lot of effort went into this salon, you know...

FirstFloorParlor_02_02.value: Why, there were footmen at the door announcing callers...

FirstFloorParlor_02_03.value: Guests were kept intentionally waiting, so that they could admire the wealth on display...

FirstFloorParlor_02_04.value: Everything here was designed to impress.

FirstFloorParlor_02_05.value: The last great performance of the Boultons as proper socialites?

FirstFloorParlor_02_06.value: You must remember, Ma’am. In the days of Margrete and Leonardus, status was still a prime commodity!

FirstFloorParlor_02_08.value: Indeed, Ma’am. Status was almost all they had at that point...

FirstFloorParlor_03_02.value: It looks like there’s a seam in the pillar? In the shape of a... door?

FirstFloorParlor_03_03.value: Maybe there’s a hidden mechanism or latch somewhere that I can trigg-

FirstFloorParlor_03_04.value: Ma’am, please! Not EVERYTHING in this mansion has a hidden door in it!

FirstFloorParlor_03_07.value: Besides, shouldn’t you be looking for the key to the pantry trapdoor?

FirstFloorParlor_03_08.value: As you wish, Ma’am. And please do be careful in here. I’ve tried my best to keep it somewhat in shape.

FirstFloorParlor_04_02.value: I guess Winston did a good job keeping this place at least somewhat in good condition.

FirstFloorParlor_04_03.value: But judging from the layer of dust, it has been closed off for a VERY long time.

FirstFloorParlor_04_04.value: Come to think of it... I have very faint recollections of the parlor doors.

FirstFloorParlor_04_05.value: I guess Grandma took me into the salon for some reason, because I remember wondering what was behind those doors.

FirstFloorParlor_04_06.value: But... then again, I DO remember going into some room after that?!

FirstFloorParlor_04_07.value: Or was it just a dream?

FirstFloorParlor_05_01.value: There... This music corner turned out really nicely!

FirstFloorParlor_05_02.value: Though I wonder who played here with a harp?

FirstFloorParlor_05_05.value: Oh, dearie. Almost all the women in the Boulton family played the harp.

FirstFloorParlor_05_06.value: You see, it originally belonged to Clara. And she even wrote some music for it!

FirstFloorParlor_05_07.value: Ever since then, every generation has learned to play it.

FirstFloorParlor_05_08.value: Michael was supposed to teach you when you were old enough, but...

FirstFloorParlor_05_11.value: Yes! I want to learn it!

FirstFloorParlor_05_13.value: ...now just look at my fingers, it's really quite simple...

FirstFloorParlor_06_01.value: Quite an elaborate setup for a dog, if you ask me...

FirstFloorParlor_06_02.value: Oh yes, this belonged to Deb’s old corgi, Fenton!

FirstFloorParlor_06_03.value: Oh, he was such a cute little rascal! This was his favorite spot to lounge when he wasn’t outside chasing deer.

FirstFloorParlor_06_05.value: Oh, he really was a live one. He’d always growl when Vincent was around, too.

FirstFloorParlor_06_07.value: Oh... I must have misspoke there. I’m sorry, dearie.

FirstFloorParlor_07_01.value: There! Starting to look more like a parlor now, doesn’t it, Grandma?

FirstFloorParlor_07_02.value: Oh yes, dearie! It’s bringing back so many memories!

FirstFloorParlor_07_03.value: I used to lounge right here. Deb would be busy getting the dog off the sofa and...

FirstFloorParlor_07_04.value: Leonard would be over there, getting told off for having his feet on the table.

FirstFloorParlor_07_06.value: Oh dearie, on about that again?

FirstFloorParlor_07_07.value: Please. I think I heard that name before.

FirstFloorParlor_07_08.value: Alright, fine. It was Vincent Crutchley.

FirstFloorParlor_07_09.value: The one from the photo! Winston mentioned this! Vincent was the one you were meant to marry!

FirstFloorParlor_07_10.value: No... That would be Richard Blackwood.

FirstFloorParlor_08_01.value: Now let me get this straight...

FirstFloorParlor_08_02.value: You married a mob boss, while set up to marry a Blackwood...

FirstFloorParlor_08_03.value: While seeing Grandpa Charlie on the side?!

FirstFloorParlor_08_04.value: Maddie, please relax. It wasn’t like that at all!

FirstFloorParlor_08_06.value: First, I hadn’t met Charlie then! So I wasn’t seeing anybody on the side!

FirstFloorParlor_08_07.value: Richard was a kind soul. Perhaps a little quiet, though...

FirstFloorParlor_08_08.value: My parents absolutely loathed the idea, but saw no choice but to arrange something with the Blackwoods.

FirstFloorParlor_08_09.value: My father didn't inherit the business knowhow of his father... A lot of bad decisions. A lot of debt...

FirstFloorParlor_08_10.value: They wanted to marry you off?!

FirstFloorParlor_08_11.value: No... Maddie, they DIDN’T! But I had no choice. I CHOSE to do it for the FAMILY!

FirstFloorParlor_08_12.value: So they hired a new hotshot lawyer from Crutchley & Sons. Someone who could handle the “business” side of things.

FirstFloorParlor_09_01.value: Understand, dearie. I was heading into a relationship I didn’t want to be in.

FirstFloorParlor_09_02.value: And in comes Vincent Crutchley. He was rugged, handsome. Everything that Richard unfortunately wasn’t.

FirstFloorParlor_09_03.value: I would be lying if I said there weren’t sparks flying between Vincent and I.

FirstFloorParlor_09_05.value: But you must believe me when I say that I did not know of his criminal background!

FirstFloorParlor_09_06.value: But you were going to marry Richard?

FirstFloorParlor_10_01.value: I still can’t believe what I’m hearing, Grandma...

FirstFloorParlor_10_02.value: Those were my exact words when I saw Richard on that very phone!

FirstFloorParlor_10_04.value: I overheard him talking to his dear old mother on the phone.

FirstFloorParlor_10_05.value: He was complaining to her that he didn’t want to get married only because of my money.

FirstFloorParlor_10_06.value: I realized then that I couldn’t force the poor man to go through something like that. So I called it off.

FirstFloorParlor_10_08.value: Yes. To the chagrin of my parents no less. You can imagine how I felt about it all...

FirstFloorParlor_10_09.value: Alone and unappreciated. They didn’t even understand what I was willing to do for them!

FirstFloorParlor_10_10.value: Vincent was the only one who consoled me that day. He was the only one who understood.

FirstFloorParlor_CharacterTask1_01.value: Oh. Hello Winston. You're still here.

FirstFloorParlor_CharacterTask1_03.value: You know you don't actually work here any more, right?

FirstFloorParlor_CharacterTask1_05.value: Are you afraid I am going to break something?

FirstFloorParlor_CharacterTask1_06.value: ...not at all, M'am. Besides, they are your priceless heirlooms to break if you do!
...not at all, ma'am. Besides, they are your priceless heirlooms to break if you do!

FirstFloorParlor_CharacterTask1_07.value: Hmm. You know, if it would make you feel better, you could maybe store some of these for me.

FirstFloorParlor_CharacterTask1_08.value: You know - until I find a better place for them.

FirstFloorParlor_CharacterTask2_01.value: It feels odd to think my father grew up with a butler.

FirstFloorParlor_CharacterTask2_02.value: I was not butler to your father, M'am, but to Master Leonard.
I was not butler to your father, ma'am, but to Master Leonard.

FirstFloorParlor_CharacterTask2_03.value: And by the time your father lived here, things were already in...decline.

FirstFloorParlor_CharacterTask2_04.value: As head butler, it was my job to see to the scaling down of the mansion.

FirstFloorParlor_CharacterTask2_05.value: This floor was one of the first to go.

FirstFloorParlor_CharacterTask2_06.value: I truly did not think I would see it restored in my lifetime.

FirstFloorParlor_CharacterTask2_07.value: I'm glad you're here helping me with it, Winston.

FirstFloorParlor_CharacterTask2_08.value: It is my pleasure, M'am. Now - let us continue.
It is my pleasure, ma'am. Now - let us continue.

FirstFloorParlor_CharacterTask3_01.value: Thank you Winston! This has been very helpful.

FirstFloorParlor_CharacterTask3_02.value: It is no trouble, M'am. It feels good to be useful.
It is no trouble, ma'am. It feels good to be useful.

FirstFloorParlor_CharacterTask3_03.value: You know what we should do, once the parlor is renovated?

FirstFloorParlor_CharacterTask3_05.value: Okay, yes, sure. But once we're done with that.

FirstFloorParlor_CharacterTask3_06.value: Polish the candlesticks. Wash the windows.

FirstFloorParlor_CharacterTask3_07.value: *sigh* I meant to celebrate. We can't constantly be cleaning things!

FirstFloorParlor_CharacterTask3_08.value: A mansion of this size, M'am...yes, we can.
A mansion of this size, ma'am...yes, we can.

FirstFloorParlor_CharacterTask3_09.value: How about a compromise: we prepare for all of that now...and then later...

FirstFloorParlor_CharacterTask3_10.value: You are correct, M'am. We really need to refill the closet supplies.
You are correct, ma'am. We really need to refill the closet supplies.

FirstFloorParlor_CharacterTask4_01.value: Phew. Will you listen to my ideas now, Winston?

FirstFloorParlor_CharacterTask4_02.value: Of course, M'am. It is, after all, your house.
Of course, ma'am. It is, after all, your house.

FirstFloorParlor_CharacterTask4_03.value: What I was saying is that we ought to use the parlor for what it was meant for.

FirstFloorParlor_CharacterTask4_04.value: Hm? If we are to dazzle visitors with its splendor, we may need to hire some footmen.

FirstFloorParlor_CharacterTask4_05.value: No! I meant...as a place to gather! Maybe we could arrange a party!

FirstFloorParlor_CharacterTask4_07.value: Yes! Now that the kitchen is renovated too.

FirstFloorParlor_CharacterTask5_01.value: I have secured Cherry as a baker, and I have tentatively begun interviews with two potential footmen.

FirstFloorParlor_CharacterTask5_02.value: O--oh. Then there's only one thing left.

FirstFloorParlor_CharacterTask5_03.value: No, M'am. I assure you there are a hundred things left to worry about.
No, ma'am. I assure you there are a hundred things left to worry about.

FirstFloorParlor_CharacterTask5_04.value: But for you, there is only one thing left: the guest list.

FirstFloorParlor_CharacterTask5_05.value: Grandma, of course. Deb. Roddy, Jackie and Julius. And...

FirstFloorParlor_CharacterTask5_06.value: ...do you want me to invite him too?

FirstFloorParlor_CharacterTask5_07.value: I leave that up to your discretion, M'am.
I leave that up to your discretion, ma'am.

FirstFloorParlor_CharacterTask5_08.value: He is still around. I think I saw him skulking about the factory, earlier.

FirstFloorParlor_CharacterTask5_09.value: I'll think about it. Thank you for all your help, Winston.

FirstFloorParlor_CharacterTask5_10.value: Thank you, M'am, for returning Beaumont Hall to its former splendor.
