Thank you, ma'am, for returning Beaumont Hall to its former splendor.

FirstFloorParlor_Intro_01.value: Alright, here I am! Is this the parlor?

FirstFloorParlor_Intro_02.value: It is the salon in fact. The parlor is beyond that door.

FirstFloorParlor_Intro_03.value: Hey, it’s actually not in too terrible shape!

FirstFloorParlor_Intro_04.value: Ah yes. Even in its current state, it holds a strange formality, does it not?

FirstFloorParlor_Intro_05.value: This was where the height of the Boulton’s social power was expressed to its very fullest, Ma’am.

FirstFloorParlor_Intro_06.value: They were a POWERHOUSE of society!

FirstFloorParlor_Intro_07.value: Many important meetings took place here, Ma’am. Some changed the world...

FirstFloorParlor_Intro_08.value: And some even changed your life, Ma’am.

FirstFloorParlor_Intro_10.value: Why, this is the room where your grandmother met the man she would marry!

FirstFloorParlor_Outro_01.value: Grandma... I’m sorry. I didn’t mean to bring up sad memories.

FirstFloorParlor_Outro_02.value: Oh, it’s alright, dearie. It’s all in the past, anyway.

FirstFloorParlor_Outro_03.value: But... if that’s the story how you met Vincent Crutchley...

FirstFloorParlor_Outro_06.value: Now, THAT is a story for another day. I promise.

FirstFloorParlor_Outro_09.value: Hold on, I'm getting a call. Hello? Julius?

FirstFloorParlor_Outro_10.value: Maddie! You have to come to the factory at once! It's an emergency!

FirstFloorParlor_Outro_11.value: Whoa, Julius, slow down. What's happening?

FirstFloorParlor_Outro_12.value: Someone's broken into the office and now there's sparks flying everywhere!

FirstFloorParlor_POI_AutomataChess_01.value: Ha! Just like Wolfgang von Kempelen’s Automaton Chess Player!

FirstFloorParlor_POI_AutomataChess_02.value: I studied it in high school. While it was a hoax, it was still a sophisticated and brilliant engineering design.

FirstFloorParlor_POI_AutomataChess_04.value: I don’t see any big box under this guy, to hide a chess player...

FirstFloorParlor_POI_Cakes_03.value: They look so realistic, I could just eat them all!

FirstFloorParlor_POI_Cakes_05.value: Oh, my... These are scented wax cakes!

FirstFloorParlor_POI_Cakes_06.value: I bet Lindsay had a hand in making these, because their fragrance is delicious!

FirstFloorParlor_POI_ConvoChair_01.value: The classic conversation chair, back in action.

FirstFloorParlor_POI_ConvoChair_02.value: It always made me wonder, where do you put the tea table with one of these?

FirstFloorParlor_POI_ConvoChair_04.value: Or just one side, then they pass over the tea?

FirstFloorParlor_POI_ConvoChair_05.value: I’ll probably stick to a regular sofa...

FirstFloorParlor_POI_Fireplace_01.value: Quite a nice mosaic of Agatha and Ignatius.

FirstFloorParlor_POI_Fireplace_02.value: Almost as if they’re looking over everyone in the room.

FirstFloorParlor_POI_Fireplace_03.value: I bet when this fireplace was going; it had a wonderfully cozy atmosphere.

FirstFloorParlor_POI_Fireplace_04.value: Just snuggle up on a lounge chair and read a book.

FirstFloorParlor_POI_Fireplace_05.value: Or have a pleasant conversation about the day with the family.

FirstFloorParlor_POI_ModelTrain_02.value: This model train set is surprisingly intricate and detailed.

FirstFloorParlor_POI_ModelTrain_03.value: But then again, my family was really into technology and inventions.

FirstFloorParlor_POI_ModelTrain_04.value: I wonder if Ignatius or someone in the family built this?

FirstFloorParlor_POI_TeaSeating_01.value: This is some really elegant tea seating.

FirstFloorParlor_POI_TeaSeating_02.value: And thanks to Winston, most of it remained in great shape.

FirstFloorParlor_POI_TeaSeating_03.value: Makes me wonder how much juicy conversation and gossip took place here!

FloorCompass_01.value: Interesting, the north node on this compass seems to be glowing.

FloorCompass_02.value: The funny thing is, it's not pointing north at all...

FloorCompass_03.value: It's probably broken, like most things in here.

FossilTalk_02.value: Says here on the plaque that these belonged to a predator hunting its pray.

FossilTalk_03.value: Eeeh, wouldn't want one these things chasing me!

FoundCards_01.value: Ooh, this deck of cards looks neat!

FoundCards_02.value: It would be great to play a couple games with it once I restore this section.

FoundCards_03.value: I think I still remember a few fun card games...

FountainFilled_01.value: Did the tile really activate some sort of mechanism to turn the fountain on?

FountainFilled_02.value: Wait, the cupid's arrow is now glowing red! Creepy!

FountainFilled_03.value: It looks like I've unlocked some kind of elaborate puzzle.

FountainFilled_04.value: Let's see what the rest of those special tiles do...

Fountain_01.value: This fountain is a work of art! Look at the details! Too bad it's all dried up.

Fountain_02.value: I'm not sure if I can get it to work, but at least I can make sure it isn't a mess!

FtuePruningShearsFound.value: Those are the pruning shears we need! Let's clear the path!
Those are the <color=#338DFF>pruning shears</color> we need! Let's clear the path!

FtueWheelbarrowsFound.value: A Wheelbarrow! That's exactly what we need!
A <color=#338DFF>Wheelbarrow</color>! That's exactly what we need!

GM_Arctic2025_Hero1_Dialogue_01.value: Just this morning, I read in the newspaper about a fascinating case - a meteorite of some size that landed in the far north.

GM_Arctic2025_Hero1_Dialogue_02.value: This land is largely uncharted and very dangerous, but the meteorite could yield great resources.

GM_Arctic2025_Hero1_Dialogue_03.value: I am in the process of putting together a crew to travel to the north and search for the meteorite, but I truly do not know what awaits us...

GM_Arctic2025_Hero2_Dialogue_01.value: Our expedition has taken off at such speed that, since my last entry, we have already set out and reached the colder climes.

GM_Arctic2025_Hero2_Dialogue_02.value: I feel as though we are at the end of the earth. The sea is vast, with only some birds to keep us company.

GM_Arctic2025_Hero2_Dialogue_03.value: Our ship is strong against the wind and tides, but there is a trepidation among our crew. There are many dangers ahead.

GM_Arctic2025_Hero3_Dialogue_01.value: We are keeping warm as best we can, but I admit, I cannot wait to finally reach our destination.

GM_Arctic2025_Hero3_Dialogue_02.value: The long journey has allowed me to make plans and calculations. The meteorite's celestial origins promise a great deal of possibilities.

GM_Arctic2025_Hero4_Dialogue_01.value: We are drawing closer to the ice pack. We were forewarned about the dangers lurking here, but we must forge ahead.

GM_Arctic2025_Hero4_Dialogue_02.value: Members of my brave crew are conducting scientific study of the area, which I predict will prove to be very useful indeed - as long as we do not become trapped by the ice...

GM_Arctic2025_Hero5_Dialogue_01.value: Yesterday, we reached land. We disembarked, formed two smaller groups and set out with some basic supplies to explore further.

GM_Arctic2025_Hero5_Dialogue_02.value: Our tents are woefully weak against the elements here, but our spirits are high. According to my calculations, the meteorite is close!

GM_Arctic2025_Hero6_Dialogue_01.value: Alas, we have had to abandon our initial plan. The pack ice is threatening to trap our ship, if the worst happens, we will be confined in this frozen realm for a considerable time.

GM_Arctic2025_Hero6_Dialogue_02.value: We are not out of danger, but the safety of the crew must come first.

GM_Arctic2025_Hero7_Dialogue_01.value: We must be close to land - and the meteorite! If my calculations hold true, the movements of the ice have been most fortuitous.

GM_Arctic2025_Hero7_Dialogue_02.value: A small group I dispatched to scout the area returned and confirmed what I so hoped for: The meteorite is here!

GM_Arctic2025_Hero8_Dialogue_01.value: Yesterday, we set out before first light, and sure enough - we found a sizeable crater. What I found there quite astounded me.

GM_Arctic2025_Hero8_Dialogue_02.value: A blue gem, light and luminescent in quality, and abundant in the crater. I want to return to the site to collect all the material, but the ice encroaches upon our ship once more.

GM_Arctic2025_Hero9_Dialogue_01.value: My enthusiasm was premature. We are imprisoned by the ice once more - this time without any recourse.

GM_Arctic2025_Hero9_Dialogue_02.value: We have no choice but to wait until the winter eases, but that is many months from now. While we wait, I will begin my experiments with the new gem.

GM_Arctic2025_Hero9_Dialogue_03.value: Unique and exceptionally beautiful - it must be worth this pain.

GM_Arctic2025_IntroPopup_Description.value: Follow Ignatius' perilous journey to the far north and the discovery of the century!

GM_Arctic2025_Intro_Dialogue_02.value: It is! I just can't put it down. The world was so different then - everything still there to be explored and discovered.

GM_Arctic2025_Intro_Dialogue_03.value: Which part are you reading now?

GM_Arctic2025_Intro_Dialogue_04.value: He's writing about a news story he read about a meteorite that supposedly landed somewhere in the Arctic...

GM_Arctic2025_Intro_Dialogue_05.value: He didn't really travel there, too, did he?

GM_Arctic2025_Intro_Dialogue_06.value: Keep reading! It is a good story.

GM_MysteryMachine2025Hero10_01.value: Boultonite has proven to be an exceptional material for my engineering research!

GM_MysteryMachine2025Hero10_02.value: It now powers the heart of my latest creation, CB-01. However...

GM_MysteryMachine2025Hero10_03.value: I am left with a curious thought. What OTHER uses may it have?!

GM_MysteryMachine2025Hero1_01.value: I have continued my studies on the mysterious properties of Boultonite.

GM_MysteryMachine2025Hero1_02.value: Its potential is staggering, yet I find myself hard-pressed to find any practical use for it!

GM_MysteryMachine2025Hero1_03.value: I have decided to head to the World Fair in search of the brightest minds that could help me solve this riddle.

GM_MysteryMachine2025Hero2_01.value: Ah, the World Fair! An astounding exhibition of culture and science.

GM_MysteryMachine2025Hero2_02.value: Hopefully, I’ll find someone here who can help me harness the potential of Boultonite!

GM_MysteryMachine2025Hero2_03.value: Who knows... I may be perhaps attending next year with my own inventions, powered by Boultonite.

GM_MysteryMachine2025Hero3_01.value: Success! I have encountered a mathematical genius showing off his new computational machine.

GM_MysteryMachine2025Hero3_02.value: We had a very productive meeting, as I showed him a small sample of Boultonite. He was astounded!

GM_MysteryMachine2025Hero3_03.value: He believes Boultonite could power a very similar machine that could be ten times more powerful!

GM_MysteryMachine2025Hero4_01.value: At last! After months of designing and tinkering, my Mark I prototype is ready for testing!

GM_MysteryMachine2025Hero4_02.value: If my calculations are correct, my new Boultonite-powered machine will revolutionize the world.

GM_MysteryMachine2025Hero4_03.value: And put the Boulton name firmly on the map!

GM_MysteryMachine2025Hero5_01.value: Failure! Soon after starting the prototype, it overheated! Try as I may, there was nothing I could do.

GM_MysteryMachine2025Hero5_02.value: A chain reaction began that resulted in the destruction of the prototype and a better part of my workshop.

GM_MysteryMachine2025Hero5_03.value: Regardless, I have gathered plenty of data from this and have begun working on a new Mark II design.

GM_MysteryMachine2025Hero6_01.value: My Mark II design is complete! I discovered that there was inadequate shielding for the Boultonite core.

GM_MysteryMachine2025Hero6_02.value: This time around, I have reinforced the housing and increased the power output, ten fold!

GM_MysteryMachine2025Hero6_03.value: If anything, it is safer and more powerful than before! I have also added some new “intelligent” functionality.

GM_MysteryMachine2025Hero7_01.value: I have moved to my secondary workshop. Testing my Mark II model seems to have given explosive results.

GM_MysteryMachine2025Hero7_02.value: While the shielding held, the Mark II prototype became... uncontrollable. I cannot quite grasp what happened.

GM_MysteryMachine2025Hero7_03.value: It almost seemed alive! In fear, I had to disable it, which led to the inevitable destruction of my workshop.

GM_MysteryMachine2025Hero8_01.value: Eureka! I have solved it! I do not know how, but... I have solved it!

GM_MysteryMachine2025Hero8_02.value: It came to me in a dream and the moment I woke; I drew up the designs for a Boultonite Heart!

GM_MysteryMachine2025Hero8_03.value: Testing it has resulted in a stable output of unfathomable power. THIS will power my Mark III!

GM_MysteryMachine2025Hero9_01.value: At last, it is complete! My Mark III prototype. But I shall call it the Computational Boss. CB-01 for short.

GM_MysteryMachine2025Hero9_02.value: It will definitely be of help in my factory plans and will be the model for all future automation!

GM_MysteryMachine2025Hero9_03.value: However, it still seems to have a few intricacies that need ironing out...

GM_MysteryMachine2025Hero9_04.value: I don’t know if it was the long night, but I swear... It feels like it has an attitude all of its own.

GM_MysteryMachine2025Intro_01.value: Grandma! This journal... is something else!

GM_MysteryMachine2025Intro_02.value: I didn’t know that Boultonite was so powerful.

GM_MysteryMachine2025Intro_03.value: Yes, it is. Almost TOO powerful...

GM_MysteryMachine2025Intro_04.value: What do you mean by that?

GM_MysteryMachine2025Intro_06.value: I suggest you read up on Ignatius’s experiments with it...

GM_SeaAdventure2025_Hero10_Dialogue_01.value: A Colossal Boultonite jewel, radiant and untouched, a crowning jewel to a lost dynasty.

GM_SeaAdventure2025_Hero10_Dialogue_02.value: Now, as I sail home and the jewel gleaming in the sun, I am struck with a thought.

GM_SeaAdventure2025_Hero10_Dialogue_03.value: What became of the crew of that ship? And...

GM_SeaAdventure2025_Hero10_Dialogue_04.value: What if this jewel had something to do with it?!

GM_SeaAdventure2025_Hero1_Dialogue_01.value: Today, a curious letter arrived, accompanied by an old key.

GM_SeaAdventure2025_Hero1_Dialogue_02.value: It spoke of a legendary sunken treasure and a crown jewel, with eerie and peculiar properties.

GM_SeaAdventure2025_Hero1_Dialogue_03.value: From its description, I theorize it may in fact be a piece of Boultonite! Could it be true?

GM_SeaAdventure2025_Hero2_Dialogue_01.value: The key that came with the letter led me to the archives where it unlocked an old dusty chest.

GM_SeaAdventure2025_Hero2_Dialogue_02.value: Filled with dusty records, the chest contained clues that will hopefully lead me to the treasure’s location.

GM_SeaAdventure2025_Hero2_Dialogue_03.value: I should take time to study these clues, if I’m to seek this treasure.

GM_SeaAdventure2025_Hero3_Dialogue_01.value: I’ve spent many nights poring over the various documents and old maps the chest contained.

GM_SeaAdventure2025_Hero3_Dialogue_02.value: But I believe I have finally discovered the location of the last known location of the sunken ship!

GM_SeaAdventure2025_Hero3_Dialogue_03.value: A chain of uncharted islands off the coast may hold the fortune that I am seeking!

GM_SeaAdventure2025_Hero4_Dialogue_02.value: I’ve chartered a power steam ship and assembled a capable crew.

GM_SeaAdventure2025_Hero4_Dialogue_03.value: The promise of fortune and discovery fills their hearts and my own. The adventure is about to begin!

GM_SeaAdventure2025_Hero5_Dialogue_01.value: After months at sea, we have finally arrived near an uncharted island!

GM_SeaAdventure2025_Hero5_Dialogue_02.value: Its rocky silhouette that looms against the horizon is almost exactly described in the clues I uncovered!

GM_SeaAdventure2025_Hero5_Dialogue_03.value: A massive cave entrance beckons us, emanating a ghostly sound, whispering secrets of what lies within.

GM_SeaAdventure2025_Hero6_Dialogue_01.value: Incredible! Our exploration of the cavern’s depths has revealed a wrecked ship!

GM_SeaAdventure2025_Hero6_Dialogue_02.value: To our astonishment, the ship hadn’t sunk at all but was left derelict within this cave...

GM_SeaAdventure2025_Hero6_Dialogue_03.value: But a disturbing question remains... Why?

GM_SeaAdventure2025_Hero7_Dialogue_01.value: Exploring the ship has frustratingly not revealed any answers why the ship was hidden here.

GM_SeaAdventure2025_Hero7_Dialogue_02.value: Furthermore, the main hold of the ship has flooded, halting our exploration.

GM_SeaAdventure2025_Hero7_Dialogue_03.value: We must proceed with our diving equipment if we are to reach the treasure hold!

GM_SeaAdventure2025_Hero8_Dialogue_01.value: With diving equipment secured, we descended into the watery depths...

GM_SeaAdventure2025_Hero8_Dialogue_02.value: After struggling to remove some rotten wood and debris, we have finally arrived at the main treasure hold.

GM_SeaAdventure2025_Hero8_Dialogue_03.value: We must rest now and continue in the morning. After all this time, the treasure is finally within reach!

GM_SeaAdventure2025_Hero9_Dialogue_01.value: With excitement, we finally opened the treasure hold, revealing its wonders!

GM_SeaAdventure2025_Hero9_Dialogue_02.value: Golden artifacts, ancient trinkets and unbelievable hoards of riches greeted us.

GM_SeaAdventure2025_Hero9_Dialogue_03.value: And there, amidst this hoard of a century, I finally saw it!

GM_SeaAdventure2025_IntroPopup_Descripti.value: Find the most valuable gems to earn rewards!

GM_SeaAdventure2025_Intro_Dialogue_01.value: Maddie, dearie. Are you still reading that old journal?

GM_SeaAdventure2025_Intro_Dialogue_03.value: I didn’t know that Ignatius Boulton was so...

GM_SeaAdventure2025_Intro_Dialogue_05.value: Yes! I’ve just started reading about his account of finding a supposed sunken treasure!

GM_SeaAdventure2025_Intro_Dialogue_06.value: Oh, that one! Yes. That’s one of my favorites.

GM_Shared_Dialogues_Hero10_Dialogue_01.value: With our scientists encouragement, we’ve successfully used Boultonite to power a prototype machine that automatically sorts cans and their contents.

GM_Shared_Dialogues_Hero10_Dialogue_02.value: The machine operates with incredible precision, far beyond anything we’ve achieved before.

GM_Shared_Dialogues_Hero10_Dialogue_03.value: This breakthrough not only showcases Boultonite’s potential but also promises to revolutionize our tin can production process.

GM_Shared_Dialogues_Hero1_Dialogue_01.value: Today, I’ve opened the Boulton Mine in the old meteor crater, and the first samples of tin are promising.

GM_Shared_Dialogues_Hero1_Dialogue_02.value: The miners are in high spirits as they uncover vein after vein of pure tin ore.

GM_Shared_Dialogues_Hero1_Dialogue_03.value: I foresee great things for the factory with this new supply.

GM_Shared_Dialogues_Hero2_Dialogue_01.value: Weeks have passed, and we continue to extract an abundance of tin, but strange red gems have begun to appear among the deposits.

GM_Shared_Dialogues_Hero2_Dialogue_02.value: They are unlike anything I’ve seen before, shimmering with an inner light that seems almost alive.

GM_Shared_Dialogues_Hero2_Dialogue_03.value: I’ve decided to name the gems Boultonite after myself.

GM_Shared_Dialogues_Hero3_Dialogue_01.value: The deeper we dig, the more gems we find! Amethysts, Topaz, even Lapis Lazuli! All in the same mine!

GM_Shared_Dialogues_Hero3_Dialogue_02.value: This is truly a rare, if unique, find! Among the other precious stones, we still find Boultonite.

GM_Shared_Dialogues_Hero3_Dialogue_03.value: I have contacted some scientist acquaintances to come and investigate...

GM_Shared_Dialogues_Hero4_Dialogue_01.value: Edison arrived today and immediately took an interest in the electrical properties of Boultonite.

GM_Shared_Dialogues_Hero4_Dialogue_02.value: He believes this gem could hold the key to a new form of energy, one that could revolutionize the world.

GM_Shared_Dialogues_Hero4_Dialogue_03.value: I’m eager to see what he and the others can uncover.

GM_Shared_Dialogues_Hero5_Dialogue_01.value: More scientists have joined our efforts, and their experiments with Boultonite have yielded astonishing results.

GM_Shared_Dialogues_Hero5_Dialogue_02.value: They claim the gem can generate a magnetic field more powerful than anything they have encountered.

GM_Shared_Dialogues_Hero5_Dialogue_03.value: I begin to wonder if this discovery is bigger than any of us anticipated...

GM_Shared_Dialogues_Hero6_Dialogue_01.value: After months of research, the scientists are unanimous: Boultonite is no ordinary gem.

GM_Shared_Dialogues_Hero7_Dialogue_01.value: The workers are curious, and their excitement mirrors my own as we uncover more of these fascinating gems.

GM_Shared_Dialogues_Hero7_Dialogue_02.value: I’m confident that Boultonite will bring us unprecedented success and recognition.

GM_Shared_Dialogues_Hero7_Dialogue_03.value: My scientists wish to do more experiments on the Boultonite.

GM_Shared_Dialogues_Hero8_Dialogue_01.value: News of our discovery has spread, and inquiries are pouring in from around the country.

GM_Shared_Dialogues_Hero8_Dialogue_02.value: Investors and scientists alike are eager to learn more about Boultonite, and the excitement is palpable.

GM_Shared_Dialogues_Hero8_Dialogue_03.value: I’m thrilled that our work is gaining the recognition it deserves.

GM_Shared_Dialogues_Hero9_Dialogue_01.value: Today, as we examined the mine’s location within the ancient impact crater, it dawned on us that Boultonite might have come from space.

GM_Shared_Dialogues_Hero9_Dialogue_02.value: The unique properties of the gem suggest an extraterrestrial origin, possibly brought here by the meteor millions of years ago.

GM_Shared_Dialogues_Hero9_Dialogue_03.value: This revelation has added a new layer of intrigue to our discovery, fueling our determination to unlock its secrets.

GM_Shared_Dialogues_Intro_Dialogue_01.value: Grandma, do we have more of Ignatius' old diaries left?

GM_Shared_Dialogues_Intro_Dialogue_02.value: I need to find out what happens next in his story. I'm TOTALLY hooked!

GM_Shared_Dialogues_Intro_Dialogue_03.value: You won’t believe what I found in the cellar! An old tunnel with tracks! It’s huge!
There are still plenty more volumes left in the library. The man loved an adventure!

GM_Shared_Dialogues_Intro_Dialogue_04.value: But every page I read, I find more questions than answers. Like what happened to his collection of gems?
But every page I read, I find more questions than answers. Like, what happened to his collection of gems?

GM_Shared_Dialogues_Intro_Dialogue_05.value: Just keep reading. Maybe you will find the answers in those diaries...

GM_Shared_Dialogues_Intro_Dialogue_06.value: Oh yes, dearie. That’s the old tunnel that lead to the Boulton tin mine!

GM_Shared_Dialogues_Intro_Dialogue_07.value: Why don’t you read Ignatius’s journal about it? It tells about the mines “interesting” history!

GM_Underwater_IntroPopup_Description.value: Search for valuable underwater treasures with Ignatius Boulton, intrepid explorer and shrewd businessman!

GM_Underwater_Intro_Dialogue_01.value: You know a lot about the Boulton family history, don't you, Julius?

GM_Underwater_Intro_Dialogue_02.value: You could say that. I have conducted research into your family's heraldry, and let me tell you - it is fascinating!

GM_Underwater_Intro_Dialogue_03.value: No doubt... but would you happen to know anything about Ignatius?

GM_Underwater_Intro_Dialogue_04.value: Are you interested in his travels?

GM_Underwater_Intro_Dialogue_05.value: I can't help it - I'm totally hooked!

GM_Underwater_Intro_Dialogue_06.value: I am not surprised. Have you read about how he ended up shipwrecked on a desert island in the middle of the ocean?

GM_Underwater_Intro_Dialogue_08.value: He did, and made it all the way back home.

GM_Underwater_StartPopup_Description.value: Find the most valuable underwater treasures to earn rewards!

GM_Underwater_Story_01_Dialogue_01.value: Mrs Boulton, my wife, recently came into possession of an old oil painting.

GM_Underwater_Story_01_Dialogue_02.value: A trifling image in itself, it concealed an altogether greater enigma.

GM_Underwater_Story_01_Dialogue_03.value: Pictured in the portrait is a lady wearing a necklace with an astoundingly beautiful, iridescent pearl!

GM_Underwater_Story_01_Dialogue_04.value: I am captivated by it, and desperate to find out more about its history and present.

GM_Underwater_Story_02_Dialogue_01.value: Alas, the magnificent necklace is lost to history, but I have managed to find some information about it.

GM_Underwater_Story_02_Dialogue_02.value: The story of the Pearl is both exciting and tragic, and it seems it has claimed countless poor souls.

GM_Underwater_Story_02_Dialogue_04.value: The journey to the origin of the Pearl is full of dangers, but it will not leave me alone. It occupies my mind, day and night.

GM_Underwater_Story_03_Dialogue_01.value: I am resolved to find this Pearl, but my research has yielded little in the way of directions.

GM_Underwater_Story_03_Dialogue_02.value: The ocean is vast, and I am unsure how to continue. This uncertainty plagues me.

GM_Underwater_Story_03_Dialogue_03.value: I must find a way forward.

GM_Underwater_Story_04_Dialogue_01.value: I have corresponded with a distant associate, located on a faraway continent, and he has been able to tell me more about these legendary pearls.

GM_Underwater_Story_04_Dialogue_02.value: They are formed inside large shells, called conchs, found in shallow waters around certain tropical islands.

GM_Underwater_Story_04_Dialogue_03.value: I have my directions and I have my mission.

GM_Underwater_Story_05_Dialogue_01.value: Our journey to the tropics is under way. I have an able crew, and the winds are fair - not storm in sight!

GM_Underwater_Story_05_Dialogue_02.value: We have been very lucky. I expect to be home to Agatha earlier than I expected.

GM_Underwater_Story_06_Dialogue_01.value: The winds are picking up, and the waves are gathering strength. My crew fears a storm is rising.

GM_Underwater_Story_06_Dialogue_02.value: I am still confident we can circle around the foul weather and arrive on schedule.

GM_Underwater_Story_06_Dialogue_03.value: We must, for my plans for the Pearl are coming along. I see great business potential! This Pearl is exactly what I have been looking for...

GM_Underwater_Story_07_Dialogue_01.value: Our plan to steer clear of the weather has failed. With storm fronts approaching from multiple directions, we have found ourselves in a perilous position.

GM_Underwater_Story_07_Dialogue_02.value: Our ship creaks with each crashing wave. It was not built for such battles, nor was I!

GM_Underwater_Story_07_Dialogue_03.value: The hope of finding the pearl gives me courage, but for how long can we keep going?

GM_Underwater_Story_08_Dialogue_01.value: The very worst has come to pass. A mighty storm caused our ship to run aground, leaving us shipwrecked on a remote island.

GM_Underwater_Story_08_Dialogue_02.value: With little hope of finding rescue - or indeed, the pearl - we are faced with certain doom.

GM_Underwater_Story_09_Dialogue_01.value: The most incredible thing has happened! A large sailing vessel, attempting the fastest circumnavigation of the globe, happened upon us.

GM_Underwater_Story_09_Dialogue_03.value: Not only that, but our defeated days on the desert island turned victorious when we discovered the fabled conchs in the shallow waters around it.

GM_Underwater_Story_09_Dialogue_04.value: We are lucky, indeed. And soon... rich!

GM_Underwater_Story_10_Dialogue_01.value: We have returned home at last, weathered and alive.

GM_Underwater_Story_10_Dialogue_02.value: The pearl rests now in my study, glowing faintly even in darkness, as though it holds a light all its own.

GM_Underwater_Story_10_Dialogue_03.value: What began as an enigma in a painting became a journey of a lifetime.

GM_Underwater_Story_10_Dialogue_04.value: Yet, as I gaze upon the pearl, I wonder... Did we truly find it? Or did it find us?!

GM_Underwater_TodoTask_Header.value: Search and merge to find the most valuable underwater treasures!

GM_Xmas2024_Hero1_Dialogue_01.value: T'was the night before Christmas, when all through the house

GM_Xmas2024_Hero1_Dialogue_02.value: Not a creature was stirring, not even a mouse

GM_Xmas2024_Hero2_Dialogue_01.value: The stockings were hung by the chimney with care,

GM_Xmas2024_Hero2_Dialogue_02.value: In hopes that St. Nicholas soon would be there

GM_Xmas2024_Hero3_Dialogue_01.value: The children were nestled all snug in their beds,

GM_Xmas2024_Hero3_Dialogue_02.value: While visions of sugar-plums danced in their heads

GM_Xmas2024_Hero4_Dialogue_01.value: When out on the lawn there arose such a clatter,

GM_Xmas2024_Hero4_Dialogue_02.value: I sprang from the bed to see what was the matter.

GM_Xmas2024_Hero5_Dialogue_01.value: He was chubby and plump, a right jolly old elf,

GM_Xmas2024_Hero5_Dialogue_02.value: And I laughed when I saw him, in spite of myself

GM_Xmas2024_Hero6_Dialogue_01.value: A bundle of Toys he had flung on his back,

GM_Xmas2024_Hero6_Dialogue_02.value: And he look'd like a pedlar just opening his pack.

GM_Xmas2024_Hero7_Dialogue_01.value: He spoke not a word, but went straight to his work,

GM_Xmas2024_Hero7_Dialogue_02.value: And fill'd all the stockings; then turned with a jerk

GM_Xmas2024_Hero8_Dialogue_01.value: But I heard him exclaim, ere he drove out of sight,

GM_Xmas2024_Hero8_Dialogue_02.value: "Happy Holidays to all, and to all a good night."

GM_Xmas2024_Hero9_Dialogue_01.value: It seems Santa has saved the best for the last;

GM_Xmas2024_Hero9_Dialogue_02.value: Rewarding himself for good deeds of the past

GM_Xmas2024_Intro_Dialogue_02.value: Wow, calm down Mason. What's got you so excited?

GM_Xmas2024_Intro_Dialogue_03.value: I- I just heard there are mines under Hopewell Bay, FILLED with treasure and and...

GM_Xmas2024_Intro_Dialogue_04.value: And jewels and all sorts of cool stuff! Maybe I could ask Santa for some of them!

GM_Xmas2024_Intro_Dialogue_05.value: You know, I did find something in Ignatius's journal on the mines about the holiday season.

GM_Xmas2024_Intro_Dialogue_06.value: He loved reading it to his children. Do you want to hear it?

Gallery01_01.value: Tell me more about this gallery, Winston. Is it a museum of sorts?

Gallery01_02.value: Oh, it's more than just that, ma'am. In here, you'll find Lindsay Boulton's heart and soul.

Gallery01_04.value: Your brilliant ancestor paved the way for women explorers!

Gallery01_05.value: All the items you see were discovered on her various expeditions.

Gallery01_06.value: Wow, really?! She sounds like the very definition of a pioneer. I can't wait to discover more!

Gallery01_07.value: I'm sure there will be no dearth of secrets, ma'am...

Gallery02_01.value: There you are, Maddie! Ooh, what is that cool, glowing statue, and why is it missing a head?

Gallery02_02.value: I'm not sure. I'm wondering if it's something evil that Lindsay brought back from the depths of the ocean.

Gallery02_03.value: I wonder if it's a fascinating monster from literature! I've read about something like this...

Gallery02_04.value: You're right, it does look like a monster, even without a head...

Gallery02_05.value: But it seems like it was placed here for a reason. Could it be protecting something?

Gallery02_06.value: You know, in my line of work, I've discovered that evil and monsters are man-made.

Gallery03_01.value: Roddy, it's been a while. I see you continue to fraternize with the wrong crowd...

Gallery03_02.value: W-who are you? What's going on?

Gallery03_03.value: Detective Sullivan, Veilwood P.D. I'll be asking the questions around here.

Gallery03_04.value: You must be Maddie. Quite a mansion you have here!

Gallery03_05.value: May I ask what brings you here, detective?

Gallery03_06.value: There's been new developments regarding your grandmother's case, and I've taken it upon myself to reopen it.

Gallery03_07.value: W-what do you mean? What kind of developments?

Gallery03_08.value: Evidence tampering. Do you remember a particular gold watch?

Gallery03_09.value: Not this again! My grandmother is innocent! She's probably being framed...

Gallery03_10.value: Oh, the number of times I've heard that one before.

Gallery04_02.value: I-I think he was that detective involved in Grandma's arrest...

Gallery04_03.value: Well, Tim and I met at the academy and we were partners for a while. Best partner I ever had!
Bingo. Well, Tim and I met at the academy, and we were partners for a while. Best partner I ever had!

Gallery04_04.value: He had to move on to bigger things and he urged me to take his place.

Gallery04_05.value: This case of his, it intrigued me. Once I got my hands on it, it just got stranger and stranger.

Gallery04_06.value: So many loose ends and endless questions...

Gallery04_07.value: But I believe that the answers are right in front of you, if only you know where to look.

Gallery04_08.value: So, what IS Grandma hiding, Maddie?

Gallery04_09.value: I'm telling you, you have the wrong idea and you don't want to go down this path...

Gallery05_01.value: Kate, are you sure this isn't some kind of mistake?

Gallery05_02.value: That's Detective Sullivan to you, and I don't make mistakes, Roddy. You're well aware.

Gallery05_03.value: Do you two know each other?

Gallery05_04.value: Maddie, you seem like a smart girl, so I'm only going to say this once - you need to stop protecting your grandmother.

Gallery05_05.value: There's a lot you don't know about her.

Gallery05_06.value: Are you aware that you could go behind bars for refusing to cooperate?

Gallery05_08.value: Don't stand in the way of justice because of mere attachments, Maddie!

Gallery05_09.value: Detective, I think you should leave. I won't say another word without a lawyer.

Gallery05_10.value: So be it, but don't be surprised if there's another arrest made soon.

Gallery06_01.value: My head is spinning, Roddy. The case has been reopened? And how do you know Sullivan?

Gallery06_04.value: I think I need to lie down.

Gallery06_07.value: I just wanted to say that perhaps the lady detective was not entirely wrong.

Gallery06_08.value: What are you talking about? I'm hardly in the mood for cryptic messages.

Gallery06_09.value: I mean, do you really know all of Mrs. Boulton's secrets?

Gallery06_10.value: Yes! I-I think. Winston, what aren't you telling me?

Gallery06_11.value: All I know is that sometimes statues hold secrets, just as people do.

Gallery06_12.value: That's it! I knew that glowing, green monster was hiding something!

Gallery07.2_01.value: It looks like a folder. Let's check what's inside!

Gallery07.2_02.value: A photograph! A wedding photograph... of Grandma!

Gallery07.2_03.value: But wait, that's not Grandpa Charlie! Oh my goodness!

Gallery07.2_04.value: W-why does that guy look like Crutchley...

Gallery07.2_07.value: No... It can't be! Are you certain?!

Gallery07.2_08.value: It's hard to forget that face...

Gallery07.2_09.value: Wait a minute, does that mean that you're part of... you're connected to...

Gallery07_01.value: Do you see a button anywhere, Maddie?

Gallery07_02.value: Ugh no, I don't see anything!

Gallery07_03.value: Hold on, there's a piece of the wood that's loose here!

Gallery07_05.value: Did you hear that?! It worked! And there's something inside!

Gallery08.2_01.value: That picture is... not what you think it is.

Gallery08.2_02.value: It looks to me like you're married to a mob boss. Quite happily married.

Gallery08.2_03.value: How could you do this to Grandpa Charlie?

Gallery08.2_04.value: Maddie, there were things I had to do to keep this family safe. You wouldn't understand.

Gallery08.2_05.value: Maybe I would if you actually told me anything at all!

Gallery08.2_06.value: All I've ever done is defend you and for what?!

Gallery08.2_07.value: And all I've ever done is protect you to the best of my abilities!

Gallery08.2_08.value: I've had enough of this insolence! I'm putting an end to your renovation and meddling!

Gallery08.2_09.value: There! I've locked the door to the next room. This ends here.

Gallery08.2_10.value: Grandma! No! You can't do this!

Gallery08.2_11.value: Oh, I can Maddie. I most definitely can.

Gallery08_01.value: This has to be some sort of twisted joke.

Gallery08_02.value: I have so many questions and I'm scared to find out what the answers are.

Gallery08_05.value: You look a bit pale, Maddie. You really should step outside more often.

Gallery08_06.value: Well, Grandma, I've had a terrible day and as of a few minutes ago, it just got worse.

Gallery08_08.value: I found something interesting... A photograph of you.

Gallery08_09.value: There are portraits and photographs all over this mansion, dearie.

Gallery08_10.value: I think you know which one I mean. A certain wedding picture...

Gallery09_01.value: Arrgh! I am beyond mad! How could she?!

Gallery09_02.value: I don't deserve to be treated like a child!

Gallery09_03.value: I won't let this stop me. Maybe I can break the door down?

Gallery09_06.value: Winston! Am I glad to see you! I need you to help me get this door open.

Gallery09_07.value: On the count of three, both of us will run at it with full force!

Gallery09_08.value: There's no need for all that, ma'am. There's a spare key hidden behind that painting there.

Gallery09_09.value: Oh, that makes things easier. Thanks, Winston!

Gallery09_10.value: Nothing can hold me back from discovering the truth now!

GalleryIntro_01.value: I can't believe I found the key to the gallery in the dining room and I'm only just unlocking it!

GalleryIntro_02.value: It's such a relief to see dry floors again....

GalleryIntro_03.value: This room looks like it was frozen in time though.

GalleryIntro_04.value: I suppose you could say that. It's a room that is steeped in ancient history.

GalleryIntro_05.value: Winston! You've got to stop creeping up on people.

GalleryTeaser_01.value: I can't believe there's a piece of history preserved in this very room!

GalleryTeaser_02.value: Ooh, I see some scribbles behind this photo...

GalleryTeaser_03.value: I think I can make out a few words. Galley? No, gallery!

GalleryTeaser_04.value: And there's a sketch here too! It looks like a key and it's different from the others.

GalleryTeaser_05.value: The key to the gallery must be somewhere in this room. I'll have to find it first!

Got to scrub those dirty feet
We need to make things shine!
Move the mud from the paths
Everything we need to wash up
This will get the mud away
The streets will soon be clean
Rufus won't make any more mess
This will help to clean up
This is just what we need

Generic_Event_Task_Goal_Description_Flow.value: Preparing to plant some lovely flowers,
Gardening gloves and tools have great powers,
Digging holes and clearing debris,
We're buzzing around like happy bees.
Our hands are dirty, our spirits high,
The sun is shining bright in the sky,
We'll water them well and wait with glee,
Soon these blooms will be a sight to see.
Our garden will be the talk of the town,
With colors so bright they'll never frown,
So let's keep digging, planting with all our might,
And soon our garden will be a beautiful sight!
Picking and cleaning flowers, oh what a chore,
We'll put the roses in the red glass,
And the tulips in the white one, with a bit of sass,
The daisies will go in the yellow vase,
And the carnations will look grand in the gold, with grace.
Now the vases are ready, and the flowers are too,
We'll put them on display, and let them be the view,
The customers will come, and they'll be wowed,
By the beauty of our flowers, and the vases that are proud.
Customers will come from far and near,
It's hard work, but we can't help but adore,
To take home a bouquet and spread some cheer.
So yes, it's hard work, but it's worth the sweat,
To see the joy that our flowers beget,
And we'll keep on picking, cleaning, and planting too,
For the love of flowers, and for all of you!
To the flower market!
The sweet smell and colors that fill the air,
We're ready to pick and plant with care.
With baskets in hand and a smile on our face,
We head to the fields at a steady pace,
Picking daisies, roses, and tulips too,
We're determined to fill our baskets through and through.
Once back at the shop, we roll up our sleeves,
The cleaning begins, oh how we grieve,
The dirt and the bugs, they cling with might,
But we'll wash them clean, then they'll be a sight.
Now it's time to plant, our backs are sore,
But the flower market is what we're here for,
We'll plant marigolds, lilies, and more,
And watch them grow and bloom galore.
The market opens early, we're all set to go,
We'll sell our flowers with a smile and a glow.
Preparing flowers for the market, what a thrill,
We'll clean and trim them all with skill,
Tulips, daisies, and roses so bright,
Their sweet aroma fills us with delight.
With scissors in hand, we'll snip and prune,
And soon our flowers will be in full bloom,
We'll sort them by color and size so fine,
And arrange them in vases that will surely shine.
The customers will come, oh what a treat,
We'll sell our flowers with smiles so sweet,
They'll take them home to brighten their space,
And our hard work will have won the race.
Where are the vases that will match our blooms,
That will show off their colors and dispel all gloom,
We need vases that sparkle, that glimmer and shine,
And will make our flowers look oh so divine!
We'll go to the store and look on the shelves,
And when we see the vases, we'll high-five ourselves,
We've found the perfect ones, the most beautiful of all,
And now we'll get to work, arranging them tall.

GoldenWeek2024_Producer_01_Dialogue_02.value: 日本に住んでいたときに、いいことを学んだのよ！日本では「知恵袋」と呼ばれるエコな考え方があるんだけど...。

GoldenWeek2024_Producer_01_Dialogue_03.value: えっ日本に住んでたの？

GoldenWeek2024_Producer_01_Dialogue_04.value: あらそうよ、昔のことね。ミックスゼリーでも食べながら、色々教えてあげるわ...。

Goldie_PremiumRewardTip_Description.value: *Ruff-ruff!* I think I can smell a squirrel!

GrandPiano_01.value: Tuning a piano as old as this was no joke. Now, it's time to see whether all that hard work paid off...

GrandPiano_02.value: It's been a while since I've played a piano piece...

GrandPiano_03.value: I hope I still remember those lessons I took as a teen!

GrandPiano_04.value: Not bad, if I do say so myself. My high school teacher, Mrs Wexley would be proud!

GrandmaChair_01.value: Ooh, this chair looks fancy. Did Grandpa Charlie sit here?

GrandmaChair_02.value: Of course not, Dear! This was my chair. I am the head of the family, after all!

GrandmaRoom_02_01.value: Huh, that was odd. I would have noticed if Grandma had walked right by me.

GrandmaRoom_02_02.value: Or was I just that engrossed in my own thoughts?

GrandmaRoom_02_03.value: No, it's definitely odd. She was also acting just like the way she used to in the past - avoidant.

GrandmaRoom_02_04.value: Well, I'm glad she didn't ask me to leave coz now I'm more certain that there's tons of secrets to uncover!

GrandmaRoom_03_01.value: Hmm, there's certainly more than meets the eye with Grandma's quaint sewing corner...

GrandmaRoom_03_02.value: Secrets all around, like these fabrics! At first glance, they seem pretty normal, but when the light hits it at a certain angle-

GrandmaRoom_03_03.value: Woah! They all have some sort of hidden pattern! Almost like a code?

GrandmaRoom_03_04.value: That has to be it. Clothes as a communication tactic!? That's genius!

GrandmaRoom_03_05.value: There's no decoder here, but it does beg the question, what exactly needed to be communicated?

GrandmaRoom_03_06.value: I wonder if this is connected to the Secret Society or something deeper?

GrandmaRoom_08_01.value: Hmm, what IS this sticking out from under the bed?

GrandmaRoom_08_02.value: It almost looks like the bed is propped up on something...

GrandmaRoom_08_03.value: It is! And it looks like it's a conveyor belt of sorts!

GrandmaRoom_08_04.value: Looks pretty homemade, but why on earth would this be a thing?

GrandmaRoom_09_01.value: These bedposts are interesting to say the least.

GrandmaRoom_09_02.value: I like how they're both representative of Grandma's knitting skills and Charlie's clock-making expertise!

GrandmaRoom_09_03.value: The top is loose, but it looks like that's intentional?

GrandmaRoom_09_04.value: It screws back on, just like a bottle cap!

GrandmaRoom_09_05.value: Knowing this mansion and the fact that this is Grandma's room...

GrandmaRoom_09_06.value: Everything weird probably has a purpose!

GrandmaRoom_09_07.value: Let's see if the other bedpost is somehow connected to this one.

GrandmaRoom_10_01.value: Just as I suspected! The top of this bedpost is loose, too.

GrandmaRoom_10_02.value: And significantly tougher to put back in place!

GrandmaRoom_10_After_01.value: W-what! My head is spinning! This painting was a door the whole time?!

GrandmaRoom_10_After_02.value: And now that conveyor belt under the bad makes sense!
And now that conveyor belt under the bed makes sense!

GrandmaRoom_10_After_03.value: The bedposts triggered the bed to move forward and opened this 'door'!

GrandmaRoom_10_After_04.value: Grandma really is always two steps ahead of me!

GrandmaRoom_14_03.value: Yeah, well. I did say I would think about the beach...

GrandmaRoom_14_04.value: There's nothing like reigniting an old flame, is there? I knew you wouldn't be able to resist!

GrandmaRoom_14_05.value: Don't push it, Arthur. And we're not reigniting anything.

GrandmaRoom_14_06.value: It's just a walk on the beach.

GrandmaRoom_14_07.value: Alright, alright. I'll take what I can get! A walk it is. See you soon, Mads!

GrandmaRoom_17_After_02.value: This wardrobe was the door in question! Who would have thought!

GrandmaRoom_17_After_03.value: I can't wait to see what's been kept hidden behind these doors!

GrandmaRoom_CharacterTask1_01.value: Whoa. Grandpa Charlie had such a large game collection. It's like a time capsule in here.

GrandmaRoom_CharacterTask1_02.value: Your grandfather had a good eye for strategy games, Maddie. The rare ones.

GrandmaRoom_CharacterTask1_03.value: Heikki! Hey, come in. The room is a bit of a mess, but it's a work in progress.

GrandmaRoom_CharacterTask1_04.value: I was... thinking of starting a small board game club. At the library. I was wondering if perhaps...

GrandmaRoom_CharacterTask1_05.value: You want to borrow some of these? That's a great idea, Heikki! I'm happy to help.

GrandmaRoom_CharacterTask1_06.value: But hey, before I dig these games up. Let me patch up that jacket for you. A club founder should look the part.

GrandmaRoom_CharacterTask1_07.value: Oh, This old thing? You really don't have to, Maddie...

GrandmaRoom_CharacterTask1_08.value: I know. But I want to. Consider it my investment in your club. Now, let me find Grandma's sewing kit.

GrandmaRoom_CharacterTask2_01.value: So, Heikki. How's the club room in the library?

GrandmaRoom_CharacterTask2_02.value: It's... functional.  Four walls and table, but a large one. Sits twelve, if you don't mind standing.

GrandmaRoom_CharacterTask2_03.value: Huh, no chairs then? We can fix that! I'm sure I have some spare chairs and decorations somewhere.

GrandmaRoom_CharacterTask2_04.value: Maddie, you have already helped enough with the jacket...

GrandmaRoom_CharacterTask2_05.value: Nonsense! Every good game club needs a vibe. And chairs. Let me help, Heikki.

GrandmaRoom_CharacterTask3_01.value: Your grandfather and I had a favorite game. It had a lot of small pieces. But I can't remember the name.

GrandmaRoom_CharacterTask3_02.value: Small pieces? Let me see... Gnomish Goldmine... Laundry Day Simulator... Or maybe Espionage: Vienna?

GrandmaRoom_CharacterTask3_03.value: No... wait! Espionage: Vienna. That sounds closer. Yes, it was a spy game.

GrandmaRoom_CharacterTask3_04.value: A spy game! Okay, that rules out The Sicilian Getaway. Let me look for boxes with spies.

GrandmaRoom_CharacterTask4_01.value: Heikki. You should write some invitations for the board game club. Call it the "Hopewell Bay's Gaming Guild".

GrandmaRoom_CharacterTask4_02.value: "Gaming Guild"? That sounds... official. But what would I even write?

GrandmaRoom_CharacterTask4_03.value: "Adventurers wanted". And mention you're providing snacks. We need a creative menu.

GrandmaRoom_CharacterTask4_04.value: Snacks? I was thinking salted licorice. A classic, very durable.

GrandmaRoom_CharacterTask4_05.value: Okay, let's workshop the snacks. But let's write invitations first. "All levels welcome".

GrandmaRoom_CharacterTask5_01.value: That was fun! See? You ran that whole game yourself.

GrandmaRoom_CharacterTask5_02.value: It has been many years. I was afraid I had forgotten how.

GrandmaRoom_CharacterTask5_03.value: Are you kidding? You're a natural. You explained those rules perfectly.

GrandmaRoom_CharacterTask5_04.value: It felt good. To have the pieces on the board game. Thank you, Maddie. For all of this.

GrandmaRoom_CharacterTask5_05.value: That's what friends are for. I have a great feeling about the Hopewell Bay's Gaming Guild.

GrandmaRoom_CharacterTask5_06.value: As do I. A new adventure begins!

GrandmaRoom_POI_Bookends_01.value: Hmm, these bookends are two completely different flowers.

GrandmaRoom_POI_Bookends_02.value: One's definitely a lily, but I can't quite figure out what the other one is.

GrandmaRoom_POI_Bookends_03.value: The lily symbolism is getting stronger....

GrandmaRoom_POI_Bookends_04.value: I almost feel like I'm getting closer to an answer!

GrandmaRoom_POI_FunnyBooks_01.value: Grandma's taste in books is fascinating to say the least!

GrandmaRoom_POI_FunnyBooks_04.value: I might have to browse through these when I get a chance!

GrandmaRoom_POI_KnittingBasket_01.value: Ha! This knitting basket has to be proof that Grandma was in this security room recently.

GrandmaRoom_POI_KnittingBasket_02.value: It's almost funny how it's sitting so bright and unassumingly in this particularly dinghy room.

GrandmaRoom_POI_PocketWatch_01.value: Huh, this pocket watch has an interesting inscription at the back.

GrandmaRoom_POI_PocketWatch_02.value:
'When the hand that holds the time aligns,
The door will shift between the lines.'

GrandmaRoom_POI_PocketWatch_03.value: Now I'm intrigued, this sounds like a puzzle! I should hold onto this watch.

GrandmaRoom_POI_PoisonBook_01.value: Hmm, a book on poisonous plants and their properties?

GrandmaRoom_POI_PoisonBook_02.value: Not really light bedtime reading, but to each their own, I suppose!

GrandmaRoom_POI_PoisonBook_03.value: There's a particular flower that's circled in red here - lily of the valley!

GrandmaRoom_POI_PoisonBook_04.value: Wow, I didn't realize how toxic it is. I wonder why it's important...

GrandmaRoom_POI_RockingChair_01.value: Woah! This chair has a cool hidden compartment!

GrandmaRoom_POI_RockingChair_02.value: And there's something in here - a letter!

GrandmaRoom_POI_RockingChair_03.value: Hmm, it's signed C, so it has to be Grandpa Charlie.

GrandmaRoom_POI_RockingChair_04.value: But, this letter is almost illegible. It looks like it's written entirely in some kind of code.

GrandmaRoom_POI_RockingChair_05.value: Hold on, the codes look very similar to the patterns on the clothes Grandma was making.

GrandmaRoom_POI_RockingChair_06.value: Wow, it's almost like they were running a secret information system!

GrandmaRoom_POI_TableFlip_01.value: Another hidden mechanism! This room is full of surprises!

GrandmaRoom_POI_TableFlip_02.value: This must be more one of Grandpa's clever inventions!

GrandmaRoom_POI_TableFlip_03.value: I love how there's a bit of both of them in this room.

GrandmaRoom_POI_TableFlip_04.value: This board game looks like something Grandpa Charlie must have created himself!

GrandmaRoom_POI_TableFlip_05.value: I can just imagine the two of them spending plenty of quality time here!

GrandmaRoom_POI_WatchCollection_02.value: There are some real vintage pieces here.

GrandmaRoom_POI_WatchCollection_03.value: It looks like he'd also restored quite a few of these back in the day!

GrandmasRoom_01_01.value: I guess this shouldn’t be so surprising.

GrandmasRoom_01_02.value: Grandma doing grandma things, like sewing.

GrandmasRoom_01_04.value: I don’t know what I was expecting, really...

GrandmasRoom_01_06.value: Grandma?! How did you get all the way over there?

GrandmasRoom_01_07.value: I didn’t even hear you come in!

GrandmasRoom_01_09.value: Must be these new slippers of mine! They’re really comfy, you know?

GrandmasRoom_01_11.value: I see you’ve decided to start on my room! How wonderful! I guess I’ll scurry along then.

GrandmasRoom_01_12.value: Don’t want to be in your way!

GrandmasRoom_02_01.value: Huh, that was odd. I would have noticed if Grandma had walked right by me.

GrandmasRoom_02_02.value: Or was I just that engrossed in my own thoughts?

GrandmasRoom_02_03.value: No, it's definitely odd. She was also acting just like the way she used to in the past - avoidant.

GrandmasRoom_02_04.value: Well, I'm glad she didn't ask me to leave coz now I'm more certain that there's tons of secrets to uncover!

GrandmasRoom_03_01.value: Hmm, there's certainly more than meets the eye with Grandma's quaint sewing corner...

GrandmasRoom_03_02.value: Secrets all around, like these fabrics! At first glance, they seem pretty normal but  when the light hits it in a certain angle-

GrandmasRoom_03_03.value: Woah! They all have some sort of hidden pattern! Almost like a code?

GrandmasRoom_03_04.value: That has to be it. Clothes as a communication tactic!? That's genius!

GrandmasRoom_03_05.value: There's no decoder here, but, it does beg the question, what exactly needed to be communicated?

GrandmasRoom_03_06.value: I wonder if this is connected to the Secret Society or something deeper?

GrandmasRoom_04_05.value: Hmm, some others are so worn out, it’s hard to see who they are.

GrandmasRoom_04_06.value: She’s really put a lot of love and effort into this!

GrandmasRoom_04_07.value: I guess she still really cares about our family history, despite all the secrecy.

GrandmasRoom_05_01.value: Almost done, just need to add a few finishing touches!

GrandmasRoom_05_02.value: Hey, don’t forget to make room for me.

GrandmasRoom_05_03.value: Arthur! What are you doing here?

GrandmasRoom_05_04.value: The door was open again, Mads.

GrandmasRoom_05_05.value: That’s a beautiful tapestry you’re working on.

GrandmasRoom_05_06.value: Thank you... But n- no. You’re not going on this!

GrandmasRoom_05_07.value: I’m still mad at you for getting into a childish fight with Roddy!

GrandmasRoom_05_09.value: Understand?! What’s there to understand? You hit him!

GrandmasRoom_06_01.value: Mads, you have to listen to me...

GrandmasRoom_06_02.value: Roddy is bad news. Really bad news!

GrandmasRoom_06_03.value: Yes! We started arguing, but he threw the first punch like a madman!

GrandmasRoom_06_04.value: Luckily, I had just got my fifth dan in black belt for judo and defended myself.

GrandmasRoom_06_05.value: But I’m telling you... He tried to kill me!

GrandmasRoom_06_07.value: That doesn’t sound like him at all.

GrandmasRoom_06_08.value: Mads, how well do you REALLY know him?

GrandmasRoom_06_09.value: Sometimes it’s the ones closest to us who are hiding the most.

GrandmasRoom_07_02.value: Aren't those your grandparents out on the beach?

GrandmasRoom_07_03.value: Yeah! They look so happy, don’t they?

GrandmasRoom_07_04.value: Hey! Remember when WE were supposed to go to the beach?

GrandmasRoom_07_05.value: How about we do it! You and me!

GrandmasRoom_07_07.value: That’s usually what “you and me” means, Mads.

GrandmasRoom_07_08.value: Arthur... I don’t think that’s a good idea... I mean...

GrandmasRoom_07_09.value: Not right now. I’m going through a lot of stuff, and I still don’t trust you, and-

GrandmasRoom_07_10.value: Mads... Mads, it’s okay! I get it. You’ve been working so hard here at the mansion.

GrandmasRoom_07_11.value: Trying to figure out the past, fighting off greedy people trying to steal your home...

GrandmasRoom_07_12.value: It feels like no one ever notices all the hard work you put into this place!

GrandmasRoom_07_17.value: Just promise to at least think about the beach?

GrandmasRoom_08_01.value: Hmm, what IS this sticking out from under the bed?

GrandmasRoom_08_02.value: It almost looks like the bed is propped up on something...

GrandmasRoom_08_03.value: It is! And it looks like it's a conveyor belt of sorts!

GrandmasRoom_08_04.value: Looks pretty homemade but why on earth would this be a thing?

GrandmasRoom_09_01.value: These bedposts are interesting to say the least.

GrandmasRoom_09_02.value: I like how they're both representative of Grandma's knitting skills and Charlie's clock-making expertise!

GrandmasRoom_09_03.value: The top is loose but it looks like that's intentional?

GrandmasRoom_09_04.value: It screws back on, just like a bottle cap!

GrandmasRoom_09_05.value: Knowing this mansion and the fact that this is Grandma's room...

GrandmasRoom_09_06.value: Everything weird probably has a purpose!

GrandmasRoom_09_07.value: Let's see if the other bed post is somehow connected to this one.

GrandmasRoom_10_01.value: Just as I suspected! The top of this bed post is loose too.

GrandmasRoom_10_02.value: And significantly tougher to put back in place!

GrandmasRoom_10_After_01.value: W-what! My head is spinning! This painting was a door the whole time?!

GrandmasRoom_10_After_02.value: And now that conveyor belt under the bad makes sense!

GrandmasRoom_10_After_03.value: The bedposts triggered the bed to move forward and opened this 'door'!

GrandmasRoom_10_After_04.value: Grandma really is always two steps ahead of me!

GrandmasRoom_11_02.value: This is how Grandma got behind me!

GrandmasRoom_11_03.value: I bet she was in here and didn’t notice I was in the room when she stepped out.

GrandmasRoom_11_04.value: But this room... This looks more like a security or panic room!

GrandmasRoom_11_05.value: Why would Grandma have something like this hidden behind her bed?

GrandmasRoom_11_06.value: And some of these security camera feeds are marked with town locations!

GrandmasRoom_11_07.value: Also, she seems to be investigating something!

GrandmasRoom_11_08.value: One thing’s for sure; she wasn’t planning on me finding this room!

GrandmasRoom_12_02.value: Looks like some sort of evidence board about a crime family!

GrandmasRoom_12_03.value: Most of these people aren’t familiar to me, but the family name is.

GrandmasRoom_12_04.value: Crutchley. I've heard that name before.

GrandmasRoom_12_05.value: I still can’t make much sense of this. It seems like there’s gaps and pieces missing.

GrandmasRoom_12_06.value: But Grandma was definitely still looking into them!

GrandmasRoom_13_01.value: Hmm... Most of these camera feeds are of the mansion grounds.

GrandmasRoom_13_03.value: Hey! That’s Roddy talking to... Sullivan?!

GrandmasRoom_13_04.value: I thought they weren’t really on speaking terms?

GrandmasRoom_13_10.value: Hey, Maddie! I’m sorry about walking out last time, but I needed a bit of fresh air.

GrandmasRoom_13_11.value: That’s alright. Want to come over for some coffee?

GrandmasRoom_13_12.value: No, no... I’m at home right now, really busy with work.

GrandmasRoom_14_03.value: Yeah, well. I did say I would think about the beach...

GrandmasRoom_14_04.value: There's nothing like reigniting an old flame, is there? I knew you wouldn't be able to resist!

GrandmasRoom_14_05.value: Don't push it, Arthur. And we're not reigniting anything.

GrandmasRoom_14_06.value: It's just a walk on the beach.

GrandmasRoom_14_07.value: Alright, alright. I'll take what I can get! A walk it is. See you soon, Mads!

GrandmasRoom_15_04.value: ... The boss isn’t too happy with what went down.

GrandmasRoom_15_05.value: You can say that again. Poor Larry.

GrandmasRoom_15_06.value: Larry was a jerk and deserved those heavy shoes.

GrandmasRoom_15_07.value: So you got the thing for the thing?

GrandmasRoom_15_10.value: Oh, that thing! Yeah, right here.

GrandmasRoom_15_11.value: I don’t get it, just a bunch of stupid animals.

GrandmasRoom_15_12.value: Actually, I think they’re horoscope symbols. See? A bull, two fish, a lion and a goat.
Actually, I think they’re horoscope symbols. See? A bull, two fish, a lion, and a goat.

GrandmasRoom_16_01.value: This safe looks sturdy! But it needs a five-number code!

GrandmasRoom_16_02.value: I bet something in here can give me a clue!

GrandmasRoom_16_03.value: Let’s see... The manufacturer symbol on the safe looks like the zodiac.

GrandmasRoom_16_04.value: Wait a minute... What were those two talking about on the recording?

GrandmasRoom_16_05.value: A bull, two fish, a lion and a goat. If we change those into the months they represent...
A bull, two fish, a lion, and a goat. If we change those into the months they represent...

GrandmasRoom_16_10.value: Who is he, and why is his photo in this safe?
Who is he, and why is his photograph locked away in this safe?

GrandmasRoom_17_01.value: Well, I wouldn’t put it past Grandma to have one more hidden passage up her sleeve.
Hmm, that inscription I read earlier - the hand that holds the time...

GrandmasRoom_17_02.value: Well, this here is a hand. I thought it was just eccentric decor, but perhaps I should place the watch here.

GrandmasRoom_17_03.value: Probably something important if it was hidden like this.

GrandmasRoom_17_04.value: Perhaps an enchanted world filled with talking animals!

GrandmasRoom_Intro_03.value: At long last I will finally learn all her secrets!

GrandmasRoom_Intro_07.value: I doubt Grandma would be so careless as to leave even a crumb of anything that could give me answers.

Greathall01_Frontdoor_01.value: I can't believe the key was under the mat this whole time!

Greathall01_Frontdoor_02.value: I'm pretty sure I checked under there and I didn't find anything...

Greathall01_Frontdoor_03.value: Still... No holding back now! I'm finally getting inside the mansion!

Greathall01_Frontdoor_04.value: You should really stop this silly little quest of yours, dear. There's nothing in there but broken dreams and sad memories...

Greathall01_Frontdoor_05.value: But Grandma, there may also be evidence that could prove your innocence!

Greathall01_Frontdoor_06.value: Dearie... If you keep digging up the past, all you get is dirty!

Greathall02_Inside_01.value: I can't believe it! I'm in the Boulton family Mansion!

Greathall02_Inside_02.value: I didn't even know there was a mansion, until I accidently saw Grandma's notice...

Greathall02_Inside_03.value: ...But now I'm inside and I can finally find something that can help Grandma!

Greathall02_Inside_04.value: Although... It does look like I have a lot of work to do in here, also.

Greathall02_Inside_05.value: So, you finally did it. You finally got inside this crumbling heap...

Greathall03_Continues_01.value: Well? Who are you, and what are you doing in my Mansion?

Greathall03_Continues_02.value: Oh please... This Mansion belongs to the Hopewell Bay town council! Or at least, it soon will, even in this sorry state...

Greathall03_Continues_03.value: Let me guess. You're Holden's boss? Something to do with infrastructure?

Greathall03_Continues_04.value: Wrong again missy... I was Head of the Infrastructure Committee.

Greathall03_Continues_05.value: I'm the head of the Town Council. Recently promoted. I think you should kneel or something?

Greathall03_Continues_06.value: So, you're the one who's been sending Holden around, photographing everything!?

Greathall03_Continues_07.value: That's right! But then I thought... Victoria, why don't you see it for yourself?

Greathall03_Continues_08.value: And missy... I ain't happy with what I'm seeing!

Greathall04_Continues_01.value: I'll be straight with you... You'll need to do more! A lot more, if you even want to consider keeping the mansion.

Greathall04_Continues_02.value: I only just got inside! I don't even have access to all the rooms yet!

Greathall04_Continues_03.value: No surprise there... The Boulton family were never very good at managing this place.

Greathall04_Continues_04.value: What do you mean by that?

Greathall04_Continues_05.value: Your grandparents ran this place into the ground! Look at it!

Greathall04_Continues_06.value: And I'm very confident you'll do the same. You are a Boulton after all.

Greathall04_Continues_07.value: And when you do... I'll be here. Claiming it for the council. Expect to see Holden a bit more from now on! Ciao!

Greathall05_Upset_01.value: Are you alright, Maddie? You look upset.

Greathall05_Upset_02.value: Grandma? I'm... fine. I wasn't expecting to see you in here, though.

Greathall05_Upset_03.value: I felt guilty for leaving you alone, so I brought some supplies to help you clean up. You must understand, this place holds a lot of memories for me...

Greathall05_Upset_04.value: I'd love to hear them some day...

Greathall05_Upset_05.value: They're not all good, Maddie! For instance, this great hall is the place you and I said goodbye to the house.

Greathall05_Upset_06.value: You were still only a little girl, but here... Here I decided to leave everything behind.

Greathall05_Upset_09.value: ...I do have another story I can tell you about the great hall!

Greathall06_Charlie_01.value: Your Grandpa Charlie never liked this room when we first got married.

Greathall06_Charlie_02.value: He didn't? But it's so grand and beautiful! Especially now that I've restored it.

Greathall06_Charlie_03.value: That's why he never liked it! He thought it was too fancy.

Greathall06_Charlie_04.value: I had a hard time trying to convince your Grandpa otherwise!

Greathall06_Charlie_06.value: I put up lots of decorations! Christmas, Halloween, Thanksgiving, you name it. Really tacky ones too.

Greathall06_Charlie_07.value: I'm glad he liked it in the end. Hopefully he'd like what I'm doing with it now!

Greathall07_Key_01.value: What's this? A key! I guess it's for one these doors.

Greathall08_Missing_Letter_02.value: Everything is covered in dust, except for this one spot!

Greathall08_Missing_Letter_03.value: Hmm, could it have been a letter?

Greathall09_Footprints_02.value: Has someone been here all this time?!

Greathall09_Footprints_03.value: Maybe I should keep an eye out, just in case...

Greathall10_Grandfather_Clock_01.value: This grandfather clock looks like it's in pretty bad shape...

Greathall10_Grandfather_Clock_03.value: Maddie... you're starting to lose it...

Greathall12_Intercom_01.value: Oh wow! An old B3 Intercom system from the 1920's!

Greathall12_Intercom_02.value: Grandma used to read me the manual as a kid, to get me to sleep.

Greathall12_Intercom_03.value: Little did she know, it sparked my love for engineering and invention!

Greathall13_Armor_02.value: Were the Boultons from an old family of knights?!

Greathall13_Armor_03.value: I always wanted to be a knight...

GreathallCorridor_Locked_01.value: It's locked! I wonder what's in there?

GreathallCorridor_Locked_02.value: Maybe there's something to help me keep Victoria off my back?!

GreathallOutro_Key_Found_01.value: Hmmm... I wonder if this key fits that door upstairs?

GreathallOutro_Key_Found_02.value: But in any case, this place is done!

GreathallOutro_Key_Found_03.value: And it looks rather amazing, if I do say so myself!

HalloweenEventOffer01_Description.value: Maybe this Halloween should be called Balloween instead?

HalloweenEventOffer02_Description.value: This should send a message to the city’s bulldozers. Everyone else is welcome though!

HalloweenEventOffer03_Description.value: Pumpkin soup? Nope. Pumpkin Pie? Nope. Pumpkin decorations? Yes!

HalloweenEventOffer04_Description.value: Let’s make Roddy think that pumpkins grow on trees!

HalloweenEventOffer05_Description.value: How many pumpkins does it take to change five lightbulbs?

Halloween_Event_Started_Message_Descript.value:
Sent by the city officials

Dear Maddie Boulton,
The city is organising a Halloween challenge and invites everyone to decorate their front yards with festive decorations! The scarier the better – let’s get creative!

Event is available for a limited time.

HallwayHallway01Intro_01.value: Okay, hallway, what secrets do you hold?!

HallwayHallway01Intro_02.value: It looks like you hold... a lot of other doors.

HallwayHallway01Intro_03.value: I hope these ones are all unlocked!

HallwayHallway01Intro_04.value: Probably best to look around first...

HallwayHallway02_01.value: Hey Maddie! I hope you don't mind, but I let myself in. I couldn't resist!

HallwayHallway02_02.value: I can't believe you're finally in the mansion!

HallwayHallway02_03.value: Me neither! And it looks like I have plenty to do in here.

HallwayHallway02_05.value: It's strange, though. It all seems so familiar somehow...

HallwayHallway02_06.value: I think I dream about this hallway sometimes!

HallwayHallway02_08.value: I... I suppose it could be! I was 4 when Grandma and I moved out of here, so I guess it's possible I remember some of it.

HallwayHallway03_01.value: Say, Jackie... Do you know anything about, uh, my family's financial problems?

HallwayHallway03_02.value: Actually... I do. I think everyone at the newspaper has heard about them!

HallwayHallway03_03.value: Oh no, really?! I had hoped Victoria was lying.

HallwayHallway03_04.value: Victoria? As in new Head of the City Council Victoria?!

HallwayHallway03_05.value: That's the one. She said my grandparents nearly ran this place into the ground.

HallwayHallway03_06.value: ...I'm sorry to say it, but I don't think she was lying.

HallwayHallway03_07.value: People say that your uncle Leonard squandered all the family money and-

HallwayHallway03_08.value: I beg your pardon, but that is entirely inaccurate!

HallwayHallway04_01.value: I'm sorry, whoever you are, but everyone knows that it was Leonard who-

HallwayHallway04_02.value: No! My Leo- Master Leonard is the only reason this place is still standing!

HallwayHallway04_03.value: Doesn't look like it to me!

HallwayHallway04_05.value: Mr. Winston, I don't understand, if Leonard is the reason this place is still around, why is it in so bad shape?!

HallwayHallway04_06.value: Perhaps you should ask your grandmother that question, Ma'am...

HallwayHallway05_02.value: That was- is the house butler, Mr. Winston.

HallwayHallway05_03.value: He seemed really defensive about Leonard Boulton...

HallwayHallway05_04.value: I know, but why did he say I should ask Grandma?

HallwayHallway06_01.value: Well dearie, this place is starting to look like its old self again!

HallwayHallway06_02.value: Yeah! The more I do, the more I remember how it used to look. But, Grandma...

HallwayHallway06_04.value: Mr. Winston said Leonard is the real reason this place is still around and that I should ask you why it's in such bad shape.

HallwayHallway06_05.value: I see... Isn't it quite funny that the butler would say such a thing?!

HallwayHallway06_06.value: Well... I guess so, but why woul-

HallwayHallway06_07.value: Anyway, I got to get going to my free diving class! Can you do me a favor?

HallwayHallway07_01.value: Er... Okay, what favor do you need?

HallwayHallway07_02.value: The study down the hallway is an awful mess, so just leave it. I don't want you to bother cleaning all that up!

HallwayHallway07_03.value: But... That's all I've been doing since I got here!

HallwayHallway07_04.value: Then maybe it's time to have a break? Bye!

HallwayIgnatiusBust_01.value: The man himself. In the uh... Stone.

HallwayIgnatiusBust_02.value: I wonder how many statues of him there are in this place?

HallwayIgnatiusBust_03.value: He did create the family fortune, after all!

HallwayIgnatiusBust_04.value: Couldn't keep it though, could he?

HallwayKatana_01.value: This katana must belong to the samurai over there...

HallwayKatana_02.value: Actually, this one belongs to someone... else.

HallwayLionStatue_01.value: This lion's mouth opened when I pressed that button.

HallwayModelShip_01.value: This is a nice model! I guess boats have been in your family since the beggining.
This is a nice model! I guess boats have been in your family since the beginning.

HallwayModelShip_04.value: Ha! At ease... I learned a few terms while fixing the yacht outside.

HallwayOutro_01.value: Looks like the key we found, fits this lock! It must be the study...

HallwayOutro_02.value: What do you think is in there?

HallwayOutro_03.value: Hopefully something that can help Grandma!

HallwayPaintingStation_02.value: It looks like someone was trying to paint Leonard.

HallwayPressingSecretButton_01.value: Oops! I think I just pressed the red button!

HallwayPressingSecretButton_02.value: Do you know what it does?!

HallwayPressingSecretButton_04.value: Did you see that? That lion statue's mouth just opened!

HallwaySamuraiArmor_01.value: Wow! This thing looks really old!

HallwaySamuraiArmor_02.value: I bet it has a huge mystery behind it.

HallwaySamuraiArmor_03.value: Knowing my family, I wouldn't be surprised.

Hideout02_02.value: It’s almost like a secret office, but some of the things in here don’t make any sense...

Hideout02_03.value: Then again, a lot of things about this family don’t make sense!

Hideout02_04.value: I should ask Grandma about that...

Hideout02_05.value: But she’ll most likely run off to a tree combing class or something.

Hideout03_01.value: Interesting, those footprints look just like the ones we found in the study...

Hideout03_02.value: Has someone been living here all this time?

Hideout03_03.value: I never thought of that! But why hide down here?

Hideout03_04.value: What kind of underhanded business was this person involved in?

Hideout04_01.value: This room doesn't seem as dusty as the others.

Hideout04_02.value: Still a mess, but this is just another sign that it was in use recently.

Hideout04_03.value: Ooh! This dresser is filled to the brim with cool trinkets...

Hideout04_04.value: I even found a vintage pin with the Boulton family crest!

Hideout05_01.value: Just a stack of crumpled-up paper, but let’s take a closer look...

Hideout05_02.value: Huh, not just rubbish it would seem.

Hideout05_03.value: It looks like there were plenty of corner stores that were hand-in-hand with Grandma’s bootlegging plans.

Hideout05_04.value: Just when I thought this bootlegging thing couldn’t get any worse!

Hideout06_01.value: Swords and now throwing stars? These certainly don’t look like props.

Hideout06_02.value: I bet the owner of this room had some military training.

Hideout06_03.value: Maybe I’m missing something amongst all the junk on the desk.

Hideout06_04.value: Aha! A map of Hopewell Bay! With an area marked out. And there’s some writing here...

Hideout06_05.value: Victory Park and... lemonade? No, Leonard! Wait, how’s Leonard involved in all of this?!

Hideout07_01.value: I can’t believe it! Grandpa Charlie could be an actual spy, and this is where he’s been hiding all along?

Hideout07_03.value: I have to tell Grandma! Unless, she already knows. Hold on! There's something shiny in the dresser.

Hideout08_01.value: What’s that? Is that piano music? Sounds like it’s coming from upstairs...

Hideout08_02.value: Grandma mentioned that there's a piano in the dining room. Guess I'll have to investigate that later. One mystery at a time, Maddie!

HideoutIntro_01.value: It’s a hidden room! One of many, I suppose.

HideoutIntro_02.value: Hmm... maybe I should wait for Jackie? It does look pretty dark down there.

HideoutIntro_03.value: Get it together, Maddie. You got this!

Holdencharactertask1_01.value: Maddie, I have some concerns about your house...

Holdencharactertask1_03.value: Well... I've almost slipped, sat on some nails and got my shoes stuck in some spilled glue!

Holdencharactertask1_04.value: Oh... Maybe you should just leave, then?

Holdencharactertask2_02.value: I guess I was expecting to find something juicy. It all seems to be hidden away...

Holdencharactertask2_03.value: Or I've been too distracted to notice.

Holdencharactertaskintro_01.value: Holden! What are you doing here?!

Holdencharactertaskintro_02.value: Let me guess... Doing Victoria's dirty work again?

Holdencharactertaskintro_03.value: Well, if you must know, I'm on an assignment.

Holdencharactertaskintro_04.value: Is this assignment to annoy me in my own house?

Holdencharactertaskintro_05.value: Good one, but I'm here on official business to gather as much photographic evidence as possible.

Holdencharactertaskintro_07.value: I'm not at liberty to say. But don't mind me, continue as you were...

Holdencharactertaskintro_08.value: Yeah right, I'm not letting him get what he wants. I'm going to make things as difficult as possible for him!

Holdencharactertaskoutro_01.value: Alright, I'm done here... Might go out and take some shots of the exterior of the house again...

Holdencharactertaskoutro_03.value: I guess I was hoping for something more interesting than plants and aquariums in here.

Holdencharactertaskoutro_05.value: Hmph. Looks like I'll be returning soon...

Hopeberry2022Chiffon_01.value: Roddy, you must try a slice of this pie!

Hopeberry2022Chiffon_02.value: Mmmm… what is this delicious filling?
Mmmm... what is this delicious filling?

Hopeberry2022Chiffon_03.value: It’s Hopeberry. It’s it simply delicious?

Hopeberry2022Chiffon_04.value: I must admit Maddie, this might be the best thing at this festival.
