Hopeberry2022Chiffon_06.value: I must go find grandma and ask more about these berries. Later Roddy!

Hopeberry2022Chiffon_07.value: Best things tend to slip away quickly, I suppose.

Hopeberry2022Decoration01_01.value: Grandma, is that one of your pies cooling on the edge of the stage?

Hopeberry2022Decoration01_02.value: It’s the Hopeberry pie I just baked from an old family recipe.

Hopeberry2022Decoration01_03.value: Tell me more about this mysterious berr--

Hopeberry2022Decoration01_04.value: You must try a slice of this pie, fresh out of the oven!

Hopeberry2022Decoration01_05.value: Grandma, this is delicious! But what in the world is this berr--

Hopeberry2022Decoration01_06.value: I must offer a slice to Julius while it’s hot. There he is, Julius! Julius!

Hopeberry2022Decoration01_07.value: And there she goes again! Never thought a berry could be such an enigma…
And there she goes again! Never thought a berry could be such an enigma...

Hopeberry2022Decoration02_01.value: I see you’ve come to try your luck with the wheel of fortune?

Hopeberry2022Decoration02_02.value: Well, what I really need is not up there I’m afraid.

Hopeberry2022Decoration02_03.value: A year long supply of Hopeberry preserve doesn’t tickle your fancy?

Hopeberry2022Decoration02_04.value: I have my eyes on something a little sweeter.

Hopeberry2022Decoration02_05.value: Ooh the crate of Hopeberry syrup? Great choice!

Hopeberry2022Decoration02_07.value: Yeah! It’s my turn to spin. Maybe I’ll beat you to that syrup!

Hopeberry2022Decoration02_08.value: Maybe my luck will turn around next time.

Hopeberry2022Decoration03_01.value: How do you like the Hopeberry bunting, Julius?

Hopeberry2022Decoration03_02.value: Ahh… these take me right back to the festivities in the days of yore.
Ahh... these take me right back to the festivities in the days of yore.

Hopeberry2022Decoration03_03.value: We had many years of berry galore until that dubious man came along.

Hopeberry2022Decoration03_05.value: Never mind who. Let’s go try some of that delicious looking jam!

Hopeberry2022Decoration03_06.value: Quite the diversion. Why am I not surprised?

Hopeberry2022Decoration04_01.value: Back at the juice bar again, Julius?

Hopeberry2022Decoration04_02.value: Oh, the Hopeberry cordial I fetched earlier was for Ursula.

Hopeberry2022Decoration04_03.value: A peace offering of sorts if you will.

Hopeberry2022Decoration04_04.value: Did you get into a spat with Grandma Ursula?

Hopeberry2022Decoration04_05.value: Oh you know, with Walter being my uncle and all—

Hopeberry2022Decoration04_06.value: Walter? The man who allegedly destroyed all the Hopeberries?

Hopeberry2022Decoration04_07.value: It’s all in the past now. Nothing a sweet cordial can’t sort out.

Hopeberry2022Decoration04_08.value: The past seems to be sprouting again from the sounds of it.

Hopeberry2022Decoration05_01.value: There! This stand’s looking good already.

Hopeberry2022Decoration05_02.value: It looks like you are diving right into the Hopeberry festivities.

Hopeberry2022Decoration05_03.value: Yep. For some reason, the committee seemed keen for the Boultons to lead by example.

Hopeberry2022Decoration05_04.value: For some reason? Didn’t you know your family was a really important part of the old festival.

Hopeberry2022Decoration05_05.value: Just like you’re really important now. For us all, you know–

Hopeberry2022Decoration05_06.value: An important part of the festival?! Grandma never told me that either!!

Hopeberry2022Decoration05_07.value: I’m going to find her and get the full story!

Hopeberry2022Decoration06_01.value: A penny for your thoughts Maddie? Or should I say a balloon?

Hopeberry2022Decoration06_02.value: I just can’t stop wondering what made all the Hopeberries disappear.

Hopeberry2022Decoration06_03.value: You must know something, Roddy. C’mon let me in on the story.

Hopeberry2022Decoration06_04.value: There was this one story my grandpa mentioned a long time ago.

Hopeberry2022Decoration06_06.value: Something about the berries being poisoned almost 50 years ago.

Hopeberry2022Decoration06_07.value: Poisoned?! By whom – someone called Walter?? And why?

Hopeberry2022Decoration06_08.value: No one really knows, except that the berries suddenly reappeared this year.

Hopeberry2022Decoration07_01.value: Doesn’t this gravel road look lush? Not a single weed in sight.

Hopeberry2022Decoration07_02.value: Once again you’ve done a wonderful job at sprucing things up Maddie.

Hopeberry2022Decoration07_03.value: And this time you’ve really outdone yourself.

Hopeberry2022Decoration07_05.value: Because you’ve had a hand in reviving the Hopeberries of Hopewell Bay.

Hopeberry2022Decoration07_06.value: But, I’ve never seen a single Hopeberry anywhere until the festival.

Hopeberry2022Decoration07_07.value: You cleared up a small patch of berry seedlings that survived all those years—

Hopeberry2022Decoration07_08.value: —bringing the Hopeberry back without even realizing. Wow!

Hopeberry2022Decoration08_01.value: Berry the Scarecrow looks so real, he’s starting to frighten the birds away!

Hopeberry2022Decoration08_02.value: He was no match for Earnest Walter though.

Hopeberry2022Decoration08_03.value: As in the man who supposedly destroyed Hopewell Bay’s Hopeberry crop?

Hopeberry2022Decoration08_04.value: Indeed. Apparently, he was the Mayor of our rival town at the time.

Hopeberry2022Decoration08_05.value: How do you know so much about him?

Hopeberry2022Decoration08_06.value: Oh you know, all part and parcel of my family tree—

Hopeberry2022Decoration08_07.value: Your family?! Does grandma Ursula know?

Hopeberry2022Decoration08_08.value: Will you look at those Hopeberry pies Maddie! I must go devouver one right away.

Hopeberry2022Decoration09_01.value: Milk churns as flower vases! What a nifty idea.

Hopeberry2022Decoration09_02.value: Julius, I’ve been looking for you.

Hopeberry2022Decoration09_04.value: Do you know how the Hopeberry Festival first came about?

Hopeberry2022Decoration09_06.value: This whole topic seems to upset her a bit, so I thought I’d come to you instead.

Hopeberry2022Decoration09_07.value: I’m just about to make a special treat with some home grown berries. I’ll be right back.

Hopeberry2022Decoration09_08.value: Guess, I won’t be holding my breath.

Hopeberry2022Decoration10_01.value: The Hopeberry Mascot looks right at home with all the bright, juicy berries.

Hopeberry2022Decoration10_02.value: It was always a favourite part of the festival even back in the day.

Hopeberry2022Decoration10_03.value: How did the festival get started grandma?

Hopeberry2022Decoration10_04.value: It was all grandma Minnie’s doing of course.

Hopeberry2022Decoration10_05.value: With grandpa Ignatius busy building his empire and all, she has all this time.

Hopeberry2022Decoration10_06.value: So, what did she think happened to all the Hopeberries?s

Hopeberry2022Decoration10_08.value: What’s obvious is how evasive everyone is.

Hopeberry2022HopeberryBucket_02.value: These, dear Maddie, are Hopeberries! Here, try one.

Hopeberry2022HopeberryBucket_03.value: They are so juicy…and sweet…and delicious…and–
They are so juicy... and sweet... and delicious... and–

Hopeberry2022HopeberryBucket_04.value: I know, I know. These berries are so rare, we haven’t seen them in 50 years.

Hopeberry2022HopeberryBucket_05.value: I wonder how they made their way to Hopewell Bay in the first place.

Hopeberry2022IceCreamSundae_02.value: It’s a very special treat I made with the berries from my garden.

Hopeberry2022IceCreamSundae_03.value: So where are you heading with it?

Hopeberry2022IceCreamSundae_07.value: Feels like something very suspicious has been churning here.

...the place where all those Hopeberry Festival gear was being stored all these years!!

Hopeberry2022IntroPart2_02.value: And everything has remained spick and span!

Hopeberry2022IntroPart2_03.value: How come you’re so excited but have never mentioned a thing about this festival?

LBE_Halloween2023Intro_01.value: Welcome everyone to the Great Pumpkin Palooza! Hopewell Bay’s spooky jack o’lantern event!

LBE_Halloween2023Intro_03.value: Pumpkin carving? Ha, haven’t done that in ages! Hopewell Bay sure does like keeping to traditions.

LBE_Halloween2023Intro_04.value: Definitely! And it’s a fun way to have a bit of friendly sport. Want to join in?

LBE_Halloween2023Intro_05.value: I- I don’t know... Last time I carved a pumpkin was with my mother... When I was seven.

LBE_Halloween2023Intro_06.value: PERFECT! Here, grab a knife and start carving!

LBE_Halloween2023Outro_02.value: I thought you said the last time you carved a pumpkin was when you were seven?!

LBE_Halloween2023Outro_03.value: It’s true, but I do ice sculpting as a pastime.

LBE_Halloween2023Outro_05.value: Don’t worry about it, buddy! I’m sure you’ll win next time.

Welcome, everyone, to Hopewell Bay's great bake-off! Let's meet our contestants!

LBE_May2023Intro_02.value: First off, we have Jackie, our resident reporter for the Boulton Bugle.

LBE_May2023Intro_03.value: Thank you, Pearl, for planning this event again! May the best baker win!

LBE_May2023Intro_04.value: Next, we have Maddie, who's been busy renovating the mansion!

LBE_Valentines2024_Flowerbed_06_Dialogue.value: Growing the right flowers is actually quite tricky. My corpse flower takes four to five years to bloom!
It's probably not ideal for floral arrangements, either...
What am I talking about? It is wonderful!

LBE_Valentines2024_Flowerbucket_06_Dialo.value: Look at all of these magnificent flowers! It is so difficult to choose, don't you think?
A flower's a flower, right? So a little bit of this and a little bit of that...
It is more than that, my dear Jackie! Take a moment to appreciate the flowers; find the beauty in each one of them.
Hmm... I guess there's a lot more to this than I first thought. Let's try!

LBE_Valentines2024_Info_Popup_Section1_T.value: Create the most impressive flower arrangements to win awesome prizes!

LBE_Valentines2024_Intro_Dialogue_01.value: Welcome to Floral Frenzy, a competition where we find out who makes the most magnificent flower arrangements in Hopewell Bay!

LBE_Valentines2024_Intro_Dialogue_02.value: Our contenders are Deb, a lover of the more exotic flowers...

LBE_Valentines2024_Intro_Dialogue_03.value: I do have a penchant for the unusual.

LBE_Valentines2024_Intro_Dialogue_04.value: Err, yes. And Julius who specializes in the gentle Japanese art of Ikebana. I can't wait to see what kind of creations you will produce!

LBE_Valentines2024_Intro_Dialogue_05.value: Salutations! Did you know that the history of Ikebana reaches back over 600 years?

LBE_Valentines2024_Intro_Dialogue_06.value: Very interesting, indeed! And our last contender is... Jackie!

LBE_Valentines2024_Intro_Dialogue_07.value: Pearl, I told you I'm too busy to take part in a silly competition. I've never even tried flower arranging before!

LBE_Valentines2024_Intro_Dialogue_09.value: Let's get to it, people. The competition is officially on - may the best amateur florist win!

LBE_Valentines2024_Outro_Dialogue_01.value: What a competition we've had! I had no idea we have such flower arranging talent in our little town.

LBE_Valentines2024_Outro_Dialogue_03.value: W-what?? I really didn't expect this...

LBE_Valentines2024_Outro_Dialogue_04.value: I'd like to thank my fellow contenders for educating and inspiring me. I never knew I had it in me to get excited about flower arranging!

LBE_Valentines2024_Outro_Dialogue_05.value: Next time, we can see if it was just beginner's luck... but congratulations, Jackie. You did well!

LBE_Xmas2023_GingerBreadHouse_08_Dialogu.value: That is a very impressive gingerbread house, Cherry! But it has no chimney...

LBE_Xmas2023_GingerBreadHouse_09_Dialogu.value: Wow, you've truly outdone yourself, Ursula! This could be difficult to beat.

LBE_Xmas2023_GingerBreadHouse_10_Dialogu.value: Phew, what a masterpiece - and we did it together!
Indeed! Just like the recipe said.

LBE_Xmas2023_GingerbreadDough_01_Dialogu.value: This recipe looks REALLY old! Do you know who could've written it?
No idea... But they clearly knew what they are doing!

LBE_Xmas2023_GingerbreadDough_05_Dialogu.value: The dough is ready for baking!
And it looks delicious! What does the book say?
"Share the dough between bakers and proceed in harmony."
Well, if that's what it says...

LBE_Xmas2023_GingerbreadPlates_01_Dialog.value: Look at all this glorious gingerbread! I can't believe we made it all... together!
Christmas does funny things to people.

LBE_Xmas2023_Info_Popup_Section1_Title.value: Bake the best gingerbread creations & win awesome prizes!

LBE_Xmas2023_IntroDialogue_Dialogue_01.value: It's the season of good cheer… and gingerbread! But who makes it the most scrumptious? Let's find out!
It's the season of good cheer... and gingerbread! But who makes it the most scrumptious? Let's find out!

LBE_Xmas2023_IntroDialogue_Dialogue_02.value: Although everyone knows my gingerbread is the tastiest...

LBE_Xmas2023_IntroDialogue_Dialogue_03.value: Maybe we'll let the people decide, Cherry? Besides, mine has been a firm favorite for decades.

LBE_Xmas2023_IntroDialogue_Dialogue_04.value: Look! I found something interesting in the Boulton attic! It looks like a really old recipe book.

LBE_Xmas2023_IntroDialogue_Dialogue_05.value: What does it say here? "The Best Gingerbread Recipe Ever Written?"

LBE_Xmas2023_IntroDialogue_Dialogue_06.value: Someone has scribbled stuff around it... "Add a pinch of magic and stir through"?

LBE_Xmas2023_IntroDialogue_Dialogue_07.value: What do you say if we skip the competition this year and bake together with this recipe instead?

LBE_Xmas2023_IntroDialogue_Dialogue_08.value: I suppose it is the season for peace and goodwill to all bakers... Why not?

LBE_Xmas2023_MediumOvenInactive_01_Dialo.value: Of course, I did! Try turning the knobs again...

LBE_Xmas2023_MediumOvenProducing_01_Dial.value: I see a light - in the oven, I mean!
It's working! I hope this gingerbread does not burn...

LBE_Xmas2023_NormalGingerBreadTable_01_D.value: When it comes to decorating gingerbread, less is definitely NOT more!

LBE_Xmas2023_OutroDialogue_Dialogue_01.value: The book might just be right. This gingerbread is GREAT!

LBE_Xmas2023_OutroDialogue_Dialogue_02.value: Hmm, you are right. It is making me feel... all warm and fuzzy inside.

LBE_Xmas2023_OutroDialogue_Dialogue_03.value: Maybe there really is a pinch of magic in there...

LBE_Xmas2023_OutroDialogue_Dialogue_05.value: But next year, I will show you the best gingerbread recipe...

LBE_Xmas2023_OutroDialogue_Dialogue_06.value: Just have another gingerbread and enjoy the moment, will you!

LBE_Xmas2023_SmalIOvenInactive_01_Dialog.value: This thing does not seem to be working.
Did you try turning it on and off again?

LBE_Xmas2023_SmalIOvenProducing_01_Dialo.value: Let's see if we can bake a batch...

LBE_Xmas2023_Start_Popup_Content_Desc.value: Roll up your sleeves and get ready to bake with Gingerbread Jamboree - but who will come out on top? Good Luck!

LBE_Xmas2024_Info_Popup_Section1_Title.value: Bake the gingerbread creations & win the best prizes!

LBE_Xmas2024_Start_Popup_Content_Desc.value:
[PLACEHOLDER] The event is starting now! The heat is on.
Get ready!
Roll up your sleeves and get ready to bake with Gingerbread Jamboree - but who will come out on top? Good Luck!

LC_Autumn_EndPopup_Description.value: [PLACEHOLDER] Thank you for playing the Autumn Lucky Catch event!
Thank you for playing the Autumn Lucky Catch event!

LC_Autumn_Intro_Dialogue_01.value: What a beautiful day! You know what would make it even better?

LC_Autumn_Intro_Dialogue_03.value: Only if you promise to wrap up extra warm. It is sunny out, but this autumn weather can get cold!

LC_Autumn_Intro_Dialogue_05.value: And if I can handle the camera this time. Your photos were a little unsteady last time.

LC_Autumn_Intro_Dialogue_06.value: You got it. Now can we go?

LC_CommonPermit_Dialogue_01.value: Nice catch, Grandma? Is it a dorado?

LC_CommonPermit_Dialogue_02.value: No, the color is wrong and fins look different... I think this is a permit.

LC_CommonPermit_Dialogue_03.value: Permit? How on earth did you know that?

LC_CommonPermit_Dialogue_04.value: Always be prepared, dearie, and do your research!

LC_Easter2025_InfoPanel_Description.value:
The Easter Lucky Catch event is on!
Complete Event Merge Tasks and earn Event Points.

LC_EpicPacificSailfish_Dialogue_03.value: Err, let's see... Ah, a Pacific Sailfish to be exact!

LC_EpicPacificSailfish_Dialogue_05.value: Know that? I recognize it by its lovely blue back!

LC_EpicPacificSailfish_Dialogue_06.value: I have also been doing some light reading. We go fishing often enough that I want to be well informed.

LC_EpicSouthernBluefinTuna_Dialogue_01.value: This fish is putting up a fight! Feels like we've been reeling it for a month!

LC_EpicSouthernBluefinTuna_Dialogue_02.value: It is coming closer, and I think I just saw a flash of silver!

LC_Generic_End_Popup_Content_NoRewards_D.value: All good! A lot of luck this time for a good fish. Stay tuned for more! [PLACEHOLDER NEEDS GENERIC TEXT]

LC_Generic_InfoPanel_Description.value:
The Lucky Catch event is on!
Complete Event Merge Tasks and earn Event Points.

LC_Generic_IntroPopup_Description.value: Get ready to reel in that fish and land your Lucky Catch! Join Maddie and Grandma as they go out for a fun and exciting fishing trip, catching and releasing.

LC_Halloween2025_Intro_Dialogue_01.value: Rise and shine, dearie! Are you ready?

LC_Halloween2025_Intro_Dialogue_05.value: Nonsense! It’s a perfect day for a little fishing trip.

LC_Halloween2025_Intro_Dialogue_06.value: I think I’m coming down with something. Maybe I should just stay home.

LC_Halloween2025_Intro_Dialogue_07.value: I have been looking forward to this so much. You wouldn’t let your old Grandma down, would you?

LC_Halloween2025_Intro_Dialogue_08.value: You never look forward to our fishing trips…
You never look forward to our fishing trips...

LC_Halloween2025_Intro_Dialogue_09.value: What is going on? I’m getting a weird sense of déjà vu…
What is going on? I’m getting a weird sense of déjà vu...

LC_Halloween2025_Outro_Dialogue_03.value: I'm sorry to wake you from your nap, but you said you wanted to go fishing today.

LC_Halloween2025_Outro_Dialogue_05.value: There is no Count Squidula? Or Werefish?

LC_Halloween2025_Outro_Dialogue_06.value: Not around here, dearie! That must have been quite a dream.

LC_Halloween_ColossalGrandmaGrandma_Dial.value: WHAT is that in the water?
I think you just spotted the most elusive fish in the sea...

LC_Halloween_CommonCrimson-LippedBatfish.value: I-is it? What is that anyway? A fish or a… bat?
I-is it? What is that anyway? A fish or a... bat?
A Crimson-lipped Batfish! Look at those ears!

LC_Halloween_CommonMummyFish_Dialogue_01.value: Well done, dearie! You caught a big one!

LC_Halloween_CommonMummyFish_Dialogue_02.value: Err... What kind of fish is that??

LC_Halloween_CommonMummyFish_Dialogue_03.value: It is a mummyfish! Very rare and interesting.

LC_Halloween_EndPopup_Description.value: Thank you for playing the Lucky Catch event - and stay tuned for more!

LC_Halloween_EpicCountSquidula_Dialogue_.value: The conditions are perfect for catching a Count Squidula.
Wh… You know, I’m not even going to ask.
Wh... You know, I’m not even going to ask.
Are you talking about a squid that looks like a vampire?

LC_Halloween_EpicTerrafish_Dialogue_03.value: There's a fish in the boat!

LC_Halloween_EpicTerrafish_Dialogue_04.value: The terrafish is able to crawl as well as swim. It is a real super fish!

LC_Halloween_ExtendPopup_Description.value:
The Lucky Catch event has sadly come to an end.
Event Merge Board and Merge Tasks will be closed now.

LC_Halloween_InfoPanel_Description.value:
The Lucky Catch event is on!
Complete Event Merge Tasks and earn Event Points.

LC_Halloween_Intro_Dialogue_01.value: You guessed it -- it's time to...

LC_Halloween_Intro_Dialogue_04.value: Yeah, just a bit light-headed... Like something seems a bit off somehow...

LC_Halloween_Intro_Dialogue_05.value: We should really get going. There is plenty of fish to catch and release!

LC_Halloween_Intro_Dialogue_06.value: Y-yes, just snap a photo and let them go!

LC_Halloween_LegendaryDragonKoi_Dialogue.value: I think I've got one, Grandma...
Is it a koi carp or a dragon??
Isn't it obvious? It's a dragon koi!
But don't worry - it does not breathe fire.

LC_Halloween_LegendaryTheBlobFish_Dialog.value: Is it time to go home yet? I’m getting a really spooky feeling out here…
Is it time to go home yet? I’m getting a really spooky feeling out here...
AAAH! What’s that weird blob floating in the water? A j-jellyfish?
A Blob Fish, dearie! We’re lucky to catch one. Usually they’re only seen…
A Blob Fish, dearie! We’re lucky to catch one. Usually they’re only seen...

LC_Halloween_Outro_Dialogue_02.value: You guessed it - it's time to go f---

LC_Halloween_Outro_Dialogue_04.value: I'm not feeling up for fishing today...

LC_Halloween_Outro_Dialogue_05.value: I just had the weirdest dream full of the weirdest fish.

LC_Halloween_Outro_Dialogue_07.value: Sounds like Halloween is playing tricks on you, dearie!

LC_Halloween_RareCutethulhu_Dialogue_01.value: I've never caught an octopus in these waters.

LC_Halloween_RareCutethulhu_Dialogue_02.value: How do you catch one with a fishing rod, anyway??

LC_Halloween_RareCutethulhu_Dialogue_03.value: But it is adorable, isn't it?

LC_Halloween_StartPopup_Description.value: Join Maddie and Grandma, and help them catch the weirdest catch of a lifetime!

LC_Halloween_UltimateReverseMermaid_Dial.value: Do you believe in mermaids, dear?

LC_Halloween_UncommonHobgoblinShark_Dial.value: I caught something! I think it looks like some kind of shark.
Don’t give up! Keep reeling it in.
I got it! But what is it??
No wonder it put up a fight! It’s a Hobgoblin Shark.
The meanest fish in these waters!

LC_Halloween_UncommonJackOAngler_Dialogu.value: This one is putting up a REAL fight!
Naturally! It is called the jack-o'-angler, after all.

LC_Halloween_VeryRareSexyCatfish_Dialogu.value: I'm... speechless. Is that a... catfish?
Yes, and a very attractive one, too!
This is getting weirder by the moment...

LC_Halloween_VeryRareWerefish_Dialogue_0.value: Well, well! There must be a Werefish nearby!
What?? There is no such thing as a Werefish! And fish can’t howl!
This must be a weird dream or something…
This must be a weird dream or something...
If this were a dream, could I pinch you?
Come on, and catch the Werefish in the net so we can take a photo!

LC_LegendaryGiantSeaBass_Dialogue_01.value: I've got one and it... it's big!

LC_LegendaryGiantSeaBass_Dialogue_04.value: Almost there! Just a little... bit... more...

LC_LegendaryGiantSeaBass_Dialogue_06.value: And a big one, too. It could be almost a hundred years old.

LC_LegendaryPacificHalibut_Dialogue_01.value: Yikes, what a looker! That has to be a Halibut!

LC_LegendaryPacificHalibut_Dialogue_02.value: I just can't get over those weird eyes.

LC_LegendaryPacificHalibut_Dialogue_03.value: Now, Halibut is a tasty fish! Especially delicious with some potatoes and...

LC_LegendaryPacificHalibut_Dialogue_05.value: One day you will let me take one home.

LC_RareBlackDrum_Dialogue_01.value: What a monster! I-is that a black drum?

LC_RareBlackDrum_Dialogue_03.value: I thought it was much smaller - like a salmon.

LC_RareCuberaSnapper_Dialogue_01.value: Dearie, I think I got a big one!

LC_RareCuberaSnapper_Dialogue_02.value: Do you want me to reel it in for you, Grandma?

LC_RareCuberaSnapper_Dialogue_03.value: I am old, not infirm! Just be ready with the net.

LC_RareCuberaSnapper_Dialogue_05.value: It looks like a huge snapper! Look at those teeth!

LC_RareCuberaSnapper_Dialogue_06.value: Not bad, if I do say so myself.

LC_Spring_CommonDogSnapper_Dialogue_01.value: Oh, my! This is a feisty one… a Dog Snapper, if I'm not mistaken!

LC_Spring_CommonDogSnapper_Dialogue_02.value: You're right. Look at those teeth!

LC_Spring_CommonDogSnapper_Dialogue_03.value: It has a bit of an overbite, hasn't it?

LC_Spring_CommonDogSnapper_Dialogue_05.value: What? I think it is charming.

LC_Spring_EndPopup_Description.value: Thank you for playing the Spring Lucky Catch event!

LC_Spring_End_Popup_Content_NoRewards_De.value: What was it? A fish? Stay tuned to find out...

LC_Spring_EpicPorbeagle_Dialogue_01.value: I think we've got a shark on the line.

LC_Spring_EpicPorbeagle_Dialogue_03.value: Oh, wow, Grandma! That's a Porbeagle.

LC_Spring_EpicPorbeagle_Dialogue_05.value: It's a kind of mackerel shark. You can tell by the white patch on the back of its dorsal fin.

LC_Spring_ExtendPopup_Description.value:
The Spring Lucky Catch event has sadly come to an end.
Event Merge Board and Merge Tasks will be closed now.

LC_Spring_InfoPanel_Description.value:
Spring Lucky Catch event is on!
Complete Event Merge Tasks and earn Event Points.

The Spring Lucky Catch event is on!
Complete Event Merge Tasks and earn Event Points.

LC_Spring_IntroPopup_Description.value: Get ready to reel in that fish and land your Lucky Catch! Join Maddie and Grandma as they go out for a fun and exciting spring fishing trip, catching and releasing.

LC_Spring_IntroPopup_Header.value: Reel in your Spring Lucky Catch!

LC_Spring_Intro_Dialogue_01.value: Don't tell me we're going fishing - AGAIN!

LC_Spring_Intro_Dialogue_02.value: This time will be totally different. It's spring!

LC_Spring_Intro_Dialogue_03.value: I am not buying it... Can I at least actually keep the fish I catch this time?

LC_Spring_Intro_Dialogue_05.value: I was not trying to be funny...

LC_Spring_Intro_Dialogue_06.value: Fishing is a big part of Hopewell Bay's history, Grandma - you know that!

LC_Spring_Intro_Dialogue_07.value: We're just keeping the tradition alive.

LC_Spring_Intro_Dialogue_08.value: Oh, alright! Let the fishing commence!

LC_Spring_LegendaryAtlanticSturgeon_Dial.value: Aha! I know this one. It is an Atlantic Sturgeon.
So it is! Did you know they can live up to sixty years? They're living fossils.
That is fascinating! And did you know that Sturgeon caviar is delicious?
The Boultons used to can it, you know. Called it Black Gold.

LC_Spring_LegendaryWarsawGrouper_Dialogu.value: Wooooow, is that a fish or a whale??
I think we need a bigger boat!

LC_Spring_RareConger_Dialogue_01.value: Watch your fingers - that slippery guy bites!

LC_Spring_RareConger_Dialogue_02.value: And it's putting up a fight, too!

LC_Spring_RareStripedBass_Dialogue_01.value: What is this one? It has a striped back…

LC_Spring_RareStripedBass_Dialogue_02.value: A Striped Bass! Good catch, Grandma!

LC_Spring_RareStripedBass_Dialogue_03.value: Not caught yet. It is putting up a fight.

LC_Spring_RareStripedBass_Dialogue_05.value: Quite the workout! No wonder they call it sport fishing…

LC_Spring_StartPopup_Description.value: Join Maddie and Grandma to help them land that Lucky Catch!

LC_Spring_UltimateThresherShark_Dialogue.value: I think I have something BIG on the line, Maddie.
Gosh, look at that tail! That's a Thresher Shark!
They use their tails like whips, stunning small fish.
But they're harmless to humans. We're much too big for them.
I think this one might give us a try… watch out!

LC_Spring_UncommonPelagicStingray_Dialog.value: My goodness, will you look at that!
Careful! I can take the picture from here, no need to reel it all the way in!
What is it? It looks like…
A Stingray! A Pelagic Stingray to be precise. Careful of that tail!
Do not worry, dearie. I have dodged worse in my time.

LC_Spring_UncommonRedDrum_Dialogue_02.value: You don't see that many red fish.

LC_Spring_UncommonRedDrum_Dialogue_05.value: How do you know so much about fish all of a sudden?

LC_Spring_VeryRareAtlanticHalibut_Dialog.value: I can feel that fish watching us...
It is a curious creature, and no mistake!
I think it's time for it to return to the depths. It's creeping me out!
The Atlantic halibut is really overfished, so you are right.

LC_Spring_VeryRareMistyGrouper_Dialogue_.value: This is a big one. I might need a little help here!
Look at those fins! They're spiky!
So, what have we got here?
It's a Misty Grouper, it's very rare to find it at this depth.
Those stripes remind me of old-style convict overalls. Stylish!

LC_Summer_2026_BootsLv1_01.value: Oh, looks like I caught a...boot?

LC_Summer_2026_BootsLv1_02.value: It's Julius' other boot! He's been looking for that for ages! Don't throw it away!

LC_Summer_2026_BootsLv1_03.value: I'm glad we got it out of the sea. Less trash in our oceans.

LC_Summer_2026_ColossalFishingRod_01.value: Umm. Mrs. Boulton, what... is that?

LC_Summer_2026_ColossalFishingRod_02.value: My fishing rod, Emilio. What does it look like?

LC_Summer_2026_ColossalFishingRod_03.value: ...you do know whale-fishing is illegal, right?

LC_Summer_2026_ColossalMolaMola_02.value: That is a Mola Mola, also known as an ocean sunfish! Amazing catch!

LC_Summer_2026_ColossalMolaMola_03.value: Poor little guy! It looks like just a fish head with no tail.

LC_Summer_2026_ColossalMolaMola_04.value: Not so little! They are fascinating fish, even if... a little funny-looking!

LC_Summer_2026_CommonGreenMoray_Dialogue.value: Look at what you've caught! Incredible!
It is definitely putting up a fight! What is it - an eel?
A Green Moray Eel, to be precise! A native of coral reefs and warm climates. A voracious predator!
No, no, it just excretes a kind of green mucus that colors it. It's actually very interesting--
That doesn't sound very palatable. Back in you go!
Ah. Well. I hope it finds its way back home. Hopewell Bay is not where you belong.

LC_Summer_2026_EpicGoldenRod_01.value: This is what I'm talking about! Oh, the specimens we'll be able to catch with this...

LC_Summer_2026_EpicGoldenRod_02.value: I remember hearing a story once about a fisherman catching something very large and rare with a rod like that...

LC_Summer_2026_EpicTotoaba_Dialogue_01.value: Mrs. Boulton! Look at what you've caught! That's a Totoaba!

LC_Summer_2026_EpicTotoaba_Dialogue_02.value: That's... a really big fish! Are you sure it's not some kind of tuna?

LC_Summer_2026_EpicTotoaba_Dialogue_03.value: No, no. But it is very lost if it's in Hopewell Bay: they only live in the Gulf of California!

LC_Summer_2026_EpicTotoaba_Dialogue_04.value: Be careful, Mrs. Boulton - they are very endangered.

LC_Summer_2026_EpicTotoaba_Dialogue_06.value: Actually, it's not hunted for its meat. It's hunted for its swim bladder - a kind of organ that helps it float.

LC_Summer_2026_EpicTotoaba_Dialogue_07.value: It definitely doesn't want to float for me!

LC_Summer_2026_EpicTotoaba_Dialogue_08.value: Let it go, Mrs. Boulton. Godspeed, Totoaba! I hope you find your way back home.

LC_Summer_2026_Intro_Dialogue_02.value: Emilio? What are you doing here?

LC_Summer_2026_Intro_Dialogue_03.value: Ah, Maddie couldn't make it, but she didn't want you to miss your fishing trip!

LC_Summer_2026_Intro_Dialogue_04.value: So she wondered if I could take you instead.

LC_Summer_2026_Intro_Dialogue_05.value: I see. Are you going to let me actually keep the fish?

LC_Summer_2026_Intro_Dialogue_06.value: Keep... the fish? To do what?

LC_Summer_2026_Intro_Dialogue_07.value: Oh, nevermind. And call me Grandma. Everyone else does.

LC_Summer_2026_Intro_Dialogue_08.value: Umm, okay then. Let's get going! This is going to be so exciting!

LC_Summer_2026_LegendarySmalltoothSawfis.value: Incredible! Look at that - a Smalltooth Sawfish! How is this possible?!
It's probably not going to be the oddest thing you find here. Look at that sword!
Did you know they are actually a type of ray? Their mouth and gills are all on the underside of their bodies!
Huh. Anyway, not what you expected to see, is it?
No, but I'm incredibly happy to see one so far north! They used to range much further than they do now.
Not really - bycatching. Caught accidentally when fishing for other fish. Which is why...
...we better release this one now. Bye-bye, Mr. Sawfish! Best of luck!

LC_Summer_2026_MaxCommonWoodenFishingRod.value: The humble fishing rod. Just what we need.
Hmm, maybe you're right. We should find some better rods!

LC_Summer_2026_MaxFishingClothesAndGolde.value: Well now! No one can say you don't look ready to take on even the biggest fish, Emilio.
I feel like a sports fisherman! Is all of this really necessary?
It suits you. And it's all for the science, right?

LC_Summer_2026_MaxFishingToolBox_01.value: Perfect! With this, our scientific journey of discovery can begin!

LC_Summer_2026_MaxFishingToolBox_03.value: This is about the science, Mrs. Boulton, and these tools will make sure it is as painless as possible for the fish.

LC_Summer_2026_Outro_Dialogue_01.value: Well, that was very interesting, Emilio. You do know a lot about fish.

LC_Summer_2026_Outro_Dialogue_02.value: That's... my entire PhD and career, so I should hope I do! And I hope you know a bit more, too, now.

LC_Summer_2026_Outro_Dialogue_03.value: It's not all about PhDs. But sure. You are not a half-bad fishing partner, after all.

LC_Summer_2026_Outro_Dialogue_04.value: I wouldn't call it fishing, Mrs. B... Grandma. More like maritime science!

LC_Summer_2026_Outro_Dialogue_05.value: If you say so! At least I got some thrills. One of these days, I might get a blue whale on the hook!

LC_Summer_2026_RareCompetitionRod_01.value: I have something for you, Emilio. A new fishing rod!

LC_Summer_2026_RareCompetitionRod_02.value: This looks professional. Where did you get it?

LC_Summer_2026_RareCompetitionRod_03.value: Oh, you know. A lady has got to have her secrets.

LC_Summer_2026_RareEuropeanMonkfish_Dial.value: Huh? Emilio, what's this thing I caught? It is... rather weird.
Oh! That's a European Monkfish, or Lophius piscatorius. A type of angler fish!
Hold on a second... I think I might have seen a skeleton of one of these somewhere in the Mansion.
Perhaps you have an ancestor who had a culinary interest? Their tails are reportedly quite delicious.
I don't know about ancestors, but I know I do... Oh. You let it go.
Of course! I got a great picture too! Isn't this fun?

LC_Summer_2026_StartPopup_Description.value: Join Emilio and Grandma, and help them land the catch of a lifetime!

LC_Summer_2026_TaskPlay_Description.value: Merge items to help Emilio catch fish!

LC_Summer_2026_UltimateBluntnoseSixgillS.value: Emiiliooo...! I have got a beast on the line!
Oh! Ah-hah! Incredible! You've caught a dinosaur!
That's a Bluntnose Sixgill Shark! Look - it has six gills! Most modern sharks only have five.
Let's just say it's not the first 'living fossil' I've caught.
Better be careful. They've been known to attack submarines.
Back into the water with you!

LC_Summer_2026_UncommonGreatBarracuda_Di.value: Ah! Look at those teeth! Do you know what it is, Mrs. Boulton?
Grandma. That's... a barracuda. And a big one at that!
Exactly right - it's a Great Barracuda, the biggest of its kind! Look at that bullet shape.
Perfect for hunting! They can swim in bursts at nearly forty miles per hour.
Lots of muscle on it then, I gather?
Oh yes! Ah - there it went! Too bad. I would've liked to measure it... some can be over five feet long!

LC_Summer_2026_VeryRareLemonShark_Dialog.value: Hupp! I got a shark on the line! A very funnily colored shark!
Ah! You've caught a Lemon Shark! Quick, let's take a picture and let it return to its friends!
Lemon Sharks are very social - although this one is quite far from its habitat. Curious.
Oh-ho, this isn't anything yet. You should see what we've dredged out of the depths here, my dear...

LC_Summer_ColossalFishingRod_Dialogue_01.value: Where did you get that fishing rod??

LC_Summer_ColossalFishingRod_Dialogue_02.value: They say to get the right tools for the job.

LC_Summer_ColossalFishingRod_Dialogue_03.value: What are you hoping to catch - a humpback whale?

LC_Summer_ColossalMolaMola_Dialogue_02.value: Let me check the guidebook... I think it is a mola mola!

LC_Summer_ColossalMolaMola_Dialogue_03.value: Poor little guy! It looks like just a fish head with no tail.

LC_Summer_ColossalMolaMola_Dialogue_04.value: I bet it would still be tasty!

LC_Summer_CommonSnook_Dialogue_01.value: This snook put up quite a fight!

LC_Summer_CommonSnook_Dialogue_03.value: They say snook are excellent culinary fish.

LC_Summer_CommonSnook_Dialogue_04.value: Couldn't we just take it home?

LC_Summer_UltimateMakoShark_Dialogue_02.value: Hold on! You caught a big one, dearie!

LC_Summer_VeryRareWhiteMarlin_Dialogue_0.value: Whoa! Look out for that spike!
It looks sharp, whatever it's called!

LC_UltimateBlackMarlin_Dialogue_01.value: Is there a fish you've always wanted to catch?

LC_UltimateBlackMarlin_Dialogue_02.value: I've always hoped we might catch a black marlin on one of our fishing trips.

LC_UltimateBlackMarlin_Dialogue_03.value: They're very impressive fish, challenging to catch, so I am not hopeful we will ever...

LC_UltimateBlackMarlin_Dialogue_04.value: Huh! I think I've got something pretty big on my hook...

LC_UltimateBlackMarlin_Dialogue_05.value: Yes, you do! And it's a black marlin!

LC_UncommonAlbacore_Dialogue_01.value: Whoa, did you see that silvery fish?? It was fast. And BIG!

LC_UncommonAlbacore_Dialogue_02.value: What in the world was it?

LC_UncommonAlbacore_Dialogue_03.value: I think we're about to find out. I've got it on the hook!

LC_UncommonAlbacore_Dialogue_04.value: Nnng... It's putting up quite a fight.

LC_UncommonAlbacore_Dialogue_05.value: Come on, dearie! Put some muscle into it!

LC_UncommonAlbacore_Dialogue_07.value: You caught an Albacore, a type of tuna. A very nice catch, indeed!

LC_UncommonAtlanticCod_Dialogue_01.value: I think I caught a cod!

LC_UncommonAtlanticCod_Dialogue_02.value: You know, cod is an excellent culinary fish...

LC_UncommonAtlanticCod_Dialogue_03.value: How about we finally take one home to make a nice pie?

LC_VeryRareAtlanticSailfish_Dialogue_02.value: I think we've got a sailfish on the hook!

LC_VeryRareAtlanticSailfish_Dialogue_03.value: You mean the fastest fish in the ocean? THAT sailfish?

LDE_CircusRerun2025_Advertising_01_Dialo.value: OK, here are some of the basics of being a circus performer.
If you want to succeed, you need a solid act. Something that will truly captivate the audience.
And you need to know how to sell it, too.
What kind of performance would you put on?
Dude, just give me some weights and let me be a strongman. No magic, just muscles!

LDE_CircusRerun2025_Brochures_03_Dialogu.value: We need to think of an act that will really stop people in their tracks. Like…
We need to think of an act that will really stop people in their tracks. Like...

LDE_CircusRerun2025_Brochures_07_Dialogu.value: I’m afraid you’re not quite far enough to touch the real knives.
We have some foam knives you can practice with!
FOAM knives? Those are for babies!

LDE_CircusRerun2025_CarnivalGames_03_Dia.value: Be careful, those balls look kinda heavy…
Be careful, those balls look kinda heavy...
I can handle them! Give me another one!

LDE_CircusRerun2025_CarnivalGames_07_Dia.value: What are you doing? I don’t think you should be touching the carnival games and the circus equipment…
What are you doing? I don’t think you should be touching the carnival games and the circus equipment...
He’s telling the truth. The ringmaster told us we could totally try stuff out.
She did? Can I try, too?

LDE_CircusRerun2025_CarnivalPrizes_03_Di.value: Are you planning on joining the Circus?
Haha, probably not... But I'm pretty good at card tricks.
But not so good at juggling, bro!

LDE_CircusRerun2025_CarnivalPrizes_07_Di.value: What do you think about what it is we do here in the circus?
It's all super interesting, but I think I'm ready for more challenging stuff.
Well... You won't tell her, will you?

LDE_CircusRerun2025_CarnivalPrizes_11_Di.value: Oh, they… they're coming in a minute. They're just kind of tied up at the moment…
Oh, they... they're coming in a minute. They're just kind of tied up at the moment...
Actually, I have to go find the key for some chains.

LDE_CircusRerun2025_CircusProps_01_Dialo.value: Hey, little man! What are you doing, poking around back here?
Looks like the kind of stuff they don’t just let anybody mess with.
Yeah, but I have permission. Look at all of this cool stuff! I already found clown noses and flowers that squirt water!
I thought you said you had permission!

LDE_CircusRerun2025_CircusProps_06_Dialo.value: I’m Mason, and this is Hank.
We were just admiring all of your circus equipment! It’s SO cool!
So you’re Mason! Maddie told me you wanted to learn about the Circus.
See, Hank! I DO have permission. Where can I start?
Just a second. First, I must ask: Are you both ready to learn about our work?
I must warn you - it’s harder than it looks. Our performers are the best in the world, and they work very hard to hone their craft.

LDE_CircusRerun2025_CircusProps_10_Dialo.value: We’re still setting everything up, but you can find all the equipment you need in our caravans.
Feel free to try things out, but please stay out of the green caravan.
Mason, listen to the lady. We won’t go in the green caravan, promise!
Well, then. Welcome to the Circus!

LDE_CircusRerun2025_CircusTent_01_Dialog.value: I wasn’t expecting to see you back in Hopewell Bay so soon.
I agree that the circumstances of our last visit were… regrettable, but I hope we can put it behind us.
I agree that the circumstances of our last visit were... regrettable, but I hope we can put it behind us.
No charges were pressed, and the show must go on, as they say.
So you’re back on the road with the Circus?
Yes, but only to bring a smile to people’s faces. I just want to show everyone what it’s all about!
You know, there’s someone I know - a boy called Mason - who would love to learn all about the Circus. Could you show him the ropes?

LDE_CircusRerun2025_CircusWagon_01_Dialo.value: Juggling, fortunetelling and simple magic tricks are fun, but we need something more challenging.

LDE_CircusRerun2025_Fortunetelling_04_Di.value: A crystal ball! This must be the fortune-teller’s caravan.
Look at me, I’m like Lady Voyance!
“Hank, you’re a man of great strength, but don’t walk under a ladder and look out for black cats!”

LDE_CircusRerun2025_HeistPlan_03_Dialogu.value: Look, guys! I designed a trick! I’ve drawn it all out here.

LDE_CircusRerun2025_HeistPlan_06_Dialogu.value: So are you going to show us how your trick works?
Actually, the trick is for you two!
For us? Are you going to use those chains on us??
Yes, and it’ll be great! I have the key here.
OK, then. Just don’t lose the key, little guy!

LDE_CircusRerun2025_Intro_Dialogue_01.value: Does the name Fiona DuVal ring a bell?

LDE_CircusRerun2025_Intro_Dialogue_02.value: You mean the scheming Circus ringmaster who tried to pull a heist at the Mansion - but was stopped right at the last minute?

LDE_CircusRerun2025_Intro_Dialogue_04.value: Yeah, so she’s coming back, or the Circus is! There are posters all over town.

LDE_CircusRerun2025_Intro_Dialogue_05.value: She has some nerve after being caught in the act!

LDE_CircusRerun2025_Intro_Dialogue_06.value: I know she did a bad thing, but the Circus is SO cool. Do you think she’d let me learn some of the acts?

LDE_CircusRerun2025_Intro_Dialogue_07.value: You want to be a circus performer?

LDE_CircusRerun2025_Intro_Dialogue_08.value: It’s one of my dream professions - right behind pirate captain and ghost hunter. It’s really hard to choose between them.

LDE_CircusRerun2025_Intro_Dialogue_09.value: Well, Fiona owes me one after her shenanigans, so I’ll put a good word in for you!

LDE_CircusRerun2025_MagicianProps_05_Dia.value: What’s in the big stripy box?
White gloves, top hats and a LOT of scarves. I guess... magician’s props!
Can I try to make you disappear?
Can you see me? Am I... invisible??

LDE_CircusRerun2025_Outro_Dialogue_01.value: Thank you so much for letting us try everything! I especially loved the tightrope walking and the knives.

LDE_CircusRerun2025_Outro_Dialogue_02.value: The strongman suit felt like a great fit for me.

LDE_CircusRerun2025_Outro_Dialogue_03.value: I really loved the magician's equipment. Not to brag, but my sleight of hand was PRETTY good.

LDE_CircusRerun2025_Outro_Dialogue_04.value: The pleasure is all mine. I must admit, I do see some great talent in the three of you.

LDE_CircusRerun2025_Outro_Dialogue_05.value: You do?? What kind of talent?

LDE_CircusRerun2025_Outro_Dialogue_06.value: You would make the perfect clown act!

LDE_CircusRerun2025_PaperScraps_03_Dialo.value: Could we shoot Roddy out of a cannon? You’ve done it once, haven’t you?
Y-yes, but maybe we could do something less… explosive?
Y-yes, but maybe we could do something less... explosive?

LDE_CircusRerun2025_RingmasterSuit_05_Di.value: Fiona was right. We need to think of an act that makes people so excited that they can’t look away.
Do you remember seeing a mysterious green caravan?
The one she said was strictly off limits? Bro, we can't touch that.
That was more like a guideline than an actual rule. I bet there’s something totally rad in there.
Maybe it’s just what we need!
I don’t know about this, Mason.

LDE_CircusRerun2025_SafeOpen_01_Dialogue.value: A safe? Oh, I get it.
This stuff is meant for a spectacular escape act. Like Harry Houdini!
Help me get inside and close the door.

LDE_CircusRerun2025_TeaGossip_04_Dialogu.value: Your friends seem to be excited about the Circus!
Friends? I thought it was just Mason who wanted to learn the tricks of the trade.
Yes, but there are two others. What were their names again... Hank and Roddy!
Hank and Roddy? I’ve got to see this!

LDE_CircusRerun2025_TeaGossip_07_Dialogu.value: Let me apologize again for my past indiscretions. I really thought I had no options but to choose a life of crime to save the Circus.
And your Grandma always made it sound like the place was vacant. It seemed like the best way out.
Sounds like you were stuck between a rock and a hard place.
I was. People just don’t get excited about the Circus like they used to, so we have to work extra hard.
I never had the best role models growing up. Looking back, the invisible woman and the strongman were probably not the best acts to follow.
I get it. It’s tough to keep everything going when the world seems to be against you.
After working at the mansion for this long, I know how that feels.

LDE_CircusRerun2025_ThiefProps_04_Dialog.value: How did you pry open the door of the green caravan so quickly?
I have many skills. Let’s see what’s in these boxes.
Are they a costume for a cat burglar?

LDE_CircusRerun2025_ThiefProps_07_Dialog.value: These could be perfect for our act!
It’s a shame the costume is about five sizes too small for Hank, and ten sizes too big for me.
What kind of a trick could they be used for?

LDE_GrandmasBirthday2023_AnalogueTapesCh.value: Done! First podcast episode in the can!
While modern podcasting is purely digital, I guess it doesn’t hurt to go old school...
Besides, analogue sounds better! I'm sure this podcast will be a hit!

We’re going to throw a pool party for my sister’s birthday!

LDE_GrandmasBirthday2023_IntroPopup_Desc.value: It's Grandma's Birthday again and this time get your pool toys ready, because she's going to have a surprise pool party! Even though she may not like celebrating her own birthday, Maddie has made sure that she'll at least get some cool gifts and a refreshing time in the pool!

LDE_GrandmasBirthday2023_IntroPopup_Head.value: Have a splash at Grandma's Pool Party!

LDE_GrandmasBirthday2023_LayerDecoration.value: Oh, this is going to be so awesome! You wait and see, I’ve designed the perfect recreational area!
After all... pools are my specialty!
Oh sweetie, that’s not the only thing - Maddie! How are you?! Have you met Hank, my boyfriend?
B- Boyfriend?! No! I haven’t. Hi, I’m Maddie!
So awesome to meet you! I’m Hank. Artist.
So uuh... You and my aunt are...
Yup! She’s so totally awesome, too! She’s funding all my artistic work!
Really?
It’s really worth it sweetie... REALLY worth it!
You’re digging the pool here?!
Where else, sweetie? It’s only temporary. Hank’s designs rarely last very long, anyway.
I believe my art should be beautiful yet fleeting. Like ocean waves during a surf.
Doesn’t he sound just wonderful?
Sounds more like poor design, to me...
Uh oh...
Oh Maddie, I was just looking for you and-
Is that a pool?
Ye...Yes?
I see...
This was my sister’s idea, wasn’t it?
Grandma! I’m surprised to find you here!
How come, dearie? Because of the pool? Oh, don’t worry about that.
I love it!
Really?
Of course! It comes with a lifeguard too!
Hello!
The Pool Party is officially open! Have an AWESOME time!
Hi, Maddie! Didn’t my Hanky-boo do such an amazing job?!
Well, Hanky- I mean Hank got some help from me!
You’re really awesome at it too, Maddie! Ever consider getting into the renovation business?
Actually, I-
Oh, sweetie! No one can match your talents.
I guess that’s true. Few are an artist and a piece of art, at the same time.
...More like a piece of work.
I could get used to this pool!
Enjoy it, sis! Happy Birthday!
Please, don’t say that... It reminds me of my age...
Oh, come on! You look awesome! Not a day over a hundred!
Oh, isn’t he funny?! Hanky-boo, sweetie? Can I have a moment in private with you?
*Ring... Ring...*
Hello, this is Maddie Boulton speaking?
Hello! This is mayor Bruno Golightly. I’m calling regarding your grandmother, Ursula Boulton.
She’s a hard woman to reach, but I was hoping you could pass on my sincerest congratulations to her for another wonderful year!
We, the people of Hopewell Bay, recognize and celebrate her citizenship within our little community and wish her the best and most interesting times in the future.
Thank you and have a pleasant party.
Who was that, dearie?
That was Mayor Bruno. He wanted to wish you a Happy Birthday and... interesting times?
Ha! I guess it could have been worse!
What do you mean by that?

I’m sure she has plenty of interesting stories to tell. And besides...
We weren’t using any of this old equipment back at the Bugle, anyway.

LDE_GreenAcresQuest2024_IntroPopup_Descr.value: Knowing that small actions lead to big impacts, Maddie creates a diverse community garden at the Mansion. Her friends buzz with excitement, each wanting different things, but Maddie harmonizes their wishes into a lush community treasure. Maddie then hears that Emilio is back in Hopewell Bay! But not by himself. He has brought along Bella, who may not be too thrilled about Emilio’s and Maddie’s past...

LDE_GreenAcresQuest2024_IntroPopup_Heade.value: To celebrate Green Game Jam, help Maddie revive a vibrant community garden!

LDE_GreenAcresQuest2024_Intro_Dialogue_0.value: Hello, dearie! What are you up to?
With everything that’s happened so far, I think it’s time we give a little back to people of Hopewell Bay.
Really? How do we do that?
By building a biodiverse community garden! Not only will it allow people to grow their own produce, it’ll be helpful for the environment.
That sounds like a wonderful idea, Maddie!
Of course I’m surprised! What are you doing back?!

LDE_GreenAcresQuest2024_Intro_Dialogue_1.value: Uhm... Anyway, can I introduce you to Isabella Cruz?
Hello Maddie! I’ve heard so MUCH about you! You’re much cuter in person! But shorter than I expected.
Nice to meet you! You’re exactly what I expected!

LDE_GreenAcresQuest2024_LayeredDecoInfoP.value:
You can level up your decoration by progressing in the event! 

Once you level the decoration over <color=#4E8EC8>Level 26</color>, it is yours to keep forever!

LDE_GreenAcresQuest2024_Outro_Dialogue_0.value: I would call this a success, dearie!
Yeah. I thought I was getting over our breakup, but with him coming back...
Look dearie, I wouldn’t worry about him... Or her.
You’re much too good for them.

LDE_GreenAcresQuest2024_Pollinator_05_Di.value: I haven’t seen those around these parts in a long time.
Looks like your garden is bringing back the old residence!

LDE_GreenAcresQuest2024_RareFlowerA_01_D.value: This garden is really working out!
Maybe I should sell some of these flowers at the flower market?

LDE_GreenAcresQuest2024_ShopProgressionP.value: Collect Event Points by completing the Green Acres Quest event merge tasks and get all the Green Acres Quest decoration sets!

LDE_GreenAcresQuest2024_StartPopup_Descr.value: A rich, biodiverse community garden may not be enough to distract Maddie from the fact that Emilio is back! And he brought a friend...

LDE_GreenAcresQuest2024_TA1_Dialogue_03.value: Look... I understand you’re still angry with me. I’m so sorry about what happened between us...

LDE_GreenAcresQuest2024_TA1_Dialogue_04.value: But, I hope you understand that my work over there was really important! I had to go.

LDE_GreenAcresQuest2024_TA1_Dialogue_05.value: Did you HAVE to bring her back with you?

LDE_GreenAcresQuest2024_TA1_Dialogue_06.value: Bella? Well... Yes. She’s my partner.

LDE_GreenAcresQuest2024_TA1_Dialogue_08.value: Work partner! I’ve known her since University, Maddie. When she called me to ask for-

LDE_GreenAcresQuest2024_TA1_Dialogue_11.value: Ugh... I’m sorry Emilio, I don’t have time for this.

LDE_GreenAcresQuest2024_TA4_Dialogue_01.value: Maddie! You won’t believe who I just saw!

LDE_GreenAcresQuest2024_TA4_Dialogue_02.value: Emilio? Yeah... He dropped by earlier with her.

LDE_GreenAcresQuest2024_TA4_Dialogue_04.value: Yep! Just a perfect ray of sunshine, that one.

LDE_GreenAcresQuest2024_TA4_Dialogue_05.value: Eeh... This must be really awkward for you.

LDE_GreenAcresQuest2024_TA4_Dialogue_06.value: Oh no, it’s totally fine. Bella and Emilio are “just friends...”

LDE_GreenAcresQuest2024_TA4_Dialogue_07.value: Oh boy... I know that look.

LDE_GreenAcresQuest2024_TA7_Dialogue_03.value: What a wonderful little garden you’ve made here!

LDE_GreenAcresQuest2024_TA7_Dialogue_04.value: Reminds me of those little gardens that my kindergarteners used to make! So colorful and disorganized!

LDE_GreenAcresQuest2024_TA7_Dialogue_06.value: Oh, don’t mention it! If you need any HELP at all, you know who to call! I used to run a holistic horticulture center in Europe for a couple of years. We won quite a few awards for it.

LDE_GreenAcresQuest2024_TA7_Dialogue_07.value: Thanks... I’ll keep that in mind.

LDE_GreenAcresQuest2024_TA7_Dialogue_08.value: And I LOOVE that yellow on you! Few can rock that color. You go, little girl!

LDE_GreenAcresQuest2024_TC1_Dialogue_03.value: This weed is pretty tough! It has really thick roots.

LDE_GreenAcresQuest2024_TC1_Dialogue_04.value: Ah, be careful with that. It’s Mandragora.

LDE_GreenAcresQuest2024_TC3_Dialogue_01.value: Wow! You really went all out on this community garden!

LDE_GreenAcresQuest2024_TC3_Dialogue_02.value: Thanks Roddy! I hope everyone will like it.

LDE_GreenAcresQuest2024_TC3_Dialogue_04.value: Not bad, Maddie... Not bad at all!

LDE_GreenAcresQuest2024_TagSinkFTUE_Desc.value: Drag any flower into the Compost to get more Soil for the Flowerbed. The higher the flower rarity, the more you get out.
Vegetable Compost decreases the level of any vegetable or chili. Note that the Compost only gives back one lower level item.

LDE_GreenAcresQuest2024_TaskPlay_Descrip.value: Merge items and discover new decorations!

LDE_GreenAcresQuest2024_TeaserPopup_Desc.value: Please reach a higher level to play the event.

LDE_GreenAcresQuest2024_UncommonFlowerA_.value: These lilies will really give the garden an elegant look!
And I think Deb will love them.

LDE_GreenAcresQuest2024_VeggieCompost_Di.value: Vegetable Compost decreases the level of any vegetable or chili. Note that the Compost only gives back one lower level item.

LDE_GreenAcresQuest2024_Veggies_08_Dialo.value: You got some fantastic vegetables growing here, Maddie!
Take as many as you wish! This is a community garden.
Alright, veggies. You’re coming with me!

LDE_GreenAcresQuest2024_v2_BoardIntro_Di.value: OK, I've got the plans Maddie drew for the garden, and all the equipment I need.
Gardening can't be that hard... Can it?
It's just a little biodiverse green space with a variety of fruit and vegetables.
Buck up, Emilio. You can build a pirate ship, and you've swum with sharks. You won't back down from a challenge!
*Sigh* Why do I keep talking to myself?

LDE_GreenAcresQuest2024_v2_CharacterBell.value: You're helping at the garden, too? This community really pulls together...

LDE_GreenAcresQuest2024_v2_CharacterCher.value: Cherry, I'm desperate. Could you help me with this garden?
Wow! I can try, but I'm not much of a gardener.

LDE_GreenAcresQuest2024_v2_CharacterDeb_.value: You look like you need some help, my dear!

LDE_GreenAcresQuest2024_v2_CharacterGran.value: Hmmm... You do not know much about gardening, do you?
I guessed as much. Let me show you!

LDE_GreenAcresQuest2024_v2_CharacterJack.value: Jackie, would you have a moment to help me?
Sure thing - but I don't know much about gardening!

LDE_GreenAcresQuest2024_v2_CharacterJuli.value: Julius, do you know anything about gardening?
Well, I have read several books about it. Does that help?

LDE_GreenAcresQuest2024_v2_CharacterMaso.value: I'm trying... I couldn't tempt you to help, could I?
I guess I owe you one. Hand me a rake!

LDE_GreenAcresQuest2024_v2_CommonFlowerD.value: If you want to attract pollinators, your garden needs flowers, too!
I have no idea... That's bad, isn't it?

LDE_GreenAcresQuest2024_v2_FlowerCompost.value: Flower Compost helps you get rid of Flowers you don't need, to get more Soil.

LDE_GreenAcresQuest2024_v2_Friendship_08.value: I've been looking for you, Emilio! I have a surprise for you - a little wedding present.
We didn't get a chance to get each other anything before, but I wanted to give you something special.
What a great little bracelet! And you made it yourself?
I did... Do you like it?

LDE_GreenAcresQuest2024_v2_GardenGnomes_.value: Don't forget to add some garden gnomes!
Do I really need garden gnomes? Do you think Bella would like them?
Of course! Everyone likes garden gnomes.
I guess we'll have garden gnomes!

LDE_GreenAcresQuest2024_v2_GoodAnimals_0.value: Is that a... hedgehog?? It's so adorable!
Welcome to Bella's community garden, little guy.

LDE_GreenAcresQuest2024_v2_GreenhouseChi.value: Bella will definitely want some chilies. The hotter, the better!
What are these? Can I taste them?
HOLY MOTHER OF LAVA! These are h-h-hot!

LDE_GreenAcresQuest2024_v2_IntroPopup_De.value: After their eventful wedding, Emilio wants to create a surprise for Bella. And what would make a better wedding gift than a beautiful garden full of biodiversity? The only problem: Emilio doesn't have the first idea about gardening. With a little bit of help from his friends, he gets to work growing plants - and friendships.

LDE_GreenAcresQuest2024_v2_IntroPopup_He.value: Join Emilio on a feel-good mission to turn a wild idea into a blooming paradise!

LDE_GreenAcresQuest2024_v2_Intro_Dialogu.value: Maddie, I was wondering if you could lend me a hand...
Married life with Bella has been wonderful, but our wedding happened so unexpectedly that I never got to give her a proper wedding gift.
I've been thinking about building her a little garden, as her works concentrate on biodiversity.
The problem is, I know nothing about gardening.
I know you've got a green thumb, so... could you help me? I know it's a lot to ask.
It sounds like a great idea. I'm a bit busy around the Mansion, but I can give you some guidance.
And I know quite a few people who can help with the rest!

LDE_GreenAcresQuest2024_v2_Outro_Dialogu.value: Phew, that was a lot of work! I have a new appreciation for all the work you've done in the Mansion gardens.
With the composts and the pollinators, there's so much to think about!
And Bella seemed pretty happy with her wedding gift.
She did, didn't she? But how can I ever beat this gift?
Next year you can build her an aquarium!
That's a great idea! Do you think you could--
Oh, man! I think I can hear Grandma calling me. Sorry, but I have to run!

LDE_GreenAcresQuest2024_v2_Pollinator_05.value: Your garden is already attracting wildlife!
It's working! The garden is really working!

LDE_GreenAcresQuest2024_v2_RareFlowerA_0.value: I can't believe how many people have helped me build this garden!
With so many beautiful flowers, everyone can enjoy it.
I just hope Bella finds her favorite among them...

LDE_GreenAcresQuest2024_v2_RareFlowerB_0.value: What is Bella's favorite flower? Could it be the rose? Or tulip?
I still don't know. I feel totally hopeless!

LDE_GreenAcresQuest2024_v2_StartPopup_De.value: Building a garden sounds fun, but it's easier said than done.

LDE_GreenAcresQuest2024_v2_TA1_Dialogue_.value: It's truly wonderful. I keep learning new things about Bella, and we're really learning to make compromises, too.
Like she snores, so I use earplugs. I keep talking about fostering stingrays, so she sometimes uses earplugs.
Sounds like you've got it all figured out!

LDE_GreenAcresQuest2024_v2_TA4_Dialogue_.value: Are you building a new garden at the Mansion?
Nice job! The ecological diversity looks great, and I saw lots of bees as well! The only thing you're missing is poppies.
Really? Are they important for biodiversity?
No, but they're my favorite flowers!

LDE_GreenAcresQuest2024_v2_TA7_Dialogue_.value: What's up? It's starting to look like a garden out here!
It's coming along, but I never knew garden work could be so hard!

LDE_GreenAcresQuest2024_v2_TC1_Dialogue_.value: There you are! What on earth are you doing out here with all those rakes and gardening gloves?
Are you helping Maddie with her new garden project?
Y-yes! She asked me to help, since there's so much work to do.
Does she know your family used to call you the "plant assassin" because you used to kill every plant you touched?

LDE_GreenAcresQuest2024_v2_TC3_Dialogue_.value: Bella, your surprise is finally ready!
What is it? I'm so excited!
Ta-da! It's a community garden. I built it for you - with a lot of help from Maddie and everyone!
YOU built this?? I can't believe it! And you even planted my favorite flowers!
Yes - I love poppies! Thank you, Emilio. You're the best!

LDE_GreenAcresQuest2024_v2_UncommonFlowe.value: I have a wonderful idea for your garden -- something Bella would love!

LDE_GreenAcresQuest2024_v2_VeggieCompost.value: Vegetable Compost decreases the level of any vegetable or chili. Note that the Compost only gives back one lower level item.

LDE_GreenAcresQuest2024_v2_Veggies_08_Di.value: You've done a fantastic job, Emilio!
I think I'm starting to get the hang of this. Gardening is fun!

LDE_GreenAcresQuest_BoardIntro_Dialogue_.value: This little garden is incredible! I really thought of everything…
There are flowers, veggies and plenty of other things to attract pollinators and animals. There are even garden gnomes!
But there’s a lot to do if I want to get this garden up and running. Who should I ask to help?
Jackie never gives up if I can get her on board. Deb’s great with flowers, and Julius knows all about bugs.
Mason always brings the fun, and Cherry knows her vegetables.
Maybe I could even get Grandma to help out...
Well, the rakes are ready, the seedbags lined up, and the beds won't turn themselves.
Let's see if I can turn this garden into a little community project!

LDE_GreenAcresQuest_CharacterBella_02_Di.value: Hey Bella! I didn’t expect an audience while I wrestle with weeds.
Hey, Bella! I didn’t expect an audience while I wrestle with weeds.
Not an audience, more like… a concerned expert witnessing ecological distress.
Let’s just say this garden has potential, but it’s currently in survival mode.
I would love to get your advice - or, you know, a full rescue plan.
Lucky for you, restoring struggling environments is kind of my thing.
Then I’m very glad you just happened to wander by.

LDE_GreenAcresQuest_CharacterCherry_02_D.value: Cherry, I was thinking... would you help me restore the old vegetable garden? At the moment it's a bit of mess.
A mess? It sounds like a goldmine of ingredients just waiting to shine. Of course I’ll help!
Yes! I could really use your energy… and maybe your optimism. There's a lot to do!
I’m already imagining fresh vegetables and berries, yummy herbs… Oh! Think of the pies we could make!
I knew you’d turn this into a baking plan somehow.
Guilty! You bring the garden tools, I'll bring the snacks.

LDE_GreenAcresQuest_CharacterDeb_02_Dial.value: What do we have here? This garden looks severely neglected!
I know, I know. That’s why I called you… I REALLY need your expertise!
Do you think you could help me fix up the flower beds?
I suppose I can help. My friends do say I am not entirely devoid of knowledge in that field…
Do you have some gardening gloves?

LDE_GreenAcresQuest_CharacterGrandma_02_.value: Look at this! You’ve been working hard! This garden already looks so much better.
Thank you! It’s not bad, if I do say so myself.
I did! Everyone has pitched in. And speaking about helping...
I am ready if you need me!

LDE_GreenAcresQuest_CharacterJackie_02_D.value: So, you’re planning to bring back the old vegetable garden?
Isn’t it too late in the season for that? There’s a LOT of work to do here…
There is, but together we can make it happen. What do you say - would you help me?
You know it! Just tell me what to do.

LDE_GreenAcresQuest_CharacterJulius_02_D.value: What a delightful place! I am so glad to hear you intend to restore this little garden.
There has been a terrible decline in pollinators in recent years. This is exactly the kind of place we need more of.
Tell me what I can do to help!
I knew I could count on you, Julius.

LDE_GreenAcresQuest_CharacterMason_02_Di.value: What’s up? On the phone you told me that you had a “really fun” project for me. What is it?
I hope that spade isn’t a part of it...
You’re going to ask me to help at the vegetable garden, aren’t you?
I saw Julius with a pair of gardening gloves and a big rake earlier. It didn’t take long to get him to ‘fess up.
Well, would you help me? Please?

LDE_GreenAcresQuest_CommonFlowerGrowth_0.value: Now, you want to grow a variety of wild flowers in your garden, Maddie. They’re good for the soil and…
Yes, I was just going to say that. Someone seems quite eager…
Maddie asked me to help due to my extensive knowledge about insects, Deb.
Guys, play nice! This is a garden based on community spirit, remember?
Hrhm, of course. I am sorry, Julius.
I apologize too. Maybe I was a LITTLE bit too eager. What were you saying about the wild flowers, Deb?

LDE_GreenAcresQuest_FlowerCompost_Dialog.value: Flower Compost helps you get rid of Flowers you don't need, to get more Soil.

LDE_GreenAcresQuest_Friendship_08_Dialog.value: Hey, Maddie! I heard you might need some help fixing up the vegetable garden. Is there something I could do?
There’s always something that needs to be done. How do you feel about turning the vegetable compost?

LDE_GreenAcresQuest_GardenGnomes_07_Dial.value: Why are there so many garden gnomes here? I seem to find another one behind every leaf pile and every mound.
I wonder if they just pop out the ground like mushrooms? So creepy...

LDE_GreenAcresQuest_GoodAnimals_05_Dialo.value: Maddie, don’t look now, but I think that pile of leaves is moving!
You never told me this garden is HAUNTED!
It’s not haunted, silly! It’s only a little hedgehog waking up from its nap.

LDE_GreenAcresQuest_GreenhouseChilis_06_.value: Hey, Roddy! I bet you can’t eat one of these chilies.
I I COULD, but I choose not to. Be careful with them - they’re so hot they’ll make your eyes water.
Oh, what yummy looking chilies! Can I have one?
Get her a glass of milk, quick!
Mmm, delicious! But a little bit too mild for me.

LDE_GreenAcresQuest_IntroPopup_Descripti.value: With an old vegetable garden to save, Maddie rounds up her friends to bring the lush community space back to life! Play now to find out who will lend her a helping hand - and why there are so many gnomes in this garden...

LDE_GreenAcresQuest_IntroPopup_Header.value: Help Maddie and her friends revive a vibrant community garden!

LDE_GreenAcresQuest_Intro_Dialogue_01.value: Remember the vegetable garden we built some time ago? You know, in front of the Mansion?

LDE_GreenAcresQuest_Intro_Dialogue_03.value: I got it ready for winter, but with everything else I had going on, I never went back to keep it going this year.

LDE_GreenAcresQuest_Intro_Dialogue_04.value: Do you think it’s too late to start now?

LDE_GreenAcresQuest_Intro_Dialogue_05.value: It is never too late, dearie!

LDE_GreenAcresQuest_Intro_Dialogue_06.value: But there’s SO much to do.

LDE_GreenAcresQuest_Intro_Dialogue_07.value: I’m sure you don't have to do it all by yourself. Why don't you get some friends to help you?

LDE_GreenAcresQuest_Intro_Dialogue_08.value: Hmm… All of my friends do have their own special abilities. And I can always bribe them with the promise of fresh produce.

LDE_GreenAcresQuest_Intro_Dialogue_09.value: Exactly! Who could say no to a bunch of beets or a nice pumpkin?

LDE_GreenAcresQuest_Outro_Dialogue_01.value: I can’t believe it... the garden’s finally done. I never could’ve done this on my own.

LDE_GreenAcresQuest_Outro_Dialogue_02.value: And just look at it! Fresh ingredients everywhere - this might be my favorite place in town now.

LDE_GreenAcresQuest_Outro_Dialogue_03.value: It’s more than beautiful, Maddie. It’s balanced and thriving! You’ve created a whole living system here.

LDE_GreenAcresQuest_Outro_Dialogue_04.value: I-I helped a little too... even with the bees and everything.

LDE_GreenAcresQuest_Outro_Dialogue_05.value: You all did! It turned out better than I expected.

LDE_GreenAcresQuest_Outro_Dialogue_06.value: Not bad for a “bit of a mess,” is it?

LDE_GreenAcresQuest_Pollinator_05_Dialog.value: The vegetable compost is done, same with the flower compost. I never realized just how stinky they are!
Whoah! This place looks completely transformed!
T-there are a lot of bees here...
I know. It means the garden’s really thriving.
Y-yeah... that’s great. It’s just... I’m a little allergic.
O-only if they sting... Maybe I should go.

LDE_GreenAcresQuest_RareFlowerGrowth_01_.value: Phew! I think our work here is done!
Amazing job, you two! I knew you'd be able to create something amazing if you worked together.
Sometimes it's OK to admit you need help.
I must admit, I learned a lot about oligolectic pollinator guilds, Julius.
And your knowledge about variegated cultivar propagation in ornamental topiary is quite unparalleled, Deb!

LDE_GreenAcresQuest_StartPopup_Descripti.value: A rich, biodiverse community garden desperately needs some TLC. Help Maddie and her friends bring it back to life!

LDE_GreenAcresQuest_UncommonFlowerGrowth.value: The very best flowers for pollinators are native, nectar-rich plants with single-layer petals.
Like the narrow-leaf mountain mint here?
Exactly! Maybe we could even add some squirrel corn and foxglove beardtongue for the spring…
And wrinkleleaf goldenrod and white turtlehead for the autumn?
Are you still talking about flowers?

LDE_GreenAcresQuest_VeggieCompost_Dialog.value: Vegetable Compost decreases the level of any vegetable or chili. Note that the Compost only gives back one lower level item.

LDE_GreenAcresQuest_Veggies_08_Dialogue_.value: I’m so happy you asked me to help in the garden. I’ve been so busy lately... I feel like I’ve been the worst friend.
You’re running a whole bakery, Cherry! I get it!
You’ve got some incredible things growing here. Wait-- Is that the tree Ursula gets the apples for her famous pie from?
Maybe? I’m not sure. Why do you ask?
Because she guards that recipe like a treasure, and I need to know what makes it so special!
I think it’s just a pinch of Grandma’s magic.
It’s a pinch of something, alright!

LDE_HolidayCarols2023_12DaysOfChristmas_.value: I bet you were singing these songs when the dinosaurs were around...
I am not that old, Mason!

LDE_HolidayCarols2023_BandCostume_03_Dia.value: Unfortunately, I can't wear this. It does not go with my colors...
I think green and red are very becoming on you, Deb!
Do you really... Well, if you say so!

LDE_HolidayCarols2023_BandCostume_05_Dia.value: We really are wrapping up warm.
I don't want you to catch a cold. God forbid you all lose your voice!

LDE_HolidayCarols2023_BoardIntro_Dialogu.value: What's the name of our group?
Too much? How about... the Fa-la-la-la Follies?

LDE_HolidayCarols2023_CarolBook_05_Dialo.value: Why don't you join our caroling troupe?
Everyone! If you join, you'll be paid in gingerbread and good cheer...
You had me at candy cane.

LDE_HolidayCarols2023_CarolOfTheBells_06.value: Why not... Do you have a lot of singing experience?
Sure! I sing in the shower every day.

LDE_HolidayCarols2023_CarolStageProducin.value: This is it! Are you ready to sing?

LDE_HolidayCarols2023_ChristmasCard_Subh.value: The holiday season means a lot of things to a lot of people. Not everyone is even that crazy about it - and that's fine too! So, I wanna wish you a wonderful and peaceful time with everything that makes you happy!

Phew, it's been a busy year! It feels like often my life is all about digging for flower beds - and answers - but now it’s time for the holidays! Enjoy the season and remember to give your grandma a call!

It's my favorite time of the year - you know why? It's not the presents or the candy canes (although I do love both). It's getting together with everyone I love. That's the best, and I'm not just saying that to stay on the "nice" list!
Have you got your decorations up yet? Well, this time of year is about so much more than appearances. Enjoy a mug of mulled Hopeberry juice on me and remember to keep your toes warm!

This time of year can get stressful - so many people poking their nose into your business - so what I do is I just go take a little nap. I want to wish you lovely holidays with plenty of pie and presents - and some snoozes!

LDE_HolidayCarols2023_DeckTheHalls_07_Di.value: The stage will need some decorations, too.

LDE_HolidayCarols2023_DecorationEarnedPo.value:
By reaching level {0} , you have permanently earned the Caroling Stage as a decoration!

Continue playing to earn further upgrades for your decoration!

LDE_HolidayCarols2023_EndPopup_Descripti.value:
Thank you for playing the Fa-la-la-la Follies event!
You can claim all your unclaimed items here!

LDE_HolidayCarols2023_EventIntro_Dialogu.value: You seem to be full of the season's cheer, dearie!
I can't help it! It's the snow, the atmosphere, the...
Ha! I really want to spread the happiness.
That sounds like a delightful idea! And you look like you already have a plan…
That sounds like a delightful idea! And you look like you already have a plan...
Well… you're right! Julius told me that there used to be a caroling troupe in Hopewell Bay.
Well... you're right! Julius told me that there used to be a caroling troupe in Hopewell Bay.
They were just a bunch of folks from all kinds of backgrounds who wanted to promote the holiday spirit.
Oh, I remember them! They played all kinds of instruments and sang… sometimes a bit too long for my liking!
Oh, I remember them! They played all kinds of instruments and sang... sometimes a bit too long for my liking!
Who will you ask to join you?
Just friends like Roddy, Julius, Deb, Mason... Maybe Emilio....
Sounds like you'll have a lot of fun!

LDE_HolidayCarols2023_ExtendPopup_Descri.value:
The Fa-la-la-la Follies event has sadly come to an end.
Event Merge Board and Merge Tasks will be closed now.

LDE_HolidayCarols2023_ExtendPopup_Header.value: The Fa-la-la-la Follies event is about to end!

LDE_HolidayCarols2023_HandBell_05_Dialog.value: How is this played? Like this?
Be careful, it can be PRETTY loud...

LDE_HolidayCarols2023_HolidayPresent_01_.value: I think I got a pair of gardening gloves!
In this garden, you need them ALL the time - especially when you least expect it.

LDE_HolidayCarols2023_HolidayPresent_03_.value: Looks like Rufus got his wish!

LDE_HolidayCarols2023_HolidayPresent_04_.value: It's perfect for writing the best recipes!

LDE_HolidayCarols2023_HolidayPresent_05_.value: Nice pearls go with any outfit, I always say!

LDE_HolidayCarols2023_HolidayPresent_06_.value: Just the way I like my knives!

LDE_HolidayCarols2023_HolidayPresent_07_.value: Ah, a singing fish! How interesting...
I get it... It's because I'm a marine biologist.

LDE_HolidayCarols2023_HolidayPresent_08_.value: You can never have too many tape recorders!
I wonder if Santa would give me an exclusive interview...

LDE_HolidayCarols2023_HolidayPresent_09_.value: Oh, it's a guksi - a type of duodji used by the Sami people!
Right... How do you know that?

LDE_HolidayCarols2023_HolidayPresent_10_.value: That looks unmistakeably like a bicycle... I could be wrong!

LDE_HolidayCarols2023_HolidayStocking_03.value: I think we have enough stockings for everyone.

LDE_HolidayCarols2023_InfoPanel_Decorati.value: An upgrade for the Holiday Market is available!

LDE_HolidayCarols2023_InfoPanel_Descript.value:
The Fa-La-La-La Follies event has started!
Complete Event Merge Tasks and earn Event Points.

LDE_HolidayCarols2023_InfoPanel_Header.value: Complete tasks to build a Caroling Stage!

LDE_HolidayCarols2023_InfoPopup_Task.value: Help Maddie spread the season's cheer!

LDE_HolidayCarols2023_IntroPopup_Descrip.value: Maddie decides to spread the season's cheer by recruiting her friends to her caroling troupe. When building a simple stage for their performance turns into putting together a full-blown Holiday Market, putting up decorations leads to a twig of mistletoe, and the results even surprise her!

LDE_HolidayCarols2023_IntroPopup_Header.value: Help Maddie put together the greatest caroling troupe in Hopewell Bay!

LDE_HolidayCarols2023_LayerDecoration_01.value: We can go from door to door, but that's a lot of doors...
Maybe we could build a stage... And I know the perfect place for it!

LDE_HolidayCarols2023_LayerDecoration_03.value: This is starting to look wonderful, Maddie!
Thank you, Emilio. I was actually hoping to see you...
Yeah, you'll never believe what Lady Voyance said...

LDE_HolidayCarols2023_LayerDecoration_05.value: Maddie, I know you're super busy with the caroling troupe, but I had an idea...
What is it, Mason? Don't worry - you'll get some candy apples.
Oh, great! But actually this is about something else...
I thought we could all write a post card - you know, like season's greetings! But they're not addressed to anyone in particular.
We'll all just put them in a mailbox and then see which one we get.
That's an excellent idea! I'll get the mailbox; you ask everyone to send a card!

LDE_HolidayCarols2023_LayerDecoration_07.value: All this stage needs now is the instruments!
But who's going to play them?
I guess I am pretty good with the tambourine!

LDE_HolidayCarols2023_LayerDecoration_10.value: I suffer from terrible stage fright!

LDE_HolidayCarols2023_LayerDecoration_13.value: Yeah, it is! I wonder who hung it there...
Apparently, you can kiss someone when you're standing under that stuff.

LDE_HolidayCarols2023_LayerDecoration_15.value: You'll never believe what I just saw!
Well, well, well... The mistletoe worked!
