LDE_HolidayCarols2023_ReverseCracker_06_.value: Oh, schnikes! I bet I'll get helmet hair from wearing this crown!
Somehow I think you don't have to worry about that...

LDE_HolidayCarols2023_ReverseCracker_07_.value: We both hold one end and... pull!

LDE_HolidayCarols2023_SewingSupply_04_Di.value: You can never have too much!

LDE_HolidayCarols2023_SewingSupply_06_Di.value: You could even say you're "sleigh-in’ it."

LDE_HolidayCarols2023_StringInstrument_0.value: You can trust me, Maddie. I never trip over...
I'll take care of the harp, dearie.
Wow, sounds good! Can you... play it?
There's a lot you don't know about me...

LDE_HolidayCarols2023_WindInstrument_07_.value: This one's been twisted into knots.
That's what a tuba is supposed to look like!

LDE_HolidayOddities2025_Bellow_03_Dialog.value: If you want to build a good fire, you need bellows. I learned that in scouts!
You’re right. A fire needs air to breathe.
This is my kind of holiday tradition!

LDE_HolidayOddities2025_BoardIntro_Dialo.value: What a beautiful winter evening! Maddie has done a magnificent job in the Mansion.
She really has worked so hard. I’m not surprised she was out like a light tonight.
Knowing her, next she will work herself ragged to get everything ready for the holidays - and there is a lot to do…
Knowing her, next she will work herself ragged to get everything ready for the holidays - and there is a lot to do...
We need to find the perfect tree, bake, cook, decorate…
We need to find the perfect tree, bake, cook, decorate...
This year, I want to give her a chance to have a little break from all of that work. For that, I will need some help - and I know just who to ask.
The first stop is the spruce forest!

LDE_HolidayOddities2025_ChristmasTreeA_0.value: Now that we have found the perfect tree and we have a basket full of materials to make ornaments, we can head back to the Mansion.
What’s the next tradition?
I will tell you all about it when we get to the shed.
Is there something in the shed that's going to help us create a holiday miracle?
We have the tree, our ornaments and a roaring fire. What’s next?
Next, we’re making soup - out of canned food!
Tell us about the next tradition! Is it baking? LET IT BE BAKING!
No, the fourth tradition is about knitting.
K-knitting?
It’s starting to look like the holidays here, don’t you think?
You're right. Maybe there's something to these traditions.
So what's next, Ursula?
Our final tradition, but some argue it is the most important - the gift of time.
Don't keep us in suspense! Tell us, how are we going to pull that off?
With these.
A bunch of clock keys?
Now we’ve turned the clocks, what comes next?
We finish decorating the tree.
I can’t wait for Maddie to see all of this! She’s going to be SO surprised.
I think we did well here, fellas.
And we worked together.
Ursula was right. This really IS a holiday miracle!

LDE_HolidayOddities2025_ChristmasTreeB_0.value: Now that we have found the perfect tree, and we have a basket full of materials to make ornaments, we can head back to the Mansion.
I will tell you all about it when we get to the shed.
Is there something in the shed that's going to help us create a holiday miracle?

LDE_HolidayOddities2025_ChristmasTreeC_0.value: We have the tree, our ornaments and a roaring fire. What’s next?

LDE_HolidayOddities2025_ChristmasTreeD_0.value: Tell us about the next tradition! Is it baking? LET IT BE BAKING!

LDE_HolidayOddities2025_ChristmasTreeE_0.value: It’s starting to look like the holidays here, don’t you think?

Our final tradition, but some argue it is the most important - the gift of time.
Don't keep us in suspense! Tell us, how are we going to pull that off?

LDE_HolidayOddities2025_ChristmasTreeF_0.value: I can’t wait for Maddie to see all of this! She’s going to be SO surprised.
I think we did well here, fellas.
Ursula was right. This really IS a holiday miracle!

LDE_HolidayOddities2025_ChristmasTreeS_0.value: Now we’ve turned the clocks, what comes next?

LDE_HolidayOddities2025_ClockATurned_01_.value: It seems to me that this old tradition could cause some chaos.
That is precisely the point, Roddy!
The holidays come when you let go of your schedules.

LDE_HolidayOddities2025_ClockBTurned_01_.value: Did you turn that clock forward or back?
Did you set that clock forward or back?
Who cares? It's the holidays, and we're making more time for opening presents and eating gingerbread.

LDE_HolidayOddities2025_ClockCTurned_01_.value: This is the last clock. Maybe we should leave one to show the real time, though. You know, just in case…
This is the last clock. Maybe we should leave one to show the real time, though. You know, just in case...
Traditions are traditions, Roddy. Turn the clock!
Traditions are traditions, Roddy. Change the time!

LDE_HolidayOddities2025_ClockKeys_03_Dia.value: What is this tradition and what are we supposed to do with these clock keys?
You will use the keys to turn all the clocks you can find to show the wrong time.
You will use the keys to set all the clocks you can find to show the wrong time.
W-why? Then I won’t know when I need to have my protein shakes.
When you cannot trust what a clock shows, you stop caring about it. And when you stop caring about what time it is, you are truly free to enjoy the holidays.

LDE_HolidayOddities2025_ExtendPopup_Head.value: The Holiday Oddities event is about to end!

LDE_HolidayOddities2025_HotDrinks_02_Dia.value: Where’s Maddie? She’s usually the one who organizes the holiday miracles.
Maybe this year, the holiday miracle is for her?
Roddy is correct. We’re giving Maddie the gift of leisure!
I wish someone would give me the gift of a nap.

LDE_HolidayOddities2025_HotDrinks_04_Dia.value: The fire is roaring! This household will have all the luck if you keep it going.
I think you have all deserved some refreshments. How about a nice cup of hot Hopeberry juice?

LDE_HolidayOddities2025_IntroPopup_Descr.value: As snow falls, turning the Mansion into a frosty winter postcard, a year of fixing, painting, gardening, and hosting has caught up with Maddie. Grandma Ursula decides to call in a crack team of helpers to create a little holiday miracle for her granddaughter - all based on the weirdest and oldest Hopewell Bay traditions!

LDE_HolidayOddities2025_IntroPopup_Heade.value: Discover old holiday traditions with Grandma Ursula!

LDE_HolidayOddities2025_KitchenUtensils_.value: Collect all the cans you can find in the pantry and bring them into the kitchen.
Then we will do a little bit of mixing and stirring and see what we end up with!
What, mix together whatever’s in the cans? Creamed corn and spaghetti hoops?
Exactly. Sometimes the end result can be quite tasty!
What’s the tradition behind making soup out of weird canned foods?
In old Hopewell Bay, waste was frowned upon. Every home contributed whatever they could spare to the communal soup, served during the holidays.
And whether it was delicious or disgusting, everyone was grateful for a hot meal shared with the community.
And I love creamed corn with spaghetti hoops!

LDE_HolidayOddities2025_KnittingNeedlesG.value: It is all about the right grip. Don’t hold the needles too tightly, but not too loosely, either.
Let the yarn run through your fingers, but maintain a good tension.

LDE_HolidayOddities2025_KnittingNeedlesR.value: Ursula, am I doing it right?

LDE_HolidayOddities2025_KnittingNeedlesW.value: That’s excellent work, Hank! You’re a natural.

LDE_HolidayOddities2025_KnittingTools_03.value: I don’t know how to knit.
Is knitting the thing you do with the hook?
But isn’t crochet the thing you do with the needles?
It is not that complicated. You will be using needles to knit odd socks, and I will show you what to do.

LDE_HolidayOddities2025_KnittingTools_06.value: I guess that’s where the tradition comes in.
Indeed. The origins of this tradition are, frankly, a mystery.
Some say it is based on socks’ tendency to lose their pairs, and others blame it on a sock thief that apparently plagued the town in the olden days.
Makes sense to me! Let’s knit!

LDE_HolidayOddities2025_LayeredDecoInfoP.value: You can level up your decoration by progressing in the Holiday Oddities event. Once you reach event <color=#4E8EC8>level 30</color>, the decoration is yours to keep!
You can level up your decoration by progressing in the Holiday Oddities event. Once you reach event <color=#4E8EC8>level 35</color>, the decoration is yours to keep!

LDE_HolidayOddities2025_Logs_03_Dialogue.value: I can see you have been working hard!
Or hardly working… Roddy used a wood-splitting machine. I bet those early folks in Hopewell Bay didn’t have one.
Or hardly working... Roddy used a wood-splitting machine. I bet those early folks in Hopewell Bay didn’t have one.

LDE_HolidayOddities2025_Outro_Dialogue_0.value: I cannot thank you enough. You really went above and beyond to give Maddie the most relaxing holiday in years.
I could not have done this on my own. The Mansion looks wonderful, and everything is ready for a celebration.
It’s what friends are for. And we all love Maddie - she’s the best! Right, guys?
Don’t make this weird, Roddy. Come on, hot chocolates are on me!
Hey, guys? Happy holidays! I’m glad I get to spend them with you.

LDE_HolidayOddities2025_SockRW_01_Dialog.value: I think my sock is ready.
Umm, is that a sock or an oven mitt?

LDE_HolidayOddities2025_SockWG_01_Dialog.value: Good job! We have some great socks and some… well, not so great ones.
Good job! We have some great socks and some... well, not so great ones.
I do appreciate your effort, of course. Now they just need to be wrapped and placed under the tree.
We’re on the home stretch now!

LDE_HolidayOddities2025_Sockgr_01_Dialog.value: Look at this. Not too bad, even if I do say so myself.
That sock is perfection, Hank! How did you get so GOOD?

LDE_HolidayOddities2025_SoupAmazing_01_D.value: You’re up, little man. Take the spoon and have a taste.
I’ll have another spoonful - this is delicious!

LDE_HolidayOddities2025_SoupGood_01_Dial.value: I already tried one soup. Someone else can taste this one.
Mason, how about you do it?
Huh! This soup is actually not bad!

LDE_HolidayOddities2025_SoupQuestionable.value: Sooo, who’s going to taste this soup first?
I think Hank has the best palate.
It's true. My palette has all the colors!
Let me get a big spoonful. Here goes! Mmm... this soup… is HORRIBLE.
Let me get a big spoonful. Here goes! Mmm... this soup... is HORRIBLE.

LDE_HolidayOddities2025_StartPopup_Descr.value: Learn about the weirdest holiday traditions in Hopewell Bay with Hank, Mason and Roddy!

LDE_HolidayOddities2025_StickBasket_03_D.value: So like why did you ask us to meet you in the forest?
I called you because we are going to organize a little holiday miracle, and I know you three work well together.
Oh, WOW! How are we going to organize a holiday miracle??
How much do you know about old Hopewell Bay holiday traditions?

LDE_HolidayOddities2025_StickBasket_05_D.value: Tell us about these Hopewell Bay holiday traditions!
Well, in the olden days, people had to make do with whatever they could find. It was traditional to collect natural materials to make beautiful ornaments.
That’s why we’re going to collect acorns, pinecones and walnuts, and paint them gold. Then we will use them to decorate the tree!
Well, off you go! We are not getting any younger.
Hank, you take the basket. After all, you’re the strongest!

LDE_HolidayOddities2025_StickBasket_06_D.value: Tell us about these Hopewell Bay holiday traditions!
Well, in the olden days, people had to make do with whatever they could find. It was traditional to collect natural materials to make beautiful ornaments.
That’s why we’re going to collect acorns, pinecones and walnuts, and paint them gold. Then we will use them to decorate the tree!
Well, off you go! We are not getting any younger.
Hank, you take the basket. After all, you’re the strongest!

LDE_HolidayOddities2025_StickBasket_07_D.value: Wonderful! Now we just need to find the perfect tree!

LDE_HolidayOddities2025_TA2_Dialogue_01.value: Hello, Grandma! I just had the most glorious nap! I feel so totally rested and recharged.

LDE_HolidayOddities2025_TA2_Dialogue_02.value: I am glad to hear it, dearie.

LDE_HolidayOddities2025_TA2_Dialogue_03.value: I think I’m going to start the holiday preparations. We need a tree and the Mansion needs to be decorated, and…
I think I’m going to start the holiday preparations. We need a tree and the Mansion needs to be decorated, and...

LDE_HolidayOddities2025_TA2_Dialogue_04.value: Actually, I think you should go and take a nice bath. I got you some of those lavender bath salts you like so much.

LDE_HolidayOddities2025_TA2_Dialogue_05.value: You did? Well… I guess I could do that. Are you sure?
You did? Well... I guess I could do that. Are you sure?

LDE_HolidayOddities2025_TC1_Dialogue_01.value: Have you already started preparing the food for the holiday dinner?

LDE_HolidayOddities2025_TC1_Dialogue_02.value: I thought I was going to help you.

LDE_HolidayOddities2025_TC1_Dialogue_03.value: I was just making you a little snack. Are you hungry?

LDE_HolidayOddities2025_TC1_Dialogue_04.value: I guess I could have a little something, but--

LDE_HolidayOddities2025_TC1_Dialogue_05.value: Would you like some of my Hopeberry cobbler?

LDE_HolidayOddities2025_TC1_Dialogue_07.value: Oh, is it? I completely forgot…
Oh, is it? I completely forgot...

LDE_HolidayOddities2025_TC3_Dialogue_01.value: What is this?? The tree is up and decorated, there are presents, and there’s even some… Is that soup?
What is this?? The tree is up and decorated, there are presents, and there’s even some... Is that soup?

LDE_HolidayOddities2025_TC3_Dialogue_04.value: Exactly. Did you do all of this?

LDE_HolidayOddities2025_TC3_Dialogue_06.value: Hey, you’ve been grinding non-stop, so we figured you deserve a breather. We got everything handled with Ursula!

LDE_HolidayOddities2025_TC3_Dialogue_07.value: I-I’m speechless. Thank you so much!

LDE_HolidayOddities2025_TC3_Dialogue_08.value: B-but, what’s the time? Am I going crazy, or are all the clocks showing a different time?

LDE_HolidayOddities2025_TaskPlay_Descrip.value: Merge items and discover new decorations!

LDE_HolidayOddities2025_Timepieces_04_Di.value: I found all kinds of clocks already, but I guess sundials and hourglasses don’t really count, right?
I did find this old wristwatch, though.
That’s perfect. Now, you just need to turn it.
It doesn’t matter, as long as it is not showing the actual time.

LDE_HolidayOddities2025_Timepieces_07_Di.value: Will we turn the old longcase clock as well? It feels sort of naughty, like I'm about to get told off…
Will we turn the old longcase clock as well? It feels sort of naughty, like I'm about to get told off...
I am giving you my permission. We will turn them back after the holidays, anyway.

LDE_HolidayOddities2025_Woodchopping_03_.value: In the early days, it was believed that as long as the holiday fire burned, joy would stay in the home.
If it went out before dawn, the spirit of winter would sneak in and steal away the household’s luck.
Yeah! What do we do first?
First, you need to chop some firewood.
You will find all the tools here, in the shed.

LDE_HolidayOddities2025_Woodchopping_06_.value: Did you not see there’s a wood-splitting machine in the shed? Now we’re talking!

LDE_Hopeberry2024_ArtesanFoods_07_Dialog.value: Is it true Julius set you up with his nephew, Herbert?
It is. You could've warned me!!
He never told me he was going to do it!
And you met Dwayne, Pearl's cousin?
I think you should swear off romance for a while, dearie.
There is no use beating a dead horse.

LDE_Hopeberry2024_Ash_04_Dialogue_01.value: I can't be with a man who's flaky or mean...

LDE_Hopeberry2024_Ash_07_Dialogue_01.value: The right guy would put me first... and not be deceitful.

LDE_Hopeberry2024_Ash_07_Dialogue_02.value: Where can I find a guy like this??

LDE_Hopeberry2024_BoardIntro_Dialogue_01.value: How's your love life these days, Maddie?

LDE_Hopeberry2024_BoardIntro_Dialogue_04.value: Have you heard from Emilio? He was such a nice guy!

LDE_Hopeberry2024_BoardIntro_Dialogue_05.value: He was, wasn't he? Is he coming back soon?

LDE_Hopeberry2024_BoardIntro_Dialogue_07.value: Don't wait around for him. Put yourself out there! You'll find another guy in no time!

LDE_Hopeberry2024_BoardIntro_Dialogue_08.value: Or do you need some help? I think I might know just the guy for you...

LDE_Hopeberry2024_BoardIntro_Dialogue_09.value: Oh, me too - I have got the perfect match.

LDE_Hopeberry2024_BoardIntro_Dialogue_10.value: Would you consider going on a blind date?

LDE_Hopeberry2024_CorkThings_07_Dialogue.value: Deb, have you offered Maddie your match-making services?
You cannot blame me, Ursula! In my present situation, I need a distraction...
Fine. But who is this Michael?
He is Hank's brother and a very respectable man. Why have you got your knitting in a twist about it?
Don't you want Maddie to find love?
Of course I do! But unfortunately, she is not the best judge of character...

LDE_Hopeberry2024_CrushedBottle_04_Dialo.value: So what DO you have on your list?
You know - what qualities do you want in the man of your dreams?
I'm not sure... Just the usual stuff, I guess?
It's time you figure it out, girl. If you don't even know what you're looking for, how can you find it?

LDE_Hopeberry2024_CutsceneDialogue1_Dial.value: I bet she's exhausted from being fixed up on all those bad blind dates.
Seems like she finally struck gold, if you ask me!
Who is that Maddie's on a date with?
I think that's Hank's brother. He came for the wedding and Hank introduced them.
I heard he's a pediatric surgeon.
Apparently, he also runs an animal rescue charity in his free time.
AND he was chosen as the most eligible bachelor of the yea---
Okay, okay, I get it. He's P-PERFECT!
No, not at all! J-just glad for her.
Come on - let's get another glass of hopeberry juice...

LDE_Hopeberry2024_EmptyBottles_01_Dialog.value: Are you looking for a date for the Hopeberry Festival?
Yeah, I guess I am, but...
I know you and my cousin would get along like a house on fire!
He's an actor, but he's kinda between gigs, so he's working as a clown at kids' birthday parties.
His name's Dwayne. Or Bungle the Clown!

LDE_Hopeberry2024_ExtendPopup_Header.value: The Love on the Vine event is about to end!

LDE_Hopeberry2024_FestivalJuice_05_Dialo.value: I heard you have been on a string of terrible blind dates.
Does EVERYONE know about my love life?
I am afraid so... But worry not! You can forget all about the cretins you have met so far.
I have the perfect man for you.
No, I mean it. He is perfect.
It seems that I am destined to live without my great love, Hank, but I want to help you find that same happiness.
His name is Michael - he's Hank's brother. He came to town for the wedding but stayed to help me find Hank.
He's a pediatric surgeon - top of his field! He also runs an animal charity.
That ACTUALLY doesn't sound too bad.
I would not deceive you, my dear. He is a CATCH.

LDE_Hopeberry2024_FreshProduce_05_Dialog.value: Why am I so unlucky with guys?
I've been dumped at the altar, passed by, left behind...
Am I just choosing all the wrong men?

LDE_Hopeberry2024_GlassSculpture_04_Dial.value: What kind of a man do I want?
He needs to have a brain.
And a good sense of style.
And he needs to be reliable. This is a BIG one.

LDE_Hopeberry2024_GlassSculpture_08_Dial.value: Do I want a man who's ambitious?
Yes! He needs to have goals and direction!
AND he should be well groomed.

LDE_Hopeberry2024_GlassSculpture_11_Dial.value: I just want a guy who can be nice and reliable, support me and give me freedom.
He needs to like the right movies - and he has to be handy with tools.
I'm not asking for too much, am I??

LDE_Hopeberry2024_HarvestingLoop_Dialogu.value: Rakes can also be produced from this producer. But watch out, if you exhaust it, the item will return to the previous level.

LDE_Hopeberry2024_Herbs_05_Dialogue_01.value: Are you looking forward to the Hopeberry Festival?

LDE_Hopeberry2024_Herbs_05_Dialogue_02.value: Oh, yeah! I wanna get into the big vat to squash the berries! How about you?

LDE_Hopeberry2024_Herbs_05_Dialogue_03.value: I'm already rolling up my pants!

LDE_Hopeberry2024_Herbs_05_Dialogue_04.value: By the way... Maddie's hasn't got a date, so I told her she could come with us...

LDE_Hopeberry2024_Herbs_05_Dialogue_05.value: But she didn't want to be a third wheel.

LDE_Hopeberry2024_Herbs_05_Dialogue_06.value: Besides, she'll probably find a date now that everyone's setting her up on blind dates!

LDE_Hopeberry2024_Hopeberry_04_Dialogue_.value: What's the history of hopeberries, Julius?
They used to say it holds a special magic - it can make people fall in love!
That's why Hopeberry Festival is such a romantic event.

LDE_Hopeberry2024_IntroPopup_Header.value: Can Maddie find her perfect date in time for the Hopeberry Festival?

LDE_Hopeberry2024_Intro_Dialogue_01.value: Are you looking forward to the Hopeberry Festival? They say it's the second most romantic event of the year.

LDE_Hopeberry2024_Intro_Dialogue_02.value: Definitely! I love the harvest season. Are you going with Roddy?

LDE_Hopeberry2024_Intro_Dialogue_03.value: Yep. I can't wait for all the hopeberry juice and delicious food!

LDE_Hopeberry2024_Intro_Dialogue_04.value: I wish I had a date! It's so boring to go to these things solo...

LDE_Hopeberry2024_Intro_Dialogue_06.value: No, I couldn't. I'd just be a third wheel. You kids have a good time!

LDE_Hopeberry2024_Outro_Dialogue_02.value: Somehow I feel like I'm destined to never find love.

LDE_Hopeberry2024_Outro_Dialogue_03.value: You will, dearie, when the time is right.

LDE_Hopeberry2024_ProducedJuice_04_Dialo.value: Did you tell everyone I'm desperate to find a date?
I just said that you're not going with anyone...

LDE_Hopeberry2024_ReusableFurniture_07_D.value: I hope Hank's brother's got some rizz...
I don't think I can take another terrible blind date!
Maddie! Michael is just over there, waiting for you.
Didn't I tell you? He IS a catch!

LDE_Hopeberry2024_ShopProgressionPopup_D.value: Collect Event Points by completing the Love on the Vine event merge tasks and get all the Love on the Vine decoration sets!

LDE_Hopeberry2024_ShopProgressionPopup_H.value: The Love on the Vine Collection

LDE_Hopeberry2024_Spices_05_Dialogue_01.value: Do you have a list of qualities you want in a partner?

LDE_Hopeberry2024_Spices_05_Dialogue_02.value: I'm a realist. Reliable and funny are enough for me.

LDE_Hopeberry2024_Spices_05_Dialogue_04.value: Haha! You know you're great. What is your dream woman like?

LDE_Hopeberry2024_Spices_05_Dialogue_05.value: M-my dream woman? Just like you, of course!

LDE_Hopeberry2024_StartPopup_Description.value: Find out if Maddie finds her perfect date for the annual Hopeberry festival - before the time runs out!

LDE_Hopeberry2024_TA1_Dialogue_01.value: The festival is approaching... and there's no sign of romance.

LDE_Hopeberry2024_TA1_Dialogue_02.value: These blind dates are REALLY bringing me down...

LDE_Hopeberry2024_TA1_Dialogue_03.value: But I don't want to give up! Mr. Right might be just around the corner!

LDE_Hopeberry2024_TA3_Dialogue_01.value: Did you have a good time with Julius' nephew? Was he cool?

LDE_Hopeberry2024_TA3_Dialogue_02.value: Cool? He was... like a younger version of Julius.

LDE_Hopeberry2024_TA3_Dialogue_03.value: He spent most of the evening telling me about his stamp collection.

LDE_Hopeberry2024_TA5_Dialogue_01.value: How was Pearl's cousin? Is he really a clown?

LDE_Hopeberry2024_TA5_Dialogue_03.value: Once I pretended to laugh at one of them, he took it as encouragement and never stopped.

LDE_Hopeberry2024_TA5_Dialogue_05.value: Yep. I think I'm gonna throw in the towel... There are almost NO interesting guys in this town.

LDE_Hopeberry2024_TA5_Dialogue_06.value: Don't lose hope! He might be just around the corner.

LDE_Hopeberry2024_TC1_Dialogue_01.value: How's it going? Deb really came through!

LDE_Hopeberry2024_TC1_Dialogue_02.value: I'm as surprised as you are! After the two other blind dates, I was ready to be disappointed...

LDE_Hopeberry2024_TC1_Dialogue_03.value: I don't want to jinx it, but he really is the perfect guy!

LDE_Hopeberry2024_TC1_Dialogue_04.value: He just had to go answer an urgent phone call - you know, from work.

LDE_Hopeberry2024_TC1_Dialogue_06.value: I really hope so! Maybe there really is some romantic magic in the hopeberries.

LDE_Hopeberry2024_TC3_Dialogue_02.value: Hi, Michael! Where did you go...?

LDE_Hopeberry2024_TC3_Dialogue_04.value: Duty calls, huh? No... It's okay.

LDE_Hopeberry2024_TC3_Dialogue_05.value: I had a great time, too! A-and... Yes, I'd love to see you again!

LDE_Hopeberry2024_TC3_Dialogue_06.value: When can you squeeze me into your busy schedule?

LDE_Hopeberry2024_TC3_Dialogue_08.value: Good luck with your emergency... Bye.

LDE_Hopeberry2024_Vinegar_05_Dialogue_01.value: Maddie, my dear girl. I just heard you're looking for a beau.

LDE_Hopeberry2024_Vinegar_05_Dialogue_03.value: Indeed I did. I think Jackie said you're "desperate to find anyone to go with."

LDE_Hopeberry2024_Vinegar_05_Dialogue_04.value: I'm glad to tell you that you are in luck! My nephew, Herbert, happens to be in town. He's very... er... presentable.

LDE_Hopeberry2024_Vinegar_05_Dialogue_05.value: Do let me arrange a little rendez-vous for you two!

LDE_Hopeberry2024_Vinegar_05_Dialogue_06.value: I guess I have nothing to lose... Ok - you can set it up.

LDE_Hopeberry2025_ArtesanFoods2_Dialogue.value: You did such a great job with the jam again, Grandma.
Thank you, Maddie, but it was all Roddy.
Oh, yes. He made me sit down and took care of everything.

LDE_Hopeberry2025_Ash3_Dialogue_01.value: So which qualities are totally wrong for me?

LDE_Hopeberry2025_Ash3_Dialogue_02.value: I want someone who is honest. I mean, honest with herself, with me and with her friends.

LDE_Hopeberry2025_Ash3_Dialogue_03.value: There has to be trust. Otherwise, there's... no foundation.

LDE_Hopeberry2025_Ash7_Dialogue_01.value: You need to know when to stop.

LDE_Hopeberry2025_Ash7_Dialogue_02.value: Curiosity is good, but it can go too far...

LDE_Hopeberry2025_Ash7_Dialogue_03.value: Everyone has some secrets they want to keep just to themselves. I can't be with a person who makes it their mission to dig them up.

LDE_Hopeberry2025_BoardIntro_Dialogue_01.value: Maybe I should find something to do to take my mind off my break-up with Jackie. It was intense!

LDE_Hopeberry2025_BoardIntro_Dialogue_02.value: But I could also really use some time alone, to figure things out and get my head straight...

LDE_Hopeberry2025_BoardIntro_Dialogue_04.value: Err, I guess not... What's up, Pearl?

LDE_Hopeberry2025_BoardIntro_Dialogue_05.value: Could you do me a favor and help me with some of the tables and chairs for the festival? I've got so much to do!

LDE_Hopeberry2025_BoardIntro_Dialogue_07.value: Thank you, Roddy! You're a darling!

LDE_Hopeberry2025_CorkThings2_Dialogue_0.value: Roddy's been pretty busy - helping everyone with their problems.
He and Jackie just broke up, and I know he's been pretty torn up about that, too.
I always knew he's a good guy, but maybe I didn't really appreciate him enough.
He really is one in a million!

LDE_Hopeberry2025_CrushedBottles5_Dialog.value: Jackie knew exactly what she wants. Her vision was so clear that I didn't think about myself at all.
Was Jackie wrong for me, or was I wrong for her?
Oh, who knows... I need a vision of my own.
I wish I had confidence, like Emilio, and determination, like Bella.
I wish I had Jackie's ambition and Hank's optimism.
Even Mason has everything figured out better than me.

LDE_Hopeberry2025_ExtendPopup_Header.value: The Love on the Vine event is about to end!

LDE_Hopeberry2025_FestivalJuice1_Dialogu.value: Hey, Julius! You've done a great job with the produce stall this year!
Oh, I cannot take the credit for that. It was Roddy who carried the boxes and set everything up.
He is a very nice young man, Maddie. Always ready to help!

LDE_Hopeberry2025_FreshProduce6_Dialogue.value: I was looking for a distraction, but maybe I overdid it.
Let's see. I have to carry the tables and chairs, then collect the harvesting tools. And then there's juicing the berries...
OK, I think I can do it all - but that's it. Then I'm out of here.
Do you have a moment, perhaps, to help an old man?
Just someone to move some of the boxes of produce.

LDE_Hopeberry2025_GlassSculpture11_Dialo.value: Can there really be someone who would have all of these qualities?
One person who could really make me happy?
I think it's time I'm totally honest with myself.
But can I be totally honest with her?

LDE_Hopeberry2025_GlassSculpture3_Dialog.value: What kind of a person am I looking for?
Do I even have an ideal woman?
Hank is right, though. I do know what I don't want.
I don't think I want someone who takes everything too seriously.
She should be playful and silly, even.

LDE_Hopeberry2025_GlassSculpture8_Dialog.value: This one is a dealbreaker. She has to like camping.
Jackie wouldn't even look at my premium tent, let alone get into it.

LDE_Hopeberry2025_HarvestingTools5_Dialo.value: I'm trying to get all these tools organized for the Hopeberry harvest, but they're all over the place! I guess no one organized them last year.
I promised to help with the festival since Grandma twisted her ankle, and now time's running out.
I-is there something I can help with?
Of course. Just tell me what to do.

LDE_Hopeberry2025_Herbs6_Dialogue_01.value: Oh, man! I'm still one performer short for the Hopeberry Festival.

LDE_Hopeberry2025_Herbs6_Dialogue_02.value: What kind of performance is it?

LDE_Hopeberry2025_Herbs6_Dialogue_07.value: I think so. You wouldn't be interested in flexing your comedy muscles, would you?

LDE_Hopeberry2025_Herbs6_Dialogue_11.value: At this point, I don't care. Will you do it?

LDE_Hopeberry2025_Hopeberry4_Dialogue_01.value: Ursula, are you OK? Maddie told me you hurt your ankle.

LDE_Hopeberry2025_Hopeberry4_Dialogue_02.value: Oh, I am perfectly fine! She is just fussing. As you can see, I can wal-- OUCH!

LDE_Hopeberry2025_Hopeberry4_Dialogue_03.value: You need to get off that ankle and get some rest!

LDE_Hopeberry2025_Hopeberry4_Dialogue_04.value: There's too much to do. Who's going to juice the berries?

LDE_Hopeberry2025_Hopeberry4_Dialogue_07.value: Yeeeeah, I think so. Yes. I'll do it!

LDE_Hopeberry2025_Hopeberry4_Dialogue_08.value: Now you go and rest that foot!

LDE_Hopeberry2025_Hopeberry4_Dialogue_10.value: I mean, please rest your foot, Ursula.

LDE_Hopeberry2025_IntroPopup_Description.value: Love is a tough nut to crack, especially to some people - like Roddy. With the annual Hopeberry Festival approaching, he tries to figure out what it is that he REALLY wants in a relationship and in life, while helping his friends get everything ready for the big celebration.

LDE_Hopeberry2025_IntroPopup_Header.value: Join Roddy on a rocky journey to self-discovery!

LDE_Hopeberry2025_Intro_Dialogue_01.value: I can't believe it's already time for the annual Hopeberry festival!

LDE_Hopeberry2025_Intro_Dialogue_02.value: It's my favorite celebration of the whole year, hands down.

LDE_Hopeberry2025_Intro_Dialogue_03.value: This year will be pretty different though - now that I'm not with Jackie anymore.

LDE_Hopeberry2025_Intro_Dialogue_04.value: This break-up has been way worse than I expected...

LDE_Hopeberry2025_Intro_Dialogue_05.value: A glass of fresh hopeberry juice is just what I need right now. Onwards and upwards!

LDE_Hopeberry2025_LayeredDecoInfoPopup_D.value:
You can level up your decoration by progressing in the event! 

Once you level the decoration over level 25, it is yours to keep forever!

LDE_Hopeberry2025_Outro_Dialogue_01.value: Hey, Roddy! I just wanted to thank you for all of your help with the Hopeberry Festival.

LDE_Hopeberry2025_Outro_Dialogue_02.value: I don't know what I would've done without you.

LDE_Hopeberry2025_Outro_Dialogue_05.value: Listen, Maddie... There's something I wanted to talk to you about.

LDE_Hopeberry2025_Outro_Dialogue_08.value: Well, it's just that... I wanted to say... that your Hopeberry juice was great.

LDE_Hopeberry2025_Outro_Dialogue_09.value: Oh, thank you! Your stand-up set wasn't half bad, either!

LDE_Hopeberry2025_Outro_Dialogue_10.value: Well, see you around, I guess.

LDE_Hopeberry2025_ProducedJuice5_Dialogu.value: I heard about your and Jackie's break-up. That's tough, man.
OK, I think. The whole thing was pretty amicable, anyway.
Relationships are hard - even when everything is good.
Sometimes I wonder if I should just be alone, you know.
The way I see it, sometimes you're emotionally bench pressing on a leg curl machine.
And you will drop a dumbbell on your toes sometimes.
But you gotta keep going. Like the ancient wisdom goes: No pain, no gain.

LDE_Hopeberry2025_ReusableFurniture1_Dia.value: What did you think about Roddy's stand-up set?
I admit I was nervous for him, but he was actually good!
I know! His jokes about wearing a helmet all the time cracked me up!
I didn't know he even wanted to do stand-up.
He didn't! He only offered to do it because I was one performer short.
He did me a big favor!
I think he did a lot more than we realize.

LDE_Hopeberry2025_Spices6_Dialogue_01.value: Hey! Did you get tricked into helping with the Festival, too?

LDE_Hopeberry2025_Spices6_Dialogue_03.value: Then you're a better man than me! There's a BIG match on TV today, and I tried every trick in the book to get away - but here I am!

LDE_Hopeberry2025_Spices6_Dialogue_04.value: I just want to help when I can. There's a lot to do with the Hopeberry Festival.

LDE_Hopeberry2025_Spices6_Dialogue_05.value: You're too nice, man! I know you wanted to see that match, too.

LDE_Hopeberry2025_Spices6_Dialogue_06.value: Yeah, but what if someone needs help?

LDE_Hopeberry2025_StartPopup_Description.value: Join Roddy, the nicest guy in Hopewell Bay, on a journey to self-discovery, while the town prepares for the annual Hopeberry Festival!

LDE_Hopeberry2025_TA1_Dialogue_02.value: You know - trying to keep busy and keep my mind off the break-up.

LDE_Hopeberry2025_TA1_Dialogue_03.value: Can I ask you, why did you break up with Roddy?

LDE_Hopeberry2025_TA1_Dialogue_04.value: It's a long story, but I don't think he was ever really in it for us. His mind was elsewhere.

LDE_Hopeberry2025_TC1_Dialogue_01.value: Are you looking to start dating again? I know a couple of nice single ladies I could set you up with...

LDE_Hopeberry2025_TC1_Dialogue_03.value: Besides, I don't even know what I'm looking for in a relationship.

LDE_Hopeberry2025_TC1_Dialogue_04.value: At least you know what you DON'T want, right?

LDE_Hopeberry2025_TC1_Dialogue_05.value: You're a total catch, my friend. It's time you give yourself credit for what a nice guy you are and realize what you DO want.

LDE_Hopeberry2025_TC1_Dialogue_06.value: Maybe she's right under your nose.

LDE_Hopeberry2025_Vinegar5_Dialogue_01.value: Is Hank right? Am I too nice? Should I be more selfish?

LDE_Hopeberry2025_Vinegar5_Dialogue_03.value: I want to help other people, and, OK, sometimes it's pretty hard to say no.

LDE_Hopeberry2025_Vinegar5_Dialogue_04.value: I really care about Jackie and I wanted to support her with her career and everything, but... should I have been concentrating on myself?

LDE_Hopeberry2025_Vinegar5_Dialogue_05.value: What is it that I ACTUALLY want - in relationships or life?

LDE_Hopeberry2025_Vinegar5_Dialogue_06.value: OK, the evidence would suggest that I have some work to do with myself.

LDE_MurderAtTheMansion_B2_C_Dialogue_01.value: I feel like there's something staring us right in the face. But what??

LDE_MurderAtTheMansion_B2_C_Dialogue_02.value: You tell me. Should I consult the tea leaves again?

LDE_MurderAtTheMansion_B2_C_Dialogue_03.value: Are you sure you can drink ANOTHER cup of tea?

LDE_MurderAtTheMansion_B2_C_Dialogue_04.value: Yeah, maybe not. Let's go back to Lady Voyance's house and review the timeline one more time.

LDE_MurderAtTheMansion_B2_C_Dialogue_05.value: In the morning, I came round to help her with some painting. At that time, she was alive and well.

LDE_MurderAtTheMansion_B2_C_Dialogue_06.value: Emilio stopped by to bring her cat the fish treats, but didn't stay. Everything was still fine.

LDE_MurderAtTheMansion_B2_C_Dialogue_07.value: Bella came for a reading and left angry, but Voyance was fine.

LDE_MurderAtTheMansion_B2_C_Dialogue_08.value: And we don't know of anyone else coming to the house on that day.

LDE_MurderAtTheMansion_B2_C_Dialogue_09.value: No, apart from the mailman. And he didn't have any motive to kill her.

LDE_MurderAtTheMansion_B2_C_Dialogue_10.value: Agreed. So what are we missing?

LDE_MurderAtTheMansion_BoardIntro_Dialog.value: What on earth has happened here?
Do you think she had some terrible accident? Maybe she got knocked out by her snow globe or something?
Something definitely doesn’t feel right. This isn’t just an accident. This is… a murder!
A-are you sure? Why would anyone want to kill Lady Voyance?
That’s what we’re going to find out.

LDE_MurderAtTheMansion_C3_Dialogue_01.value: How is your investigation going? I thought you must be hungry by now, so I've brought you some apple pie fresh from the oven!

LDE_MurderAtTheMansion_C3_Dialogue_03.value: We are so close, but a piece seems to be missing. A lot of people had a potential motive, but everyone we interviewed had an alibi.

LDE_MurderAtTheMansion_C3_Dialogue_04.value: The only other person who came by her house that day was the mailman. Apparently, a package addressed to you was mistakenly delivered to her house.

LDE_MurderAtTheMansion_C3_Dialogue_05.value: Very mysterious. Wait, did you say a package was delivered? Let me see the photos of the crime scene again!

LDE_MurderAtTheMansion_C3_Dialogue_06.value: Sure, but I'm not sure you'll find anything there. We've combed through them so many times.

LDE_MurderAtTheMansion_C3_Dialogue_07.value: The position of the body, the coloration of the skin...

LDE_MurderAtTheMansion_C3_Dialogue_08.value: And the package was stamped in... *Sigh* It's not the first time I've encountered this.

LDE_MurderAtTheMansion_C3_Dialogue_10.value: Lady Voyance was always curious to a fault, but this time she stuck her nose in the wrong place. She was killed by a poison, delivered in that package.

LDE_MurderAtTheMansion_C3_Dialogue_11.value: The package that was addressed to... you??

LDE_MurderAtTheMansion_C3_Dialogue_12.value: I am afraid so. There are people who wish me ill, and this time Lady Voyance happened to be in the wrong place at the wrong time.

LDE_MurderAtTheMansion_C3_Dialogue_14.value: That, I am afraid, is classified. It wouldn't be safe to you or anyone here to know.

LDE_MurderAtTheMansion_C3_Dialogue_16.value: Now help yourselves to some apple pie before it gets cold! I have a phone call to make.

LDE_MurderAtTheMansion_CatClues3_Dialogu.value: Hang on... There are paw prints everywhere.
Of course! Voyance's cat saw everything! What is it trying to show us?

LDE_MurderAtTheMansion_CatClues5_Dialogu.value: Take a look at this fish treats. They were made in Bolivia.
Well, that would point to... Emilio!

LDE_MurderAtTheMansion_DNAEvidence2_Dial.value: It would seem that Lady Voyance had a lot of visitors lately.
There are fingerprints from eight different individuals, including the two of us. The killer must be among them.
This is starting to get a little bit too real...

LDE_MurderAtTheMansion_DNAEvidence6_Dial.value: There's one inconclusive print. What IS that??
Wait, that looks like a paw print.
Are you saying that Voyance’s cat is a… person of interest?
We have to consider all alternatives, however unlikely.

LDE_MurderAtTheMansion_DNAKit4_Dialogue_.value: Voyance's house is full of weird stuff.
It'll be hard to tell what has meaning here and what doesn't.
Collecting DNA samples is the only way to find out.

LDE_MurderAtTheMansion_DNAKit7_Dialogue_.value: She had a lot of visitors who came to have their fortunes told.
Therefore there must be a lot of fingerprints, too!
Huh, the love potion. She was still up to her old tricks.

LDE_MurderAtTheMansion_DNAKitActive1_Dia.value: The results of the DNA tests will be coming in soon. Modern forensic science is amazing!
I wonder if we can see something the police missed?
The police were in too much of a hurry to rule it out as an accidental death. There's more to this case than that.

LDE_MurderAtTheMansion_DetectiveTools5_D.value: I’m used to digging around for the truth, but this is a whole different ball game. We need to make a note of every detail.
Anything here could tell us something about what happened and why. We need to find the murder weapon and even the tiniest clues about who has been here - even a possible motive!
I can’t believe this has happened! I was just here earlier!
In the morning. I was fixing some stuff up for her around the house. Some of Ursula’s mail had also been delivered to her by mistake.
Everything seemed totally normal then. Why are you looking at me like that?
You don’t have any reason to wish her ill, do you?
Fine… So we know the murder happened sometime during the afternoon.
Come on - it’s time to investigate!

LDE_MurderAtTheMansion_DirtPatch4_Dialog.value: Jackie! There is something buried in here!
An old chest... Seems like this town has old chests buried all over the place.
Now, how do we open this thing?

LDE_MurderAtTheMansion_ExtendPopup_Descr.value: The Murder at the Mansion event has ended. Event Merge Board and Merge Tasks will now be closed.

LDE_MurderAtTheMansion_ExtendPopup_Heade.value: The Murder at the Mansion event is about to end!

LDE_MurderAtTheMansion_GardenPlants4_Dia.value: There could be clues in the garden, too. The killer had to pass through it at some point.
It would be the perfect place if you wanted to hide something...
You can bury a lot of secrets in a garden.

LDE_MurderAtTheMansion_GardenTools3_Dial.value: OK, here we go. I guess I just... Hmmm...
How DO you consult the universe? Do I just ask a question? Or look for the vibes?

LDE_MurderAtTheMansion_IncriminatingEvid.value: Lady Voyance had strong ties to the Boultons and the Mansion.
She probably knew more than most about what REALLY went on there.
Hmmm... This deserves a closer look!
Looks like Voyance had a very clear idea of who should get all of her wealth and fortune.
And that someone is... Maddie Boulton!
Did she know that she's the beneficiary of Voyance's will? I can't believe she did.
That would be a powerful motive.

LDE_MurderAtTheMansion_InfoPanel_Descrip.value: The Murder at the Mansion event has started! Complete Event Merge Tasks and earn Event Points.

LDE_MurderAtTheMansion_Interviews10_Dial.value: So, Maddie. Where were you when you found out about Lady Voyance's death?
I was at home, as you know. We were waiting for her to arrive for bridge night, but she was late. That was highly unusual, so I asked you to check on her and...
Well, I think you know the rest.
Did you know she had a will?
I didn't, no. Is there something weird about it?
Only that you stand to inherit everything. Her house, her snow globes... Even her cat.
What?? I had no idea! You have to believe me! I already have a house... a-and pets! And I don't know the first thing about snow globes.
Lady Voyance was my friend, and her death is a shocking loss to the whole town.

LDE_MurderAtTheMansion_Interviews3_Dialo.value: Next we need to talk everyone who saw her on that last day.
Next we need to talk with everyone who saw her on that last day.
Do you think they will talk?
It’s unlikely we’ll get a confession, but someone will slip.

LDE_MurderAtTheMansion_Interviews4_Dialo.value: So, Ursula... What was your relationship with Lady Voyance like?
She was my dear friend, and you know that I would NEVER have done anything to hurt her.
Are you absolutely sure about that?
Then why did we find your knife buried in the rose bush in her garden?
My knife? Ooooh! She borrowed it to do some trimming in her garden - 15 years ago! Examine the knife more carefully, and you'll find I'm telling the truth.
I see... Where were you in the afternoon on that day?
I was at home, making canapés for bridge night. Julius was with me, telling me about a new book about the birds of the Amazon.

LDE_MurderAtTheMansion_Interviews5_Dialo.value: Bella, did you ever happen to visit Lady Voyance for... a reading or to hear your fortune?
Pfft, I visited her ONCE - just this week - but her prediction was nonsense! She implied that I have a habit of suffocating... Whatever.
Mad? Yes! I threw that stupid star chart away, and I gave her a terrible review online. But I wasn't mad enough to kill the poor woman!
Where were you on that afternoon, by the way?
Oh, I was shoe-shopping with Emilio. He has the best taste!

LDE_MurderAtTheMansion_Interviews6_Dialo.value: Hank, how well did you know Lady Voyance?
We were friends, I guess. I helped her out sometimes - you know, heavy lifting and stuff.
She returned the favor by telling my fortune. She was super connected to the cosmos!  I can't believe she's gone.
Me neither. She was a lovely lady. So kind and--
Oh, right. What do you know about poison, Hank?
Not a lot. Oh, yeah! I got some ant poison for Lady Voyance. She had a real bad infestation in her kitchen. Why do you ask?
Just dotting all the I's and crossing all the T's. Where were you on that afternoon?
I was playing tennis with Deb. It's really fun, but I just can't hit that tiny ball!

LDE_MurderAtTheMansion_Interviews7_Dialo.value: Can you confirm that this candlestick is from your antique shop, Julius?
Oh, yes! A lovely piece, too. Lady Voyance ordered it for her study.
So you didn't use it to...
Never mind. Where were you on that afternoon?
Ahem, I was at Ursula's house. I had just bought a new book about the birds of the Amazon. Let me tell you about--
Thank you, Julius, but it'll have to wait. We still have work to do!

LDE_MurderAtTheMansion_Interviews8_Dialo.value: What is going on? Is it really true that Lady Voyance has... passed away?
Unfortunately, yes. Did you happen to visit her house in the afternoon of the killing?
Killing? How terrible... Did I visit? Umm... yes, I did.
I had brought some fish treats for her cat from Bolivia. I stopped by her house to deliver them, but she was - *gulp* - alive then.
Did you see anything out of the ordinary?
No... She had just had a package delivered, and she seemed quite preoccupied with something, but... she was totally fine.
One more question: Where were you in the afternoon?
I was shopping with Bella. She is very thorough, so we spent quite a long time at the shoe shop. She can confirm this - she has the shoes to prove it.

LDE_MurderAtTheMansion_Interviews9_Dialo.value: I think we can rule out Lady Voyance's cat as a suspect. Clearly the cat knows what happened, but she loved Voyance.
You're probably right. Let's take a closer look at everything she's tried to show us. I've got a feeling we might find something there...

LDE_MurderAtTheMansion_IntroPopup_Descri.value: A crime most foul has occurred in Hopewell Bay, causing a shock and a great deal of suspicion. With few clues and a senseless crime in their hands, Jackie and Roddy begin an investigation to find out... who killed Lady Voyance?

LDE_MurderAtTheMansion_Intro_C_Dialogue_.value: The cards are shuffled and the snacks are ready. When can we start our bridge night? Is everyone here?
Jackie said she was running late, and we seem to be missing Lady Voyance.
That’s odd. She’s never late for bridge. Something must be wrong! I think I’ll call Jackie and ask to check in at her house on her way.
Hey, Maddie! What’s up? Roddy and I are just on our way to your house.
Great! But could you do me a favor? We’re still missing Lady Voyance...
She’s never late for bridge night!
Exactly! Could you stop by at her house to see if she’s there. Maybe she’s been delayed by a tricky reading.
Let's see what's holding up Lady Voyance! Hello? Is there anyone home?
J-jackie, the door is open. Something doesn’t feel right.

LDE_MurderAtTheMansion_Knife1_Dialogue_0.value: I think someone has been here. There's a knife hidden in the flowerbed!
So there is. And I remember seeing this in Ursula's kitchen.
I think we have our first suspect.

LDE_MurderAtTheMansion_LayeredDecoInfoPo.value: You can level up your decoration by progressing in the Murder at the Mansion event. Once you reach event <color=#4E8EC8>level 35</color>, the decoration is yours to keep!

LDE_MurderAtTheMansion_MWCandlestick1_Di.value: Look what I found under the sofa! This thing has red paint all over it.
There's a label at the bottom. It's from Julius' antique store!
But why would he want to hurt Voyance?
I always thought there's more to the old man than meets the eye.

LDE_MurderAtTheMansion_MWPoison1_Dialogu.value: Roddy, look at this! The label reads pretty ominous to me.
Voyance was known for making potions, but she wouldn't have used poison.
That means that this came into her house through someone else. But WHO? And did this poison kill her?
According to the fingerprint analysis, this bottle belongs to... Hank!

LDE_MurderAtTheMansion_MWYarn1_Dialogue_.value: How did this yarn end up here, all unraveled?
Someone could have used it as a murder weapon.
All I'm saying is that we have to put the pieces together - however they fit.

LDE_MurderAtTheMansion_OpenBriefcase1_Di.value: The briefcase is finally open. What's this...? Voyance's Last Will and Testament!
She had way more assets than I ever realized - a house, a caravan, her snow globe business...

LDE_MurderAtTheMansion_Outro_Dialogue_02.value: An international assassin who bears a grudge against Ursula.

LDE_MurderAtTheMansion_Outro_Dialogue_05.value: What will you do with your inheritance from Lady Voyance?

LDE_MurderAtTheMansion_Outro_Dialogue_06.value: I have no idea! Maybe I'll let you continue her snow globe business. Seems like you have a talent for the supernatural.

LDE_MurderAtTheMansion_Outro_Dialogue_07.value: I'm not so sure about that. There will never be anyone like Lady Voyance!

LDE_MurderAtTheMansion_SeanceTools3_Dial.value: Something fishy definitely happened here, but how are we ever going to find out what? We have so many clues and so much potential evidence.
We follow up on everything and rule out the wrong options until we have the answer.
I’m not sure that kind of investigation alone is going to get us closer to the answer.
I’m talking about the COSMIC investigation.

LDE_MurderAtTheMansion_SeanceTools5_Dial.value: You know, a lot of investigators use psychics to break difficult cases.
You do know that you're not a psychic, Roddy?
Of course, but we have all of Voyance's tools right here... Maybe the tea leaves, cards, and Ouija board could tell us something.
You consult the material facts, I'll consult the stars!

LDE_MurderAtTheMansion_StarCharts3_Dialo.value: Hmm... I think I found something, Jackie. A bunched-up paper with writing and some drawings on it.
It says: "According to the stars, many will adore you. According to your heart, this is a promising start."
There's more: “The universe advises that your great love dreams not of escape, but of breathing room.”
Uh-uh, that's Bella alright. She would not have been happy to read this.
Uh-huh, that's Bella alright. She would not have been happy to read this.

LDE_MurderAtTheMansion_TA1_Dialogue_01.value: So this is where it happened.

LDE_MurderAtTheMansion_TA1_Dialogue_02.value: Poor Lady Voyance! She must have been terrified.

LDE_MurderAtTheMansion_TA1_Dialogue_03.value: I guess the real question is whether she already knew this was going to happen.

LDE_MurderAtTheMansion_TA1_Dialogue_04.value: If she did, maybe she left us some clues to lead us towards the right answer.

LDE_MurderAtTheMansion_TA1_Dialogue_05.value: Well, let's see what we can find!

LDE_MurderAtTheMansion_TagSinkFTUE_Descr.value: Drag any Murder Weapons into a DNA Kit to get DNA Evidence. Rarer Murder Weapons will produce more DNA Evidence.

LDE_MurderAtTheMansion_TaskPlay_Descript.value: Merge items and discover new decorations!

LDE_MurderAtTheMansion_UnfortunateEvents.value: Nnngh, I will look behind the veil of fate. What will the stars tell meeeee?
Tell me something, stars! What happened at this house?
The place is full of weird signs... A broken mirror brings seven years of bad luck.
Voyance would have known that something was on the way!
Spilled paint next to a step ladder? She didn't walk under the ladder, did she?
The stars tell me that it would've been most unfortunate.
The universe really had it out for her. But if she didn't meet a bloody end, it came some other way...

LDE_MurderAtTheMansion_VoyancesBelonging.value: She sure was a strange lady.
I can't say I ever believed any of her "predictions", but I know other people did.
And people told her all sorts of secrets. I wonder if one of them sealed her fate.

LDE_MurderAtTheMansion_v2_IntroPopup_Des.value: A crime most foul has occurred in Hopewell Bay, causing a shock and a great deal of suspicion. With few clues and a senseless crime in their hands, Jackie and Roddy begin an investigation to find out... who killed Lady Voyance?

LDE_MurderAtTheMansion_v2_StartPopup_Des.value: A crime most foul has occurred in Hopewell Bay. Join the investigation and find out who has something on their conscience!

LDE_PicnicConfusion2023_Activitieschain_.value: There's so many fun things to do during a picnic!
Good thing I found this old instant camera to remember them by!

LDE_PicnicConfusion2023_AllRewardsComple.value: I know this wasn't the original idea, but I have to call it a success!
Well... I was still hoping for something a bit more intimate.
Cheer up, Julius! This was a wonderful surprise nonetheless!
I agree! And Roddy... It was really nice of you to help Julius out with this!
Oh! I... Uhhh, well I sort of wanted us to have a picnic too.

LDE_PicnicConfusion2023_Boardintro_Dialo.value: This is going to be great! Just us four having a cozy little picnic.
Thank you again, Roddy, for letting me join you. I know that you originally meant to have this alone with Maddie.
Don't worry about it, Julius. Besides, the more the merrier right?!
Right! Let's get everything ready and then meet them at the estate!

LDE_PicnicConfusion2023_Clothingchain_Di.value: I think we should have a whole picnic table set up for them, before they arrive!
Well, if that's the case, I'll go get the cutlery.
Good idea, I'll grab the food for it!

LDE_PicnicConfusion2023_Coalchain_Dialog.value: Holy smokes, that thing must be expensive!
It's a paste necklace, but still quite valuable. I've been holding on to it for quite some time...
You... Thinking of giving that to Ursula?

LDE_PicnicConfusion2023_EventIntro_Dialo.value: Grandma! Why is this old rusty truck parked outside our home?!
Didn't you hear, dearie? There's going to be a huge picnic soon.
I don't know actually, but I was told it was going to be a surpise and lots of people are going to attend.
Is this busted up hunk of junk a... Food truck?
It is! My old one. And we're going to fix it up as good as new!
You used to own a food truck?!
Oh dearie, why do things always come as such a surprise to you?
Come on then! We need it up and running before the health inspectors catch a glimpse of it and take her away!

LDE_PicnicConfusion2023_Firewoodchain_Di.value: I guess a small campfire wouldn't hurt, would it Julius?
But we got a hamper full of food!
Yeah, but for roasting marshmallows and cozying up next to the fire in a blanket!
You mean cozying up next to someone by the fire...

LDE_PicnicConfusion2023_IntroPopup_Descr.value: Hearing about the huge surprise picnic, Grandma and Maddie know that the only solution to feed all the people is to use a food truck. Fortunately, Grandma has one stored in the backyard. Unfortunately, it’s in terrible shape. So it’s time to fix it up, slap on a fresh coat of paint and get ready for a very confusing picnic!

LDE_PicnicConfusion2023_IntroPopup_Heade.value: Get ready for a really confusing picnic!

LDE_PicnicConfusion2023_Layerdecoration_.value: There! At least it's in working order again.
I didn't know you could fix a car, dearie?!
Look who's surprised now!
Mind you, I wasn't expecting to apply my engineering degree in fixing up a rusted old food truck...
You're right! We should probably give her a shiny new coat of paint!
Good idea!
I still think we should have gone with yellow...
We don't want people to think it's an ambulance, now do we?
Oh alright...
Besides, blue is such an inviting color!
Looks like the restaurant window still works!
Ha! I guess I owe your grandfather ten bucks...
How come?
He cut that window in, himself. I said it looked flimsy, but he protested and said, "Nonsense, this thing will outlast us!"
I guess Boulton's make things to last!
That we do, dearie!
What's a picnic without a rug!
Do you think all the people will fit on that?
Do you actually know how many people are actually going to come to this picnic?
No... But I guess it might be good idea to get more seats?
And maybe sign to show people where to come?
Helloo? Hello?!
Hmmm... Perhaps we're early.
...Is that a food truck?
I design buildings, not cars! You sure you we were suppose to meet here?
Yes! I asked Pearl's boy, whatshisname... To tell Maddie and Ursula to join us here for a picnic.
You asked Mason?! Oh boy... You don't think he might have misheard you?
Come to think of it, the boy did seem a bit unworldly. Maybe it is best we find him.
Hmm... We're probably going to need more than this.
At least we have some seats for those who want to eat at the counter.
Thats right! What about the food?!
Don't worry dearie, I have that all sorted out!
I admit, I'm surprised we're not serving pies from the food truck!
I'm not a one trick pony, you know. I can make plenty of other delicious things.
Pies are just a handy way to get rid of any... Leftovers.
Why'd you say it like that? Leftovers...
Whatever do you mean, dearie?
It's just... Nevermind.
A ha! Back at the scene of the crime!
Wh- What?
We got you kid, there's nowhere to run now!
But... I didn't do anything!
Remember when I asked you to leave a message to Ursula and Maddie?
Uuhm... Yeah?
What exactly did you say to them, young man?
Julius?!
Ursula!
Roddy?!
M- Maddie!
What is going on here?!
Alright boys, out with it!
Yeah, where is everyone?
Oh boy... We're sorry, but I think there's been a huge misunderstanding!
All I wanted was for us to have a nice little picnic together...
But how come you wanted a food truck?!
Yeah! You told me to tell them to bring the food truck down as there'll be a surprise picnic for everyone!
Ah... I believe what I said was, We will bring the food and they can truck on down to a surprise picnic for all of us.
Oh... That's right! Sorry, Mrs. Boulton!
Ha! That's alright, dearie.
So what do we do now?
What do you think? Have a picnic of course!
With a food truck? Isn't that a bit excessive for four people?
Nonsense! That's why we invite everyone else!
That's right, stick to the original plan!
But... It was original meant to be just us.
That's good Roddy! Make sure those flags are really high!
Yes, ma'am!
Oh please, dearie! Call me Grandma!
Yes, ma'am! Erhm... Grandma!
Is everything alright, Julius?
Yes, it's alright. I was just hoping that this would have been more of a quiet affair. For Ursula, I mean.
Oh, I wouldn't worry about her. She's having the time of her life.
Thanks to you...
Really? Thank you, Maddie!
Well, I think we're about done!
Looks like you can serve the whole of Hopewell Bay now, incredible!
I guess that's the idea.
You really do go all out when you put your mind to it.
That's what us Boulton Girls do!
Boulton Girls... Ha! I like that!
Wow! Who did the decal work?
Julius! He's a wonder with a paintbrush!
I'm impressed!
That bagel sure looks delicious.
Thank you! I found some leftover parade balloons in my shop.
What can't be found in there?

LDE_PicnicConfusion2024_Activities_05_Di.value: Make sure you have some fun things to do during the picnic!
You don't want Roddy to get bored, do you? ...What do you think she does?

LDE_PicnicConfusion2024_BoardIntro_Dialo.value: Maddie! I'm sorry, I didn't mean to get you upset. Look, I'm heading out with Roddy and-
Don't worry! I'm fiiiine. Hey, How ARE things with Roddy, anyway?
Good... awesome, he's all the time surprising me with-
Heey! I got a great idea! You should throw a surprise for him! Ooh ooh, I can help you!
Uuh, Maddie, you don't have to-
No no, this'll be great! He always tried to surprise me, so let's make one for him!

LDE_PicnicConfusion2024_Clothing_07_Dial.value: Ah perfect, we have a great picnic table ready!
All it needs now is some good food and some cutlery!
...How do you think he met her?

LDE_PicnicConfusion2024_Coal_05_Dialogue.value: Don't forget to save some of the coal. I've seen Roddy do some charcoal sketching every now and then.
Sure, they're not like the stuff you can get in the art store, but it's the thought that counts.
You want me to give him.... Coal?

LDE_PicnicConfusion2024_FireWood_07_Dial.value: Nothing like a nice romantic fire to liven up the picnic, right?
Right?! Emilio never liked campfires, did you know that? Something about its dangers...
Ha! I actually think he never learned how to light one! But don't worry about Roddy.
He's lit every fire he's set his eyes on!

LDE_PicnicConfusion2024_IntroCutscene_Di.value: Jackie! Great to see you, what's up?
Just coming over to see how you're doing? You know... after what happened.
Jackie... I'm totally fine! I'm over Emilio. Honest!
Phew. That's good! I thought that photo of him would've really done a number on you.
The one he posted on his social me- Uh oh!
*sigh* No, it's alright. I've also started dating again, so it's okay for him to find someone else...
I mean... look at her! She looks lovely!

LDE_PicnicConfusion2024_IntroPopup_Descr.value: Still reeling from her breakup with Emilio, Maddie is doing her best to move on. To make matters worse, she discovers some surprising new details of Emilio’s time in Bolivia! However, it’s not all bad news. Her best friends, Jackie and Roddy, are really hitting it off together! Maybe she could help them! Yeah, that’ll keep her mind off things!

LDE_PicnicConfusion2024_IntroPopup_Heade.value: Can Maddie finally get over Emilio and help Jackie impress Roddy?

LDE_PicnicConfusion2024_Marshmallow_11_D.value: ... I mean honestly, he is TOTALLY free to do what he wants. We're both adults after all!
But isn't it just a little weird that he breaks up with me; moves ALL THE WAY over there and then SUDDENLY meets this OTHER woman?
Maddie, I really think you sho-
I mean look at her! She's gorgeous! I can't compete with THAT! Do you think she's an ex?
... Or... Oh no... Was he still together with her when he was here? Was I... the OTHER woman?!

LDE_PicnicConfusion2024_Outro_Dialogue_0.value: Oh boy! I... I wasn't expecting this at all!
To be honest, neither was I...
Like it?! I LOVE IT! I love food almost as much as architecture!
Hey, Jackie? I just wanted to apologize...
And say that you're right! I think I am jealous. And I guess I might have taken it out on you.
So, I'm going to make it a personal priority of mine to move on! ... And maybe take up yoga, or something...
Haha! It's alright Maddie. Just don't get manic again. You scare me when you get... excited.

LDE_PicnicConfusion2024_PhotoAlbum_05_Di.value: Maddie, you got to pull yourself together!
Maddie, you're acting like a crazy woman! I really appreciate all this but...
We both know what this is truly about.

LDE_PicnicConfusion2024_PicnicBasket_04_.value: Alright! I'm thinking a surprise picnic for just the two of you would really make his day!
Of course! Who doesn't love a good picnic? Besides, he loves food! Last year he even tried to set up a surprise picnic for me!
Yeah! I guess he just wanted an excuse to eat some tasty food with good company.

LDE_PicnicConfusion2024_StartPopup_Descr.value: Find out how awkward things can get between friends in Third Wheel Tango!

LDE_PicnicConfusion2024_TA0_Dialogue_01.value: Time to take this old hunk of junk out of the garage and fix 'er up!

LDE_PicnicConfusion2024_TA0_Dialogue_02.value: Not exactly what I thought my engineering degree would be used for...

LDE_PicnicConfusion2024_TA0_Dialogue_03.value: But you work with what you got!

LDE_PicnicConfusion2024_TA1_Dialogue_03.value: Hmm... Doesn't look too hot though...

LDE_PicnicConfusion2024_TA2_Dialogue_01.value: Nice! Nothing like a fresh coat of paint to make things look as good as new!

LDE_PicnicConfusion2024_TA3_Dialogue_01.value: *Ungh!* There we go! Now it's open!

LDE_PicnicConfusion2024_TA3_Dialogue_02.value: Yikes! This wood needs some work done on it...

LDE_PicnicConfusion2024_TA4_Dialogue_01.value: A good rug to tie the erm...

LDE_PicnicConfusion2024_TA5_Dialogue_01.value: Let's make sure that everyone can see this is a food truck!

LDE_PicnicConfusion2024_TA5_Dialogue_02.value: But what should I write on it?

LDE_PicnicConfusion2024_TA5_Dialogue_03.value: Food Truck? No... Maddie's Food Truck? Nah... Geez, advertizing is hard!

LDE_PicnicConfusion2024_TA6_Dialogue_01.value: A couple of nice stools for people who'd want to stay a while!

LDE_PicnicConfusion2024_TA6_Dialogue_02.value: Would be nice to have some company, and besides...

LDE_PicnicConfusion2024_TA6_Dialogue_03.value: It'll draw more people in to buy some delicious food!

LDE_PicnicConfusion2024_TA7_Dialogue_01.value: Let's see now... What's on the menu?

LDE_PicnicConfusion2024_TA7_Dialogue_02.value: Hmm... Actually, that's a good question, Maddie.

LDE_PicnicConfusion2024_TB1_Dialogue_01.value: Time for a bit of shade.

LDE_PicnicConfusion2024_TB1_Dialogue_02.value: Rain or shine, my customers must be protected!

LDE_PicnicConfusion2024_TB2_Dialogue_01.value: Yes! A few more tables and we're done!

LDE_PicnicConfusion2024_TB2_Dialogue_02.value: Wow... Sometimes I even impress myself...

LDE_PicnicConfusion2024_TB2_Dialogue_03.value: I should keep this food truck around, you know... Just in case!

LDE_PicnicConfusion2024_TB3_Dialogue_01.value: Liven it up with some flowers!

LDE_PicnicConfusion2024_TB3_Dialogue_02.value: Pretty cute if you ask me.

LDE_PicnicConfusion2024_TB4_Dialogue_02.value: Am I getting a bit carried away with these pennant flags?

LDE_PicnicConfusion2024_TB5_Dialogue_01.value: Let's add a small self service trailer!

LDE_PicnicConfusion2024_TB5_Dialogue_02.value: For quick pick-ups and healthy snacks.

LDE_PicnicConfusion2024_TB5_Dialogue_03.value: Hmm... It's actually big enough to fit Mason in here... MASON! I got a job for you!!!!

LDE_PicnicConfusion2024_TC1_Dialogue_02.value: But good thing I got Julius to do it for me!

LDE_PicnicConfusion2024_TC1_Dialogue_03.value: He's a master with a paintbrush.

LDE_PicnicConfusion2024_TC2_Dialogue_01.value: Julius managed to find me some old parade balloons that work great to promote the food truck!

LDE_PicnicConfusion2024_TC2_Dialogue_02.value: Though it makes me wonder what a giant bagel balloon was for...

LDE_PicnicConfusion2024_TC3_Dialogue_01.value: Who knows how far into the night my food truck will be operating...

LDE_PicnicConfusion2024_TC3_Dialogue_02.value: Better to put up some lights to allow people to still enjoy themselves after sunset.

LDE_PiratesOfHopewellBay20232023_ShopPro.value: Reach the previous Pirate Ship upgrade to unlock

LDE_PiratesOfHopewellBay2023_AntiqueFurn.value: Blistering barnacles! This desk is FULL of stuff!
But these aren't pirate coins - just dusty old money. And no key...
What's this? An old letter written by some old seadog? A pirate called Boulton?
No WAY! The key is buried in the huge garden! Oh, how can I find it THERE??
The metal detector! I think I saw one in the garage...

LDE_PiratesOfHopewellBay2023_Battery_05_.value: Extra powerful batteries to find a buried key - CHECK!
Now I just need to put these in the metal detector, and we're in business.
This key is reeeeally old, but this thing will find it!
But if there's a treasure, there could be treasure hunters! I better be fast.

LDE_PiratesOfHopewellBay2023_BoardIntro_.value: I bet the Boulton attic is super old and dusty. Which means that it's FULL of cool old stuff...
It may be perilous, filled with unknown dangers and impossible obstacles...
But Captain Mason never says no to adventure!

LDE_PiratesOfHopewellBay2023_BoultonAtti.value: Where should I begin? The place is full of old junk!
Maddie mentioned old papers... Could there be a map, too?
Mysterious boxes! And dusty old furniture, straight from a pirate ship!
We just keep Christmas decorations in our attic... This is WAY better!

LDE_PiratesOfHopewellBay2023_CouponStore.value: I wish I had some pirate clothes.
A-HA! The costume store! I hope they have eye patches...

LDE_PiratesOfHopewellBay2023_EndPopup_De.value: Thank you for playing the Pirates of Hopewell Bay event!

LDE_PiratesOfHopewellBay2023_EventIntro_.value: Trim the sails and batten down the hatches because adventure awaits!
Whoa! What an adorable little pirate ship!
Erm... I built it myself. The wood is from the shed and the flag is my mom's tablecloth! I mean... Never mind!
I've built a boat or two. Maybe I can help you spruce up your vessel?
Oh, that would be so cool! Can we have a BIG anchor?
AND golden trims on the railings? AND a mysterious monkey cave??
What's up? Are you two planning a pirate adventure?
Maddie! Emilio is helping me build the BIGGEST and BESTEST pirate ship in the WORLD!
Hello, Maddie! Well, maybe not the biggest in the world...
You know, I read somewhere that there were pirates on Hopewell Bay a looong time ago...
Hmm... I'm sure I saw something in the attic. Old papers and stuff...

LDE_PiratesOfHopewellBay2023_IntroPopup_.value: Mason's little Pirate Ship gets a make-over from Emilio - who ends up wading in deeper than he expected... To play the event and join Mason on a quest to find the ultimate pirate treasure, you need to reach <color=#4E8EC8>level 12</color> in the game!
Go on a fantastic pirate adventure to look for a long buried treasure with Mason!

LDE_PiratesOfHopewellBay2023_LayerDecora.value: Are you SURE you know what you're doing? There's not a lot of ship left.
We're taking it apart to build it anew!
Whoa, look out! There are some PRRRETTY rusty nails in there.
Mom says you can get sick if you hurt yourself on them!
I think you should always listen to your mother.
Huh! She says that too...
So, young Mason. A good ship needs a strong skeleton.
That'a a great idea! Skeletons are soooo cool.
Can we have skeletons AND a Monkey Cave?
That would be AWESOME!
I'm talking about the frame of the ship. See, now we can start to build!
And then we'll do the skeletons?
What do you think? A handsome ship, isn't it?
Yeah, really handsome! Although... It's missing a mast.
Well, yes... But not too bad, even if I do say so myself.
And you know what would be REALLY rad?
W-what?
Some water for the ship to sail in!
Shiver me timbers! It's starting to look like a pirate ship!
You can say that again! I think we've done pretty well here.
We still need finish the poop deck...
The WHAT?
The poop deck - located at the back of the ship...
It's the... Forget about it. Let's add some color!
Hehehe! Poop deck...
Phew, that was quite a job!
Aye, Emilio. T'was!
But without wind in its sails, my ship is going nowhere fast.
Yes, sails...
And there COULD be some cannons... In case I need to protect the ship, you know.
And it needs a pirate flag!
Of course.
There's no mistaking it now.
Pirates sail here, so all landlubbers better beware!
Are you ready for an adventure?
Yes and it will be EPIC! Only...
Don't get me wrong. I love it! Its better than I ever could have imagined, but...
Don't tell me.
... there's no Monkey Cave.
It's PERFECT!
The ship, the cannons, the lake, the MONKEY CAVE!
Yes, it's more than I had planned for, but...
It really is glorious. And there's some very interesting sealife in there, too. Did you notice... Maddie!
Ohoy! I can't believe you've built all this!
Well, Emilio did help a little.
Well, adventure calls! See you later, you scallywags!
Safe travels, young Mason!
HARRR! That's Captain Mason, if you don't mind.

LDE_PiratesOfHopewellBay2023_LayeredDeco.value: You can level up your decoration by progressing in the Pirates of Hopewell event. Once you reach event <color=#4E8EC8>level 30</color>, the decoration is yours to keep!

LDE_PiratesOfHopewellBay2023_MasonQuest_.value: Hmmmm... The lighthouse is in the wrong place on the map.
It looks like the Hopewell Bay lighthouse, but ISN'T!
I need to follow these clues, cause the treasure waits for no man.
The map tells me to out to sea... But HOW?
The rowing boat by the pier! I hope it's not booby-trapped...
Quick - there's no time to waste!
I see something on the horizon... A desert island!!
This is where I'd hide a treasure...
There's EVEN a dark, scary cave!
The pirates got caught in a storm... and shipwrecked here!
The crew was saved, but the treasure...
So the stories of pirates in the Boulton family are true...
And I found their ULTIMATE pirate treasure!!
Thus ends the epic adventure of Captain Mason, the terror of the Seven Seas.

LDE_PiratesOfHopewellBay2023_MetalDetect.value: HARRR! The metal detector is ready to go!
Sink me - it has no BATTERIES!
There's a lot of junk in the attic... I bet I can find some batteries up there, too!

LDE_PiratesOfHopewellBay2023_MysteriousC.value: Jackpot! Is this the treasure I'm looking for?
This old coffer is full of pirate booty, but I think there's an even bigger treasure somewhere...
Oh, WOW! What's going on here?
This old chest has to be filled with treasure!
Dagnabbit - it's locked! And no sign of a key...
I bet if I keep digging, I'll find some clues.

LDE_PiratesOfHopewellBay2023_PirateCloth.value: Now I just need the right get-up.
The stuff every decent pirate needs...
A hook... and an EYE PATCH!
And a sword to fight any busted buccaneers!

LDE_PiratesOfHopewellBay2023_PirateCoins.value: So there is a treasure SOMEWHERE!
What a dusty coin! It looks really old and kinda valuable...
Nah! I think I'll keep looking for something better!
Oooh, my pirate senses are tingling!
Now where would a pirate hide the rest of his booty?
It's straight from a pirate's coffer... But there has to be more!
One, two, three, four... and these look like gold!
To sail the Seven Seas and plunder for riches...
This is a whole BAG of gold doubloons!
More treasure from the briny deep!
This coin has a 'B' stamped on it. Does that stand for... Boulton??
Blow me down! A whole chest full of gold!
And the chest has the same 'B' as the doubloons...
So there were pirates in the Boulton family!

LDE_PiratesOfHopewellBay2023_PirateKey_0.value: Now I can open the mysterious chest and get my hands on the treasure!

LDE_PiratesOfHopewellBay2023_PirateRegal.value: A red coat, a gold chain and a big hat... NOW we're talking!
Who would dare to cross Captain Mason?

LDE_PiratesOfHopewellBay2023_PreparingAd.value: I did it! I finally found the MAP!!
This is it - my final quest!
There's no knowing what I'll come up against. Stormy seas, treacherous traps... a rumbling belly!
I'll pack some snacks just in case.

LDE_PiratesOfHopewellBay2023_SeafaringEq.value: Hmm... What DOES a sailor need?
Do I know how to use a compass? Maybe I should pack the GPS, too.
I'll just grab the whole box. Don't want to get stranded at sea!

LDE_PiratesOfHopewellBay2023_ShopProgres.value: Collect Event Points by completing the Pirates of Hopewell Bay event merge tasks and get all the Pirates of Hopewell Bay decoration sets!
Collect Event Points by completing the Pirates of Hopewell Bay Event Merge Tasks and get all the Pirates of Hopewell Bay decoration sets!
