LDE_PiratesOfHopewellBay2023_StartPopup_.value: Get your sea legs and search for clues of a hidden treasure with Mason in the rib-tickling Pirates of Hopewell Bay event!

LDE_PiratesOfHopewellBay2023_TaskGoalDec.value: An upgrade is available for the Pirate Ship

LDE_PiratesOfHopewellBay2023_TaskPlay_De.value: Merge items and discover new decorations!

LDE_PiratesOfHopewellBay2023_TeaserPopup.value: You must reach <color=#4E8EC8>level 12</color>  to play this event.

LDE_PiratesOfHopewellBay2023_Watches_04_.value: I knew that old pirate captain had something up his sleeve.
This is just a taste of the REAL treasure!
Now I need to follow the clues to find it...

LDE_PiratesOfHopewellBay2024_AntiqueFurn.value: I've learned that there's always more than meets the eye in this place.
There will be some hidden compartment in here somewhere. I just need to find it...
Aaahh, an old map! This will lead me to the chest and the log book - I KNOW it!

LDE_PiratesOfHopewellBay2024_Battery_05_.value: Yes! A mega high-powered battery. This is exactly what we need!
The key? I thought we already have the map!
We do, but we need a key for the chest that contains the lost log book!

LDE_PiratesOfHopewellBay2024_BoardIntro_.value: Is it true? About pirates? In your family?
Pirates? Hmmm, that is a complicated question, Mason.
But I do remember a story my grandfather told me once... about a ship that ran aground in the bay, and the captain's lost log book.
I think he said: "Hidden in a chest missing its key, a log book to help you navigate a mystery."
Did he say anything else? Where could the log book be now??
All I remember is that the clues for its whereabouts were hidden somewhere in the attic.
Nnnnggh, that's AMAZING. I think there's something I need to go do... See you later, Grandma Ursula!

LDE_PiratesOfHopewellBay2024_BoultonAtti.value: I love the attic at the Mansion. There's always some treasure to find...
Think, think, think... Where would Grandma Ursula hide the evidence of her pirate relatives?
It's gonna take me all day to search this place, but who knows what else I'll discover!

LDE_PiratesOfHopewellBay2024_BoultonGara.value: Have you ever been on a pirate adventure, Roddy?
I can't say that I have. Why?
Grandma Ursula told me about pirates in her family, and their ship ran aground, so they had to abandon their treasure...
Destiny is calling Captain Mason to search for it, but I need a first mate to join me on this quest.

LDE_PiratesOfHopewellBay2024_CouponStore.value: Why are we going to a costume store?
We need the right outfits if we wanna pass for real pirates, of course!

LDE_PiratesOfHopewellBay2024_DecorationE.value:
By reaching level {0} , you have permanently earned the pirate ship as a decoration!

Continue playing to earn further upgrades for your decoration!

LDE_PiratesOfHopewellBay2024_EventIntro_.value: Wood, nails, rope, an anchor... What else do I need to build a MEGA pirate ship?
Emilio made building a ship look really easy. I wish I had someone to help me...
Hello, Mason! Planning a building project?
Roddy! Yeah, it's going to be an EPIC pirate ship. What brings you here on this fine day?
I-I was just down the road on business and thought I'd come and see how Maddie is getting on with the renovations.
Say, Roddy... Do you wanna help me build this ship? I could sure use a hand!
Well, I'm an architect, so I don't really know anything about building ships.
I understand. I guess it takes special expert to do that... Like Emilio.
But it's OK. I'm sure you're really busy.
Never mind. I'll help you. Where do we begin?

LDE_PiratesOfHopewellBay2024_InfoPanel_D.value:
The Pirates of Hopewell Bay event has started!
Complete Event Merge Tasks and earn Event Points.

LDE_PiratesOfHopewellBay2024_IntroPopup_.value: Help Roddy fulfil Mason's dream to build an ultimate Pirate Ship and search for hidden Pirate Treasure!
Go on a pirate adventure with Mason!

LDE_PiratesOfHopewellBay2024_LayerDecora.value: I've looked up some literature and watched some ship building tutorials, and I think I've cracked it.
I might not be some cool marine biologist who makes a red beanie look annoyingly good, but I CAN build a pirate ship.
Mason, grab the tools. Let's get to work!
So how did Emilio do this exactly?
He made it look super easy... but it's not! It's super hard!
I'm sure we can figure it out...
Let's just draw some plans and write a list of supplies. Organization is the key to every successful building project.
Ha! We did it! The frame is ready and really solid!
You see, I found out that wooden vessels are susceptible to both hogging and sagging, and that bends the deck convexly...
Whoa, whoa! That's a lot of weird words I don't understand. When do we add the mast?
All in good time, Mason!
Emilio dug a little pond for the ship to sail in. Could we have one, too?
A pond??
That means we would have to conduct a brief geological survey...
Maybe a wildlife survey, too...
I'll make the application for the surveys and the building licence, but...
I think we can do it!
According to my books, it's now time to build the... poop deck. Did I read that right?
Teehee!
Yes, it definitely says "poop deck".
Hehehe!
Mason!
Ahahahah!
Phewww! What a job that was!
I never knew hoisting sails could be so hard. And those cannons weigh a ton!
It's looking great, Roddy! Now we just need the monkey water fall and the Kraken.
Do you really NEED them? I mean, this ship already looks pretty good to me.
Emilio built them when I asked.
Let's get to work, then.
I can't believe we've built this thing. It's GLORIOUS!
The sails are up, the monkey waterfall is ready, and you can sail off to adventure!
This ship really is pretty sweet! Nice job, Roddy.
It's way better than Emilio's ship, right?

LDE_PiratesOfHopewellBay2024_LayeredDeco.value:
You can level up your decoration by progressing in the Pirates of Hopewell event. 
Once you reach event <color=#4E8EC8>level 30</color>, the decoration is yours to keep!

LDE_PiratesOfHopewellBay2024_MasonQuest_.value: Grandma was so cool to tell me about this secret!
Grandma Ursula revealed a secret? That's a first...
Let's see what the log book says!
"It has been most terrible of late... My crew constantly grumble about the quality of food and stale ship biscuits..."
I would totally complain about stale biscuits, too!
"The island rose from the mist like the hump of an angry whale. Everything about it looked menacing, but we had no choice but to head for it."
Oooh, I can't take the suspense!
I can see the old ship!
"It is here we left our treasure, in the hopes that we can return to fetch it later. If that does not come to pass, I can only hope that it is found by a worthy sailor."

LDE_PiratesOfHopewellBay2024_MysteriousC.value: This is the chest missing its key!!
But where do I find the key??

LDE_PiratesOfHopewellBay2024_PirateCloth.value: Do I really have to wear this?
I'll do it. *Sigh* Hand it over.

LDE_PiratesOfHopewellBay2024_PirateCoins.value: This is a real antique coin, Mason!
This is really historical. Maybe we should show these to an expert...
MAYBE we should keep looking for the treasure!
The treasure! Mason, we found the treasure!
We totally did! Oh, there's a note...
"Well done, me hearties. You completed your quest with great bravery. Now come over for some apple pie! - Grandma Ursula"
Oh, dagnabbit! Grandma Ursula's always one step ahead...
But I had the best time anyway!

LDE_PiratesOfHopewellBay2024_PirateKey_0.value: Well done, Roddy. You make a great first mate.

LDE_PiratesOfHopewellBay2024_PirateRegal.value: Look at this - a complete pirate captain's costume!
That sword still looks really sharp. Can I have it?

LDE_PiratesOfHopewellBay2024_PreparingAd.value: So you have... a map to find this treasure?

LDE_PiratesOfHopewellBay2024_SeafaringEq.value: Those pirates ended up sailing into a big storm... We'll need to be prepared for the worst, too!
Right-o, captain! With this equipment we'll be safe and sound.
Let's pack it all up and head out!

LDE_PiratesOfHopewellBay2024_StartPopup_.value: Get your sea legs and search for clues of a hidden treasure with Mason in the rib-tickling Pirates of Hopewell Bay event!

LDE_PiratesOfHopewellBay2024_Watches_04_.value: More treasure? Oh, these are just old clocks.
Forget about them. Who cares about some dusty antiques, when we're searching for ACTUAL pirate treasure!

LDE_PiratesOfHopewellBay2024__Dialogue_0.value: Err, s-sure! So is it a REAL treasure?
As real as the Mansion itself, Roddy.

LDE_Rumors2025_Advertising_01_Dialogue_0.value: Could you be a darling and hand these flyers out in town? It would be such a big help.
OK, here are some of the basics of being a circus performer.
If you want to succeed, you need a solid act. Something that will truly captivate the audience.
Thank you again, Maddie! I have to dash to the dress rehearsal.
And you need to know how to sell it, too.
Break a leg! I mean, not actually...
What kind of performance would you put on?
You should be careful with her.
Why? I thought you were friends.
Dude, just give me some weights and let me be a strongman. No magic, just muscles!
We are, dearie, but I know her better than you think.
I know she is impressive, but she has a lot of secrets.
Thanks for the heads up, Grandma, but I think you might just be paranoid!

LDE_Rumors2025_Brochures_03_Dialogue_01.value: We need to think of an act that will really stop people in their tracks. Like…
We need to think of an act that will really stop people in their tracks. Like...

LDE_Rumors2025_Brochures_03_Dialogue_02.value: She said she was going to the dress rehearsal, but I can't find her anywhere.

LDE_Rumors2025_Brochures_03_Dialogue_03.value: I ran out of circus brochures, but I know I saw more of them somewhere.

LDE_Rumors2025_Brochures_03_Dialogue_04.value: No, haven't seen her... She's probably just getting ready for the show.

LDE_Rumors2025_Brochures_03_Dialogue_05.value: Of course. But I don't want to disturb her...

LDE_Rumors2025_Brochures_03_Dialogue_06.value: I'm sure she won't mind if you get more brochures from her wagon.

LDE_Rumors2025_Brochures_07_Dialogue_01.value: Now where are the rest of the programs and brochures?
I’m afraid you’re not quite far enough to touch the real knives.

LDE_Rumors2025_Brochures_07_Dialogue_02.value: We have some foam knives you can practice with!

LDE_Rumors2025_Brochures_07_Dialogue_03.value: I guess people who work in the circus are pretty bohemian, but maybe I could help Fiona and straighten the place out.
FOAM knives? Those are for babies!

LDE_Rumors2025_Brochures_07_Dialogue_04.value: These old crumpled leaflets can probably go in the dumpster.

LDE_Rumors2025_CarnivalGames_03_Dialogue.value: I don't want to toot my own horn, but I'm pretty good at throwing.
I could probably win you the main prize, if you wanted.
Be careful, those balls look kinda heavy…
Be careful, those balls look kinda heavy...
Aww, thanks little guy... Maybe I'll win it for you first.
I can handle them! Give me another one!

LDE_Rumors2025_CarnivalGames_07_Dialogue.value: Everybody knows these things are always rigged!
What are you doing? I don’t think you should be touching the carnival games and the circus equipment…
What are you doing? I don’t think you should be touching the carnival games and the circus equipment...
He’s telling the truth. The ringmaster told us we could totally try stuff out.
I beat you both fair and square!
She did? Can I try, too?

LDE_Rumors2025_CarnivalPrizes_03_Dialogu.value: Are you planning on joining the Circus?
Haha, probably not... But I'm pretty good at card tricks.
But not so good at juggling, bro!

LDE_Rumors2025_CarnivalPrizes_07_Dialogu.value: What do you think about what it is we do here in the circus?
It's all super interesting, but I think I'm ready for more challenging stuff.
Well... You won't tell her, will you?

LDE_Rumors2025_CarnivalPrizes_11_Dialogu.value: Oh, they… they're coming in a minute. They're just kind of tied up at the moment…
Oh, they... they're coming in a minute. They're just kind of tied up at the moment...
Actually, I have to go find the key for some chains.

LDE_Rumors2025_CircusProps_01_Dialogue_0.value: Grandma, did you hear that the circus folks are in Hopewell Bay?
Hey, little man! What are you doing poking around back here?
Are they really? I wonder if they still have the same old wagons and big top...
Looks like the kind of stuff they don’t just let anybody mess with.
Wait a minute. Have you seen them perform before?
Yeah, but I have permission. Look at all of this cool stuff! I already found clown noses and flowers that squirt water!
In a manner of speaking. It is quite a spectacle!
I know. I can't wait to see the show!
I thought you said you had permission!

LDE_Rumors2025_CircusProps_06_Dialogue_0.value: I’m Mason, and this is Hank.
We were just admiring all of your circus equipment! It’s SO cool!
So you’re Mason! Maddie told me you wanted to learn about the Circus.
See, Hank! I DO have permission. Where can I start?
Just a second. First, I must ask: Are you both ready to learn about our work?
I must warn you - it’s harder than it looks. Our performers are the best in the world, and they work very hard to hone their craft.

LDE_Rumors2025_CircusProps_07_Dialogue_0.value: You were right! The circus is in town!
I saw them setting up the big top right in front of the Mansion.
It sure is. But I just have one question.
How in tarnation do you ride a bike with just one wheel?

LDE_Rumors2025_CircusProps_10_Dialogue_0.value: Ever since I got the letter from Fiona, I've been looking forward to seeing her and the whole troupe.
We’re still setting everything up, but you can find all the equipment you need in our caravans.
I love the circus and its magic...
Feel free to try things out, but please stay out of the green caravan.
It's such a nice distraction from all my usual work.
Mason, listen to the lady. We won’t go in the green caravan, promise!
Well, then. Welcome to the Circus!

LDE_Rumors2025_CircusTent_01_Dialogue_01.value: I wasn’t expecting to see you back in Hopewell Bay so soon.

LDE_Rumors2025_CircusTent_01_Dialogue_02.value: I am, and you must be Fiona DuVal!
I agree that the circumstances of our last visit were… regrettable, but I hope we can put it behind us.
I agree that the circumstances of our last visit were... regrettable, but I hope we can put it behind us.

LDE_Rumors2025_CircusTent_01_Dialogue_03.value: That's right! Thank you again for letting us come to the Mansion.
No charges were pressed, and the show must go on, as they say.

LDE_Rumors2025_CircusTent_01_Dialogue_04.value: We had planned our tour, paid for all the permits, and then the council told us we couldn't use the park after all.
So you’re back on the road with the Circus?

LDE_Rumors2025_CircusTent_01_Dialogue_05.value: Yes, but only to bring a smile to people’s faces. I just want to show everyone what it’s all about!

LDE_Rumors2025_CircusTent_01_Dialogue_06.value: The pleasure is all mine. I'm just so happy to finally meet you!
You know, there’s someone I know - a boy called Mason - who would love to learn all about the Circus. Could you show him the ropes?

LDE_Rumors2025_CircusTent_01_Dialogue_07.value: I've read so much about your circus.

LDE_Rumors2025_CircusTent_01_Dialogue_08.value: Thank you, Maddie. You're so kind!

LDE_Rumors2025_CircusTent_01_Dialogue_09.value: Let me know if there's anything I can do to help you while you're here. I can organize clown noses or hand out flyers.

LDE_Rumors2025_CircusTent_01_Dialogue_10.value: I might just take you up on your offer!

LDE_Rumors2025_CircusWagon_01_Dialogue_0.value: Ursula Boulton, as I live and breathe! How long has it been?
Juggling, fortunetelling and simple magic tricks are fun, but we need something more challenging.
Too long to remember. It is nice to see you again, Fiona.
You look well. Still traveling and performing, I see.
Oh, yes. We go WAY back. Don't we, Ursula?
We slept in the same wagon back in the day. We trained together and shared so many stories.
The Mansion looks so much better! Someone's been working hard to turn it around.
Is it still full of old stuff?

LDE_Rumors2025_ExtendPopup_Description.value:
The Circus Caper event has sadly come to an end.
Event Merge Board and Merge Tasks will be closed now.

LDE_Rumors2025_ExtendPopup_Header.value: The Circus Caper event is about to end!

LDE_Rumors2025_Fortunetelling_04_Dialogu.value: A crystal ball! This must be the fortune-teller’s caravan.
What can you tell me about the future?
Look at me, I’m like Lady Voyance!
With sleight of hand, it slips away, vanishing in the light of day.
“Hank, you’re a man of great strength, but don’t walk under a ladder and look out for black cats!”

LDE_Rumors2025_HeistPlan_03_Dialogue_01.value: So it was Fiona all along!
Look, guys! I designed a trick! I’ve drawn it all out here.

LDE_Rumors2025_HeistPlan_03_Dialogue_02.value: She asked to bring the Circus here, because she knew about everything that was in it.

LDE_Rumors2025_HeistPlan_03_Dialogue_03.value: And she kept me busy with brochures and flyers, while she was planning her heist.

LDE_Rumors2025_HeistPlan_03_Dialogue_04.value: She completely took advantage of me!

LDE_Rumors2025_HeistPlan_03_Dialogue_05.value: The perfect sleight of hand, indeed.

LDE_Rumors2025_HeistPlan_06_Dialogue_01.value: Stop right there, Fiona! I know what you're doing.
So are you going to show us how your trick works?

LDE_Rumors2025_HeistPlan_06_Dialogue_02.value: I just can't believe you'd take advantage of our hospitality like this!
Actually, the trick is for you two!

LDE_Rumors2025_HeistPlan_06_Dialogue_03.value: I told you. In this business, you sometimes have to break the rules.
For us? Are you going to use those chains on us??

LDE_Rumors2025_HeistPlan_06_Dialogue_04.value: I wish I hadn't guessed this, Fiona. I wanted to give you the benefit of the doubt.
Yes, and it’ll be great! I have the key here.

LDE_Rumors2025_HeistPlan_06_Dialogue_05.value: I almost pulled it off, too!

LDE_Rumors2025_HeistPlan_06_Dialogue_06.value: I'd be only my jolly way by now if it wasn't for your meddling granddaughter!
I'd be on my jolly way by now if it weren't for your meddling granddaughter!

LDE_Rumors2025_HeistPlan_06_Dialogue_07.value: Just tell me, where is it?
OK, then. Just don’t lose the key, little guy!

LDE_Rumors2025_HeistPlan_06_Dialogue_10.value: So that's what you were after...

LDE_Rumors2025_HeistPlan_06_Dialogue_11.value: You didn't think I want to tour with the Circus for the rest of my life, did you?

LDE_Rumors2025_HeistPlan_06_Dialogue_12.value: Well, you can think about that for a nice long while - behind bars!

LDE_Rumors2025_InfoPanel_Description.value:
The Circus Caper event has started!
Complete Event Merge Tasks and earn Event Points.

LDE_Rumors2025_InfoPopup_Subheader4.value: Reach Event <color=#4E8EC8>Level {0} </color> to keep the decorations!

LDE_Rumors2025_IntroPopup_Description.value: A traveling circus headed by the legendary Fiona DuVal arrives in Hopewell Bay, eager to set up at the Mansion, but it does not take long for rumors to start flying. Get ready for amazing tricks, a masterful sleight of hand and an almost miraculous escape!

LDE_Rumors2025_IntroPopup_Header.value: Don't miss the greatest show in a lifetime!

LDE_Rumors2025_Intro_Dialogue_01.value: I say, Maddie! I think I just saw a group of clowns in the grocery store!
Does the name Fiona DuVal ring a bell?

LDE_Rumors2025_Intro_Dialogue_02.value: What on earth is going on?
You mean the scheming Circus ringmaster who tried to pull a heist at the Mansion - but was stopped right at the last minute?

LDE_Rumors2025_Intro_Dialogue_03.value: Are you talking about the strongman training in the park?

LDE_Rumors2025_Intro_Dialogue_04.value: No, I am talking about the clowns!
Yeah, so she’s coming back, or the Circus is! There are posters all over town.

LDE_Rumors2025_Intro_Dialogue_05.value: She has some nerve after being caught in the act!

LDE_Rumors2025_Intro_Dialogue_06.value: Sounds like the circus has come to town!
I know she did a bad thing, but the Circus is SO cool. Do you think she’d let me learn some of the acts?

LDE_Rumors2025_Intro_Dialogue_07.value: You want to be a circus performer?

LDE_Rumors2025_Intro_Dialogue_08.value: Yep, the great traveling circus headed by the legendary Fiona DuVal.
It’s one of my dream professions - right behind pirate captain and ghost hunter. It’s really hard to choose between them.

LDE_Rumors2025_Intro_Dialogue_09.value: Get ready to be wowed, because we're in for a treat!
Well, Fiona owes me one after her shenanigans, so I’ll put a good word in for you!

LDE_Rumors2025_LayeredDecoInfoPopup_Desc.value: You can level up your decoration by progressing in the Circus Caper event. Once you reach event <color=#4E8EC8>level 30</color>, the decoration is yours to keep!
You can level up your decoration by progressing in the Circus Caper event. Once you reach event <color=#4E8EC8>level 35</color>, the decoration is yours to keep!

LDE_Rumors2025_Lottery_01_Dialogue_01.value: I bought lots of raffle tickets to make sure I win the biggest prize!

LDE_Rumors2025_Lottery_01_Dialogue_02.value: My ticket has never won, but this time the prize will be mine!

LDE_Rumors2025_Lottery_01_Dialogue_03.value: Ah, the excitement! I think I will get some raffle tickets, too.

LDE_Rumors2025_Lottery_01_Dialogue_04.value: What is it, Ursula? Are you not going to buy a couple of raffle tickets?

LDE_Rumors2025_Lottery_01_Dialogue_05.value: I know this crowd... At the circus, the house always wins.

LDE_Rumors2025_MagicianProps_05_Dialogue.value: Can you do any magic tricks?
What’s in the big stripy box?
I can make a pile of twigs disappear from the garden!
White gloves, top hats and a LOT of scarves. I guess... magician’s props!
Can I try to make you disappear?
It's not a real magic trick, Hank. Just gardening.
Oh... but can I still see it?
Can you see me? Am I... invisible??

LDE_Rumors2025_Outro_Dialogue_01.value: I have to hand it to you, Maddie. You did a great job revealing Fiona's dastardly plan.
Thank you so much for letting us try everything! I especially loved the tightrope walking and the knives.

LDE_Rumors2025_Outro_Dialogue_02.value: The strongman suit felt like a great fit for me.

LDE_Rumors2025_Outro_Dialogue_03.value: But she didn't, thanks to you.
I really loved the magician's equipment. Not to brag, but my sleight of hand was PRETTY good.

LDE_Rumors2025_Outro_Dialogue_04.value: I just hope she didn't ruin the magic of the circus for you.
The pleasure is all mine. I must admit, I do see some great talent in the three of you.

LDE_Rumors2025_Outro_Dialogue_05.value: No, I still love the circus. But next time they can pitch their tents somewhere else!
You do?? What kind of talent?

LDE_Rumors2025_Outro_Dialogue_06.value: You would make the perfect clown act!

LDE_Rumors2025_PaperScraps_01_Dialogue_0.value: What are these scraps of paper in the dumpster?
There's some writing on them, but I can't make it out...
This one says something about the Mansion!
I wonder if I could put them together with some tape.

LDE_Rumors2025_PaperScraps_03_Dialogue_0.value: These scraps are starting to look kinda suspicious.
Could we shoot Roddy out of a cannon? You’ve done it once, haven’t you?
There's a list of things in the Mansion, but some of them have been crossed out.
Y-yes, but maybe we could do something less… explosive?
Y-yes, but maybe we could do something less... explosive?
It's almost like some kind of... shopping list for a thief!

LDE_Rumors2025_Prizes_03_Dialogue_01.value: Are you going to the circus?

LDE_Rumors2025_Prizes_03_Dialogue_03.value: But I don't want to see any clowns...

LDE_Rumors2025_Prizes_07_Dialogue_01.value: The circus would be a great cover for a criminal enterprise, don't you think?

LDE_Rumors2025_Prizes_07_Dialogue_02.value: Why? I don't think there's a more colorful and conspicuous group.

LDE_Rumors2025_Prizes_07_Dialogue_03.value: I know! They're hiding in plain sight.

LDE_Rumors2025_Prizes_07_Dialogue_04.value: It's the perfect sleight of hand.

LDE_Rumors2025_Prizes_11_Dialogue_02.value: I really didn't expect the magician to pull a raccoon out of his hat.

LDE_Rumors2025_Prizes_11_Dialogue_06.value: Deb won the biggest prize in the raffle - and she had only bought one ticket!

LDE_Rumors2025_RingmasterSuit_05_Dialogu.value: It must be so exciting to be a part of the Circus!
Fiona was right. We need to think of an act that makes people so excited that they can’t look away.
How did you become the ringmaster?
That, Maddie, is a long story. I suppose I had ambition and the right vision.
Do you remember seeing a mysterious green caravan?
You have to go big or go home if you want to make it in this business.
The one she said was strictly off limits? Bro, we can't touch that.
And sometimes you have to break the rules to get what you want.
That was more like a guideline than an actual rule. I bet there’s something totally rad in there.
But I don't want to bore you with my life story...
Maybe it’s just what we need!
Would it be too much to ask you to take these programs to the big top?
I don’t know about this, Mason.
You don't have to ask twice!

LDE_Rumors2025_SafeOpen_01_Dialogue_01.value: Someone's broken into the old safe!!
A safe? Oh, I get it.

LDE_Rumors2025_SafeOpen_01_Dialogue_02.value: What is going on in here?
This stuff is meant for a spectacular escape act. Like Harry Houdini!

LDE_Rumors2025_SafeOpen_01_Dialogue_03.value: It seems like whoever is behind this doesn't want just anything. The Mansion is full of valuable things, but they cracked the safe.
Help me get inside and close the door.

LDE_Rumors2025_SafeOpen_01_Dialogue_04.value: They must be after something specific. But what?

LDE_Rumors2025_StartPopup_Description.value: Roll up for a circus performance to remember! Fiona DuVal and her troupe are ready to perform...

LDE_Rumors2025_TA3_Dialogue_01.value: Do you think this location would be good for the circus?

LDE_Rumors2025_TA3_Dialogue_03.value: It's next to your beautiful Mansion, and right by to the road for easy access.

LDE_Rumors2025_TA3_Dialogue_04.value: I think it would be perfect!

LDE_Rumors2025_TA5_Dialogue_01.value: What do you remember of your time in the circus, Ursula?

LDE_Rumors2025_TA5_Dialogue_03.value: Come on, I know you remember everything.

LDE_Rumors2025_TA5_Dialogue_04.value: You are not wrong there, Mason.

LDE_Rumors2025_TA5_Dialogue_05.value: I can tell you that the circus is a very exciting and sometimes dangerous place.

LDE_Rumors2025_TA5_Dialogue_06.value: Wow... Do you think I'm too young to join?

LDE_Rumors2025_TC1_Dialogue_01.value: Could you settle an argument, Ursula?

LDE_Rumors2025_TC1_Dialogue_02.value: We've been trying to figure out what you did in the Circus.

LDE_Rumors2025_TC1_Dialogue_04.value: Well, I tried my hand in several things, but I was best known for my motorcycle stunts.

LDE_Rumors2025_TC1_Dialogue_07.value: No one guessed it right, did they?

LDE_Rumors2025_TaskPlay_Description.value: Merge items and discover new decorations!

LDE_Rumors2025_TeaGossip_04_Dialogue_01.value: I just heard the wildest rumor. Someone said Ursula used to be in the circus!
Your friends seem to be excited about the Circus!

LDE_Rumors2025_TeaGossip_04_Dialogue_02.value: Friends? I thought it was just Mason who wanted to learn the tricks of the trade.

LDE_Rumors2025_TeaGossip_04_Dialogue_03.value: Fiona DuVal - the ringmaster of the Circus - was just telling me about how they once trained together.
Yes, but there are two others. What were their names again... Hank and Roddy!

LDE_Rumors2025_TeaGossip_04_Dialogue_04.value: Hank and Roddy? I’ve got to see this!

LDE_Rumors2025_TeaGossip_07_Dialogue_01.value: Did you hear that Ursula used to be in the circus?
Let me apologize again for my past indiscretions. I really thought I had no options but to choose a life of crime to save the Circus.

LDE_Rumors2025_TeaGossip_07_Dialogue_02.value: Yeah, I heard she was a trapeze artist.
And your Grandma always made it sound like the place was vacant. It seemed like the best way out.

LDE_Rumors2025_TeaGossip_07_Dialogue_03.value: I thought she was shot out the cannon.
Sounds like you were stuck between a rock and a hard place.

LDE_Rumors2025_TeaGossip_07_Dialogue_04.value: I was. People just don’t get excited about the Circus like they used to, so we have to work extra hard.

LDE_Rumors2025_TeaGossip_07_Dialogue_05.value: I never had the best role models growing up. Looking back, the invisible woman and the strongman were probably not the best acts to follow.

LDE_Rumors2025_TeaGossip_07_Dialogue_06.value: I get it. It’s tough to keep everything going when the world seems to be against you.

LDE_Rumors2025_TeaGossip_07_Dialogue_07.value: After working at the mansion for this long, I know how that feels.

LDE_Rumors2025_ThiefProps_04_Dialogue_01.value: I do not want to worry you, dearie, but there has been some weird activity around the Mansion.
How did you pry open the door of the green caravan so quickly?

LDE_Rumors2025_ThiefProps_04_Dialogue_02.value: Are you talking about... the circus?
I have many skills. Let’s see what’s in these boxes.

LDE_Rumors2025_ThiefProps_04_Dialogue_03.value: No, but I wouldn't be surprised if they had something to do with it.
Are they a costume for a cat burglar?

LDE_Rumors2025_ThiefProps_04_Dialogue_04.value: I am serious, dear. Things have been moved around, but nothing seems to be missing.

LDE_Rumors2025_ThiefProps_07_Dialogue_01.value: Is there something hidden in the bushes?
These could be perfect for our act!

LDE_Rumors2025_ThiefProps_07_Dialogue_02.value: It’s a shame the costume is about five sizes too small for Hank, and ten sizes too big for me.

LDE_Rumors2025_ThiefProps_07_Dialogue_03.value: Maybe Grandma wasn't just being paranoid... Maybe there IS something going on.
What kind of a trick could they be used for?

LDE_Rumors2025_ThiefProps_07_Dialogue_06.value: Lock-picks? Where did you find those?

LDE_Rumors2025_ThiefProps_07_Dialogue_07.value: They were hidden in some bushes right next to the Mansion.

LDE_Rumors2025_ThiefProps_07_Dialogue_08.value: I don't want to sound suspicious, but do you think there's someone in your troupe who could be planning a robbery here at the Mansion?

LDE_Rumors2025_ThiefProps_07_Dialogue_09.value: What a shocking thought! I promise to make sure no one in my circus steps out of line.

LDE_Rumors2025_ThiefProps_07_Dialogue_10.value: After all, you've been so welcoming to us.
