LS_Autumn_BurrowingOwl_Dialogue_03.value: What kind of an owl is it?

LS_Autumn_BurrowingOwl_Dialogue_04.value: Err… I’m not sure. It’s brown with white spots. It’s not too big.
Err... I’m not sure. It’s brown with white spots. It’s not too big.

LS_Autumn_BurrowingOwl_Dialogue_05.value: That sounds like a Burrowing Owl.

LS_Autumn_BurrowingOwl_Dialogue_06.value: Burrowing? Does that mean it lives… underground??
Burrowing? Does that mean it lives... underground??

LS_Autumn_CanadaGoose_Dialogue_01.value: You hear that? There must be geese approaching.

LS_Autumn_CanadaGoose_Dialogue_02.value: Yup, I can see a whole flock of Canada Geese flying overhead.

LS_Autumn_CanadaGoose_Dialogue_04.value: It is one of the joys of bird-watching, my dear!

LS_Autumn_Dunlin_Dialogue_02.value: Quite common! But they are mostly found on shorelines, like here in Hopewell Bay.

LS_Autumn_Dunlin_Dialogue_03.value: We are pretty well situated for bird-watching here, aren’t we?

LS_Autumn_Dunlin_Dialogue_04.value: We sure are. But the autumn is my favorite time.

LS_Autumn_Intro_Dialogue_01.value: Can I interest you in a little bird-watching today?

LS_Autumn_Intro_Dialogue_02.value: Let me guess - the autumn is an excellent time for bird-watching?

LS_Autumn_Intro_Dialogue_03.value: You know me too well, my dear... But yes, it is!

LS_Autumn_Intro_Dialogue_04.value: The fall migration brings many interesting birds our way, and you cannot beat a crisp autumn day.

LS_Autumn_Intro_Dialogue_05.value: Can we have that hot cocoa in a thermos again?

LS_Autumn_MandarinDuck_Dialogue_01.value: I think I might have a real treat for you, my dear!

LS_Autumn_MandarinDuck_Dialogue_02.value: What is it? A cool eagle or some exotic bird?

LS_Autumn_MandarinDuck_Dialogue_03.value: Why don't you take a look!

LS_Autumn_MandarinDuck_Dialogue_04.value: Oh, WOW! What is that bird??

LS_Autumn_MandarinDuck_Dialogue_05.value: A Mandarin Duck. It’s a very shy bird, but always a joy to spot.

LS_Autumn_MandarinDuck_Dialogue_06.value: It might be my new favorite!

LS_Autumn_RedcrownedCrane_Dialogue_01.value: Oh, wow! Is that a Red-crowned Crane?

LS_Autumn_RedcrownedCrane_Dialogue_03.value: They are a very rare sight these days, so this is a very lovely surprise!

LS_Autumn_RedcrownedCrane_Dialogue_04.value: Do you see how they almost seem to be dancing?

LS_Autumn_RedcrownedCrane_Dialogue_05.value: Oh, yeah! Why are they doing that?

LS_Autumn_RedcrownedCrane_Dialogue_06.value: It’s a way for them to warn the others of some danger.

LS_Autumn_Shoebill_Dialogue_01.value: Well, well, well! If it isn’t the shoebill wading in the water, looking for a snack!

LS_Autumn_Shoebill_Dialogue_03.value: Do not be fooled! That bill is powerful, with razor-sharp edges and a pointed hook at the end to finish off even a huge fish.

LS_Autumn_WillowPtarmigan_Dialogue_01.value: I thought I just saw something over there in those trees, but I don’t think it was actually anything.

LS_Autumn_WillowPtarmigan_Dialogue_02.value: Hang on! There’s definitely something there!

LS_Autumn_WillowPtarmigan_Dialogue_03.value: Where? Over there, past the shrubbery?

LS_Autumn_WillowPtarmigan_Dialogue_04.value: Exactly! No, I think I was wrong, after all.

LS_Autumn_WillowPtarmigan_Dialogue_05.value: You weren’t wrong at all! It just happens to be a bird that is a true master of camouflage - a Willow Ptarmigan!

LS_CommonLoon_Dialogue_01.value: I can see a bird in the water. I don't think I've ever spotted it before.

LS_CommonLoon_Dialogue_02.value: Oh? What does it look like?

LS_CommonLoon_Dialogue_03.value: It has a black head, kind of a checkered body and... red eyes?

LS_CommonLoon_Dialogue_04.value: Ah, it is the Common Loon.

LS_CommonLoon_Dialogue_05.value: The eyes are a little eerie, I know.

LS_Easter_Common_Bunny_01_Dialogue_01.value: Okay, I've got this. I just need to remember the basics.

LS_Easter_Common_Bunny_01_Dialogue_02.value: "Stay quiet and move slowly." No problem there. I'm stealth and stealth is me.

LS_Easter_Common_Bunny_01_Dialogue_03.value: "Listen before looking." Hmmm, I can definitely hear something close by.

LS_Easter_Common_Bunny_01_Dialogue_05.value: Now, what's that behind that tree?

LS_Easter_Common_Bunny_01_Dialogue_06.value: Well, that bird forgot its wings… and grew extra cute!
Well, that bird forgot its wings... and grew extra cute!

LS_Easter_Common_Lamb_Dialogue_01.value: Ah, hmm! I would know that sound anywhere!

LS_Easter_Common_Lamb_Dialogue_02.value: The tell-tale sound of a Common Snipe in flight!

LS_Easter_Common_Lamb_Dialogue_03.value: Perhaps not the most exotic animal, but an exciting sight nonetheless! Let's see...

LS_Easter_Common_Lamb_Dialogue_04.value: ...what on Earth! That isn't a Common Snipe! That is an adorable lamb!

LS_Easter_Epic_Mason_01_Dialogue_01.value: Ooh, there's something substantial over there.

LS_Easter_Epic_Mason_01_Dialogue_02.value: This could win me the competition!

LS_Easter_Epic_Mason_01_Dialogue_03.value: Oh, my! Do my eyes betray me or is that an abnormally large rabbit??

LS_Easter_Intro1_Dialogue_01.value: What a beautiful day! Perfect for a bit of birding, don't you think, Julius?

LS_Easter_Intro1_Dialogue_02.value: I do agree! Let me just grab my camera bag and we can go.

LS_Easter_Intro1_Dialogue_03.value: Ooh, are you going to hunt more exotic creatures?

LS_Easter_Intro1_Dialogue_04.value: Well, I am hoping to see a Scarlet Tanager, but...

LS_Easter_Intro1_Dialogue_07.value: You're just afraid I'm going to beat you again - just like last spring!

LS_Easter_Intro1_Dialogue_08.value: I'm not so sure you beat us!

LS_Easter_Intro1_Dialogue_10.value: But what are we competing for? Oh...he is already gone...

LS_Easter_Intro_Dialogue_01.value: I've done some studying since our last bird-watching trip, and I can't wait to get out there!

LS_Easter_Intro_Dialogue_02.value: How marvelous! The weather looks most promising, too.

LS_Easter_Intro_Dialogue_05.value: Are you planning for a *bird-watching* day?

LS_Easter_Intro_Dialogue_08.value: How about you make it more interesting?

LS_Easter_Intro_Dialogue_10.value: Let's see which one of you can spot the most exotic creature.

LS_Easter_Intro_Dialogue_11.value: Hmmm... I feel I have an unfair advantage, as I have been bird-watching for much longer.

LS_Easter_Intro_Dialogue_12.value: You might be surprised by how much I've learned. I've had an excellent teacher, after all!

LS_Easter_Intro_Dialogue_13.value: Flattery will get you everywhere. Let's do it!

LS_Easter_Legendary_Cat_01_Dialogue_01.value: I bet Julius has already spotted a dozen exotic birds...

LS_Easter_Legendary_Cat_01_Dialogue_02.value: But I won't give up! I think I can hear something...

LS_Easter_Legendary_Cat_01_Dialogue_03.value: It almost sounds like a... tiny kitten!

LS_Easter_Legendary_Ferret_Dialogue_01.value: What's that over there? It's too big to be a mouse, so it must be...

LS_Easter_Legendary_Ferret_Dialogue_02.value: A ferret! And just a baby, by the looks of it. Hello, little one!

LS_Easter_Legendary_Ferret_Dialogue_03.value: Are you tame? You look tame. Do you want to come home with me?

LS_Easter_Outro1_Dialogue_01.value: This year I know I am going to win!

LS_Easter_Outro1_Dialogue_02.value: I am still not sure what the winner is awarded with.

LS_Easter_Outro1_Dialogue_03.value: The joy of participating, right, Mason?

LS_Easter_Outro1_Dialogue_04.value: What? No! That's stupid. Whoever wins... gets to eat all the Easter eggs they want!

LS_Easter_Outro1_Dialogue_05.value: I think that means we'd better let Pearl pick the winner. Just in case!

LS_Easter_Outro_Dialogue_01.value: Let's hear it! Which one of you spotted the most exotic bird?

LS_Easter_Outro_Dialogue_02.value: I only spotted adorable baby animals, but I'm not complaining!

LS_Easter_Outro_Dialogue_03.value: I am not sure about birds, but I did spot something that took me quite by surprise.

LS_Easter_Outro_Dialogue_06.value: What can I say? I photograph really well.

LS_Easter_Rare_Raccoon_Dialogue_01.value: This time I'm going to find something better than a chicken!

LS_Easter_Rare_Raccoon_Dialogue_02.value: Not that a chicken isn't pretty cool, of course.

LS_Easter_Rare_Raccoon_Dialogue_03.value: Wait - I think I see something! I bet it's a wolf! Or a tiger!

LS_Easter_Rare_Raccoon_Dialogue_04.value: Whoa! Is that...is that...a raccoon? That's EVEN COOLER!!

LS_Easter_Rare_Squirrel_01_Dialogue_01.value: Ah, I can see movement in a tree over there... but I cannot hear its song.

LS_Easter_Rare_Squirrel_01_Dialogue_02.value: This might be my chance to capture a truly exotic bird.

LS_Easter_Rare_Squirrel_01_Dialogue_05.value: That is a baby squirrel. And so cute!

LS_Easter_Ultimate_Calf_Dialogue_01.value: Ughhh, there's nothing here! If I don't find anything interesting soon I'm going to take a picture of a bird!

LS_Easter_Ultimate_Calf_Dialogue_02.value: Wait. What was that? Was that a... bell?

LS_Easter_Ultimate_Calf_Dialogue_03.value: Oh, wow! A miniature cow! Maddie's going to be so jealous.

LS_Easter_Ultimate_Chicks_01_Dialogue_01.value: This whole bird-watching thing is actually not as boring as I thought.

LS_Easter_Ultimate_Chicks_01_Dialogue_02.value: You need to be real quiet to spot them, like a spy.

LS_Easter_Ultimate_Chicks_01_Dialogue_03.value: AND I read that birds are like tiny dinosaurs!

LS_Easter_Ultimate_Chicks_01_Dialogue_04.value: My senses are tingling... There's something in a tree over there!

LS_Easter_Uncommon_Hedgehog_01_Dialogue_.value: You may know, Julius, that spring is the best time for bird-watching.
Correct, Maddie. Migratory birds returning to nest offer a veritable cornucopia of avian delights!
In fact, I think I can already see something in the grass!

LS_Easter_Uncommon_Puppy_Dialogue_01.value: Maybe I will find that Scarlet Tanager still. It's pretty rare, I think.

LS_Easter_Uncommon_Puppy_Dialogue_02.value: Although... it is fun to look down from the sky once in a while.

LS_Easter_Uncommon_Puppy_Dialogue_03.value: You never know what you might find, like...oh my gosh!

LS_Easter_Uncommon_Puppy_Dialogue_04.value: Isn't that the cutest puppy in the whole world?!

LS_Easter_VeryRare_Capybara_01_Dialogue_.value: Many birds love the water. I'm hedging my bets and heading towards the biggest splashes.

LS_EuropeanRobin_Dialogue_02.value: They are! But did you know there are nine subspecies of Robin?

LS_EuropeanRobin_Dialogue_04.value: And that Robins are so widespread that there are hundreds of millions of them across the globe?

LS_LuckySnap2024_AmateurCamera_Dialogue_.value: Can't we get closer to get a better photo?
Code of birding ethics stipulates that we must always be cautious around bird habitats.
Oh, that makes sense. There might be nests there.
Exactly, Maddie. You are a natural birder!

LS_LuckySnap2024_AtlanticPuffin_Dialogue.value: There is one more bird I wish we could spot - the Atlantic Puffin.
Does it look like penguin with a funny beak?
Then I've spotted it - right there on the cliffs!

LS_LuckySnap2024_BaldEagle_Dialogue_01.value: I know that one - it's the bald eagle!

LS_LuckySnap2024_BaldEagle_Dialogue_02.value: Very good, Maddie. It is indeed!

LS_LuckySnap2024_BaldEagle_Dialogue_03.value: I-is it looking straight at us?

LS_LuckySnap2024_BarnSwallow_Dialogue_01.value: Did you spot that barn swallow?

LS_LuckySnap2024_BarnSwallow_Dialogue_02.value: Look, one of them has made a nest in the roof of the Mansion!

LS_LuckySnap2024_BasicCamera_Dialogue_01.value: Now we are ready to begin!

LS_LuckySnap2024_BasicCamera_Dialogue_02.value: We need to get the perfect photo of each bird for our Life List!

LS_LuckySnap2024_BasicCamera_Dialogue_04.value: It is the complete list of all the birds we have spotted.

LS_LuckySnap2024_BasicCamera_Dialogue_05.value: That sounds fun! It's like we're collecting birds.

LS_LuckySnap2024_BasicCamera_Dialogue_06.value: It IS fun! You will be hooked before you even know it!

LS_LuckySnap2024_CameraCupboard_Dialogue.value: This is where I keep my BEST cameras and lenses...
I still don't understand why you need so many...
To capture the graceful flight of our most beautiful birds, Maddie, you need the very best equipment.
In that case, you're ready for anything!

LS_LuckySnap2024_CamoHat_Dialogue_01.value: I bet you see all kinds of things while you're bird-watching!

LS_LuckySnap2024_CamoHat_Dialogue_02.value: You are right about that! You know, I once saw... Oh, I cannot tell you.

LS_LuckySnap2024_CamoHat_Dialogue_03.value: You'll think I have gone loopy.

LS_LuckySnap2024_CamoHat_Dialogue_05.value: Well, I was once trying to spot a charming barn owl when I saw some flashing lights...

LS_LuckySnap2024_CamoHat_Dialogue_07.value: I cannot say, Maddie. But it was not a barn owl!

LS_LuckySnap2024_Hummingbird_Dialogue_01.value: What is that bird?? It's lovely - like a little fairy! I think I could watch it for hours.

LS_LuckySnap2024_Hummingbird_Dialogue_02.value: It is a hummingbird. I think you found your spark bird!

LS_LuckySnap2024_Hummingbird_Dialogue_04.value: Your spark bird! The bird that makes you fall in love with bird-watching!

LS_LuckySnap2024_Intro_Dialogue_01.value: Julius, what on earth are you doing, hiding in the bushes!?

LS_LuckySnap2024_Intro_Dialogue_04.value: Watching birds - there is a very rare one right behind yo--- Oh, well.

LS_LuckySnap2024_Intro_Dialogue_05.value: I'm sorry... I guess I scared it away.

LS_LuckySnap2024_Intro_Dialogue_06.value: It happens. Have you ever been birding, Maddie?

LS_LuckySnap2024_Intro_Dialogue_07.value: No - I mean, I like birds, but they're just kinda... there.

LS_LuckySnap2024_Intro_Dialogue_08.value: There is SO much more to our avian friends - and I can teach you all about it!

LS_LuckySnap2024_Intro_Dialogue_09.value: Welcome to the world of birding, Maddie!

LS_LuckySnap2024_MuteSwan_Dialogue_01.value: Mute swans mate for life. Their bonds are quite unbreakable!

LS_LuckySnap2024_MuteSwan_Dialogue_02.value: Of course... Even the birds have a better love life than some people around here...

LS_LuckySnap2024_ProCameraBag_Dialogue_0.value: Do you really need all of this stuff just to watch birds?
You need the right tools for the job, Maddie!
You can't just go winging it!

LS_LuckySnap2024_ProCamera_Dialogue_01.value: So, I just sit here with the camera, keep watching the birds... and then snap photos?

LS_LuckySnap2024_RockDove_Dialogue_03.value: Right there, on the bird feeder.

LS_LuckySnap2024_RockDove_Dialogue_04.value: All I can see is a big pigeon.

LS_LuckySnap2024_RockDove_Dialogue_05.value: Correct - and in Latin, it is called Columba livia.

LS_LuckySnap2024_SageGrouse_Dialogue_01.value: There's a strange looking bird on the ground... and another one! They look like they're about to have a fight!

LS_LuckySnap2024_SageGrouse_Dialogue_02.value: Well spotted! You can add sage grouse to your Life List.

LS_Peacock_Dialogue_01.value: Peacocks are nature's weathermen. They call out when it is going to rain.

LS_Peacock_Dialogue_03.value: Yes, indeed - but unfortunately they are not known for their beautiful song.

LS_Robin_Dialogue_02.value: They are! But did you know there are nine subspecies of Robin?

LS_Robin_Dialogue_04.value: And that Robins are so widespread that there are hundreds of millions of them across the globe?

LS_Shared_CameraFTUE_Description.value: <color=#338DFF>Merge the bird</color> with your Life List to log it and progress in the event.

LS_Shared_CameraFTUE_Header.value: You snapped a photo of a bird!

LS_Shared_End_Popup_Content_NoRewards_De.value: Thank you for coming along for a Lucky Snap - and keep your eyes open for more!

LS_Shared_ExtendPopup_Header.value: The Lucky Snap event is about to end!

LS_Shared_Extend_Popup_Offer_Title.value: Would you like to extend it?

LS_Shared_Extend_Popup_Rewards.value: Get these items as a bonus!

LS_Shared_Extention_Encouragement.value: Not finished yet? Extend the event!

LS_Shared_InfoPanel_Description.value: Keep merging to snap photos of birds and earn rewards!

LS_Shared_IntroPopup_Description.value: Birding is a blast - just try it! Snap photos of all the different types of birds, collect rewards and try to beat your own record!

LS_Shared_IntroPopup_Header.value: Get ready to snap the perfect photo!

LS_Shared_RewardPopup_WorldRecord.value: Wow! You have beaten the current World Record!

LS_Shared_Stars_Reward.value: New reward claimable in the <color=#338DFF>Life List</color>!

LS_Shared_StartPopup_Description.value: Help Julius spot different birds and snap the perfect photos for your Life List!

LS_Shared_TaskPlay_Description.value: Merge items to help Julius snap photos of birds!

LS_Shared_TaskPopup_Reward_Description.value: You have <color=#338DFF>new rewards</color> available in your Life List!

LS_Shared_TeasePopup_Description.value: You need to reach a <color=#338DFF>higher level</color> to play the event.

LS_Spring_CommonMourningDove_Dialogue_01.value: Aha! Do you recognize that bird, Maddie?

LS_Spring_CommonMourningDove_Dialogue_02.value: Of course, I do! It's a Mourning Dove. Also known as a Turtledove!

LS_Spring_CommonMourningDove_Dialogue_03.value: How strange we haven't seen one until now! They are quite common, after all.

LS_Spring_CommonMourningDove_Dialogue_04.value: Do you hear that call? Almost sounds like an owl! A sad one.

LS_Spring_CommonMourningDove_Dialogue_05.value: And if there's one, there's likely to be a lot more. Let's snap that picture!

LS_Spring_EpicBohemianWaxwing_Dialogue_0.value: What a beauty! Who is this little charmer?
A Bohemian Waxwing. Look at that crest!
Oh yes! I think I've seen this one. It eats berries, right?
Especially in winter. Sometimes it can get a bit dizzy on fermented berries.
A party bird! At least the hairstyle matches.

LS_Spring_Intro_Dialogue_01.value: Can you hear all those birds?

LS_Spring_Intro_Dialogue_02.value: It's quite a symphony, isn't it!

LS_Spring_Intro_Dialogue_03.value: There's nothing quite like the spring for a bird-watcher!

LS_Spring_Intro_Dialogue_04.value: Because you can finally wear shorts?

LS_Spring_Intro_Dialogue_06.value: Because of all the birds migrating back after the long winter.

LS_Spring_Intro_Dialogue_07.value: Every tree is full of life. All you need is a pair of binoculars and an adventurous spirit!

LS_Spring_Intro_Dialogue_09.value: Well, let's not scare the birds off back to their winter habitat!

LS_Spring_LegendaryWhiteBreastedNuthatch.value: Oh, my, do you hear that? I think…
Oh! That is a loud, loud little bird!
So it is! Did you know they sometimes travel in flocks with other birds, like titmice and chickadees?

LS_Spring_Outro_Dialogue_02.value: It seems like all the birds came back at once.

LS_Spring_Outro_Dialogue_03.value: I told you - spring is the best time for bird-watching.

LS_Spring_Outro_Dialogue_04.value: And I see you have turned into quite an expert.

LS_Spring_Outro_Dialogue_05.value: I have a great teacher, that's all!

LS_Spring_RareEurasianCapercaillie_Dialo.value: What in tarnation! Look at that!
Ummm. I don't know… some kind of grouse?
That, Maddie, is a Eurasian Capercaillie.
Oh, my! What vibrant plumage. And that eye!
It is all a part of its elaborate, and famous, courtship display.

LS_Spring_UltimateRoseateSpoonbill_Dialo.value: Look! Look at that beauty in pink!
Is that a flamingo? It can't be a flamingo?
That is a Roseate Spoonbill. Look at the shape of its bill.
Incredible! Does it also get its color from its diet, like the flamingo?
Right again, my dear. It comes from the crustaceans they eat. Fascinating, is it not?

LS_Spring_UncommonRedWingedBlackbird_Dia.value: Look at that beauty! What pretty wings!
Ah, yes! A Red-winged Blackbird. Endemic to all of North America.
That is correct, Maddie. Only the males have the distinctive red-and-yellow shoulder patch.
Got the shot! Thank you, sir!

LS_Spring_VeryRareArcticTern_Dialogue_01.value: Look Maddie! Do you see that little white bird?

LS_Spring_VeryRareArcticTern_Dialogue_02.value: I do! I got a picture, too.

LS_Spring_VeryRareArcticTern_Dialogue_03.value: That is an Arctic Tern. Look at its little black skullcap.

LS_Spring_VeryRareArcticTern_Dialogue_05.value: The Arctic Tern is famous for its migration, all the way from the Arctic to Antarctica!

LS_Spring_VeryRareArcticTern_Dialogue_06.value: It flies up to 25 000 miles per year.

LS_Summer2026_CommonHoodedWarbler_Dialog.value: Julius, look at that one! That's a Wilson's Warbler, right?
Close! It is a Hooded Warbler. Wilson's Warblers only have a small black cap, not a whole hood.
Watch for its white tail feathers when it displays them. That is another way you can tell.
Aw, shoot. I thought I was getting good at this.
You are, Maddie! I just happen to have, ahem, a few more decades of experience!

LS_Summer2026_EpicPipingPlover_Dialogue_.value: Oh! Oh! Maddie, you are getting your wish today! Look at that little fellow!
What little fellow? All I see is sand...
Look for the orange legs! That's a Piping Plover! They are extremely rare and extremely endangered!
I see it now! Let me snap a picture, you handsome little floofball...
Let's not get too close. If you ever see a Piping Plover that looks like its wing is broken...
...it's probably just trying to lead you away from its nest in the sand!
I'll be careful. I'm just happy to see one from afar!

LS_Summer2026_Intro_Dialogue_01.value: Ahhh! The sound of birds all around! Summer is here.

LS_Summer2026_Intro_Dialogue_02.value: Yes indeed, Maddie. And you know what that means.

LS_Summer2026_Intro_Dialogue_03.value: I do, Julius. I've got my camera bag, I've got my little foldable chair...

LS_Summer2026_Intro_Dialogue_04.value: I wonder what rare, exotic birds we'll see this time!

LS_Summer2026_Intro_Dialogue_05.value: Now, now, Maddie - every bird is special, whether or not it is rare or 'exotic'.

LS_Summer2026_Intro_Dialogue_06.value: I mean, I guess... but still, seeing something you've never seen before is always fun.

LS_Summer2026_Intro_Dialogue_07.value: Well, that is something I can guarantee. There is a vast world of birds out there waiting for us.

LS_Summer2026_Intro_Dialogue_08.value: ...and a few of them are likely to be exotic, right...?

LS_Summer2026_LegendaryBrownCreeper_Dial.value: We've been waiting forever, Julius! Where is this bird of yours?
Patience is a virtue, Maddie. You have been birding long enough to know that.
I know, I know. I'm just not sure what I'm supposed to see.
There! That's it! It just flew down to the bottom of that tree!
Happens to the best of us, my dear! Look - it's camouflaged against the bark. Now it's creeping upwards, slowly!
Oh! I see it now. Wow! It's just walking up that tree, isn't it?
Indeed! A Brown Creeper. They eat insects, methodically zigzagging up the trunks like that!
Well worth the wait, Julius. I'm sorry for doubting you!

LS_Summer2026_Outro_Dialogue_01.value: Another successful outing, even if I say so myself.

LS_Summer2026_Outro_Dialogue_02.value: It really was. I wish we could share this with more people.

LS_Summer2026_Outro_Dialogue_03.value: I have, ah, several times attempted to ask Ursula if she might be interested but...

LS_Summer2026_Outro_Dialogue_04.value: ...yeah, I've asked Grandma too. She said she 'prefers shooting of a different kind', whatever that means.

LS_Summer2026_Outro_Dialogue_05.value: Perhaps someone in the younger generation, then?

LS_Summer2026_Outro_Dialogue_06.value: Maybe! Or maybe we will just keep it as our special thing, eh, Julius?

LS_Summer2026_Outro_Dialogue_07.value: Nothing would delight me more, Maddie.

LS_Summer2026_RareEasternBluebird_Dialog.value: What a beauty - a bluebird, right?
Yes, my dear - an Eastern Bluebird, to be precise. Looks like it hasn't molted its bright blue feathers yet!
Look how it's perched, looking for insects to eat. They have incredible vision.
Also makes for a great pose for this photo!
Bluebirds can have several broods per year. Their later chicks even stay with them over winter, sometimes!
It's funny, lately I've been dreaming of bluebirds. Maybe I predicted getting this shot!
I see, I see. That warms my heart, Maddie...

LS_Summer2026_UltimatePaintedBunting_Dia.value: Julius! I think I saw a... a parrot?!
That can't be right. Unless it's somebody's escaped pet. Let me see...
Ah! No, Maddie, not a parrot. That is a type of cardinal! A Painted Bunting!
It's so colorful! I never thought I'd see something like this in our neck of the woods.
And he sings, too! Beautifully! We got very lucky today, Maddie.
Not luck, my friend, but perseverance and patience.

LS_Summer2026_UncommonEider_Dialogue_01.value: This one I know - that's an eider duck!

LS_Summer2026_UncommonEider_Dialogue_02.value: Yes, indeed, Maddie. It may look like a common duck, but it is quite famous.

LS_Summer2026_UncommonEider_Dialogue_03.value: Of course - eiderdown, used in pillows and blankets and such.

LS_Summer2026_UncommonEider_Dialogue_04.value: That is correct! Their latin name is Somateria mollissima, which means 'softest body'.

LS_Summer2026_UncommonEider_Dialogue_05.value: We have been collecting down feathers from eider nests since... well, since the 7th century, perhaps earlier!

LS_Summer2026_UncommonEider_Dialogue_06.value: Of course only kings could afford it.

LS_Summer2026_UncommonEider_Dialogue_07.value: ...I don't think that part's changed very much...I just looked up how much an eiderdown pillow costs!

LS_Summer2026_VeryRareBlackbilledMagpie_.value: Look at that tail, Julius! It's a little hard to see, but when the sun catches it just right...
A Black-billed Magpie! And yes, that is some impressive tail plumage.
They are said to be 'wearing the rainbow' according to Native American myth, as thanks for being so...helpful.
Helpful? Last time I was on a picnic, a magpie 'helpfully' tried to steal my sandwich!
Well now! They are very intelligent, sociable, and fearless birds, to be sure. I am always excited to see one.
Hmmm. If I feed it, do you think it'll bring me little shiny baubles?
Perhaps! Or perhaps it will steal some from you!

LS_Summer_BlueJay_Dialogue_01.value: I think I just saw a flash of blue in that big oak tree.

LS_Summer_BlueJay_Dialogue_02.value: You might have glimpsed a Blue Jay!

LS_Summer_BlueJay_Dialogue_04.value: Can you hear the song? Yes, that is definitely a Blue Jay.

LS_Summer_Crescent-CapedLophora_Dialogue.value: That black bird over there looks very odd!
Actually, I can tell you it's a Crescent-caped Lophorina.
Well, well! You are right! What an amazing display.
It is, right? The male uses its black coloring as a part of its courtship ritual.
And very effective it is, too!

LS_Summer_HerringGull_Dialogue_01.value: There is one bird you can always spot, even at this time of year.

LS_Summer_HerringGull_Dialogue_03.value: The Herring Gull! You can find it in our beautiful Bay, but it also enjoys spending time at garbage dumps and parking lots.

LS_Summer_Intro_Dialogue_01.value: Binoculars at the ready, Maddie. Let's go birding!

LS_Summer_Intro_Dialogue_02.value: I'm not sure there's any point...

LS_Summer_Intro_Dialogue_03.value: What on earth do you mean?

LS_Summer_Intro_Dialogue_04.value: Well, it's like all the birds have disappeared!

LS_Summer_Intro_Dialogue_05.value: Oh, no, my dear! They haven't disappeared... but they are laying low.

LS_Summer_Intro_Dialogue_06.value: You see, they did the hard work of migrating back and then formed families.

LS_Summer_Intro_Dialogue_09.value: Exactly! And they will emerge looking quite different.

LS_Summer_Intro_Dialogue_10.value: You just need to know where to look!

LS_Summer_Intro_Dialogue_11.value: So it's like we're levelling up?

LS_Summer_Intro_Dialogue_12.value: I'm not sure what you mean, but let's say yes!

LS_Summer_Kingfisher_Dialogue_01.value: Is that a small bird or a big dragonfly?

LS_Summer_Kingfisher_Dialogue_02.value: It's a Kingfisher. A very colorful and quick little bird.

LS_Summer_Kingfisher_Dialogue_03.value: It has a wonderful plumage, don't you think?

LS_Summer_Long-EaredOwl_Dialogue_01.value: Maybe we should head back - it's already getting dark.

LS_Summer_Long-EaredOwl_Dialogue_02.value: Not just yet... I heard there is a Long-eared Owl living in these woods.

LS_Summer_Long-EaredOwl_Dialogue_04.value: I can. It's a real hoot!

LS_Summer_PeregrineFalcon_Dialogue_01.value: Eek, we're so close to the cliffs. Maybe we should go back... Whoah!!

LS_Summer_PeregrineFalcon_Dialogue_03.value: The reason I brought you here. It was a Peregrine Falcon - one of the fastest birds in the world!

LS_Summer_PeregrineFalcon_Dialogue_04.value: Are you sure it was a bird? It was so fast it just looked like a flash of brown.

LS_Summer_PeregrineFalcon_Dialogue_05.value: Oh, yes! It is a real joy to watch.

LS_Summer_PileatedWoodpecker_Dialogue_01.value: Look at that huge hole in the tree trunk!

LS_Summer_PileatedWoodpecker_Dialogue_02.value: Was that made by a woodpecker?

LS_Summer_PileatedWoodpecker_Dialogue_03.value: You have good eyes, my dear. Yes, that is the handiwork of a Pileated Woodpecker.

LS_Summer_PileatedWoodpecker_Dialogue_04.value: But it's so even and almost... rectangular.

LS_Summer_PileatedWoodpecker_Dialogue_05.value: Indeed. And that hole will make a good home for another little animal.

LS_Summer_PileatedWoodpecker_Dialogue_06.value: Huh! It must be a good neighbor.

LS_Winter2024_Common_Mallard_01_Dialogue.value: I think there's a bird upside down in the water!
That is the Mallard. Birds that tilt upside down in the water to look for food are dabblers.
Dabblers? So they don't take it seriously?

LS_Winter2024_Epic_LongtailedTit_01_Dial.value: Why do you love birding so much, Julius?
It is the best mindfullness practice I know, my dear.
Enjoying the fresh air, the vitamin D, the wonderful wildlife. Birding is---
Wings and flutter! Hand me my binoculars, Maddie! Quickly!
A long-tailed tit - the fluffiest of all birds!

LS_Winter2024_Intro_Dialogue_01.value: Salutations, Maddie! Have you wrapped up warm?

LS_Winter2024_Intro_Dialogue_04.value: There are a great many wonderful birds you can spot even at this time of year.

LS_Winter2024_Intro_Dialogue_05.value: You just need a pair of binoculars and an adventurous spirit!

LS_Winter2024_Intro_Dialogue_06.value: A flask of hot chocolate is also very important.

LS_Winter2024_Intro_Dialogue_07.value: If there's hot chocolate involved, I'm there!

LS_Winter2024_Legendary_SnowyOwl_01_Dial.value: Be very quiet, Maddie. I just saw a Snowy Owl in a tree over there.
Yes, they are - but not the Snowy Owl.
Look! Isn't it wonderful and majestic?

LS_Winter2024_VeryRare_Cardinal_01_Dialo.value: Can you hear that birdsong? That is the Cardinal singing.
Did you happen to bring that bag of seeds?
Yes, it's in the bag, next to our lunch.
Why don't we serve him a little meal to get him closer...
I think it's working! I see him - and his great little hairdo!

LadyvPoster_01.value: "Claire Voyance. Mystic Medium and Lady Seer..."

LadyvPoster_02.value: "Get your fortune told! 10 percent off your first reading!"

LadyvPoster_03.value: I dunno... I'm still sort of iffy about someone who can tell your future by reading snow globes!

Landing1_01.value: Ugh... Why am I even doing this anymore?

Landing1_02.value: Why am I helping Grandma if she won’t even let me?!

Landing1_03.value: It's so frustrating that she still insists on hiding things! After everything that we've been through!

Landing1_04.value: The mansion is just like this family! The more I discover...

Landing1_06.value: Maybe I should just let them tear down the place for good!

Landing1_07.value: Why, hello. I hope I’m not interrupting...

Landing1_09.value: The name is Bruno Golightly. Mayor of Hopewell Bay.

Landing2_01.value: Mayor?! That makes you Victoria’s husband, doesn’t it?

Landing2_03.value: And what makes you think you can just waltz in here, like you own the place?

Landing2_04.value: Well... Funny you should put it like that.

Landing2_05.value: I'm here because I have a proposition for you!

Landing3_01.value: What proposition could you possibly have that would interest me?!

Landing3_02.value: This mansion of yours... I'm interested in taking it off your hands.

Landing3_03.value: I knew it! What do you people have against this mansion?! This is OUR property!

Landing3_04.value: Understood, but if I may ask... Why are you so intent on keeping this place?

Landing3_06.value: I couldn’t help but overhear you when I arrived, and it seems like you REALLY don’t like it here. Why stay?

Landing3_08.value: Ms. Boulton, with the money I’m willing to offer for this place, you could buy ANY house in all of Hopewell Bay!

Landing3_09.value: You could start fresh... With your grandmother!

Landing4_01.value: There's a difference between a house and home, Mr. Golightly. This place means a lot to my family.

Landing4_03.value: I can understand the attachment, but I think you misunderstand my intentions. I mean to preserve this wonderful home.

Landing4_05.value: I’m not a heartless businessman, you know. I believe Beaumont Hall is one of Hopewell Bay’s finest historical treasures.

Landing4_06.value: And I wish for it to remain that way.

Landing4_07.value: But Grandma... She’s um... in a little trouble and...

Landing4_08.value: I know all about your grandmother’s investigation and the unfortunate trouble she’s in.

Landing4_09.value: I am sure as mayor, I could help the police department see reason and stop this dreadful investigation.

Landing4_10.value: Besides, if I were to acquire Beaumont Hall, I wouldn’t want its heritage to be smeared by scandalous controversy.

Landing5_01.value: Y-you could make it all go away? I don’t know what to say...

Landing5_03.value: I have to admit, I’m slightly taken aback by the offer. It wasn’t what I was expecting. But...

Landing5_04.value: Now, Ms. Boulton, I understand this is a huge decision, but I would like to remind you that the investigation will eventually end.

Landing5_05.value: And it’s not looking too good for your grandmother. Time MAY be of the essence.

Landing5_06.value: I... I understand. Can I think about it?

Landing5_07.value: By all means. I have to take this call, it's the wife. When you’ve made your decision, don’t hesitate to reach out.

Landing5_08.value: I have big plans for Hopewell Bay. Huge! And they could include you and your family as well!

Landing6_01.value: Hey, wow! Was that Mayor Bruno?!

Landing6_04.value: He offered to buy the place and help with Grandma’s investigation.

Landing6_06.value: I said I’d think about it.

Landing6_07.value: Maddie... Are you sure? Mayor Bruno isn’t someone you should trust. He’s Victoria’s husband, after all.

Landing6_08.value: I know... I know. But... if there’s a chance to get Grandma out of this mess and maybe move into a place that isn’t falling apart...

Landing6_09.value: Isn’t that the reason I came here in the first place?

Landing7_01.value: Well, you’ve always had your family’s best interests at heart. So I know you’ll make the right decision.

Landing7_03.value: Don’t worry about it, and by the way... what is that smell?

Landing7_04.value: Oh, that? I think it may be the aquariums...

Landing7_05.value: But, don't worry. I'm working on it!

Landing7_06.value: This room is beyond intriguing, Jackie. That compass on the ground... it moves!

Landing7_07.value: Uh, are you sure you've been getting enough sleep, Maddie?

Landing7_08.value: Haha, I know how it sounds. Trust me, this room isn't like the others. Everything is interconnected!

Landing7_09.value: I'll have to see it to believe it!

LandingAquariums_01.value: It must be quite tricky to fix those leaks...

LandingAquariums_02.value: I have to admit, I've never had to fix an aquarium before.

LandingAquariums_03.value: Hmm... Maybe you can call in your plumber friend, Ash?

LandingAquariums_04.value: NO! The good thing is that Ash gave me all the knowledge I need for situations like these.

LandingIntro_01.value: Okay, let’s see what Grandma was trying so desperately to hide from me!

LandingIntro_02.value: Um, what is this place? There's so many vines and plants, it almost looks like it belongs outdoors.

LandingIntro_03.value: Ugh, and what is that musty smell?

LandingIntro_04.value: Well... There must be something in here worth discovering!

LandingTiles2_01.value: W-what?! I thought that compass on the floor was just a cool design...

LandingTiles2_03.value: I have never seen anything like this in the mansion before!

LandingTiles2_04.value: I feel like I'm in one of those video games that Mason always plays!

LandingTiles3_01.value: Hmm, well the compass didn't move this time, but all of its grooves are now filled with water too.

LandingTiles3_02.value: I think I'm on the right track!

LandingTiles4_01.value: Yes! I did it! Wow, that compass made the whole room shake!

LandingTiles4_02.value: Hmm, the arrow is still red though...

LandingTiles4_03.value: Oh no, no, no... the aquariums! They're leaking!

LandingTiles4_04.value: Are you sure you don't need a professional?

LandingTiles4_05.value: Yes! I'm pretty certain that all the tremors from the compass caused this...

LandingTiles5_01.value: Well, that went smoothly. Ha! Too bad Jackie wasn't here to see it.

LandingTiles5_02.value: One step closer, I have to get this compass in the right position.

LandingTiles6_01.value: Oh my gosh! What just happened! My head is spinning...

LandingTiles6_02.value: That has to be the most interesting reveal I've ever experienced in this mansion!

LandingTiles6_03.value: The arrow is finally blue! I never would have guessed there was a door hidden behind all that foliage.

LandingTiles6_04.value: It looks like everything is pointing to it now, even the water track! Whoever thought of that was a genius!

LandingTiles6_05.value: Now, all that's left is to get this ancient looking door open and discover what secrets have been so well protected.

LandingTiles_01.value: Hmm... This tile looks interesting. Almost like it's special.

LandingTiles_02.value: Why is it misaligned with the rest of the floor? Maybe I could try to jump on it so it goes back in place?

LandingTiles_03.value: Well, that didn't work. Hmm, what else...

LandingTiles_04.value: It does look like it's missing a piece.

LandingTiles_05.value: I guess I'll have to clean up some more if I'm going to find anything in here...

LeonardPoster_02.value: Why is he painted up like some sort of mob boss?

LeonardPoster_03.value: *Sigh* Sometimes I think my family is a little TOO into theatrics.

LeonardPoster_04.value: I hope it's only theatrics though...

Library02_02.value: Huh... It’s Leonard. What does HE want?!

Library02_04.value: You no-good scheming nobody... I don’t know how you pulled this off, but mark my words...

Library02_05.value: Excuse me! What are you talking about?!

Library02_06.value: Don’t play coy with me, little girl! Now it makes total sense why you came back!

Library02_07.value: You thought you could take MY mansion away from me?!

Library02_08.value: I was about to sign the deed away when it was suddenly discovered that ownership was transferred to YOU!

Library02_10.value: Oh, don’t worry. Bruno is on his way now to have you sign it away. You’ve only delayed the inevitable! *Click!*

Library02_11.value: How did I become the sole owner of the estate?!

Library03_03.value: I think you know why I’m here.

Library03_04.value: Yes. Leonard kindly informed me. And no, I won’t be signing anything today!

Library03_05.value: Oh, my dear Maddie... I don’t think you understand the grave situation you are in at the moment.

Library03_06.value: If you do not sign away this mansion to me, you and your grandmother will go to jail for a very long time.

Library03_08.value: Oh, but I can. I can do whatever I want. And I WANT this mansion.

Library04_01.value: Look... I’m running out of patience here, so I’ll do you a favor.

Library04_02.value: I’ll offer you one last time the chance to sign it, and I’ll make sure your grandmother’s investigation will end.

Library04_03.value: I’ll even offer a share of the profits so that you and your grandmother can move away and live comfortably.

Library04_04.value: Honestly, it’s a win-win scenario. You get to start over, your grandmother goes free...

Library04_06.value: That’s right. Everybody wins. No more police, no more investigation, no more renovating a dilapidated ruin, day after day...

Library04_07.value: But... This is our home. I’ve learnt so much about my family here.

Library04_08.value: And there’s still so much left...

Library04_09.value: Is it truly worth putting your grandmother and yourself in jail?

Library04_10.value: Just sign the paper and all of this goes away...

Library05_01.value: Don’t sign, Maddie! I found it! I found the proof!

Library05_03.value: This mansion is protected as a heritage site! I found these documents to prove it.

Library05_05.value: You would know, wouldn’t you? You tried to hide them! I had to pull a few favors, but found them in the end.

Library05_06.value: Mayor Bruno had these documents removed from the archives and deleted from the system on purpose so that he could start his little project!

Library05_07.value: Hah, you can’t prove any of that. In fact, I think you just lost your job! Now, if we could-

Library05_09.value: Victoria? Baby, I’m in the middle of something...

Library05_10.value: Slow down, slow down... What?! The police are there?! Well, don’t let them in!

Library05_11.value: They have a warrant?... Embezzlement and corruption? Just... Just don’t let them in the office!

Library05_12.value: Look, I’ll call the lawyer and I’ll be right there. *Click*

Library06_01.value: This isn’t over... I’ll make sure all of you go to prison for this!

Library06_02.value: I think you might have that a bit backwards, Mayor.

Library06_05.value: I might have called a friend at the police. Looks like they were investigating him for a long time.

Library06_06.value: What I discovered was exactly the evidence they needed to make a move on him.

Library06_07.value: Does this mean the mansion is safe?

Library06_08.value: Not entirely. As a heritage site, the council could potentially take it away from you...

Library06_09.value: but at least it won't be turning into a casino!

Library08_02.value: Excuse me, but who are you?

Library08_03.value: Er, I’m her fiancé. Who are YOU?

Library08_07.value: No choice?! You left me at the altar!

Library08_08.value: Do you understand how hard that was for me to do? What it took for me to leave the love of my life?

Library08_09.value: Stop it! You can’t just walk back as if nothing happened. I’ve moved on. Grandma was right about you.

Library08_11.value: Arthur? I thought I got rid of you...

Library09_03.value: But believe me, it was for a VERY good reason!

Library09_04.value: You have no idea what kind of man he is...

Library09_05.value: It’s not up to you to decide what’s best for me, Grandma!

Library09_07.value: Mads, don’t be angry at her. She was only looking out for you...

Library09_08.value: I don’t need YOUR endorsement, Arthur...

Library09_11.value: No... You need time with your “fiancé”.

Library10_02.value: You left me, Arthur. I can’t just forget that.

Library10_03.value: I understand... but please believe me, I never stopped loving you.

Library10_04.value: Arthur, I... I don’t know what to say... Or feel.

Library10_05.value: I’ll give you time... I’ll be staying in Hopewell Bay for a while. I want to...

Library10_06.value: I want us to work this out, Mads.

Library10_07.value: I want you to trust me again...

Library10_08.value: That’s enough, Arthur. You need to leave. Now.

Library10_10.value: What I really want is for everyone to just leave.

Library11_01.value: Hey, looks like there's something behind this portrait...

Library11_02.value: A book! Well that's not as surprising considering this is a library.

Library11_03.value: But, why is it hidden here?

Library11_04.value: It looks like it's just a book about women in history...

Library11_05.value: Wait, no, it's a book on famous female spies!

Library11_06.value: Hmm, this one woman in particular - Lily, looks a lot like Grandma when she was younger!

Library12_01.value: Huh, a hidden book, And it's inside a grandfather clock?

Library12_03.value: Let's see... Unsurprisingly, it's a book on clocks. Why was this hidden again?

Library12_04.value: Hold on, There are some pages at the back that are handwritten...

Library12_05.value: Seems to be about recording devices and cameras in watches! Fascinating!

Library12_06.value: Signed by a 'C'. I'm almost certain this was Charlie...

Library13_01.value: Wha- a knife? That's the last thing I expected to find in this book!

Library13_02.value: What is one supposed to do with this in a library?

Library13_03.value: Wait... that strange bust on the mantel!

Library13_04.value: I think that's where it goes...

Library13_06.value: This feels weird but here goes nothing!

Library14_01.value: I-it worked! Who would have thought?

Library14_02.value: Let's see what kind of book this fireplace was hiding...

Library14_03.value: Wow... it's a list of handlers and their spies!

Library14_04.value: This seems like information I shouldn't even know...

Library14_05.value: Hey, here's that Lily name again!

Library14_06.value: There's even a note about how this book should be burned if they're ever compromised!

Library14_07.value: Hmm, I'm going to have to make sure this book stays safe in here!

Library15_01.value: Well, this library certainly served as a good distraction from my predicament!

Library15_02.value: I might have read through a couple of books while I was renovating...

Library15_03.value: From what I gathered, other than being a cozy family library,

Library15_04.value: This place could have been connected to The Curiosity Fellowship or some kind of spy organization!

Library15_05.value: Anything is possible in this mansion, and in my love life, it seems...

Library15_06.value: I can't believe Arthur would just waltz back into my life like it was nothing!

Library15_07.value: And Roddy... I have no idea what he must think of me now.

Library15_08.value: Ugh, everything's a mess! Including parts of this mansion...

Library15_09.value: But, that at least I can fix!

Library15_10.value: I've been putting this off for a while because I wasn't sure I was ready...

Library15_11.value: But I think it's finally time to visit my old childhood room.

Library_Bookpyramid_02.value: I guess it’s for reading books, but I can’t help but feel like this belongs to...

Library_Bookwheel_02.value: Some consider this thing as the first search engine, which allowed easy cross-referencing of books.

Library_Bookwheel_03.value: An elegant feat of engineering, if I say so myself.

Library_Bust_01.value: Hmm this bust is a bit odd, why does it have a crack at the top?

Library_Bust_02.value: It almost looks like it's been stabbed...

Library_Chainedbook_01.value: A book with chains? That's excessive!

Library_Chainedbook_02.value: Hmm, could this be some sort of banned book?

Library_Chainedbook_03.value: Or is it full of secrets that are meant to be hidden?

Library_Charactertask1_02.value: Maddie, I came as soon as I heard what's going on, they can't do that!

Library_Charactertask1_03.value: I know! But I think Roddy has something that might help us.

Library_Charactertask1_04.value: Actually, that's why I'm here... I think I found something about Leonard!

Library_Charactertask2_02.value: I've been going through some old articles and discovered that Leonard was connected to some shady deals that went bad.

Library_Charactertask2_03.value: He was acquitted on all charges, but a lot of people went bankrupt because of it.

Library_Charactertask2_04.value: I can go talk to them if you want, but...

Library_Charactertask2_05.value: But this would mean that you'll write an article.

Library_Charactertask3_01.value: I won't sugar coat it for you, Maddie.

Library_Charactertask3_02.value: What I found out is pretty damning stuff. This'll be a hit piece, pure and simple.

Library_Charactertask3_03.value: And it won't help with your family's reputation. But it might get Leonard off your back for a while!

Library_Charactertask4_01.value: I've spoken to the people that were involved with the incident, and they've agreed to make a statement.

Library_Charactertask4_02.value: I'm heading over to the Bugle now to get the article ready for the editor.

Library_Charactertask4_03.value: Last chance to back out, Maddie.

Library_Charactertask4_04.value: No. If Leonard insists on playing dirty, lets see how he likes it!

Library_Charactertask5_03.value: They murdered my article! It was set to be a headline, but now it's just a short paragraph on the last page.

Library_Charactertask5_05.value: I'm sorry Maddie, but I don't think the article will do much good now...

Library_Charactertask5_06.value: It's alright... To be honest, I'm somewhat relieved. I really didn't want to stoop to their level.

Library_Charactertask5_07.value: Hmph... It was a good article too...

Library_Intro_01.value: Alright... Let’s see what this room has to offer.

Library_Intro_02.value: Hmm... plenty of books, a fireplace... run down couch...

Library_Intro_03.value: If I’d have to guess, I would say this place was some sort of library.

Library_Intro_05.value: I should take the time one day to go through all these books. Looks like some are based on the Boulton family...

Library_Intro_06.value: Perhaps there’ll be something in them that could shed more light on my family history.

Library_Ladder_02.value: You know you’re in a fancy library when they have one of these...

Library_Ladder_03.value: I must admit, these are really fun to climb!

Library_Mingus_01.value: This must be Grandma’s first cat... Mingus.

Library_Mingus_02.value: Or, as Julius would sometimes call it, Mingus the Merciless.

Library_Mingus_03.value: I guess he wasn’t much of a cat person.

Libraryminigameintro_01.value: These library books sure are disorganized!

Libraryminigameintro_02.value: None of them are even in the right sections.

Libraryminigameintro_03.value: Let's make sure they're back in order!

Libraryminigameoutro_01.value: Phew! That was hard work but someone had to do it!

Libraryminigameoutro_02.value: I can rest easy now that these books are well organized.

Lighthouse10_Ending_01.value: How did the riddle go? The one Granpa Charlie made you memorize?
How did the riddle go? The one Grandpa Charlie made you memorize?

Lighthouse10_Ending_02.value:
“Seldom noticed, often seen,
Come rain or shine, I keep you clean."

Lighthouse10_Ending_03.value:
"I am first to greet you to the chateaux,
Yet I am always last to see you go."

Lighthouse10_Ending_04.value:
"Just as secrets lie beneath the sea,
You will find one hidden beneath me.”

Lighthouse10_Ending_07.value: It means the key is under the doormat.

Lighthouse10_Ending_10.value: You can't mean that the Mansion key has been under the mat all this time?

Lighthouse10_Ending_13.value: Thanks, Heikki, I'll see you later.

Lighthouse1_Wizard_01.value: Alright, listen up. Here's everything I know about the wizard in the lighthouse...

Lighthouse1_Wizard_02.value: He's lived there alone for decades. The place is like his magic tower, or something.

Lighthouse1_Wizard_03.value: I heard he controls birds, and speaks some weird wizard language. He's a total weirdo, anyway.

Lighthouse1_Wizard_04.value: You should get on with your photography, Holden. I want to, uh, take a walk up there.

Lighthouse1_Wizard_05.value: Alright, but don't say I didn't warn you. And Maddie? You really need to get a jump on the mansion repairs...

Lighthouse1_Wizard_06.value: My boss really has it in for you, and you don't want to make an enemy of her. Bye!

Lighthouse1_Wizard_07.value: Ugh! Okay. Someone hiding up at the Lighthouse for years could be Grandpa Charlie! Let's find out.

Lighthouse2_Attheentrance_01.value: Alright, Maddie, you can do this! You're about to finally meet your grandpa!

Lighthouse2_Attheentrance_04.value: It's, well, it's Maddie! Your granddaughter.

Lighthouse2_Attheentrance_05.value: Maddie? I'm not your grandfather, I'm Heikki! But we should lift the cat onto the table together.

Lighthouse2_Attheentrance_06.value: Huh?! Who?! What does that mean?

Lighthouse2_Attheentrance_07.value: It is a saying in my birth country, Finland! It means we need to talk, so follow me.

Lighthouse2_Attheentrance_08.value: I'm not sure I should be following a weird stranger, but I really need to find out more!

Lighthouse3_Magpies_01.value: So, you thought I was Charlie, did you? The brave will eat the soup.

Lighthouse3_Magpies_03.value: Yes, it means you had the courage to find out! But, I'm not him, and I'm no wizard, either.

Lighthouse3_Magpies_04.value: Oh yeah. I heard about the wizard thing, and that it, uh, has something to do with birds?

Lighthouse3_Magpies_05.value: Ahaha! I do talk to the magpies that live around here.

Lighthouse3_Magpies_06.value: But don't worry! They don't talk back. At least, not English or Finnish.

Lighthouse3_Magpies_07.value: I thought they called me the wizard because I read a lot of fantasy books and have a wizard shaped weathervane on top of my sauna.

Lighthouse3_Magpies_08.value: But why do people think you're my grandpa? Did you know him?

Lighthouse3_Magpies_09.value: You could say that, yes indeed you could. Charlie Boulton saved my life!

Lighthouse4_Bookclub_01.value: You have to tell me how my grandpa saved you!

Lighthouse4_Bookclub_02.value: Oh, but to tell you that would be to pick the raisins out of the bun!

Lighthouse4_Bookclub_04.value: It means I would be telling you only the best part of my story with Charlie!

Lighthouse4_Bookclub_05.value: No. I'll tell you a little at a time. Starting over here, where we held our weekly reading club!

Lighthouse4_Bookclub_06.value: You and Grandpa were in a reading club?! What kind of books did you read?

Lighthouse4_Bookclub_07.value: You haven't guessed already? The wizard and his friend read fantasy together!

Lighthouse4_Bookclub_08.value: Now come with me, I want to show you another place.

Lighthouse5.1_Storm_04.value: It's alright, do you know what happened here?

Lighthouse5.1_Storm_05.value: Oh yes. A big storm came rolling in one evening and turned this place upside down!

Lighthouse5.1_Storm_06.value: My little friends had to relocate to the chimney and now I can't heat up my sauna anymore...

Lighthouse5.2_Weathervane_02.value: It looked so unique that it would have been a shame not to.

Lighthouse5.2_Weathervane_03.value: Yeah, Charlie had it made for us and our book club!

Lighthouse5.2_Weathervane_04.value: I guess the wizard is you then?

Lighthouse5.2_Weathervane_07.value: I wonder why Grandpa isn't up there?

Lighthouse5_Birds_03.value: I didn't know magpies were local to this area.

Lighthouse5_Birds_04.value: These aren't any old magpies you know… They're Finnish Magpies!
These aren't any old magpies you know... They're Finnish Magpies!

Lighthouse5_Birds_06.value: Hope wildlife services don't find out…
Hope wildlife services don't find out...

Lighthouse5_Birds_07.value: Yeah. A little piece of home!

Lighthouse5_Birds_08.value: You know that abandoned nest by the beach? It's filled with shiny objects!

Lighthouse5_Birds_11.value: One's own home is worth gold!

Lighthouse5_Birds_13.value: Hmmm. Maybe if I fix up the old nest…
Hmmm. Maybe if I fix up the old nest...

Lighthouse6_Atfireplace_01.value: Here we go, the place I first met Charlie. We were both very young men at the time.

Lighthouse6_Atfireplace_02.value: He was trying to swim around the Hopewell Bay coast, but it ended like the flight of the chicken.

Lighthouse6_Atfireplace_04.value: No! His attempt was short and unsuccessful. He almost drowned.

Lighthouse6_Atfireplace_05.value: So you saved him?! I thought he saved you!

Lighthouse6_Atfireplace_06.value: He did. But that was many years later...

Lighthouse7_Spoontocorner_01.value: Will you tell me how Grandpa saved you now?

Lighthouse7_Spoontocorner_02.value: Not yet! That is the sugar at the bottom.

Lighthouse7_Spoontocorner_03.value: I am saving it for last. You are as impatient as Ursula.

Lighthouse7_Spoontocorner_04.value: How do you know my grandma?!

Lighthouse7_Spoontocorner_05.value: We're in a knitting group together. I make sweaters for my magpie friends.

Lighthouse7_Spoontocorner_06.value: We first met at your grandpa's funeral, though.

Lighthouse7_Spoontocorner_07.value: I can't believe Charlie threw his spoon in the corner! He should not be dead.

Lighthouse7_Spoontocorner_08.value: Look, Heikki, I know we don't really know each other, and you, uh, talk to birds, but I need to tell you something...

Lighthouse8_Cinnamon_01.value: Okay. Thing is, Grandpa's not dead! In fact, he sent me on a quest.

Lighthouse8_Cinnamon_02.value: Before I say more, though, I'd really like to hear how Grandpa saved you.

Lighthouse8_Cinnamon_03.value: And I'll tell you! The news about Charlie has set me on a good wind.

Lighthouse8_Cinnamon_04.value: I'm in a very good mood now! Well, your grandpa was the only person who ever visited me here.

Lighthouse8_Cinnamon_05.value: One day he came and found me choking on a cinnamon roll!

Lighthouse8_Cinnamon_06.value: He saved me, and I'll be grateful forever for it.

Lighthouse8_Cinnamon_07.value: Sounds like you saved each other!

Lighthouse8_Cinnamon_08.value: Alright, Heikki. I'll tell you about Grandpa, then I need to ask you something else...

Lighthouse9_Riddle_01.value: This is a weird question, but did Grandpa tell you how to get into the Boulton mansion?

Lighthouse9_Riddle_02.value: No. But thinking of that old mansion is like thinking of the snow of last winter.

Lighthouse9_Riddle_03.value: I mean it is not worth talking about that place. It caused your family too many problems.

Lighthouse9_Riddle_04.value: I really need to get in, though! Please, what about clues, codes, riddles?

Lighthouse9_Riddle_05.value: Well, he did make me memorize a riddle once.

Lighthouse9_Riddle_06.value: A riddle? Could it be another clue?

LighthouseIntro_01.value: I feel strange about this. Could my grandpa really be hiding out at the Lighthouse?

LighthouseIntro_02.value: Ugh, why are you up here? You're supposed to stay away from the Wizard of the Lighthouse!

LighthouseIntro_03.value: Wizard? And what are you doing here?

LighthouseIntro_04.value: I've come to take more photos, obviously. Turns out I missed a few spots when I was here last time.

LighthouseIntro_05.value: I did get some amazing selfies in, though. Anyway, yeah, this place is rumor central and you should stay away!

LighthouseIntro_06.value: What rumors?! I need to know more before I go up!

LilReggie_PremiumRewardTip_Description.value: How lovely to meet you! You wouldn't happen to have any carrots?

LindsayPhoto_02.value: Ooh! It's Lindsay! And is she sitting on a fossil?

LindsayPhoto_03.value: She is! The very one that's displayed here...

LindsayPhoto_04.value: Only Lindsay can manage to look fashionable in the middle of an expedition!

LindsayPhoto_05.value: Imagine all the barriers she had to break through to make her mark!

LindsayPhoto_06.value: It makes me so proud to be her descendant.

Lipstick_01.value: Wow, this make-up collection is fancy!

Lipstick_03.value: Just like those spy movies I would watch when I was younger!

Lipstick_04.value: This is creepy. Suddenly, I don’t feel all that safe here...

Lounge02_01.value: Well, well, well... It looks like Holden was right.

Lounge02_03.value: Holden said you might be up to no good and you were more suspicious than usual.

Lounge02_04.value: What is this place anyway? It looks like a tacky casino...

Lounge02_05.value: Hmm, my husband's going to love this!

Lounge02_07.value: Poor little Maddie, ever so clueless. Anyway, I'm off to tell Bruno.

Lounge02_08.value: Victoria, wait. Be careful, the staircase isn't finished...

Lounge03_01.value: AHHH! My foot! My foot is stuck in the stairs!!

Lounge03_02.value: Oh no! Victoria, stay calm and stay still. You might injure yourself...

Lounge03_04.value: Victoria, please let me help you!

Lounge03_05.value: I've never needed anybody's help, and I'm not about to ask you...

Lounge03_06.value: This wouldn't have happened if your house wasn't in such disrepair!

Lounge03_08.value: I know this looks bad, but I only just started fixing up this room. The rest of the mansion-

Lounge03_09.value: Pfft! Excuses again. I should have torn down this monstrosity when I had the chance!

Lounge03_10.value: You'll be hearing from my husband soon enough. He'll take you through the plans.

Lounge03_12.value: And just so you know, these shoes are vintage Manuelo's! Expect a bill.

Lounge04_05.value: I'm not in the mood for any more arguments. I managed to get past the Gallery despite your interference!

Lounge04_06.value: I noticed, dearie. I actually came here to... apologize.

Lounge04_08.value: I might have been a bit too harsh on you.

Lounge04_09.value: But the answers you are seeking are just... too difficult to explain.

Lounge05_01.value: That picture, that day, was not one I take lightly.

Lounge05_02.value: Were you actually married to someone else? Are you both... still married?

Lounge05_03.value: I heard something about a mob...

Lounge05_05.value: My first husband was a mob boss.

Lounge06_01.value: It was a few years before I met your Grandpa Charlie.

Lounge06_02.value: This family, we were in a lot of financial trouble.

Lounge06_03.value: I'd just met a charming and successful young man, and he promised me the world.

Lounge06_04.value: Promised that he would get me out of any debt, but only if I married him.

Lounge06_05.value: I was young, and I thought I made the right choice. Only to find out who he really was...

Lounge06_06.value: I tried to get away, but it wasn't until I met Charlie that I truly had the strength.

Lounge06_07.value: He's had a target on our backs ever since...

Lounge06_08.value: Grandma... I don't know what to say...

Lounge07_01.value: I'm sorry I wasn't more understanding before. I feel terrible!

Lounge07_02.value: Our past is what makes us who we are, dearie. And maybe it's good for you to know.

Lounge07_03.value: I do hope you can forgive me...

Lounge07_04.value: Of course, Grandma! And don't worry, it may look like there are a lot of things against us...

Lounge07_05.value: But, us Boulton women are made of stronger stuff!

Lounge07_06.value: I'm glad we reconciled, Grandma. I hope we can continue to be more open with each other.

Lounge08_01.value: Hey, Maddie! Sorry about our earlier encounter. I had a... um important meeting to get to.

Lounge08_02.value: It's okay, Roddy, but you did seem a bit freaked out when you saw the photo of Grandma and that man...

Lounge08_03.value: Y-Yeah, I did! I mean... I thought Ursula was only married to one person... Charlie. It was a bit of a surprise.

Lounge08_04.value: That makes two of us. I tried to talk to her about it, but it ended up in a fight.

Lounge09_01.value: Wow! Look at all this cash!

Lounge09_03.value: Maybe someone was trying to get rid of evidence? Didn't do too good of a job it seems.

Lounge09_04.value: Who would leave money behind?! I think there's enough here to really help us out!

Lounge09_05.value: Umm, Maddie, I don't think this money is worth anything...

Lounge09_07.value: It's fake. The ink on counterfeit bills usually changes color when exposed to heat. You can see it on some of the burned ones...

Lounge09_08.value: Really? How do you know that?

Lounge09_09.value: I... Erm... I watch a lot of crime shows...

Lounge10_02.value: Sure do look like slot machines... But wasn't gambling illegal in Hopewell Bay until recently?

Lounge10_03.value: Yeah! One of Mayor Bruno's first changes once he took office was to abolish the anti-gambling law.

Lounge10_04.value: Hmm, interesting. So that means this entire place was some sort of secret casino!

Lounge10_05.value: This doesn't look good for your family, Maddie.

Lounge10_06.value: I know... But there must be more to the story. I'll get to the bottom of it!

Lounge11.2_02.value: Roddy, I didn't know you were still around...

Lounge11.2_04.value: Well, it looks like you got things handled here, so I'll head back to the office.

Lounge11.2_06.value: No no... maybe I'm just not good company.

Lounge11_01.value: Now, time to put my card skills to the test!

Lounge11_02.value: Oof, it feels good to finally sit down and get my mind off of things.

Lounge12_01.value: Ah, Maddie! Good to see you!

Lounge12_03.value: No pleasantries? I know that look. You spoke to my darling wife, Victoria, didn't you?

Lounge12_04.value: ... I did. She told me you have some plans for the mansion. What might they be?

Lounge12_05.value: Look, you're not going to like it. But believe me when I tell you that this will help everyone in Hopewell Bay.

Lounge12_06.value: Why do I have the feeling that this'll only help YOU out?

Lounge12_07.value: Well, I think a casino would be loved by many.

Lounge12_09.value: What can I say, I'm a businessman, Maddie. Nothing personal.

Lounge12_10.value: Because if it were personal... this would be a different conversation.

Lounge13_01.value: You'd be smart to be afraid of me. You don't know the kind of friends I have.

Lounge13_02.value: The answer is NO, Mayor. I'm not selling.

Lounge13_03.value: Look... Stop and think for once in your life. Why do you want to keep this old house? Vanity? Bring back the glory days?

Lounge13_04.value: The Boulton Empire is gone! Vanished. Turned to dust in the wake of progress.

Lounge13_05.value: It doesn't matter how many coats of paint you put on these walls, Maddie.

Lounge13_06.value: It won't cover up the truth that the Boultons were failures. Brought down by greed and hubris.

Lounge14_01.value: I'm tired of playing games, Maddie. So I'll make this simple.

Lounge14_02.value: Give me Beaumont Hall and maybe I'll leave you with just enough to hire a semi-competent lawyer.

Lounge14_04.value: You heard me. The deal to help your grandma is off the table. She's going to jail. That's just a fact. YOU, however, still have the chance to leave all of this unscathed.

Lounge14_07.value: Alright, alright. But, just so you know, your fate is sealed.

Lounge15.2_01.value: Will you look at that, I managed to revive the great Malzar!

Lounge15.2_02.value: *Bzzzt* "-*ome and listeN to the great Maaalllzaaar...."

Lounge15.2_04.value: *chhht* "Your dEstiny Lies in Wait...*bzzt* "To help, It isn't TOo late." *clink* "AliVe is the pOrtrait..."

Lounge15.2_05.value: Portrait? Huh... What does that mean?!

Lounge15_02.value: This looks vintage. I've never seen one of these up close. I wonder if I can fix it up...

Lounge16_01.value: Ma'am... It seems I found the intruder that was munching on all the foliage...

Lounge16_07.value: Yes, a runaway one, it seems. Quite stubborn. I managed to lead the rascal to the Ranch.

Lounge16_09.value: We have a ranch? This keeps getting more and more shocking...

Lounge16_10.value: Don't worry, Winston, I'm on it!

Lounge17_01.value: Hmm... I was about to throw this piece of paper out, but it looks important.

Lounge17_03.value: It's a cease and desist notice, addressed to Leonard!

Lounge17_04.value: Says here that they suspect he was running an illegal casino.

Lounge17_05.value: Well, they're not wrong. Looks like there was definitely an investigation.

Lounge17_06.value: But, wow! This explains why most of the things in this room were upturned. I guess this place was thoroughly searched...

LoungeIntro_01.value: Wow! This is... not what I expected to find.

LoungeIntro_02.value: Is it some sort of secret den? A casino?

LoungeIntro_03.value: It looks like this place was thoroughly searched though...

LoungeIntro_04.value: And why was the entrance cordoned off with tape? Was there an official investigation, perhaps?

MBE_DeckTheHalls2023Birthdaygrandmaacces.value: They say that fashion comes back in cycles.
Then this stuff should be pretty trendy soon!
You can't beat the classics, dearie!

MBE_DeckTheHalls2023Birthdayjewelry_02_0.value: What's this... Looks liks something's fallen behind the boxes...
Got it! This doesn't look like it belongs in a dusty basement...
I've been looking for this everywhere!!

MBE_DeckTheHalls2023Birthdayjewelry_05_0.value: Look what I found in a box with all the bags and hats! What a beautiful watch.
I remember that one! If I remember correctly, you can dive to 100 meters while wearing it!
Maybe someone has more use for it than you, Grandma...

MBE_DeckTheHalls2023Entrancenext_03_02.value: Do you have the key to open it, Grandma?

MBE_DeckTheHalls2023Entrancenext_03_04.value: I wonder what's on the other side! Family secrets, lost treasures...

MBE_DeckTheHalls2023Entrancenext_03_05.value: Apart from all the dust and cobwebs?

MBE_DeckTheHalls2023Fancycabinet_01_01.value: Wow! This room is FULL of stuff.

MBE_DeckTheHalls2023Fancycabinet_01_02.value: I think it's time we clear some space in here.

MBE_DeckTheHalls2023Fancycabinet_01_03.value: But all of this stuff is perfectly good... Do we have to give it away?

MBE_DeckTheHalls2023Floaties_07_01.value: Do you remember what a great time we had at your birthday party?

MBE_DeckTheHalls2023Floaties_07_02.value: Mmm, yes. Even though I said I didn't really need a party...

MBE_DeckTheHalls2023Floaties_07_03.value: You had a great time, I know it!

MBE_DeckTheHalls2023Floaties_07_04.value: I admit, I have had worse!

MBE_DeckTheHalls2023Giftbox_01_01.value: Oh, boy. There's a lot to wrap!

MBE_DeckTheHalls2023Giftbox_01_02.value: But we did find a LOT of treasures to give away. Now they can be treasured by someone else!

MBE_DeckTheHalls2023Giftbox_05_02.value: The basement is a little bit neater, we've got plenty of great presents all wrapped up, and we found the decorations.

MBE_DeckTheHalls2023Giftbox_05_03.value: Not bad, I have to admit.

MBE_DeckTheHalls2023House_01_01.value: Another door!! This place IS like a maze!

MBE_DeckTheHalls2023House_01_02.value: A house like this doesn't give up its secrets easily. You should know that, dearie!

MBE_DeckTheHalls2023House_01_03.value: Well, the only way is forward.

MBE_DeckTheHalls2023Intro_01.value: I think it's that time of year again...

MBE_DeckTheHalls2023Intro_03.value: We get to decorate the Mansion grounds for the festive season!

MBE_DeckTheHalls2023Intro_04.value: Lights, tinsel, ornaments... The whole works!

MBE_DeckTheHalls2023Intro_05.value: Hmmm... All of the decorations are in the basement - and you know what a maze it is down there!

MBE_DeckTheHalls2023Intro_06.value: Our family finds it hard to let things go...

MBE_DeckTheHalls2023Intro_07.value: You may be right, but we need to find the decorations.

MBE_DeckTheHalls2023Intro_08.value: Come on, get your flashlight. It'll be an adventure, and who knows what we'll find...

MBE_DeckTheHalls2023Packingsack_04_01.value: Tape, ribbon, paper... Here's everything we need to wrap the presents.

MBE_DeckTheHalls2023Packingsack_04_02.value: You know, I am excellent at wrapping presents. Do you want to have a little wrapping race?

MBE_DeckTheHalls2023Packingsack_04_03.value: I don't think that's in the spirit of the season, Grandma!

MBE_DeckTheHalls2023Perfumes_05_01.value: What an elegant bottle! Wasn't this a birthday present from Julius?

MBE_DeckTheHalls2023Perfumes_05_02.value: It was! He does have impeccable taste.

MBE_DeckTheHalls2023Perfumes_05_03.value: Someone is going to be so happy to have this!

MBE_DeckTheHalls2023Plushies_06_01.value: Look at all of these old toys!

MBE_DeckTheHalls2023Plushies_06_02.value: I've got an idea! Why don't we wrap these up and give them to Mason's class? That nice boy deserves a little holiday surprise!

MBE_DeckTheHalls2023Podcastequipment_07_.value: I think 'podcaster' is the number one dream profession among 12-year-olds today.
Well, maybe not. But hopefully someone will get some use out of this stuff!

MBE_DeckTheHalls2023Toys_06_01.value: Spinning tops, toy trains, puppets... This basement is like Santa's workshop.

MBE_DeckTheHalls2023Toys_06_03.value: Let's wrap it all up for a holiday delivery!

MBE_DeckTheHalls2023Xmasclothes_09_01.value: People complain about winter being cold...

MBE_DeckTheHalls2023Xmasclothes_09_03.value: They are just not dressed approriately!

MBE_DeckTheHalls2023Xmaspostcard_07_01.value: We have a whole bunch of lovely holiday cards, too.

MBE_DeckTheHalls2023Xmaspostcard_07_02.value: There's enough here to send a greeting to all of our friends.

MBE_DeckTheHalls2023Xmaspostcard_07_03.value: Let's send them. After all, good friends are card to find!

MBE_DeckTheHalls2023Xmastree_03_03.value: Well, yes, but we're on the right track.

MBE_DeckTheHalls2023Xmastree_05_02.value: I knew we had a bigger tree! It's better to have a tree you can use year after year, you know, instead of cutting down a brand-new tree every year.

MBE_DeckTheHalls2023Xmastree_07_01.value: Very nice, indeed! I just think...

MBE_DeckTheHalls2023Xmastree_09_01.value: I think we have everything we need for the tree.

MBE_DeckTheHalls2023Xmastree_09_02.value: There's ornaments, tinsel, the star... Looking good to me!

MBE_DeckTheHalls2023Xmastree_09_03.value: But this is just the start. I'm curious to see what else we'll find...

This really is the best holiday. Even the treats are better!
I completely agree. Here's to the holidays, Maddie!
Let's make it the best yet!

MME_MysteryMachine_Intro_Dialogue_03.value: I think you've managed to prod the old inventory and order system back to life.

MME_MysteryMachine_Intro_Dialogue_04.value: Maybe you should see if you can make some use of it, dearie?

MME_MysteryMachine_Start_Dialogue_01.value: But what exactly does it do?

MME_MysteryMachine_Start_Dialogue_02.value: It's one of Ignatius's old inventions... quite brilliant, actually.

MME_MysteryMachine_Start_Dialogue_03.value: But, the order system seems to think the tin can factory is still in operation...

MME_MysteryMachine_default_Dialogue_07.value: Ah... Now I remember why I turned it off.

MME_MysteryMachine_default_Dialogue_08.value: M- M- Maddie, w- will you help me?

MMM_02_01.value: Grandma, what's this about the council tearing down the mansion?

MMM_02_02.value: Oh, nothing you should worry about. Something about it being an eyesore and a hazard.

MMM_02_03.value: Well, I'm not about to let the council tear down our family's history!

MMM_02_04.value: If you insist, Maddie. This old wreck really isn't worth all that...

MMM_02_05.value: This is our legacy and as the last surviving Boulton it's my duty to be here.

MMM_02_06.value: And I'll restore it all to its old glory. No council will condemn our family home under my watch!

MMM_03_02.value: Hello! I was passing by and, uh, just wanted to see if everything's ok. You know, after the fire...

MMM_03_03.value: Are you trying to get this old place back in shape? You're brave. I've heard so many strange stories about it.

MMM_03_04.value: Strange stories? What do you mean?

MMM_03_05.value: Uh, just silly local rumors about the reason for it being so rundown. I didn't mean to make you angry...

MMM_03_06.value: Sorry - you didn't. I've just got a lot to do to restore the estate so the council won't condemn it.
Sorry - you didn't. I’ve just got a ton to do to get the estate back in shape before the council condemns it.

MMM_03_07.value: Ouch! The council here is tough. Especially the hot-headed Infrastructure Committee chair, Victoria.

MMM_03_08.value: Hot-headed, huh? Good thing I've been putting out fires all week. And just why would you help me, Mr...?
Maybe I can help out? I'm an architect, and I know a thing or two about renovating homes...

MMM_03_09.value: Took - Roddy Took. I've loved the look of this place since I moved into town. I'd hate to see it gone!
Hot-headed, huh? Good thing I've been putting out fires all week. And just why would you help me, Mr...?

MMM_03_10.value: Hmm. Well, I'm Maddie, and I may just take you up on your offer. Thanks!
Took - Roddy Took. I've loved the look of this place since I moved into town. I'd hate to see it gone!

MMM_03_11.value: Hmm. Well, I'm Maddie, and I may just take you up on your offer. Thanks!

MMM_FTUE_Done.value:
Amazing!
Grandma's house looks brand new!

MMM_FTUE_Intro.value: That looks like Grandma’s house! It's on fire! I've got to help put it out!

MMM_FTUE_Intro2.value:
It's on fire!
I need to help put it out!

MMM_FTUE_Intro_AB_Test.value:
Is that Grandma’s house?! It's on fire!
Let's put it out, quickly!

MMM_Intro_01.value: Oof! It took all night to clean all that soot, and Grandma's still not back from the police station.

MMM_Intro_02.value: Being called by the authorities is NOT how I expected to see her old house for the first time.

MMM_Intro_03.value: And what about that gated wall, just how big is Grandma's property?

MMM_Intro_04.value: That gate is locked for a reason, dear.
That gate is locked for a reason, dearie.

MMM_Intro_06.value: Don't look so surprised, Maddie. The police are not in the business of locking down kind old ladies.

MMM_Intro_07.value: But you looked so worried! And what was that message about? Who is "alive"?

MMM_Intro_08.value: We can talk about that later. Don't you wanna see our family's old mansion first?
We can talk about that later. Don't you want to see our family's old mansion first?

MMM_Intro_09.value: You know I do! You're the one who's always kept our past under lock and key.

MMM_Intro_10.value: Well, you should see it at least once before the council tears it down. I'll go get the keys.

MMM_Variant_Cutscene_Intro_01.value: It took all night to clean the soot. I didn't expect Grandma's old house to be on fire when I was called here!

MMM_Variant_Cutscene_Intro_02.value: Hmm, there's even a gated wall - just how big IS this property? And why was it kept a secret from me?

MMM_Variant_Cutscene_Intro_03.value: That gate is locked for a reason, dearie.

MMM_Variant_Cutscene_Intro_04.value: Grandma! Where were you?! I can't believe you've been hiding this place-

MMM_Variant_Cutscene_Intro_05.value: Calm down, dearie. We can talk about that soon. Don't you want to see our family mansion first?

MMM_Variant_Cutscene_Intro_06.value: Oh, wow! You bet I do!

MaB_EndingPopup_NoRecipeEnding.value: You’ve crafted everything you can for now. Thanks for playing Mix a Booster!
