Maddieroom_02_03.value: Over? OVER?! It isn't over until I DECIDE it is! Do you hear me?!

Maddieroom_02_04.value: Because of YOU, my precious Bruno is now rotting in a jail cell!

Maddieroom_02_06.value: You have no idea who and what you're dealing with, Maddie!

Maddieroom_02_07.value: But I'll make sure you and your grandmother learn by the end of it... Oh, I'll make sure!

Maddieroom_02_10.value: Who was that, dearie? I could hear their voice in the hallway!

Maddieroom_03_01.value: It was Victoria... She's basically vowed revenge upon us.

Maddieroom_03_02.value: Don't worry about her, dearie. She's had it out for our family for a long time...

Maddieroom_03_03.value: I wonder what brought that on...

Maddieroom_03_04.value: Victoria's family and ours have a... history.

Maddieroom_03_05.value: It's just a part of life in small towns like Hopewell Bay.

Maddieroom_03_07.value: Looks like you finally decided to visit your old room.

Maddieroom_03_09.value: I remember how you'd play for hours in here!

Maddieroom_03_10.value: You'd gather up all your toys for elaborate tea parties on that little table.

Maddieroom_03_11.value: Ha... I don't really remember that.

Maddieroom_03_12.value: You were only four at the time... I'm sure as you fix up the place, some memories will come back to you.

Maddieroom_04_02.value: And over there I would build a huge pillow fort with...

Maddieroom_04_04.value: Ah, yes. Michael really liked building things with you.

Maddieroom_04_05.value: He sort of hoped you'd get into engineering... I guess he was right.

Maddieroom_04_08.value: Can you tell me about them? About my parents?

Maddieroom_04_09.value: I... I have glimpses of them. Short snapshots of their faces, being happy.

Maddieroom_04_10.value: But... I don't know anything about them. You never...

Maddieroom_05_01.value: Michael and Rebecca were the most loving parents you could ever hope for.

Maddieroom_05_02.value: Everything they did was for you Maddie, all their decisions...

Maddieroom_05_03.value: Even the ones I... I didn't approve of.

Maddieroom_05_05.value: Please, don't let me go into that. I'll tell you another time...

Maddieroom_05_06.value: Okay... What else can you tell me about them?

Maddieroom_05_07.value: They were very creative! When they put their heads together, they could do just about anything.

Maddieroom_05_08.value: I see a lot of that creativity in you, Maddie.

Maddieroom_05_09.value: And they always saw the best in people!

Maddieroom_05_10.value: They sound lovely, exactly as I imagined....

Maddieroom_05_12.value: I... I want to know about the accident.

Maddieroom_05_13.value: I want to know about the night my parents...

Maddieroom_06_02.value: I sometimes have strange dreams, like I was right there...

Maddieroom_06_03.value: I see a fire... I try reaching out, my eyes stinging.

Maddieroom_06_04.value: I'm just about to reach them when...

Maddieroom_06_06.value: But I know that's silly and-

Maddieroom_06_07.value: No Maddie... It's not silly at all.

Maddieroom_06_10.value: You were there the night Michael and Rebecca died...

Maddieroom_07_03.value: There was an awful fight between your father and I.

Maddieroom_07_04.value: By the end of it, he stormed out and drove you and your mother home.

Maddieroom_07_05.value: I felt guilty and didn't want to leave it there, so I took my car to follow him back.

Maddieroom_07_08.value: Fire?! So... I didn't just dream it...

Maddieroom_08_03.value: And that's when I heard you crying! You were in the back seat.

Maddieroom_08_04.value: I pulled you out before the fire engulfed the whole car...

Maddieroom_08_05.value: And after that... there was nothing more I could do...

Maddieroom_08_07.value: It's alright, dearie. I've had a lot of time to think about it.

Maddieroom_08_08.value: I know I did the right thing in saving you first. But...

Maddieroom_08_09.value: But you still feel guilty for having the fight.

Maddieroom_09_01.value: If we wouldn't have had that fight, Michael would not have charged off.

Maddieroom_09_03.value: Grandma, it's okay. It wasn't your fault.

Maddieroom_09_04.value: But it was... I'm consumed by guilt.

Maddieroom_09_07.value: No, Grandma. You saved me! How could I blame you for that?

Maddieroom_10_01.value: Do you hear that? I think it's Winston...

Maddieroom_10_02.value: Yes, sounds like it's something urgent-

Maddieroom_10_03.value: I'll take care of it, dearie. I'll give you some space to process your feelings...

Maddieroom_10_04.value: Alright, Winston, I'll be right with you!

Maddieroom_10_05.value: Maddie, I am so proud of you. You are so much like your parents!

Maddieroom_10_06.value: Headstrong and brilliant. Just don't let the past hold you back.

Maddieroom_11_02.value: It looks like something I know...

Maddieroom_11_03.value: I think I've had dreams about this-

Maddieroom_11_04.value: Wait! That's it. I remember Mom playing this before bedtime!

Maddieroom_11_06.value: It's just like I remember it...

Maddieroom_12_01.value: I didn't expect to feel this many emotions before I entered my old room...

Maddieroom_12_02.value: Grief is a funny thing. It really creeps up on you sometimes.

Maddieroom_12_03.value: I do wish my parents were around. I know I could use their advice on a number of things...

Maddieroom_12_04.value: But, I also know now that I'll be okay with the love and support of my friends and family.

Maddieroom_12_05.value: I'm really glad Grandma was here to guide me through this... As she always is.

Maddieroom_12_06.value: Connecting with my roots makes me want to continue renovating this mansion...

Maddieroom_12_07.value: It helps me feel closer to them. I can't wait to see what else I can uncover about them!
It helps me feel closer to my parents. Speaking of which...

Maddieroom_12_08.value: I wonder if I missed something at the cemetery. There has to be some little thing connected to them!

Maddieroom_12_09.value: Perhaps I should take a closer look at the mausoleum...

Maddieroom_Blanket_02.value: I remember how cozy it felt when Mom and Dad tucked me in.

Maddieroom_Blanket_03.value: I felt so safe and loved...

Maddieroom_Charactertask2_01.value: Shouldn’t you be outside, taking pictures of the mansion or...

Maddieroom_Charactertask2_04.value: Actually... Do you do house calls?

Maddieroom_Charactertask3_01.value: Well, if you insist on being in here, documenting every little thing...

Maddieroom_Charactertask3_04.value: But... But wait! I need to take pictures!

Maddieroom_Charactertask4_01.value: Seriously Maddie, I got to get back to taking pho-

Maddieroom_Charactertask4_03.value: I’m not a gardener! I’m a photographer!

Maddieroom_Charactertask4_04.value: I thought you said you were a journalist?

Maddieroom_Charactertask5_01.value: Fine! You win! I’m heading back to my desk.

Maddieroom_Charactertask5_04.value: How much would it cost to have you come and clean my de-

Maddieroom_Charactertaskintro_02.value: What are you doing in here?!

Maddieroom_Charactertaskintro_03.value: Getting the scoop on the biggest story in town! I’m a journalist, after all.

Maddieroom_Charactertaskintro_04.value: ... Oh, and Victoria sent me. Boy, you sure made her angry!

Maddieroom_Charactertaskintro_06.value: Oh, come on... You won’t even notice me.

Maddieroom_Frogplush_01.value: Wait a minute! This is... This is...

Maddieroom_Frogplush_03.value: I’m actually quite embarrassed at how many times I gave him a kiss so that I could have a friend to play with.

Maddieroom_Frogplush_04.value: Oh, Princey! I'm so glad to see you again!

Maddieroom_Hopscotch_02.value: I bet I made quite the racket to whomever was below...

Maddieroom_Hopscotch_03.value: Hmm... Maybe I should give it a go again?!

Maddieroom_Intro_01.value: I guess I've avoided this room long enough...

Maddieroom_Intro_04.value: It figures, in a way... my old room is a mess...

Maddieroom_Intro_08.value: Maddie. I will make you pay, if it's the last thing I do!

Maddieroom_Lumpybear_01.value: Oh, dear... This teddy seems to have had a rough time.

Maddieroom_Lumpybear_03.value: Okay... I blame Grandma’s cat for this one.

Maddieroom_Minigameintro_01.value: Stepping into my own childhood room has surely awakened my inner child!

Maddieroom_Minigameintro_02.value: This doll house is so adorable! It’s a miniature Beaumont Hall!

Maddieroom_Minigameintro_03.value: Wait a minute... I see a letter etched into the bottom of the wood!

Maddieroom_Minigameintro_04.value: L? This must have been Lindsay's!

Maddieroom_Minigameintro_05.value: How I wish I had this when I was younger...

Maddieroom_Minigameintro_06.value: Well, nothing's stopping me from playing house now!

Maddieroom_Minigameoutro_02.value: And I even managed to restore this vintage dollhouse in the process.

Maddieroom_Minigameoutro_03.value: I'm glad I got to add my own personal touch to it, just like the actual mansion!

Maddieroom_Musings_01.value: This room sure is bringing back a lot of memories...

Maddieroom_Musings_03.value: I admit, I was very young, but still...

Maddieroom_Musings_04.value: I was very happy in here!

Maddieroom_Portraitparents_01.value: Aaw... I must have made this when I was in daycare.

Maddieroom_Portraitparents_02.value: Mom and Dad, and me in the middle.

Maddieroom_Smudgedphoto_01.value: Hey! A photo of my parents!

Maddieroom_Smudgedphoto_02.value: But... Why are the faces smudged with paint?

Maddieroom_Smudgedphoto_03.value: *sigh* It looks like a small hand did this...

Maddieroom_Smudgedphoto_04.value: I... I must have been angry at them for leaving me.

Maddieroom_Teddybears_03.value: Either I never played with them...

Maddieroom_Toyplane_01.value: I sure had a lot of toys!

Maddieroom_Toyplane_02.value: Especially mechanical ones, like this plane.

Maddieroom_Toyplane_03.value: I remember how Dad insisted on getting me this.

Maddieroom_Toyplane_04.value: He used it to teach me the parts of a plane!

Maddieroom_Toyplane_05.value: Judging by the dents on this thing, it looks like I literally tried to make it fly.

Maddieroom_Toytrunk_01.value: Wow, looking at all these toys, I'm sure now that I must have been pretty loved...

Maddieroom_Toytrunk_02.value: It looks like dear Mom and Dad bought me the whole store!

Maddieroom_Wallpaper_01.value: Amazing! This color really livens up the place!

Maddieroom_Wallpaper_02.value: And I have flashes of this room having yellow wallpaper.

Maddieroom_Wallpaper_03.value: I guess my parents always knew my favorite color!

Maddieroom_Yellowarmchair_01.value: I remember waking up some nights from nightmares...

Maddieroom_Yellowarmchair_02.value: And Mom would soothe me back to sleep, holding me in this chair.

MaintenanceRoom_BlackmailingBrother_01.value: Here's the truth... Your brother Leonard has been blackmailing me for many, many years.

MaintenanceRoom_BlackmailingBrother_02.value: When I lost my job here, Leonard caught me taking something for myself. He kept it secret in exchange for my help.

MaintenanceRoom_BlackmailingBrother_03.value: His, ahem, habits have rather gotten the better of him. Over the years, he has made me steal several things from your estate.

MaintenanceRoom_BlackmailingBrother_05.value: My brother has a problem with gambling. Specifically that he enjoys it too much, and doesn't know when to stop.

MaintenanceRoom_BlackmailingBrother_06.value: When our parents died, he was given money instead of a share of the estate, as they didn't trust him.

MaintenanceRoom_BlackmailingBrother_07.value: They were right. He lost all the money, and fast. If he's fallen back on his old ways, things must be bad.

MaintenanceRoom_BlackmailingBrother_08.value: I am deeply sorry, Madam Ursula. You'd be well within your rights to call the authorities and report me.

MaintenanceRoom_BlackmailingBrother_09.value: What are you going to do, Grandma?

MaintenanceRoom_ButlerFirstSeen_01.value: Oh my! Who are you, and what are you doing in my house?

MaintenanceRoom_ButlerFirstSeen_02.value: Your house? I don't know who you are, young lady, but this is most certainly not your house.

MaintenanceRoom_ButlerFirstSeen_03.value: This house belongs to the noble Boulton family.

MaintenanceRoom_ButlerFirstSeen_04.value: It's been in their family for hundreds of years, and still is!

MaintenanceRoom_ButlerFirstSeen_05.value: Exactly - and I'm Maddie Boulton! So you'd better tell me why you're here, and, oh my goodness...

MaintenanceRoom_ButlerFirstSeen_06.value: Are you stealing silver candlesticks from our house?

MaintenanceRoom_ButlerFirstSeen_07.value: Madam, I'm a butler, and a butler never steals. I was simply, ahem, polishing these. Now, if you'll excuse me--

MaintenanceRoom_ButlerFirstSeen_08.value: Not so fast! You'd better explain yourself, and quickly.

MaintenanceRoom_LeonardBoulton_01.value: Well? Who are you, and why are you stealing silverware from my family house?

MaintenanceRoom_LeonardBoulton_02.value: As I have clearly stated, I am a butler. A butler to the Boulton family, I might add.

MaintenanceRoom_LeonardBoulton_03.value: I am, ahem, employed by Leonard Boulton, and under his instruction to take these candlesticks.

MaintenanceRoom_LeonardBoulton_04.value: Leonard Boulton? Who on earth is Leonard Boulton?

MaintenanceRoom_LeonardBoulton_05.value: He's the last remaining Boulton heir.

MaintenanceRoom_LeonardBoulton_06.value: I already told you that I'm a Boulton heir! And so's my Grandma, Ursula.

MaintenanceRoom_LeonardBoulton_07.value: I'm going to get her over here to settle this!

MaintenanceRoom_MaddieDiscoversSecretEnt.value: Hmmm... That’s strange. There are just bare bricks here.
Wait a minute! Is it a sealed entrance? It must have led inside the Mansion!

MaintenanceRoom_MaddieDiscoversTheTrunk_.value: Looks pretty old. I wonder what’s inside...

MaintenanceRoom_MaddieFinishesRenovation.value: There! All done! Grandma’s going to be so happy to see this.
Now I'm going to try to forget about that old trunk and continue outside!

MaintenanceRoom_MaddieOpensTheTrunk_01.value: Let's see what's inside this trunk. Whoa! It's filled with valuable items…
Let's see what's inside this trunk. Whoa! It's filled with valuable items...

MaintenanceRoom_MaddieOpensTheTrunk_02.value: Hey! These must all be something Mr. Winston stole from the Mansion!

MaintenanceRoom_MaddieOpensTheTrunk_04.value: I should put everything back where it belongs.

MaintenanceRoom_MaddieOpensTheTrunk_05.value: Well… I’m not sure where exactly everything belongs… but I’m sure going to try!
Well... I’m not sure where exactly everything belongs... but I’m sure going to try!

MaintenanceRoom_MaintenanceRoomIntro_01.value: What's that noise coming from the old side entrance?!

MaintenanceRoom_MaintenanceRoomIntro_02.value: It sounds like someone is inside our mansion!

MaintenanceRoom_MaintenanceRoomOutro_01.value: Where did Winston go?! It was like he vanished into thin air.

MaintenanceRoom_MaintenanceRoomOutro_02.value: He's probably gone back into the house!

MaintenanceRoom_MaintenanceRoomOutro_03.value: But he definitely didn't open the door, and it looks like it's bricked up on the other side!

MaintenanceRoom_MaintenanceRoomOutro_04.value: There's no way into the main mansion from here.

MaintenanceRoom_MaintenanceRoomOutro_05.value: Strange. Guess he found one of the old secret entrances then!

MaintenanceRoom_MaintenanceRoomOutro_06.value: Secret entrances? Huh? Where are they?

MaintenanceRoom_MaintenanceRoomOutro_08.value: Why do I get the feeling she's hiding something - again!

MaintenanceRoom_NotTheButlerUrsulaRememb.value: Do you hear that noise? It sounds like a, ahem, cat! In distress! You should go and find it.
Oh, dearie, I know a ruse when I hear one. We're blocking your way out, and we aren't moving for any fake cat!
Now. I'm guessing my no-good brother sent you here. What else have you taken? I can't believe it would just be two candlesticks.
Oh, very well. He has requested my assistance several times over the years. To help collect a few knick-knacks.
You've stolen more of our stuff than just this?! That's it, I am calling the police.
Hang on a moment. This isn't like you, Winston. You were always so gentle, so nice.
We all loved you. I mean, your dad was our dad's butler, and then he passed on the torch to you.
I can't imagine what our dads would think, knowing you'd robbed us like this...
Oh, fine! I'll tell you everything. But you're not going to like it.

MaintenanceRoom_UrsulaMeetsWinston_01.value: There you are, Grandma! I caught this guy stealing our candlesticks. He says his name is--

MaintenanceRoom_UrsulaMeetsWinston_03.value: My word, is that Madam Ursula? I, ahem, I thought you were dead!

MaintenanceRoom_UrsulaMeetsWinston_04.value: Well, as you can see I'm alive and kicking, dearie. What are you doing here?

MaintenanceRoom_UrsulaMeetsWinston_05.value: He's stealing from us! He even made up someone called Leonard Boulton.

MaintenanceRoom_UrsulaMeetsWinston_06.value: I'm sad to say that Leonard isn't make-believe. He's my brother!

MaintenanceRoom_UrsulaMeetsWinston_07.value: Brother? Grandma, you never told me you had a brother before! I knew about your sister Deb, but a brother?

MaintenanceRoom_UrsulaMeetsWinston_08.value: In fact, forget about it. I think we should get the police over!

MaintenanceRoom_UrsulaMeetsWinston_09.value: Do you really want the police here, after your recent troubles?

MaintenanceRoom_UrsulaMeetsWinston_10.value: What recent troubles? Don't try to confuse me!

MaintenanceRoom_UrsulaMeetsWinston_11.value: You'd better spill the beans, or I really will call the cops.

MaintenanceRoom_WinstonVanishes_01.value: Should we call the police about Winston's theft, Grandma?

MaintenanceRoom_WinstonVanishes_02.value: I don't think so, dearie. In fact, Winston, you can take the candlesticks.

MaintenanceRoom_WinstonVanishes_03.value: To be honest, I always suspected that something like this was happening.

MaintenanceRoom_WinstonVanishes_04.value: I love my brother, despite his flaws, and I care about you too. I just hope this helps him.

MaintenanceRoom_WinstonVanishes_05.value: I... well, thank you, Madam. If it's any consolation, I do think that Master Leonard is getting better.

MaintenanceRoom_WinstonVanishes_06.value: Getting better? He blackmailed you! That doesn't sound too good to me.

MaintenanceRoom_WinstonVanishes_07.value: Perhaps not, but I have a soft spot for him. We grew up together, and he is my best friend, despite everything.

MaintenanceRoom_WinstonVanishes_08.value: Thank you again. I truly am sorry, but it was a pleasure to see you, Madam Ursula, and to meet you, Maddie.

MaintenanceRoom_WinstonVanishes_09.value: Well, I guess it was nice to meet you--

MaintenanceTools14_Description.value: Sometimes you gotta break it first.

MapDiscovery_01.value: Hey, what's this? There's an old map buried under all the debris here.

MapDiscovery_02.value: Ooh, it looks like Lindsay's adventure map!

MapDiscovery_03.value: How fun would it be to retrace her steps. It would surely help me understand this gallery better!

MazeDialogue_A_01.value: Okay, maze! What am I supposed to do now? Let's see what Grandpa's notebook says.

MazeDialogue_A_02.value: So there's the drawing of the maze, and on the next page there's a series of numbers.

MazeDialogue_A_03.value: Some of them look like coordinates, but the other numbers?! I've no idea!

MazeDialogue_A_04.value: Salutations, Maddie! How are you on this fine day?

MazeDialogue_A_05.value: Oh, hi Julius! I'm alright. I'm just looking through my grandpa's old notebook.

MazeDialogue_A_06.value: Goodness, really? Oh, the secrets that must hold. He had a brilliant mind, that Charlie.

MazeDialogue_A_07.value: He was an inventor too, you know, and keen to prove that he was worthy the Boulton name.

MazeDialogue_A_08.value: An inventor, huh? I wonder if these numbers I found could be for an invention of his?

MazeDialogue_A_09.value: May I see? You know, I think you're right! These look to me like dimensions.

MazeDialogue_A_10.value: Amazing! I'm going to try and build this, but I'd better keep looking around the maze, too!

MazeDialogue_B_01.value: Julius... my grandpa, uh, left me some instructions for a scavenger hunt which led me to find this notebook.

MazeDialogue_B_02.value: Do you know why he'd do that instead of just telling me outright where to find it?

MazeDialogue_B_03.value: He always loved treasure hunts and suchlike! I believe he even wrote love-letters to Ursula in, ACHOO! code.

MazeDialogue_B_05.value: Oh, how ACHOO delightful, your furry friend is ACHOO here now.

MazeDialogue_B_06.value: Rufus, if you're coming to find out how I'm getting on with Grandpa's design, then the answer is badly!

MazeDialogue_B_07.value: I don't even understand what it is. I'm going to keep trying to make it, though, and exploring this maze!

MazeDialogue_C_01.value: Maddie, darling, it's me! The woman who puts the "Great" in "Great Aunt!"

MazeDialogue_C_02.value: Aunt Deb! What are you doing here?

MazeDialogue_C_03.value: I'm here to look after my sister, of course. I read all about her thrilling brush with the law.

MazeDialogue_C_04.value: And Julius, so good to see you. But you're so happy to see me that you're crying? Delightful.

MazeDialogue_C_05.value: It's my ACHOO allergies! And I really must be going. Goodbye, Deborah.

MazeDialogue_C_06.value: He always was a sensitive one. Just us girls now, huh Maddie? You can catch me up on things.

MazeDialogue_C_07.value: Uh, okay! I'm just going around the maze. You can join me if you like.

MazeDialogue_D_01.value: Deb? What are you doing here?

MazeDialogue_D_02.value: I'm here to help you after your arrest, of course!

MazeDialogue_D_03.value: I don't need any help, thank you very much. I keep telling Maddie that I'm fine, too.

MazeDialogue_D_04.value: While I have you both, can either of you answer a question?

MazeDialogue_D_05.value: Julius said that Grandpa Charlie liked codes and things. Do either of you know why?

MazeDialogue_D_07.value: I know the answer! And it's a good one, dearie.

MazeDialogue_E_01.value: Well, Grandma? Why did Grandpa Charlie like codes and puzzles so much?

MazeDialogue_E_02.value: His mother was a codebreaker in World War II, and she passed her skills down to him.

MazeDialogue_E_04.value: She was an amazing person. She had to keep her job a secret for the whole of the war!

MazeDialogue_E_05.value: Anyway, she taught your grandpa everything she knew, until he was almost as good as her.

MazeDialogue_E_06.value: She was a formidable woman. I didn't think you got along with her though, Ursula?

MazeDialogue_F_01.value: Why didn't you get along with Grandpa's mom, Grandma?

MazeDialogue_F_02.value: I was just scared of her. I mean, who can compete with a war hero?!

MazeDialogue_F_03.value: Neither of our families wanted Ursula and Charlie to get married, either. But they did!

MazeDialogue_F_04.value: And I'm glad of it! Anyway, I'm off to join my knitting club - want to come, Deb?

MazeDialogue_F_05.value: Knitting isn't my style! No, I saw a cute mailman on the way over. I think I'll go and chat with him.

MazeDialogue_F_06.value: Now that they've gone, I can get back to figuring out what Grandpa wanted me to do here!

MazeDialogue_G_01.value: Hi Maddie! Nice maze. Looks like a good place to, uh, spend some time getting lost together...
Hi, Maddie! Nice maze. Looks like a good place to, uh, spend some time getting lost together...

MazeDialogue_G_02.value: Huh? I guess so, but I'm here to figure out what this new quest my grandpa sent me on is!

MazeDialogue_G_03.value: New quest? What do you mean?

MazeDialogue_G_04.value: I found a notebook at the end of my grandpa's scavenger hunt, and now I'm trying to decode what it all means.

MazeDialogue_G_05.value: He left dimensions and some diagrams in it, but I can't get them to 'make' anything. Take a look!

MazeDialogue_G_06.value: I don't know what they mean, but I, uh, think I know what this drawing is.

MazeDialogue_G_07.value: You might not want to hear my opinion on it, though.

MazeDialogue_H_01.value: Well, Roddy? What did you see in the notebook?

MazeDialogue_H_02.value: It was one of the little sketches. It reminded me of the gold watch you showed me.

MazeDialogue_H_03.value: You know, the one that I took a photograph of and showed around town.

MazeDialogue_H_04.value: The one that got my grandma thrown in jail!

MazeDialogue_H_05.value: Uh, that's it. There's a tiny sketch of it beside the drawing of the maze, I'm sure of it.

MazeDialogue_H_06.value: Wait, you're right! I didn't even notice. I was so busy looking at the maze itself.

MazeDialogue_H_07.value: Oh my! This has given me an idea, and I think I should go to the old conservatory next!

MazeDialogue_I_01.value: And there we are! One amazing sundial, courtesy of Grandpa Charlie.

MazeDialogue_I_02.value: I got the idea from the watch! I figured this had to be another timepiece.

MazeDialogue_I_03.value: I've positioned it exactly on the coordinates he gave me, too. But... there's no clue here!

MazeDialogue_I_04.value: Is there anything else in his notebook?

MazeDialogue_I_05.value: Yes! There are sketches from a few other places around the estate.

MazeDialogue_I_06.value: Maybe you should take a look at them and see if there are more clues scattered about?

MazeDialogue_I_07.value: Great idea! The next sketch in his notebook is of the old greenhouse - so I'm going there next!

MazeDialogue_J_01.value: And there we are! One amazing sundial, courtesy of Grandpa Charlie.

MazeDialogue_J_02.value: I got the idea from the watch! I figured this had to be another timepiece.

MazeDialogue_J_03.value: I've positioned it exactly on the coordinates he gave me, too. But... there's no clue here!

MazeDialogue_J_04.value: Is there anything else in his notebook?

MazeDialogue_J_05.value: Yes! There are sketches from a few other places around the estate.

MazeDialogue_J_06.value: Maybe you should take a look at them and see if there are more clues scattered about?

MazeIntro_01.value: So... I found this old notebook that belonged to Grandpa, and I think he wanted me to come here.

MazeIntro_02.value: He used to love scribbling in that old thing! Where did you find it?

MazeIntro_03.value: Honestly? It was the 'prize' at the end of the scavenger hunt he sent me on!

MazeIntro_04.value: I told you to drop that, Maddie! That can't have been Charlie, alright?

MazeIntro_05.value: But Grandma, I'm sure it was! How else would I have found the notebook.

MazeIntro_06.value: I don't know, and I don't want to know!

MazeIntro_07.value: Hmm. Sorry Grandma, but this is too important! I'm going to find out what's in this maze.

Migration_MosaicReturn_Description_Long.value: Do you remember the beautiful mosaic you worked hard to merge? Grandma might have a need for it, after all. So, keep an eye out. It might appear back in your pouch - and don’t sell it!

Migration_MosaicReturn_Description_Short.value: Psst! There’s something on the way…
Psst! There’s something on the way...

MiniBarrel_01.value: It’s my old piggy bank! Er... Barrel bank?

MiniBarrel_02.value: That’s pretty cute. Is it filled with your family's riches?

Moths_01.value: Ooh, what an interesting collection! Was this Lindsay's?

Moths_02.value: Indeed, ma'am. Lindsay Boulton was a lepidopterist!

Moths_03.value: That's a person who studies moths and butterflies, right?

MusicianCharacterOutro_03.value: Yes! It’s all here! Proof that this Mansion is protected as a heritage site!

MusicianCharacterOutro_05.value: But I still need to verify these, just in case.

MusicianCharacterOutro_06.value: Remember the string I had to pull?

MusicianCharacterOutro_07.value: Well, it's an old friend of mine. We both owed each other a few favors.

MusicianCharacterOutro_08.value: Some of the stuff I helped them with was... odd.

MusicianCharacterOutro_09.value: Remind me to never work at a restaurant again!

MusicianCharacterOutro_10.value: Alright, thanks again, Roddy. I'll be waiting...

MusicianCharacterTask1_01.value: Maddie! I found out that family members of people who built this mansion are still alive.

MusicianCharacterTask1_02.value: They might know something, but they said I need to help them with some errands first.

MusicianCharacterTask1_03.value: Trying to earn some brownie points?

MusicianCharacterTask1_04.value: A tried and tested method, Maddie. Tried and tested...

MusicianCharacterTask2_02.value: It took a bit of work, but I think I found something!

MusicianCharacterTask2_03.value: Her great-great-grandfather was a supervisor for the Mansion’s construction.

MusicianCharacterTask2_04.value: She let me look through some old designs and papers, and I found the name of an accountant.

MusicianCharacterTask2_05.value: They might have more details, if not the documents we need, but...

MusicianCharacterTask2_06.value: But they need your help first?

MusicianCharacterTask3_03.value: The accountant had some important documents, which finally led me back to City Hall.

MusicianCharacterTask3_04.value: But when I opened the file box... They were missing!

MusicianCharacterTask3_05.value: But didn’t you say they were disorganized?

MusicianCharacterTask3_06.value: No, Maddie, this box was behind a lock and key.

MusicianCharacterTask3_07.value: Those files were taken away! That’s illegal!

MusicianCharacterTask3_09.value: Well... I have one last thread to pull, but... it’ll cost me.

MusicianCharacterTask3_11.value: Don't worry about it. Just an old friend.

MusicianCharacterTaskIntro_01.value: Roddy, you’re back so soon! Did you find the documents?

MusicianCharacterTaskIntro_02.value: No... Not yet. A lot of the files for the older buildings in Hopewell Bay are disorganized.

MusicianCharacterTaskIntro_03.value: It almost seems as if on purpose. No one at city hall nor the archives can be bothered to go through them.

MusicianCharacterTaskIntro_04.value: I’m doing my best to check, but a lot of the archived files have been thrown into the basement.

MusicianRoomAmplifier_02.value: This is definitely some high-quality equipment!

MusicianRoomAmplifier_03.value: It also looks like it was customized...

MusicianRoomAmplifier_04.value: Huh, the maximum volume on this device is 11? I didn’t know that was possible!

MusicianRoomAwards_01.value: For such a recluse, they sure won a lot of awards...

MusicianRoomBubbleChair_01.value: I’ve seen some of these designer chairs around... I think they were really popular in the 70s.

MusicianRoomBubbleChair_02.value: Maybe not exactly to my taste, but somehow it really ties this room together!

MusicianRoomBubbleChair_03.value: I wonder if Julius has any more of these?

MusicianRoomElectricGuitar_03.value: A suitable replacement for my old guitar, which I lost in the fire...

MusicianRoomFloor_01.value: Ugh... Linoleum... If there’s anything I hate, it’s linoleum.

MusicianRoomFloor_02.value: A mansion is no place for such... tackiness. As Winston would say.

MusicianRoomFramedJacket_01.value: This varsity jacket has been framed and signed!

MusicianRoomFramedJacket_02.value: I can’t figure out the name, but this must be someone the musician admired!

MusicianRoomGoldRecord_01.value: “Homegrown in Hopewell Bay”... Oh wow! This must be the gold record for the hit!

MusicianRoomGoldRecord_02.value: The name is a bit faded, but I can make out an E... for Eddie!

MusicianRoomMixTapes_01.value: These must be all his mixtapes!

MusicianRoomMixTapes_02.value: I... don’t recognize any of the songs...

MusicianRoomOldWalkman_01.value: Oh, sweet! An old portable cassette player!

MusicianRoomOldWalkman_02.value: I remember fixing Grandma’s old one many times!

MusicianRoomOldWalkman_03.value: Although, it tended to eat a lot of tapes afterward...

MusicianRoomSheets_01.value: Ooh, what's this? These look like music sheets...

MusicianRoomSheets_02.value: I-I think it's the original sheet music for the hit song!

MusicianRoomSheets_03.value: But it's only part of it. The rest seems to be spread around the room.

MusicianRoomSheets_04.value: I wonder if the musician did this in a fit of rage...

MusicianRoomSheets_05.value: I should collect these sheets and put it back together. Maybe I could even try to play the piece!

MusicianRoomStudioSection_01.value: This studio has some impressive equipment!

MusicianRoomStudioSection_02.value: But many almost look like they’re prototypes...

MusicianRoomStudioSection_03.value: Where did he get his hands on all this stuff?

MusicianRoomStudioSection_04.value: Or did he build it himself?

MusicianRoomTinCanLight_01.value: How cool! A light fashioned out of tin!

MusicianRoomTinCanLight_02.value: And it looks just like the Boulton cans...

MusicianRoomYellowSpeaker_02.value: As an audiophile myself, I reckon it has a real rich sound.

Musicianroom02_01.value: You called, ma’am? I assume this has something to do with the construction workers outside...

Musicianroom02_02.value: Yes! Winston, do you think you can deal with the mayor's cronies and tell me what they’re up to?

Musicianroom02_04.value: Well... I should head back to city hall and see if I can’t find those documents.

Musicianroom02_07.value: With everything that’s happened... and is happening, I don’t think I’ve properly ever had the chance to thank you.

Musicianroom02_08.value: Oh, don’t mention it... I’m only-

Musicianroom02_09.value: No Roddy, listen to me... Thank you. You’ve had my back ever since we’ve met.

Musicianroom02_11.value: You’ve always been around to help me, never doubted me... You’ve been the best!

Musicianroom03_01.value: The thing is, Maddie... I - I think you're an amazing person.

Musicianroom03_02.value: Aw shucks, Roddy! You're amazing too...

Musicianroom03_04.value: Maddie... The real reason I... We... Maddie, I think I'm in l-

Musicianroom03_06.value: What the- a message from ARTHUR?!

Musicianroom04_02.value: I know you’re still upset... You have every right to be, but you must believe me when I say that I had no choice.

Musicianroom04_03.value: I wish I could go back to that day and change things.

Musicianroom04_04.value: Every day, I regret what I did to you... But things will change.

Musicianroom04_05.value: I hope to see you soon, Mads... This time, it will be different. - Arthur”

Musicianroom04_07.value: I can’t believe he sent me a message after all this time!

Musicianroom04_09.value: I guess I have to think about it.

Musicianroom04_10.value: Wait, what were you saying earlier? Before the text?

Musicianroom04_11.value: That I... I got to get back to the office.

Musicianroom06_01.value: Hmm... This place looks more like a music studio than anything else!

Musicianroom06_02.value: I wonder what type of music was made in here?

Musicianroom06_03.value: And who this person was, for that matter!

Musicianroom06_04.value: Ooh, I think they were someone famous! It could be the one who made that hit single - Homegrown in Hopewell Bay!

Musicianroom07_01.value: Look at all this amazing vintage stuff!

Musicianroom07_02.value: Holy smokes, some of this is even signed by the original musician!

Musicianroom07_03.value: I could really make a fortune selling some of this...

Musicianroom07_05.value: He’d have a field day in here!

Musicianroom08_01.value: Dearie, who are all these people outside in hard hats?

Musicianroom08_02.value: For a moment, I thought we were being ambushed by an army of Roddys.

Musicianroom08_03.value: They’re Bruno’s people. Hopefully Winston has slowed them down.

Musicianroom08_04.value: If there’s anything he’s capable of doing well, it is slowing things down.

Musicianroom08_05.value: Good. Then we might just have enough time to save the mansion!

Musicianroom08_07.value: That’s right, Grandma! Roddy has found a way to save the mansion!

Musicianroom08_09.value: He says the mansion was declared a heritage site, but he needs to find the documents to prove it.

Musicianroom08_10.value: I always knew that boy was bright!

Musicianroom10_01.value: Is everything alright with you, dearie? You look like you’ve seen a ghost!

Musicianroom10_02.value: You could say that. I just received a text from Arthur!

Musicianroom10_06.value: Oh nothing, dearie... I'm mixing things up.

Musicianroom10_08.value: Grandma, I've been meaning to ask about the resident of this room...

Musicianroom10_10.value: Ah yes, they called him the "Musical Maverick."

Musicianroom10_11.value: But his real name was Eddie. A distant cousin and quite the recluse!

Musicianroom10_12.value: Eddie went through a time where fans would chase him wherever he went and linger around his studio.

Musicianroom10_13.value: Sounds like he was really popular...

Musicianroom10_14.value: Yes, but he was so terribly fed up that he asked if he could record here, at the mansion.

Musicianroom10_15.value: Charlie and I were happy to help. We have plenty of rooms!

Musicianroom10_16.value: We never really saw much of him, though. But we did hear plenty of music!

Musicianroom12_01.value: But what happened to him, Grandma? Does he still make music?

Musicianroom12_02.value: Oh, I don't think so, dearie. It's not a pleasant story...

Musicianroom12_03.value: Well, Eddie had a sudden rise in popularity after his hit, and he needed a record label.

Musicianroom12_04.value: He signed a contract with a smooth-talking record executive, even though he wasn't so sure.

Musicianroom12_05.value: Oh no, I don't like the sound of this...

Musicianroom12_06.value: The label started to act strange, taking over creative control.

Musicianroom12_07.value: According to the contract, he was still obliged to write and perform four songs under the label.

Musicianroom12_08.value: That's what those other songs were! What happened then?

Musicianroom12_09.value: He made sure those songs were nothing like his first hit, and the label couldn't publish it.

Musicianroom12_10.value: After that, he left and never made music again.

Musicianroom13_01.value: So if Eddie hadn't signed with that record label, he might still be making music today...

Musicianroom13_02.value: I-I can't help but sympathize with him. After all, I am in a similar situation.

Musicianroom13_03.value: And this proves that I should never take Bruno and Victoria's deal.

Musicianroom13_04.value: If I do, we could lose everything in a moment.

Musicianroom13_05.value: Yes, dearie. It is a valuable lesson, and I'm glad you can see through their facade.

Musicianroom13_06.value: Never ever give away your power, my dear.

Musicianroom13_07.value: You're right. Thanks, Grandma! I needed to hear this.

Musicianroom14_01.value: Phew! That's the last of the music sheets!

Musicianroom14_02.value: I have a better understanding of Eddie's rage and why these sheets were scattered around now.

Musicianroom14_03.value: I would be furious, too, if I were him.

Musicianroom14_04.value: Hmm... The notes are a bit smudged, but I'm pretty sure I can read them.

Musicianroom14_05.value: I wonder if my piano skills are any match for this award-winning masterpiece...

Musicianroom14_06.value: Wow, that rhythm! So catchy and very much from the 80s!

Musicianroom14_07.value: Hey, wait, there's a section here that requires an electric guitar!

Musicianroom14_08.value: That's all the motivation I need to try out that fancy guitar next!

Musicianroom15_01.value: The guitar isn't even plugged in, and wow... it feels powerful.

Musicianroom15_02.value: Is this how musicians feel onstage? How thrilling!

Musicianroom15_03.value: The sound is so crisp. I bet this guitar is modified as well.

Musicianroom15_04.value: I'd love to see how it sounds with that fancy amplifier though.

Musicianroom15_05.value: That red button is calling out to me...

Musicianroom15_06.value: W-what just happened.... I-I'm shaking... And covered in dust!

Musicianroom15_07.value: Wait, that door! It has to be the way to the next room!

Musicianroom16_01.value: Well, that was certainly one of the more interesting ways of finding an exit...

Musicianroom16_02.value: I'm still a bit shaken up. The amplifier was way more powerful than I thought.

Musicianroom16_03.value: And it's possible that I didn't calibrate it right...

Musicianroom16_04.value: Well, I'm glad Eddie isn't around to see the mess I created.

Musicianroom16_05.value: I should get all of this cleaned up!

Musicianroom18_01.value: Phew, that was some heavy lifting. Now, to see what's behind this door...

Musicianroom18_03.value: Ugh, this better not be Arthur...

Musicianroom18_04.value: Hello? Winston? I'm kind of in the middle-

Musicianroom18_05.value: Slow down, I can't hear you.

Musicianroom18_07.value: At the ranch?! Why would they be there?!

Musicianroom18_08.value: You've got to be kidding me. Does it ever end?

MusicianroomAmplifier2_01.value: Hmmm, I don't know too much about amplifiers but...

MusicianroomAmplifier2_02.value: I think this part goes here?

Musicianroom_Intro_01.value: Wow... Who would hide a room like this behind a fridge?

Musicianroom_Intro_02.value: Maddie, there you are! Wait, did I just walk through a fridge- Wow!

Musicianroom_Intro_03.value: Yeah, more secret rooms. Who would have thought! What is it, Roddy?

Musicianroom_Intro_04.value: Well, you won’t believe it, but I think this mansion is protected!

Musicianroom_Intro_05.value: It certainly is! I’ll do anythin-

Musicianroom_Intro_06.value: No! I mean historically protected! As in protected by the state!

Musicianroom_Intro_07.value: Maddie, I might have found documents that confirm THIS mansion is a historical heritage site!

Musicianroom_Intro_09.value: That means it can’t be torn down, changed, or even touched by Bruno!

Musicianroom_Intro_11.value: Well, hold your horses. I still need to find the original documents and blueprints. They seem to have been “misplaced.”

Musicianroom_Intro_13.value: Yeah... I’m pulling some strings to see if I can scrounge them up.

Office02_02.value: Shame, I don’t think I can fix this one. I don’t think they even make the parts anymore.

Office02_03.value: Wait! I see a name on the side. Charlie Boulton! This was Grandpa’s!

Office02_04.value: I bet this was HIS office!

Office02_05.value: I wonder what he was working on in here...

Office03_01.value: There we go. All fixed up.

Office03_02.value: This desk will see new days again!

Office03_04.value: Don’t really want to work on an old busted up typewriter, anyway.

Office04_02.value: I... I thought it was just a dream, but it’s real!

Office04_03.value: I would crawl through it and think I was transported into a wizard’s tower with all their amazing knick knacks!

Office04_04.value: But I was only visiting Grandpa all this time! Ha! He always looked like a wizard.

Office05_02.value: And very... modern. Actually, there’s some real genius in them!

Office05_03.value: It’s a clock of some kind, but I can’t quite tell. It almost feels like it came out of a steampunk book.

Office05_04.value: I think there’s enough here for me to follow these designs and rebuild this invention!

Office06_01.value: Ah! Good thing I didn’t have to start from scratch!

Office06_02.value: This must have been the prototype Grandpa was working on in his designs.

Office06_03.value: Now that it’s complete, I still can’t quite recognize what type of clock it is...

Office07_01.value: Hmm... this looks like Charlie's trophy shelf...

Office07_02.value: Wait a minute... I know just what to place here!

Office07_03.value: I’ve never really had my own trophy shelf, but I've been meaning to celebrate fixing up the Mansion.

Office07_04.value: I've come so far and it only feels right to commemorate my journey!

Office07_05.value: And here... here feels just right! I'm sure Charlie would approve too!

Office08_01.value: Uhm... Maddie? Could I speak to you for a sec?

Office08_03.value: Look, I’m sorry for what happened. I... I don’t know what got into me!

Office08_04.value: Roddy, I’m not in the mood to hear apologies right now, alright?

Office08_06.value: No, seriously! You, of all people! Getting into a fight?!

Office08_07.value: I thought you were smarter than that.

Office09_01.value: No. You tell me right now why I should accept your apology.

Office09_02.value: Tell me what is going on with you!

Office09_06.value: Oooh, you’re in big trouble now!

Office09_07.value: I know your family is up to something, but breaking into the precinct and stealing evidence?!

Office09_08.value: That’s a new low. Even for you!

Office10_01.value: Stealing evidence? Why would I ever want to incriminate myself like that?

Office10_02.value: Obviously not! That’s why you had your criminal grandmother steal it for you!

Office10_04.value: The gold watch, of course! The audacity too! I guess I was getting too close, right? Was I?

Office10_06.value: Oh, is it Roddy? Would make sense that YOU’d be in on this, too.

Office11_02.value: Afraid you’ll disappoint little Maddie over there?

Office11_03.value: Then again, you always were comfortable around criminals, weren’t you?

Office11_05.value: If I recall correctly, you were the one who was comfortable around criminals.

Office11_06.value: That’s why you always put your work before relationships, correct?

Office11_08.value: You know what? You’re absolutely right.

Office12_03.value: I’m a detective. I can do whatever I want!

Office12_05.value: Finally, an arrest!! This’ll do wonders for my paper!

Office13_01.value: Hey, can you say that again? I’ll take another photo from a different angle!

Office13_03.value: Thomas Holden, for the Holden Howler at your service.

Office13_04.value: Would it be alright if I ask you for a quote on the reasons for Roddy’s arrest?

Office13_05.value: And try to make it juicy.

Office13_08.value: Tell him EXACTLY WHY he is being arrested.

Office13_11.value: Fine! I’m letting you go, but I’ll be back! And that's a warning...

Office14_01.value: Holden! I can’t believe I’m happy to see you!

Office14_03.value: Well, I need a good front-page story for my paper, don’t I?

Office14_05.value: Please... I quit working for her. She was too corrupt and overbearing.

Office14_06.value: And I couldn’t write about it! So I’ve started my own paper!

Office14_07.value: The Holden Howler, “Your proper source for JUICY news!”

Office14_09.value: That’s right. I can write about whoever I want now!

Office15_01.value: Maddie, what she said about criminals is right, but...

Office15_02.value: What?! Was she telling the truth? Is this what Arthur was-

Office15_03.value: Maddie, I promise I'll tell you everything, I swear. But not with HIM here.

Office15_04.value: Oh, don’t mind me, I’ll just stay here out of earshot.

Office15_06.value: Oh, alright... But I too... “WILL BE BACK!”

Office15_07.value: Sometimes I think he was dropped on the head as a child.

Office15_08.value: Roddy... I think it might be best if you tell me later. I've had enough surprises today.

Office15_09.value: Ah, right... I’ll... I’ll get back to you. I promise.

OfficeCharacterTask1_03.value: Holden is up to something! I think he’s stealing my scoops!

OfficeCharacterTask1_04.value: Well, I wouldn’t put it past him...

OfficeCharacterTask1_05.value: This is different! He told me I’ve gone soft and only he could tell the truth!

OfficeCharacterTask1_06.value: “The truth of the corruption that festers in the heart of Hopewell Bay,” as he puts it.

OfficeCharacterTask1_07.value: But his stories have gone too far! Sensationalist trash filled with half-truths!

OfficeCharacterTask2_01.value: Sigh! I know how Holden is, but, I’m working on a new story... Something big!

OfficeCharacterTask2_02.value: But, I know Holden is working on it, too! Can you help me get it done before he ruins it?

OfficeCharacterTask2_03.value: Of course, Jackie! What’s it about?

OfficeCharacterTask2_04.value: I think Bruno and Victoria are still scheming something with other construction projects in the Bay.

OfficeCharacterTask2_05.value: I have enough evidence from sources to blow this story wide open. However...

OfficeCharacterTask2_06.value: Holden has somehow gotten to them as well! He could ruin my reputation!

OfficeCharacterTask2_07.value: I think he’s planning on exposing them all to reveal the “Deep Corruption”.

OfficeCharacterTask2_08.value: We can’t let him do that!

OfficeCharacterTask3_01.value: Hey Jackie, how’s the exposé going?

OfficeCharacterTask3_02.value: I admit, Holden may be right... I’ve uncovered a complex web of neglected properties, questionable permits...

OfficeCharacterTask3_03.value: Unauthorized demolitions, you name it. Severe code violations, fast tracked safety inspections...

OfficeCharacterTask3_04.value: Maddie, this is affecting everyone in Hopewell Bay! People are losing their jobs or worse, their business!

OfficeCharacterTask3_05.value: But... Many of the people involved are not responsible. This story can hurt many people.

OfficeCharacterTask3_06.value: I don’t think Holden cares. He just wants to make a sensational piece.

OfficeCharacterTask4_01.value: Maddie... I don’t know what to do...

OfficeCharacterTask4_03.value: Well... This story has also led me to find a lot of evidence that suggests a pattern of ethical violations...

OfficeCharacterTask4_04.value: By, Holden... I have enough to expose him. Show everyone how he’s manipulating the public trust.

OfficeCharacterTask4_06.value: No, it’s not that easy. If I use my column to expose him, sure... I can get him discredited...

OfficeCharacterTask4_07.value: But then his article on Bruno and Victoria would ALSO be discredited. I see your problem.

OfficeCharacterTask4_08.value: I know you Jackie... I’m sure you’ll make the right decision.

OfficeCharacterTask5_03.value: I did the exposé on Bruno and Victoria. It was a better story, anyway.

OfficeCharacterTask5_04.value: And will do more good in the long run.

OfficeCharacterTask5_05.value: I knew you’d make the right call! How is Holden taking it?

OfficeCharacterTask5_06.value: How’d you think? He did an instant hit piece on me right after!

OfficeIntro_01.value: Cutting these vines was like going through a jungle!

OfficeIntro_03.value: This room looks like an office of some sort.

OfficeIntro_04.value: I wonder who it belonged to?

OfficeOutro_01.value: Well, apart from all the drama, it's been great to learn more about Charlie and his inventive mind. I-

OfficeOutro_03.value: What was that?! Is that Deb's voice I hear?

OfficeOutro_04.value: I need to figure this out. I hope she's not in trouble!

OfficePOI_FakeBonsai_01.value: Well, this thing shouldn't be in a terrarium!

OfficePOI_FakeBonsai_02.value: Let me just... Hey! It's fake!

OfficePOI_FakeBonsai_03.value: Ah... I think it was placed in the glass just to keep the dust off the leaves.

OfficePOI_GossipBench_02.value: I bet people used to lounge around and talk for hours on this.

OfficePOI_GossipBench_03.value: I guess there's nothing stopping me from doing the same!

OfficePOI_MansionPlans_01.value: I know Roddy found the old blueprints to the mansion at the archives...

OfficePOI_MansionPlans_02.value: But I think these are earlier drafts!

OfficePOI_MansionPlans_03.value: Very interesting designs... I should show these to Roddy when I have the chance!

OfficePOI_OpenBook_01.value: Hmmm.. What an interesting old book.

OfficePOI_OpenBook_02.value: I don't understand what language it is written in, but it really is quite pretty.

OfficePOI_OpenBook_03.value: There's just something about the art of hand binding books that I find so fascinating!

OfficePOI_PaperieBox_02.value: Even though everything has gone digital these days,

OfficePOI_PaperieBox_03.value: nothing beats getting real paper correspondence!

OfficePOI_Portrait_02.value: Grandpa must have been so proud of him.

OfficePOI_Portrait_03.value: I am too, Dad... I'm too.

OfficePOI_Terrariums_02.value: Actually... I think each one has a different self sustaining ecosystem!

OfficePOI_Terrariums_03.value: Was Grandpa studying these? Or perhaps just doing it as a hobby?

OfficePOI_VintageInstruments_01.value: These instruments look old. Almost vintage.

OfficePOI_VintageInstruments_02.value: I guess if they still do the job, why change them?

OfficePOI_VintageInstruments_03.value: I'll keep them around, just in case.

Outro_01.value: It’s a trapdoor! Hmm... This lock has a very strange looking key hole, I wonder if-

Outro_02.value: Do you smell that? Is something on fire?!

Outro_03.value: Oh no, look outside! I think it’s the lighthouse!
I'm dreadfully sorry to bother you Miss Boulton but...

Outro_04.value: It appears that the lighthouse is on fire.

OwlStatue_01.value: Eeh... It’s one of those weird statues that makes it look like it’s constantly staring at you.

OwlStatue_04.value: I can make bad jokes too, you know!

PEHalloweenEndOfEventChain_02.value: Let's just see if it's a winner...

PEHalloweenEndOfRewards_01.value: Well, Roddy, what do you think? Do you like the outfit?

PEHalloweenEndOfRewards_02.value: It's beautiful. I've always liked that shade of yellow.

PEHalloweenEndOfRewards_04.value: Uh, yeah, I meant the Scarecrow! Just couldn't see the color properly.

PEHalloweenEndOfRewards_05.value: Ahem. I think it's great. Are you ready to submit it to the competition?

PEHalloweenEndOfRewards_06.value: Definitely. Let's see if my family Scarecrow gets first place!

PEHalloweenIntro_01.value: Hi Maddie, I, uh, just wondered how you were getting on with your Scarecrow?
Hi, Maddie, I, uh, just wondered how you were getting on with your Scarecrow?

PEHalloweenIntro_02.value: Hmm? What are you talking about?

PEHalloweenIntro_03.value: It's a Hopewell Bay tradition. Townsfolk build a Scarecrow for Halloween...

PEHalloweenIntro_04.value: The best Scarecrow gets displayed by the Town Hall for everyone to see, the rest are used to protect Hopeberry bushes!

PEHalloweenIntro_05.value: Then I'd better invent the best Scarecrow ever.

PEHalloweenIntro_06.value: Winning the competition would be a great way to raise my family profile!

PESpaEndOfEventChain_02.value: They sure do! They're going to be the signature scent for your spa.

PESpaIntro_01.value: I think you're working a little too hard, dearie.

PESpaIntro_02.value: All these repairs, all this "investigation" into our family history. It must be exhausting.

PESpaIntro_03.value: Well, now you mention it I do feel a bit tired. But there's so much to do!

PESpaIntro_04.value: I know, but it's important to relax sometimes. That's why I go to the spa once a week.

PESpaIntro_05.value: Grandma, I don't have the time for that!

PESpaIntro_06.value: Then I'm going to make the spa come to you! Don't worry, dearie, I'll take care of everything...

PE_Christmas2022Deco_Intro_01.value: Can I help you decorate the house, Grandma?

PE_Christmas2022Deco_Intro_02.value: No thank you, dearie. I'd prefer that you just... stay away.

PE_Christmas2022Deco_Intro_04.value: Of course not! Anyway, Julius here is going to help me, aren't you?

PE_Christmas2022Deco_Intro_05.value: Certainly, Ursula. It does seem like rather a lot of work, though...

PE_Christmas2022Deco_Intro_06.value: Then we will just need to work extra hard.

PE_Christmas2022Deco_Outro_01.value: Thank you for all your help, Julius!

PE_Christmas2022Deco_Outro_03.value: I still don't understand why you didn't want my help, Grandma.

PE_Christmas2022Deco_Outro_04.value: And you don't need to, dearie! Isn't it enough that the house looks good?

PE_Christmas2022Deco_Outro_05.value: It doesn't just look good, it looks splendid!

PE_Christmas2022Deco_Outro_06.value: Exactly! Now let's go celebrate with some hot cocoa.

PE_Christmas2022Deco_Outro_07.value: Hmm. I still feel like she's hiding something, but cocoa sounds good!

PE_Christmas2022Eight_Gift_01.value: Hi Roddy. How are you doing today?
Hi, Roddy. How are you doing today?

PE_Christmas2022Eight_Gift_02.value: Great. You? You look very nice.

PE_Christmas2022Eight_Gift_03.value: Pardon? Oh, I'm alright. Wondering where today's "gift" is.

PE_Christmas2022Eight_Gift_04.value: I have it here, actually. I, uh, found it outside.

PE_Christmas2022Eight_Gift_05.value: Ooh! Is that a Christmas milkshake?

PE_Christmas2022Eight_Gift_06.value: Feels like it weighs about eight ounces, too.

PE_Christmas2022Eight_Gift_07.value: It tastes delicious! But... oh no! What if it's poisoned?

PE_Christmas2022Eight_Gift_08.value: Poisoned? Maddie, it's definitely not poisoned!

PE_Christmas2022Eight_Gift_09.value: I just think, someone cares enough to send you all these things!

PE_Christmas2022Eight_Gift_10.value: Well, alright. It is really tasty! But I wish I knew who "Santa" was!

PE_Christmas2022Eleventh_Gift_01.value: Uh, hello Maddie. Look what I found for you.

PE_Christmas2022Eleventh_Gift_02.value: Another gift? Ooh, let me see.

PE_Christmas2022Eleventh_Gift_03.value: Really?! I mean, uh, yeah! Here you go.

PE_Christmas2022Eleventh_Gift_06.value: Aha! I think I finally understand my Secret Santa's riddle!

PE_Christmas2022Eleventh_Gift_07.value: And if my guess is right, there's only one more day to go...

PE_Christmas2022EndOfChainDialogue_01.value: Time to find out who was right about Christmas trees!

PE_Christmas2022EndOfChainDialogue_02.value: Don't be surprised if it's me...

PE_Christmas2022EventEndDialogue_01.value: Okay, Roddy, I know you want to tell me... who was right about the origin of the Christmas tree?

PE_Christmas2022EventEndDialogue_02.value: We were both right! Turns out there are lots of traditions involving Christmas trees.

PE_Christmas2022EventEndDialogue_03.value: Just like there are lots of Christmas traditions! Personally, I love gift-giving the most.

PE_Christmas2022EventEndDialogue_04.value: And I enjoy spending time with the people I love, like Maddie.

PE_Christmas2022EventEndDialogue_05.value: You love Maddie?! I mean, I had a suspicion, but that's huge news! Does she know?!

PE_Christmas2022EventEndDialogue_06.value: I didn't mean... I shouldn't have... uh, please don't say anything to her?

PE_Christmas2022EventEndDialogue_07.value: Well, sure. Keeping your secret will be my Christmas gift to you, Roddy!

PE_Christmas2022Fifth_Gift_01.value: Here's a special delivery for you, Maddie!

PE_Christmas2022Fifth_Gift_03.value: You don't seem too happy about it, dearie.

PE_Christmas2022Fifth_Gift_04.value: Only because some of the gifts are really... weird.

PE_Christmas2022Fifth_Gift_05.value: I guess I should open it. Oh! Ooh, I like this.

PE_Christmas2022Fifth_Gift_06.value: Is that a box of donuts?

PE_Christmas2022Fifth_Gift_07.value: It is! Five of them. Two for you, three for me! Yum.

PE_Christmas2022First_Gift_01.value: Maddie, dearie, this package was sitting by the mailbox for you!

PE_Christmas2022First_Gift_02.value: For me? I'd better open it and see what's inside!

PE_Christmas2022First_Gift_05.value: It says "To Maddie, from Santa." Who could that be from?!

PE_Christmas2022First_Gift_06.value: I don't know, but I can make a mean pear pie, dearie.

PE_Christmas2022First_Gift_07.value: Then go ahead, Grandma! Maybe they're meant for you...

PE_Christmas2022Fourth_Gift_01.value: What's that you have there, Grandma? Did someone give you a gift?

PE_Christmas2022Fourth_Gift_02.value: No, it's for you again, dearie!

PE_Christmas2022Fourth_Gift_03.value: Oh, what's this? Is it a jewelry box?

PE_Christmas2022Fourth_Gift_04.value: I think it's a music box! I loved them when I was a kid.

PE_Christmas2022Fourth_Gift_05.value: Really? Let's see what music it plays... Argh!

PE_Christmas2022Fourth_Gift_06.value: Call that music?! It sounds like a flock of screaming birds!

PE_Christmas2022Fourth_Gift_08.value: You're not wrong! That sounds like angry birds.

PE_Christmas2022Fourth_Gift_09.value: Who could be sending me these things, and why?!

PE_Christmas2022InitialDialogue_01.value: Hi, Jackie. I'm on my way to see Maddie. What about you?

PE_Christmas2022InitialDialogue_02.value: I'm here for Maddie too! I brought her a golden key ornament for her Christmas tree.

PE_Christmas2022InitialDialogue_03.value: I didn't know you two were such good friends.

PE_Christmas2022InitialDialogue_04.value: Yeah? You sound a bit jealous. Do you want to be her only "friend" around here?

PE_Christmas2022InitialDialogue_05.value: No! I, uh... Are you sure Maddie even has a Christmas tree?

PE_Christmas2022InitialDialogue_06.value: Of course! Yesterday she and I were talking about how the Christmas tree originally came from Germany.

PE_Christmas2022InitialDialogue_07.value: Actually, ancient Egyptians used trees and wreaths as decorations in their homes and temples.

PE_Christmas2022InitialDialogue_08.value: Sure, but it wasn't until Queen Victoria was drawn with a Christmas tree that they really got popular.

PE_Christmas2022InitialDialogue_09.value: Looks like we need to figure out who's right here. What's the origin of the Christmas tree?

PE_Christmas2022Ninth_Gift_02.value: Rufus! What do you have in your mouth, boy?

PE_Christmas2022Ninth_Gift_03.value: Hmm, is that a festive envelope?

PE_Christmas2022Ninth_Gift_04.value: I wonder if it's another mystery gift from my secret Santa?

PE_Christmas2022Ninth_Gift_06.value: Alright, let's see... Huh! This is weird.

PE_Christmas2022Ninth_Gift_07.value: It's a gift card for the upcoming "Hopewell Bay Ladies Ballet Night" at the library!

PE_Christmas2022Ninth_Gift_08.value: Looks like it'll admit nine people, or let me go nine times!

PE_Christmas2022Ninth_Gift_09.value: Nine tickets to see ladies dancing... what next?!

PE_Christmas2022Second_Gift_01.value: Hi Maddie! What, uh, do you have there?
Hi, Maddie! What, uh, do you have there?

PE_Christmas2022Second_Gift_02.value: Someone left me a gift. I was about to open it.

PE_Christmas2022Second_Gift_03.value: It's a Christmas tree ornament! Looks like a... swan?

PE_Christmas2022Second_Gift_04.value: That's a dove. I mean, I think that's a dove.

PE_Christmas2022Second_Gift_05.value: A dove?! Oh no! Could this be because of Rufus chasing pigeons?

PE_Christmas2022Second_Gift_07.value: Rufus, boy, time to go indoors for a while!

PE_Christmas2022Seventh_Gift_01.value: Uh, Maddie? I found another package for you.

PE_Christmas2022Seventh_Gift_02.value: Another one?! This is getting silly!

PE_Christmas2022Seventh_Gift_03.value: It's... a spa set with a towel in the shape of a swan.

PE_Christmas2022Seventh_Gift_04.value: What's going on? What does this mean?!

PE_Christmas2022Seventh_Gift_05.value: Haha! I think I understand it all now.

PE_Christmas2022Seventh_Gift_06.value: You do? What is it, Grandma?

PE_Christmas2022Seventh_Gift_07.value: Oh, I think it's best if you figure it out yourself, dearie.

PE_Christmas2022Seventh_Gift_08.value: You still have five days to go!

PE_Christmas2022Sixth_Gift_01.value: What's that you have with you, Roddy?

PE_Christmas2022Sixth_Gift_02.value: A box I found by your mailbox.

PE_Christmas2022Sixth_Gift_03.value: Uh oh, it's another gift. Let's see what it is...

PE_Christmas2022Sixth_Gift_04.value: A box of six eggs? That's weird.

PE_Christmas2022Sixth_Gift_05.value: Six organic hen eggs. Perfectly formed, like you...

PE_Christmas2022Sixth_Gift_06.value: I bet Grandma ordered these to use in her Christmas cake!

PE_Christmas2022Sixth_Gift_08.value: See you later! I'd better get these to Grandma.

PE_Christmas2022Tenth_Gift_01.value: Another gift! What could it be?

PE_Christmas2022Tenth_Gift_02.value: You seem happier about the gifts now, dearie.

PE_Christmas2022Tenth_Gift_03.value: Yeah. I was annoyed for a while, but they are kind of fun.

PE_Christmas2022Tenth_Gift_04.value: Let's see... it's ten gingerbread cookies!

PE_Christmas2022Tenth_Gift_05.value: And it looks like they're wearing little top hats and bow ties.

PE_Christmas2022Tenth_Gift_06.value: Have you figured out the theme of your presents yet?

PE_Christmas2022Tenth_Gift_07.value: No... Go on, give me a clue, Grandma.

PE_Christmas2022Tenth_Gift_08.value: It's ten gingerbread cookies decorated like "Lords".

PE_Christmas2022Tenth_Gift_09.value: Go on, Maddie, think of all the Christmas songs I taught you!

PE_Christmas2022Third_Gift_01.value: Another present! I wonder what it could be.

PE_Christmas2022Third_Gift_02.value: It's pastries. And they smell delicious!

PE_Christmas2022Third_Gift_03.value: Not just any pastries - three French croissants.

PE_Christmas2022Third_Gift_04.value: I bet they're from Cherry, at the new Hopewell Bay bakery!

PE_Christmas2022Third_Gift_06.value: I'd better send her a thank-you card!

PE_Christmas2022Twelfth_Gift_01.value: Hi Maddie! I found another gift for you.
Hi, Maddie! I found another gift for you.

PE_Christmas2022Twelfth_Gift_03.value: Uh, yes. Anyway, here it is!

PE_Christmas2022Twelfth_Gift_04.value: Today we have... a drum kit?!

PE_Christmas2022Twelfth_Gift_05.value: Have you figured out what the gifts mean?

PE_Christmas2022Twelfth_Gift_06.value: Yes! It's gifts for the twelve days of Christmas.

PE_Christmas2022Twelfth_Gift_07.value: Do you, uh, know who they're from?

PE_Christmas2022Twelfth_Gift_08.value: They must be from your true love.

PE_Christmas2022Twelfth_Gift_09.value: I don't have a true love! And I don't have time for love.

PE_Christmas2022Twelfth_Gift_10.value: To be honest, I'd rather imagine they really did come from Santa!

PE_Christmas2022Twelfth_Gift_11.value: I - I mean, they - are probably glad the gifts made you smile.

PE_NewYearsResolutions2023_Completion_02.value: Cheer up Roddy, you shouldn't be so hard on yourself.

PE_NewYearsResolutions2023_Completion_03.value: I just hate feeling like I started the year on the wrong foot.

PE_NewYearsResolutions2023_Completion_04.value: What if we make some new, New Year's Resolutions together and help each other to follow through?

PE_NewYearsResolutions2023_Completion_05.value: What a great idea! I can always count on you.

PE_NewYearsResolutions2023_End_Popup_Con.value: Roddy feels much better and Maddie's glad to have helped. Thank you for helping out too!

PE_NewYearsResolutions2023_Endofchain_01.value: It's only the start of the year and I've failed to stick to a single resolution.

PE_NewYearsResolutions2023_Intro_03.value: I could cut down on the candy and try to have more fun at work...

PE_NewYearsResolutions2023_Intro_04.value: Those sound really nice. What else have you thought of?

PE_NewYearsResolutions2023_Intro_05.value: Hmmm.. to follow my heart and be braver in showing how I feel...

PE_NewYearsResolutions2023_Intro_06.value: These are great Roddy! Let's write them all down.
