Padlock2_Bubble.value: Oof! This lock is tricky. Maybe a couple more tries will do it!

Padlock3_Bubble.value: Almost there. A twist to the left and this lock will be open soon!

Padlock_01.value: Phew! Locks everywhere! Whoever this room belonged to certainly didn’t want anyone snooping around...

Padlock_02.value: I never thought lock picking would be a skill I’d need, but it sure is handy!

ParentsRoom01_Intro_02.value: My parents' room... I honestly don’t know what I’m expecting to find in here.

ParentsRoom01_Intro_03.value: Apart from the usual mess, of course!

ParentsRoom01_Intro_04.value: Actually... This looks more like it was ransacked.

ParentsRoom01_Intro_05.value: Don’t worry, Mom and Dad. I’ll fix this place up!

ParentsRoom02_02.value: That piece of wood blocking the staircase is finally out of the way!

ParentsRoom02_03.value: I wonder why it was boarded up like that?

ParentsRoom02_04.value: Well, at least now I have access upstairs to the mezzanine floor!

ParentsRoom02_06.value: Yup. That word has lost all meaning to me now.

ParentsRoom03_01.value: This is a really nice layout!

ParentsRoom03_03.value: My parents really knew how to live it up.

ParentsRoom03_05.value: Roddy! Check it out! Pretty cool, huh?

ParentsRoom03_07.value: Mezzanine... Mezzanine? Sounds kinda funny after a while...

ParentsRoom04_01.value: So, Roddy... Ready to tell me what’s really going on with you?

ParentsRoom04_02.value: Yeah... I guess my past eventually caught up with me.

ParentsRoom04_03.value: Wouldn’t be fair if you got mixed up in it and had no idea what was going on.

ParentsRoom04_04.value: But just know that I’m still ME. I’m not lying to you. I’ve never lied to you.

ParentsRoom04_07.value: Okay... I guess I should start at the beginning.

ParentsRoom05_01.value: I grew up in a bad part of town. My family had little to no money and my parents took on various jobs.

ParentsRoom05_02.value: Things were pretty much like that until my 8th birthday, when it miraculously took a turn for the better!

ParentsRoom05_03.value: Suddenly, my dad had a new job, and we moved into a fancy house in an upscale neighborhood!

ParentsRoom05_04.value: It was great! I even got to go to a private school!

ParentsRoom05_05.value: So you can imagine my surprise when I later found out what my dad did...

ParentsRoom05_07.value: Well, my dad was always good with numbers and accounting. I guess he impressed someone.

ParentsRoom05_08.value: Oh? That doesn’t sound so bad. Who was it?

ParentsRoom06_01.value: I’ll be honest. I grew up thinking this sort of life was normal.

ParentsRoom06_02.value: Dad never really spoke about work, but we were still invited to many parties.

ParentsRoom06_03.value: I got to hang out with quite a few “colorful” people.

ParentsRoom06_04.value: They even started teaching me a few tricks on how to pick locks!

ParentsRoom06_05.value: I ended up being quite good at it, too! I just didn’t realize I was being groomed...
I ended up being quite good at it, too! I just didn’t realize I was being manipulated...

ParentsRoom06_06.value: But if it wasn’t for that, I wouldn’t have found my love of architecture.

ParentsRoom06_08.value: I had to study a lot of blueprints and floor plans for my... “job”.

ParentsRoom07_01.value: I don’t mean to pry, but...

ParentsRoom07_02.value: If you were in that sort of life, how did you ever get married to Detective Sullivan?!

ParentsRoom07_03.value: Ah... Well, you see, I met her one day, quite suddenly, at a late-night diner!

ParentsRoom07_04.value: We hit it off right away. It was like she knew everything about me! She even liked architecture.

ParentsRoom07_05.value: We would hang out, go out to town, and I’d tell her fun facts about the buildings.

ParentsRoom07_06.value: As you would guess, we quickly fell in love. And as the young idiots we were, we secretly got married.

ParentsRoom07_07.value: We rushed into it. We weren’t thinking, but it was great for a while. I had this exciting life, and she was a huge part of it.

ParentsRoom07_09.value: A couple of months later, she had a sudden family emergency and had to leave for a while.

ParentsRoom07_10.value: Which was lucky for me, because my big job was essentially the following week.

ParentsRoom07_12.value: Yeah... It wasn’t a family emergency.

ParentsRoom08_01.value: It was the night of my first job and we got busted. And guess who was leading the charge?

ParentsRoom08_03.value: Yeah. She was undercover. Her FIRST job. And I was the mark. She lied about everything.

ParentsRoom08_04.value: Even the wedding was a sham.

ParentsRoom08_06.value: I asked her. She claimed the love was real, and she did everything she could to help me.

ParentsRoom08_07.value: Thankfully, my charges were dropped, and we never saw each other again.

ParentsRoom08_08.value: And since I married a cop, I wasn’t really welcomed at home anymore, either.

ParentsRoom08_09.value: So I took up architecture and moved here. FAR AWAY from everything.

ParentsRoom09_02.value: It’s okay Maddie. I know it’s a lot.

ParentsRoom09_03.value: I just hope you know how much you mean to me... Really.

ParentsRoom09_09.value: Okay... I... Uhm... I gotta go. You know... Get some fresh air.

ParentsRoom10_03.value: I wish I could remember them better...

ParentsRoom10_04.value: I wish I could remember this photo being taken!

ParentsRoom10_06.value: At least I remember them loving me.

ParentsRoom10_07.value: I guess that's all that matters!

ParentsRoom11_01.value: Looks like Mom took some notes from Grandma!

ParentsRoom11_02.value: She really knew how to make this place a home.

ParentsRoom11_03.value: This crochet blanket is so comfy! I bet they spent hours up here on it.

ParentsRoom11_04.value: And Dad must have been a hopeless romantic, bringing mom breakfast in bed, each morning.

ParentsRoom11_05.value: He even circled daily quotes in the book for her!

ParentsRoom11_06.value: They really loved each other fully...

ParentsRoom12_01.value: I must admit, this room is so different from the other ones!

ParentsRoom12_02.value: Even the smallest corner in here is set up to be cozy and inviting.

ParentsRoom12_03.value: I could spend weeks in here!

ParentsRoom12_04.value: Mom and Dad really didn’t care what other people thought of them.

ParentsRoom12_05.value: They were unpretentious, loving, and creative.

ParentsRoom12_07.value: I can almost FEEL them in here.

ParentsRoom13_01.value: This must have been Mom’s art corner!

ParentsRoom13_02.value: Wow, she was so talented as well. So many styles and experiments.

ParentsRoom13_03.value: I guess my style comes from her.
I guess my creativity comes from her.

ParentsRoom13_05.value: Oh! It’s a family portrait of Mom, Dad and me at sunset...

ParentsRoom13_06.value: It’s a family portrait of Mom, Dad and me at sunset...
And another adorable one of mom holding me tight!

ParentsRoom14_02.value: Someone else has been in here and left a trail of painted footprints!

ParentsRoom14_04.value: Who would want to come in here?!

ParentsRoom14_05.value: And rummage around Dad’s old stuff?

ParentsRoom14_06.value: It looks like they turned the place over, pretty good as well...

ParentsRoom14_07.value: I wonder what they were looking for?

ParentsRoom15_01.value: I figured Dad would be into model airplanes...

ParentsRoom15_03.value: This is a replica of John Boulton’s fighter plane! Of course!

ParentsRoom15_04.value: John really inspired Dad in many ways!

ParentsRoom15_05.value: I guess aviation runs in the family!

ParentsRoom16_01.value: This must be Dad’s desk! Look at all this aviation stuff!

ParentsRoom16_02.value: Manuals, technical specs and drawing. Model airplanes!
Manuals, technical specs, sketches and there's even model airplanes!

ParentsRoom16_03.value: Even some of his own design sketches! He really was an engineer at heart.

ParentsRoom16_04.value: Actually... Some of these designs are good. REALLY GOOD.

ParentsRoom17_01.value: What’s this? These aren’t engineering plans...

ParentsRoom17_02.value: They’re police reports! On a crime family!

ParentsRoom17_03.value: But why was Dad looking into this? Wait...

ParentsRoom17_04.value: Some of these notes were dated on the day he...

ParentsRoom17_06.value: Was dad mixed up with criminals too?!

ParentsRoom18_01.value: There are also some blueprints on the old tin can factory!

ParentsRoom18_02.value: And it looks like my dad knew about what was really going on there.

ParentsRoom18_03.value: They were using the cans to transport secret information, sometimes blackmail, across the country.

ParentsRoom18_05.value: How does this connect with the crime family?

ParentsRoom18_06.value: And what has this got to do with my dad?!

ParentsRoom19_02.value: And this armchair is really comfy too...

ParentsRoom19_03.value: I bet Mom sat right here, singing me to sleep.

ParentsRoomCharacterTask01_04.value: I have asked Leonard countless times now to remove his things from the mansion.

ParentsRoomCharacterTask01_05.value: And what does he take out?

ParentsRoomCharacterTask01_07.value: A SELF-PORTRAIT! That is all. As if that would be the only thing of value in here..

ParentsRoomCharacterTask01_08.value: I tell you; I have had enough with the man!

ParentsRoomCharacterTask01_10.value: If you’d help me, I would like to remove every trace of him.

ParentsRoomCharacterTask01_11.value: My pleasure! Where do we start?

ParentsRoomCharacterTask01_12.value: There’s an old bench he loved.

ParentsRoomCharacterTask01_13.value: How about we use it as kindling?

ParentsRoomCharacterTask02_03.value: What’s with the enormous pile of rocks and dirt outside?

ParentsRoomCharacterTask02_04.value: Ah. That was Leonard’s failed meditation experiment.

ParentsRoomCharacterTask02_06.value: He tried to build a rock garden, Ma’am.

ParentsRoomCharacterTask02_07.value: Ended up making a sandbox instead.

ParentsRoomCharacterTask02_08.value: I do believe he enjoyed building sandcastles as a child.

ParentsRoomCharacterTask03_02.value: What’s the story with the moth?

ParentsRoomCharacterTask03_03.value: Ah. I see you have found “Bartholomew the LXXVIII”.

ParentsRoomCharacterTask03_04.value: He is the great descendant of Bartholomew, the first. Leonard’s pet moth as a child.

ParentsRoomCharacterTask03_06.value: He had somewhat of a lonely childhood.

ParentsRoomCharacterTask03_07.value: One day, he found a moth that kept him company. He swore it was his only friend.

ParentsRoomCharacterTask03_08.value: He also made sure that no harm would ever come to any moth in the mansion!

ParentsRoomCharacterTask03_09.value: Suddenly all the fabric damage makes sense!

ParentsRoomCharacterTask04_01.value: Ah, the vase Leonard broke during one of our fights.

ParentsRoomCharacterTask04_03.value: Yes, Ma’am. It holds... Sentimental value.

ParentsRoomCharacterTask04_04.value: You see... He bought it for me as a gift.

ParentsRoomCharacterTask04_06.value: It was an accident. I knew he didn’t mean it.

ParentsRoomCharacterTask04_08.value: I might know someone who can fix this using the art of Kintsugi!

ParentsRoomCharacterTask04_09.value: That would be wonderful, Ma’am! Thank you!

ParentsRoomCharacterTask05_01.value: I see one of these seed bags was labeled ‘hope’?

ParentsRoomCharacterTask05_02.value: Yes... I made it for Leonard to cheer him up. He’s a very practical man.

ParentsRoomCharacterTask05_03.value: I thought if he could actually grow some hope, he might change...

ParentsRoomCharacterTask05_07.value: My sincerest thank you for helping me with this personal matter.

ParentsRoomCharacterTask05_08.value: You truly are a Boulton worthy of their name.

ParentsRoomOutro_01.value: All right... I’ve found what I can in here.

ParentsRoomOutro_02.value: And I’m happy that at least a part of my parents’ memory has been restored.

ParentsRoomOutro_03.value: But I think I should head to the tin can factory next.

ParentsRoomOutro_04.value: And finally figure out what is actually going on there!

ParentsRoomPOI_BabyMobile_01.value: This handmade baby mobile has Mom written all over it.

ParentsRoomPOI_BabyMobile_02.value: And it even has little airplanes for Dad.

ParentsRoomPOI_BabyMobile_03.value: The felt feels so soft to touch, I probably spent many nights reaching for it.

ParentsRoomPOI_BabyMobile_04.value: Some things are always slightly out of reach. Just like Grandma.

ParentsRoomPOI_ChangingStation_01.value: This is my old changing station!

ParentsRoomPOI_ChangingStation_02.value: It still smells like baby powder and that perfume Mom always wore.

ParentsRoomPOI_ChangingStation_03.value: And they kept Gizmo? It's a bit wonky, but this bear was my first friend.

ParentsRoomPOI_DepartureBoard_01.value: Interesting! This looks like a flight departure board...

ParentsRoomPOI_DepartureBoard_02.value: Paris, Tokyo, Rome... But, why do they have years next to them?

ParentsRoomPOI_DepartureBoard_03.value: Oh, wait a minute! These are cities that my Mom and Dad visited together!

ParentsRoomPOI_DepartureBoard_04.value: And the years they went there.

ParentsRoomPOI_Dreamcatcher_01.value: What intricate dreamcatchers! Mom must've made these as well.

ParentsRoomPOI_Dreamcatcher_02.value: Dreamcatchers are supposed to protect people from bad dreams.

ParentsRoomPOI_Dreamcatcher_03.value: There are so many of them.

ParentsRoomPOI_Dreamcatcher_04.value: Mom, Dad... What kind of worries kept you up at night?

ParentsRoomPOI_InstrumentsFramed_01.value: They framed their guitars together, that's so romantic!

ParentsRoomPOI_InstrumentsFramed_02.value: Oh, look! There's also their song sheets from their band days.

ParentsRoomPOI_InstrumentsFramed_03.value: Cheers For Shears did a tour?!

ParentsRoomPOI_InstrumentsFramed_04.value: Mom, Dad... I'd give anything to hear you play live.

ParentsRoomPOI_MediaNook_01.value: This is where they kept their media collection.

ParentsRoomPOI_MediaNook_02.value: Depeche Mode and aviation magazines? Oh, Dad...

ParentsRoomPOI_MediaNook_03.value: I wonder if the VCR is still working? I could have a 90s movie night with Grandma.

ParentsRoomPOI_TrolleyFridge_01.value: Did Dad convert an airline trolley into a mini-fridge?

ParentsRoomPOI_TrolleyFridge_02.value: He really was an excellent inventor!

ParentsRoomPOI_TrolleyFridge_03.value: Wait, what's this by the door... green fingerprints?

ParentsRoomPOI_TrolleyFridge_04.value: Mom must have picked something to drink in the middle of a painting session.

ParentsRoomScooterTravel_01.value: Aha! My trusty, true blue, scooter! It's been a while.

ParentsRoomScooterTravel_02.value: I should really maintain it more often...

ParentsRoomScooterTravel_03.value: But luckily, I think it has just enough fuel to get me to the tin can factory!

ParentsRoomTeaser_01.value: There’s something about the tin can factory that keeps bugging me.

ParentsRoomTeaser_02.value: There has to be something important there that Dad was investigating...

ParentsRoomTeaser_03.value: Perhaps I’ll find more answers there.
Based on the plans I've seen, it looks like it's located quite a ways away.

ParentsRoomTeaser_04.value: Based on these plans I saw, it looks like it's located quite a ways away and I believe I'll need my scooter!
I'll need to examine the blueprint so I can figure out how to get there, and then I should head to my scooter!

Passports_01.value: A bunch of passports, all with the same name - “Eric Hal”.

Passports_02.value: Hold on, I think that’s an anagram. If I rearrange it, it spells...

Passports_04.value: And these photos, they’re all of him in various meticulous disguises!

Passports_05.value: This confirms my suspicions. This has to be Grandpa Charlie’s hideout and I think... I think he was... a spy!

Patches_PremiumRewardTip_Description.value: *Chirp!* Do you want to see a magic trick?

Perfumery01_Intro_01.value: Deb said I should check this room out next, because it was interesting.

Perfumery01_Intro_02.value: That’s a bit of an understatement if you ask me!

Perfumery01_Intro_03.value: This looks more like a workshop...

Perfumery02_01.value: Ah... I see you’ve found the Perfumery.
Ah... I see you’ve found Lindsay's Perfumery.

Perfumery02_03.value: Perfumery, girl. Oh wait, that’s right. YOU didn’t live here as long as I did.

Perfumery02_04.value: And much good that did. I see you’re still trying to spruce up the place with pictures of yourself.

Perfumery02_06.value: Why are you still around? It’s obvious you don’t enjoy being here!

Perfumery03_01.value: Well, girl. I won’t be around for much longer, thanks to you.

Perfumery03_02.value: I’m collecting my things, because YOU have thrown me out of my home.

Perfumery03_03.value: You do RUIN everything you touch, you know.

Perfumery03_05.value: For example, the deal I made with Bruno.

Perfumery03_06.value: I could have been living in a penthouse suite!

Perfumery03_07.value: Selling your ancestral home is never a good plan, Leonard. It’s wrong.

Perfumery03_08.value: Don’t be too quick to judge, Maddie.

Perfumery04_01.value: You were selling out your family, Leonard! You didn’t want to save this place!

Perfumery04_02.value: You wanted to sell it to make a quick buck!

Perfumery04_03.value: Ha! So young, thinking that you know EVERYTHING. The naivete of youth, I suppose.
Ha! So young, thinking that you know EVERYTHING. The naïveté of youth, I suppose.

Perfumery04_04.value: Oh, stop it with the over-bloated rhetoric. You’re a greedy old man who was only looking out for number one.

Perfumery04_05.value: I’ll have you know, little girl, that I made sure there would have been enough money for everyone.

Perfumery04_06.value: Cover all our family debts, and even get Ursula off the hook!

Perfumery04_07.value: Wh- Why didn’t you tell me?

Perfumery04_08.value: Because of the way you are acting now! Besides, you made it clear you would not sell, anyway.

Perfumery04_09.value: You are not as smart as you think you are...

Perfumery04_10.value: Sometimes it’s best to not know everything.

Perfumery05_01.value: Oh? I guess you didn’t heed your own advice when you told Deb she was adopted!

Perfumery05_03.value: How do you think I learned that lesson?
How do you think I learnt that lesson?

Perfumery05_04.value: I saw how it ate her up inside. How it led her to go searching for the truth. How it hurt her in the end.

Perfumery05_05.value: I couldn’t stand seeing her so hurt after she came back.

Perfumery05_06.value: You see, Maddie... All this family has is pain and debt.

Perfumery05_07.value: Something Deb learned all too well during her time in Europe.

Perfumery05_08.value: What do you mean? And tell me more about how Lindsay started this...

Perfumery05_09.value: Oh, I’m sorry Dearie... I need to go for my manicure.
Oh, sorry girl... I need to go for my manicure.

Perfumery06_02.value: Oh, Winston... It’s alright. Just Leonard.

Perfumery06_03.value: Ah... I had a feeling he was about. He has a certain way with people.

Perfumery06_05.value: *Ahem* I see that you’re working on the stained glass window of Lindsay!

Perfumery06_06.value: Such a strong and prominent lady. Reminds me of you, in fact. A true pioneer.

Perfumery06_07.value: It truly is a pity how her life became so tragic because of her decisions.

Perfumery06_08.value: Do you know what really happened to her?

Perfumery07_01.value: It is a sad story, but yes, I know it.

Perfumery07_03.value: Well, as far as Boultons go, she was on top of the world. Recovered the Boulton name and made one for herself!

Perfumery07_04.value: And then she left it all behind. Her name. Her wealth. Her home...

Perfumery07_06.value: Love. What else? During her many travels, she met a man. Some prince from a small nation called Monte Brava.

Perfumery07_07.value: It was like something out of a fairy tale. However, her parents were not too happy about it.

Perfumery07_08.value: In fact, neither were the prince’s parents. Regardless, they got married, and she moved over there.

Perfumery07_09.value: Contact was cut and the last thing we learned about her was that she died some time after.

Perfumery07_11.value: But... She got to live with the love of her life, right? It was worth it?

Perfumery07_12.value: It would be a nice ending, wouldn’t it?

Perfumery07_14.value: We will never know, I’m afraid.

Perfumery08_01.value: This looks like New York. I guess this was to show her fortitude at inventing things!
This looks like New York. I guess this was to showcase what a trailblazer she was when she joined Wall Street!

Perfumery08_02.value: She saved the family for the first time with inventing perfumes and helping her father get out of debt.

Perfumery08_03.value: This then led her to inventing the spray can! I bet it was in this very room...

Perfumery08_04.value: I remember she worked at Wall Street and was a very shrewd business woman in New York.
I remember she was a very shrewd business woman in New York.

Perfumery08_05.value: She made a fortune until the Crash.

Perfumery09_01.value: Ah, her love of exploration. I remember seeing a photo of her in the gallery as well!
Ah, her love of exploration. I remember seeing a photo of her in the Gallery as well!

Perfumery09_02.value: I bet she had a love for exploration and archaeology, since she found some really historic artifacts.
She was known to have a deep passion for discovery and archaeology; she even found some really historic artifacts!

Perfumery09_03.value: Not to mention the travel. She loved to do that.

Perfumery09_04.value: What a life she must have had... I must admit, I am envious.

Perfumery09_05.value: To chase your dreams, no matter what. Never knowing what the next day will bring!

Perfumery10_01.value: This is about the Beaumont Blossom! Her first invention that saved the family!

Perfumery10_02.value: She based the fragrance on the Hopeberry and it became a sensational hit!

Perfumery10_03.value: I bet this was a catalyst that led her down a path of science, innovation, and perfumes.

Perfumery10_04.value: This being the centerpiece, I bet that fragrance was her most treasured creation.

Perfumery11_02.value: A plaque in front of the stained glass. It has a description.
A plaque in front of the stained glass. It has an inscription.

Perfumery11_05.value: Oh my! The perfumes... The jewelry. Her time in Europe...

Perfumery11_06.value: Falling in love with a prince! Royalty!!! I think... I think-

Perfumery11_08.value: Deb found out that she wasn’t really adopted! She was brought back to her family!

Perfumery11_09.value: But what about the ones in Europe?! Why didn’t they keep her?!

Perfumery11_10.value: Why didn’t Deb’s parents tell her she was really a related?!
Why didn’t Deb’s parents tell her she was really related?!

Perfumery12_01.value: Every great lab needs a sink. Even one as fancy as this!

Perfumery12_02.value: Hey... These look like some unique handmade soaps and they smell wonderful!

Perfumery12_03.value: I wonder if this lab was also used to make soaps?

Perfumery13_01.value: Hmm... This stained glass mural is in really bad shape.

Perfumery13_02.value: Can't even figure out what it's about!

Perfumery13_03.value: But good thing I LOVE puzzles!

Perfumery14_03.value: Whoever made this, must have really respected her.

PerfumeryCharacterTask01_01.value: Maddie Boulton. Still rummaging around in junk, I see.

PerfumeryCharacterTask01_03.value: Please. Your mansion is like a sieve. I can come in and out as I please.

PerfumeryCharacterTask01_04.value: Then please get out. And STAY out.

PerfumeryCharacterTask01_05.value: Relax. I've come to bury the hatchet.

PerfumeryCharacterTask01_06.value: Yeah, right. Probably in my back.

PerfumeryCharacterTask01_07.value: Ha! Don't threaten me with a good time!

PerfumeryCharacterTask01_09.value: So snappy! I guess there's no fooling you.

PerfumeryCharacterTask01_10.value: You're right! I'm here to make your life a living hell!

PerfumeryCharacterTask02_03.value: What's wrong with you?! You're acting like a mad woman!

PerfumeryCharacterTask02_04.value: Ha! I have nothing to lose!

PerfumeryCharacterTask02_05.value: You've taken everything away from me!

PerfumeryCharacterTask03_01.value: Hey! I thought I threw you out?!

PerfumeryCharacterTask03_03.value: Look, Victoria... I'm sure we can figure this out.

PerfumeryCharacterTask04_01.value: Aaargh! Make it stop! I hate this song!

PerfumeryCharacterTask04_02.value: Ha! I knew it! I'll make it stop if you leave my home!

PerfumeryCharacterTask05_01.value: That's it. The place is sealed shut.

PerfumeryCharacterTask05_02.value: Oh you think you can lock me out, do you?!

PerfumeryCharacterTask05_03.value: I'll have Winston escort you out now.

PerfumeryCharacterTask05_04.value: This won't stop me Maddie! I'll hound you to the ends of the Earth!

PerfumeryOutro_01.value: There! The Beaumont Blossom once again recreated!

PerfumeryOutro_02.value: Quite fitting, actually. For the first and last time in the same room.

PerfumeryOutro_03.value: Taking center place here where it all began.

PerfumeryOutro_04.value: I still can’t believe that Lindsay is Deb’s mother...

PerfumeryOutro_05.value: But this family loves its secrets.

PerfumeryOutro_06.value: Maybe it’s time for me to finally learn mine...

PerfumeryOutro_07.value: I should head to my parents’ room next.

PerfumeryPOI_LabDesk_01.value: This has to have been Lindsay's lab!

PerfumeryPOI_LabDesk_02.value: So many beakers and flasks full of interesting liquids...

PerfumeryPOI_LabDesk_03.value: And there's a centrifuge too! She really was ahead of her time.

PerfumeryPOI_LabDesk_04.value: Her passion and dedication shine through every area of this room!

PerfumeryPOI_LabDesk_05.value: And this portrait, she looks so academic and brilliant.

PerfumeryPOI_LabDesk_06.value: Ooh! It's signed by someone - Delacourt! Was it a gift? I wonder who that is...

PerfumeryPOI_PackagingPreOutro_01.value: Well, now that I know how to make Beaumont Blossom, I might as well package them.

PerfumeryPOI_PackagingPreOutro_02.value: It would be a shame to leave all these boxes empty...

PerfumeryPOI_PackagingPreOutro_03.value: Perhaps I could make a limited run as nice little side hustle?

PerfumeryPOI_PerfumeDispensers_01.value: Looks like Lindsay had a little production line going here!

PerfumeryPOI_PerfumeDispensers_02.value: Wow. Even the boxes were handmade. She really was a Do-it-Yourself type of gal.

PerfumeryPOI_PerfumeDispensers_03.value: I admit, I probably wouldn't have had the patience for it!

PerfumeryPOI_PerfumeDispensers_04.value: Probably design a machine for it... Hmm...

PerfumeryPOI_PerfumeJournal_02.value: It contains all her experimental notes, recipes and even...

PerfumeryPOI_PerfumeJournal_03.value: Even the recipe for The Beaumont Blossom!

PerfumeryPOI_PerfumeJournal_04.value: How about we make it again?

PerfumeryPOI_PerfumePlants_01.value: What a wonderful collection of fragrant plants!

PerfumeryPOI_PerfumePlants_02.value: Bonsai Lemon, Lavender, Neroli, Rose... They smell amazing!

PerfumeryPOI_PerfumePlants_03.value: Most perfumes are derived from plants like these so it makes sense that she was growing them herself!

PerfumeryPOI_PetalJars_01.value: Not only are they fragrant. But they look great too!

PerfumeryPOI_PetalJars_03.value: I should probably make a few for my room in the lighthouse!

PerfumeryPOI_ScentFunnel_02.value: I looked it up and this apparatus is designed to help direct vapors from a perfume toward the nose!

PerfumeryPOI_ScentFunnel_03.value: This must have been so useful when designing fragrances.

PerfumeryPOI_ScentFunnel_04.value: I could spend hours here just enjoying all these wonderful fragrances.

PerfumeryPOI_ScentFunnel_05.value: Lindsay really knew how to make a symphony of perfumes!

PerfumeryPOI_SciencePortrait_01.value: Making perfume is a science, and Lindsay was a true scientist. One of the pioneers!

PerfumeryPOI_SciencePortrait_02.value: Especially her work with the Hopeberry flower.

PerfumeryPOI_SciencePortrait_03.value: I hope one day she’ll be recognized properly for her contributions.

PerfumeryPOI_SteamDistiller_02.value: These are used to extract essential oils from fragrant plants.

PerfumeryPOI_SteamDistiller_03.value: It would usually take a lot of natural material to make even a drop of oil!

PoolHouseAfterarrest2_02.value: Julius! Good that you're here! You won't believe what just happened!

PoolHouseAfterarrest2_03.value: Salutations Maddie! Oh my, what is it?

PoolHouseAfterarrest2_04.value: Grandma was taken away by a cop car!!

PoolHouseAfterarrest2_08.value: Julius! Did you hear what I said?! They arrested Grandma!

PoolHouseAfterarrest2_10.value: What?! What do you mean?! Why aren't you at all surprised?!

PoolHouseAfterarrest2_11.value: Umm... Eh, nothing. I mean... Good heavens! I'm just in shock.

PoolHouseAfterarrest2_13.value: Well what can we do?! We need to help her! We need to get her back home!

PoolHouseAfterarrest2_14.value: Hmmm... yes. There might be something we can do. Let me think for a while.

PoolHouseAfterarrest_01.value: I can't believe it! Grandma was taken away by a cop car!!

PoolHouseAfterarrest_03.value: And why?! What has she done?

PoolHouseAfterarrest_04.value: I know Grandma's hiding something but whatever it is it can't be THAT bad!

PoolHouseAfterarrest_06.value: And what did she mean by "he's alive"?!

PoolHouseAfterarrest_08.value: I better keep this to myself until I know who she meant.

Reception_02_01.value: Oof... This is A LOT of junk mail!

Reception_02_04.value: Did he run the factory for a while?!

Reception_02_05.value: Why yes, he did, Ma’am. For about 2 months.

Reception_02_06.value: 2 months? I guess it didn’t go too well...

Reception_02_10.value: As you can see, not his brightest idea.

Reception_02_Dialogue_01.value: Oof... This is A LOT of junk mail!

Reception_02_Dialogue_04.value: Did he run the factory for a while?!

Reception_02_Dialogue_05.value: Why yes, he did, Ma’am. For about 2 months.

Reception_02_Dialogue_06.value: 2 months? I guess it didn’t go too well...

Reception_03_03.value: Winston told me it was Ignatius' design, but Agatha made sure it went on every single can. No exceptions.

Reception_03_04.value: No wonder they had such an impact. They weren't just making cans, they made standards.

Reception_03_05.value: Pioneers. Right down to the stamp on the tin.

Reception_03_Dialogue_03.value: Stamped on every can, Ma’am. It was Agatha’s idea.

Reception_03_Dialogue_04.value: They really were revolutionary, weren’t they?

Reception_04_01.value: Oh, cool! An old employee time clock!

Reception_04_02.value: This one is quite unique, actually. Ignatius designed it himself. Supposedly, it kept perfect time.

Reception_04_03.value: We do like our clocks in the family.

Reception_04_04.value: Ignatius always said, “Time is money.” With this he meant it literally. He liked orderly paychecks.

Reception_04_05.value: Hey! Let’s use this on the guests!

Reception_04_07.value: I mean when guests come in, they can clock in their ticket!

Reception_04_08.value: Then when they leave, they can clock out!

Reception_04_09.value: It'll make the experience of coming to the factory even more immersive!

Reception_04_Dialogue_01.value: Oh, cool! An old employee time clock!

Reception_04_Dialogue_02.value: This one is quite unique, actually. Ignatius designed it himself. Supposedly, it kept perfect time.

Reception_04_Dialogue_03.value: We do like our clocks in the family.

Reception_04_Dialogue_04.value: Ignatius always said, “Time is money.” With this he meant it literally.

Reception_05_01.value: These photos must have been from the factory’s grand opening and ribbon-cutting ceremony.

Reception_05_02.value: It was a grand day, Ma’am. Everyone from Hopewell Bay was there.

Returnbox_01.value: Well, I think that's the last bit of tile that needed fixing!

Returnbox_02.value: I should put this box back where I found it, now that I don't need it anymore.

RomanticSpotCarWithFlowers_01.value: Don't tell me someone used to drive this old thing? It's a wreck!

RomanticSpotCarWithFlowers_02.value: True, but at one time, it was your father's pride and joy.

RomanticSpotCarWithFlowers_03.value: He restored it and took your mom out on their first date in this car!

RomanticSpotCarWithFlowers_04.value: Your Grandpa Charlie wasn't happy. He thought something bad would happen in the car.

RomanticSpotCarWithFlowers_05.value: It turned out he should have worried about something else with those two.

RomanticSpotCarWithFlowers_06.value: What? Grandma, whatever did happen to my parents?

RomanticSpotCarWithFlowers_07.value: This is why I don't like telling you family stories! I don't want to dredge up bad things from the past.

RomanticSpotCarWithFlowers_08.value: Okay, sorry Grandma. Tell me another happy story about them instead, please?

RomanticSpotClosing_01.value: Thanks for asking me to come and help out here, Maddie.

RomanticSpotClosing_02.value: It was nice to be reminded of all the good times with your parents.

RomanticSpotClosing_03.value: I'm glad! Now that we've talked about the good times, can we talk about... the bad times?

RomanticSpotClosing_04.value: What, uh, what exactly happened to my parents?

RomanticSpotClosing_05.value: I really want to know, Grandma.

RomanticSpotClosing_06.value: And I really don't want to talk about it, dearie!

RomanticSpotClosing_07.value: I do want to go and watch a horror film, though. Goodbye!

RomanticSpotClosing_08.value: Huh. She might not want to talk about it, but one day, I will find out what happened to my mom and dad!

RomanticSpotFlowerBeds_01.value: Well, here you go. This is the place my Michael first saw Becky!

RomanticSpotFlowerBeds_02.value: My parents first met by some flowers?

RomanticSpotFlowerBeds_03.value: That's right. Becky and her family were new in town, and I invited them here one afternoon.

RomanticSpotFlowerBeds_04.value: When little Mikey saw Becky, that was it! He was eight years old, and it was love at first sight.

RomanticSpotFlowerBeds_05.value: He tried to give her some flowers, but she just wanted to play hide and seek!

RomanticSpotFlowerBeds_06.value: It would be years and years until she felt the same way as him.

RomanticSpotOldTree_01.value: Grandma, do you see this?! It says 'Becky loves Mikey' on it!

RomanticSpotOldTree_02.value: My Mom must have carved it into the tree!

RomanticSpotOldTree_03.value: She did. She and Michael used to love coming here together.

RomanticSpotOldTree_04.value: Really? Oh, Grandma, will you tell me about them? I... I'd love to know more about my parents.

RomanticSpotOldTree_05.value: Well, alright, but I need some time to gather my memories. This isn't easy to talk about, you know.

RomanticSpotOpening_01.value: What a cute little part of the estate!

RomanticSpotOpening_02.value: I wonder if it has any clues about what happened between Grandma and Grandpa?

RomanticSpotOpening_03.value: I'm going to ask Grandma to come here and help me out as I tidy up!

RomanticSpotSmallCreek_01.value: What's the matter, Grandma? Why do you look so sad?

RomanticSpotSmallCreek_02.value: It's just that this is the spot where your parents broke up.

RomanticSpotSmallCreek_03.value: What?! My Mom and Dad broke up? When?

RomanticSpotSmallCreek_04.value: Oh, long before you were born, don't worry! But it was a sad time.

RomanticSpotSmallCreek_05.value: Your mom got accepted into a good college... in Europe.

RomanticSpotSmallCreek_06.value: She, well, she didn't think they'd make it long distance, so she broke up with Michael.

RomanticSpotSmallCreek_07.value: I can't believe this! Why did she do it?

RomanticSpotSmallCreek_08.value: Things were different back then. We didn't have the internet. No video calls, no emails.

RomanticSpotSmallCreek_09.value: What made them get back together?

RomanticSpotSmallStatue_01.value: Well, Grandma? What made my mom and dad get back together?

RomanticSpotSmallStatue_02.value: Funnily enough, it was this statue!

RomanticSpotSmallStatue_04.value: Your mom was visiting during her summer break about halfway through college.

RomanticSpotSmallStatue_05.value: She came to see Michael and brought him a little statue as a peace offering from Europe.

RomanticSpotSmallStatue_06.value: As soon as she saw him, though, she realized how much she'd missed him, and dropped the statue to kiss him!

RomanticSpotSmallStatue_07.value: If you look closely, you can see the cracks from where Michael glued it back together.

RomanticSpotSmallStatue_08.value: She transferred to a local college, and they got right back on track.

RomanticSpotSmallStatue_09.value: That sounds so sweet! I wish I remembered them.

RomanticSpotSmallStatue_10.value: They were sweet on each other, but they were both even sweeter on you, dearie.

RomanticSpotTreehouse_01.value: This treehouse is just adorable. I can't wait to sit up there and read a book.

RomanticSpotTreehouse_02.value: It's true, it's the perfect place to read a horror novel at night, dearie.

RomanticSpotTreehouse_03.value: But it's more than that. It was a special place for Michael and Becky.

RomanticSpotTreehouse_04.value: When they were just kids, they used to leave notes here for each other.

RomanticSpotTreehouse_05.value: As the years went on, the notes got more and more romantic!

RomanticSpotTreehouse_06.value: Michael left Becky a note here that started his treasure hunt, and led to her finding the engagement ring!

RomanticSpotTreehouse_07.value: How lovely. It's nice to hear how happy they were!

RomanticSpotTreehouse_08.value: They were happy... most of the time...

RubberBandsOverall_01.value: There was a lot of colorful duct tape in your bag!

RubberBandsOverall_02.value: And each one has a purpose, trust me.

RubberBandsOverall_03.value: But what's the difference? Color doesn't change the tensile strength-

RubberBandsOverall_04.value: Hey... Do not mock the bands, okay? I have a system. If you want to learn how to fix your leaky plumbing, listen to the expert!

SBE_Jailbreak_1StActivationOfTheStorageR.value: Hold it! I thought I told you that you couldn’t-
Come in without a cart? I know that, dearie, so here it is! All ready for the Storage Room!
Oh... Uuuh, okay then. Go on in then!

SBE_Jailbreak_1StCartFromOperationJailbr.value: Great! This’ll help me get into the Storage Room!
All I need to do now is fill it up!

SBE_Jailbreak_1StCartFromTasks_01.value: I see you like exploring the jail, but unfortunately, the Warden runs a pretty tight ship. However, there is a trick I learned when I first started here...

SBE_Jailbreak_1StCartFromTasks_04.value: Well, if you have a filled cart, the guards will let you in, because it looks like you’re working there!

SBE_Jailbreak_1StContrabandBurnerPhoneAp.value: A burner phone! Wait, what’s this? It has a note on it saying, “Call me.”

SBE_Jailbreak_1StTimeGraceIsTired_02.value: Oooh boy, I’m calling it a night, Grandma!

SBE_Jailbreak_1StTimeGraceIsTired_03.value: I’ll head back to our cell...
I’ll head back to my cell...

SBE_Jailbreak_1StTimeGrandmaIsTired_01.value: Oh, dearie me... It’s been a very long day!

SBE_Jailbreak_1StTimeGrandmaIsTired_02.value: I think it’s time for me to get a little shuteye in my cell...

SBE_Jailbreak_1StTrashBagAppears_03.value: It uh... It has some ‘other’ stuff inside, if you know what I mean. I’ll let you handle them now.

SBE_Jailbreak_1StTrashBagAppears_04.value: But in the future, it might be a good idea if you let ME handle them.

SBE_Jailbreak_AdamsTalks_01.value: Well, Mrs. Boulton, you sure did a great service for us today!

SBE_Jailbreak_AdamsTalks_02.value: Thanks to you, there was no way for ex-Warden Decker to deny what’s been going on here. He admitted to everything!

SBE_Jailbreak_AdamsTalks_03.value: They have promoted me to warden for the time being, but I’m sure it’ll become a permanent position.

SBE_Jailbreak_AdamsTalks_04.value: I should be able to get Kitty, Mama and C.J. released pretty much right away. They’ll be able to leave within the week.

SBE_Jailbreak_AdamsTalks_05.value: As for you and the rest, I’ll be looking into every case personally. I’m sure I can get you all cleared by the end of the year.

SBE_Jailbreak_AdamsTalks_06.value: End of the year?! That’s too long!

SBE_Jailbreak_AdamsTalks_07.value: I’m not a miracle worker. Besides, I don’t think it should be too inconvenient for you... With your knitting project and all.

SBE_Jailbreak_AfterAFewTasksWorkingAlone.value: I've spent some time learning about the jail. Key players and routines...
I think I've come up with a good enough plan that should get me out of here and back to Maddie, before she gets into trouble.
Step 1. I need to make a name for myself. Which in turn means I need to make friends. I'll start with my cell mate, Grace Martin.

SBE_Jailbreak_BluetoothEscapesPop-Up_01.value: The guards arrived in the morning to find Grandma’s cell empty! They searched the entire area and found her trying to escape the yard. Later, after they had thrown away and taken the decoy to the landfill, a dirty yet happy Bluetooth climbs out of the decoy to freedom! Congratulations!

SBE_Jailbreak_BluetoothIsTired_01.value: All done for the day! See you in the morning.

SBE_Jailbreak_BluetoothOpensTheFactory_0.value: I’ll make sure you’ll get exactly what you need!

SBE_Jailbreak_Cafeteria_01.value: Eerily quiet... But I should still be able to avoid the guards for now...

SBE_Jailbreak_Cafeteria_02.value: I’m sure a lot of food would liven up the place, however!

SBE_Jailbreak_CharacterStartPopup_Descri.value: He is tough as nails and considered to be the Warden’s right-hand man. Some think he may be doing something shady on the side.
She is everyone’s favorite guard. Friendly and often let things slide. But she seems distracted lately.
Constantly sleeping on the job, she is everyone’s second favorite guard for obvious reasons.
The 2nd in command of Veilwood County Jail. Doesn’t like how things are run by Warden Decker and is looking for a way to make some changes.
Self appointed “King” of Veilwood County Jail. He is corrupt, a bully, and knows it.
Doing time for theft of government property. She claims she was framed after she did a report on a city official. She knows her way around the jail and seems friendly enough.
She really loves fast cars. Can’t afford them though. That’s why she’s in here. She runs the storage room, loves to talk, and has a monopoly on bubble gum.
Everyone calls her Mama, mostly because she treats everyone like her children. And like every strict parent, she keeps people in line. The de facto boss of the cell block.
In for hacking and misuse of government computers. She’s really tech-savvy, efficient, and sharp.
In for vandalism and destruction of private property. She’s not a fan of authority. Nor being in jail.
In for identity theft. She’s shy and keeps to herself, but seems to like heavy metal, and on the occasion, cracks the odd joke.

SBE_Jailbreak_CjIsTired_01.value: A library never sleeps, but unfortunately I do...

SBE_Jailbreak_CjOpensTheLibrary_01.value: Hey Grandma! You won’t believe what I just found out. Have a look!

SBE_Jailbreak_DiscoveryOfJournal_02.value: This looks like Grandma’s journal! Hmm... Some pages seem to be ripped out...

SBE_Jailbreak_DiscoveryOfJournal_04.value: This is from her time in... JAIL!!

SBE_Jailbreak_DiscoveryOfPages_02.value: I need to find out more!

SBE_Jailbreak_DropingGraceIdOnTrashBag_0.value: Grandma c’mere. I think I trust you enough to show you something.
Shhh... Okay, you know these trash bags we collect? Well, they serve another purpose.
The Warden is a tough brute, and he doesn’t allow almost anything in here. So we’ve taken it upon ourselves to bring in some more...
Thank you, dearie! These will really come in handy!

SBE_Jailbreak_DropingGracesIdOnTrashBag_.value: Grandma, c'mere. I think I trust you enough to show you something.
Shhh... Okay, you know these trashbags we collect? Well, they serve another purpose.
The Warden is a tough brute, and he doesn't allow almost anything in here. So we've taken it upon ourselves to bring in some more...
Thank you, dearie! These will really come in handy!

SBE_Jailbreak_DroppingGrandmaIdOnPhone_0.value: Hello? You asked me to call you.
Ah, good. You received the phone. It’s very hard to keep things undercover here...
Executive Correctional Officer Kimberly Adams. This isn’t usually the way I speak with our inmates, but matters have escalated... Look.
You and I both want something and we can help each other. I can get you what you need to leave this place. But in return...
I need you to do something for me.
Well dearie, it all depends on what that something is. I’m also slightly concerned for you, because you don’t seem to know EXACTLY who you’re talking to...
Why, THE Ursula Boulton, of course. I know ALL about YOU! Help me out with this little thing, and who knows? I may be even generous enough to help you...

SBE_Jailbreak_DroppingGrandmasIdOnPhone_.value: Hello? You asked me to call you.
Ah, good. You received the phone. It's very hard to keep things undercover here...
For now, all you need to know is that I'm... A friend.
You and I both want something and we can help each other. I can get you what you need to leave this place. But in return...
I need you to do something for me.
Well dearie, it all depends on what that something is. I'm also slightly concerned for you because it may seem like you don't EXACTLY know who you're talking to...
Why THE Ursula Boulton of course. I know ALL about YOU! Help me out with this little thing, and who knows. I may be even generous enough to help you...

SBE_Jailbreak_EndPopup_Content.value: Maddie has stumbled upon Grandma’s secret journal chronicling her experiences in jail! Discover the untold story of what happened to Grandma after she was arrested. This event is VERY different from other events, so think outside of the box, buckle up and get ready!

SBE_Jailbreak_EndPopup_Content_Bluetooth.value: The guards arrived in the morning to find Grandma’s cell empty! They searched the entire area and found her trying to escape the yard. Later, after they had thrown away and taken the decoy to the landfill, a dirty yet happy Bluetooth climbs out of the decoy to freedom! Congratulations!

SBE_Jailbreak_EndPopup_Content_Generic.value: The guards arrived, in the morning, to find Grandma’s cell empty with a decoy! They searched the entire area but found no trace of her. Congratulations! Grandma has escaped!
The guards arrived in the morning to find Grandma’s cell empty with a decoy! They searched the entire area, but found no trace of her. Congratulations! Grandma has escaped!

SBE_Jailbreak_EndPopup_Content_Grace.value: The guards arrived in the morning to find Grandma’s cell empty! They searched the entire area and found her trying to escape the yard. Later, after they had thrown away and taken the decoy to the landfill, a dirty yet happy Grace climbs out of the decoy to freedom! Congratulations!

SBE_Jailbreak_EndPopup_Content_Izzy.value: The guards arrived in the morning to find Grandma’s cell empty! They searched the entire area and found her trying to escape the yard. Later, after they had thrown away and taken the decoy to the landfill, a dirty yet happy Izzy climbs out of the decoy to freedom! Congratulations!

SBE_Jailbreak_EventPopUp(NonDialogue)_01.value: Maddie has found Grandma's secret journal! Discover the unknown truth of Grandma's time in Jail!

SBE_Jailbreak_Factory_01.value: I’m sure this place will be busy when they have some scrap metal to work with.

SBE_Jailbreak_FinalWardenConfrontrationI.value: I don’t know how you fooled my guards, but I doubt there is anything you can do to harm me.
Don’t forget... THIS IS MY DOMAIN.

SBE_Jailbreak_GettingTheSuitcaseOfMoneyI.value: This is it! Proof that the Warden is taking bribes to keep people in jail illegally!
Time to show him that his time is up.

SBE_Jailbreak_GraceEscapesPop-Up_01.value: The guards arrived in the morning to find Grandma’s cell empty! They searched the entire area and found her trying to escape the yard. Later, after they had thrown away and taken the decoy to the landfill, a dirty yet happy Grace climbs out of the decoy to freedom! Congratulations!

SBE_Jailbreak_GrandmaAsksBluetoothAboutL.value: I can’t believe they got the Warden! Wow!
Sure was. I even heard from my lawyer! Can you believe that?!
Supposedly, this’ll all get cleared up by the end of the year. This is incredible.
I even heard that some girls are getting released right away! I’m thrilled for them.
Wouldn’t you want to join them?
Me? Naah, I can wait. I got a fun enough job to pass the time, and now I can tease the guards!

SBE_Jailbreak_GrandmaAsksGraceAboutLeavi.value: Just great! Here I was, thinking that we’d all get to leave after this mess and I just found out it’ll take till the end of the year to clear my name.
But I guess I could wait just a little longer...
What will you do when you leave?
Probably go see my sister again and give her a big hug...
I’d do that right away if I could...

SBE_Jailbreak_GrandmaAsksIzzyAboutLeavin.value: Oh Izzy... I’m sorry you aren’t one of the first to leave.
It’s okay, I guess. After the Warden’s arrest, my father started getting a bit of headway on my situation. There’s even evidence that my case may even be fraudulent!
But... End of the year? It is quite a long time to wait if you ask me...

SBE_Jailbreak_GrandmaCellInOperationJail.value: Wonderful, our cell is nice and clean for the day!
Wonderful, the cell is nice and clean for the day!
You know, I’ve never seen it like this before. It’s down right homely!

SBE_Jailbreak_GrandmaDecoyAndChooseWhoGe.value: In the morning, when the guards come and find my cell empty, apart from my decoy. They’ll think I’ve escaped.
What they won’t know is, I’ll be hiding in the decoy! So when they throw the decoy out in the trash, that’ll be my escape.
Good thing I sabotaged the trash compactor... But...
What about Grace, Izzy and Bluetooth? They deserve to escape as much as I do!
I could tell them about my escape plan. But only one of them could hide in the decoy...
So I need to be sure about this... Do I go... Or do I give my spot to someone else? Who do I pick?!

SBE_Jailbreak_GrandmaEscapesPop-Up_01.value: The guards arrived in the morning to find Grandma’s cell empty with a decoy! They searched the entire area, but found no trace of her. Congratulations! Grandma has escaped!

SBE_Jailbreak_GrandmaTalksToAdamsAboutEs.value: So, it looks like you’ve met the illustrious warden.
Unfortunately, yes. But thankfully, I know the type. His hubris will be his downfall, dearie.
One last thing... I know now how to call in that favor from you.
I’m very fond of knitting, so I’m going to need some wool.

SBE_Jailbreak_GrandmasCellInOperationJai.value: Wonderful, our cell is nice and clean for the day!
Wonderful, the cell is nice and clean for the day!
You know, I've never seen it like this before. It's down right homely!

SBE_Jailbreak_Grandmatask1_01.value: I guess it all started when they threw me in jail after the police believed that the gold watch Maddie found linked me to the disappearance of Charlie!
I guess it all started when they threw me in jail after the police believed that the gold watch Maddie found linked me to the death of Charlie!

SBE_Jailbreak_Grandmatask2_01.value: Of course, there was a connection to me. I gave him that watch! But I was soon going to find out another reason why they threw me into this particular jail...

SBE_Jailbreak_Grandmatask3_01.value: Being in jail wasn’t so bad. So in order to pass the time, I took up a job as a cleaner. These messy cells don’t clean themselves.

SBE_Jailbreak_Grandmatask3_02.value: Seemed oddly appropriate, since I had to sort out the mess that got me thrown me in jail as well. Thankfully, Julius was there to help me on that front.

SBE_Jailbreak_Grandmatask3_03.value: So, while I waited, I thought it best to make as many friends as possible. And that is when I met Grace...

SBE_Jailbreak_Grandmatask3_04.value: Step 3. Create a decoy. With the items I can get from each location and with the help of my allies, I’ll make a convincing decoy of myself.

SBE_Jailbreak_Grandmatask3_05.value: Step 4. Create a distraction. I’ll need to create a distraction in the cafeteria to help me escape.

SBE_Jailbreak_Grandmatask3_06.value: Step 5. Escape during the hustle and bustle of the distraction.

SBE_Jailbreak_Grandmatask3_07.value: So let’s start with my cellmate, Grace. She seems to know her way around this place!

SBE_Jailbreak_Guard2Intro_01.value: Warden Decker was very specific to keep an eye on you, Mrs. Boulton.

SBE_Jailbreak_Guard2Intro_02.value: Oh? I’m not the only one you’re keeping an eye on, am I Officer Lewis?

SBE_Jailbreak_Guard2Intro_03.value: Wh... What do you mean by that?!

SBE_Jailbreak_Guard2Outro_01.value: How?! How did you know that I have a crush on Lt. Johnson?

SBE_Jailbreak_Guard2Outro_02.value: I have my ways, dearie. Now... I need you to tell me everything about the Warden.

SBE_Jailbreak_Guard2TaskA_01.value: Oh, please... I’ve seen the way you look at him.

SBE_Jailbreak_Guard2TaskA_02.value: Not to mention the sweet notes you sometimes leave.

SBE_Jailbreak_Guard2TaskA_03.value: I... I don’t know what you’re talking about!

SBE_Jailbreak_Guard2TaskB_01.value: You can’t threaten me! I’m a guard.

SBE_Jailbreak_Guard2TaskB_02.value: Oh dearie, I’m not threatening. I’m just stating obvious facts.

SBE_Jailbreak_Guard2TaskB_03.value: Which begs the question. Do you think Lt. Johnson knows about this?

SBE_Jailbreak_Guard3Intro_01.value: *Yawn* Okay, I’ve been tasked to follow you around, but to be honest, I’m way too tired. So how about I just sit here and you do nothing illegal?

SBE_Jailbreak_Guard3Intro_02.value: Oh, dearie... I wouldn’t dream of such a thing.

SBE_Jailbreak_Guard3Outro_02.value: Dearie, I really need you to wake up. You shouldn’t be sleeping on the job, you know. Might look bad.

SBE_Jailbreak_Guard3Outro_03.value: Huh what?! Oh no! Not again! I can’t get a third strike! Please, I’ll do anything!

SBE_Jailbreak_Guard3TaskA_04.value: Oh! Yes? I was just resting my eyes. The air is pretty dry in here...

SBE_Jailbreak_Guard3TaskB_02.value: So how long has she been like that?

SBE_Jailbreak_Guard3TaskB_04.value: With guards like there, I often wonder why we don’t just walk out of here...

SBE_Jailbreak_GuardIntro_01.value: You don’t scare me, Grandma! You may be popular amongst the other inmates, but that means nothing to me.

SBE_Jailbreak_GuardIntro_02.value: In here, I am the law.

SBE_Jailbreak_GuardIntro_03.value: We shall see about that, dearie.

SBE_Jailbreak_GuardOutro_01.value: Alright, alright! You win Grandma! I don’t know how you learned all that about me, but I can’t let people know. I’ll lose my job!

SBE_Jailbreak_GuardOutro_02.value: Then you won’t mind helping me take down the Warden.

SBE_Jailbreak_GuardTaskA_01.value: Lt. Johnson... You seem to be doing well for yourself.

SBE_Jailbreak_GuardTaskA_02.value: And what would YOU know about that?

SBE_Jailbreak_GuardTaskB_01.value: Okay, I’ll bite. What do you think you know?

SBE_Jailbreak_GuardTaskB_02.value: Oh, nothing much... Only that you “may” have bought a sailboat and “may” have forgotten to pay your taxes...

Finish tasks and progress in milestones to help Grandma escape!
