SBE_Jailbreak_IzzyEscapesPop-Up_01.value: The guards arrived in the morning to find Grandma’s cell empty! They searched the entire area and found her trying to escape the yard. Later, after they had thrown away and taken the decoy to the landfill, a dirty yet happy Izzy climbs out of the decoy to freedom! Congratulations!

SBE_Jailbreak_IzzyIsTired_01.value: I don’t think I should be around this much, so I’ll be heading back to my cell.

SBE_Jailbreak_IzzyOpensTheWardensOffice_.value: Don’t worry Grandma! I can open this door for you. All I need is a hairpin and... Presto!

SBE_Jailbreak_JailboardIntro_03.value: I’ve decided to write an account of my short time in jail.

SBE_Jailbreak_JailboardIntro_04.value: I must admit that it was a strange time, and I met a lot of interesting people.

SBE_Jailbreak_JailboardIntro_05.value: However, I didn’t quite expect it to end the way it did! But perhaps it would be best if I start at the beginning...

SBE_Jailbreak_JailboardIntro_06.value: No matter how lovely things are in here, I have to leave. I need to get back to Maddie before she gets herself into trouble!

SBE_Jailbreak_JailboardIntro_07.value: So, it's time to enact my little escape plan. I've already learned everyone's routines and potential weaknesses...

SBE_Jailbreak_JailboardIntro_08.value: That means I now have to make a reputation for myself. I'll start with befriending my cellmate!

SBE_Jailbreak_KittyIsTired_01.value: Time to head back to my cell. I’m beat!

SBE_Jailbreak_KittyOpensStorageRoom_01.value: Don’t worry about it Grandma, I got this for you!

SBE_Jailbreak_Library_01.value: Never underestimate a good library. They often contain more information than just books...

SBE_Jailbreak_MamaIsTired_01.value: This ol’ gal needs to rest her eyes for a second...

SBE_Jailbreak_MamaOpenTheCafeteria_01.value: C’mon darlin’, you know Ol’ Mama wouldn’t let you do it by yerself!

SBE_Jailbreak_MergingLocationDialogue_01.value: I should really explore this jail. This jail cell shouldn’t be the only thing I know about this place. Besides...

SBE_Jailbreak_MergingLocationDialogue_02.value: Maybe I’ll find something useful in them.

SBE_Jailbreak_MoneybagDialogue_01.value: This is it! Proof that the Warden is taking bribes to keep people in jail illegally!

SBE_Jailbreak_MoneybagDialogue_02.value: Let’s show him that his time is up.

SBE_Jailbreak_P1BiographyPopUp(NonDialog.value: Grace Martin - Doing time for theft of government property. She claims she was framed after she did a report on a city official. She knows her way around the jail and seems friendly enough.

SBE_Jailbreak_P1Complete_01.value: Yes, my sister is Jackie Martin! She works for the Boulton Bugle.

SBE_Jailbreak_P1Complete_02.value: Oh dearie, I know her! She is good friends with my granddaughter Maddie!

SBE_Jailbreak_P1Complete_05.value: Yeah, I was doing a piece on a government official. I guess I got too close to the truth, so they framed me for something I didn’t do and threw me in here.

SBE_Jailbreak_P1Complete_06.value: I think the Warden is in on it, too, because I’ve been stuck here for months. My lawyer even says he can’t find any legal paperwork to say I should be in here, except... Here I am!

SBE_Jailbreak_P1Complete_07.value: Well... That just won’t do, will it, dearie?

SBE_Jailbreak_P1GangUnlock_01.value: So, it looks like you’re making friends...

SBE_Jailbreak_P1GangUnlock_02.value: Yes, and it looks like you’re illegally holding people against their will!

SBE_Jailbreak_P1GangUnlock_03.value: I must admit, that seems to be the case. You’re speaking about Grace Martin, correct?

SBE_Jailbreak_P1GangUnlock_05.value: Well, she isn’t the only one. And THAT is the issue I need your help with resolving. The chief warden, Decker, is a corrupt man. He’s using this jail as his own private business.

SBE_Jailbreak_P1GangUnlock_06.value: He is taking money from people in power to make their rivals disappear. I cannot, in good conscience, let this continue. That’s why I need your help.

SBE_Jailbreak_P1GangUnlock_07.value: I’ll call you later with more information. For now, go meet with “Kitty” Palmer. She works in the Storage Room. You’ll find that she may share something with Grace...

SBE_Jailbreak_P1IdPositive_01.value: Hey! Thanks for helping out with this! I really appreciate it!

SBE_Jailbreak_P1IdPositive_02.value: Not a problem, dearie! I’ve got this handled.

SBE_Jailbreak_P1Intro_03.value: I just wanted to apologize for my recent behavior. I’m usually quite social, you know!

SBE_Jailbreak_P1Intro_04.value: First time, huh? I get it. Don’t worry about it.

SBE_Jailbreak_P1Intro_05.value: Please! Let me make it right, dearie. I see you all day cleaning our cell and the others all by yourself.
Please! Let me make it right, dearie. I see you all day cleaning our cell, and the others, all by yourself.

SBE_Jailbreak_P1Intro_07.value: Alright then... try to keep up!

SBE_Jailbreak_P1TaskA_01.value: So what are you in for, Grandma?

SBE_Jailbreak_P1TaskA_02.value: You don’t seem the type to end up in a place like this...

SBE_Jailbreak_P1TaskA_03.value: It’s all big a misunderstanding... They arrested me in front of my mansion and-

SBE_Jailbreak_P1TaskB_01.value: That’s one amazing story! If I weren’t in here, I’d probably write a piece on you!

SBE_Jailbreak_P1TaskB_03.value: A reporter actually! Best in the field. But...

SBE_Jailbreak_P1TaskB_04.value: My sister isn’t half bad either! Jackie has taken up the mantle while I’m here being framed.

SBE_Jailbreak_P1TaskB_05.value: Framed? Wait, did you say your sister was Jackie? As in Jackie Martin?

SBE_Jailbreak_P2Complete_01.value: So, are you telling me... you’re only in here for scratching a car?

SBE_Jailbreak_P2Complete_02.value: Yup! Pretty much. I’m still waiting to see my lawyer. But no one’s come yet.

SBE_Jailbreak_P2Complete_03.value: I’m getting the feeling that your story isn’t unique here...

SBE_Jailbreak_P2Complete_04.value: Yeah, that’s the running joke we have. Everyone is innocent! Hahahahaha!

SBE_Jailbreak_P2GangUnlock_01.value: I’m pretty sure you can see the problem I’m dealing with now.

SBE_Jailbreak_P2GangUnlock_02.value: What I see is that the Warden is on the wrong side of these bars...

SBE_Jailbreak_P2GangUnlock_03.value: Warden Decker has this place wrapped around his finger, tighter than a boa constrictor. None of the guards are eager to go up against him.

SBE_Jailbreak_P2GangUnlock_04.value: That’s why I need someone like you... on the inside. To... persuade them. While you gather evidence of all the false incarcerations, of course.

SBE_Jailbreak_P2GangUnlock_05.value: You should speak to “Mama” Kowalski, who runs the cafeteria! Find out her story and see if we use it as more evidence...

SBE_Jailbreak_P2IdPositive_01.value: People should call you Super Grandma!

SBE_Jailbreak_P2IdPositive_02.value: You’ve been so helpful here, I might have free time for the first time in ages!

SBE_Jailbreak_P2Intro_01.value: Ah! You must be Ur- no wait... Grace said to call you Grandma!

SBE_Jailbreak_P2Intro_02.value: Yes, dearie! But I don’t mind introducing myse-

SBE_Jailbreak_P2Intro_03.value: Catherine Palmer! But everyone calls me Kitty.

SBE_Jailbreak_P2Intro_04.value: Kinda like everyone calling you Grandma, huh?

SBE_Jailbreak_P2Intro_05.value: Nice to meet you! So what did you do to get thrown in with us?

SBE_Jailbreak_P2Intro_06.value: Let me guess! You Drove over a flower garden?

SBE_Jailbreak_P2Intro_08.value: Nonono! You ROBBED A BANK! Hijacked an airplane! Crashed a cruise ship into a port!

SBE_Jailbreak_P2Intro_09.value: People say I speak too much...

SBE_Jailbreak_P2TaskA_01.value: Tell me, dearie... Why are YOU in here?

SBE_Jailbreak_P2TaskA_02.value: Me?! Ha! The sheriff thought I boosted a car! Can you believe that? Me?!

SBE_Jailbreak_P2TaskA_03.value: I was just borrowing my brother’s car to do some stunt driving... Okay, I may have accidentally scratched Mayor Bruno’s car in the process, but still, it was only an accident.

SBE_Jailbreak_P2TaskA_04.value: Next thing I know, the PD was knocking on my door and dragging me in here! I didn’t even get my phone call!

SBE_Jailbreak_P2TaskB_01.value: Wow, Grandma! You sure know how to get things going!

SBE_Jailbreak_P2TaskB_02.value: Not my first rodeo. I know how to get around, dearie.

SBE_Jailbreak_P2TaskB_03.value: You know, you remind me of my Nana. She always said...

SBE_Jailbreak_P3BiographyPopUp(NonDialog.value: Amanda "Mama" Kowalski - Awaiting trial for smuggling and counterfeiting. Everyone calls her Mama, mostly because she treats everyone like her children. And like every strict parent, she keeps people in line. The de facto boss of the cell block.

SBE_Jailbreak_P3Complete_01.value: Well, butter my backside and call me a biscuit!

SBE_Jailbreak_P3Complete_03.value: It takes a whole lot to impress ol’ Mama over here, and you impressed me a lot!

SBE_Jailbreak_P3Complete_04.value: Truth be told, darlin’... You’re starting to make me look bad!

SBE_Jailbreak_P3Complete_05.value: Not my intention in the least, Mama!

SBE_Jailbreak_P3Complete_06.value: Ha! I know. But if it’s all the same between you and me, I’m gonna send you to Bluetooth.

SBE_Jailbreak_P3Complete_08.value: She’s one of my girls who runs the recyclin’ factory. She needs a hand and we have a lot of trash from lunch that needs to be taken there.

SBE_Jailbreak_P3Complete_09.value: But don’t be a stranger now!

SBE_Jailbreak_P3GangUnlock_02.value: Yes... It sounds like Bruno and his wife Victoria seem to have a connection to this place. Both have caused people to end up here.

SBE_Jailbreak_P3GangUnlock_03.value: Hmm... that’s a pretty big accusation, but perhaps it’ll help. I assume Mama was one of their victims?

SBE_Jailbreak_P3GangUnlock_04.value: Unfortunately, yes... But now it’s my turn to ask you a question. You said you would help me. All I see currently is me digging up information for you!

SBE_Jailbreak_P3GangUnlock_05.value: Ah yes... Alright, I’ll be honest with you. I can’t entirely... legally get you out of here, since you’re not entirely legally registered to this jail.

SBE_Jailbreak_P3GangUnlock_07.value: That’s why I’m willing to help you to... Not entirely legally, escape this jail.

SBE_Jailbreak_P3IdPositive_01.value: You make me happier than a dead pig in sunshine!

SBE_Jailbreak_P3IdPositive_03.value: Ain’t no other way to put it, darlin’. You’re a special as all get out.

SBE_Jailbreak_P3IdPositive_04.value: Only doing what is needed, dearie.

SBE_Jailbreak_P3Intro_01.value: Well, aren’t you sweeter than a cherry pie!

SBE_Jailbreak_P3Intro_02.value: C’mere darlin’! Let Mama give ya a big ol’ hug!

SBE_Jailbreak_P3Intro_04.value: There we go! Welcome to the cafeteria! Or, as I like to call it, Mama’s Kitchin’.

SBE_Jailbreak_P3Intro_05.value: Now I heard from some of my girls that you’re pretty handy to have around... That true, darlin’?

SBE_Jailbreak_P3Intro_06.value: Well, I’d like to think so, yes. Those poor girls really need all the help they can get.

SBE_Jailbreak_P3Intro_07.value: Oh my, where are my manners? I’m Mama Kowalski!

SBE_Jailbreak_P3Intro_08.value: But you can call me Mama. Everyone does!

SBE_Jailbreak_P3TaskA_01.value: You ain’t never tasted food like ol’ Mama’s Kitchin’!

SBE_Jailbreak_P3TaskA_02.value: Sometimes my girls might get their feathers all ruffled up because there ain’t enough corn bread. You ever taste my corn bread? Of course you haven’t, darlin’!

SBE_Jailbreak_P3TaskA_03.value: Here... Have a big ol’ bite.

SBE_Jailbreak_P3TaskB_01.value: You got gumption, darlin’! Never seen someone your age in here.

SBE_Jailbreak_P3TaskB_02.value: Oh, it’s all a mistake, dearie. One could even say that I’m being framed!

SBE_Jailbreak_P3TaskB_03.value: Framed?! You n’ me are like two peas in a pod. So was I!! Careful now, don’t want my girls to confuse you for ol’ Mama.

SBE_Jailbreak_P3TaskB_04.value: So, what got you in here?

SBE_Jailbreak_P3TaskB_05.value: Well, ain’t that the darndest thing! I have no idea. But one of my girls thinks it was this lady I served at my restaurant before they shut it down. She said she hated my food!

SBE_Jailbreak_P3TaskB_06.value: Called it vile and third class drivel! So I gave her a piece of my mind and she had a real hissy fit. She stormed off with those horns of her like a bull in a china shop!

SBE_Jailbreak_P3TaskB_07.value: Next thing I know, the police arrive and arrest me for egregious food violations! I didn’t even know that existed!

SBE_Jailbreak_P3TaskB_08.value: Did you say horns? This lady wasn’t Victoria Golightly by any chance, was it?

SBE_Jailbreak_P3TaskB_09.value: You know, darlin, it very well may have been!

SBE_Jailbreak_P4Complete_01.value: So it looks like you and Grace were sent in here because you found something you shouldn’t have...

SBE_Jailbreak_P4Complete_02.value: And people in power sent in the others because of petty whims!

SBE_Jailbreak_P4Complete_04.value: I see... Well, dearie, it looks like I arrived just in time!

SBE_Jailbreak_P4Complete_05.value: Wh.... What do you mean by that?!

SBE_Jailbreak_P4Complete_06.value: It means I have a lot of work to do! Tell me...

SBE_Jailbreak_P4Complete_07.value: Who should I talk to that knows all the secrets around here?

SBE_Jailbreak_P4GangUnlock_01.value: Alright. I’ll help you take down Warden Decker.

SBE_Jailbreak_P4GangUnlock_03.value: But you’ll need to do A LOT more than just let me escape...

SBE_Jailbreak_P4GangUnlock_05.value: All these girls who are wrongfully jailed. I want all their names to be cleared.

SBE_Jailbreak_P4GangUnlock_06.value: I’m sorry, I can’t do that.

SBE_Jailbreak_P4GangUnlock_08.value: Because the Warden hasn’t registered them. They’re ghosts in the system.

SBE_Jailbreak_P4GangUnlock_10.value: I’m sorry, I can’t allow that either. I got my reputation to consider here.

SBE_Jailbreak_P4GangUnlock_11.value: You’re resourceful... You’ll figure it out.

SBE_Jailbreak_P4IdPositive_01.value: Maybe once I get out and start my computer company, I’ll have you run the manufacturing?

SBE_Jailbreak_P4IdPositive_02.value: Oh, I don’t know about that, dearie. But I’ll sure make you a good Hopeberry pie!

SBE_Jailbreak_P4IdPositive_03.value: If you can bake as well as you run machinery, you’re on!

SBE_Jailbreak_P4Intro_02.value: Yes, dearie! But you can call me Grandma.

SBE_Jailbreak_P4Intro_03.value: Yeah, no. That’s weird, and honestly, you look nothing like my grandmother.

SBE_Jailbreak_P4Intro_05.value: So, Ursula, do you have any technical skills? Do you know how to run any sort of industrial machinery?

SBE_Jailbreak_P4Intro_06.value: I once operated the bodymaker at the family can plant.

SBE_Jailbreak_P4Intro_07.value: Okay, I can work with that!

SBE_Jailbreak_P4TaskA_01.value: ...Are you telling me that they threw in an old lady because of a gold watch?! Well, ain’t that a stretch!

SBE_Jailbreak_P4TaskA_02.value: It seems to me, dearie, that this is a common problem around here.

SBE_Jailbreak_P4TaskA_03.value: Ah yeah... Well, not for me. I guess I’m the only one who deserves to be in here.

SBE_Jailbreak_P4TaskA_04.value: What? Why? What did you do?!

SBE_Jailbreak_P4TaskB_01.value: I guess I’m good with computers, you know.

SBE_Jailbreak_P4TaskB_02.value: I can get into places others can’t. That sort of thing.

SBE_Jailbreak_P4TaskB_03.value: Well, one day I was in this government system and I found some stuff. Real shady too! I made a copy and sent it to a journalist friend of mine and-

SBE_Jailbreak_P4TaskB_05.value: Shhh! These walls have ears, you know. Yes, Grace. That’s probably why she’s in here. Because of me. I broke into the system, but she only got the data I stole.

SBE_Jailbreak_P4TaskB_06.value: But I tell you... What I saw in that data? Those people should be in here, instead of us!

SBE_Jailbreak_P5Complete_01.value: While you might not have a need for this information, I’m sure I can find a use for it, dearie.

SBE_Jailbreak_P5Complete_03.value: That’s very kind of you, dearie. Hopefully, once I’m done with this mess, I can do something about our situation here.

SBE_Jailbreak_P5Complete_04.value: Let’s just make sure none of that then leads back to me, okay?

SBE_Jailbreak_P5Complete_05.value: Wh- What do you mean by that?

SBE_Jailbreak_P5Complete_06.value: Come on, a Granny like you in a place like this? It has got to be a MISTAKE!

SBE_Jailbreak_P5Complete_07.value: Oh! Hahaha. Yes, dearie. All a big misunderstanding.

SBE_Jailbreak_P5GangUnlock_01.value: I heard you’ve gathered some dirt on the guards? Shouldn’t you be focusing on the Warden?

SBE_Jailbreak_P5GangUnlock_02.value: I have my methods, dearie. Besides, I may need their cooperation for what I have in mind...

SBE_Jailbreak_P5GangUnlock_03.value: I’ll be surprised if you can get the guards to turn on the Warden...

SBE_Jailbreak_P5GangUnlock_04.value: But if you want to go down that route, then I suggest you talk to Iseul Park...

SBE_Jailbreak_P5GangUnlock_05.value: But for now, I believe I have enough access to the jail in order to advance my escape plans.

SBE_Jailbreak_P5IdPositive_01.value: Wow! This is more than I hoped for! Amazing work, Granny!

SBE_Jailbreak_P5IdPositive_03.value: You even organized the library cards!

SBE_Jailbreak_P5Intro_01.value: Ah... Grandma. Did I get that right?

SBE_Jailbreak_P5Intro_02.value: Yes, dearie. I heard from Bluetooth that you run the library?

SBE_Jailbreak_P5Intro_03.value: That’s absolutely right. Welcome to my domain!

SBE_Jailbreak_P5Intro_04.value: Here you’ll find a surprisingly vast collection of fiction, non-fiction, recipe books, newspapers and magazines. And my favorite...

SBE_Jailbreak_P5Intro_06.value: You’d be surprised how much you can learn about people from the books they read...

SBE_Jailbreak_P5Intro_07.value: to the notes they leave each other.

SBE_Jailbreak_P5Intro_08.value: How interesting, it looks like I came to the right place!

SBE_Jailbreak_P5Intro_09.value: Tell me... How WELL do you know the jail staff?

SBE_Jailbreak_P5TaskA_01.value: You’d be surprised how much I DO know about the guards...

SBE_Jailbreak_P5TaskA_02.value: You see, they like to use the library as their private club house. I guess they don’t enjoy being in the office rec room with the Warden nearby and all.

SBE_Jailbreak_P5TaskA_03.value: That’s why we stock some really interesting magazines and books covering subjects I don’t think people would normally want inmates to read.

SBE_Jailbreak_P5TaskA_04.value: May I have a look at these books and magazines?

SBE_Jailbreak_P5TaskA_05.value: Sure thing! Just don’t be surprised if you find some interesting stuff in the books. People in here like to use the books as an unofficial messaging service.

SBE_Jailbreak_P5TaskA_06.value: Even THE GUARDS like to use them from time to time, when they don’t want their conversations on the record.

SBE_Jailbreak_P5TaskB_01.value: Dearie me! You can’t believe what I’ve found in here!

SBE_Jailbreak_P5TaskB_02.value: Oh, I’m pretty sure I can...

SBE_Jailbreak_P5TaskB_03.value: A lot of this would look VERY bad to some of these guards.

SBE_Jailbreak_P5TaskB_04.value: You got that right. I even thought for a while to use it as a leverage, but then again. What would I stand to gain from it? I’m only in here for a short time.

SBE_Jailbreak_P5TaskB_06.value: I spray painted the court house. It was due some color.

SBE_Jailbreak_P6Complete_01.value: Dearie, I know you’re not supposed to be in here... It looks like none of us are. So if you want to, you could help me get us out of here?

SBE_Jailbreak_P6Complete_03.value: You said you aren’t allowed to talk to anyone. So that makes you a bit of a ghost, right? Maybe you could overhear some stuff about what the guards are talking about?

SBE_Jailbreak_P6Complete_04.value: You... You want me to be a spy?

SBE_Jailbreak_P6Complete_05.value: In a matter of speaking... Yes.

SBE_Jailbreak_P6Complete_07.value: Sure. Why not! What else have I got to lose? Besides, it would be nice to get a little payback!

SBE_Jailbreak_P6GangUnlock_01.value: Hello, Mrs. Boulton. It is a pleasure to finally meet you. I hope you’ve enjoyed your stay so far?

SBE_Jailbreak_P6GangUnlock_02.value: Actually, I would like to see the manager and lodge a complaint.

SBE_Jailbreak_P6GangUnlock_03.value: Ha! You’ve got quite the wit. Not a problem. That’s usually the first thing to go after a few years here...

SBE_Jailbreak_P6GangUnlock_04.value: Funny, here I thought you should be the one to go, dearie.

SBE_Jailbreak_P6GangUnlock_05.value: I’m on to you, “Grandma”. I might not have all the details yet, but you’re up to something.

SBE_Jailbreak_P6GangUnlock_06.value: So, just to be safe, I’m going to have my top guards monitor you from now on.

SBE_Jailbreak_P6GangUnlock_07.value: Whatever makes you feel safer, dearie...

SBE_Jailbreak_P6IdPositive_01.value: Thank you! These are exactly what I was looking for!

SBE_Jailbreak_P6IdPositive_02.value: You know, with your help, I’m sure I could build a machine that could dig us out of here?

SBE_Jailbreak_P6Intro_01.value: Hello, dearie. I’ve seen you around a couple of times. I was wondering if we could talk?

SBE_Jailbreak_P6Intro_04.value: Don’t you know the rules? You don’t talk to me!

SBE_Jailbreak_P6Intro_05.value: But you seem pretty lonely... Are you sure?

SBE_Jailbreak_P6TaskA_01.value: You again, what do you want?

SBE_Jailbreak_P6TaskA_02.value: Let me introduce myself. I’m Ursula Boulton, but people call me Grandma around here, dearie.

SBE_Jailbreak_P6TaskA_03.value: Well, okay then, GRANDMA. What do you want?

SBE_Jailbreak_P6TaskA_04.value: I need your help with the guards...

SBE_Jailbreak_P6TaskB_01.value: No way, I ain’t helping you with them! They told me specifically not to talk to anyone, and that’s what I’ll do.

SBE_Jailbreak_P6TaskB_02.value: But dearie, that isn’t right! Why are you in here?

SBE_Jailbreak_P6TaskB_03.value: I... don’t know. I was in university, and the cops came in and dragged me to jail. Said something about identity theft. My dad is trying to sort it out, but I have heard nothing in a while.

SBE_Jailbreak_P6TaskB_05.value: Yeah, well... What can you do? I’ve also been ordered to keep my mouth shut about it, so...

SBE_Jailbreak_RespectShop_InfoPopup_UseR.value: Buy Respect Items and Find the way out

SBE_Jailbreak_SafeboxDialogue_01.value: Hmm... Whatever secrets he’s hiding must be in there!

SBE_Jailbreak_SafeboxDialogue_02.value: All I need to do now is get inside.

SBE_Jailbreak_ShopProgressionPopup_Decor.value: Complete tasks to unlock the character

SBE_Jailbreak_SpecialLetterDialogue_01.value: I should have enough evidence here to “persuade” some of the guards now.

SBE_Jailbreak_SpecialLetterDialogue_02.value: I should have enough evidence here to “persuade” some of the guards now.

SBE_Jailbreak_StartPopup_Description.value: Maddie has found Grandma's secret journal! Discover the unknown truth of Grandma's time in Jail!

SBE_Jailbreak_Storage_01.value: Hmm... Looks like a useful location, but I might-

SBE_Jailbreak_Storage_02.value: Hey! You can’t be in here unless you work here or you’re bringing in a cart!

SBE_Jailbreak_Storage_03.value: Oh dearie me, I’m dreadfully sorry...

SBE_Jailbreak_Task_016.value: Find the phone in the Cell

SBE_Jailbreak_Task_019.value: Use Cart to access the Factory

SBE_Jailbreak_Task_032.value: Search your Cell for a Pie

SBE_Jailbreak_Task_043.value: Help send a letter in secret

SBE_Jailbreak_Task_045.value: Use evidence to arrest the Warden

SBE_Jailbreak_TeasePopup_Description.value: Please reach requirement X to discover the story of how Grandma escaped from jail!

SBE_Jailbreak_WardenChat1_01.value: I’ve been reading up on you Ursula... Or is it Grandma? Would you prefer Grandma?

SBE_Jailbreak_WardenChat1_03.value: Very well... Ursula. I hope you realize that I’m being far more accommodating to you than my other “guests”.

SBE_Jailbreak_WardenChat1_04.value: Thanks, but you don’t need to show me any special treatment. I’m more than capable of handling this place...

SBE_Jailbreak_WardenChat2_01.value: I hope my guards haven’t been pestering you too much, my dear.

SBE_Jailbreak_WardenChat2_02.value: Oh, not at all. In fact, some have been downright helpful!

SBE_Jailbreak_WardenChat2_04.value: Not too difficult with the present company, I assure you.

SBE_Jailbreak_WardenChat2_05.value: Let’s see how funny you are after a few years in here.

SBE_Jailbreak_WardenChat2_06.value: I may not be as funny. But you, Warden Decker, will always be a fool.

SBE_Jailbreak_WardenChat3_01.value: You know... I thought you would be easier to control...

SBE_Jailbreak_WardenChat3_02.value: That was your first mistake, dearie.

SBE_Jailbreak_WardenChat3_03.value: Oh, don’t get me wrong, Ursula.

SBE_Jailbreak_WardenChat3_04.value: It just means that I haven’t found the right “motivation” yet.

SBE_Jailbreak_WardenChat3_05.value: Tell me, how is your grand daughter doing these days?

SBE_Jailbreak_WardenOutro_02.value: I believe you know what it is, dearie...

SBE_Jailbreak_WardenOutro_03.value: How dare you! How did you get that?!

SBE_Jailbreak_WardenOutro_04.value: Nevermind that dearie, what you should be concerned about is what happens next.

SBE_Jailbreak_WardenOutro_05.value: Warden Thomas Decker, you are under arrest for racketeering, corruption and illegal incarceration! Guards!

SBE_Jailbreak_WardenOutro_06.value: What?! Officer Adams, you can’t do that! I’M THE WARDEN IN HERE!

SBE_Jailbreak_WardenOutro_08.value: STOP! What are you doing? Take your hands off of me!

SBE_Jailbreak_WardenOutro_09.value: Come on, sir... Don’t make this difficult....

SBE_Jailbreak_WardenOutro_10.value: NO! Let go of me! LET GO!!!

SBE_Jailbreak_XoAdamsMeetsGrandmaAtOffic.value: You really know how to surprise people, Grandma. I really didn’t expect you to uncover so much information.
To be honest, dearie, it wasn’t that difficult. Corruption usually leaves a mess behind it. I just happen to be a good cleaner.
That you are. Now with this information, we should have enough to take on the Warden!
Not yet. I need to find a find more pieces of vital evidence before we can take him down.
Not yet. I need to find more pieces of vital evidence before we can take him down.

SBE_Jailbreak_^WhenWardenOfficeIsUnlocke.value: To be honest, dearie, it wasn't that difficult. Corruption usually leaves a mess behind it. I just happen to be a good cleaner.
That you are. Now with this information, we should have enough to go ahead and take on the Warden!
Not yet. I need to find a find more pieces of vital evidence before we can take him down.
Not yet. I need to find more pieces of vital evidence before we can take him down.

SE_DoubleDateDisaster2024_Cookware_Dialo.value: Here we go; let’s get cooking!

SE_DoubleDateDisaster2024_Cutlery_Dialog.value: Wow, these are razor sharp! Where’d you get them?
Erm... I borrowed them from Grandma!

SE_DoubleDateDisaster2024_Decoration_Slo.value: I’ve really been enjoying myself!
Yeah... That’s great...
How did you know I LOVE mini golf? Just such a fun combination of engineering and sport.
Though this gopher is a bit creepy. Haha!
Uuuhm...
Emilio? Helloo?
Oh! Sorry, I... Maddie, something has come up and I... I need to tell you.
So... What is that you have to tell me?
Well... This is pretty hard for me to say...
I’ve known you for a year now, and I’ve never had a connection with anyone else, like the one I’ve had with you.
I’ve known you for almost a year now, and I’ve never had a connection with anyone else, like the one I’ve had with you.
Emilio... I... I feel the same way!
I... I know... I think I know... No, I know. So that’s why I have to tell you this now... I...
...Yes?
I... I’m leaving tonight for Bolivia to save the fish.
You’re leaving?
Tonight?!
TO BOLIVIA?!! It’s not even next to an ocean!
Well, it has some big lakes, which include lake Titic-
Stop! You could have told me earlier! You know... BEFORE!
I... I’m sorry! I truly am. But I just got the call, and they really need me there, Maddie! They really need me...
But... I need you. I... I lo-
Maddie...
Just... Just go, okay?!
Just go...
Whenever you ask someone on a date, you ask the question, right?
A mini golf course?!
Yeah! She’ll love it! She’s an engineer, after all. And she’s spoken about it before...
I was actually considering asking her o- Um. Asking her... This was before she met you, you understand?
Roddy, my friend, don’t worry.
I trust you. If you think this is a good idea, then let’s go with it. Who will you bring along?
Me?!
Of course. Mini Golf is always better in teams!
The Question
Avoid the chocolate. But you can’t. Can you?
Roddy Took... Are you asking me out on a date?!
Well... Um, it’s just that Emilio is planning this whole double date thing and...
I mean, I’m flattered, but don’t you have a thing for... You know?
That ship has sailed a while ago. And I’m sure you can guess who the captain is, anyway.
Haha! Fair enough. But back to your original question... Sure, why not?!
Great! Grab a putter!
Putter?
Confectionary Way
Fill the skies with love.
What’s all this?!
Surprise! I thought for our first Valentine’s I would do something special!
How sweet! I was ready for a nice romantic dinner, but this is something else!
Oh, the dinner is coming up! And so are the other guests!
Yay!
Heart-shaped Balloons
Let your love light shine!
Jackie and... Roddy?! Are you the other guests?
Yep! Roddy here asked me out on a date. Can you believe that?
Wow! Well, I always knew the two of you would finally see what I’ve been seeing.
Wh- What do you mean?!
Just that under that hard hat lies a pretty great guy!
Re- Really?!
Heart-shaped Lights
A few tasty treats to start the game.
Hey, Maddie! Have you seen- RODDY?!
Hello ladies, fancy a game of golf?
Ahahahahaha!! What are...
Hahaha!
Uuhm... I’ll be right back!
Candy Corner
Sometimes the path to one’s heart takes a turn.
Emilio has really put a lot of effort into this.
Actually, I think it’s mostly been Roddy! I’ve seen him running around and helping Emilio out.
I gotta admit. I’m quite surprised to see someone help so selflessly. He really IS a great guy. Wow!
Roddy, why do you look like you’ve just arrived on the Titanic?!
Too much?
Too much.
Cupid’s Curve
A feast for four.
Sup...
Okay, Roddy, I gotta ask.
What are you doing?!
I’m... I don’t know. I guess I got nervous and just don’t want to blow it. I thought if I could change the way I look, perhaps you’d...
Roddy! Fashion is great and all. But don’t worry about it. It’s what’s under the hard hat that counts.
Okay, great! I wasn’t so sure about this one, anyway.
Just promise me you’ll never wear that again. EVER.
Hahaha...
Valentine’s Banquet
It even has a spot for locks!
I think we got a winner here, buddy!
Yes! And I really want to thank you, Roddy. None of this would have been possible without you.
You’re a fantastic friend. And-
*Ring* *Ring*
Hmm... Looks like a call from an old college buddy! Would it be okay if I grab this call?
Sure, don’t worry about it! I’ll keep them company!
The Love Bridge
Time to feed the gopher.
The Gopher
Enter a world of love.
The Gates of Love
Shot through the heart, and he’s to blame.
Ignatius Cupid

SE_DoubleDateDisaster2024_IngredientProt.value: I’m sure we can make something delicious with these!

SE_DoubleDateDisaster2024_IntroDialogue_.value: Ah, Maddie. It still astonishes me how you make every day feel like the best day of my life.
I’m really happy I met you, Emilio.
Ha! I know someone who will be happy to hear that!
Anyway, I’m off to get ready.
Oh, right! Of course! See you tonight!
Hey, Roddy! Can I talk to you for a sec?
I totally forgot it was Valentine’s Day!

SE_DoubleDateDisaster2024_IntroPopup_Des.value: As Valentine’s Day approaches and love is in the air, Emilio needs some help to set up the ultimate Valentine’s Day date! And who knows Maddie better than his good old buddy, Roddy? Get ready for a double date of disastrous proportions that will shake the very foundation of Maddie’s relationships.

SE_DoubleDateDisaster2024_OutroDialogue_.value: But there are no oceans next to Bolivia!
I’m sorry, Maddie. Nobody deserves to get dumped on Valentine’s Day.
It’s alright... I guess we can salvage this somehow and turn it into a girls’ night out? What do you say?!
Oh... Uuh... I’m actually going to the movies with Roddy tonight.
I can call it off? I’ll be happy to hang out!
No, no! Please, one ruined date on Valentine’s is enough. I don’t want to ruin it for others.
Yeah, of course! You go have fun. I’ll just...

SE_HopeberryFestival2023_Decoration_Slot.value: These berries are pretty large
Wow! Look at the size of those berries!
They're just Hopeberries Mason.
I know that, lady!
It's Maddie!
I know that too!
Huge Hopeberry Bushes
Huge Hopeberry Bushes
A rare and delicious berry that only grows in and around Hopewell Bay
Are these actual hopeberry bushes?
Yes! Like any proper vineyard, one has to show where their product comes from.
Vineyard?
Hopeberry Bushes
Hopeberry Bushes
She is sassy, spicy, and the queen of juice!
May I introduce you to the Hopeberry Juice Woman!
The new face to the new and improved hopeberry juice! Go on... Have a taste.
*sip* Oh! Eehh... That's... different.
My gosh, Deb... What did you put in this?! This isn't my recipe!
It isn't sis, you write recipes like a mad scientist. I'm an artist!
I mean... It isn't bad! It just has a-
A wonderful bouquet? That is the secret ingredient!
The New Hopeberry Mascot
The New Hopeberry Mascot
An artistic interpretation of the Hopeberry itself
That's a fancy looking statue! Er... What is it?
It's the hopeberry of course!
Oh! Okay! If I... squint my eyes and...
Aaanyway, it was custom made by a dashing young artist new to town. I think his name was Hank?
You're going to ask him out, aren't you...
Oh please, sweetie... I already have!
Hopeberry Statue
Hopeberry Statue
Crush some Hopeberries between your toes
Having fun there, Mason?
Yeah! This is great!
This is how they used to make juice in the old days. With their bare feet!
Cool! I guess I should take my socks off then?
Hopeberry Treading Barrel
Hopeberry Treading Barrel
All-new Hopeberry concoctions for you to taste and enjoy
My improved juice is excellent as a frozen slushy, smoothie mix or just as a classic refreshing drink!
Mmm! I gotta say, these are all quite delicious, but honestly... What is that smell?!
Oh that?! That is what gives my drink its uniqueness. My secret ingredient...
Unique is an understatement... It almost smells like someone died!
I see... Well, if you cannot appreciate my exceptional beverage, then I wish you good day.
Oh.. I'm sorry, I didn't mea-
I said good day!
Hopeberry Juice Kiosk
Hopeberry Juice Kiosk
Wh... What's that smell?
Eeeh... It's the corpse flower from the conservatory.
I guess it's better to have it outside than in there, stinking up the place.
Actually, this smells an awful lot like her new juice! You don't think she...
Naaah!
Corpse Flower
Corpse Flower
Greeting you to the festival
Come one, come all to the new Hopeberry Festival!
Don't forget to taste my wonderful new hopeberry juice! It's to die for!
You can say that again! It smells like a dead body.
Reeeeeeeally?!
Good job, Julius...
Why is everyone angry at me today?
Hopeberry Festival Banner
Hopeberry Festival Banner
Looks like Ignatius gives his blessing to the juice!
I'm proud of you Deb... You may not be the best juice maker, but you sure do know how to throw a festival!
Really?
Yes, really. It's nice to see so many happy faces here again! It almost makes one forget the...
*sigh* It does... But, do you know what the best part of all of this was?
Doing something with my sister again!
Yes... It is nice, isn't it?
Berry Boulton
Berry Boulton
Hi Deb! I heard you wanted to run the Hopeberry Festival this year!
I was wondering if you needed any help?
No need, sweetie, no need! I have it all under control! This wheel will help me find the right flavors.
Sounds more like luck to me!
No such thing as luck sweetie. It is destiny! My psychic, Lady Voyance, said so...
All I have to do is spin this wheel and I'll know exactly what ingredients I need.
Okay... Good luck with that.
Thank y- Hey!
I really appreciate you helping out, Roddy!
No problem, ma'am! I'm always happy to help.
I know... I guess I'm always in need of strapping young lads, like yourself.
Oh... Erm... Okay.
Hey! I thought you said you didn't need any help!
Maddie! Sweetie... Of course I need help, but only in the more physical sense. Ha ha!
Right... Anyway, I'll stick around to help you get everything set up...
Well, Roddy... I think I saw a bit of jealousy in her eyes!
Re- Really?!
I'm impressed Deb! Didn't expect you to nail the recipe! This tastes just like it!
It's not your recipe, is it?
No, it isn't! I found some frozen concentrate from last year...
Oh, sis... I really need your help! This is a lot harder than I thought it would be.
It's alright, dearie. I have the recipe right here. Just follow it closely and you can't go wrong!
You're an angel, sis!
It's nice to hear that someone thinks so!
Hopeberry jam! I love this stuff!
Have a jar, sugar. On the house!
Awesome!
Hello, Cherry! Ooh! Is this the jam I helped you make?
Er... Yes! Yes it is!
Mmmm! I don't remember it tasting this delicious.
Sometimes things improve over time.
How's the hopeberry juice coming along?
Well... It is quite interesting. The recipe isn't the easiest to follow, you know.
What do you mean?
Well, there are so many steps and ingredients and it's... Boring.
Boring? It's a recipe, Deb. It's supposed to be boring.
Take a look for yourself then...
"Bring your solution to the point of ebullition and let it reach congealment, then dilute your gel in a mixture of citric acid and dihydrogen monoxide..."
Boy, Deb... You weren't kidding!
All she had to say was "Boil your mixture until it thickens and add some lemon juice and water."
I honestly don't see what all the fuss is about...
Come now, Victoria. You're the new head of city council! You should know all about the Hopeberry Festival!
It's just some silly event celebrating a shrub. Who cares?
The people care, Victoria. Besides, this "shrub" is the only one of its kind in the world!
I doubt that, Deb.
I now see why my sister speaks so "highly" of you...
This thing has always given me the creeps...
Then it is doing its job, ma'am.
Come to think of it, it does resemble Mr. Winston, doesn't it?!
Ha ha!
Hmph!
I brought some flowers for you, Deb!
Oooh, daffodils! These will be great for the festival.
I thought so too. I really like daffodils!
Let me guess... It's the color?
Ye...Yes! How'd you know?!
Hopeberry Juice Man! I love this guy!
He is charming but nothing like his girlfriend...
Girlfriend? What are you talking about?
I may have ordered a custom made Hopeberry Juice Woman...
But... I don't see it anywhere...
Honey... You ain't seen nothing yet!

SE_RemasterDirt_01.value: Oh, no! I think Rufus has been digging the ground again.

SE_RemasterDirt_02.value: Wait a second, there's something buried here. That's probably why!

SE_RemasterRepeatableTask_01.value: Hmm... This tree still doesn't look too good. It definitely needs a lot of water to spring back!

SE_RemasterRepeatableTask_02.value: Where would I be able to find that much water...

SE_RemasterRepeatableTask_03.value: Oh, I have an idea! The old well!

SE_RemasterRepeatableTask_04.value: Looks like there's plenty of water here to fix that poor tree but there's only so much I can carry at a time.

SE_RemasterRepeatableTask_05.value: Let me fill up this bucket and I'll come back for more!

SE_RemasterSideEntrance01_01.value: This grand old oak tree must have been such a beauty back in the day...

SE_RemasterSideEntrance01_02.value: I can imagine it being a popular meeting point!

SE_RemasterSideEntrance01_03.value: It'll need lots of tender loving care and hydration to return to its original state.

SE_RemasterSideEntrance01_04.value: Hold on, are those... envelopes in the trunk?

SE_RemasterSideEntrance02_01.value: They are envelopes! Looks like they've been here a long time...

SE_RemasterSideEntrance02_02.value: Judging by the heart, it's definitely a love letter. Ooh, this is so exciting!

SE_RemasterSideEntrance02_03.value: Let's see here. Hmm, the ink is a bit faded...

SE_RemasterSideEntrance02_04.value: "At first I was worried about our differences. We come from very different worlds, as you know, but you were right."

SE_RemasterSideEntrance02_05.value: "True love defies everything. The first time we met under this very oak tree, all my doubts disappeared."

SE_RemasterSideEntrance02_06.value: Oh, my! Who are these mystery lovebirds?!

SE_RemasterSideEntrance03_01.value: Another letter! The handwriting looks different...

SE_RemasterSideEntrance03_02.value: "My dear Lionheart, I couldn't take my eyes off of you at the dance tonight."

SE_RemasterSideEntrance03_03.value: "It was almost like you were the only person in the room and everyone else was invisible"

SE_RemasterSideEntrance03_04.value: "I know we can't be seen together so find me when the party is over. I'll be waiting for you."

SE_RemasterSideEntrance03_05.value: Wow! These letters are beautiful! It looks like this oak tree holds a lot of love and some secrets too.

SE_RemasterSideEntrance03_06.value: It sounds like a forbidden romance, though. These letters must be between two servants from the mansion!

SE_RemasterSideEntrance04_01.value: Hi, Maddie! What are you up to?

SE_RemasterSideEntrance04_02.value: Roddy, you won't believe it! I was fixing up this place when I found love letters hidden in the old oak tree!

SE_RemasterSideEntrance04_03.value: These letters are so swoon-worthy! Listen to this...

SE_RemasterSideEntrance04_04.value: "Every day without you is torture, my Lionheart. I so wish that we could walk hand-in-hand for all to see."

SE_RemasterSideEntrance04_06.value: Say, Maddie, do you like love letters? I mean, if um, someone were to write you one?

SE_RemasterSideEntrance04_07.value: Of course! Expressing yourself like that is a lost art form these days...

SE_RemasterSideEntrance04_08.value: Really? Oh um, I just remembered I have something to do. I'll catch up with you later!

SE_RemasterSideEntrance05_01.value: I found a letter that was stuck to the previous one! It seems sadder than the others. Words have been scratched out...

SE_RemasterSideEntrance05_02.value: "Things are getting tougher. I feel like I'm constantly being watched."

SE_RemasterSideEntrance05_03.value: "There are questions surrounding my operation and the legitimacy of the money."

SE_RemasterSideEntrance05_04.value: "We might have to leave sooner than expected."

SE_RemasterSideEntrance05_05.value: "I can't wait for our new life together, my darling Winnie."

SE_RemasterSideEntrance05_06.value: Winnie? Hmm, whoever could that be?

SE_RemasterSideEntrance06_01.value: Wow, it's an old suitcase! It's got some shoes and clothes...

SE_RemasterSideEntrance06_02.value: And a whole bunch of silver that looks like it came from the mansion. Probably stolen.

SE_RemasterSideEntrance06_03.value: There's a stack of love letters as well!

SE_RemasterSideEntrance06_04.value: The last love letter I read mentioned that these lovebirds were planning to run away...

SE_RemasterSideEntrance06_05.value: This has to be what they were going to use to start their new life elsewhere!

SE_RemasterSideEntrance06_06.value: It seems like they were ready to leave. Why didn't they?

SE_RemasterSideEntranceIntro_01.value: Hmm... I wonder why this spot is known as a side entrance?

SE_RemasterSideEntranceIntro_02.value: Well, dearie, the house help used this as their entrance to the mansion.

SE_RemasterSideEntranceIntro_04.value: Maddie, dearie, I've told you many a time to keep your wits about you.

SE_RemasterSideEntranceOutro_01.value: Reading those love letters made me feel like I was right there with them.

SE_RemasterSideEntranceOutro_02.value: What they went through sounds pretty distressing.

SE_RemasterSideEntranceOutro_03.value: I wish I could know that everything worked out but the fact that the suitcase is here says otherwise.

SE_RemasterSideEntranceOutro_04.value: True, I'm quite curious about this shady operation, though...

SE_RemasterSideEntranceOutro_05.value: I wonder if it was happening on mansion grounds.

SE_RemasterSideEntranceOutro_06.value: I have a feeling that the butler would know. He's been around for ages!

SE_RemasterSideEntranceOutro_07.value: The butler? It looks like I have more discoveries to make! Hey, what's this?

SE_RemasterSideEntranceOutro_08.value: Oh, you must have missed a letter...

SE_RemasterSideEntranceOutro_09.value: "Roses are red, violets are blue. I don't really like poems, but I do like you"

SE_RemasterSideEntranceOutro_10.value: Ahem, Roddy? Did you write this?

SE_RemasterSideEntranceOutro_11.value: Nuh-uh, I believe you have a secret admirer!

SE_RemasterSideEntranceOutro_12.value: Haha, that's one secret I guess I can live with!

SE_RemasterSwing_01.value: Untangling that swing was quite a feat! Now I can finally try it out!

SE_RemasterSwing_02.value: I have to admit, swings always bring out my inner child.

SE_RemasterSwing_03.value: Ooh, there are some initials carved into the wood. V? No, W and the other one is... too defaced for me to recognize.

SE_RemasterSwing_04.value: Darn it. Well, at least I have one initial to work with...

SP_AllHallowsEve2026_AllRewardsCompleted.value: A resounding Halloween success! We sold so much old junk, and made a tidy sum to donate!
And you got to experience what it is like to be a witch.
I actually half-believed finishing that ritual would do something!
It didn't? It made you believe in the supernatural for a moment!
How on earth did you set it all up so perfectly, Grandma?
I will not tell you all my secrets, Maddie. That is where the real magic is.

SP_AllHallowsEve2026_Decoration_Slot33_D.value: Annnnd another pumpkin carved! Phew. This is starting to look very nice!
I can't stop thinking about Grandma's spell books though. Maybe...
...can't hurt to take a look. 'tis the season after all.
Hah. How appropriate. A potion for sharpening knives!
And I've already got all the ingredients here. Hmm...

SP_AllHallowsEve2026_Decoration_Slot34_D.value: Hello, dearie! Oh, what a lovely little corner you've made!
Not now, Grandma. I'm looking for pokeweed.
Oh, dear, that's quite poisonous, you know. What is it for?
For a spell, of course! For finding things. Aha! Here's one, let me just cut it...
My, that's a very sharp-looking knife you got there. Tell me, what's lost?
If I told you that, it would spoil the experiment!

SP_AllHallowsEve2026_Decoration_Slot35_D.value: Right! This is of course still all nonsense, but...
Well, there have been an awful lot of coincidences. Knives sharpening themselves, lost objects found...
What was it you had lost?
Some halloween decorations from last year. I finished the spell, spoke the words, and...poof! There they were.
Oh, my. Perhaps you really are a witch.  Wouldn't be the first Boulton!

SP_AllHallowsEve2026_Decoration_Slot36_D.value: Hello, dearie! How're the preparations coming for the charity shop?
There's something here...a code. References between the books...a secret!
Maddie? Are you quite all right?
Look: each of these books reference the same spell, and each only contain one part of the ritual!
Oh, Maddie, are you sure you want to dabble in dark magic? Especially at a time like this?
I...I have to know! It says it needs to be cast at midnight...

SP_AllHallowsEve2026_Decoration_Slot37_D.value: This will do very well for the charity shop Maddie. Good work!
What? Oh - these aren't for sale, these are all the things needed for the spell!
How curious that the spell knew of all the things around the mansion I was thinking of selling at the shop.
Hm? Oh, yes, luckily everything that was needed for the spell was in the mansion somewhere!
And now you've gathered it all here, nicely organized. And you got the cauldron boiling!
I did. Now all I have to do is cast the spell. I'm a bit nervous, Grandma.
No need to be. I think I might know what will happen when you do...

SP_AllHallowsEve2026_End_Popup_Content_N.value: Magic isn't real, or so Maddie believes. But even after packing away the spellbooks, a little doubt still lingers in her mind...

SP_AllHallowsEve2026_Intro_Dialogue_01.value: Happy Halloween Grandma! Are those the decorations I was looking for?

SP_AllHallowsEve2026_Intro_Dialogue_02.value: Happy Halloween, dearie. Oh no, this is just something I found in the Boulton family archives!

SP_AllHallowsEve2026_Intro_Dialogue_03.value: I thought perhaps you'd want them for the charity shop?

SP_AllHallowsEve2026_Intro_Dialogue_04.value: You think so? They look pretty special. Like...spell books!

SP_AllHallowsEve2026_Intro_Dialogue_05.value: Oh, I suppose they do! We Boulton women have been known to dabble.

SP_AllHallowsEve2026_Intro_Dialogue_06.value: Dabble? In...magic? Don't be silly, Grandma. I don't believe in that kind of stuff!

SP_AllHallowsEve2026_Intro_Dialogue_07.value: Of course not, dearie. But do you mind if I leave them with you, in case you change your mind?

SP_AllHallowsEve2026_Intro_Dialogue_08.value: Sure, Grandma. At least they fit the decor!

SP_AllHallowsEve2026_LastCollectibleItem.value: Aha! The potion is complete! Whoa. Should it be bubbling like that?
What have you made there, dearie?
Oh! Grandma. I made a...potion. Don't laugh, but it's for a spell.
It smells delicious! Let me have a taste.
A...are you sure? Some of the ingredients seemed a little sketchy!
Oh, don't worry, I've trained to recognize poisons. And this...is tasty!

SP_AllHallowsEve2026_Start_Popup_Desc.value: It's the spooky season again, and Grandma has uncovered a mysterious library of books. What is she cooking up this time?

SP_AlpacaPet2024_AllRewardsCompleted_Dia.value: There's something fishy going on, Buddy!
First SOMEONE changed the newspaper ad for my ghost tour at Halloween.
Did someone leave Buddy at Cherry's house on purpose - knowing it would cause trouble?
That's so far-fetched it just might be likely...
Everyone is still so on edge from the storm and the secrets in the tin cans, that it's TOO easy to rile everyone up.
I need to find out what's going on in this town.

SP_AlpacaPet2024_BuddyUnlockCutscene_Dia.value: Oh, a text from Cherry. But what-- Is that the same alpaca I saw here earlier??
There's a baby alpaca in my front yard! I named it Buddy. Isn't he adorable?
I don't know what to do! Do you think he could live in my garden shed?
Thank you so much for helping me, Maddie!
That's OK, Cherry! Did you try to call someone? Maybe someone's missing him.
I did! There's no sign of an owner, and the local farms aren't missing him either.
So he just appeared out of the blue in your front yard??
Yeah, with a little bag of apples.
Whatever happened, the whole thing is a real nightmare.
This is my busiest season business-wise, so I don't have time to babysit this cutie...
He can stay here with us. There's always room for an animal this furry!

SP_AlpacaPet2024_End_Popup_Content_NoRew.value: Buddy found a good home, but did someone leave him in Cherry's front yard to cause trouble?

SP_AlpacaPet2024_IntroCutscene_Dialogue_.value: I love the fall. It's the best season with the leaves turning and all the coziness!
That reminds me, I need to do some raking...
If I start early enough, I might just get it all done.
Where on earth did you come from?
Did you run away from Santa's workshop, or something?
Did you run away from Santa's workshop or something?
Wait, I might have some apples inside...

SP_AlpacaPet2024_LastCollectibleItemDisc.value: Hey. Nothing much... Just getting the gardens ready for fall.
So... are we okay - after everything?
Look, I think I just need some space to think things through. It's been a lot.
But you can still help with the raking.

SP_AlpacaPet2024_PetHomeTA1_Description.value: A place for Buddy to feel at home.

SP_AlpacaPet2024_PetHomeTA2_Description.value: The perfect home for an alpaca who's a little bit extra.

SP_AlpacaPet2024_PetInfoDescription.value: Meet Buddy - the baby alpaca who loves to get cozy!

SP_AlpacaPet2024_Start_Popup_Desc.value: When a mischievous baby alpaca appears in Hopewell Bay only to wreak havoc among its residents, Maddie cannot help but feel suspicious...

SP_AlpacaPet2024_TA1_Dialogue_02.value: Hey, Julius. But you look upset - what's up?

SP_AlpacaPet2024_TA1_Dialogue_03.value: You may be aware of my collection of antique wreaths.

SP_AlpacaPet2024_TA1_Dialogue_04.value: The beautiful creations I hang in my garden in the fall?

SP_AlpacaPet2024_TA1_Dialogue_07.value: I'm so sorry, Julius. Who could've done that?

SP_AlpacaPet2024_TA1_Dialogue_08.value: I do not know, Maddie, but it looked as though like someone had taken a bite out of one with wax apples.

SP_AlpacaPet2024_TA2_Dialogue_01.value: Maddie! Something TRULY awful has happened!

SP_AlpacaPet2024_TA2_Dialogue_05.value: Someone had eaten a part of it!

SP_AlpacaPet2024_TA2_Dialogue_06.value: Are you sure? I mean, it's not the most delectable smelling thing...

SP_AlpacaPet2024_TA2_Dialogue_10.value: Cherry's?? I'll be having words with her, then!

SP_AlpacaPet2024_TA2_Dialogue_11.value: It is one thing to have a... well, adorable alpaca as a pet. It is quite another to let it wander around ruining people's beloved plants!

SP_AmyPet2025_AllRewardsCompleted_Dialog.value: Could you put your phone away for a minute?
You've been on it all day!
Not all day... I have just been researching things and...
What ARE you doing on your phone? Are you really making cat videos?
Yes... and no. There is something else, but you have to trust me.
I'll tell you all about it -- but not yet. There is still too much that is uncertain...
I promise everything will become clear.

SP_AmyPet2025_AmyUnlockCutscene_Dialogue.value: Here she is. Amy, do you remember Maddie?
Welcome to the Mansion, Amy! I promise I will make you super comfortable while you're here.
You really are so sweet for doing this. Could we snap a quick photo?
Perfect! I need to get to work but I'll be back to see her, okay?
Ughh, what was that? "See you later, alligator"... Who even says that??
I started to act like a clown as soon as Emilio paid attention to me.
Remember your resolution, Maddie. No men, no drama!

SP_AmyPet2025_Decoration_TA1_Description.value: An entertaining and comfortable cat home.

SP_AmyPet2025_Decoration_TA2_Description.value: The ultimate cat home with all the trimmings.

SP_AmyPet2025_End_Popup_Content_NoReward.value: What is Grandma hiding - and are her cat videos actually any good? So many questions...

SP_AmyPet2025_IntroCutscene_Dialogue_01.value: Hello, Maddie! How are you on this beautiful day?

SP_AmyPet2025_IntroCutscene_Dialogue_02.value: Oh, hey! I'm great. And how are you?

SP_AmyPet2025_IntroCutscene_Dialogue_03.value: I'm very well, too. Well, actually there's something weighing on my mind...

SP_AmyPet2025_IntroCutscene_Dialogue_05.value: Maybe you remember my cat, Amy?

SP_AmyPet2025_IntroCutscene_Dialogue_06.value: I'm not able to keep her until I've found a more permanent place here in Hopewell Bay.

SP_AmyPet2025_IntroCutscene_Dialogue_07.value: Does--- does that mean you're staying here?

SP_AmyPet2025_IntroCutscene_Dialogue_08.value: I guess so... I feel like I owe you an explanation for everything.

SP_AmyPet2025_IntroCutscene_Dialogue_10.value: No. Leaving you for Bolivia, coming here with Bella... I've been unfair and thoughtless.

SP_AmyPet2025_IntroCutscene_Dialogue_11.value: I'm sorry, Maddie. Maybe we could grab a cup of coffee sometime? Talk things through?

SP_AmyPet2025_IntroCutscene_Dialogue_13.value: Right! I know you're busy but could you maybe take Amy for a while? Just a little while?

SP_AmyPet2025_IntroCutscene_Dialogue_14.value: I guess I can do it...

SP_AmyPet2025_LastCollectibleItemDiscove.value: Grandma, what would you say about getting a new pet?
As long as it's not another overly nosy dog who's always digging up my flowerbeds!
Actually, this one would be a cat. Amy, Emilio's cat, remember?
A cat? What a lovely idea!
Really? I didn't expect you to get so excited...
I could create all kinds of great content for my social media! People love cat videos.

SP_AmyPet2025_PetUnlock_Description.value: You've just unlocked a brand new friend!

SP_AmyPet2025_PetUnlock_Header.value: Meet Amy the Cat - Emilio's beloved pet!

SP_AmyPet2025_PremiumRewardMaxLevel_Desc.value: The perfect home for your new pet!

Play to reach level 15 and unlock the Cat Heaven!
Play to reach level 25 and unlock the Cat Paradise!

SP_AmyPet2025_Start_Popup_Desc.value: When Emilio reaches out to Maddie to ask her for help with Amy the Cat, she cannot refuse. But WHAT is Grandma doing on her new phone?

SP_AmyPet2025_TA1_Dialogue_01.value: You just couldn't say no to Emilio!

SP_AmyPet2025_TA1_Dialogue_02.value: No... But Amy is actually a really lovely cat. Look - she's so happy in her new home!

SP_AmyPet2025_TA1_Dialogue_04.value: Oh, she's "creating content for her social media."

SP_AmyPet2025_TA1_Dialogue_05.value: Is she really doing that or is she using Amy as a cover for whatever she is ACTUALLY doing?

SP_AmyPet2025_TA2_Dialogue_01.value: Ta-da! Isn't it great? I think I've thought of everything, and Amy seems very satisfied.

SP_AmyPet2025_TA2_Dialogue_02.value: She should be! What a wonderful little place.

SP_AmyPet2025_TA2_Dialogue_03.value: Let me just snap a couple of photos of it.

SP_AmyPet2025_TA2_Dialogue_04.value: What account is that you've got open on your phone?

SP_AmyPet2025_TA2_Dialogue_05.value: Oh, this? I think this phone is acting up, always switching things up...

SP_AmyPet2025_TA2_Dialogue_06.value: Here we go. These cat photos will be gold for my followers!

SP_AmyTheCat2023_AllRewardsCompleted_Dia.value: Hi, I’m Emilio Costa, a marine biologist. You called about some expatriated fish?
Oh, oh yes! Of course, let me show you. There’s been this cat and she’s been-
Ah, she's your cat! That must explain the fish then!
Here they are! Amy... Have you been bringing this beautiful lady my fish?
My deepest apologies. She tends to do this with people she likes. You must be a good person at heart.
Oh, you know! It’s nothing. Just happy she’s found her family again.

SP_AmyTheCat2023_Decoration_Slot25_Descr.value: With the right cat-titude, anything is paw-sible!

SP_AmyTheCat2023_Decoration_Slot25_Dialo.value: Aww shucks, off she goes again. Wait! Did she drop something? A goldfish?!
Actually, that looks like a Betta Fish.
Hi Roddy! Is that what it is? Well, I hope Amy hasn’t fished it out of someone’s aquarium...
This cat I’ve seen around lately... You wouldn’t happen to know who owns her?
Hmmm... Not really no. Maybe she’s a stray from out of town?
Alright... Well, I gotta find this little fish a new home, fast!

SP_AmyTheCat2023_Decoration_Slot26_Descr.value: I got this one from a cat-alogue.

SP_AmyTheCat2023_Decoration_Slot26_Dialo.value: There! I dare any cat to ignore the majesty of...
A ha! Never in doubt. Now, little Amy, let’s see who your owner is, shall we?
Looks like the cat dropped something.
There she goes again! Let's see… Another exotic fish!
You know you can go to the pet shop for those, right?
That’s what I’m afraid of. This cat has been bringing me some really strange fish! I wonder who she belongs to...
A lot of people own cats in Hopewell Bay, but there’s a handsome marine biologist who may help you figure out the fish?

SP_AmyTheCat2023_Decoration_Slot27_Dialo.value: There you go, little guy, a new home for you and your friends!
That’s a nice fish pond you have there, Maddie.
Thanks Roddy! I’m surprised at how delicate Amy is with the fish she brings me.
But I’m still curious where she’s getting them from?
Maybe she’s just a good fisher?

SP_AmyTheCat2023_Decoration_Slot28_Dialo.value: Oh Maddie! Good thing I found you! Have you seen my sis Ursula around?
Hi Deb, no... I haven’t, actually!
Whoose a good kitty? You are! Yes, you are!
Ah, there she is! I guess she found Amy. That cat is a bit of a mystery. I’ve been trying to figure out who she belongs to.
Is that your name? What a pretty pretty name!

SP_AmyTheCat2023_Decoration_Slot29_Descr.value: You got to be kitten me!

SP_AmyTheCat2023_Decoration_Slot29_Dialo.value: Don’t you think that’s a bit much?
No! The giant cat head over the balcony!
Not at all, dearie. If little Amy is going to be living with us, she should know which house is her home.
But she belongs to someone else. Once I found out who she belongs to, I’ll be giving her back.

SP_AmyTheCat2023_Intro_Dialogue_04.value: Oh! Hello there! What’s your name? Let’s find your name tag...

SP_AmyTheCat2023_Intro_Dialogue_08.value: No wait! Oh Rufus... You scared her away!

SP_AmyTheCat2023_Intro_Dialogue_10.value: I found a cat, but Rufus scared her away. Say...

SP_AmyTheCat2023_Intro_Dialogue_11.value: You wouldn’t happen to have a secret kitty cat, would you?

SP_AmyTheCat2023_LastCollectibleItemDisc.value: Don’t worry little Amy, if we don’t find your owner, you’ll have a nice home right here!
I guess she’ll have plenty of fish friends too! Look at all of them!
Well, until I find her owner, I guess there’s no harm in keeping Amy here.
But these fish, however... Some of them seem very exotic for our little pond.
That’s alright, I called the marine biologist from the Aquarium to come and have a look!

SP_AmyTheCat2023_Start_Popup_Desc.value: Get ready kitty lovers for a paw-some event! Introducing Amy the cat, Hopewell Bay's new feline friend!

SP_AmyTheCat2025_End_Popup_Content_NoRew.value: [PLACEHOLDER] Buddy found a good home, but did someone leave him in Cherry's front yard to cause trouble?

SP_AmyTheCat2025_Start_Popup_Desc.value: [PLACEHOLDER] When a mischievous baby alpaca appears in Hopewell Bay only to wreak havoc among its residents, Maddie cannot help but feel suspicious...

SP_Apiary2026_AllRewardsCompleted_Dialog.value: The bees have been helping all the plants in Hopewell Bay flourish!

SP_Apiary2026_Decoration_Slot25_Dialogue.value: I hope you don't mind me setting up some flowers on your fence?
No problem at all, dearie! In fact...
I've been busy like a bee, making all sorts of delicious treats made with honey!
And once I have enough Hopeberry honey, you'll be in for a special treat!
Some say it's the color, while others say it's the unique flavor.
It also makes a spectacular mead!

SP_Apiary2026_Decoration_Slot27_Dialogue.value: Once we have enough honey, we can start collecting it in here.
Grandma told me that it used to be part of the old apiary.
So I thought, why not spruce it up a little?
Great idea! I can take a picture of it for my article!
Ha! I love it. Maybe it'll drive up the sales for the honey?
Well, if what your Grandma says is true, I don't think it'll have to!

SP_Apiary2026_Decoration_Slot28_Dialogue.value: Aaw, that's a cute bee hive!
Getting into the spirit of things, I see?
It's actually a fun way to keep the bees out of the house.
Oh, I see! Sort of like a scarecrow, right?
Exactly! They'll know that a queen already lives here.

SP_Apiary2026_Decoration_Slot29_Dialogue.value: Hank! When I said I wanted a big sign...
I didn't mean one that you could see from space!
Oh, geez, I'm sorry! I guess I got a bit carried away!
Hey there, sugar! I saw your sign and thought, "Now there's a stroke of luck!"
With all the bees buzzing about, I got inspired and need all the honey I can get!
Yes, Hank. Where do you think we get our honey from?
Ha! Don't worry Hank. And Cherry, we'll get you all the honey you'll ever need!

SP_Apiary2026_Decoration_Slot38_Dialogue.value: Thriving! They're busy little bees, I'm almost all out of honey jars!
I bet! I've been hearing stories from all across town about them!
Plants, flowers, even hopeberry bushes are all blooming at record levels!
It looks like this year we're going to have a record hopeberry harvest!

SP_Apiary2026_End_Popup_Content_NoReward.value: With the hives humming and the hopeberries flourishing, it’s clear that even the smallest care can make the biggest difference.

SP_Apiary2026_Intro_Dialogue_01.value: Hey, Jackie! What brings you here?

SP_Apiary2026_Intro_Dialogue_02.value: Hey, Maddie! I was doing some research for World Bee Day and discovered something.

SP_Apiary2026_Intro_Dialogue_03.value: The mansion used to have an apiary!

SP_Apiary2026_Intro_Dialogue_05.value: But I'll be honest... I don't think I've ever seen it before...

SP_Apiary2026_Intro_Dialogue_06.value: Don't worry, dearie. I know where they kept the old equipment.

SP_Apiary2026_Intro_Dialogue_07.value: Would you also know why they shut it down?

SP_Apiary2026_Intro_Dialogue_08.value: Probably something to do with the Hopeberry honey it made...

SP_Apiary2026_Intro_Dialogue_09.value: What's special about the Hopeberry honey?

SP_Apiary2026_LastCollectibleItemDiscove.value: Where did you manage to get a queen bee for the hive?
I wonder why Grandma would need a queen bee connection...
Now that we have a working hive, we can start getting the apiary running!

SP_BunnyPet2026_AllRewardsCompleted_Dial.value: Looks like you're a happy little fellow, aren't you?
Thanks for taking care of him, this really means a lot.
Hey guys! Oh! Looks like you've got a new-

SP_BunnyPet2026_End_Popup_Content_NoRewa.value:
Some problems are worth keeping.
With a proper pen and a lot of patience, the giant bunny finally has a home.

SP_BunnyPet2026_Intro_Dialogue_02.value: Wait, a minute... I know that look.

SP_BunnyPet2026_Intro_Dialogue_05.value: I was walking past a rescue shelter when I thought I saw my old pet bunny!

SP_BunnyPet2026_Intro_Dialogue_06.value: So without thinking twice, I just went in and rescued him.

SP_BunnyPet2026_Intro_Dialogue_08.value: Well, the thing is... I can't take care of him. So I was kinda thinking...

SP_BunnyPet2026_Intro_Dialogue_09.value: Hey, don't worry about it. There's plenty of space for a bunny here...

SP_BunnyPet2026_LastCollectibleItemDisco.value: What can I say? He loves them!
But I'll make sure he has a nice, rounded diet.

SP_BunnyPet2026_PetInfoDescription.value: A gentle giant with a talent for stealing hearts, snacks, and just a bit too much space.

SP_BunnyPet2026_PetUnlock_Description.value: You've just unlocked a brand-new friend!

SP_BunnyPet2026_PetUnlock_Header.value: Meet Sir Fluffsalot, the most fluffiest of knightly companions.

SP_BunnyPet2026_PremiumRewardMaxLevel_De.value: The perfect home for your new pet!
