SP_BunnyPet2026_Start_Popup_Desc.value:
Jackie shows up with a surprise.
A very big, very fluffy one. Maddie steps in to help before Jackie figures out where exactly you’re supposed to keep a giant bunny.

SP_BunnyPet2026_TA1_Dialogue_03.value: Wow, hey! That's a big boy!

SP_BunnyPet2026_TA1_Dialogue_04.value: He's really friendly and really doesn't eat THAT much.

SP_BunnyPet2026_TA1_Dialogue_06.value: That means he has a big heart. Isn't that right, Sir Fluffsalot?

SP_BunnyPet2026_TA2_Dialogue_03.value: I still can't get my head around how big he is!

SP_BunnyPet2026_TA3_Dialogue_01.value: Wow! This bunny pen is looking really amazing!

SP_BunnyPet2026_TA3_Dialogue_02.value: Thanks! Hey... I have a question.

SP_BunnyPet2026_TA3_Dialogue_04.value: Well, as a child I really loved Arthurian legends and always wanted a knight for a friend.

SP_BunnyPet2026_TA3_Dialogue_05.value: So when my parents got me a bunny for a pet, all I saw was a majestic, noble, if not fluffy knight.

SP_BunnyPet2026_TA3_Dialogue_07.value: I couldn't help it when I saw him in the shelter. It's almost like he was reincarnated!

SP_CancelledFun2025_AllRewardsCompleted_.value: I think all the thanks go to you today.
You kept the festival alive! Your food is amazing, and you never gave up!
Oh, sugar! I’m going to name a cake after you!
You’ve been very EAGER to help. More than usual, I should say.
And why were you letting Cherry burn “fake” money?
I had no leaves to bury them under!

SP_CancelledFun2025_Decoration_Slot33_Di.value: Looks like you’re making yourself at home!
Oh, I am! It’s been such a long while since the last time I cooked here, sugar.
Well, if there’s anything you need, just let me know!
Could you ask your Grandma where she got those WONDERFUL bricks for smoking?
Oh, sugar, I’m sorry! I was out of wood for my smoker, and Grandma graciously offered these bricks! They give off so much smoke and impart a great flavor!
Wait a minute! These “bricks” are filled with money!

SP_CancelledFun2025_Decoration_Slot34_Di.value: Wow, these chairs sure are heavy!
They’re wrought iron, Maddie! What do you expect?
I’ll have you know these chairs are part of an illustrious set, handcrafted and designed here in Hopewell Bay!

SP_CancelledFun2025_Decoration_Slot35_Di.value: Mason! Pull your face out of that chocolate fountain this instant!
But Moooom! Someone’s gotta do quality control! Who knows if this chocolate is up to standard?
That’s... Where the mouth is, Mom.
And you think you’re the right person for the job?
Of course I am! I’m a child! Chocolate and candy are my LIFE!
It’s alright, Pearl. He can help as long as he uses a SPOON.
Mason, official Chocolate quality control officer, reporting for duty, Ma’am!

SP_CancelledFun2025_Decoration_Slot36_Di.value: I think we should keep this oven after the festival!
Oh, dearie. This oven is useful for so much more than pizza!
Well, of course! You can use it to bake pies, roast meats and-

SP_CancelledFun2025_Decoration_Slot37_Di.value: Oh, just a little something I whipped up for everyone who's helped so far!
Is that a vintage bottle of hopeberry juice?!
Yes, it is, dearie! I’ve been saving it for a special occasion.
And my favorite hopeberry pie! You just couldn’t help yourself, could you, Grandma?

SP_CancelledFun2025_End_Popup_Content_No.value: The Feast ends in triumph, with Cherry basking in gratitude while Maddie quietly gives her the credit. But as the lanterns fade, Maddie can’t shake her curiosity about Grandma and the strange “money” she burned.

SP_CancelledFun2025_Intro_Dialogue_01.value: I really love autumn, don’t you, Grandma?

SP_CancelledFun2025_Intro_Dialogue_03.value: Plenty of leaves to bury things under!

SP_CancelledFun2025_Intro_Dialogue_05.value: Hey... Is that Cherry? She looks... Very UPSET!

SP_CancelledFun2025_Intro_Dialogue_06.value: You’re right, I’m upset! The mayor just cancelled the Festival Feast!

SP_CancelledFun2025_Intro_Dialogue_07.value: Might as well cancel all the fun while she’s at it... What am I supposed to do now?
Might as well cancel all the fun while they're at it... What am I supposed to do now?

SP_CancelledFun2025_Intro_Dialogue_08.value: Sounds like you had a lot riding on it.

SP_CancelledFun2025_Intro_Dialogue_09.value: You’re darned tootin’ I did! I’ve ordered enough food to feed the whole town!

SP_CancelledFun2025_Intro_Dialogue_10.value: Without the festival, I’ll go bust!

SP_CancelledFun2025_Intro_Dialogue_11.value: Don’t worry, dearie, we can hold the festival right here!

SP_CancelledFun2025_Intro_Dialogue_12.value: That’s right! We’ve been doing these for quite a while now, and we’re getting pretty good at them!

SP_CancelledFun2025_Intro_Dialogue_13.value: Really?! It won’t be too much trouble?

SP_CancelledFun2025_Intro_Dialogue_16.value: We’ll show that mayor that she can't stop us from having fun!
We’ll show that mayor that they can't stop us from having fun!

SP_CancelledFun2025_LastCollectibleItemD.value: Oh, I’m sorry, sugar! I hope you don’t mind?
When I got home, this thought just popped into my head! “Sugar, you've got to honor Grandma somehow!”
So, what better way than to bake Grandma’s special pie! With a pumpkin twist!
Oh, give it here, let me taste...

SP_CancelledFun2025_Start_Popup_Desc.value: When the mayor cancels Hopewell Bay’s Festival Feast, Grandma offers to host it on the old Mansion grounds. With Cherry baking, Maddie organizing, and Julius adding vintage flair, the town prepares for a celebration filled with warmth and mystery.

SP_CherrysMysteryMeat2024_AllRewardsComp.value: Listen... Do you think there's something weird about this mystery meat business?
Your grandma just happened to have a fridge full of meat...
I'm just putting two and two together here. There's no smoke without fire - especially at a BBQ.
C-could it be HANK in that pie??

SP_CherrysMysteryMeat2024_Decoration_Slo.value: Welcome to the party!
This event will be our best yet - I can feel it in my bones!
I still need to find someone to man the official Hopewell Bay Centennial merchandise booth... and someone to look after the barbecue.
Deb! How are you, you poor thing?
I married the love of my life - well, the latest one - and he just vanished! I mean... He could have just said if he did not want to tie the knot.
It does sound a bit fishy... but maybe a job at our little festival might take your mind off the whole thing - selling merchandise or tending the barbecue?
I certainly have no time to be selling T-shirts or poking meat with a stick. I have these "Missing" posters to put up!
Ursula, you are such a natural sleuth. Did you notice anything weird about Hank before he disappeared? I thought I saw you talking...
No, I did not notice anything at all! Oh, Pearl... I can take care of the barbecue.
Done and done!
Hopeberry Gate
What's cooking in there?
It's all happening here!
Is everything ready for the giant pie, Cherry? My editor sent me to write a story about it - might even make the front page!
Almost! I got some great vegan meat substitute from Ursula. It looks and tastes so meaty!
And Ursula just happened to have a giant pie's worth of vegan meat lying around?
I guess so...
Thanks. Maybe there IS a decent news story here - but it's not about breaking a pie record. I need to do some digging...
BBQ
Set the table for the big event.
Baking the biggest pie in the world is a headache! I've got bags and bags of flour, a hundred sticks of butter, and your meat...
But now I need a huge pie dish, and they don't sell those in just any hardware store.
As it happens, my dear, I might be able to help again.
W-what? You've got a giant pie dish in your basement?
Well, you never know when you need to make a huuuge pie.
Picnic Table
A pie for the ages.
Everyone, the pie's almost ready to come out of the oven!
And it looks delicious - seriously!
I need to get some photos of that thing for the paper.
Where's Roddy? He'd love this.
I know - he totally would! He'll be here soon. You wanna join us for a cup of Hopeberry juice?
Umm, I promised to help Grandma with the BBQ...
Record Pie
Quench your thirst - Hopewell Bay style!
Yummm! The founders knew a good pie!
They sure did. What kind of vegan meat is this, Cherry? It's so tasty!
You can thank Ursula for that. But Ursula, where DID you get it?
Oh, it is just something I had in the freezer. I am glad it made such a scrumptious pie!
Hopeberry Juice Stand
A T-shirt to commemorate the world's biggest pie?
Maddie, could you do me a favor and put up some of these posters of Hank?
There's still no sign of him, huh?
Not even a trace.
I'm sure he's fine, wherever he is. Here, Deb. Have a piece of pie!
Mmmm... There is something... strangely familiar about this flavor.
That IS strange!
Merch Stand

SP_CherrysMysteryMeat2024_End_Popup_Cont.value: Did the pie break the world record - and where IS Hank? Stay tuned to follow the story...

SP_CherrysMysteryMeat2024_Intro_Dialogue.value: Official party organizing committee business, of course, Ursula.
Hopewell Bay's 100th anniversary is coming, and it deserves a BIG celebration.
Now, I understand that, err... with Hank gone it's not quite the festive atmosphere we wanted, but maybe this can help get our minds off that for a while.
I could not agree more. Besides, I am sure Hank is fine. Maybe he just got cold feet!
Who knows! But what have you got planned for the town centennial?
We're going to bake the world's biggest meat pie, based on a recipe from the town's founders.
Cherry will do the baking, but could we organize the celebration in your backyard? The mansion would make such a wonderful backdrop.
The world's biggest meat pie, you say?

SP_CherrysMysteryMeat2024_LastCollectibl.value: Pearl gave me this historic recipe to recreate our founders' favorite pie.
I've made some calculations, and I'm going to need about a whole hunk of meat to make it!
I'm not sure I'm gonna find enough.
You know, I think I have got you covered...
Don't worry, dearie. It's ALL vegan!

SP_CherrysMysteryMeat2024_Start_Popup_De.value: After Hank disappears from his own wedding, the folks of Hopewell Bay regroup by gearing up for the town centennial - and the world's biggest meat pie!

SP_CinqoDeMayo2026_AllRewardsCompleted_D.value: You sure know how to throw a great party, Grandma!
Bella and Emilio a wonderful organizers. All I did was supply the location.
Bella and Emilio are wonderful organizers. All I did was supply the location.
And the steel baseball bat! It really did the trick on the ol' piñata!
Too bad the candy inside had gotten old.
Too bad the candy inside had gotten old.
Ha! It's fine. What matters is that I finally got my REVENGE!
Oh! I really do like her!

SP_CinqoDeMayo2026_Decoration_Slot33_Dia.value: This should be plenty for everyone!
Oh, dearie! This is only half of it!

SP_CinqoDeMayo2026_Decoration_Slot34_Dia.value: You're going all out, aren't you?
Yes, dearie. Emilio and Bella are over the moon!
We've used this area for everything from festivals, weddings and funerals.
Why not also throw a few parties here?

SP_CinqoDeMayo2026_Decoration_Slot35_Dia.value: Yes! This one is a family heirloom.
Heirloom? Aren't these usually meant to be smashed open?
This one has haunted me since my 5th birthday! No matter how hard we try...
But today... Today is the DAY!
Actually dearie, I may have JUST the thing to help you with that!

SP_CinqoDeMayo2026_Decoration_Slot36_Dia.value: Well, you can thank Maddie for that!
She spent all night working on it...
Oh, please. It was nothing! I loved working on it.
You did a great job, though!

SP_CinqoDeMayo2026_Decoration_Slot37_Dia.value: Oooh! A stage! Are you going to play something for us, Emilio?
Well... I was sort of thinking about it.
He isn't leaving here until he plays my favorite song.
Oh... You KNOW which one, Emilio...

SP_CinqoDeMayo2026_End_Popup_Content_NoR.value: With the music playing with a bountiful feast prepared and an immortal piñata's reign of terror coming to an end, Hopewell Bay enjoys a fiesta to remember!
With the music playing, a bountiful feast prepared, and an immortal piñata's reign of terror coming to an end, Hopewell Bay enjoys a fiesta to remember!

SP_CinqoDeMayo2026_Intro_Dialogue_01.value: Thank you for letting us use your home for our fiesta!

SP_CinqoDeMayo2026_Intro_Dialogue_02.value: Not a problem at all, dearie!

SP_CinqoDeMayo2026_Intro_Dialogue_03.value: I always love a good party.

SP_CinqoDeMayo2026_Intro_Dialogue_04.value: I wish I could make my Abuela's enchiladas...

SP_CinqoDeMayo2026_Intro_Dialogue_05.value: Don't worry, dearie. I think I have JUST the recipe!

SP_CinqoDeMayo2026_Intro_Dialogue_06.value: I would love to try them!

SP_CinqoDeMayo2026_LastCollectibleItemDi.value: So, dearie? What do you think?
Almost as good as my Abuela's!

SP_CinqoDeMayo2026_RewardMail_Topic_Long.value: Season Pass - Flavors of Tradition has ended.

SP_CinqoDeMayo2026_RewardMail_Topic_Shor.value: Season Pass - Flavors of Tradition has ended!

SP_CinqoDeMayo2026_Start_Popup_Desc.value: Emilio and Bella are bringing music, color, and family traditions to Grandma’s cabin!

SP_CorpseFlower2025_AllRewardsCompleted_.value: So Lady Voyance was right all along! She predicted a wedding and a funeral, and we've now had both!
I know! I can't believe I'm saying this, but maybe she does possess some cosmic powers after all.
Nonsense! I cannot believe you have fallen for her visions. She can predict the future no more than I can.
She is a dear, dear friend of mine, but do I have to remind you that she predicts the future from a snow globe?
When you put it that way...

SP_CorpseFlower2025_Decoration_Slot25_Di.value: I understand you're upset, but it was only a...
Only a what? I grew that flower from a seedling and learned to love its unusual charm over decades!
One doesn't simply plant another Titan Arum! These plants are extremely fickle.
But you managed to do it once. I could help you!
Would you do that, dear? Really?

SP_CorpseFlower2025_Decoration_Slot26_Di.value: Maddie, our discussion gave me a wonderful idea amid this misery.
I want to organize a worthy funeral for my beloved corpse flower.
Yes! A magnificent send-off for a magnificent specimen.

SP_CorpseFlower2025_Decoration_Slot27_Di.value: What are you doing with Deb? Organizing an early Halloween party?
A funeral, for her corpse flower. The flower wilted after Pablo the goat took a bite out of it, and Deb's taking the whole thing pretty badly.
I wanted to make her feel better, and this seems to be helping.
I know that plant meant a lot to her, but I cannot say I will miss its scent.
That makes two of us. Just don't tell Deb!

SP_CorpseFlower2025_Decoration_Slot28_Di.value: Thank you everyone for coming today. It is with a heavy heart that I part with my beautiful Titan Arum.
We've shared so many wonderful years together, and life will not be the same without it.
Today, we will be able to enjoy its fragrance for the final time, before we lay it to rest in a special compost built by Maddie.
Psst, Maddie! I love Deb so much and I'm so sorry for her terrible loss, but am I the only one who finds this smell overpowering?

SP_CorpseFlower2025_Decoration_Slot29_Di.value: I know my beautiful lily would want this to be a celebration of life, rather than death, so I have a very special surprise for all of you.
We will all plant new corpse flowers together, and each one of you can take one home. This way, my beloved plant can live on.

SP_CorpseFlower2025_End_Popup_Content_No.value: A wilting corpse flower is enough to shake anyone back to their senses - at least until the next premonition...

SP_CorpseFlower2025_Intro_Dialogue_01.value: Maddie! Something terrible has happened! TERRIBLE!

SP_CorpseFlower2025_Intro_Dialogue_02.value: What's wrong, Deb? Are you okay??

SP_CorpseFlower2025_Intro_Dialogue_03.value: Absolutely not! My beautiful corpse flower... It's dead!

SP_CorpseFlower2025_Intro_Dialogue_05.value: Maddie... Remember Voyance's premonition? She predicted this!

SP_CorpseFlower2025_Intro_Dialogue_06.value: You're right -- first Emilio and Bella's wedding, and now this!

SP_CorpseFlower2025_LastCollectibleItemD.value: What happened?? How can the corpse flower be dead?
There is a big chunk missing from one of its petals. It almost looks like someone has taken a bite out of it!
What? Who would... Oh, I think I know what happened.
I think it was Pablo - Bella and Emilio's goat. He has a big appetite, and I think I saw him walking towards the Conservatory.
But I don't think he enjoyed his mouthful too much...
This is a dark day, my dear.

SP_CorpseFlower2025_Start_Popup_Desc.value: The hand of fate has dealt a great blow to a certain person, or was it just a goat who was hankering for a snack?

SP_CowPet2026_AllRewardsCompleted_Dialog.value: I got to admit, I'm getting pretty good at this!
Give you a run for your money, that's for sure!

SP_CowPet2026_End_Popup_Content_NoReward.value: With McLeod all settled in and looking adorable, his happy little moos (and the occasional jingle) make it clear he feels right at home.

SP_CowPet2026_Intro_Dialogue_02.value: “Gone to Japan. Time to finish what I started. Love, Grandma”

SP_CowPet2026_Intro_Dialogue_07.value: Well... I won something at the farmer’s market raffle!

SP_CowPet2026_Intro_Dialogue_08.value: You wouldn’t have space for another pet, would you?

SP_CowPet2026_LastCollectibleItemDiscove.value: I mean, it's nothing out of the ordinary, you know?
Just your typical farm animal... Well... Almost.
Well, this collar definitely has a cowbell on it.
Roddy! Are you bringing over a cow?!

SP_CowPet2026_PetInfoDescription.value: A pint-sized pasture pal with a curious moo and an even cuter waddle.

SP_CowPet2026_PetUnlock_Description.value: You've just unlocked a brand-new friend!

SP_CowPet2026_PetUnlock_Header.value: Meet, McLeod! The udderly adorable mini cow!

SP_CowPet2026_PremiumRewardMaxLevel_Desc.value: The perfect home for your new pet!

SP_CowPet2026_PremiumRewardTip_Descripti.value: Play to reach level 1 and unlock McLeod the mini cow!
Play to reach level 15 and unlock the Basic Mini Cow Barn.
Play to reach level 25 and unlock the Fancy Mini Cow Barn.

SP_CowPet2026_Start_Popup_Desc.value: Grandma left in a hurry… and Roddy just showed up with a “prize” from the farmer’s market. What could it be?

SP_CowPet2026_TA1_Dialogue_01.value: I’m telling you, Roddy, I don’t have space for a cow...

SP_CowPet2026_TA1_Dialogue_02.value: I know, I know. But you might have space for this one!

SP_CowPet2026_TA1_Dialogue_05.value: It’s so cute! What’s its name?!

SP_CowPet2026_TA1_Dialogue_08.value: Because there can be only one?

SP_CowPet2026_TA1_Dialogue_11.value: Alright, little McLeod. What do you think?

SP_CowPet2026_TA2_Dialogue_01.value: Hey, Maddie! How is our little friend doing?

SP_CowPet2026_TA2_Dialogue_04.value: He’s doing all right. He just misses you a little.

SP_CowPet2026_TA2_Dialogue_06.value: Oh, no! I’m sorry, little guy, I just... I can’t keep you at my place!

SP_CowPet2026_TA2_Dialogue_08.value: It’s alright. Roddy can come by and visit you whenever you like!

SP_CowPet2026_TA3_Dialogue_01.value: ...So he has to fight the bad guy in New York!

SP_CowPet2026_TA3_Dialogue_03.value: But the bad guy was waiting for him...

SP_CowPet2026_TA3_Dialogue_05.value: Oh Maddie! I uhh... I was just telling McLeod about where his name comes from.

SP_CowPet2026_TA3_Dialogue_07.value: You should show it to me sometime!

SP_DebsMystery2023AllRewardsCompleted_01.value: Well... That’s it. Guess we have to wait another 10 years for the next one.

SP_DebsMystery2023AllRewardsCompleted_02.value: But good things come to those who wait, right?

SP_DebsMystery2023AllRewardsCompleted_03.value: If I were you, sweetie... I wouldn’t be waiting too long, though.

SP_DebsMystery2023AllRewardsCompleted_04.value: Wh- What do you mean by that?

SP_DebsMystery2023AllRewardsCompleted_05.value: The Titan Arum may only bloom every 10 years, but when it does, it’s only for a few precious days.

SP_DebsMystery2023AllRewardsCompleted_06.value: It doesn’t dwell on the past and wait for a better time. It takes those rare days and makes them hers!

SP_DebsMystery2023Decoration_Slot25_01.value: Ah, Maddie! Right on time! I’ve taken it upon myself to get a little assistance for you!

SP_DebsMystery2023Decoration_Slot25_02.value: Er... I’m okay! I don’t think Hank needs to help on this one.

SP_DebsMystery2023Decoration_Slot25_03.value: Don’t be silly, sweetie! He’s busy working on a piece of art.

SP_DebsMystery2023Decoration_Slot25_05.value: And what a fine piece of art he is...

SP_DebsMystery2023Decoration_Slot25_07.value: Oh! I got lost in my thoughts! No, I called that handsome marine biologist of yours, Enrique!

SP_DebsMystery2023Decoration_Slot26_01.value: Hi Emilio! I’m sorry that Deb dragged you into this.
Hi, Emilio! I’m sorry that Deb dragged you into this.

SP_DebsMystery2023Decoration_Slot26_02.value: Don’t worry about it, Maddie. It sounded like she really needed some help.

SP_DebsMystery2023Decoration_Slot26_03.value: Wonderful, you’re here! Now, sit down, you two, and I’ll bring you some afternoon tea.

SP_DebsMystery2023Decoration_Slot26_04.value: Er- Deb... What are you doing?

SP_DebsMystery2023Decoration_Slot26_06.value: Is... Is everything alright with her?

SP_DebsMystery2023Decoration_Slot26_07.value: I’m not sure. She’s been quite manic lately, with the blooming of her corpse flower.

SP_DebsMystery2023Decoration_Slot26_10.value: No, not me. My mother was a botanist, and she really loved her garden.

SP_DebsMystery2023Decoration_Slot26_12.value: Ah! Sorry, no! She switched careers. She pilots commercial airlines now!

SP_DebsMystery2023Decoration_Slot27_03.value: A small price to pay for its beauty, sweetie!

SP_DebsMystery2023Decoration_Slot27_04.value: Oh Deb, I don’t know if I can have that thing stinking up my home.

SP_DebsMystery2023Decoration_Slot27_05.value: It took over a month to get the smell out when we stashed your IMPROVED hopeberry juice!

SP_DebsMystery2023Decoration_Slot28_01.value: Rolled out the red carpet, huh?

SP_DebsMystery2023Decoration_Slot28_02.value: Well, it is a big occasion after all!

SP_DebsMystery2023Decoration_Slot28_03.value: No offense, Deb, but it’s just a flower.

SP_DebsMystery2023Decoration_Slot28_04.value: Maddie, sweetie. It’s more than just a flower! That flower is something I’ve cultivated for a very long time...

SP_DebsMystery2023Decoration_Slot28_05.value: For me, it shows that there is beauty in everything. Even in the most unlikely places.

SP_DebsMystery2023Decoration_Slot28_06.value: Besides, doesn’t hurt to make this place look a bit fancy!

SP_DebsMystery2023Decoration_Slot29_01.value: Fleur-de-lis, spikes... I’m sensing a theme here!

SP_DebsMystery2023Decoration_Slot29_02.value: You got me! I ADORE European nobility and their architecture. I spent most of my twenties traveling through Europe, looking for...

SP_DebsMystery2023Decoration_Slot29_04.value: ... What’s that? Oh, LOVE of course!

SP_DebsMystery2023Intro_01.value: Maddie, sweetie! So good of you to join me in this little endeavor.

SP_DebsMystery2023Intro_02.value: It’s no problem aunt Deb, anything to help!

SP_DebsMystery2023Intro_03.value: That’s wonderful, because something amazing is about to happen!

SP_DebsMystery2023Intro_05.value: Yes, my Titan Arum is blooming!

SP_DebsMystery2023Intro_07.value: My corpse flower! She’s blooming! Hasn’t done that in 10 years! We need to show the WORLD!

SP_DebsMystery2023LastCollectibleItemDis.value: I admit, it is quite beautiful.
That it is Maddie, sweetie. They can grow tall and strong and live very long lives...
The name “corpse flower” does unfortunately betray many of its beautiful qualities.
Never let a name betray who you really are, Maddie.
Names are just labels we give each other. They don’t define us...
Even if we sometimes wish they did.
I wonder what she meant by that? Doesn’t she like her name?

SP_DebsMystery2023_Decoration_Slot25_Des.value: A lavish introduction to botanical wonders, yet to come.

SP_DebsMystery2023_Decoration_Slot26_Des.value: An elegant location for afternoon tea.

SP_DebsMystery2023_Decoration_Slot27_Des.value: Witness the bloom of the corpse flower in all its... potency.

SP_DebsMystery2023_Decoration_Slot28_Des.value: Feel like royalty as you rest your weary legs in style...

SP_DebsMystery2023_Start_Popup_Desc.value: One of Deb’s Corpse Flowers is about to bloom! This rare event only happens every 7-10 years and Deb wants to share it with everyone. Maddie, however, sees this as an opportunity to learn more about Deb’s secretive love for this pungent plant.

SP_FairToRemember2026_AllRewardsComplete.value: Look around, Julius. The whole town is here!
I hardly know what to say.
Try "I was right." Your Renaissance Faire is a resounding success!
I think Ursula’s pastries were the hit this event needed.
Not to mention Hank’s sword-wielding demonstrations!
Do you think we'll have another Renaissance Faire next year?

SP_FairToRemember2026_Decoration_Slot33_.value: Wonderful. A proper fair needs a proper marketplace.
And look at all the banners!
Ah, now it's starting to feel authentic.

SP_FairToRemember2026_Decoration_Slot34_.value: Are all these costumes for the fair?
Of course! Half the fun is pretending you have stepped into another century.

SP_FairToRemember2026_Decoration_Slot35_.value: The blacksmith demonstration area is ready.
Excellent! Nothing brings history to life like seeing a craft in action.
They should be. These skills took years to master.
And here I thought people just wanted to watch me hit things with a hammer.

SP_FairToRemember2026_Decoration_Slot36_.value: There is already a line to my pastry stall!
No wonder! Those pastries smell delicious.
You know, fairs were famous for their feasts.
And today they're famous for making people buy second pastries. I am glad I made an extra batch!

SP_FairToRemember2026_Decoration_Slot37_.value: I am Sir Mason, Defender of Hopewell Bay!
Thank you. I gave it to myself.

SP_FairToRemember2026_End_Popup_Content_.value: The Hopewell Bay Ren Faire was a roaring success, and even the doubters ended up enjoying themselves in the end.

SP_FairToRemember2026_Intro_Dialogue_01.value: I've been thinking about something... rather ambitious.

SP_FairToRemember2026_Intro_Dialogue_04.value: A Renaissance Faire, here in Hopewell Bay.

SP_FairToRemember2026_Intro_Dialogue_05.value: That sounds amazing! But I’ve never been to a Renaissance Faire.

SP_FairToRemember2026_Intro_Dialogue_06.value: What are they like? Do people walk around in old-fashioned clothes and challenge each other to duels?

SP_FairToRemember2026_Intro_Dialogue_07.value: Well, yes – but no actual dueling.

SP_FairToRemember2026_Intro_Dialogue_08.value: There is historical food and drink, demonstrations, stalls where you can buy things…

SP_FairToRemember2026_Intro_Dialogue_09.value: It is glorious! I have been dreaming of organizing one for a long time.

SP_FairToRemember2026_LastCollectibleIte.value: Everyone seems to be enjoying themselves.
Even the people who claimed this sounded silly.

SP_FairToRemember2026_RewardMail_Topic_L.value: A Fair to Remember has ended.

SP_FairToRemember2026_RewardMail_Topic_S.value: A Fair to Remember has ended.

SP_FairToRemember2026_Start_Popup_Desc.value: Julius realizes Hopewell Bay has never had a Renaissance Faire before, and decides now would be the best time to arrange one!

SP_FerretPet2025_AllRewardsCompleted_Dia.value: I love the sound they make!
I guess you’re getting along with the ferrets!
Oh yes, dearie! They’re wonderful little accomplices!
They’ve helped me find a lot of my old jewelry!
Although... I don’t recall ever owning some of the items they brought back.

SP_FerretPet2025_End_Popup_Content_NoRew.value: After weeks of chaos, chases, and unexpected friendships, Maddie helps each ferret find its perfect home. Hopewell Bay settles down. Though Klepto and Bandit still guard their shiny stash, they may have found their greatest treasure of all: a new home.

SP_FerretPet2025_Intro_Dialogue_03.value: Maddie! Thank goodness I found you!

SP_FerretPet2025_Intro_Dialogue_04.value: You have to help me! Help Hopewell Bay!

SP_FerretPet2025_Intro_Dialogue_05.value: Calm down! You need to tell me what’s going on first!

SP_FerretPet2025_Intro_Dialogue_06.value: Oh right! The ferrets, Maddie! They’re back!

SP_FerretPet2025_LastCollectibleItemDisc.value: Oh yes! This is how we caught them back in ‘82.
By giving them a great time?
The great ferret fiasco of ’82 was quite the ordeal! It even inspired a popular movie!
About a bunch of ferrets running around stealing and causing havoc in a small town during the holiday season?
Well... some artistic liberties were taken, of course.

SP_FerretPet2025_PetInfoDescription.value: Two mischievous ferret siblings with a nose for trouble, a heart for mischief, and an unstoppable urge to “borrow” shiny things.

SP_FerretPet2025_PetUnlock_Description.value: You've just unlocked a brand-new friend!

SP_FerretPet2025_PetUnlock_Header.value: Get ready for Klepto and & Bandit, the mischievous Ferrets!
Get ready for Klepto & Bandit, the mischievous Ferrets!

SP_FerretPet2025_PremiumRewardMaxLevel_D.value: The perfect home for your new pets!

SP_FerretPet2025_Start_Popup_Desc.value: Hopewell Bay is in uproar! Ferrets everywhere! Following strange clinking sounds to her cupboard, Maddie discovers two tiny culprits snoozing among a hoard of stolen trinkets. The Ferret Fiasco has begun!

SP_FerretPet2025_TA1_Dialogue_02.value: The strangest thing has happened! I can’t seem to find-

SP_FerretPet2025_TA1_Dialogue_06.value: Last night I found these two little kleptomaniacs sleeping in my cupboard!

SP_FerretPet2025_TA1_Dialogue_07.value: Oh! How precious! Look at that one! He even has a bandit mask!

SP_FerretPet2025_TA1_Dialogue_08.value: Hey! That’s a great name! Bandit! And Klepto!

SP_FerretPet2025_TA2_Dialogue_01.value: Alright! I’ve gathered you and Jackie to form the ferret task force!

SP_FerretPet2025_TA2_Dialogue_02.value: We’re going to gather all these little rascals before they steal everything that isn’t nailed down.

SP_FerretPet2025_TA2_Dialogue_03.value: And we’re going to give them new homes!

SP_FerretPet2025_TA2_Dialogue_05.value: Where were you thinking we’d put them?

SP_FerretPet2025_TA3_Dialogue_01.value: That's it! All the ferrets have been rounded up and found new homes!

SP_FerretPet2025_TA3_Dialogue_03.value: You thought I forgot about you, didn't you?

SP_FerretPet2025_TA3_Dialogue_05.value: Who do you think the ferretropolis was built for?

SP_GhostDog2025_AllRewardsCompleted_Dial.value: I’ve heard what you did for Mason and...
The kid’s kinda grown on me.
Yeah, he’s an endearing little troublemaker, isn’t he?
That he is, he practically lives here.
I hope that’s okay! I... I don’t mean to intrude or any-

SP_GhostDog2025_End_Popup_Content_NoRewa.value: Boo, the ghost dog brings fun and laughter to the Mansion, chasing away the chill of the season with playful mischief. But, what new shadows await next at the door?

SP_GhostDog2025_Intro_Dialogue_05.value: Mom should be here by now!

SP_GhostDog2025_Intro_Dialogue_06.value: But she said she had some last-minute “work” things to do!

SP_GhostDog2025_Intro_Dialogue_07.value: Ugh. You grownups with your work. Always getting in the way of important stuff!

SP_GhostDog2025_Intro_Dialogue_10.value: I need to cheer him up, somehow.

SP_GhostDog2025_Intro_Dialogue_12.value: Rufus! Just the dog I was looking for...

SP_GhostDog2025_LastCollectibleItemDisco.value: And your frightful feast is ready, Ru- Er... Boo!
That’s actually quite spooky how you can make your howl echo like that...
Alright, alright. You’re a pro, I get it.

SP_GhostDog2025_PetInfoDescription.value: A friendly phantom pup with a big heart

SP_GhostDog2025_PetUnlock_Description.value: You've just unlocked a brand-new friend!

SP_GhostDog2025_PetUnlock_Header.value: Meet Boo, Mason's adorable friend from beyond the grave!

SP_GhostDog2025_Start_Popup_Desc.value: A scruffy little dog wrapped in an old sheet appears on Grandma’s porch, looking every bit like a ghost. Charmed by his spooky sweetness, Maddie and Mason welcome Boo into the Mansion, where he brings laughter, mischief, and a hint of spookiness!

SP_GhostDog2025_TA1_Dialogue_03.value: I think I’ve seen a ghost! Look!

SP_GhostDog2025_TA1_Dialogue_04.value: Is that a ghost dog behind you in that photo?!

SP_GhostDog2025_TA1_Dialogue_05.value: Yeah! Someone slipped this under my door. Maybe it’s that stranger from last year!

SP_GhostDog2025_TA1_Dialogue_12.value: Huh! A ghost dog. Gave us quite a fright, didn’t you?

SP_GhostDog2025_TA1_Dialogue_14.value: How about we call you Boo?

SP_GhostDog2025_TA1_Dialogue_15.value: Yeah! Oh boy, my very own paranormal pooch!

SP_GhostDog2025_TA2_Dialogue_03.value: Huh! Sounds like a bunch of ghosts are loose in my...

SP_GhostDog2025_TA2_Dialogue_07.value: Got to admit, it’s the cutest graveyard I’ve ever seen.

SP_GhostDog2025_TA2_Dialogue_09.value: Hey! It’s Halloween! You’ll make Boo angry!

SP_GhostDog2025_TA2_Dialogue_12.value: Hmm... Maybe I should have an exorcist on speed dial.

SP_GhostDog2025_TA3_Dialogue_01.value: Well, it looks like you two have been having a downright ghoulish time!

SP_GhostDog2025_TA3_Dialogue_02.value: Yeah! It’s been so much fun, but...

SP_GhostDog2025_TA3_Dialogue_03.value: But what happens when Halloween is over?

SP_GhostDog2025_TA3_Dialogue_04.value: Does Boo have to leave too?

SP_GhostDog2025_TA3_Dialogue_06.value: Boo, want to stick around for a while and keep Mason company?

SP_GhostDog2025_TA3_Dialogue_09.value: I think that’s a yes, Mason.

SP_GoatPet2025_AllRewardsCompleted_Dialo.value: Another wedding done! You should consider becoming a wedding planner.
I know! I'm getting pretty good at it.
What do you think about Lady Voyance's premonition?
I think she is a whimsical character who believes far too much in how the stars align and tea leaves fall.
You should take her premonitions with a good pinch of salt!
You're right. By the way, have you seen Pablo lately?
I think I saw him wandering towards Deb's garden, but I cannot imagine why. The smell of the corpse flower is so overwhelming!
Not even the hungriest goat would want to take a bite out of that!
Come on, let's go and have a cup of tea and some apple pie.
Sounds good. I've had enough drama for one day!

SP_GoatPet2025_End_Popup_Content_NoRewar.value: Bella and Emilio get their happily ever after, while the others are left wondering about whose bloom might wither too soon...
Bella and Emilio get their happily ever after, while the others are left wondering about whose bloom might wither too soon...

SP_GoatPet2025_Intro_Dialogue_01.value: Emilio, I just told my parents about our wedding! They're so excited and happy for us!

SP_GoatPet2025_Intro_Dialogue_03.value: And they've sent a wedding present - a fishing boat! It'll be delivered here at the Mansion.

SP_GoatPet2025_Intro_Dialogue_04.value: A fishing boat? I'm sure we'll find a place for it...

SP_GoatPet2025_Intro_Dialogue_06.value: But listen, Bella, about the wedding...

SP_GoatPet2025_Intro_Dialogue_07.value: It's looking great, isn't it? Maddie's done such an amazing job!

SP_GoatPet2025_Intro_Dialogue_10.value: I know you're nervous - I am too! But it'll be great, I promise.

SP_GoatPet2025_LastCollectibleItemDiscov.value: How are you doing? I can't believe you're getting married!
Neither can I. I have to admit that I'm starting to feel some nerves.
That's totally understandable. The whole thing came up pretty suddenly.
It's a lot to take in.
I've known Bella since university and I've always admired her, but I never thought we would end up together.
I always thought love would hit me like a lightning out of a clear blue sky.
Sometimes it does. And sometimes it's been under your nose the whole time.
