SP_GoatPet2025_RewardMail_Topic_Long.value: Secrets at the Altar has ended.

SP_GoatPet2025_RewardMail_Topic_Short.value: Secrets at the Altar has ended!

SP_GoatPet2025_Start_Popup_Desc.value: Bella and Emilio are set to walk down the aisle - but someone is getting cold feet. As the big moment approaches, a hooved wedding present creates the perfect distraction!

SP_GoatPet2025_TA1_Dialogue_01.value: Maddie, can we take some photos when the present arrives? I want to capture the moment for my parents.

SP_GoatPet2025_TA1_Dialogue_02.value: They can't be here for us today, so their wedding present is extra special.

SP_GoatPet2025_TA1_Dialogue_03.value: It's here! Maddie, are you ready to snap a photo?

SP_GoatPet2025_TA1_Dialogue_06.value: It's definitely not a fishing boat.

SP_GoatPet2025_TA1_Dialogue_07.value: More like a... fishing goat! Where did you come from, buddy?

SP_GoatPet2025_TA1_Dialogue_08.value: It says here he's called Pablo.

SP_GoatPet2025_TA1_Dialogue_10.value: This is crazy! There has been a mistake. I mean, look at this thing. It's... a goat!!

SP_GoatPet2025_TA1_Dialogue_14.value: I think a goat fainting on your wedding day means good luck!

SP_GoatPet2025_TA2_Dialogue_01.value: Welcome everyone! It's a beautiful day to celebrate love, partnership and the union between Bella and Emilio.

SP_GoatPet2025_TA2_Dialogue_02.value: Next, Emilio will read his vows to Bella.

SP_GoatPet2025_TA2_Dialogue_03.value: OK. I want to say to you, Ma...

SP_GoatPet2025_TA2_Dialogue_05.value: Oh... no! Pablo is about to faint again!

SP_GoatPet2025_TA2_Dialogue_06.value: No - it was a false alarm! What were you saying, Emilio?

SP_GoatPet2025_TA2_Dialogue_07.value: Erhh... Bella, I... This has all been a lot to digest and...

SP_GoatPet2025_TA2_Dialogue_09.value: I've known you're my person ever since we first met, and you know me better than anyone else. If you let me, I promise to make you so happy.

SP_GoatPet2025_TA2_Dialogue_10.value: You've been there for me all my life, and now it's my turn to be there for you. Let's get married!

SP_GoatPet2025_TA3_Dialogue_01.value: Thank you for arranging the wedding, Maddie. Everything was so beautiful.

SP_GoatPet2025_TA3_Dialogue_02.value: Just one thing... Do you think Emilio almost said your name during the ceremony?

SP_GoatPet2025_TA3_Dialogue_03.value: Definitely not. You're the right person for him - and he knows it. You make a great couple!

SP_GoatPet2025_TA3_Dialogue_04.value: Thanks. I know we've had our differences in the past, and maybe I wasn't fair to you.

SP_GoatPet2025_TA3_Dialogue_05.value: You're important to Emilio, and now we're married so...

SP_GoodVibrations2026_AllRewardsComplete.value: It's amazing how many people came. I mean, rocks are not the most glamorous thing in the world.
But these are more than rocks. They're stories, colors, memories.
Some treasures are valuable because they're rare. Others because they make people curious.
Then I'd call this showcase a success.

SP_GoodVibrations2026_Decoration_Slot25_.value: I keep finding more stones tucked into these boxes. Whoever packed this collection was very thorough.
Some of these have notes attached. Dates, locations...
"Found along the northern cliffs, 1968." That's pretty specific. Imagine how many hands these passed through before ending up here.
The Boultons never threw away an interesting rock.
Good thing, too. Otherwise we'd never have found any of this.
Good thing, too. Otherwise, we'd never have found any of this.

SP_GoodVibrations2026_Decoration_Slot26_.value: The labels on the display tables make such a difference. Visitors can learn what they're looking at.
I've added magnifying glasses too. But this sample doesn't match any description we have.
Then the label must have been lost years ago.
Or nobody ever identified it properly.

SP_GoodVibrations2026_Decoration_Slot27_.value: Look at those prisms! The sunlight is scattering rainbows everywhere.
And these jars of colorful pebbles are gorgeous.
But look at this! This stone has a strange shimmer. I wonder if it's rare...
Let's just say unusual rocks have a habit of appearing around this family.

SP_GoodVibrations2026_Decoration_Slot28_.value: More people brought collections! Now we have fossils, shells, beach glass...
And every item has a story behind it.
Half the town has stories about rare stones discovered around Hopewell Bay.
And somehow every version is different.
That's a mystery worth digging into...

SP_GoodVibrations2026_Decoration_Slot29_.value: More people brought collections! Now we have fossils, shells, beach glass...
And every item has a story behind it.
Half the town has stories about rare stones discovered around Hopewell Bay.
And somehow every version is different.
That's a mystery worth digging into...

SP_GoodVibrations2026_Decoration_Slot38_.value: The giant geode is stealing the whole show.
That's understandable! Nature doesn't make many treasures like that.
You know, for a town showcase, we ended up with quite a few unusual specimens.
Including that unlabeled mystery stone nobody can identify.

SP_GoodVibrations2026_End_Popup_Content_.value: Looks like odd geological discoveries are more common in Hopewell Bay than anyone realized. Maybe the vein of secrets runs deeper than it originally seemed...

SP_GoodVibrations2026_Intro_Dialogue_01.value: I can't believe I let you talk me into helping you clean out the Garage.

SP_GoodVibrations2026_Intro_Dialogue_02.value: Me neither! But I promise I'll make it up to both of you.

SP_GoodVibrations2026_Intro_Dialogue_03.value: Whoah! What's in this old box? It weighs a ton.

SP_GoodVibrations2026_Intro_Dialogue_04.value: Oh my goodness, look at these crystals! Some of them are labeled. Quartz, amethyst, agate... And a few aren't labeled at all.

SP_GoodVibrations2026_Intro_Dialogue_05.value: My ancestors collected rocks from around the world for generations. Things get misplaced.

SP_GoodVibrations2026_Intro_Dialogue_06.value: Weren't they known for finding some pretty unusual stones? I think I read somewhere that some of them were discovered right here, in Hopewell Bay.

SP_GoodVibrations2026_Intro_Dialogue_07.value: It's true, but I don't know half of it. It's another secret Grandma is keeping from me...

SP_GoodVibrations2026_Intro_Dialogue_08.value: I think these treasures deserve to be shown off to the whole town. How about we put on a little showcase?

SP_GoodVibrations2026_Intro_Dialogue_09.value: Maybe we'll find some answers along the way!

SP_GoodVibrations2026_LastCollectibleIte.value: Here's the last box. Wait... why is it so heavy?
There's a huge grey rock inside! Let's handle it carefully. It might be fragile.
There's a huge gray rock inside! Let's handle it carefully. It might be fragile.
Carefully now... Don't trip over those box--
I'm fine, but the rock is not...

SP_GoodVibrations2026_Start_Popup_Desc.value: When Maddie discovers boxes full of rare crystals and rocks, Pearl seizes the opportunity to showcase the Boultons' impressive collection - and to maybe mine some secrets, too!

SP_GrandmasMystery2024_AllRewardsComplet.value: I assure you, I did NOT kill poor Hank.
I did speak to him before he left, but he is still in one piece, as far as I know.
HANK?? Is that a baby you have with you?
You must be totally confused about what happened to me!
See, Ursula found out that my ex-girlfriend had had a baby and sent me to make things right... I asked her not to tell you, 'cos I was wanted to get everything in order first.
So here I am! It's your baby, Deb.
I don't think that's how it works, Hank...
I learned about this child through Reginald's letter and told Hank. He begged me to keep his secret, so I did.
Hank is a gentleman at his core, so I knew that he would do what was right.
So... everyone's alive, Hank's back, and everything's fine?

SP_GrandmasMystery2024_Decoration_Slot33.value: Let's set up a seating area here! A bench, some cushions, lights...
I've sensed so much trouble around town after Hank went missing. Maybe this little project can bring some harmony.
What a lovely idea! It really HAS been a strange couple of months.
By the way, how do you know Grandma?
Oh, Ursula and I go way back!
She spent so long in Japan and speaks the language fluently... You know, that's not exactly usual!

SP_GrandmasMystery2024_Decoration_Slot35.value: I'm sorry, but I don't have any crackers for you... Please don't be offended!
Please don't, Ursula! *Squeeek!* Please don't do it!
E-excuse me?? Could you say that again?
Don't! I'll do anything you want!
If you're saying what I think you're saying, this is really serious...

SP_GrandmasMystery2024_Decoration_Slot36.value: Grandma, I just had a REALLY worrying talk with Sgt. Pepper!
Y-yes, he can talk, you know! And I have to say, he made me pretty scared.
Did you kill Hank and let Cherry bake him into a pie?

SP_GrandmasMystery2024_Decoration_Slot37.value: The scene that ends this strange, eventful history...
Would I really kill Hank, my own sister's husband?
According to what Maddie said, the evidence speaks for itself, Ursula.
The vegan meat you offered for the pie, the bone Goldie dug up...
You were the last person seen with Hank before he disappeared, and Sgt. Pepper repeated Hank's last words.
First of all, it is just good sense to stock up on quality ingredients when they are on sale. That vegan meat was a great bargain!
Secondly, the bone Goldie found was an old Halloween decoration. Now if I really HAD done what you accuse me of, you would not suspect a thing...
That is a more complicated question, dearie...

SP_GrandmasMystery2024_End_Popup_Content.value: All's well that ends well, as Grandma Ursula likes to say!

SP_GrandmasMystery2024_IntroDialogue_Dia.value: Are we gonna talk about the bone?
The bone Goldie dug up in Grandma's yard? Yeah, that was creepy!
First Ursula comes up with all that vegan meat for Cherry's pie, and then Goldie digs up something that looks like a human bone...
On top of that, Ursula was the last one seen talking to Hank!
And you need to tell Deb -- she's worried sick about Hank!
*Gulp* I guess it's the only way...

SP_GrandmasMystery2024_LastCollectibleIt.value: Maddie, dearie! There's someone I want you to meet.
This is Kazuko. She owns a shop in town, and she is a friend of mine. To round off Hopewell Bay's centennial celebrations, she is organizing a community theater project.
How lovely to meet you, Maddie. Your grandma has told me so much about you!
Nice to meet you! So, the community theater ---
This is my cockatoo, Sgt. Pepper. I'm afraid he is pretty nosey...
Aaaall you need is a... CRRRACKER!

SP_GrandmasMystery2024_Start_Popup_Desc.value: A giant pie, a mystery bone... It's time for Grandma Ursula to spill the tea about what happened to Hank!

SP_GranniesOfAnarchy2023_AllRewardsCompl.value: It's time for us to get our domes on and grab a handful.
That means that we are going take off for a drive, dearie.
I gathered that, Grandma. You and your friends are quite an impressive bunch!
Thank you! You can forget about any crimes. The Grannies of Anarchy always ride on the right side of the law.
I still feel like you're not telling me everything. There's more to your skillfully knitted patches than you let on...
Some of us were just born to be wild, Maddie, dearest.

SP_GranniesOfAnarchy2023_Decoration_Slot.value: The gang's all here!
Maddie, what on earth are you doing sneaking around?
Err... We were just admiring these impressive motorbikes on your drive.
I didn't know you were expecting guests, Grandma!
There's plenty you don't know, dearie...
These are my friends. We are all members of a little hobby group.
That's quite the hobby group...
Well, we all enjoy a good kicker with some farkle, but a citizen like you would probably not understand such things.
What language was that?
That was biker slang. This is our biker gang, the Grannies of Anarchy.
Ha! So I was right!
Biker Parking
Does your ride need some tuning?
Tell us more, Grandma! When did you join your biker gang?
Oh, we've been flying our colors for decades.
The world was different when we founded the club, and we yearned for the freedom of the open road...
So, we decided to put together a group of like-minded ladies to challenge the more... traditional views.
What an amazing story, Ursula. An all-female biker gang is a totally rebellious idea.
And the knitted decorations on your bikes are really amazing!
We do know a thing or two about knitting... and rebellion.
Motorcycle Tools
This shed might hide some secrets...
When we started our motorcycle club, people just did not take us seriously.
So, we were forced to break the rules every now and again.
We did ruffle some feathers, too.
Your biker club looks like a wild bunch! But what exactly do you do?
Burn rubber and stand up against the man, of course!
Oh? So things sometimes get out of hand?
Whatever do you mean?
Does your gang dabble with anything... criminal?
Biker Shed
The meeting can begin!
Why on earth do you think our club would be involved in criminal activity?
We happened to overhear some of your conversation and... it sounded  fishy.
You were eavesdropping? That is rather rude, dearie.
I admit that our crochet work is so good that it's criminal, but we are certainly no outlaws!
What kind of crimes did you have in mind?
Murder?
Murder?? You should get your ears checked, dearie.
Oh, now I understand. My friend Mama said that we need a new recorder. You must have misheard her!
I guess that could've been it, but...
That's settled then!
Clubhouse
A motorcycle club with a difference.
What a relief! They're just a group of nice old ladies.
Who happen to ride around on big bikes and wear leather jackets!
Your Grandma is full of surprises!
She certainly is...
So, you don't think they are really involved in anything shady?
I guess not. But what would a biker gang need a recorder for?
Neon Sign

SP_GranniesOfAnarchy2023_End_Popup_Conte.value: The Grannies of Anarchy are riding off towards a new adventure - and we know a little bit more about Grandma's awesome (and audacious) history!

SP_GranniesOfAnarchy2023_Intro_Dialogue_.value: Hey, Maddie! Is everything OK with Grandma Ursula?
There are so many ways to answer that... Why do you ask?
Erm, there are a bunch of big motorcycles outside her house! But they look oddly... cozy and sweet.
Hmm... I know she loves her bike, but that sounds pretty wild, even for her!
I think we need to find out what's going on. Let's just sneak a little bit closer and take a look...
Look at that! Grandma's house is full of old ladies having tea - in full biker gear!
Grannies of Anarchy... I've heard rumblings about this gang. I should have guessed your Grandma is involved somehow!
Grandma's in a BIKER GANG? What is she - Easy Rider?! What are they whispering about, anyway?
Eavesdropping on your own Grandma, Maddie? I'm so here for it.
Uh-oh... Did you hear that? I'm pretty sure one of them just said something about... a MURDER!

SP_GranniesOfAnarchy2023_LastCollectible.value: Did you just hear those ladies whisper something about a murder?
They are a biker gang, but murder? Then again, those knitting needles look pretty sharp...
What are they doing - drawing up a biker granny hit list?
I think we need to dig a little deeper. Come on, Jackie. Let's see what these biking buddies are up to!

SP_GranniesOfAnarchy2023_Start_Popup_Des.value: A biker gang rumbles up to Grandma Ursula's house - but things are not quite what they seem... Help Maddie find out what this gaggle of grannies is up to!

SP_Halloween2024_AllRewardsCompleted_Dia.value: That was a strange business about the newspaper ad, wasn't it?
I was hoping to put all of the commotion behind us and start clearing the Boulton name, but someone seems intent on causing trouble.
I'm sure it was an honest mistake!
A very strange mistake, I would say, and I do intend to look into it.
Now I have to run, or my apple pie will burn in the oven. See you later!
...that I might know who is behind this.

SP_Halloween2024_Decoration_Slot25_Descr.value: Step inside and make yourself at home.

SP_Halloween2024_Decoration_Slot25_Dialo.value: Your plan for the tour looks excellent, and the Mansion looks way creepier when you're looking for ghosts!
It sure does! But all the spirits here are friendly -- or at least I think so.
I'll talk to Cherry about making snacks for the tour, and we're good to go!

SP_Halloween2024_Decoration_Slot26_Dialo.value: OK, let's write this ad. What do you want it to say?
I don't know... I'm not sure there's any point.
Come on, this ad could really help draw in some crowds.
Fine. I guess it could say something like, "Experience the most haunted house in Hopewell Bay!"
And maybe, "Come for the scary stories and stay for the Halloween snacks."
No one's able to turn down free snacks!
The ad should be upbeat and fun. Don't you agree?

SP_Halloween2024_Decoration_Slot27_Descr.value: Even a fountain can be haunted.

SP_Halloween2024_Decoration_Slot27_Dialo.value: Cherry said she's too busy to help with the snacks.
It's weird because she'd already promised to do it before.
I'd even briefed her on soda flavors and the right shade of frosting.
Now that I think about it, I'm sure I saw her duck into the frozen aisle when I ran into her in the supermarket.
Something is definitely up with her - but let's worry about it later.
We have a ghost tour to organize!

SP_Halloween2024_Decoration_Slot28_Descr.value: Take a seat and get comfortable.

SP_Halloween2024_Decoration_Slot28_Dialo.value: Maddie, I love what you've done with the place... but we have another issue.
The newspaper ad you posted for the ghost tour is a bit... scary.
We wanted it to be a little bit creepy, but not SCARY.
"Dare to enter Hopewell Bay's Infamous Haunted Mansion?"
"Step beyond the rotting gates of Beaumont Hall, where whispers and lies linger in the cold night air. The spirits here are not friendly..."
This is NOT what I wrote with Jackie!

SP_Halloween2024_Decoration_Slot29_Dialo.value: Next, we will head to Frog Pond Falls, where the spirit of Amelia Boulton allegedly often wanders...
The tour is going great, Maddie!
I feel like I'm getting weird looks from people...
So the mood is a little bit spooky - who cares? Everyone is loving the haunted Mansion.
Something is off... Why would Jackie change the newspaper ad like that?
I'm sure there's an answer for everything... Let's keep going with the tour!
You're right. Follow me, everyone - Lady Amelia awaits!

SP_Halloween2024_Decoration_Slot38_Dialo.value: Care to explain why you decided to change the newspaper ad?
It was supposed to be creepy and funny -- but it was just straight up scary!
Hold on-- I didn't change it!
Oh, no! I can't believe I went along with this, even after your Boulton exposé...
Seriously, Maddie! I didn't change it. I filed it exactly as we wrote it together.
Then... someone else changed it. But why?
This story has more angles than I ever thought...

SP_Halloween2024_End_Popup_Content_NoRew.value: The most haunted Halloween is over, but who is out to sabotage Maddie?

SP_Halloween2024_IntroDialogue_Dialogue_.value: I just realized that I'd promised to organize a ghost tour at the Mansion for Halloween.
You know, before the storm and the cans full of secrets...
Maybe it is not such a bad idea.
I'm not sure how many people would want to come...
And I'm not sure I really want to see anyone, either!
I'm still upset with Jackie for writing in the newspaper about our family. Now everyone's got it in for us!
The first step out of any mess is to make amends, Maddie dear. Maybe this is just the thing!
Let's get all the skeletons out of the closet!

SP_Halloween2024_LastCollectibleItemDisc.value: Hey. Listen, I'm so sorry the exposé about your family... I thought I was just doing my job, but I...
You knew it would hurt my family - and me! I don't know how I can trust you again.
It wasn't personal... I just believe people have the right to know the truth.
I'm so sorry, Maddie. Let me make it up to you! You're organizing a ghost tour at the Mansion, right?
Let me publish an ad for it in the paper. I know it doesn't make up for anything, but let me help. Please?
Whatever, it's not like anyone's coming anyway.
You might be wrong about that. We can make the ad funny and inviting.
I want to save our friendship. Please, let me try.

SP_Halloween2024_Start_Popup_Desc.value: Maddie plans a ghost tour of the Mansion to get everyone into the spirit of Halloween, but someone is not ready to forget about the mess left by the storm...

SP_HanksMystery2024_AllRewardsCompleted_.value: Deb, there is something you should see...
What's all this in your front yard? If this is your idea of a joke, Ursula, I swear...
No, Deb - this is all for you.
Hank?? You did all of this... for me?
But why? I thought you were gearing up to leave Hopewell Bay - and me.
Actually, there's something I want to ask...
Would you make me the happiest man in the world and be my wife?

SP_HanksMystery2024_Decoration_Slot25_Di.value: Maddie... Have you noticed something strange about the front yard?
Two giant ice creams seem to have appeared there - and one of them oddly reminds me of Deb!
Haha! You're actually right - it's uncanny!
But WHY are there giant ice creams there?

SP_HanksMystery2024_Decoration_Slot26_Di.value: Oh, Maddie! How do you young people stand the merciless ebb and flow of romance?
Is something up with you and Hank? You seemed so... happy together.
I thought so too! But then he neglected to plan anything for Valentine's Day.
Not a diamond in sight - not even a bouquet of roses!
I-I think that Hank is going to leave me! I don't know what's going on in that handsome head of his.

SP_HanksMystery2024_Decoration_Slot27_Di.value: Grandma, there's a pink Cadillac in your front yard!
It's very nice, but isn't it kinda late for someone to be organizing a Valentine's surprise?
Maybe it is not a Valentine's surprise at all...

SP_HanksMystery2024_Decoration_Slot28_Di.value: This is definitely starting to look like a romantic surprise.
And that's the ring we found among the Valentine's presents, on the front step! But who's surprising whom?
Let's see... A giant ice cream sculpture, a pink Cadillac and a couple of swans...
WHO would consider that peak of romance?
It's all here! Wow, this delivery was seriously late.

SP_HanksMystery2024_Decoration_Slot29_Di.value: Yeah, this is all me. Sorry about crowding your front yard, Ursula.
It is quite alright - I guessed it was you! But tell us, what is all of this for?
I wanted to do this big surprise on Valentine's Day - you know, when we had the party - but the delivery got delayed.
The only thing that was delivered on time was the ring, and I had to make a move to save it...
But... is it an engagement ring??

SP_HanksMystery2024_End_Popup_Content_No.value: Will Deb say yes to Hank, and will they ride the pink Cadillac into the sunset together? Find out in the next Mystery Pass.

SP_HanksMystery2024_Intro_Dialogue_01.value: What a Valentine's Day we had!

SP_HanksMystery2024_Intro_Dialogue_03.value: But don't you think that there's been some weird stuff going on lately?

SP_HanksMystery2024_Intro_Dialogue_04.value: Hmm, you mean the burned teddy? That certainly was odd...

SP_HanksMystery2024_Intro_Dialogue_05.value: Yeah - and the diamond ring found among the Valentine's presents Mason bought for all of us.

SP_HanksMystery2024_Intro_Dialogue_06.value: Valentine's does make people act funny, but now that you mention it...

SP_HanksMystery2024_Intro_Dialogue_07.value: There is certainly something odd about all of this!

SP_HanksMystery2024_LastCollectibleItemD.value: I have a feeling that the ring was no coincidence. Someone is planning something big!
And I think I know who it is...

SP_HanksMystery2024_Start_Popup_Desc.value: What do you get when you combine a pink Cadillac, giant ice cream cones, and a diamond ring? A Proposal Mystery, of course!

SP_Hopefest2026_AllRewardsCompleted_Dial.value: Listen to that crowd — we actually pulled this off.
Against all odds, and with minimal disasters. I still can’t believe how much talent this town was hiding.
Including Roddy. Who knew there was a real rock'n'roll hunk hiding under that hard hat? Right, Maddie?
After this, people will expect a festival every summer.
Maybe they should. Tonight feels special.
Careful, Maddie. Next year you might want to take to the stage, too!

SP_Hopefest2026_Decoration_Slot25_Dialog.value: I heard Pearl recruited you to design the stage, Roddy. It's looking excellent!
Thank you! I've made all the necessary calculations to make sure it's safe and ready for rocking night.
Do you have the permits for the stage, Maddie?
Well, we're still waiting on the FINAL stamp of approval, but--
Come on, Jackie! If you wanna rock, you gotta break the rules!

SP_Hopefest2026_Decoration_Slot26_Dialog.value: Next on the list: building the backstage area with seating for the performers.
Sounds good! By the way... who will be performing? Has anyone signed up?
Oh, yeah. We have a great line-up for the night, but we still have space for a few more if you want to get onstage.
Me?? Oh, I don't sing. I can barely hold the drumsticks!
No? Ursula said you absolutely own the shower every morning!

SP_Hopefest2026_Decoration_Slot27_Dialog.value: You know what really makes a festival work?
Sure, but there’s something even more important.

SP_Hopefest2026_Decoration_Slot28_Dialog.value: Have you seen the stage lights? It’s finally starting to feel like a real festival.
I know — I can barely sit still. Wait… who’s rehearsing up there?
Right? Quietest guy in town, and suddenly he’s a rock star.

SP_Hopefest2026_Decoration_Slot29_Dialog.value: Everything is ready for the festival to begin!
But did we get all the permits approved?
So now we just need to...

SP_Hopefest2026_Decoration_Slot38_Dialog.value: Look at this place! Lights, music, people everywhere… we actually pulled it off.
I’ll admit, I was expecting at least three disasters by now.
Relax, Pearl. The crowd’s happy, the bands are good, and nobody’s had food poisoning. That’s a successful festival in my book.
And listen to everyone singing along. It feels like the whole town showed up.
That’s exactly what I hoped for.
And I think just what Hopewell Bay needed!

SP_Hopefest2026_End_Popup_Content_NoRewa.value: Hopefest Rock Festival rocked the town and left everyone talking about Roddy. Apparently, stage lights can make a guy look totally studly and buffed.

SP_Hopefest2026_Intro_Dialogue_01.value: Have you noticed how lively Hopewell Bay gets on summer nights lately?

SP_Hopefest2026_Intro_Dialogue_02.value: Totally! The harbor’s packed, music’s always drifting from somewhere... It feels really magical.

SP_Hopefest2026_Intro_Dialogue_03.value: That’s why I’ve been thinking... What if we gave people something bigger to gather for? A real music festival.

SP_Hopefest2026_Intro_Dialogue_04.value: Pearl, that’s an amazing idea. Local bands would love it!

SP_Hopefest2026_Intro_Dialogue_05.value: A festival’s a pretty big project for a place this size.

SP_Hopefest2026_Intro_Dialogue_06.value: Maybe, but we’d start small – one stage, local talent, some food stalls.

SP_Hopefest2026_Intro_Dialogue_07.value: And we could set it all up at the Mansion. The place would look amazing all lit up!

SP_Hopefest2026_Intro_Dialogue_08.value: Well… if we do this, we should do it properly. Permits, schedules, promotion... It's boring but important as we want this festival to be a success.

SP_Hopefest2026_Intro_Dialogue_10.value: That’s a “yes, before this turns into complete chaos.”

SP_Hopefest2026_LastCollectibleItemDisco.value: This place is gonna need a lot of work before you can call it a festival site!
We'll need to clear everything away and build a stage, stalls, a backstage area... And what if no one even shows up??
I hear you. But you know what they say?
If you build it, they will come!

SP_Hopefest2026_Start_Popup_Desc.value: An idea from Pearl sparks an ambitious plan to organize a rock festival that reveals rare talent and makes everyone realize that Hopewell Bay is not just a town, but a state of mind.

SP_IguanaPet2026_AllRewardsCompleted_Dia.value: Look at this place… warm lights, tropical plants, cozy rocks.
Meanwhile, our guest is living better than the rest of Hopewell Bay.
Just look at that! I wish someone would build me a personal spa.
It’s hard to believe he was freezing under those leaves just a few days ago.
And we happened to be in the right place at the right time!
Turns out Hopewell Bay’s pretty good at keeping cold-blooded guests warm.

SP_IguanaPet2026_End_Popup_Content_NoRew.value: Rascal the Iguana found a wonderful little home with Maddie, but the mystery remains - where on earth did he come from?

SP_IguanaPet2026_Intro_Dialogue_01.value: Did you see there’s a storm coming? I think it’s going to be a big one, too.

SP_IguanaPet2026_Intro_Dialogue_02.value: Yeah, I have tons of stuff to do before I can hunker down with a cup of tea and a blanket.

SP_IguanaPet2026_Intro_Dialogue_03.value: I know! There’s so much I need to-- *Gasp*

SP_IguanaPet2026_Intro_Dialogue_04.value: Jackie, come here quick… There’s something moving under the leaves. Please tell me that’s not another ferret.

SP_IguanaPet2026_Intro_Dialogue_06.value: An iguana? In Hopewell Bay? During autumn? Sure, why not.

SP_IguanaPet2026_Intro_Dialogue_07.value: Oh, it’s freezing cold! Look how sluggish it is. Poor thing probably took a very wrong turn somewhere.

SP_IguanaPet2026_Intro_Dialogue_08.value: We can’t leave it out here tonight. We have to warm it up somehow.

SP_IguanaPet2026_LastCollectibleItemDisc.value: Okay… The final heat lamp is up.
Moment of truth. Look – it’s lifting its head!
And moving closer to the heat! That’s the most energy it’s shown all day.
Hey there, little guy. Welcome back.

SP_IguanaPet2026_PetUnlock_Description.value: You've just unlocked a brand new reptile friend!

SP_IguanaPet2026_PetUnlock_Header.value: Meet Rascal, the green iguana who will capture your heart.

SP_IguanaPet2026_PremiumRewardMaxLevel_D.value: The perfect home for your pet!

SP_IguanaPet2026_PremiumRewardTip_Descri.value: Play to reach tier 1 and unlock Rascal the Iguana.
Play to reach tier 15 and unlock the Tropical Habitat.
Play to reach tier 25 and unlock the Luxury Tropical Habitat.

SP_IguanaPet2026_Start_Popup_Desc.value: As a storm closes in on Hopewell Bay, Maddie and Jackie make a startling discovery - a lost iguana! With little time to act, they set about building a homey habitat for the little reptile.

SP_IguanaPet2026_TA1_Dialogue_03.value: Yesterday he could barely move. Now he’s acting like he owns the yard.

SP_IguanaPet2026_TA1_Dialogue_04.value: But we need to figure out where he came from… Someone might be missing him.

SP_IguanaPet2026_TA1_Dialogue_05.value: Let's see... Blink once if you have an owner!

SP_IguanaPet2026_TA1_Dialogue_08.value: Hmmm… I don’t think so. He really seems to enjoy that basking rock.

SP_IguanaPet2026_TA1_Dialogue_09.value: I guess that means he’s staying with us for now.

SP_IguanaPet2026_TA2_Dialogue_01.value: Maddie, your iguana is loose again.

SP_IguanaPet2026_TA2_Dialogue_04.value: See? He's settled in so well. I'll really miss him when we find his real owner...

SP_IguanaPet2026_TA2_Dialogue_05.value: Umm, he’s currently inside a flower pot staring at me suspiciously.

SP_IguanaPet2026_TA2_Dialogue_06.value: Oh, that’s normal. Reptiles can sense uncertainty.

SP_IguanaPet2026_TA2_Dialogue_08.value: Why do I suddenly feel judged by a reptile?

SP_IguanaPet2026_TA3_Dialogue_01.value: The temperature’s dropping again tonight. I’m worried the enclosure still isn’t warm enough.

SP_IguanaPet2026_TA3_Dialogue_03.value: You can feel it too, can’t you?

SP_IguanaPet2026_TA3_Dialogue_05.value: I’ll reinforce the wind barriers before the heat escapes and get extra greenhouse plants for insulation.

SP_IguanaPet2026_TA3_Dialogue_06.value: Thank you! Rascal is very grateful, too.

SP_JamSession2023_DialogueForCompletingA.value: Here you go Cherry! Organic, grade A Hopeberry jam, fresh from the estate! Have a taste!
You don't like it, do you?
No! No! It's great! It's just... So... Thick?!
Here you go Cherry! Organic, grade A Hopeberry jam, fresh from the estate! Have a taste!
You don't like it, do you?
No! No! It's great! It's just... So... Thick?!

SP_JamSession2023_EndOfChainDialogue_01.value: Well... I'm not sure if this is exactly what she wanted, but it sure does taste amazing!

SP_JamSession2023_End_Popup_Content_NoRe.value: Good job! It looks like Cherry "loves" her new jam! Maybe Maddie can make some more in the future?

SP_JamSession2023_InitialDialogue_02.value: Hi Cherry, how's the bakery coming along?

SP_JamSession2023_InitialDialogue_03.value: Terrible! Just terrible. I'm out of Hopeberry jam!

SP_JamSession2023_InitialDialogue_04.value: I'm sure you can make some more?

SP_JamSession2023_InitialDialogue_05.value: Not without hopeberries! My order of berries never arrived, and your estate is the only one I know of that has them in the wild!

SP_JamSession2023_InitialDialogue_06.value: Okay sure, I'll help you make some!

SP_JamSession2023_InitialDialogue_07.value: You're a life saver! Thanks Byyeeeeee!

SP_JamSession2023_Start_Popup_Desc.value: Cherry needs help making her famous Hopeberry jam, but it may not be as easy as it sounds!

SP_JuliusMystery2023_AllRewardsCompleted.value: Even I didn’t know my family did so much traveling! They hardly ever spoke about such things...
Oh, dearie, I tell you things all the time! You just have to ask the right questions...
Julius, dearie. I just wanted to thank you for the wonderful gift. I may have been a bit snappy with you earlier, but...
But the conversation we had made it utterly clear why it's duck soup, Ursula.
And the NEW coat of arms is simply lovely!

SP_JuliusMystery2023_Decoration_Slot25_D.value: The Boultons loved traveling by train, purely due to the love of locomotive engineering.
Cute?! This is a highly detailed reproduction of the railway locomotive your great-great-grandfather used to travel in.
Yes. A USRA 0-6-0 coal powered locomotive with two cylinders, 62-inch drive diameter and a tractive force of over 17,000 kg.

SP_JuliusMystery2023_Decoration_Slot26_D.value: Bearing the crest proudly with the new family motto, "Sic Possum".
It’s wonderful! Can you explain what it all means?
But, of course! The can represents your family’s ingenuity and successes, the anchor represents their travels.
The frog represents new beginnings. Finally, the Hopeberry represents the land you are on.
It’s Latin for “Yes, I can.” An excellent motto. And...
Oh, I get it! CAN... Haha!

SP_JuliusMystery2023_Decoration_Slot27_D.value: If a train couldn't get there, then it was time to go by air...
Did my family travel in these too?
That’s the curious thing. It seems like a lot of information has gone missing!
Every time I seem to get close to an answer, I come to a dead end.
Trust me... I know the feeling.
Why would someone want to keep information about balloons secret?

SP_JuliusMystery2023_Decoration_Slot28_D.value: On their many travels, the Boultons managed to collect many souvenirs.
This is some very interesting stuff! You connected all this to my family?
It looks like a lot of my collection at the shop previously belonged to them.
How interesting! Wait... is this a pirate coat?!
Seriously, Julius. Don’t you have anything better to do than dig up my family history?!
But- But you asked me to-

SP_JuliusMystery2023_Decoration_Slot29_D.value: A mast once belonging to an unknown ship... Curious.
Maddie, dearie! What on earth is that thing doing up there?!
Isn’t it amazing? Julius found it! Supposedly part of some old pirate ship...
Oh, dear... Well, I guess he was bound to find out about them, eventually.
I think I'll have to speak with him. I'll be right back...
Speak with him? Why? Are there PIRATES in our family?!

SP_JuliusMystery2023_End_Popup_Content_N.value: It looks like Julius uncovered more than he realized!

SP_JuliusMystery2023_Intro_Dialogue_02.value: Hi, Julius. Quiet day at the antique store?

SP_JuliusMystery2023_Intro_Dialogue_03.value: Quite the contrary, my dear! I came across a wonderful find. Behold; an unpublished journal of the Boulton Family's travels!

SP_JuliusMystery2023_Intro_Dialogue_04.value: How interesting! How did you come across that?

SP_JuliusMystery2023_Intro_Dialogue_05.value: I’ve been doing some research on your family history and came across it in the library...

SP_JuliusMystery2023_Intro_Dialogue_06.value: You’re doing research on my family? What for?

SP_JuliusMystery2023_Intro_Dialogue_07.value: Well... It’s more of a hobby, actually. I love history, and your family seems to have a fascinating one.

SP_JuliusMystery2023_Intro_Dialogue_08.value: You can say that again! I wish I knew more...

SP_JuliusMystery2023_Intro_Dialogue_09.value: Well, if I find anything interesting, I’ll let you know!

SP_JuliusMystery2023_LastCollectibleItem.value: Maddie, can I show you something?
My research still has some holes in it, especially concerning your family lineage...
But it looks like your family has heraldic origins, but for the life of me, I can’t find any coat of arms!
It’s as if someone has removed it from history! So I...
I made you a new one based on your family’s latest history and achievements.

SP_JuliusMystery2023_Start_Popup_Desc.value: Researching Boulton family history is no easy task, but for Julius it is a hobby! As he follows the family's many travels across the world, he learns that some parts are missing! Or perhaps... removed!

SP_LadyVoyanceMystery2023_AllRewardsComp.value: That Lady Voyance sure is a character!
Yes, she is, dearie. Did she give you a reading?
Yes! She said I was about to find love! Or it... Me? I couldn’t quite understand what she meant.
Yes, she can be very confusing sometimes. I guess it has something to do with her 20% accuracy rate.
Yes, but in that 20%, she’s right all the time.
I don’t think that’s how it works, Grandma.

SP_LadyVoyanceMystery2023_Decoration_Slo.value: Come one, come all! Have your fortune read by snowfall!
Hello, my child! Come to have your fortune told?
My fortune? No, I just came over to ask if Ma-
Shh! Let me consult the snow! You are here to see... Maddie!
Yes... She here?
No, my child, your paths do not cross at this time...
I’m not a child. My name is-
Shh! I sense your name is... Jackie!
Incredible... Exactly what is written on my press badge.
Ah... A skeptic.
A reporter.
I sense GREEEAT conflict in your future!
Lady Voyance: Medium, Mystic, Fortuneteller!
Even spirits need a place to rest.
Hi... I’m uuuh, here to see the psychic?
Yes, my child... I knew you would come.
Y- You did?!
Of course! The globe never lies... And for you, I see wonderful things ahead!
Finally!
I sense that you’ve been waiting for a looong time too!
I... I have!
Do not worry, my child... Your wait is almost over.
Oh wow!
Spiritual Rest Stop
Sit, relax, and get your fortune told!
Ah, Maddie! Please, step inside.
Hello, Lady Voyance! I guess I’m ready for my reading now.
I know, my child... Let us begin....
I see a great loss in your life. Oh, poor thing, you’ve lost so much! But yet...
Despite it all, you’ve gained a lot more in return. Perhaps even things you do not yet know you have!
What does that mean?
Shh! The globe still SPEAKS to me! I see that you are searching for... Something.
Actually, I’m looking for something to help Gran-
Love!
Love?!
Yes! And your search is almost over, for love has found.... YOU!
What?! Who?!
I... I’m sorry. The globe has gone silent. But it is close, my child. CLOSE.
Magic Carpet
Communicate with the spirits and finally learn those winning lottery numbers!
Hey! Is-
Shhh! You are here to ask me a question!
Y- Yes! How did you know that?!
Shhh! The GLOBE SPEAKS!
You also like to work out!
Whoah.... This is getting freaky! What are you?
I am a medium...
Awesome! I’m... XXL myself!
Mystic Seance
Reading the clouds is a thing. Seriously, look it up.
Lady Voyance... I see that you’ve moved your shady operation to this ramshackle hole...
How fitting!
Regardless, you STILL need a business license to perform your little show.
I am performing my services for free.
Not a good business model if you ask me...
Heed my words Victoria... I see GREEEEAT DAAAANGER in your future!
Hahahahahahahaha!!!!
It is quite entertaining. I’ll give you that!
Observatory for Aeromancy

SP_LadyVoyanceMystery2023_End_Popup_Cont.value: The mystic snow globe has grown quiet, but perhaps it has given just enough information to change someones fate!
The mystical Snow Globe has grown quiet, but perhaps it has given just enough information to change someone's fate!

SP_LadyVoyanceMystery2023_Intro_Dialogue.value: No, my child... It is I who has come to help... YOU!
Maddie, dearie! I see you have met my old friend, Lady Voyance.
Really? How interesting! Came here to give Grandma a reading?
For heaven’s sake, no! I have come to help all of Hopewell Bay! I sense a great change in the future!
Ursula has graciously let me set up my services temporarily, so that I may help everyone in need.
... Especially you, Maddie. I can sense that something amazing is in store for you.
Yes, my child! Love is in the air!

SP_LadyVoyanceMystery2023_LastCollectibl.value: Wait... You read people’s fortunes from...
Yes, my child! The snowflakes react to the strands of fate that bind us all...
And so, I read the unique patterns of their fall.

SP_LadyVoyanceMystery2023_Start_Popup_De.value: Fate is a fickle thing, but don't worry, Lady Voyance is here to help! Visit her at Grandma's cabin and find out what the future holds for some of the residents of Hopewell Bay!

SP_LostLights2026_AllRewardsCompleted_Di.value: It's so beautiful with all the lanterns bobbing on the waves.
And none of them have sunk yet!
Thank you, Grandma and Julius. I think I needed this.
I am glad you could finally participate, Maddie.
It is quite the spectacle, even if you do not have anyone you are saying goodbye to.
What do both you say to some mulled wine to warm us up after that boat ride?
What do both of you say to some mulled wine to warm us up after that boat ride?
I have some pictures in the family photo album to show you. And some more funny stories.

SP_LostLights2026_Decoration_Slot25_Dial.value: Okay! I think I've got most of the supplies! Candles, paper, glue...
There is still time before evening, dear.
I know! I just want to make sure I get it right. What if the boats all sink?
Sure, but I'd like to keep them afloat long enough for the ceremony!
...which, by the way, I'm still not sure how it goes..?
Then let me tell you. It is my favorite part!

SP_LostLights2026_Decoration_Slot26_Dial.value: Where was I? Oh yes - the stories. Usually we start while we fold the boats.
Hopewell Bay has a very strong maritime culture, Maddie.
There is fishing, which you know, of course. But the sea was also important for trade and travel!
But the sea can be dangerous. Not every sailor comes back.
Indeed, yes! All manner of things could befall a sailor out to sea. Storms, pirates, shipwreck.
But at times they were simply late. The winds changed, or they were blown off course.
I guess they didn't have mobile phones to call and check in, huh.
They did not, dear. But looking to the horizon day after day, hoping against hope...that's no way to live.
Joining the Lights for the Lost festival was a way of saying goodbye.

SP_LostLights2026_Decoration_Slot27_Dial.value: So the people would tell stories about their lost loved ones while making the lanterns.
And then when they let them go, it was...sort of like a funeral at sea.
I can't imagine there are that many sailors lost to sea any longer, though...
We've got...GPS and sea charts and a lot fewer pirates!
Yes. These days, we usually remember anyone we've lost, not just sailors.

SP_LostLights2026_Decoration_Slot28_Dial.value: It's almost time! Does everyone have their lanterns?
Yes, yes. I am coming. To the row boat!
Look - others have already begun to let their lanterns go from the shore.
Indeed. They are catching the ebb tide, making sure the lanterns are carried out to sea.
Let's make sure we catch it too! I want to see it from the water.

SP_LostLights2026_Decoration_Slot29_Dial.value: This one is for my Dad. Thank you for making me curious.
Michael definitely was curious. He'd take things apart just to see how they work.
It took a little time to teach him he'd still need to put them back together again afterwards!
Your grandpa Charlie was left with more than one disassembled toy to fix...
And this one is for my Mom. For always making me feel safe and loved.
Oh, Maddie. Rebecca was the best mother anyone could hope for.
She would be so proud of the woman you've become.

SP_LostLights2026_End_Popup_Content_NoRe.value: The festival is over, leaving only beautiful memories of the lights floating in the bay. Not to mention the shared stories and laughter.

SP_LostLights2026_Intro_Dialogue_01.value: Good evening, Maddie. Are you ready for the festival?

SP_LostLights2026_Intro_Dialogue_03.value: The Lights for the Lost Festival of course!

SP_LostLights2026_Intro_Dialogue_04.value: It is a long-standing tradition in Hopewell Bay, in remembrance of sailors lost at sea.

SP_LostLights2026_Intro_Dialogue_05.value: Oh! In that case: I'm not ready at all! What happens during it?

SP_LostLights2026_Intro_Dialogue_06.value: We fold paper lanterns with lights, and let them float out into the bay when the sun sets.

SP_LostLights2026_Intro_Dialogue_07.value: While telling stories and remembering the lost. Don't forget that, Julius!

SP_LostLights2026_Intro_Dialogue_08.value: O...okay! Then I better get working on those lanterns!

SP_LostLights2026_LastCollectibleItemDis.value: Phew! That wasn't half as hard as I thought it would be.
What a beautiful lantern you've made, Maddie!
Thanks, Julius. Let's hope it floats.
I have no doubt it will. Now we just need a few more.
No need to worry, dear. I will tell you when you can stop folding. Now get back to it!

SP_LostLights2026_RewardMail_Topic_Long.value: Lights for the Lost has ended!

SP_LostLights2026_RewardMail_Topic_Short.value: Lights for the Lost has ended!

SP_LostLights2026_Start_Popup_Desc.value: Maddie learns about a Hopewell Bay tradition, where the townsfolk release paper lanterns into the bay to commemorate those lost to sea. Join Grandma, Julius and Maddie as they share stories and craft lanterns of their own!

SP_LoveLetter2025_AllRewardsCompleted_Di.value: ...and then she said, “Why are you wearing that silly hat?!”
Hahaha! I remember that! It was the night the four of us were stuck on that boat!
Exactly! Charlie almost went over the side!
Ha ha ha ha! He went over the side! Kelly was shouting, “Man overboard, man overboard!”
Well, look at you two having a grand old time!
Oh, dearie. It’s been wonderful! We’ve been reminiscing about fond memories.
I guess everything’s been cleared up?
Yes, dearie. It has... It has.
Why don’t you join us? I want to tell you the story of the time your grandfather stole a stuffed penguin.

SP_LoveLetter2025_Decoration_Slot25_Dial.value: Was only wondering if you would like to come over for some tea?
I’m sorry, dearie, but I think I left the pie in the oven!
Er... That pie is very special!
Marvelous! She can bring it to tea then!

SP_LoveLetter2025_Decoration_Slot26_Dial.value: Grandma! You shouldn’t have ghosted Julius like that!
I’m sorry, dearie! I was just too nervous to face him!
Grandma, you’re never nervous! About anything!
What’s that hanging over my window?!
I see you’ve found my little reminder.
Every time you avoid Julius, you’ll see another of my little friends. Cute, aren’t they?

SP_LoveLetter2025_Decoration_Slot27_Dial.value: What a glorious fire pit you have set up!
May I join you and perhaps partake of your glühwein?
I’m sorry, dearie, but I fear there is no more room left!
Oh? I’m sure I can sit right here where-
Oh no. The er... Teddy took that seat.
Oh... Alright then. I apologize for the intrusion.

SP_LoveLetter2025_Decoration_Slot28_Dial.value: Quite alright, Maddie. I was just wondering if you could...
Tell you why Grandma is acting like a lunatic?
Well... She read your letter and, I really shouldn’t be the one to tell you this, but she doesn’t feel the same way...
Your letter! The one where you spill your heart out and pledge your love to her!
I thought I'd lost that letter!
No... She found it. And... did you hear what I said?
It’s quite alright, Maddie. It all makes sense now.

SP_LoveLetter2025_Decoration_Slot29_Dial.value: No running off again! Okay, Grandma?
I guess I have a lot of explaining to do!
No! No, really, I’m sorry, but I...
It’s alright, Ursula! I don’t love you. Well... Anymore.
I wrote that over 50 years ago! When we were still young!
I admit, I was madly in love with you! But I lost the letter I wrote.
I guess someone found it and mailed it after all these years! How about that?
But I want to tell you something... The day I lost that letter...
Was the day I met my wife, Kelly!

SP_LoveLetter2025_End_Popup_Content_NoRe.value: Under the winter stars, Julius explains the letter was written decades ago, before fate led him to his wife and Grandma to Charlie. They share a tender laugh, realizing that love has always had a funny way of working out just as it should.

SP_LoveLetter2025_Intro_Dialogue_02.value: I hope you don’t mind my going through the festival decorations in the attic. I just-

SP_LoveLetter2025_Intro_Dialogue_05.value: I... I think Julius is in love with me!

SP_LoveLetter2025_LastCollectibleItemDis.value: Well... I was sorting through some of the festival decorations you left all over the place, and I found this.
Hmmm, let me have a look.
Woo boy... IT IS a love letter.
Maddie... Dearie. I’m a bit at a loss for what to do!
What do you mean? Of course you’re going to tell him!
No, I mean talk to him. He deserves to know how you feel. Be honest.

SP_LoveLetter2025_RewardMail_Topic_Long.value: A Love Letter Lost has ended.

SP_LoveLetter2025_RewardMail_Topic_Short.value: A Love Letter Lost has ended!

SP_LoveLetter2025_Start_Popup_Desc.value: When Grandma discovers a love letter from Julius hidden among festival decorations, she mistakes it for a new confession and struggles to find a gentle way to let him down. Meanwhile, Julius is puzzled by her behavior until the truth of the letter finally comes to light.

SP_LovePotion2025_AllRewardsCompleted_Di.value: Oh, my! The love potion has certainly done its work.
I can see many of our young people aflutter with feelings.
I wonder which lucky girl will win the heart of Emilio...
Mmm, the stars are aligning, the veil of fate lifts...
I sense some great drama - and even GREATER surprises!

SP_LovePotion2025_Decoration_Slot25_Dial.value: How have you been? How's work?
I've been studying a particular school of herring and their courtship behavior.
Please, tell me more. I've always been really interested in the behavior of... herring.

SP_LovePotion2025_Decoration_Slot26_Dial.value: What do you think about Emilio?
Do you think he likes me?
Thanks for the vote of confidence!
No, I don't mean that. I guess Emilio might like you... but looks like Bella is into him, too.
You know, I'm not feeling too hot. I feel kinda lightheaded...
I think I saw him getting some more Hopeberry juice.
I need to find him. See you later, Maddie.
That Bella... She's so perfect with her hair and her shorts and her... everything.
But maybe she's not THAT into Emilio... Maybe they're just friends.

SP_LovePotion2025_Decoration_Slot27_Dial.value: Where have you been? I've looked for you everywhere!
Lady Voyance insisted on telling my fortune, so I couldn't get away. Did you see Maddie talking to Emilio earlier?
Yeah, she's obsessing about him again. Poor Maddie!
She's wasting her time. Bella's not gonna let her snatch him.
Why are you so interested in her relationship drama all of a sudden?
I'm not. It's just that Emilio's obviously not the right guy for her!
And Maddie is someone I... care about.
I think we should take a break. Your heart's not in this.

SP_LovePotion2025_Decoration_Slot28_Dial.value: So, the Hopeberry juice is great, isn't it?
Let's just cut to the chase.
How long have you had a crush on Emilio?
I've seen the way you look at him, and I know he can be very charming.
But make no mistake - he's mine.

SP_LovePotion2025_Decoration_Slot29_Dial.value: Tell me, how are you feeling?
J-just fine. Maybe I had too much Hopeberry juice, but...
Oh? Have you experienced any tingling? A warm sensation or lightheadedness, maybe?
Well, now that you mention it...
A-ha! It worked. The cosmic powers are at play...

SP_LovePotion2025_End_Popup_Content_NoRe.value: Lady Voyance's plans worked out perfectly - but is there another cosmic surprise on the horizon?
Lady Voyance's plans worked out perfectly - but is there another cosmic surprise on the horizon?

SP_LovePotion2025_Intro_Dialogue_01.value: What do the stars want to tell me today?

SP_LovePotion2025_Intro_Dialogue_03.value: Oh, a powerful feeling is coming over me!

SP_LovePotion2025_Intro_Dialogue_06.value: There is a new moon and a change in the weather.

SP_LovePotion2025_Intro_Dialogue_07.value: People need a new spring in their step!

SP_LovePotion2025_Intro_Dialogue_08.value: I think I have just the thing...a little potion!

SP_LovePotion2025_Intro_Dialogue_09.value: Now what was it called... A-ha! Moonstring Serum!

SP_LovePotion2025_Intro_Dialogue_10.value: I'll pour it into the Hopeberry juice and watch the magic unfold!

SP_LovePotion2025_LastCollectibleItemDis.value: The Hopeberry juice is so delicious this year!
I know! It must be an especially good vintage.
I have to admit, there is nice quality to the bouquet of the drink.
But do I detect a hint of... oyster?
I want another round. Anyone else?
Oh, yeah! Pour me another one!

SP_LovePotion2025_Start_Popup_Desc.value: Lady Voyance has decided to stir up some romance with a very special love potion, but who will be touched by its magic?

SP_MasonsMystery2023_AllRewardsCompleted.value: Why would you go through all this trouble, dearie?
Well... You know... I’ve had so much fun around here in the past year... The spooky summer camp, the swimming pool.
Not to mention the awesome pirate ship! I just...
I just wanted to give something back.
Well, I love it! Thank you.

SP_MasonsMystery2023_Decoration_Slot25_D.value: All the snowmen do need a place to play!
Getting into the holiday spirit, I see!
What’s wrong? I think it looks lovely, if not hectic.

SP_MasonsMystery2023_Decoration_Slot26_D.value: A perfect place to keep Santa's sleigh hidden while he delivers presents.
It wasn’t me! Someone is coming over and decorating my home in secret!
No.... No, I guess not. But I’m wondering who it might be!
Well... When they’re done, tell them to do my house too.

SP_MasonsMystery2023_Decoration_Slot27_D.value: An entire holiday tree made of baubles!
Hmm... That tree doesn’t look structurally sound.
Looks like a croquembouche! I bet they built it around a mold and the structure supports itself.
Wow. Didn’t think of it like that!
I used to do desserts as a hobby. Big showy ones and gingerbread houses, mostly.
But I guess, it’s really my love of architecture and structural design. Desserts were just a way for me to express myself.
Come on Roddy... My first article was on the architectural designs of Hopewell Bay!

SP_MasonsMystery2023_Decoration_Slot28_D.value: So, who do you think is behind this?
Salutations! Your home looks quite grand, does it not?
Capital! It really brightens up the place. However...
I wouldn’t leave all these unopened gifts on the porch. Can’t trust the riff raff around here.
You thought it was Julius, didn’t you?

SP_MasonsMystery2023_Decoration_Slot29_D.value: Nothing says happy holidays like a bow wrapped roof!
I heard you figured it out!
Yes, dearie... Mason? You can come out from behind the bushes!
Oh! Hello, Grandma... I guess you figured it out.
I did. But I have to say, you had me going for a while! That’s a hard thing to do!
You bet, Mason! It’s really rare to fool Grandma!

SP_MasonsMystery2023_End_Popup_Content_N.value: Mason really surprised everyone! Happy Holidays!

SP_MasonsMystery2023_Intro_Dialogue_01.value: Looks like it’s the holiday season again, Grandma!

SP_MasonsMystery2023_Intro_Dialogue_02.value: Yes, dearie! I can’t wait to make my special holiday pie!

SP_MasonsMystery2023_Intro_Dialogue_03.value: Ooh! Is it the one with cinnamon, hopeberries and oranges?!

SP_MasonsMystery2023_Intro_Dialogue_04.value: That’s the one! I know little Mason has always wanted to try it, so I thought I’d surprise him.

SP_MasonsMystery2023_Intro_Dialogue_06.value: Not as sweet as my pie, dearie!

SP_MasonsMystery2023_Intro_Dialogue_07.value: Brrr... It’s getting cold, let’s head inside...

SP_MasonsMystery2023_Intro_Dialogue_08.value: Oh, man... Grandma has been so awesome this year! And now she’s making me pie?!

SP_MasonsMystery2023_Intro_Dialogue_09.value: I wonder what she would want for this holiday season?

SP_MasonsMystery2023_LastCollectibleItem.value: These ornaments will look great on our tree, Grandma!
Can’t go wrong with the classics, dearie.

SP_MasonsMystery2023_Start_Popup_Desc.value: Mason has decided to give Grandma a special holiday gift. He will decorate her house! What can go wrong?

SP_MiniHorseMystery2024_AllRewardsComple.value: Is there anything you would like to tell me - before we tie the knot?
My ex-husband Reginald thinks otherwise! "Your husband-to-be is hiding something from you..."
I-I don't know what he's talking about. Honest! He must be jealous of our love!
Hrrrmm, maybe. I think the seating chart requires my attention... But this conversation is not over!
Hank, may I steal you for a minute?

SP_MiniHorseMystery2024_End_Popup_Conten.value: Welcome to the Mansion, Lil' Reggie! But what is Hank hiding?

SP_MiniHorseMystery2024_IntroCutscene_Di.value: Hmmm, I'm sorry! I didn't mean to offend...
Do you need a new home?
I have just the perfect place!
But I'm getting way ahead of myself.
Let's start this story from the beginning!

SP_MiniHorseMystery2024_LastCollectibleI.value: So, Deb... Would you make me the happiest man on earth and be my wife?
Aah, yes! I love you, Deb! Then... we just need to set the date!

SP_MiniHorseMystery2024_LayerDecoration_.value: Listen, Deb... Did you read the whole letter?
Yeah... but there was some worrying small print...
He writes: "Good luck, dear Deb. You should know that your husband-to-be is hiding something from you..."
What on earth does that mean - and right before our big day!
What in the world is going on?
Hank's got some explaining to do, that's what!
Now this looks like a worthy home for my valiant steed! Reginald would also approve.
You have thought of everything. There's carrots, too! He does love them.

SP_MiniHorseMystery2024_PetHomeTA1_Descr.value: Everything a mini horse could need.

SP_MiniHorseMystery2024_PetHomeTA2_Descr.value: The classiest home for the classiest horse.

SP_MiniHorseMystery2024_PetInfoDescripti.value: Meet Lil' Reggie, the mini horse!

SP_MiniHorseMystery2024_PetUnlock_Descri.value: You've just unlocked a brand new friend!

SP_MiniHorseMystery2024_PetUnlock_Header.value: Meet Lil' Reggie, the mini horse!

SP_MiniHorseMystery2024_PremiumRewardMax.value: You have unlocked the Premium Horse Stables for Lil' Reggie! Well done!

SP_MiniHorseMystery2024_PremiumRewardTip.value: Play to reach level 1 and unlock Lil' Reggie!
Play to reach level 15 and unlock the Basic Mini Horse Stables!
Play to reach level 25 and unlock the Fancy Mini Horse Stables!

SP_MiniHorseMystery2024_ReggieUnlockCuts.value: The wedding preparations are coming along nicely! How are your toes, Deb?
They are toasty warm, thank you! I could not be happier.
I'm happy to hear it! I just heard that we can expect a large delivery soon. Probably stuff for the wedding!
I hope it is my corpse flower arrangements!
Oh, it is a mini horse! We used to breed them with my ex-husband, Count Reginald III of Wallopstone.
He IS handsome, isn't he? There is a letter - with Reginald's seal!
Hmm... He sent me "Little Reginald" as a wedding present. How thoughtful!
A horse needs stables - or in his case, mini stables!
Don't worry, Lil' Reggie. We'll build you a beautiful house!
Deb, can I take a look at that letter? I think you missed a couple of lines...
Sure! I am off to tell Hank about Little Reginald - a new family member. He'll be thrilled!

SP_MiniHorseMystery2024_Start_Popup_Desc.value: The arrival of an adorable mini horse brings a mystery that threatens to upend Deb and Hank's plans...

SP_Misery2025_AllRewardsCompleted_Dialog.value: To be brutally honest, you’ve been more of a mom to her than Charlotte lately.
To be brutally honest, you’ve been more of a mom to him than Charlotte lately.
Pearl, you shouldn’t be too hard on her.
While I don’t know her, I can’t help but feel she has a very good reason she couldn’t make it.
How could you ever say no to that?

SP_Misery2025_Decoration_Slot33_Dialogue.value: A good place to rest while we build the treehouse.
Yeah! Can we roast some marshmallows?
*Sigh* I just wish... Mom were here.
I know... want to talk about it?
Want to see me burn my eyebrows?

SP_Misery2025_Decoration_Slot34_Dialogue.value: I built you a little hangout spot next to the treehouse!
Not bad work, Mason. I’m impressed!
It was all me! And a little help.
Okay, it was a team effort!

SP_Misery2025_Decoration_Slot35_Dialogue.value: At least we won’t get lost, dearie.
It points to all the most important sites here!
The camp, the Treehouse and... Mud.
I’m a child, Grandma. I need a steady source of mud.
How else would I get dirty?!

SP_Misery2025_Decoration_Slot36_Dialogue.value: NO- Meganificent. Like SUPER DUPER magnificent.
Hey, don’t worry about it, Kiddo.

SP_Misery2025_Decoration_Slot37_Dialogue.value: That kid’s got a lot of energy...
This is so cool, Maddie! Like my very own theme park!
It IS a pretty cool jungle gym, though...

SP_Misery2025_End_Popup_Content_NoReward.value: With family, laughter and a treehouse all his own, Mason finds holiday joy again among the family and friends that are always by his side!

SP_Misery2025_Intro_Dialogue_03.value: And coming home to see your son isn’t?!

SP_Misery2025_Intro_Dialogue_05.value: Oh! Maddie! I’m so sorry! I’m just talking to myself.

SP_Misery2025_Intro_Dialogue_09.value: It’s Charlotte. And she’s not coming home, as I feared!

SP_Misery2025_Intro_Dialogue_11.value: Exactly, and I downright refuse that she’ll mess up this holiday as well!

SP_Misery2025_LastCollectibleItemDiscove.value: Maddiee... Why are we collecting all this junk?!
Why would you call the ladder to your new treehouse junk?
The great Fort Mason, of course!

SP_Misery2025_Start_Popup_Desc.value: Mason's holiday spirit dims when his mother doesn't arrive for the festive season. But at the Mansion, loss often stirs something unexpected!

SP_MysteriesUnveiled2024_AllRewardsCompl.value: Well... At least all the cans are gone. Feel any better?
Yeah... A little. I just needed to let out some frustration.
What better way than to use all these cans for some art!
Something tells me it’ll only get crazier...

SP_MysteriesUnveiled2024_Decoration_Slot.value: Love can triumph.
Hi, Maddie...
Jackie.
I guess... I guess you read the paper.
Yep. And used it to wipe off the little message your “fans” left on my door.
Thanks for that.
Maddie! I didn’t mean to-
Oh, I know exactly what you meant!
“NEVER trust a Boulton?!” Jackie! We were friends!
How could you do this?!
Just go...
Can You Bee Loved
A cantastic display of beauty.
Hi, Maddie.
Roddy! If Jackie sent you here to talk, I swear...
Easy! No, she doesn’t know I’m here. I just wanted to come and see how you’re doing...
Well, as you can see, I’m doing my darndest to work off some steam.
I have to get rid of these cans somehow.
Need some help?
Thanks, Roddy... I’d like that.
Tin Garden
You'll need a bigger can...
Wow, neat! You’re really creative, Maddie.
Thanks, Mason.
Hey... That guy looks familiar...
Er...
Isn’t that-
Hey Mason, wanna build a spaceship?!
YEAH!
One Can Imagine
Have a quiet moment, if you can.
Grandma, you need to tell me, is what Jackie wrote the truth?
I’m sorry, dearie... But yes. Yes, it is.
But... But why would he do that?
Because tin cans weren’t the only way our family made their fortune...
Ignatius Boulton started by collecting secrets from all the wealthiest families in Hopewell Bay.
Soon, that turned into ALL the families in the country. Information like that is worth a lot of money.
His connections allowed him to create a vast network of information gathering. He used the tin can factory as a cover to transport them secretly to all his clients.
... Sometimes, I wish she never invented the thing...
She? Who?
Oh, sorry... I must have gotten confused.
But, dearie, this was a long time ago. The entire operation was shut down.
This’ll all blow over soon enough. It always does...
Can-delight Ornaments
In space, cans can truly shine.
Tadaa!
Holy smokes, you built all that?!
Yeah! Well... Roddy helped a bit.
A bit?! I did the whole thing!
Alone...
Yeah, well, I drew the schematics!
In crayon!
Well, what did you expect? I’m just a kid!
Haha! You two are cute!
One Can Escape
If anyone can, Maddie can.
Is that supposed to be you, dearie?
Er... Yeah.
Why do you look so sad?
I dunno... I guess I feel like all I do is clean up the family mess.
Grandma! What are you doing?
I’m building myself. We’re in this together, dearie!
Racking the Cans

SP_MysteriesUnveiled2024_End_Popup_Conte.value: How will Maddie win back the trust of Hopewell Bay?

SP_MysteriesUnveiled2024_IntroCutscene_D.value: Who would do such a thing?
Oh, dearie... Have you read the news?
I thought you and Jackie were friends?
It says here that Ignatius Boulton spied on the people of Hopewell Bay!
And sold those secrets! He... allegedly did this across the country and secretly used the tin can factory to transport them!
... Is this true, Grandma? Is our family responsible?
I... I need some time alone, Grandma.
And do something with all these cans!

SP_MysteriesUnveiled2024_LastCollectible.value: Maddie! I made these for you!
Yeah! The papers said your family are spies!
And every good spy needs good binoculars.

SP_MysteriesUnveiled2024_Start_Popup_Des.value: Things are about to heat up in Hopewell Bay, as the people discover the truth behind the cans and what secrets they hold! What will Maddie do when the mystery of the tin cans are finally unveiled?

SP_MysteriousMaelstrom2024_AllRewardsCom.value: Have you not read the latest news? My dear Maddie-san, you should really keep up-to-date.
*sigh* There is an article just released about the tin can factory and possibly the truth behind it!
I knew I should not have sold everyone those can openers...
Maddie-san, your ancestor Ignatius Boulton was not a good man! They said that he ran the tin can factory as cover to sell secrets!
Other people's secrets! That’s what’s in the cans, Maddie-san.
Everyone’s secrets... And now they know about it.
Other people's secrets! That’s what’s in the cans, Maddie-san.
Everyone’s secrets... And now they know about it.

SP_MysteriousMaelstrom2024_CocoUnlockCut.value: I can't take it! You guys are so CUTE!
How about we give you a name? How about Coco?
You know what? You just gave me a great idea!
Who says we still can't enjoy a relaxing summer? I'm going to build us a spa!

SP_MysteriousMaelstrom2024_End_Popup_Con.value: Will the capybara help Maddie finally relax?

SP_MysteriousMaelstrom2024_IntroCutscene.value: Well... so much for my relaxing week. Let’s see what’s going on...
Oh, dear! Are those all the cans Mason dug up?!
Look what I found! I think the storm brought them here.
Mom said I can’t keep them, so I thought I’d bring them here!
Aaw, aren’t you a long way from home?
Well, don’t you worry! I’ll make sure you feel right at home.

SP_MysteriousMaelstrom2024_LastCollectib.value: Kazuko-san, how are things at the shop?
Really, good! Everyone is going crazy buying up all my can openers!
Didn’t you read the newspaper? The storm pulled up all these cans from the factory.
So everyone got curious. "What’s in these cans?" they ask.
Luckily for them, they got the right idea to come to my shop!
I have the best can openers in all of Hopewell Bay, you know...

SP_MysteriousMaelstrom2024_PetHomeTA1_De.value: Rest, relax and let your woes melt away...

SP_MysteriousMaelstrom2024_PetHomeTA2_De.value: Enjoy the tranquility of your very own capybara spa. If she lets you use it, that is...

SP_MysteriousMaelstrom2024_PetInfoDescri.value: Meet Coco, the wayward capybara who loves to relax!

SP_MysteriousMaelstrom2024_PetUnlock_Des.value: You've just unlocked a brand-new friend!

SP_MysteriousMaelstrom2024_PetUnlock_Hea.value: Meet Coco, the wayward capybara who loves to relax!
