SP_MysteriousMaelstrom2024_Start_Popup_D.value: A storm has struck Hopewell Bay, leaving behind hundreds of strange tin cans in its wake! As Maddie learns more about them, Mason arrives with a new wayward companion!

SP_MysteriousMaelstrom2024_TA1_Dialogue_.value: Hey, Maddie! I was wondering if I could get a few quotes from you!
Quotes? Are you writing something for the Bugle?
Yeah, I was asked to write a piece about all these cans and with what I found, they all came from a large landfill near your old family-owned tin can factory.
Really? I thought they were old tin cans that Mason dug up?!
The boy is industrious but not THAT industrious.
I was wondering if you knew anything about all the strange things that people were finding inside?
Uhm... no. I wouldn’t know about that. What strange things?
Some old photos, strange writing in code. I heard some people are now trying to crack it.

SP_MysteriousMaelstrom2024_TA2_Dialogue_.value: Hi Jackie! How’s the article coming along?
Well... I’ve been doing some digging and...
You’re probably not going to like it.
What? What am I not going to like?
Well, you see... I’ve been doing some digging, pulling some strings and getting some more information about your ancestor, Ignatius Boulton.
And... It looks like he may have been using the tin can factory as cover for something way more... clandestine.
You’re the one with the family full of secrets. I was hoping you could tell me!
I’m as much in the dark as you, but... could I ask you a favor?
Could you perhaps drop this story? Or at least change it so it doesn’t directly tie to my family?
What?! You know I’m a journalist, right? This is my job. You can’t ask me to compromise my integrity like that!
I’m sorry! I know... I know. It’s just that-
No, no, I get you. I’ll be seeing you around, Maddie.

SP_NewYearNewMaddie2024_RewardMail_Topic.value: [PLACEHOLDER] New Year New Maddie has ended!
[PLACEHOLDER] New Year New Maddie has ended!

SP_NewYearNewMaddie2024_Start_Popup_Desc.value: [PLACEHOLDER] Start up description placeholder for MP New Year New Maddie

SP_NewYearsResolutions2023_AllRewardsCom.value: Hey, Maddie! Have you seen Roddy around?
No! I think he's been really busy.
Of course you haven't. You're all about Emilio now!
It is going really well. I think next year is gonna be the best ever!
You... wouldn't happen to have Roddy's number?
Did you know that Emilio climbed Mount Everest?

SP_NewYearsResolutions2023_End_Popup_Con.value: Do you want to find out what the new year will bring for our hero? Stay tuned...

SP_NewYearsResolutions2023_Intro_Dialogu.value: This is it! I'm gonna do it and knock on that door.
I'm gonna be honest and say how I feel.
Great. Another year, and I still can't speak my mind.
Next year is going to be different. I'm going to be different.
I'm need to make some resolutions. NOW.
I need to make some resolutions. NOW.

SP_NewYearsResolutions2023_LastCollectib.value: Okay, resolutions are done! Get a new haircut, buy self-help books, find a new style...
That's a lot of stuff to do. Should I pick one at first?

SP_NewYearsResolutions2023_Start_Popup_D.value: Another has passed - but Roddy is less than satisfied. Determined to make the next year better, he writes down his resolutions!

SP_NoRest2025_AllRewardsCompleted_Dialog.value: So... What are you going to do, Maddie?
Are you going to tell them?
I... I don’t know Jackie. Pearl deserves to know. But...
But something tells me there’s a very good reason she doesn’t know.

SP_NoRest2025_Decoration_Slot25_Dialogue.value: Thanks for keeping Mason occupied, Maddie.
It’s alright. He really can’t wait for his mom to come back!
In fact, I’m actually quite excited too! She’s a relative, after all.
Okay, what is it, Pearl? You’ve been really reticent about her returning.
Well... I don’t think she will. Her job is REALLY important. So much so, I don’t even know what it is.
But it’s been her go-to excuse for the past 3 years. But honestly?
I- I just don’t think she wants to see ME. I chose for us to move here, and she was against it.
Against it? Why? Her mom lives here! Hmm... I should talk to Deb.

SP_NoRest2025_Decoration_Slot26_Dialogue.value: Hi, Deb! Thanks for dropping by. I just wanted to talk about Charlotte-
You see... She’s supposed to be coming back and Mason is REALLY excited, but...
What’s going on? Why does she think Charlotte doesn’t want to come home?
Well, I can tell you it isn’t Pearl’s fault! Charlotte chose a life that doesn’t leave room for family.
I don’t believe she thinks she gets to come back from a life like that.

SP_NoRest2025_Decoration_Slot27_Dialogue.value: Okay... That’s strange. This is Charlotte’s number, but I keep getting these odd numbers!
Hey, Jackie. I uh... I need your help.
I tried calling her, but I got some strange garbled message and a series of numbers.
Sure! I know a guy who might help. Just give me her number and I’ll look into it!

SP_NoRest2025_Decoration_Slot28_Dialogue.value: Mom! When will she be here?! Do you think she’ll stay now? I can’t wait to show her what I’ve made!
I’ll head home to see if I can find a whole skeleton to throw in!
He’s so excited! I don’t know if I should tell him...
I’m sorry Pearl... I tried calling her, but she didn’t pick up.
I don’t know, but I know she’s doing something important...

SP_NoRest2025_Decoration_Slot29_Dialogue.value: Maddie! You won’t believe what we found! This’ll make one heck of a story!
She’s a spy, Maddie! Charlotte is some sort of spook!
Those numbers were a coded message my contact recognized. Not sure who she’s working for but...
It’s up there Maddie. WAY up there!

SP_NoRest2025_End_Popup_Content_NoReward.value: Among the candy wrappers and flickering pumpkins, the truth stayed quiet. Mason was family, and that was what truly counted.

SP_NoRest2025_Intro_Dialogue_02.value: Hey, Mason! What’s gotten you all excited?

SP_NoRest2025_Intro_Dialogue_03.value: Mom is coming back! Can you believe it?!

SP_NoRest2025_Intro_Dialogue_05.value: No, silly! MY OTHER MOM! I’m going to make her something really special!

SP_NoRest2025_Intro_Dialogue_06.value: Ah, Maddie. Sorry about that! Mason is just really excited...

SP_NoRest2025_Intro_Dialogue_07.value: Don’t worry about it, Pearl! I bet you can’t wait either.

SP_NoRest2025_Intro_Dialogue_10.value: Well... She was supposed to come last year, and had a last-minute thing come up.

SP_NoRest2025_Intro_Dialogue_11.value: Mason was REALLY disappointed. And he’s so excited right now, I don’t want...

SP_NoRest2025_Intro_Dialogue_12.value: Hey, I understand. I’ll let Mason help me with some of the decorations. Maybe that’ll keep his mind off things.

SP_NoRest2025_LastCollectibleItemDiscove.value: Oh, yeah... Wh- What is it?
Oh! Yeah, it’s- It’s a spitting image!
Aaaanyway, I was going to give it to my mom as a gift!
This way, she can take me with her the next time she leaves!

SP_NoRest2025_RewardMail_Topic_Long.value: No Rest for the Wicked has ended!

SP_NoRest2025_RewardMail_Topic_Short.value: No Rest for the Wicked has ended!

SP_NoRest2025_Start_Popup_Desc.value: As Pearl plans the perfect Halloween for Mason, a buried truth about his mother surfaces. Could this unravel the family she has so desperately tried to hold together?

SP_Omoide2026_AllRewardsCompleted_Dialog.value: Yes, dearie. Sakura has challenged me, and I must face it.
But... But, the letter is over 50 years old!
A challenge is a challenge, dearie.
It is only right I take her up on it. She deserves as much.

SP_Omoide2026_Decoration_Slot25_Dialogue.value: Maddie! So I heard you wanted to learn how to play Go! Wonderful.
Yeah! I found this board in Grandma's attic and-
This board is very familiar, and if we look at the bottom...
Yes... This board belonged to my cousin, Sakura.

SP_Omoide2026_Decoration_Slot26_Dialogue.value: Sakura was a brilliant Go player. The best in the village.
And she was a wonderful teacher.
I knew she knew how to play that game!
And very well! She lived with my cousin in Japan for a while. They were like sisters!
Until they played that one fateful game...

SP_Omoide2026_Decoration_Slot27_Dialogue.value: So what happened between Grandma and Sakura?
They were playing in the village square. Everyone could watch. Expecting Sakura to win...
But perhaps she was a better teacher than a player!
Your grandmother won that game in front of everyone, and Sakura felt publicly humiliated.
Pride and misunderstanding grew between them until your grandmother left Japan. They never spoke again.

SP_Omoide2026_Decoration_Slot29_Dialogue.value: Hmm... There must be something I can do to cheer Grandma up!
I know Grandma didn't mean to humiliate Sakura.
And keeping her board must mean- Wait!
A hidden compartment under the board! There's a letter inside!
"If you still remember our last game, meet me once more beneath the cherry blossoms."
"I'll be waiting for our final match. Sakura"
I need to show this to Grandma!

SP_Omoide2026_Decoration_Slot38_Dialogue.value: Grandma, I found this letter inside the Go board.
All this time you were waiting for a rematch.
What are you going to do?
Practice! Come on, dearie. Time I teach you the Sakura method.

SP_Omoide2026_End_Popup_Content_NoReward.value: With Sakura’s letter finally read, Grandma prepares to return to Japan and finish the game that began a lifetime ago. One last match between friends, beneath the cherry blossoms.

SP_Omoide2026_Intro_Dialogue_02.value: I was going through some of the stuff in your attic and I came across this old Go board!

SP_Omoide2026_Intro_Dialogue_04.value: I didn’t know you played Go.

SP_Omoide2026_Intro_Dialogue_05.value: I... I'm sorry dearie, but I need to check something.

SP_Omoide2026_LastCollectibleItemDiscove.value: Those are all the pieces found for the game.
Now just to find someone who could teach me!
I see you’re still playing with that silly thing.
Well, that’s the thing. I don’t know how! Care to teach me?

SP_Omoide2026_Start_Popup_Desc.value: While sorting through Grandma’s attic, Maddie uncovers an old Go board. An heirloom with a mysterious past and memories Grandma isn’t ready to share.

SP_Pickleball2025_AllRewardsCompleted_Di.value: Your pickleball tournament was a great success, Grandma!
But it could be seen as suspicious that you ended up also winning the whole thing.
I won it fair and square, dearie!
Have you found the balance and harmony you were so hoping to discover?
Not quite. I'm working on it. And did you find your phone?
Oh, yes! It was in my pocket the whole time.
You should be more careful about where you leave it, Grandma.
Don't worry -- I won't lose it again.

SP_Pickleball2025_Decoration_Slot32_Dial.value: Where is this pickleball tournament taking place?
I hope Ursula is prepared to bow down to a superior opposition!
Salutations, Maddie! Ursula invited us to play in her little tournament, but I am afraid competitive spirit is already overshadowing the fun.
Looks like Deb and Grandma will have a tense match...
They have a history of competition, and I doubt it won't be resolved in the pickleball courts.

SP_Pickleball2025_Decoration_Slot33_Desc.value: Get ready to cheer for your favorites.

SP_Pickleball2025_Decoration_Slot33_Dial.value: What is Grandma doing with her new smartphone? Is she taking selfies - AGAIN?
And now she's just scrolling and scrolling...
Oh, no... Have I created a monster??
Jackie said she wouldn't be surprised if Grandma had a secret smartphone for years… Could she be right?
Jackie said she wouldn't be surprised if Grandma had a secret smartphone for years... Could she be right?
I wonder what Grandma is actually doing on her phone...

SP_Pickleball2025_Decoration_Slot34_Desc.value: For the best of the best.

SP_Pickleball2025_Decoration_Slot34_Dial.value: That was a good match, dearie! You put up quite a fight.
Thank you, and congratulations! It was a well-deserved victory.
Thank you very much. How about we snap a little post-match selfie?
I'll post it to my social media account -- not that one...
How many social media accounts do you have?
What's that, dearie? Smile for the camera!

SP_Pickleball2025_Decoration_Slot35_Desc.value: The game is about to start!

SP_Pickleball2025_Decoration_Slot35_Dial.value: What a game, Deb! It was SO close.
*Sniffs* Your Grandma cheated again, I am sure of it!
No? Even when we were younger, she did not hesitate to claim points that were not hers!
But maybe she was the better pla--
Have you still not realized, Maddie? Your Grandma is the master of hoodwinking people.

SP_Pickleball2025_Decoration_Slot36_Dial.value: Have you seen my phone, dearie?
Where did you last see it? Let's try to retrace your steps.
I played a match with Deb, and then... I cannot remember!
I just have to find it. I was just about to...
I am going to see if Deb saw it after our match. It HAS to be somewhere...

SP_Pickleball2025_Decoration_Slot37_Dial.value: Hey, Jackie! Grandma wanted to invite you to play a game of pickleball.
Pickleball? I've never even tried it. Does it involve actual pickles?
By the way, do you think there's something suspicious about everything she is doing on her smartphone?
There's something suspicious in just about everything she does. Why?
I don't know - maybe I'm imagining it, but she seems to have a lot more going on than I imagined.
You know your Grandma better than anyone, Maddie. You should trust your instincts.

SP_Pickleball2025_End_Popup_Content_NoRe.value: What is Grandma doing on that smartphone - watching cute cat videos or something else entirely?

SP_Pickleball2025_IntroDialogue_Dialogue.value: Maddie, dearie, I enjoyed your yoga retreat - until I pulled a muscle in my back. It still hurts!
Does it? I'm sorry... Maybe we went too far with the extra demanding poses.
You can make it up to me by joining me for a pickleball tournament!
Yes! Like tennis - but more fun!
But does it involve actual pickles?

SP_Pickleball2025_LastCollectibleItemDis.value: You might know I was something of a tennis champion in my younger days...
When I was reading some news on the internet on the handy smartphone you bought me, I saw an article about pickleball and thought it looked fun.
So, I decided to organize a little tournament!
H-have you ever played it before?
No, but it can't be that difficult.
So? Will you play with me?
You bet I will. It's a new year, I'm a whole new me, and the new me doesn't shy away from a challenge!

SP_Pickleball2025_Start_Popup_Desc.value: It is time to play pickleball - but do you have what it takes to play in Grandma Ursula's Tournament?

SP_PieWars2023_AllRewardsCompleted_Dialo.value: The votes are in... Who wants to do the honors?
It's close, but the winner is...
Congratulations, sugar! I guess I still have a lot to learn...
Not too much, dearie. You can bake with the best of them, but sometimes you just can't beat the classics!

SP_PieWars2023_Decoration_Slot25_Dialogu.value: Just a bit of promotion, dearie.
It looks like you're running for office! Mind you, the head of City Council could do with a change...
I see we have an unsanctioned bake sale. No matter... It won't save your mansion. You'd need to bake a lot of pies to do that.
Ah Victoria, speak of the devil. I see that you're still rocking those horns! Good for you!
Remind me to never be on your bad side...

SP_PieWars2023_Decoration_Slot26_Dialogu.value: Mmm... That smells delicious! Hoping to lure more people in?
Hoping? I may need to move inside! I'm having trouble handling the demand!
Only you'd get upset when things go well, Grandma!
Hey! I could smell that all the way in my bakery! Do you really think that's fair?
All's fair in pies and war, dearie...
Oh I see... It's war then.
Interesting... Looks like Ursula and Cherry are having a bit of a competition...

SP_PieWars2023_Decoration_Slot27_Dialogu.value: That sneaky baker! I knew she was up to no good!
What? Grandma, I don't think she'd do something like that.
I'm telling you, she can't win in a fair fight!
But you said all is fair in pies and-

SP_PieWars2023_Decoration_Slot28_Dialogu.value: Where is your grandmother?! I have a bone to pick with her!
Hey, wow! Hold your horses, what's going on?!
She switched the labels of my salt and sugar jars!
I did no such thing! You sabotaged my oven!

SP_PieWars2023_Decoration_Slot29_Dialogu.value: Victoria! What are you trying to do to that balloon?
Er... Do you have a license for this? Unsanctioned balloons may pose a flight risk!
Hey, wait a minute! You're behind all the trouble with Cherry and Grandma, aren't you?!
How dare you! I've never been so insulted in my life!
Uh huh, sure... You should leave, before Grandma finds you!

SP_PieWars2023_End_Popup_Content_NoRewar.value: Victory to Grandma! Sometimes you just can't beat the classics.

SP_PieWars2023_Intro_Dialogue_01.value: Hi Cherry! Need more help making jam for your bakery?

SP_PieWars2023_Intro_Dialogue_02.value: Oh, sugar... Something better! I brought you my new and improved Hopeberry pie! Have a taste...

SP_PieWars2023_Intro_Dialogue_03.value: ...Oh my gosh, that's amazing! That's the best thing I've ever tasted!

SP_PieWars2023_Intro_Dialogue_05.value: Oh, Grandma, you have to taste this! It's phenomenal.

SP_PieWars2023_Intro_Dialogue_06.value: Really? You've always said my pies were the best...

SP_PieWars2023_Intro_Dialogue_07.value: Looks like you've got a bit of competition, sugar!

SP_PieWars2023_Intro_Dialogue_08.value: How about we make it official then, dearie?

SP_PieWars2023_Intro_Dialogue_09.value: Alright, you're on! Let the people decide. The best tasting pie wins!

SP_PieWars2023_LastCollectibleItemDiscov.value: I've got to say, Grandma, you sure know how to make a pie!
Nothing like a bit of competition to get the old baking juices flowing, dearie.
I couldn't help but come over and see how my competition is doing!
Oh please, I don't need your secrets to win!

SP_PieWars2023_Start_Popup_Desc.value: The ultimate contest has begun! Grandma Ursula has been challenged by Cherry to finally see who makes the best pies! May the best baker win!

SP_PigPet2025_AllRewardsCompleted_Dialog.value: You got quite a birthday present, Mason!
I sure did. Tofu and I are going to be so happy together!
You're welcome to come here and play with him anytime.
And when I'm a little bit older, I can take him home. Right, mom?
Come on, Tofu - let's go look at your new house. Tofu?
I think he's having a nap!
I think I need a nap...

SP_PigPet2025_End_Popup_Content_NoReward.value: Tofu the mini pig has made himself at home - and Mason is over the moon! Let the birthday celebrations commence!

SP_PigPet2025_IntroCutscene_Dialogue_01.value: My mom sent me a card and told me that there's a big surprise arriving for me today.

SP_PigPet2025_IntroCutscene_Dialogue_03.value: No, my other mom - Charlotte. She works away, so she wanted to send me something special.

SP_PigPet2025_IntroCutscene_Dialogue_04.value: I wonder if I'm finally getting that potato cannon!

SP_PigPet2025_IntroCutscene_Dialogue_05.value: Yikes! Let's hope it's something less messy.

SP_PigPet2025_LastCollectibleItemDiscove.value: I don't think I've ever met Mason's other mom, Charlotte. What is she like?
She has very much taken after her mother.
Yes. They are both intelligent and sharp-witted.
What does Charlotte do for a living?
Ah, that I cannot tell you.

SP_PigPet2025_PetInfoDescription.value: A mini pig with a big personality

SP_PigPet2025_PetUnlockCutscene_Dialogue.value: Do you have any idea what Mason's surprise could be?
I'm not totally sure. Charlotte wouldn't tell me what it is, but I have my suspicions. I just hope I'm not right.
Uh-oh! I think I can see a delivery van.
Mason, I think your surprise is here!
What is it? What is it?
Aaaaawww, a mini pig! Mom writes that she's sorry she couldn't be here but the pig is very cuddly.
Mom, you scared him! Come on, he's such a cute little guy.
You have to admit that he's pretty adorable, Pearl!
I guess he is... But where are we going to put a pig??

SP_PigPet2025_PetUnlock_Description.value: You've just unlocked a brand new friend!

SP_PigPet2025_PetUnlock_Header.value: Meet Tofu, Mason's adorable birthday present!

SP_PigPet2025_PremiumRewardMaxLevel_Desc.value: The perfect home for your new pet!

SP_PigPet2025_PremiumRewardTip_Descripti.value: Play to reach level 1 and unlock Tofu, the Mini Pig!
Play to reach level 15 and unlock the Basic Pig House.
Play to reach level 25 and unlock the Fancy Pig House.

SP_PigPet2025_RewardMail_Topic_Long.value: A Pig Birthday Surprise has ended.

SP_PigPet2025_RewardMail_Topic_Short.value: A Pig Birthday Surprise has ended!

SP_PigPet2025_Start_Popup_Desc.value: A birthday present from Mason's other mom, Charlotte, arrives for Mason, taking everyone by surprise - and making Maddie wonder: Who is the mysterious Charlotte?

SP_PigPet2025_TA1_Dialogue_01.value: I owe you BIG time for this, Maddie.

SP_PigPet2025_TA1_Dialogue_02.value: Don't worry about it. I'm happy to help!

SP_PigPet2025_TA1_Dialogue_03.value: And that pig is just too cute.

SP_PigPet2025_TA1_Dialogue_04.value: What will Ursula say when she finds out?

SP_PigPet2025_TA1_Dialogue_05.value: She's used to this by now!

SP_PigPet2025_TA1_Dialogue_06.value: What are you going to name him, Mason?

SP_PigPet2025_TA1_Dialogue_07.value: There's only one name you can give to a pig this cute.

SP_PigPet2025_TA2_Dialogue_01.value: Listen, I was just wondering... Where does Charlotte work?

SP_PigPet2025_TA2_Dialogue_02.value: She must be super busy - I mean, I've never met her, and I've known you forever.

SP_PigPet2025_TA2_Dialogue_03.value: It's classified and REALLY important, so we can't talk about it at all. To anyone.

SP_PigPet2025_TA2_Dialogue_06.value: He's right - Charlotte works for the government, but her position and work are classified.

SP_PigPet2025_TA2_Dialogue_07.value: And we're NOT supposed to talk about it!

SP_PigPet2025_TA2_Dialogue_08.value: I promise I won't tell a soul!

SP_RaccoonPet2025_AllRewardsCompleted_Di.value: Your Grandma just posted a photo of a raccoon. Do you have a new pet?
That's Patches! He came here as a stowaway among the circus crates, but he's done traveling.
I built him a home on the Mansion grounds, and it seems like he's really happy with it.
Like you've just uncovered something bad. Is it about the rumors someone is spreading about Grandma?
They're getting worse, Maddie. The theories people are throwing around are crazy!
Ursula and the Mansion are getting a lot of unwanted attention.
I'm afraid it'll only be a question of time before someone shows up here up to no good.

SP_RaccoonPet2025_End_Popup_Content_NoRe.value: [PLACEHOLDER] What is Grandma hiding - and are her cat videos actually any good? So many questions...
Patches found a home, but who could resist such a cute little face?
Patches found a home, but who could resist such a cute little face?

SP_RaccoonPet2025_IntroCutscene_Dialogue.value: Have you noticed things going missing recently? I could swear I left my favorite teacup on the porch...
And someone stole a whole bag of potato chips from the kitchen window!
A bunch of stuff the circus sent ahead also disappeared. I've also been hearing some weird noise outside at night.
I was starting to get worried, so I installed a doorbell camera at your front door.
Good thinking, dearie! Let's see what it has recorded.
A raccoon! He must have come here with the circus equipment.
I knew that circus would bring trouble...
Look how cute he is! Poor thing has no home, he has to steal food to get by...
What? I didn't even say anything!

SP_RaccoonPet2025_LastCollectibleItemDis.value: Thanks for helping me with the boxes and crates. When I let the circus set up at the Mansion, I didn't realize how much stuff they would have.
I hear you. There's a whole box full of red clown noses over there!
You never know when you need one!
By the way, I think you're right about Grandma and her smartphone.
I overheard her talking about someone causing problems online. Someone she's trying to stop.
That's a great clue, Maddie! I'll do some more digging online - and you keep your eyes and ears open.

SP_RaccoonPet2025_PetInfoDescription.value: The circus raccoon with sticky fingers.

SP_RaccoonPet2025_PetUnlockCutscene_Dial.value: What is that rustling sound? I bet it's that raccoon!
Hello, little guy! Don't be afraid, I'm not going to hurt you.
You're kinda cute, but you need to stop stealing stuff.
Grandma's not too happy about you creeping around. You took her favorite teacup!
Awwww, don't worry - she'll warm up to you, I know it!
What is your story anyway? Maybe the ringmaster knows where you came from.

SP_RaccoonPet2025_PetUnlock_Description.value: You've just unlocked a brand new friend!

SP_RaccoonPet2025_Start_Popup_Desc.value: Are there thieves at the Mansion? Someone has been stealing things - leaving Grandma and Maddie confused - and the culprit will surprise everyone.

SP_RaccoonPet2025_TA1_Dialogue_01.value: When are you getting rid of that raccoon?

SP_RaccoonPet2025_TA1_Dialogue_04.value: The ringmaster told me. I called her, and she told me that Patches has been traveling with the circus for a good while now.

SP_RaccoonPet2025_TA1_Dialogue_05.value: He loves show business, but he's getting old.

SP_RaccoonPet2025_TA1_Dialogue_07.value: I could easily build a little home for him.

SP_RaccoonPet2025_TA1_Dialogue_08.value: I see you have already done it. Maddie dear, I really feel that inviting a raccoon to...

SP_RaccoonPet2025_TA1_Dialogue_11.value: Ohhh... fine! But no more stealing!

SP_RaccoonPet2025_TA2_Dialogue_01.value: What do you think, Patches? Does this meet your exacting standards?

SP_RaccoonPet2025_TA2_Dialogue_03.value: I'm glad to hear it! It was a really fun little project.

SP_RaccoonPet2025_TA2_Dialogue_04.value: I can't stop thinking about Grandma and whatever she's doing online.

SP_RaccoonPet2025_TA2_Dialogue_07.value: Yep. I should talk to her, just ask her straight.

SP_RaccoonPet2025_TA2_Dialogue_08.value: But what if she dodges my questions like she always does?

SP_RaccoonPet2025_TA2_Dialogue_10.value: True - I have to ask at least.

SP_RaccoonPet2025_TA2_Dialogue_11.value: Thanks, Patches! You're a great listener.

SP_Ringmaster2025_AllRewardsCompleted_Di.value: I am very proud of you, Maddie. You were placed in a difficult situation but you did not choke.
Thanks, Grandma. That means a lot.
Some months ago I discovered that there is a member of our family who is in fact not a true Boulton.
You will find out soon enough. You can imagine that this information has made some people very angry.
I have been trying to confirm their identity, and I think I have done it.
Grandma, that sounds really serious. Is there anything I can do?
Just leave it to me for now. All you need to know is that I have taken care of everything.

SP_Ringmaster2025_Decoration_Slot33_Dial.value: Why did the ringmaster say that you would know how to put on a circus show?
Fine... once upon a time, a very long time ago, I toured as a member of the troupe.
I did a couple of different things...
So will you be able to help me put on a show?
I suppose I can try. But we will need more performers.
I'll get you performers. Thank you, Grandma!

SP_Ringmaster2025_Decoration_Slot34_Dial.value: Nothing much. What's up? You seem...
No! I desperately need your help.
Everything is set up for the circus, but the performers are stuck!
That is a pickle! But what can I do?
How would you feel about... performing? You could be a human cannon ball, or maybe do some tricks on the trapeze?
I g-guess I could try the cannon?
Great, I owe you one! Now we just need a magician...

SP_Ringmaster2025_Decoration_Slot35_Dial.value: Did you manage to recruit some performers?
Yep, and everyone is ready for practice. But...
I happened to look over Roddy's shoulder while he was on his phone, and...
I couldn't believe what some people are saying about you. They're attacking you with really wild accusations.
You know how people like to talk.
Please, Grandma! You need to tell me what you've been doing online. I know it's more than just cat videos.
I suppose you need to know the truth. I promise I will tell you when this circus business is over.

SP_Ringmaster2025_Decoration_Slot36_Dial.value: As ready as I'll ever be. I'm just a little distracted...
Grandma promised to tell me the truth about her online escapades after the show.
You know, I've been following it all for a while, and it seems that one person in particular keeps trolling her.
The accounts are all different, but the MO is always the same.
I don't know, but it almost seems personal.

SP_Ringmaster2025_Decoration_Slot37_Dial.value: We did it! I can't believe we actually put on a circus performance.
Thank god Ursula was there. She was the only one who knew what she was doing.
Where did she learn all those knife tricks??
Who knows! How are you feeling?
A little wobbly, but oh man! What a feeling!
There's no business like show business!

SP_Ringmaster2025_End_Popup_Content_NoRe.value: A shocking revelation finally sheds light on Grandma's mysterious activities!

SP_Ringmaster2025_Intro_Dialogue_03.value: This is Fiona DuVall, ringmaster of the circus.
This is Fiona DuVal, ringmaster of the circus.

SP_Ringmaster2025_Intro_Dialogue_04.value: I'm calling to thank you for all of your help... and to let you know that unfortunately there is a TEENY problem.

SP_Ringmaster2025_Intro_Dialogue_05.value: Phew, at least it's not a BIG problem.

SP_Ringmaster2025_Intro_Dialogue_07.value: To cut a long story short, we won't be able to make it in time for the big show.

SP_Ringmaster2025_Intro_Dialogue_09.value: You wouldn't be able to stand in for us somehow, would you?

SP_Ringmaster2025_Intro_Dialogue_10.value: I know I'm asking for a lot, but I'm quite desperate.

SP_Ringmaster2025_Intro_Dialogue_11.value: But I haven't got the first idea about putting on a circus show!

SP_Ringmaster2025_LastCollectibleItemDis.value: Grandma! We have a serious situation!
Are you sure? Last time you said that there was a spider in the bathroom - and not a very big one either.
No, this is for real. The circus troupe is having some trouble on the road.
They won't be able to make here in time to perform, so we have to put on a show.
Hmm... That IS a big problem.
The circus ringmaster, Fiona DuVall, said that you would be able to help.
The circus ringmaster, Fiona DuVal, said that you would be able to help.

SP_Ringmaster2025_Start_Popup_Desc.value: A phone call from the ringmaster of the circus sends Maddie and her friends on a frenzy and spills an old secret - but the show must go on!

SP_RoboPet2026_AllRewardsCompleted_Dialo.value: Wow! Calm down, what is it?
*huh huh huh* Let me catch my breath a sec...
We did it! WE WON THE FAIR!
I'm so proud of you! Both of you!
I know right? He can't stop doing that after we won! But guess what?!
I was picked to go on a robotics showcasing tour visit all the cool tech companies! It's all around the country!
But... I can't take Gizmo with me. Will... You take care of him?
Of course, kiddo. Gizmo will be safe with me!

SP_RoboPet2026_End_Popup_Content_NoRewar.value: And as Mason sets off on his Robotics Grand Tour, the little robot stays happily behind with Maddie to tend to the mansion.

SP_RoboPet2026_Intro_Dialogue_02.value: Oh boy, am I! It's our school science fair this month!

SP_RoboPet2026_Intro_Dialogue_03.value: Cool! I didn't know you were interested in science?

SP_RoboPet2026_Intro_Dialogue_04.value: Well... Not so much science as Science-Fiction!

SP_RoboPet2026_Intro_Dialogue_06.value: That's cool! Need any help? I'm an engineer after all?

SP_RoboPet2026_Intro_Dialogue_08.value: Of course! Let's build you a robot!

SP_RoboPet2026_LastCollectibleItemDiscov.value: And done... What do you think?
And you're saying this little battery will have enough juice to power it?
What about its power lifting? The plasma blasters and turbo smashers?!
Ha! While those would be awesome, how about we turn it on first?

SP_RoboPet2026_TA1_Dialogue_02.value: What if he doesn't turn on?!

SP_RoboPet2026_TA1_Dialogue_03.value: Then we work the problem and try again, right?

SP_RoboPet2026_TA1_Dialogue_11.value: Well, what shall we call him?

SP_RoboPet2026_TA2_Dialogue_02.value: Great! He's actually been a real help around the mansion, lately.

SP_RoboPet2026_TA2_Dialogue_03.value: Although, he gets a bit eager sometimes. I caught him going around in circles, trying to sweep up his own tracks.

SP_RoboPet2026_TA2_Dialogue_06.value: No no! Quite the opposite! He's very... meticulous.

SP_RoboPet2026_TA3_Dialogue_02.value: What's wrong? Did something happen to Gizmo?

SP_RoboPet2026_TA3_Dialogue_03.value: Oh no, no... It's just that... He's so cute and all.

SP_RoboPet2026_TA3_Dialogue_04.value: I just don't know if he's sciency enough for the science fair!

SP_RoboPet2026_TA3_Dialogue_06.value: Sure he is! He's a general intelligent zone operator.

SP_RoboPet2026_TA3_Dialogue_09.value: Thanks Maddie! I'll use that for my presentation!

SP_RoddysMystery2023_AllRewardsCompleted.value: I'm sorry Roddy. All I wanted to do was bring a little fun to your summer camp...
Fun?! You scared me half to death!
Well, I wasn't expecting you to have a crippling fear of ghosts!
I guess I wanted to keep that secret. It's a bit embarrassing.
How about you, Mason, dearie? Did you have fun?
BEST. SUMMER CAMP. EVER!!! It had everything: camping, marshmallows, GHOSTS!

SP_RoddysMystery2023_Decoration_Slot25_D.value: While you play, enjoy a snack at the wilderness table!
Oh, hi Maddie! Come to check out "Camp Wilderness"?
Actually, yes! I heard you were running summer camp here this summer, and I didn't quite believe it.
Yeah, I usually run summer camp out of state, but some kids couldn't make it this year.
So I thought, Why not bring summer camp home? So I uhh.. So I did! Your grandma was very generous to let me use her yard!
Really? I wasn't trying to impress you or-
Ha ha! It's a compliment, Roddy!

SP_RoddysMystery2023_Decoration_Slot26_D.value: Go with the flow and paddle a canoe!
Do you want to go canoeing, Mason?
Unless there's some old cursed ghost out at sea, waiting to pull us into the dark depths of the abyss!
Gosh, I hope not! I was thinking more about seeing the wildlife and taking in the Bay view!
Oh, uhm.. We needed space for the canoe and... I asked the kids to move them!

SP_RoddysMystery2023_Decoration_Slot27_D.value: After a long day of adventure, enjoy a few roasted marshmallows by the fire...
Yeah... I guess it's alright. I haven't seen any ghosts yet, though.
Oh, well, how about I tell you a spooky campfire story?
Okay... Not so long ago, around these parts liv- wait... Did you see that?!

SP_RoddysMystery2023_Decoration_Slot28_D.value: Don't forget to do target practice! Just not when people are at the table.
C'mon Roddy! In order to catch a ghost, we need to improve our aim!
I... I don't know about this Mason. Who is that ghost, and why are they h-haunting ME?!
Restless spirits care not for the will of the living! We must be prepared!

SP_RoddysMystery2023_Decoration_Slot29_D.value: Climb up and into Fort Wilderness, no adults allowed!
From what I've read, ghosts LOVE the attic! So if we climb in from both sides, I'm sure we can catch it!
Catch it?! No! I want it out of here!
Mrs. Boulton! wh- What are you doing here?
I'm sorry, dearie, I believe my joke has gone a little too far!

SP_RoddysMystery2023_End_Popup_Content_N.value: Roddy's summer camp was a spooky success!

SP_RoddysMystery2023_Intro_Dialogue_01.value: Thanks again for letting me run summer camp at your cottage, Mrs. Boulton.

SP_RoddysMystery2023_Intro_Dialogue_02.value: Not a problem, dearie! I think it's really important that our younger generation still learns wilderness skills!

SP_RoddysMystery2023_Intro_Dialogue_03.value: I couldn't agree more! Ah! Here comes our newest camper!

SP_RoddysMystery2023_Intro_Dialogue_06.value: Cheer up, Mason! I promise, you'll be having so much fun that by the time it ends, you won't want to leave!

SP_RoddysMystery2023_Intro_Dialogue_08.value: Huh... I wonder what's gotten him so down?

SP_RoddysMystery2023_Intro_Dialogue_09.value: Well, let me know if I can help, dearie.

SP_RoddysMystery2023_LastCollectibleItem.value: Well done, Mason! You've gotten almost all the merit badges!
Although... I don't quite recognize this last one...
Oh that? It's my own design! For ghost hunting!
Gh- Ghosts? What are you talking about?
Don't you know? They say the Mansion is haunted!
And I'm here to catch some ghosts!

SP_RoddysMystery2023_Start_Popup_Desc.value:
What? Summer camp at the Mansion?!
Join Roddy as he teaches everything from tent pitching to marshmallow roasting and ghost stories! However, he soon discovers that one of the ghost stories may be real!

SP_RufusMystery2024_AllRewardsCompleted_.value: Rufus, where on earth have you been??
I looked for you everywhere - even the Old Well!
I missed you SO much! Even Grandma was worried about you.
This place is way too quiet without you!
So, where DID you go? Did you get lost chasing a rabbit or some tasty treat?
Speaking of tasty treats - you're dinner is waiting!
I wonder if Rufus found something while he was on his little adventure...
Sometimes I feel like that dog could tell me all kinds of secrets!

SP_RufusMystery2024_End_Popup_Content_No.value: Welcome, Goldie! Life at the Mansion just got even more interesting.

SP_RufusMystery2024_GoldieIntro1_Dialogu.value: Maddie, there seems to be a strange dog here..
A strange dog? Rufus ran away earlier, but the people from the shelter promised to bring him home.
I think I know what that mischievous furball looks like. This is not him!
What?? It definitely isn't! Hello, you. Where did you come from?

SP_RufusMystery2024_GoldieIntro2_Dialogu.value: Hello? I think you brought me the wrong dog... My dog is black and has a blue collar.
Yes, that's him! So will you come get the one you brought here earlier?
Of course we'll help her! We have plenty of space, and Rufus would love to have a friend...
I know the perfect spot to set up a little house for her, too!

SP_RufusMystery2024_Intro_Dialogue_03.value: Where is that dog?? He's usually never far away when I get his meal ready...

SP_RufusMystery2024_Intro_Dialogue_05.value: Hello? Y-you're calling from the dog shelter?

SP_RufusMystery2024_Intro_Dialogue_06.value: You caught a stray dog? Yes, my dog IS missing!

SP_RufusMystery2024_Intro_Dialogue_07.value: I live at the Boulton Mansion. You can bring him here? Thank you so much!

SP_RufusMystery2024_Intro_Dialogue_08.value: Oh, Rufus... I wonder what made him run away!

SP_RufusMystery2024_LastCollectibleItemD.value: I'm gonna have to talk to Rufus when he comes back. What was he thinking, running away like that?
But I do miss him so much!
I think I'll make him his favorite food when he comes back. He must be so hungry after his little escapade!
I can't wait for him to come home!

SP_RufusMystery2024_LayerDecoration_01_D.value: This little corner of the garden has been empty for far too long!
A comfy bed, some toys, and a little pond for you to splash around in...
And, of course, a couple of balls, so we can play fetch!

SP_RufusMystery2024_LayerDecoration_02_D.value: Ta-da! A dream home for a brand-new family member!
I think you'll be very happy here with us.

SP_RufusMystery2024_PetHomeTA2_Descripti.value: The perfect home for a four-legged friend!

SP_RufusMystery2024_PetUnlock_Descriptio.value: You've just unlocked a brand-new friend!

SP_RufusMystery2024_Pet_Not_Owned_Descri.value: [PlaceHolder] Unlock your Pet through the Mystery Pass

SP_RufusMystery2024_Start_Popup_Desc.value: A story in the newspaper sets Maddie and Rufus on an unexpected mission - to make a new friend!

SP_RumorsRing2025_AllRewardsCompleted_Di.value: I know Grandma hates eavesdropping, but desperate times call for desperate measures.
What are these comments under my last cat video?
I thought I already took care of this...
Ugh! This is going to take more work than I originally thought.
I won't let her keep going. She is too unpredictable. And she can't find out I'm onto her...
Oh, I hope my pie is not burning!
Jackie was right - there IS something going on.
But who was Grandma talking about?
So many questions, so few answers...

SP_RumorsRing2025_Deco_25_Dialogue_01.value: A big truck just dropped off a whole shipment of big crates on my front lawn!

SP_RumorsRing2025_Deco_25_Dialogue_02.value: Did you happen to order a dozen colorful wigs, trapezes and a knife wheel?

SP_RumorsRing2025_Deco_25_Dialogue_03.value: It has to be the circus equipment!

SP_RumorsRing2025_Deco_25_Dialogue_05.value: I told you the ringmaster of a traveling circus asked if they could set up here at the Mansion, and you said yes.

SP_RumorsRing2025_Deco_25_Dialogue_06.value: I never did such a thing!

SP_RumorsRing2025_Deco_25_Dialogue_07.value: You did. Remember you were checking the insurance prices, and I asked...

SP_RumorsRing2025_Deco_25_Dialogue_09.value: They have nowhere else to go, and the ringmaster seemed to know you!

SP_RumorsRing2025_Deco_25_Dialogue_10.value: Besides, who doesn't love the circus!

SP_RumorsRing2025_Deco_26_Dialogue_01.value: What's all this?? Are you putting on a circus?

SP_RumorsRing2025_Deco_26_Dialogue_04.value: The Mansion is hosting the touring circus, and we've just accepted the first shipment of equipment.

SP_RumorsRing2025_Deco_26_Dialogue_05.value: What does Ursula think about it?

SP_RumorsRing2025_Deco_26_Dialogue_06.value: She's so into her cat videos and knitting tutorials that she barely paid attention when I told her.

SP_RumorsRing2025_Deco_26_Dialogue_08.value: Yep. I don't know what to do! It's like living with a phone-addicted teenager.

SP_RumorsRing2025_Deco_27_Dialogue_01.value: It's time to get all this circus stuff organized.

SP_RumorsRing2025_Deco_27_Dialogue_02.value: More ropes, juggling balls and posters!

SP_RumorsRing2025_Deco_27_Dialogue_03.value: I can't even imagine what it would be like to travel around the country performing wild tricks and wowing audiences everywhere.

SP_RumorsRing2025_Deco_27_Dialogue_04.value: I love all of it - the fire-eaters, acrobats, magic tricks and knife wheels...

SP_RumorsRing2025_Deco_27_Dialogue_05.value: If only I could do anything like that, but I'm not a big fan of heights - or fire.

SP_RumorsRing2025_Deco_27_Dialogue_06.value: It's probably best to leave it to the professionals.

SP_RumorsRing2025_Deco_28_Dialogue_01.value: I've got most of the circus stuff in order, and I've set up a little fun fair next to Grandma's house like the ringmaster asked.

SP_RumorsRing2025_Deco_28_Dialogue_02.value: I can't wait for the big top to go up!

SP_RumorsRing2025_Deco_28_Dialogue_03.value: It's been so busy around here with everything and Grandma is no help at all!

SP_RumorsRing2025_Deco_28_Dialogue_06.value: This whole business with the smartphone seemed kinda sketchy, so I did some online research.

SP_RumorsRing2025_Deco_28_Dialogue_09.value: Well, there's a whole bunch of people spreading weird rumors about Ursula.

SP_RumorsRing2025_Deco_28_Dialogue_10.value: Someone said she used to be a member of this very circus!

SP_RumorsRing2025_Deco_29_Dialogue_01.value: Could Jackie be onto something with Grandma and her phone?

SP_RumorsRing2025_Deco_29_Dialogue_02.value: I mean, it's obvious she is up to something. She panicked when she thought she'd lost her phone.

SP_RumorsRing2025_Deco_29_Dialogue_03.value: And I think she has multiple accounts on social media. But why?

SP_RumorsRing2025_Deco_29_Dialogue_04.value: Either she's doing something sketchy like Jackie suspects, or she is covering up something in order to protect me and the Mansion.

SP_RumorsRing2025_Deco_29_Dialogue_05.value: Jackie is always so suspicious - she's so determined to get to the bottom of Grandma's secrets...

SP_RumorsRing2025_End_Popup_Content_NoRe.value: Eavesdropping is wrong, but Maddie is finally finding out that Grandma is up to her old tricks!

SP_RumorsRing2025_Intro_Dialogue_01.value: Deb, you'll never guess what the mailman just dropped off!

SP_RumorsRing2025_Intro_Dialogue_02.value: Nothing exciting ever lands in our mailbox, but this time there was something pretty cool among the bills and the letters from the city council!

SP_RumorsRing2025_Intro_Dialogue_04.value: A letter from a traveling circus! They are coming to Hopewell Bay.

SP_RumorsRing2025_Intro_Dialogue_06.value: Apparently they were supposed to set up in the park downtown, but some official regulation forbids it.

SP_RumorsRing2025_Intro_Dialogue_07.value: Their plans are already made and it would be impossible for them to skip Hopewell Bay, so they need a new location - and fast.

SP_RumorsRing2025_Intro_Dialogue_08.value: We have plenty of space, and it would be so cool to have the circus here - at the Mansion!

SP_RumorsRing2025_Intro_Dialogue_09.value: I thought you would say that. You should check this with Ursula, my dear. She might... have some objections.

SP_RumorsRing2025_LastCollectibleItemDis.value: Hey, Grandma. What's so interesting on your phone?
W-what? Oh, just comparing insurance prices, dearie.
You can save a lot of money with a good deal.
That sure sounds fascinating! Anyway, I just got a letter...
M-mm... Extra liability coverage against property damage...
It's nothing big... You wouldn't mind if a circus set up in front of the Mansion, would you?
Uh-huh...  And I would get cyber insurance, too... Interesting...
Yes, yes. Sounds great, dearie. Now let me do this.

SP_SplashMystery2025_AllRewardsCompleted.value: Mason's party was excellent. It was nice to see you and Bella work together to bring it all together.
I know she can be a handful. She's always had trouble making friends with other girls, and she can seem...
Yes, but it only masks her crippling insecurity.
Give her a chance. Underneath all the other stuff, she's great really, I promise.
I'll do my best, I promise.

SP_SplashMystery2025_Decoration_Slot33_D.value: Hello, Mason! I heard your birthday is coming up soon.
You know... I'm a pretty awesome party planner myself and I'd love to help your mom put together something cool.
What would you really love to have at your party?
Well, if a wave machine is too much...
...then I would love to have some pool chairs for chilling out.

SP_SplashMystery2025_Decoration_Slot34_D.value: So, your birthday is soon, isn't it?
It sure is, and I have a feeling it's gonna be epic.
Is there something you'd really like to make it even more epic?
Bella just asked me the exact same thing.
Yeah. She wanted to help my mom with the party.
I bet I could do something EVEN better than her!

SP_SplashMystery2025_Decoration_Slot35_D.value: I can't believe Bella's trying to outdo me with this party! She doesn't even like Mason!
She's just trying to make herself look good in front of Emilio, but if she thinks she's winning, she can think again.

SP_SplashMystery2025_Decoration_Slot36_D.value: Are you ready to see your party?
You can bet your pool floaties I am!
Ta-da! What do you think? Maddie and Bella both helped me put everything together.
And two cakes?? This is the best birthday EVER!
Very impressive! Bella and Maddie, you have been incredibly selfless, helping Pearl with Mason's party.
This party is better than I could've imagined. Thank you, both. You rock!

SP_SplashMystery2025_Decoration_Slot37_D.value: What do you think you're doing?
What do you mean? I was just helping my friend organize a birthday party for her son.

SP_SplashMystery2025_End_Popup_Content_N.value: Mason got the birthday party of his dreams, but where will Bella and Maddie's rivalry lead?

SP_SplashMystery2025_Intro_Dialogue_01.value: Do you know what day is almost here?

SP_SplashMystery2025_Intro_Dialogue_06.value: My mom promised me a pool party with floaties and lemonade in coconut shells with little umbrellas and--- Aah, I can't wait!

SP_SplashMystery2025_Intro_Dialogue_07.value: Sounds very exciting - especially the coconuts. Did you know that they're not actually nuts?

SP_SplashMystery2025_Intro_Dialogue_08.value: I didn't, and I'm sure you want to tell me more, but right now I would like to concentrate on my party.

SP_SplashMystery2025_Intro_Dialogue_09.value: I understand. I'll tell you all about coconuts afterward!

SP_SplashMystery2025_LastCollectibleItem.value: What have you got planned for Mason's big party?
Pfft, you know what he's like.
He wants a pool party with all the trimmings, but I'm not sure I can deliver all of that.
I'm afraid he'll have to settle for some coconut drinks and a big cake.
I would love to help you set up the party of his dreams.
Are you serious? That would be amazing.
Of course! He's such a great kid. He deserves it!
Mason's dream birthday party, huh? I bet I can make it even bigger and better.
Maddie will have to admit that I am more fun!

SP_SplashMystery2025_Start_Popup_Desc.value: Mason's approaching birthday sparks a fierce competition between Maddie and Bella - but who will create the best surprise for Mason?

SP_SpringCleaning2026_AllRewardsComplete.value: Almost like it's always been this way...
Again?! I just spent the whole day digging up an old path!
Change is good for the soul, dearie!
Yeah, but not for the back!

SP_SpringCleaning2026_Decoration_Slot25_.value: Thank you, dearie. I'm sure you didn't mind the yellow!
I'm actually still thinking why we need shovels?

SP_SpringCleaning2026_Decoration_Slot27_.value: Wow! I had no idea this was buried under the ground!
You'd be surprised what you can dig up around these parts!
At least now I know what we needed the shovels for!

SP_SpringCleaning2026_Decoration_Slot28_.value: Tell me again, why these statues were buried?
To give them that authentic patina, dearie.
Then why am I breaking a sweat trying to get it off with a toothbrush?
I didn't say it was a good idea...

SP_SpringCleaning2026_Decoration_Slot29_.value: A greenhouse on the roof! That's pretty smart, Grandma.
I figured it would be the best place to catch the sun.
And it has a great view!

SP_SpringCleaning2026_End_Popup_Content_.value: The garden is renewed, the paths are clear, and everything is ready to grow again. Just the way Grandma likes it.

SP_SpringCleaning2026_Intro_Dialogue_03.value: Yes it is, dearie! Time for a spring-cleaning I think.

SP_SpringCleaning2026_Intro_Dialogue_04.value: Looks like you have something in mind?

SP_SpringCleaning2026_LastCollectibleIte.value: I love the snow globe! Ooh, and the lantern too!
Why thank you, dearie! You use what you have.

SP_SpringCleaning2026_Start_Popup_Desc.value: Maddie and Grandma are getting the grounds ready for the warmer days ahead! Clearing old paths, planting fresh greenery, and uncovering a few surprises along the way.

SP_SpringSeason2023_Decoration_25_Descri.value: A perfect spot for a perfect breeze.

SP_SpringSeason2023_Decoration_25_Dialog.value: These kites are really beautiful and creative!
Is that a pie?! Who knew pies could fly?
Actually, a pie tin was used to make the first-
Roddy!? RODDY!? Are you hiding from me again? We need to work on this kite!
Oh no, she found me! You've got to help me... She's crazy! I've drawn up four different schematics already!
Oh, come on Roddy, give her a chance! I'm sure you two will get along eventually?
There you are! Roddy, we need to work together! Nothing will get done if you stroll about in the yard!

SP_SpringSeason2023_Decoration_26_Descri.value: When you just want to relax and let the breeze take you away.

SP_SpringSeason2023_Decoration_26_Dialog.value: I think the length of the tail should be longer.
Wouldn't be realistic, what if we make the supports wider?
Aaaw, look at you two getting along!
Yep. I'm actually building the kite for the both of them. They refuse to talk to each other.
At least that's something they have in common...

SP_SpringSeason2023_Decoration_27_Descri.value: You can tie a string to a chair and it would fly here!

SP_SpringSeason2023_Decoration_27_Dialog.value: Heey, I remember this guy, Hopeberry Juice Man! This festival sure brings back some memories!
That it does! Did you know that the Kite Festival goes all the way back to the foundation of Hopewell Bay?
Yesiree. Benjamin Franklin himself would often visit the festival!
That's what they say. Ha! That's how he got his idea for the kite expirement!
Oh come on, Julius. You expect me to believe that?!

SP_SpringSeason2023_Decoration_28_Descri.value: Who said flying a kite requires standing?

SP_SpringSeason2023_Decoration_28_Dialog.value: Nothing quite like sitting down and flying a kite!
I wouldn't count tying the kite to the porch as flying it, Grandma...
But it is a great way to air the rug!
Wait... Is that the porch rug flying up there?!

SP_SpringSeason2023_Decoration_29_Descri.value: High flying, high perfomance kites only.

SP_SpringSeason2023_Decoration_29_Dialog.value: Wow Aunt Deb... That's not ostentatious at all!
No, of course not! No no no... No.
Great! Send my love to your Grandma, Tataa!
I wonder what she'll think when sees that flying over her bedroom...
Jackie! How's the kite coming along?

SP_SpringSeason2023_EndOfChainDialogue_0.value: Wow, Grandma! Our kite is beautiful!
Are you sure you needed my help? You know an awful lot about kite making!
Honestly dearie, you've been so busy fixing up the Mansion, I thought it would be nice to do something else for a while!
Yes it was! ...But you didn't answer my question.
Making a kite and baking a pie are surprisingly similar, dearie...

SP_SpringSeason2023_End_Popup_Content_No.value:
What an uplifting Kite Festival! Grandma is thrilled with how everything turned out.

Watch out for more fun events, coming soon!

SP_SpringSeason2023_EventEndDialogue_03.value: It's his fault! He kept going on about structural integrity this, aerodynamics that...

SP_SpringSeason2023_EventEndDialogue_04.value: She wanted to make a kite that looked like a pig!

SP_SpringSeason2023_EventEndDialogue_05.value: Yes! "When pigs fly..." Don't you get it?!

SP_SpringSeason2023_EventEndDialogue_08.value: Cheer up, you two. At least you won first place in the Kids Favorite category!

SP_SpringSeason2023_EventEndDialogue_09.value: I was sort of hoping to win something else instead...

SP_SpringSeason2023_EventOpeningDialogue.value: Not only a festival, dear but remember, a competition as well! I'm sure we'll win it this year, you'll see!
Would make for a nice story too!
Roddy! You're here for the kite festival as well?
Yeah! I- Uuh... I was thinking we could team up?
Actually, I was thinking WE could team up!
Oh no! I'm sorry, but I already promised to help Grandma!
Oh, it's alright dear, I'm sure I can handle this alone. Why don't you and Roddy-
Heeeey! I got a great idea! Why don't YOU TWO team up?!
I'm sure you have a lot in common and would make a great kite together!
Are you kidding?! He can barely build a house, let alone a kite!
They look cute together, don't you think Grandma?
Sometimes, I think you need thicker glasses than me, sweetie...

SP_SpringSeason2023_Start_Popup_Desc.value: You are cordially invited to the annual Hopewell Bay Kite Festival! Fill the skies with beautiful kites and help Maddie win first prize!

SP_StrayBonesMystery2024_AllRewardsCompl.value: What's that Goldie's got in her mouth?
Looks like a big juicy bone.

SP_StrayBonesMystery2024_End_Popup_Conte.value: Will Goldie dig up more of Grandma's secrets?

SP_StrayBonesMystery2024_GoldieIntro1_Cu.value: They must have made a mistake at the animal shelter! I think I need to give them a call...
Hello? I think you brought me the wrong dog... My dog is black and has a blue collar.
Yes, that's him, the rascal! Could you maybe... Oh, you'll bring him here?
And you'll pick up the one you brought me earlier? See, we already have one dog, and...
A photo? Is it in the paperwork you dropped off with her?
So your name is Goldie. And you love to dig holes!
It says here you've been alone for a while...
Was she really wandering on the streets all alone? Poor doggie...
I GUESS we can keep her...
And I think I know a great spot in the garden for a new dog home...
Oh... okay! Goldie, you just found your forever home!

SP_StrayBonesMystery2024_Intro_Cutscene_.value: What in the world is that noise?
I am sure I saw a dog out here... a big one, too!
I hope it was not lost, poor pooch.
There is nothing here, though. I guess I'm getting old!
I'd better get back inside before my pie burns to a crisp!

SP_StrayBonesMystery2024_LastCollectible.value: Have you seen Rufus?? It's his dinnertime, but there's no trace of him!
I am sure he is just feeling guilty. He has been digging up my flowerbeds!
Hello? Y-you're calling from the animal shelter?
You caught a stray dog? Yes, my dog IS missing!
I live at Beaumont Hall. You can bring him here? Thank you so much!
Oh, Rufus... I wonder what made him run away!

SP_StrayBonesMystery2024_LayerDecoration.value: You got another dog!?
Rufus disappeared, and there was a mix-up with animal control... So they brought me the wrong dog!
And you didn't have the heart to send her back?
Well... no.
Do you know where she came from?
No... Only that she's been alone for a while.
She seems like a really sweet dog, and we have plenty of space.
That's for sure!
Roddy told me you got a new pet, so I had to come see if for myself - I looove dogs!
News travels fast, huh? Meet Goldie!
*Wooof!*
Hey, Goldie! You get ready for some serious scritches!
She's been a good distraction, for sure. I just...
What?
I can't stop thinking about ALL the strange stuff that's been going on...
You mean Hank's disappearance?
Well, first we found out that he was hiding something from Deb. Then he went missing right after their wedding!
Cherry needed a whole bunch of meat for the record-breaking pie...
And your Grandma just happened to have it.
Exactly. It all just seems kinda... fishy

SP_StrayBonesMystery2024_PetHomeTA2_Desc.value: A forever home with all the frills.

SP_StrayBonesMystery2024_PetInfoDescript.value: Meet Goldie, the curious Golden Retriever!

SP_StrayBonesMystery2024_PetUnlock_Descr.value: You've just unlocked a brand new friend!

SP_StrayBonesMystery2024_PetUnlock_Heade.value: Meet Goldie, the curious Golden Retriever!

SP_StrayBonesMystery2024_PremiumRewardMa.value: The perfect home for your new pet!

SP_StrayBonesMystery2024_Start_Popup_Des.value: When Rufus goes off on a misadventure, Maddie makes a new furry friend - who happens to love digging holes!

SP_Taikai2026_AllRewardsCompleted_Dialog.value: I’m really happy for you, Grandma!
To go back and make amends is a really nice thing you did.
I should have done it a long time ago, dearie.
Now... how about a game of Go?
Okay... but I warn you! I’ve been practicing while you were away!
That’s good, dearie. I’m always up for a challenge!

SP_Taikai2026_Decoration_Slot33_Dialogue.value: Wow! You made this rock garden?
Yes, I needed somewhere for my thoughts to settle.
Those lines... They’re so gentle, deliberate. Yet...
Hmm... Like I’m trying to be.

SP_Taikai2026_Decoration_Slot34_Dialogue.value: It’s called a shihi-odoshi. It fills, it tips, it knocks.
It is... originally meant to scare away deer. Sakura’s family had one in their garden.
I made it to remind me of them.
Are you going to tell me what happened in Japan?

SP_Taikai2026_Decoration_Slot35_Dialogue.value: I love the sound of running water!
Wow! This is really impressive! Another memory from Japan?
Why yes, dearie! Sakura and I used to play Go next to a small waterfall just like this one.
Okay, I admit it is very soothing!

SP_Taikai2026_Decoration_Slot36_Dialogue.value: So... care to tell me what happened?
Alright, dearie. I went back and met Sakura.
We spoke about what had happened so many years ago.
Not at all! In fact, she was thrilled to see me again.
She’s a 9-dan Go player now! One of the best.
Oh! I guess you didn’t need to play against her again, then!
Oh, we played. It was a challenge after all.

SP_Taikai2026_Decoration_Slot37_Dialogue.value: We had our match. In a room much like this one!
By the waterfall we had played at so many years ago.
She had only one request. I wouldn’t hold back. And I didn’t.
She did! I had no chance.
You seem to be taking it well.
Dearie, I was so happy! I had my old friend back after all these years!
We laughed about it afterwards. There was no resentment. There never was.
All she wanted was a rematch. And I had foolishly run away.
We’ve promised to keep in touch! And play Go online!

SP_Taikai2026_End_Popup_Content_NoReward.value: Maddie lets the last of Grandma’s story settle in, seeing her in a new light. Then they set out the Go board and play a quiet, friendly game together, trading small smiles over thoughtful moves.

SP_Taikai2026_Intro_Dialogue_03.value: Well?! How did it go?! You look... lighter.

SP_Taikai2026_LastCollectibleItemDiscove.value: A bamboo spoon, whisk, cup, and teapot...
This looks like a tea set.
It is, dearie. From my time in Japan.
From my... first time in Japan.
Nice. Why haven’t I seen it before?
Because now I brought it back with me.

SP_Taikai2026_Start_Popup_Desc.value: Grandma returns with a calm that feels earned and with memories of her time in Japan. One question still presses on Maddie: when the long-awaited rematch was finally played at full strength, who won?

SP_TheWindOfMystery2024_AllRewardsComple.value: Maddie! I have grave news for you!
Lady Voyance! What are you doing here?
Maddie, I come with bad tidings! I was doing my usual reading, when I was struck with a VISION!
Yes, I know! I know! I’m packing everything up and heading inside. You’re the third per-
No, Maddie! That’s not the storm I’m talking about!

SP_TheWindOfMystery2024_Decoration_Slot3.value: A nice, little white picket fence.
Getting ready for the pleasant weather, dearie?
Yup! I’m gonna make this entire area a veritable relaxation utopia!
Well, don’t get too carried away. I can smell rain in the air...
Maddie! Grandma! Look! I found secret codes in these cans!
Oh, my! Really?
Why would these cans have codes in them? Grandma, do you know anything about them?
Me? Oh dearie, why would I know anything about that? Look at the time; I need to head to my fencing class!
She does that a lot?
All the time...
Carefree Fence
Lay down, rest your legs, and swing away the stress.
Deb! Hank! Nice to see you there!
ZzzzZZzzz...
Hank!
Zzzzzz. What?! I... I wasn’t sleeping, just resting my eyes!
Your turn to hold the baby...
Okay...
I guess you’re both still adjusting to this... change.
No, it’s not that… It’s the “OTHER” child that has been a bit of a problem...
No, it’s not that... It’s the “OTHER” child that has been a bit of a problem...
Yeah... *yawn*, Mason was running around our house, banging cans, and that woke the little legend up.
Oh, Mason...
I guess I knew those cans would get dug up eventually. Especially when they were the reason the Cannery shut down and all.
What?!
What? Oh... That? Never mind, I didn’t say anything. C’mon Hank. I really need to go to sleep...
Happy Hammock
Grow some tasty veggies while you're at it.
Hey, Maddie!
Hi, Roddy! Just in time; you can help me fertilize these tomatoes!
Erm... You’re planting tomatoes... Now? Haven’t you seen the weather?
Yes! The newspaper promised perfect weather!
Er... Maddie, it looks like the storm might change course. There’s a good chance it might hit us!
Oh, don’t be so full of doom and gloom. A few gusts of wind and a bit of rain never hurt anybody.
Seriously, I have a friend at the weather station, and they’re pretty sure things might go south...
Fast.
I’m sure it’ll be fine!
Vegetable Garden
An elegant, yet rustic path to lead you to leisure.
Wow!
Okay... That was a pretty strong gust of wind...
Oh! Hey, Mason! Why do you look so sad?
My mom said I can’t look for treasure anymore because of the storm.
And because I’ve been digging in people’s yards...
Again.
Aaw, I’m sorry to hear that. But hey, why don’t you stay here and help me set up for a nice sunny day?
Naaw... Those clouds look really angry, and I don’t want to get caught out in the rain again.
Bye...
But it won’t rain! The newspaper promised perfect weather!
Rustic Stone Path
You know she needs one...
Ah, great idea, Maddie!
Yeah? I’ve been meaning to get a tool shed for a while too.
Great, I’ll help you gather all the tools and store them inside for safety!
What are you talking about? The storm again? Please, Roddy...
Maddie, I don’t know what’s gotten into you, but you have to listen to me.
The storm is heading right for us! You need to start boarding up your home!
Fine! I’ll get someone who CAN talk some sense into you!
Lovely Little Shed
A comfy spot to relax after an eventful day.
Maddie, dearie! What are you doing?!
I. Am. Enjoying. This. BEAUTIFUL. DAY!
Maddie! Half of this stuff is going to be blown away by the storm!
They’re even saying that there could be flooding!
Flooding?!
Yes! Haven’t you been listening to the news reports? All of Hopewell Bay is shutting down! Mayor’s orders!
Oh... I didn’t know. I was too busy working on this...
Come on, Maddie. We need to start working on boarding up the house!
Cozy Couch Corner

SP_TheWindOfMystery2024_End_Popup_Conten.value: Lady Voyance may be more correct than she knows! Something is coming...

SP_TheWindOfMystery2024_IntroCutscene_Di.value: Let’s see what’s in store for us...
Will you look at that! Perfect weather for the entire-
Maddie! Maddie! You won’t believe what I just found!
NO! It’s amazing! I found all sorts of strange codes and maps inside! I think...
I gotta get my metal detector! There’s an entire landfill of these!
Okay! You go have fun. I’ll just take it easy and enjoy the weather!

SP_TheWindOfMystery2024_LastCollectibleI.value: Delicious! Nothing like having some fresh lemonade and a good book to read.
Why yes, dearie... But don’t you think this wind is starting to get a bit strong?
Just a wonderful summer breeze, Grandma! Enjoy it...
Well, I guess it won’t hurt to rake all these loose leaves away.

The Winds of Mystery have ended!

SP_TheWindOfMystery2024_Start_Popup_Desc.value: A perfect storm is slowly brewing on the horizon and with it, a gust of mystery...
