More fun events coming soon!

SP_Valentines2023_CupidsCove_01.value: Ooh… I could snuggle up here until Xmas!

SP_Valentines2023_CupidsCove_02.value: I must admit Maddie, you’ve really outdone yourself with the decorations.

SP_Valentines2023_CupidsCove_03.value: How about another story from your infamous dating life?

SP_Valentines2023_CupidsCove_04.value: I did meet this feller on a singles site and I was sure he’s the one--

SP_Valentines2023_CupidsCove_05.value: --until I realized he was easily scared.

SP_Valentines2023_CupidsCove_06.value: He wasn’t up for pranks, stayed in during Halloween and hated scary movies.

SP_Valentines2023_CupidsCove_07.value: Naturally, I had to stay away from him.

SP_Valentines2023_CupidsCove_08.value: I think we can cross him out from your list of secret admirers.

SP_Valentines2023_Decoration_Description.value: CAUTION: Love is in the air
Because kissing booth is so last season

SP_Valentines2023_EndOfChainDialogue_01.value: I must say, that’s one of the prettiest bouquets of flowers I’ve ever seen!

SP_Valentines2023_EndOfChainDialogue_02.value: Too bad we have no clue who sent it.

SP_Valentines2023_EndOfChainDialogue_03.value: Well dearie, I’m just happy to know that someone out there admires me.

SP_Valentines2023_EndOfChainDialogue_04.value: C’mon grandma, I know you… I bet you already have cooked up a plan to lure out this feller!

SP_Valentines2023_EndOfChainDialogue_05.value: You’ll just have to wait and see.

SP_Valentines2023_EventEndDialogue_01.value: Ooh, Grandma! Doesn’t this place look like the sweetest–pink–candy floss dream?

SP_Valentines2023_EventEndDialogue_02.value: Hahaha! Seems like you’re fully in the spirit of Valentine’s.

SP_Valentines2023_EventEndDialogue_03.value: Team Cupid all the way! Now, let’s find out who your mystery beau is--

SP_Valentines2023_EventEndDialogue_04.value: --Or we could look into a certain building inspector who clearly has eyes for you.

SP_Valentines2023_EventOpeningDialogue_0.value: What have you got there Grandma?
It’s… a Valentine’s Bouquet! For me!
I haven't had one of these since Charlie was around.
Let's see, the card says: "Lillies for my Lily".
But these are roses, not lilies! How strange!
Who are they from? Grandma, do you have a secret admirer?!
Perhaps a gentleman I went on a date with, and before you ask--
--I’ll dish a story or two if you help me decorate for Valentine’s Day!

SP_Valentines2023_KissingPorch_01.value: I can almost picture it… sharing a good night kiss under the porch after a romantic date.

SP_Valentines2023_KissingPorch_02.value: Brings back memories of all the great times I had with your Grandpa Charlie.

SP_Valentines2023_KissingPorch_03.value: Come to think of it, this is the second time I got a bouquet of flowers with no name.

SP_Valentines2023_KissingPorch_05.value: Maybe… or it might have been Julius. Speak of the devil--

SP_Valentines2023_KissingPorch_06.value: Julius dear, did you send me a Valentine’s bouquet all those years ago?

SP_Valentines2023_KissingPorch_07.value: Deb spilled the beans about a little crush you might have had.

SP_Valentines2023_KissingPorch_08.value: Uh.. well… haha… you sister did have a wild imagination. I must run, ladies!

SP_Valentines2023_PinkHeartTree_01.value: My, this tree looks like it's made of pink candy! How on earth did you pull that off dearie?

SP_Valentines2023_PinkHeartTree_02.value: Inspired by my love for love, Grandma.

SP_Valentines2023_PinkHeartTree_03.value: I think I’ve earned another juicy dating story--

SP_Valentines2023_PinkHeartTree_04.value: Let me have a think… well, Deb once set me up on a blind date.

SP_Valentines2023_PinkHeartTree_05.value: I met him down at the little tea shop in Hopewell Bay and all was going really well--

SP_Valentines2023_PinkHeartTree_07.value: You’d think so. But then he told me the most terrible thing--

SP_Valentines2023_PinkHeartTree_09.value: That he doesn’t like pies, at all. The nerve! That was that.

SP_Valentines2023_RewardMail_Description.value: Thank you for taking part in the event! Your remaining Event Items were automatically collected and we have sent you all of your unclaimed rewards!

SP_Valentines2023_RomanticRooftop_01.value: All set for spotting eligible suitors, I see?

SP_Valentines2023_RomanticRooftop_02.value: Hahaha! We do love how this romantic little watchtower turned out.

SP_Valentines2023_RomanticRooftop_03.value: Maybe now we’ll catch a glimpse of the mysterious flower bouquet sender.

SP_Valentines2023_RomanticRooftop_04.value: Anonymous flower deliveries? Humph! What’s next, chocolate via mail?

SP_Valentines2023_RomanticRooftop_05.value: We hardly talk about the sacrifice of St. Valentine–

SP_Valentines2023_RomanticRooftop_06.value: --In fact, Valentine’s Day goes back to ancient Rome and has a rather dark origin.

SP_Valentines2023_RomanticRooftop_07.value: How fascinating! You’re always full of the most interesting facts, Julius.

SP_Valentines2023_RomanticRooftop_08.value: Wish I could hear more but there’s quite a bit of decorating to do. Bye now.

SP_Valentines2023_Start_Popup_Desc.value:
Roses are red, violets are blue and the flowers Ursula receives for Valentine’s are mysterious. Maddie has her suspicions about the secret admirer, can you guess?
Play the event to find out more about Grandma’s secret romances!

SP_Valentines2023_ValentinesLawn_01.value: Woah Maddie, you seem to be giving Cupid a run for his money!

SP_Valentines2023_ValentinesLawn_02.value: Do you have any grand Valentine’s day plans lined up?

SP_Valentines2023_ValentinesLawn_03.value: To be honest Roddy, I’m way too caught up with Grandma’s secret admirer shenanigans.

SP_Valentines2023_ValentinesLawn_04.value: Really? Maybe a nice dinner out is just what the doctor ordered?

SP_Valentines2023_ValentinesLawn_05.value: I’d be too distracted making plans to track down florists and trail suspicious visitors.

SP_Valentines2023_ValentinesLawn_06.value: How about a heart-shaped box of peanut chocolates to fuel your detective work?

SP_Valentines2023_ValentinesLawn_07.value: That would have been amazing, except for the small fact that I’m allergic to peanuts.

SP_Valentines2023_ValentinesLawn_08.value: Oh? I have to run…uh… Those buildings won't inspect themselves. Good luck with the mystery!

SP_ValentinesMystery2024_AllRewardsCompl.value: Mason?? How much did you spend on all these presents?
Some... but YOU told me to get something "special" for everyone. And I didn't get a sports car or exotic animals!
The thought is lovely, but it's all just WAY too much. We'll have to return them...
But your friendship is enough for us, Mason. It doesn't cost anything, but it's more valuable than any fancy present.
Aww, shucks! Thanks, guys. I guess Valentine's Day doesn't have to be about just yucky love or expensive gifts.
Was that diamond ring actually Hank's? What's he planning??

SP_ValentinesMystery2024_Decoration_Slot.value: Step inside the perfect Valentine's Day!
A Japanese teapot! What amazing craftmanship!
This was not a cheap present, my boy.
Only the best for you, Grandma Ursula!
Do I get a present too?
A silk scarf! T-that's... so beautiful. And so expensive!
Valentine's Day is all about making people feel special, and you deserve it.
This one is for you, Roddy!
Wow, this is great. I wonder what you've got for me...
A gold watch?? Thanks, Mason, but this seems a bit too much...
Friendship is more valuable than gold!
It looks really familiar... but it can't be!
It looks like my old childhood teddy... but I thought I lost it in the fire!
S-someone has sent it to me... But who?
Lady Voyance's snow globe did also show me something weird... I'm sure its just a coincidence...
Just wrap a bow around it!
That's a beautiful ring! It kinda looks like an engagement ring...
Nooo... I-I just think a ring like this is way too expensive for a little Valentine's present.

SP_ValentinesMystery2024_End_Popup_Conte.value: Who sent the old teddy to Maddie - and what's up with Hank's diamond ring? Stay tuned to find out...

SP_ValentinesMystery2024_Intro_Dialogue_.value: Yes, Mom? You sound like you're about to ask me to do something boring.
I promised to organize a little Valentine's party at Grandma Ursula's place, but there's so much to do. Could you help me?
A Valentine's party? I knew it!
Please? I need to get a little present for everyone. Could you pick them and order them on my credit card?
So I would get to choose a present for everyone?
Yes, something special to each of our friends - but within reason! No sports cars or exotic animals.
So, no frilly hearts and the rest of that romantic stuff? I guess I can do that.
Great! I'll get everything else ready. I think this will be fun!

SP_ValentinesMystery2024_LastCollectible.value: They ARE nice. I chose them myself!
And I can't wait to see everyone's reactions!

SP_ValentinesMystery2024_Start_Popup_Des.value: A picture-perfect Valentine's celebration takes a funny turn - in more ways than one!

SP_Voyance2025_AllRewardsCompleted_Dialo.value: Harrumph! You should be more careful, old friend.
These young people take your words too seriously, and that will turn them into a self-fulfilling prophecy.
Well, well, Ursula! Did you just call me a PROPHET?
Very well. I know you think I'm a little bit... strange with my premonitions.
But I am guided by the movements of the stars - and they are more powerful than you might realize!

SP_Voyance2025_Decoration_Slot25_Dialogu.value: A wedding? So, who's getting married?
Listen, she's just trying to be mysterious... right?

SP_Voyance2025_Decoration_Slot26_Dialogu.value: Did you hear about Voyance's premonition? About the funeral and wedding taking place soon?
She is a strange lady. I find it difficult to believe her premonitions. There is no room for such things in science.
Exactly! She's just spinning tales about stars aligning and lunar events.
I wouldn't worry, Maddie. There won't be a funeral - or a wedding!

SP_Voyance2025_Decoration_Slot27_Dialogu.value: Lady Voyance is an interesting character, isn't she?
She sure is. It's not very nice - creeping everyone out with a crazy prediction.
I agree. These thing shouldn't be a joke.
My parents have been married for 30 years, and they are very happy. That's what I aim for - a love that lasts forever.
Bella, you know them. You understand what I mean, don't you?
A partner who'll be there for you.
That's what I've been looking for and now...
Yes! I would love to be your forever partner!
I've been waiting for you to ask me for so long - years!

SP_Voyance2025_Decoration_Slot28_Dialogu.value: I can't believe that just happened. Bella and Emilio are engaged!
Poor Emilio looked like he was about to pass out when Bella said she wanted to have the wedding immediately!
I know. Bella and I haven't always seen eye to eye...
...but I can see that she does really love Emilio. She's been in love with him since they were kids! They belong together.
OK, but remind me again. Why do you have to organize the whole affair? It's their wedding.
They're our friends, and that's what you do for your friends, right?

SP_Voyance2025_Decoration_Slot29_Dialogu.value: Lady Voyance said there would be a wedding - and a funeral.
Now the wedding is actually happening, and half of the premonition has come true, so...
What about the funeral? Do you think... she could be right?
If she is, whose funeral will it be?

SP_Voyance2025_End_Popup_Content_NoRewar.value: The first half of lady Voyance's prediction is set to come true - but dark clouds seem to be gathering...
The first half of lady Voyance's prediction is set to come true - but dark clouds seem to gathering...

SP_Voyance2025_Intro_Dialogue_01.value: Voyance! It is nice to see you. Where have you been hiding?

SP_Voyance2025_Intro_Dialogue_02.value: I attended a retreat all about celestial secrets, which was very interesting indeed.

SP_Voyance2025_Intro_Dialogue_03.value: Ever since, I've been pouring over my star maps. It seems that there is something BIG on the way.

SP_Voyance2025_Intro_Dialogue_04.value: Are you talking about the northern lights they predicted for tonight?

SP_Voyance2025_Intro_Dialogue_05.value: Maddie invited a group of her friends to come see them in my front yard. You are more than welcome to join us!

SP_Voyance2025_Intro_Dialogue_06.value: I might just take you up on that! But we might get more than just northern lights...

SP_Voyance2025_LastCollectibleItemDiscov.value: Here we go! We should be seeing something pretty soon.
How exciting! I've never seen the northern lights before.
Me neither. Hey, is there something happening up there?
Voyance, are you seeing this? Isn't that wonderful?
I can see the lights... and I see something coming!
My maps were correct! The stars have SPOKEN! There will be TWO turns of fate - nuptials and a burial.
I think she said there will be a wedding and a funeral.

SP_Voyance2025_Start_Popup_Desc.value: Lady Voyance is up to her old tricks - this time with a premonition that promises great drama ahead. Whose wedding will the stars align for - and whose funeral is she predicting?

SP_WeddingMystery2024_AllRewardsComplete.value: Well, I would call that a very successful wedding!
You did great out there, baby.
Well, I uuh... Should start clean-
Have any of you seen Hank?!
Yeah, sure! He was just here a minute ago.
No, he wasn’t... I’ve looked everywhere! Haaank!
Deb, Deb... Calm down, I’m sure he’s just inside, doing his hair or lifting weights or something...
No, his hair is fine and today is leg day. He isn’t answering his phone; I can’t find him, Maddie! HAANK!
Wasn’t.... Wasn’t Grandma the last person to speak to him?

SP_WeddingMystery2024_Decoration_Slot32_.value: Hello, Deb. Getting ready for the big day, I see.
Put any more thought into what Reginald wrote in that letter about not trusting Hank?
It only read that he may be hiding something. Nothing about not trusting him! Whatever it is...
Ursula! Don’t you go jinxing my wedding like you did Maddie’s, do you understand me?!
I... I’m sorry, dearie. I don’t know what came over me. I’ll go see if Maddie needs some help.
Good! And don’t worry. I’ll find out what Hank is hiding!

SP_WeddingMystery2024_Decoration_Slot33_.value: It’s so nice of you to officiate their wedding, Roddy! I had no idea you could do that!
Oh yeah, I officiated at a friend’s wedding after I completed his home.
Aaw, that’s so sweet of you!
Roddy! Why aren’t you dressed yet?! You’re not marrying them in that hard hat are you?!
*sigh* Alright, fine. You do you. I couldn’t prepare for the wedding either... Had to grab my camera from the office.
Forgot my dress... What a right pair we make, eh?! Oh, hi Maddie!

SP_WeddingMystery2024_Decoration_Slot34_.value: A fancy feast of fine drink and finer cake!
So you’re sure the food is vegan, right? I mean, maybe we should hold off until we’re sure, okay?
Hank... CALM DOWN! I know it’s a big day, but you’ll get through it, alright? The food is fine.
But is it vegan like I ordered? I’m vegan. I can’t keep my physique if-
Hank... Breathe. You can do this!
I think Hank just realized he’s getting married!
Ha! Oh, did he now? I guess there’s nothing more intimidating than marrying a Boulton!

SP_WeddingMystery2024_Decoration_Slot35_.value: No matter where you go, there you are.
So! Soon to be Mr and Mrs. Boulton! I’m surprised you took on the Boulton name, Hank!
What, are you kidding? Hank Boulton... Can’t ask for a better name!
Now, if you would be so kind, I have a few words I need to share with Hank after the ceremony!
Ursula. This better not be the same “talk” you gave my 2nd husband! He was afraid of airplanes for a month!
Hahaha! Oh yes, I remember! Nothing like that.
Just a little something I need to discuss with him...

SP_WeddingMystery2024_Decoration_Slot36_.value: Deborah Boulton, do you take Hank Johnson for your lawful husband, to have and to hold, from this day forward, for better, for worse, for richer, for poorer, in sickness and in health, until death do you part?

And Hank, do you take Deborah Boulton for your lawful wife, to have and to hold, from this day forward, for better, for worse, for richer, for poorer, in sickness and in health, until death do you part?
Then, by the power invested in me by the state of Seranova, I pronounce you husband and wife!

SP_WeddingMystery2024_Decoration_Slot37_.value: What did you want to talk about, Grandma?
I just wanted to congratulate you on your wonderful wedding!
And to tell you I’ve learned something about your past...
Looks like you haven’t been ENTIRELY honest with us!
Gr- Grandma! I... I don’t know what you’re talking about!
How about I give you a LITTLE reminder!

SP_WeddingMystery2024_Intro_Dialogue_01.value: I can’t believe that today is the big day! Eeeh! So exciting!

SP_WeddingMystery2024_Intro_Dialogue_02.value: Settle down, Maddie. I’m the one getting married today.

SP_WeddingMystery2024_Intro_Dialogue_03.value: Haha! I know that. I’m just so happy for you! In fact, I want to show you my wedding gift for you!

SP_WeddingMystery2024_Intro_Dialogue_06.value: This area, silly! I cleared it out for you! It’ll be perfect, trust me!

SP_WeddingMystery2024_Intro_Dialogue_07.value: Oh, my... Maddie, it’s perfect! I don’t know what to say...

SP_WeddingMystery2024_Intro_Dialogue_08.value: The only thing you have to say today Deb is, “I do.”

SP_WeddingMystery2024_LastCollectibleIte.value: I’m so happy you found some more of the vintage Hopeberry juice, Grandma.
Hmm? Oh yes, of course it is, dearie!
Everything will be alright. Everything will be just fiiiine...

SP_WeddingMystery2024_Start_Popup_Desc.value: It is the big day and everyone is getting ready for a wedding they will soon not forget! However, questions still linger about Hank...

SP_WorldCup2026_AllRewardsCompleted_Dial.value: I'm okay. Hank didn't tackle me that hard.
He's really enjoying the championship though. After I explained the rules to him, of course.
He never fails to surprise me!
Speaking of surprises, I noticed the trophy cup has gone missing.
Do you think it was actually real?
I don't know... Grandma did say it was a piece of junk she found.

SP_WorldCup2026_Decoration_Slot33_Dialog.value: Big enough? Half of Hopewell Bay will be able to see the games now, dearie!
It's so big it's like almost being there!
I don't even need my glasses!

SP_WorldCup2026_Decoration_Slot34_Dialog.value: Thanks for helping out with the food, Cherry.
It's no problem at all, sugar.
Why, it would only be the right thing to do after all the help you've given me!
Don't mention it. I still appreciate it!
Are those... Cherry's pigs in blankets?!
You read my mind! Om nom nom...
Hey! Leave some for the rest of us!

SP_WorldCup2026_Decoration_Slot35_Dialog.value: Hey, Grandma. I was thinking about that cup you bought in Brazil...
Well, you see... The REAL cup was stolen back then, around that time... around THAT area.
Well... Maybe whoever sold it to you sold the REAL one!
It's just a silly trinket I found at the market.
But why would you buy a championship cup at a market, in Brazil?

SP_WorldCup2026_Decoration_Slot36_Dialog.value: Step right up and test your goal scoring skills!
Hey, wow! What a great setup, Roddy.
Thanks, Maddie. Want to give it a go?
Ha! Maybe later. But I think I see someone coming over...
I accept your challenge. 1-2-3-HUT HUT HUT!
Touchdown! You just got sacked, Roddy! HAHAHA!

SP_WorldCup2026_Decoration_Slot37_Dialog.value: Doing a bit of a light workout there, Hank?
Yeah! Nothing like doing it outside.
Interesting use of the football for the speed bag?
Well you see... After I sacked Roddy, a totally legit play, I may add, I started thinking. In Football, we use our hands and...
And in soccer you use your feet, so...
I lost my train of thought.

SP_WorldCup2026_End_Popup_Content_NoRewa.value: The crowd’s cheering, the night’s a success, but Maddie can’t shake the feeling that the “replica” trophy might have a story of its own...

SP_WorldCup2026_Intro_Dialogue_02.value: Sure am! While I'm more of a football fan, I don't mind a little soccer now and then.

SP_WorldCup2026_Intro_Dialogue_03.value: Well, you're in for a treat! Grandma has let us set up a watch party for the entire championship!

SP_WorldCup2026_Intro_Dialogue_05.value: Emilio, Bella! Wonderful that you could join.

SP_WorldCup2026_LastCollectibleItemDisco.value: Hmm... This cup seems awfully heavy for a replica.
It's also pretty weathered and has a date here, I can't quite make out... Nineteen eighty-something.
It does look quite authentic... Grandma, where did you get this?
Oh, that old thing? I found it at a street shop in Brazil.
Got it for a good price too, dearie.

SP_WorldCup2026_RewardMail_Topic_Long.value: Season Pass - Soccer Watch Party has ended.

SP_WorldCup2026_RewardMail_Topic_Short.value: Season Pass - Soccer Watch Party has ended!

SP_WorldCup2026_Start_Popup_Desc.value: The Soccer Championship has hit Hopewell Bay, and Maddie and Roddy are turning the cabin yard into the ultimate watch party. Fun, snacks, big screen… and apparently, a very convincing “replica” trophy.

SP_XmasMystery2024_AllRewardsCompleted_D.value: It certainly was... but I think Maddie is right.
Someone is behind all of this. I just cannot QUITE put my finger on it...
Ursula, I might have a suspicion.
You will have to tell me more about your suspicion before Maddie gets too far with her investigation.
All I can say is that it has something to do with a person whose initials are CB.

SP_XmasMystery2024_Decoration_Slot32_Des.value: Welcome to the Dinner Under the Stars!

SP_XmasMystery2024_Decoration_Slot32_Dia.value: I can't wait for tonight! The Dinner Under the Stars is one my favorite events of the year!
I know! It's going to be fantastic - if only Cherry and Grandma would get along...
What do you mean? They always work together on this - even if it does turn into a friendly competition!
Maybe not that friendly this year.

SP_XmasMystery2024_Decoration_Slot33_Des.value: Do a twirl on the ice!

SP_XmasMystery2024_Decoration_Slot33_Dia.value: Thanks, Emilio! I want it to be extra cozy this year.
You know, I just ran into Cherry. She seemed quite upset about something...
I heard her muttering something about your Grandma.
Wait-- maybe I misheard her. The evening will be a success, I just KNOW it!

SP_XmasMystery2024_Decoration_Slot34_Des.value: Sit down by the fire and enjoy yourself.

SP_XmasMystery2024_Decoration_Slot34_Dia.value: This spread is amazing, you guys!
Your risotto is… interesting. Did you mean for it to be this "al dente", or did the stove just quit on you?
Your risotto is... interesting. Did you mean for it to be this "al dente", or did the stove just quit on you?
It’s called “texture.” Not everything needs to be boiled into submission like your very ambitious soufflé.
You mean the soufflé that’s actually risen? I wasn’t sure if the “decadent” dessert you're serving is meant to look like a pancake.
At least one of us is serving something memorable tonight...

SP_XmasMystery2024_Decoration_Slot35_Dia.value: Why are you so angry with each other?
I would tell you, but Ursula will probably just try to make it all about her.
I know we are both competitive, but this seems like a lot - even for you!
Did someone put you up to this?

SP_XmasMystery2024_Decoration_Slot36_Dia.value: You didn't get a weird letter? Or a phone call from someone you didn't know?
W-well, I-- There was an anonymous phone call, and I couldn't recognize their voice...
Just that Ursula is always there to steal my thunder...
The Hopeberry festival was more like Ursula's festival.
Even when I was baking the record-breaking pie last summer, she still overshadowed it with her mystery meat...
So the caller just said that I shouldn't stand for it anymore. And I won't!

SP_XmasMystery2024_Decoration_Slot37_Dia.value: Oh, Cherry... I am terribly sorry for stealing your thunder.
You're an excellent cook and baker -- a real professional! I only dabble.
Thank you... I appreciate that, Ursula. I'm sorry I said those things about your cooking.
I feel so silly for making such a big deal out of this...
Someone just clearly saw an opportunity to cause trouble between the two of you.
You're both competitive, so it was almost too easy...
But this isn't the first sign of trouble.
First, someone ruined my Halloween ad, then they sent an apple-munching alpaca to wreak havoc, and now this!
This is going too far. I'm going to find out who's setting us against each other.

SP_XmasMystery2024_End_Popup_Content_NoR.value: The Dinner Under the Stars was a success after all - but Hopewell Bay is simmering with a strange mystery!

SP_XmasMystery2024_IntroDialogue_Dialogu.value: Maddie, do you have a minute?
Sure! Are you as excited about our annual Dinner Under the Stars as I am?
Actually, that's what I wanted to talk to you about.
You didn't burn the Yule Log, did you?
Of course not! It's just that... well, I would like your Grandma to take a backseat on the preparations this year.
Umm... I can talk to her, but did something happen?
I need to run to the market to get the last supplies for the dinner, so I can't get into it right now.
I just need you to promise that you'll talk to her.
I wonder what that was about...

SP_XmasMystery2024_LastCollectibleItemDi.value: Soooo... What are you up to, Grandma?
Just counting my gingerbread and preparing the icing for the cake...
Cherry just dropped by and asked if you could let her take care of the dinner preparations this year.
Why? We have always done it together.
I d-don't know... I thought you might know what's going on.

SP_XmasMystery2024_Start_Popup_Desc.value: You are cordially invited to: Dinner Under the Stars - prepared by Cherry and Grandma Ursula! Enjoy an evening of dreamy delights and tasty drama...

SP_Yoga2025_AllRewardsCompleted_Dialogue.value: I really appreciate your new enthusiasm for self-care, dearie.
I know you went through a lot, last year, and I think it is a good idea to put all of that behind you and look ahead instead.
There is no point in dwelling on the past, as I always say.
But yoga is just too SLOW for me. How about we speed things up?
I read about a new game that sounds fun, so I'm planning a little tournament. I already invited Julius and Deb!
It doesn't sound like a high-speed game if Julius and Deb are involved...
Very funny - but you might be surprised!

SP_Yoga2025_Decoration_Slot25_Dialogue_0.value: So you're going to organize a yoga retreat? Did Pearl put you up to it?
No, I've seen them on social media, and I've always wanted to go.
We have all this beautiful space, so it makes perfect sense to have one here.
Me?? I am not quite sure that I am bendy enough.
But will you try at least? It's so good for finding your balance.

SP_Yoga2025_Decoration_Slot26_Dialogue_0.value: They really do. I never knew what a downward dog was before.
Me neither! I'm starting to feel like a new person.
She's playing with her ancient phone when she should be concentrating on yoga!
That phone looks almost as old as her...
Fiddlesticks! Your whispering startled me and made me drop my phone.

SP_Yoga2025_Decoration_Slot27_Dialogue_0.value: I'm so sorry about your phone, Grandma. I know you really loved that old thing.
It was a very reliable device. They just don't make them like that anymore.
Well, I got you a new phone. It's a smartphone!
What is so smart about it?
You can download apps, take photos, find new recipes... it can do pretty much anything.

SP_Yoga2025_Decoration_Slot28_Dialogue_0.value: How's it going with the new phone, Grandma? Do you need help setting things up?
Oh, I think I have got it under control.
Wow, you've already got all the apps... and all the security features.
Are you sure you've never used a smartphone before?
You have seen my old phone, haven't you? That thing was only good for texting and calling - and sometimes not even that.
I guess so... Well, good job!

SP_Yoga2025_Decoration_Slot29_Dialogue_0.value: How is Ursula doing with the new phone? Did you have to do everything for her?
Actually, she managed to set the whole thing up herself.
Really? Then again, why am I even surprised? She's probably had a secret smartphone for years, right?
Come on, the yoga class is starting and I want the best spots!

SP_Yoga2025_Decoration_Slot32_Descriptio.value: Finding your inner peace can be easy.

SP_Yoga2025_Decoration_Slot34_Descriptio.value: All you need to do is channel the sun's energy.

SP_Yoga2025_Decoration_Slot38_Dialogue_0.value: A-are you taking a selfie, Grandma??
Yes, I learned it is all the rage!
I set up some social media accounts and found a whole new world of fun things!
Have you seen how many cat videos there are in the world?
Sure, there are a lot. Great to see that you're enjoying the new phone.

SP_Yoga2025_End_Popup_Content_NoRewards.value: Grandma has a new phone, and Maddie is on her way to finding harmony. So why does it all feel so suspicious?

SP_Yoga2025_IntroDialogue_Dialogue_01.value: Phew, the year is nearly over... and what a wild ride it's been!

SP_Yoga2025_IntroDialogue_Dialogue_02.value: There's been so much drama - and trauma - from heartbreak to Halloween mysteries.

SP_Yoga2025_IntroDialogue_Dialogue_03.value: I'm SO done with all of it - especially romance. A new year means a chance to start over, right?

SP_Yoga2025_IntroDialogue_Dialogue_04.value: It's time I put me first!

SP_Yoga2025_IntroDialogue_Dialogue_05.value: This year will be all about finding harmony and joy.

SP_Yoga2025_LastCollectibleItemDiscovere.value: Meditating? What for? If you need to clear your mind, you should do some knitting instead. You would be productive at the same time.
This year has been pretty hectic, so I'm going to concentrate on finding my inner peace and balance for a change.
Where are you going to be looking for it?
Funny you should ask! I'm going to organize a yoga retreat!

SP_Yoga2025_Start_Popup_Desc.value: A new year, a new Maddie! After a year full of drama and heartbreak, Maddie organizes a yoga retreat to focus on what really matters.

STE_PrisonBreak_CharacterEndPopup_Descri.value: Thanks to your efforts, Prisoner X will now help you out by dropping (SPAWNER) on your board to help you progress!
Thanks to your efforts, Grace will now help you out by adding her ID to your board to help you progress!

STE_PrisonBreak_CharacterStartPopup_Desc.value: The rumor is going around that Grandma's pies are a hot commodity in prison. The kitchen would like a piece of the pie. Will Grandma be able to convince the kitchen staff?

STE_PrisonBreak_TeasePopup_Description.value: Please reach requirement X to discover the story of how Grandma escaped from prison!
Please reach requirement X to discover the story of how Grandma escaped from jail!

Sauna01_01.value: It doesn't help to cry at the market, you know...

Sauna01_02.value: Oh alright... What needs to be done?

Sauna01_03.value: Well, first we need to clear all this rubble, then we can get to work rebuilding.

Sauna01_04.value: However, some of the things you'll need, you'll find from the lighthouse! That sausage is for you.

Sauna01_05.value: Ooh, I get to go up there?!

Sauna02_01.value: Thank you for all the help so far!

Sauna02_02.value: No problem, Heikki! Speaking of which, I noticed your lighthouse is an absolute mess!

Sauna02_03.value: Oh yes... I haven't been there in ages... Not since the accident.

Sauna02_05.value: Tell you what! As a thank you for helping me rebuild the sauna, you get to keep the lighthouse room for yourself!

Sauna02_07.value: What comes whistling, goes singing. Besides, I don't need it anymore.

Sauna02_09.value: I can't believe it! A room of my own that's filled with so much history!

Sauna03_01.value: No niin! You'll need the right type of wood, if you want to build a proper Finnish sauna.

Sauna03_02.value: I'm sure any type of wood would work.

Sauna03_03.value: Maddie... This is a serious matter.

Sauna03_04.value: The sauna is the landscape of the soul!

Sauna03_05.value: Oh... I didn't know it was that important.

Sauna04_01.value: You know, this reminds me of the time when Charlie accidentally burned the sauna down.

Sauna04_03.value: Yeah, it was hilarious! We accidentally locked ourselves outside with nothing but our towels on. In the winter!

Sauna04_05.value: And Charlie said, "I have an idea! Let's use my lock picks!"

Sauna04_07.value: Haha! But it was so dark, he needed a light and accidentally set his towel on fire!

Sauna04_08.value: I tried to blow it out with my towel, but that caught fire too!

Sauna04_09.value: Oh, no...  Wait... Did you say you were only wearing towels?

Sauna04_10.value: So there we were in the resin, two old men in our birthday suits, staring at our sauna burning down!
So there we were as if in the resin, two old men in our birthday suits, staring at our sauna burning down!

Sauna04_11.value: Please let me forget that mental image...

Sauna04_13.value: Not that one at least... But why would Grandpa have lock picks?

Sauna05_02.value: Ah yes! Your grandfather was a rogue/assassin!

Sauna05_04.value: Oh! I meant in the game we often played! He liked his character so much, he wanted to learn some of her skills.

Sauna05_06.value: Better than learning how to assassinate someone.

Sauna05_08.value: I wonder if Grandpa lost his lock picking set in the fire?

Sauna06_01.value: Every good sauna needs a good "kiuas"!

Sauna06_02.value: That's what heats the sauna, right?

Sauna06_03.value: Good! You're learning! Ha! That reminds me of the time the kiuas caught fire and-

Sauna06_04.value: Let me guess... The sauna burned down?

Sauna06_06.value: How many times has this place burned down?

Sauna06_08.value: Hmm... Probably easier to ask how many times it hasn't.

SaunaIntro_01.value: Is everything alright?! Is the lighthouse on fire?

SaunaIntro_02.value: Oh, this? It's nothing, it's just my sauna that's in flames!

SaunaIntro_05.value: A strong will takes a man through a grey rock.

SaunaOutro_01.value: Today must be your lucky day because I found those lock picks I was telling you about!

SaunaOutro_02.value: Your grandfather had those specially made for him. Look at the engraving in the leather.

SaunaOutro_04.value: I never understood that one. Your grandfather did like his riddles.

SaunaOutro_05.value: Hold on... I know what he means!

SaunaRepeatable_01.value: I forgot all about this little wood shed!

SaunaRepeatable_02.value: It looks like the logs underneath are charred from the sauna fire...

SaunaRepeatable_03.value: This should be a good resource to help me get all the charred wood I need!
This should be a good resource to help me get all the charred debris I need!

ScavengerHunt_DogareaEmpty_01.value: Looks like there is nothing here...

ScavengerHunt_DogareaEmpty_02.value: Let's see if there is something on the statue.

ScavengerHunt_Dogarea_01.value: Let's see, is anything here? Yoo-hoo, clues? Where are you?!

ScavengerHunt_Dogarea_02.value: Uh, Maddie? Is this a bad time?

ScavengerHunt_Dogarea_03.value: Roddy! What a surprise. I guess I must look pretty strange, huh?

ScavengerHunt_Dogarea_04.value: You look pretty, but not strange. I mean, uh, what are you doing?

ScavengerHunt_Dogarea_05.value: I'm on a scavenger hunt! I found a clue on the statue of the WWI nurse that led me here.

ScavengerHunt_Dogarea_06.value: You mean the little picture of the frog? I noticed that too! We have so much in common, don't we?

ScavengerHunt_Dogarea_07.value: Wait, that was a frog? I thought it was a dog! This changes everything. Follow me!

ScavengerHunt_Driveway_01.value: Okay, the last clue was a picture of a tin can. Here we are! Hey tin can, what secrets do you hold?

ScavengerHunt_Driveway_02.value: I see the number '5' and a little etching of a water bucket! I should go to the old well next.

ScavengerHunt_Driveway_03.value: Hey Maddie. Just wondering how things are going here. Any updates on your grandma's case?

ScavengerHunt_Driveway_04.value: Jackie, I'm not going to talk about that with you, so you might as well leave.

ScavengerHunt_Driveway_05.value: I... Sorry. I understand. Mind if I hang out awhile?
I... Sorry. I understand. Mind if I hang out a while?

ScavengerHunt_Driveway_06.value: I guess so! I'm on a scavenger hunt that, uh, someone set up for me.

ScavengerHunt_Driveway_07.value: Can I help? I love things like this. My idea of heaven is an escape room with a ten minute timer.

ScavengerHunt_Driveway_08.value: Really?! Umm.. Sure! Let's go take a look around the plaza and the old well.

ScavengerHunt_Flowergarden_01.value: Okay, let's start the scavenger hunt Charlie sent me! The first clue is 'A sad heroine holds a key' and there's nobody sadder than the statue of this nurse!

ScavengerHunt_Flowergarden_02.value: Let's see... nothing there, or there...

ScavengerHunt_Flowergarden_03.value: Wait, I see something on the statue! It's the letter 'R.' Looks like there's a picture of a dog beside it, too.

ScavengerHunt_Flowergarden_04.value: What could the dog mean? Maybe - Oh! Maybe there's something in the little area Rufus likes to play in!

ScavengerHunt_Gardenright_01.value: Here we are - the fountain where Grandpa proposed to Grandma! This must be what the 'ring' carving meant.

ScavengerHunt_Gardenright_02.value: Using the glass vase, I can see underwater aaaand I have it! There's a letter 'U' here, along with a picture of a tin can!

ScavengerHunt_Gardenright_03.value: Hello up there. Name's Holden, and I'm the best photographer in town. I assume you've heard of me?

ScavengerHunt_Gardenright_04.value: Anyway, I work for the local council, and I've been sent to document your progress.

ScavengerHunt_Gardenright_05.value: Do you mind if I get some shots around the place?

ScavengerHunt_Gardenright_06.value: I suppose that's okay. I'm just about to go over to the driveway, though.

ScavengerHunt_Gardenright_07.value: No problem - I'll just take some selfies with this old statue, then get some shots around the grounds.

ScavengerHunt_Intro_01.value: Here you are, dearie. Looks like some mail came for you.

ScavengerHunt_Intro_02.value: Let's see. "Dear Maddie. I'm sorry for calling and scaring you like that, but I can help you prove Ursula's innocence..."

ScavengerHunt_Intro_03.value: "Everything you need is in the pool house safe. I'm afraid to say that I've forgotten the code. It's been many years, after all!"

ScavengerHunt_Intro_04.value: "I've hidden clues to the code around the estate. Just follow them. I only remember the first one."

ScavengerHunt_Intro_05.value: "The first clue is 'A sad heroine holds a key.' Got that? Good luck, from Grandpa Charlie."

ScavengerHunt_Intro_06.value: Maddie, I don't know who sent that, but it can't have been your Grandpa! You should throw it away.

ScavengerHunt_Intro_07.value: No way! I can't wait to begin this - and I know just where to start looking.

ScavengerHunt_OldwellEmpty2_01.value: Nothing here it seems... except so many knives at the bottom of that pond.

ScavengerHunt_OldwellEmpty_01.value: I don't think there is anything here...

ScavengerHunt_Oldwell_01.value: I see something here! There's a letter. I think it's an 'L!'

ScavengerHunt_Oldwell_02.value: Well, I'm almost done for the day, and... wait, Jackie?

ScavengerHunt_Oldwell_03.value: Ugh, Holden? I was hoping that the day you got fired would be the last time I saw you.

ScavengerHunt_Oldwell_04.value: Oh, come on. They took me back! And if you hated me, you never would have dated me.

ScavengerHunt_Oldwell_05.value: We dated one time! The biggest mistake of my life. You wouldn't stop looking at yourself on your phone.

ScavengerHunt_Oldwell_06.value: Whatever. Maddie, I've taken some shots, but I'll be back. Between you and me, I don't think my superior is going to be happy.

ScavengerHunt_Oldwell_07.value: You know what? I don't care. I've got bigger things to deal with than the local council right now!

ScavengerHunt_Oldwell_08.value: I bet you do. I heard all about your grandma's arrest. Until next time...

ScavengerHunt_Oldwell_09.value: Ugh. Ignore him! I think you found the last clue, so it's time to go back to the pool house.

ScavengerHunt_Poolhouse_01.value: Okay, here we are! We have all the letters in Grandpa's code, and we're at the right place - the pool house. Let's try and see if that code opens the safe.

ScavengerHunt_Poolhouse_02.value: So you found the letters 'R4U5L' - will they work as the code?

ScavengerHunt_Poolhouse_03.value: Uh, nope, that didn't work. It could be... oh! I know what it is - R5UL4! Ursula!

ScavengerHunt_Poolhouse_04.value: Well done Maddie, it opened! And is that a... notebook inside?

ScavengerHunt_Poolhouse_05.value: Huh, there's nothing to help Grandma in here! Just lots of drawings and numbers.

ScavengerHunt_Poolhouse_06.value: But this Maze looks like the one on the grounds, and it has the number '1' written above it. I guess I'll go there next!

ScavengerHunt_Poolhouse_07.value: Thanks for letting me help and hang out, Maddie. I hope this notebook leads to whatever you're looking for!

ScavengerHunt_Watergarden_01.value: My parents loved playing here with the frogs, and Grandpa Charlie would have known that.

ScavengerHunt_Watergarden_02.value: Your grandpa Charlie put you on a scavenger hunt? But he's, uh, dead...

ScavengerHunt_Watergarden_03.value: He's not! He called me, and then he sent me a letter starting this quest.

ScavengerHunt_Watergarden_04.value: Let's check the statue. Yes! Here's a number '4' and a little carving of a ring.

ScavengerHunt_Watergarden_05.value: Maddie, are you sure that it was your grandpa who sent you on this quest?

ScavengerHunt_Watergarden_06.value: Of course I am! And I know exactly where his clue is going to lead next.

ScavengerHunt_Watergarden_07.value: I'd like nothing more than to stay and help, but I should get back to work. Good luck, Maddie!

SeasonAutumn2023_Start_Popup_Description.value: Strong winds herald the beginning of a glorious and colorful new season in Hopewell Bay!

SeasonAutumn2024_Start_Popup_Description.value: Turn over a new leaf as the cool autumn months make their way to Hopewell Bay!

SeasonAutumn2024_Start_Popup_Title.value: Leaves are falling and autumn is calling!

SeasonFall23_Intro_01.value: Maddie dearie, I’ve got a feeling in my bones that it’s the perfect season for apple pie!

SeasonFall23_Intro_02.value: Really? But you’ve always said apple pies are great during fall and it doesn’t feel like that at all!

SeasonFall23_Intro_03.value: Well, a new season could be just around the corner, my de-

SeasonFall23_Intro_04.value: What’s this? Ah - a newspaper! Let’s take a look.

SeasonFall23_Intro_05.value: The headlines here say that there are strong winds blowing through Hopewell Bay.

SeasonFall23_Intro_06.value: Hmm, it is getting a bit chilly isn’t it. Did I just see a leaf fall from that tree?

SeasonFall23_Intro_07.value: Wow! I-I guess I was wrong about fall. Hopewell Bay looks beautiful in these colors!

SeasonFall23_Intro_08.value: There’s few things I’m wrong about, dearie and pie isn’t one of them!

SeasonFall23_Intro_09.value: Ooh this is just lovely! I can’t wait for apple picking, cozying up by the fire and…
Ooh, this is just lovely! I can’t wait for apple picking, cozying up by the fire and...

SeasonFall23_Start_Popup_Description.value: Strong winds herald the beginning of a glorious and colorful new season in Hopewell Bay!

SeasonSpring2024_Intro_01.value: Maddie dearie, spring is finally here! Isn't it a beautiful sight?

SeasonSpring2024_Intro_02.value: It sure is! Especially after all that snow. This feels like a reward!

SeasonSpring2024_Intro_03.value: I suppose we'll have to get started on spring cleaning and-

SeasonSpring2024_Intro_04.value: Now, now, dearie. Take a deep breath. Spring isn't about rushing. You must learn how to slow down.

SeasonSpring2024_Intro_05.value: You're right. I have to learn to stop and smell the flowers as they say.

SeasonSpring2024_Intro_06.value: What do you love about spring, Grandma?

SeasonSpring2024_Intro_07.value: Apart from the endless sunshine? Spring for me has always meant the start of something new...

SeasonSpring2024_Intro_08.value: Hmm, new beginnings. I could definitely use some of that!

SeasonSpring2024_Intro_09.value: This year, I'm going to try a bunch of things I've never tried before!

SeasonSpring2024_Intro_10.value: Thanks for the reminder, Grandma! I'm ready to spring into action!

SeasonSpring2024_Start_Popup_Description.value: Wipe away those winter blues, spring is just around the corner!

SeasonSpring2024_Start_Popup_Title.value: Sunny spring days are here again!

SeasonSpring2026_Start_Popup_Description.value: Wipe away those winter blues, spring is just around the corner!

SeasonSpring2026_Start_Popup_Title.value: Sunny spring days are here again!

SeasonWinter2023_Intro_01.value: Maddie, dearie, I was rummaging through some old things in my attic and I found-

SeasonWinter2023_Intro_02.value: More garden gloves? I somehow keep misplacing mine...

SeasonWinter2023_Intro_03.value: No, dearie. I found an old picture... of you!

SeasonWinter2023_Intro_05.value: Goodness, I'm so tiny here! Am I opening a present?

SeasonWinter2023_Intro_06.value: Oh yes, you loved opening all your holiday presents early!

SeasonWinter2023_Intro_08.value: Hey! It's a snowflake! C-could it be winter already? But, I'm not prepared!

SeasonWinter2023_Intro_09.value: Oh nonsense, dearie! There's no such thing! All we need is a good outfit.

SeasonWinter2023_Intro_10.value: Let's go inside and see what we can find...

SeasonWinter2023_Intro_11.value: Oh, wow! Grandma, look! It's a winter wonderland out here!

SeasonWinter2023_Intro_12.value: It sure is, dearie. And wouldn't you say we look swell in these new, warm clothes?

SeasonWinter2023_Intro_13.value: Oh, definitely. I've never been cozier! Winter, here we come!

SecretsocietyAncientScroll_01.value: Hey! This scroll seems to have the tenets of the Fellowship written on it!

SecretsocietyAncientScroll_03.value: Hmph... Of course, it’s in code.

SecretsocietyArtifactDisplay_03.value: Maybe... Maybe I should donate these to the museum anonymously.

SecretsocietyAstrologyGlobe_02.value: Looks like some sort of orrery... But for astrology!

SecretsocietyAstrologyGlobe_03.value: I wonder what my sun sign has in store for me this year...

SecretsocietyMasks_01.value: Yeah, okay... I’m officially creeped out.

SecretsocietyMasks_02.value: What, why? These artifacts are beautiful and mysterious!

SecretsocietyMasks_03.value: Sometimes, Maddie, you’re more of a Boulton than you think!

SecretsocietyMedallion_01.value: I know what this is! It’s an ancient Mayan calendar!

SecretsocietyMedallion_03.value: I took archeology for one semester in university.

SecretsocietyRobes_01.value: Ooh, these must be the robes they would wear on initiation days?

SecretsocietyRobes_03.value: They're so fancy and kind of eerie at the same time.

SecretsocietyShoes_01.value: I just noticed that one of these shoes belongs to a woman!

SecretsocietyShoes_02.value: Oh! Do you think it could be Lindsay?

SecretsocietyShoes_03.value: It's possible. This is exactly the kinda thing she'd be into...

Secretsociety_02.1_01.value: Maddie, you're brilliant! I can finally breathe in here.

Secretsociety_02.1_02.value: Yeah, but what on earth are those numbers?

Secretsociety_02.1_03.value: Hmm, maybe it's just a pattern?

Secretsociety_02.1_04.value: Knowing this mansion, nothing is ever what it seems...

Secretsociety_02.1_05.value: Um, Maddie... Don't freak out, but I think I see a rat...

Secretsociety_02_01.value: I have a feeling that this lever will help with the bad smell in here...

Secretsociety_02_03.value: From what I can see, it looks like it was engineered to drain the water.

Secretsociety_02_04.value: Ah, of course! I forget that engineering is your thing.

Secretsociety_02_06.value: Well, let's give it a try because I can't stand this smell much longer!

Secretsociety_03_01.value: Look at all of this stuff! What do you think happened down here?

Secretsociety_03_02.value: Strange... It sort of reminds me of the gallery. But some of these things...

Secretsociety_03_03.value: Some of these things belong in a museum!

Secretsociety_03_04.value: Why do you think they’re stuck down here?

Secretsociety_03_05.value: Perhaps it has something to do with the cryptex? It had a word...

Secretsociety_03_07.value: Curious? Wait... You don’t think that...

Secretsociety_04_02.value: I remember it from my university days, talk about a strange secret society for inventors, adventurers and explorers.

Secretsociety_04_03.value: Me too! The Curiosity Fellowship was a legend for us engineers at Veilwood University!

Secretsociety_04_04.value: Rumors about crazy inventions like flying contraptions, free energy, automatons...

Secretsociety_04_05.value: We used to hear stories of their adventures in far-away lands, discovering lost ancient cities!

Secretsociety_04_06.value: But then something happened, and they had to shut it down...

Secretsociety_04_07.value: That’s right! And their secret sanctum was lost forever...

Secretsociety_05_01.value: Wait... You think this is the secret sanctum of the Curiosity Fellowship?!

Secretsociety_05_02.value: Yeah! What else could it be?

Secretsociety_05_03.value: But... They said it was somewhere in the university?

Secretsociety_05_04.value: I’m sure they had an office there, but this place... This is where it happened!

Secretsociety_05_05.value: Look, Maddie! Robes, masks, weird artifacts... It all fits! Even getting in here with a cryptex!

Secretsociety_05_06.value: They were also very secretive, using passwords and secret identities... Remind you of something?

Secretsociety_06.1_01.value: Are you actually planning to stand on this bridge?

Secretsociety_06.1_02.value: How else am I supposed to fix it?

Secretsociety_06.1_03.value: I don't know, Maddie. This place feels like it's full of traps. The lamp-

Secretsociety_06.1_04.value: I know, I know. What if I just place one foot on it like so...

Secretsociety_06.1_05.value: Wait, do you hear rumbling? Step back, Maddie!

Secretsociety_06.2_01.value: Phew! That was close... Thanks, Jackie.

Secretsociety_06.2_02.value: I might have to add "saving lives" to my professional profile!

Secretsociety_06.2_03.value: Haha, hopefully this bridge is the last of the traps.

Secretsociety_06.2_04.value: I trust you can build a much sturdier bridge?

Secretsociety_06_01.value: I remember hearing a story about how to become a member of the Fellowship.

Secretsociety_06_02.value: Oh? I didn’t hear that one.

Secretsociety_06_03.value: It was said that in order to join, you had to contribute something unique.

Secretsociety_06_04.value: We would try to design utterly unique inventions. But judging from all these things...

Secretsociety_06_05.value: I guess unique also meant cool artifacts!

Secretsociety_06_06.value: That would explain the creepy statue in your Gallery.

Secretsociety_06_07.value: Oh! That’s right! It’s so out of place too!

Secretsociety_06_08.value: Hmm... I wonder what caused them to shut it down?

Secretsociety_07_01.value: That was a solid bridge, Maddie! I'm sorry if I was still hesitant to cross it.

Secretsociety_07_02.value: I don't blame you after the events we've seen down here...

Secretsociety_07_03.value: I wonder why they didn't want anyone to get to this side?

Secretsociety_07_04.value: Hmm... might have something to do with all these blueprints.

Secretsociety_07_05.value: You could be right. But what were they building?

Secretsociety_07_06.value: Mostly harmless stuff, from the looks of it.

Secretsociety_07_07.value: Invisibility machine? Early Navigation System? Anti-Distraction Hat?

Secretsociety_07_08.value: Maddie... These folks had some far out ideas...

Secretsociety_07_09.value: This must be their intellectual corner.... The very spot where ideas came to life!

Secretsociety_08_01.value: Check out this podium and all these seats, Jackie!

Secretsociety_08_02.value: Can you imagine all the amazing speakers they had here?

Secretsociety_08_03.value: I've read that secret societies usually invite prominent speakers in various fields.

Secretsociety_08_04.value: Oh how I wish I were a fly on this wall...

Secretsociety_08_05.value: Do you think presidents have been here?

Secretsociety_08_06.value: I wouldn't be surprised. These societies were known to host a few presidents over the years...

Secretsociety_09_01.value: Look! It's the same numbers that were in the pool!

Secretsociety_09_02.value: Wow, guess it does have a purpose. Do you think it's some sort of puzzle?

Secretsociety_09_04.value: Ooh, I bet if we solve this, we might unearth some more secrets...

Secretsociety_10_01.value: Hmm, I just have to put the last piece of this puzzle together.

Secretsociety_10_02.value: If this goes here, then... Hmmm I almost have it...

Secretsociety_11_02.value: Oh my goodness, it worked! There's a beam of light!

Secretsociety_11_03.value: And it's bouncing off the fire bowl...

Secretsociety_11_04.value: I'm sure this light reflection puzzle unlocks something... Let's polish the bowl and see where it leads!

Secretsociety_12.1_01.value: I thought I heard a faint ringing, and I was right! What's a telephone doing here?

Secretsociety_12.1_02.value: Let's find out! It's a bit muffled...

Secretsociety_12.1_04.value: "I applaud you for coming this far... not an easy task...."

Secretsociety_12.1_05.value: "We are the Curiosity Fellowship. We honor... loyalty... truth and-

Secretsociety_12.1_08.value: "We are not easy to find... hidden among you... in plain sight"

Secretsociety_12.1_09.value: I wonder if we've already met a society member. Could be anyone!

Secretsociety_12.1_10.value: "This is not the end. Tell... no one..."

Secretsociety_12.1_12.value: Is it just me or did that sound like a threat?

Secretsociety_12.1_13.value: Can you believe we actually solved one of the Fellowship's puzzles?!

Secretsociety_12.1_14.value: Based on that message, there might be more around the mansion. I can't wait!

Secretsociety_Intro_01.value: Wow! I can’t believe this was under the conservatory all this time!

Secretsociety_Intro_02.value: How did you know it was here?

Secretsociety_Intro_03.value: There were clues hidden in the mosaic and-

Secretsociety_Intro_08.value: Maybe we should stick together for this one. Just in case...

Secretsociety_Intro_09.value: That sounds like a good idea.

Secretsociety_Intro_10.value: Besides, I smell a good story in this room!

Secretsociety_Intro_11.value: Ugh... That’s not the only thing you’re probably smelling... Look at that water!

Secretsociety_Intro_12.value: You know, you should really get your plumbing fixed.

Secretsociety_Unlock_01.value: Hey, Maddie! There you are! I have something to ask-

Secretsociety_Unlock_02.value: Jackie! I was right, the very same blue gem I discovered is right here at the conservatory!

Secretsociety_Unlock_04.value: The gem from the cryptex! And it looks like one of the gem slots here is actually hollow!

Secretsociety_Unlock_05.value: Maybe I just need to place the gem here and see what happens...

Secretsociety_Unlock_07.value: W-wait a second, I think the stone is moving!

Secretsocietycharactertask2_01.value: So, Maddie, do you have any tips on garden decor?

Secretsocietycharactertask2_03.value: I always like to start with planters and flowers!

Secretsocietycharactertask3_01.value: Maddie, our readers want to know ALL about upholstery!

Secretsocietycharactertask3_02.value: Well, having a sewing kit can be handy, but make sure to have plenty of fabric!

Secretsocietycharactertask4_01.value: How do you keep dust away in indoor spaces?

Secretsocietycharactertask4_02.value: A good, fluffy duster does wonders!

Secretsocietycharactertask4_03.value: And remember to always dust before you vacuum!

Secretsocietycharactertaskintro_01.value: Maddie, I completely forgot to mention what I actually came over here for!

Secretsocietycharactertaskintro_03.value: My article? What do you mean?

Secretsocietycharactertaskintro_04.value: I did some research for the Bugle. Turns out that people are loving home renovation and cleaning tips...

Secretsocietycharactertaskintro_05.value: There's no one better than you for the job!

Secretsocietycharactertaskintro_06.value: Oh! I'm flattered! I guess I could do an interview...

Secretsocietycharactertaskoutro_01.value: Thanks for the interview, Maddie. You were a natural!

Secretsocietycharactertaskoutro_03.value: I have a feeling that this could be a regular column someday...

Secretsocietyextcharactertask6_01.value: You know, now that Victoria has an eye on you, maybe this article could help!

Secretsocietyextcharactertask6_03.value: By getting Hopewell Bay to see how you've revived this mansion!

Secretsocietyextcharactertask6_04.value: Look how far you've come! Everyone will surely be on your side!

Secretsocietyextcharactertask6_05.value: You might be right. Thanks, Jackie. It's nice to be appreciated!

ShowJumpPoles_01.value: I used to love watching equestrian sports on TV!

ShowJumpPoles_02.value: The riders and horses were so elegant.

ShowJumpPoles_03.value: I wonder if Babylon will be interested in show jumping too. It's in her genes, after all.

SinkAndMirror_01.value: Phew! That was a lot more complicated than I thought!

SinkAndMirror_02.value: But you did good, Maddie! Real good.

SinkAndMirror_03.value: I even avoided mixing up the different colored pipes this time!
