Speakeasy01_Intro_01.value: Huh... I have to admit, I’m slightly disappointed.

Speakeasy01_Intro_07.value: I’ve studied the blueprints of this mansion quite extensively, and this spot shouldn’t have a room.

Speakeasy01_Intro_08.value: Every architect back at university studies this mansion for its unique design.

Speakeasy01_Intro_11.value: I have an idea. Don’t worry, I think... I think I know of a way to save the mansion!

Speakeasy01_Intro_13.value: Hmph... There he goes... Why can’t anyone ever give me a straight answer?

Speakeasy02_01.value: Well, well, well... look what we have here. More money!

Speakeasy02_02.value: And just like the notes in the Lounge, they're counterfeit.

Speakeasy02_04.value: I'm sure this room has something to do with Leonard and his shady business!

Speakeasy03_01.value: I wonder what this fuse box connects to?

Speakeasy03_02.value: Hmm... all the fuses are missing. I should look around and see if I can find them.

Speakeasy03_03.value: There's a little sketch that explains what goes where at least. I should look around and see if I can find the fuses.

Speakeasy03_04.value: Maybe if I get it running again, it’ll turn on whatever it’s supposed to power!

Speakeasy04_01.value: There’s a lot of strange stuff in here...

Speakeasy04_02.value: Quite similar in a way to the dance floor, actually.

Speakeasy04_03.value: What was up with those mannequins, though? I could swear one of their outfits looked like Winston's.

Speakeasy04_04.value: And I’m assuming the other one is L. L for Lionheart? That doesn't sound like an actual name...

Speakeasy04_05.value: They have to represent the couple with the secret relationship!

Speakeasy05_02.value: Putting that first fuse in place, activated the-

Speakeasy05_04.value: Wait, a minute! There was a Lounge, a dance floor...

Speakeasy05_06.value: Finally... I’ve been asking Winnie to fix that thing for ages. Good job.

Speakeasy05_07.value: You! You're from the painting in the Lounge! You're Leonard!

Speakeasy06_01.value: Right you are. You must be Maddie. I've heard that you're the one to save us all... Ha!

Speakeasy06_02.value: Leonard. What are you doing here?

Speakeasy06_04.value: No. I mean here! At the mansion!

Speakeasy06_05.value: I belong here more than you do, little girl.

Speakeasy06_06.value: Oh really? Then I should thank you for keeping it in such good shape!

Speakeasy07_01.value: Aaah. The refreshing taste of Hopeberries. I knew Winnie would stash a box in here.

Speakeasy07_02.value: Good thing I found it before they tear this wretched place down...

Speakeasy07_03.value: Hold on. You know about the Mayor’s plans? About turning it into a casino?!

Speakeasy07_04.value: My dear little girl... Who do you think gave him the idea?

Speakeasy07_05.value: How can you be so... so...

Speakeasy07_06.value: Nonchalant? Uncaring? Callous? I’ve been called worse...

Speakeasy07_07.value: But this is your home! Grandma’s home!

Speakeasy07_08.value: If she cared so much, she wouldn't have left it to me for all these years...

Speakeasy07_09.value: Hmm? What’s that? You don’t know? She won’t tell you? Pshhh.

Speakeasy07_10.value: Better get used to it, little girl. Your grandmother is the very reason we’re in this mess.

Speakeasy07_11.value: But don’t worry... I’ve finally come up with a plan that’ll save this ungrateful family.

Speakeasy08_01.value: A plan? From what I’ve seen and heard, each and every harebrained plan of yours has failed!

Speakeasy08_02.value: I guess this little “establishment” of yours was also one of your “great ideas.”

Speakeasy08_03.value: Yet it still didn’t save you from squandering all the family money.

Speakeasy08_05.value: Grandma, of course. Right before she told me you tried to blackmail her, too!

Speakeasy08_07.value: Then tell me what did happen! Be the first one in this family to give me a straight answer.

Speakeasy08_08.value: I don’t need to explain myself to you, Ursula, or anybody. Hmpf...

Speakeasy08_09.value: Winnie was right about this family. None of you understand...

Speakeasy08_12.value: Whe- Where’d you hear that name?!

Speakeasy09_01.value: You and Winston! You’re the ones in those letters by the swing! W+L!

Speakeasy09_03.value: But Winston said that you two had a falling out. I never realized it meant...

Speakeasy09_04.value: How... How could you do this? How could you be so heartless?

Speakeasy09_05.value: You have no idea what I’ve been through...

Speakeasy09_06.value: Not only have you broken Grandma’s heart, but you broke the heart of the only person who ever truly loved you...

Speakeasy09_07.value: Is that why you want to get rid of this place? To get rid of those hurtful memories?

Speakeasy10_01.value: Not quite the conversation I was expecting to have with my grandniece! I knew you would only cause problems.

Speakeasy10_02.value: In fact, I’m quite inclined to end it right now. You bore me...

Speakeasy10_03.value: Not a ray of sunshine yourself, old man.

Speakeasy10_04.value: Right. If I were you, I’d really take the Mayor up on his offer...

Speakeasy10_05.value: You might not get another chance!

Speakeasy11_01.value: Let's see what this next fuse does...

Speakeasy11_02.value: This room is so unexpected; I can't even predict what it could be!

Speakeasy12.2_01.value: Well, I managed to get it all shiny again, but it's probably just a very unique disco ball?

Speakeasy12.2_02.value: I mean, considering the context of this room and the previous one...

Speakeasy12.2_03.value: W-wait! I see something at the base, almost like a button?

Speakeasy12.3_01.value: Oh my! I did not expect it to open up...

Speakeasy12.3_02.value: And there's a beautiful crystal heart inside!

Speakeasy12.3_03.value: Ooh, an inscription - "You will always have my heart, Winnie."

Speakeasy12.3_04.value: This has to have been made by Leonard. A hidden heart, how symbolic.

Speakeasy12.3_05.value: Does this mean that he actually has a heart under all those layers?

Speakeasy12.3_06.value: Hmph. Remains to be seen, I think.

Speakeasy12_01.value: WOW! Wh-what is this? It looks like a crystal ball...

Speakeasy12_02.value: Even underneath all the dust, it's so ornate!

Speakeasy12_04.value: Let's get this cleaned up and take a better look.

Speakeasy13.1_01.value: Ah! It looks like the jukebox screen has been updated to a modern one.

Speakeasy13.1_02.value: It's possible that it broke, and they couldn't find the original parts anymore...

Speakeasy13.1_03.value: Ooh, there are plenty of old songs here that I've only ever heard Grandma mention!

Speakeasy13.1_04.value: I guess Leonard and Grandma have something in common after all.

Speakeasy13_02.value: I'm starting to get used to things popping out of the ground...

Speakeasy13_03.value: I've never seen a jukebox like this. Looks like it's straight out of a movie set!

Speakeasy13_04.value: And a tad bit too futuristic for this room. Hmm, I wonder if there's a significance...

Speakeasy14_01.value: Another room without an exit in sight!

Speakeasy14_03.value: If I just take it easy, I'm sure I'll find a way out somehow.

Speakeasy15.2_01.value: I think this jukebox was upgraded to act like a password input device...

Speakeasy15.2_04.value: The table! That wasn't an infinity sign; it's a number eight!

Speakeasy15.2_05.value: There has to be more numbers hidden in plain sight around this room...

Speakeasy15.2_06.value: There! Another one on the drink dispenser and...

Speakeasy15.2_07.value: On the side of the fridge!

Speakeasy15.2_08.value: How do I guess the correct order though?

Speakeasy15.2_09.value: Hmm, I'm just going to add them in the same order I fixed them.

Speakeasy15_01.value: I just noticed this paper on the fridge.

Speakeasy15_03.value: I wonder... could this be a clue?

Speakeasy15_04.value: I-I think I should probably check the jukebox again. It's the only music related thing in the room.

Speakeasy16_01.value: What!! That's amazing! The fridge is finally open!

Speakeasy16_02.value: And it's the path to another room? Who would've thought!

Speakeasy16_03.value: Wow, I never imagined I'd be standing inside a fridge...

Speakeasy16_07.value: Maddie, I never heard back from you....

Speakeasy16_08.value: Bruno. I thought I told you-

Speakeasy16_09.value: Well, I've decided to take matters into my own hands.

Speakeasy16_10.value: My construction company is at the mansion, taking the required measurements before they start their work.

Speakeasy16_12.value: Not at all. I just sent you a photo...

Speakeasy16_13.value: What?! You cannot just trespass on my property!

Speakeasy16_14.value: I'm the mayor, Maddie. I can do whatever I want. *Click*

Speakeasy16_15.value: I can't believe he'd stoop so low! Does it never end?!

Speakeasy16_16.value: I hope Roddy returns with the evidence we need...

SpeakeasyChestFound_01.value: Aha! A fully stocked bucket of beverages and garnishes!

SpeakeasyChestFound_02.value: I've always wanted to try my hand at crafting custom beverages!

SpeakeasyFridge_01.value: Here's another thing that doesn't quite seem to fit in...

SpeakeasyFridge_02.value: This fridge feels a lot more modern than the rest of the room. Kind of like the jukebox.

SpeakeasyFridge_03.value: And it's stuck! The door doesn't budge.

SpeakeasyFridge_04.value: I hope there wasn't anything left inside...

SpeakeasyJukebox_01.value: Hmm... this jukebox is pretty custom.

SpeakeasyJukebox_02.value: There's an assortment of parts that you wouldn't normally find here...

SpeakeasyJukebox_03.value: Definitely feels like someone upgraded it.

SpeakeasyJukebox_04.value: Funny thing is, none of the buttons seem to play any music.

SpeakeasyMarbleTable_01.value: This marble table has an interesting pattern...

SpeakeasyMarbleTable_02.value: It almost looks like an infinity sign!

SpeakeasyMiniGameIntro_01.value: Oh, look! Another set of cards!

SpeakeasyMiniGameIntro_02.value: Hmm, it wouldn't hurt to take a little break and indulge in a game.

SpeakeasyMiniGameIntro_03.value: Let's see what's in the cards for me!

SpeakeasyMiniGameOutro_01.value: Looks like I still got it!

SpeakeasyMiniGameOutro_02.value: Now, let's get back to fixing up this room...

Speakeasy_Easel_02.value: Looks like someone had painter's block!

Speakeasy_Fuses_01.value: Here we are! There's a couple of fuses here!

Speakeasy_Fuses_02.value: And they're all a different color!

Speakeasy_Fuses_03.value: Finally! Now I can see what the fuse box powers...

Speakeasy_Trophies_01.value: These trophies look quite cheap, and they're all for trivia quizzes?

Speakeasy_Trophies_02.value: Huh. Seems like they were awarded to a Lenny, and they all took place at a local Hopewell Bay restaurant.

Speakeasy_Trophies_03.value: I suppose these are Leonard's. But why would this have such sentimental value?

Speakeasy_Wall_01.value: Hmm... Under all this junk, the room itself seems to have a lot of nice trimmings.

Speakeasy_Wall_03.value: Why would a hidden room like this be so elaborate?

Speakeasy_Wall_04.value: Speaking of which, I’m no architect, but even I can see that this wall seems out of place!

Speakeasycharactertask1_01.value: I'm heading to the garden next.

Speakeasycharactertask1_02.value: The gardener probably sees everything that goes on around here!

Speakeasycharactertask1_03.value: I hope my gardening skills are believable...

Speakeasycharactertask1_04.value: Don't worry, I can always guide you!

Speakeasycharactertask2_01.value: I didn't learn as much as I wanted on that mission...

Speakeasycharactertask2_02.value: But I did hear that there's a gala at the town hall today!

Speakeasycharactertask2_03.value: I've always wanted to try my hand at crafting custom drinks!

Speakeasycharactertask3_01.value: Everyone's busy at the gala, so I can finally slip away.

Speakeasycharactertask3_02.value: I'm sure I can get into Bruno's office!

Speakeasycharactertask3_03.value: This sounds a bit risky, Jackie. Be careful!

Speakeasycharactertaskintro_01.value: Maddie! You won't believe it! I finally got assigned to something big!

Speakeasycharactertaskintro_03.value: Well, we have a new editor at the Hopewell Bay Times. Real investigative type...

Speakeasycharactertaskintro_04.value: She's looking into Victoria and Bruno and all their dealings.

Speakeasycharactertaskintro_05.value: The best part is that she picked me to go undercover! Will you help?

Speakeasycharactertaskintro_06.value: No way! I'm in! Those two need to be taken down...

Speakeasycharactertaskintro_07.value: I knew you would be! I think I can find a way inside the town hall, but I'll need to change my look!

Speakeasycharactertaskoutro_02.value: The security guard almost discovered me, but I managed to escape.

Speakeasycharactertaskoutro_03.value: Did you find what you needed?

Speakeasycharactertaskoutro_04.value: I hope so. I grabbed a bunch of files that looked important, but I'll have to go over it back at the office!

Speakeasycharactertaskoutro_05.value: Thanks for all your help, Maddie! I'll keep you updated.

SpyRoom_02_01.value: Huh... Not exactly what I was expecting.

SpyRoom_02_03.value: It looks pretty empty too. Usually, these sorts of hidden rooms are filled with stuff, right?

SpyRoom_02_04.value: Unless... Could it possibly be some sort of panic room?

SpyRoom_02_05.value: Hmm? What would make you say that?

SpyRoom_02_06.value: Look at this! It’s a medicine cabinet. Maybe this was some sort of safe room to escape to?

SpyRoom_02_07.value: I mean, one of these vials is labeled “antidote”...

SpyRoom_02_08.value: Okay, that tracks. But why the elaborate doorway? I don’t know...

SpyRoom_02_09.value: I think there’s more to this room!

SpyRoom_03_02.value: What? The random portraits with targets drawn on them?

SpyRoom_03_03.value: Or the whole assortment of decoding equipment?

SpyRoom_03_08.value: Well, no... But it’s not altogether unbelievable, after what I’ve dug up in the mansion.

SpyRoom_03_10.value: If that’s true... who were they working for?

SpyRoom_04_01.value: There are tons of notes here! Maybe we can find out something about their organization?

SpyRoom_04_02.value: I'm not entirely sure because they're all in code.

SpyRoom_04_03.value: Hmm, this journal has some names crossed out. Looks a bit sinister!

SpyRoom_04_04.value: Hey, look, there's a date circled in red in here and a note that says:

SpyRoom_04_05.value: "They're getting closer, time to go dark."

SpyRoom_04_06.value: Oh, my! This was around the time Charlie disappeared!

SpyRoom_04_07.value: Who do you think "they" refers to?

SpyRoom_04_08.value: I don't know, but I hope I find out. It could help me get one step closer to seeing Grandpa Charlie again.

SpyRoom_05_01.value: Hmm... Looks like they were researching this plant.

SpyRoom_05_03.value: Do you think this has something to do with the notes we found earlier?

SpyRoom_05_04.value: Most likely... But I’m unsure if this is a poison or...

SpyRoom_05_06.value: You think they were trying to protect themselves?

SpyRoom_05_08.value: This must be the stuff in the “antidote” vials in the medicine cabinet, right? Don’t worry.

SpyRoom_06_01.value: That looks like one expensive diamond! How did they get their hands on this?

SpyRoom_06_02.value: Hmm, on closer inspection, I don't think it's a diamond. It looks more like Boultonite!

SpyRoom_06_04.value: Yeah! It's the gem that powers the mystery machine!

SpyRoom_06_05.value: Wow, sounds like it can be pretty powerful!

SpyRoom_06_06.value: For sure. I wonder if it powers anything in here...

SpyRoom_07_01.value: You know... I think we’d make pretty excellent spies!

SpyRoom_07_02.value: Haha! And what would be your codename? Double oh negative?

SpyRoom_07_04.value: I’m just teasing Roddy! So, super spy, what’s our codenames?
I’m just teasing, Roddy! So, super spy, what are our codenames?

SpyRoom_07_05.value: Well, I was thinking... “The Architect” and you could be-

SpyRoom_07_07.value: Hold on a sec, someone’s calling.

SpyRoom_07_10.value: Could you... Just give me a sec?

SpyRoom_08_01.value: Arthur! Hey, I’m sort of busy right now and-

SpyRoom_08_02.value: Mads! I had SUCH A GREAT TIME at the beach!

SpyRoom_08_03.value: It was just like old times, remember?

SpyRoom_08_05.value: Riight? That’s why I was thinking we should do it again! I’ll let you pick the spot this time!
Right? That’s why I was thinking we should do it again! I’ll let you pick the spot this time!

SpyRoom_08_07.value: No, just kidding! I booked us a table at that nice little fusion restaurant that you loved!

SpyRoom_08_08.value: Arthur! That’s out of state! I-

SpyRoom_08_09.value: I know that’s why I’m thinking we could stay at a nearby BnB. We could make it a weekend!

SpyRoom_08_10.value: I... I’m really busy right now and-

SpyRoom_08_12.value: Oh! Er... Sorry, I thought you needed my help.

SpyRoom_08_14.value: I’ll... I’ll just step over here and er... Wait.

SpyRoom_08_16.value: Arthur?! Oh, sorry. I’m... Look, can I call you back? Now’s not a great time.

SpyRoom_08_17.value: No problem! Talk to you soon!

SpyRoom_09_03.value: I wonder what is about? Looking into the future?

SpyRoom_09_06.value: Love, Maddie. These two have got to be your grandparents. Look at ‘em!

SpyRoom_09_07.value: You know what, Roddy? I think you’re right.

SpyRoom_10_01.value: This is so cool! A simple mural hiding a whole world map?

SpyRoom_10_02.value: Check out these pins on the map, what could they mean?

SpyRoom_10_03.value: Hmm, I'm pretty sure it has something to do with their mission locations!

SpyRoom_10_04.value: Wow! They travelled to some pretty interesting places, far and wide!

SpyRoom_10_05.value: Yeah, some of those locations correspond to the pictures I've seen of them in the walk-in closet.

SpyRoom_10_06.value: Now it makes sense why they were dressed in trench coats and hats...

SpyRoom_11_02.value: Yeah... This sort of settles it, doesn’t it?

SpyRoom_11_03.value: I had my suspicions, but honestly, this goes beyond my wildest imagination.

SpyRoom_11_04.value: Oh, I don’t know... Who doesn’t have international super spies as their grandparents?

SpyRoom_11_05.value: Roddy... I need to take a minute. My head is spinning.

SpyRoom_11_09.value: The pillar? It seems to be moving!

SpyRoom_12_01.value: Gotta admit, your grandparents had some style!

SpyRoom_12_02.value: This mansion sure loves its secret bars...
This mansion sure loves its hidden doors...

SpyRoom_12_03.value: Want a drink? I know a fitting cocktail?
Want a drink? I know a fitting mocktail!

SpyRoom_13_01.value: Wow! Look at all of this stuff!

SpyRoom_13_02.value: You got gold bars, passports. Even license plates!

SpyRoom_13_03.value: I found the car keys those plates belong to...

SpyRoom_13_04.value: You think there’s a secret garage somewhere, housing dozens of vintage sports cars?!

SpyRoom_13_05.value: They really thought of everything, didn’t they?

SpyRoom_13_06.value: Everything you’d need to survive a mission, I guess.

SpyRoom_14_01.value: You know, Maddie, there was something in those folders earlier that is still on my mind...

SpyRoom_14_03.value: In each photo, they're positioned near specific artifacts...

SpyRoom_14_04.value: When I cross-referenced those with the poison research notes...

SpyRoom_14_05.value: Every single one of those artifacts later appeared in reports about poisoning incidents.

SpyRoom_14_06.value: Woah! So the artifacts carried the poison?!

SpyRoom_14_07.value: Yeah, I think your grandparents were tracking a criminal network!

SpyRoom_14_08.value: Wow, that means that they were studying them to create antidotes and protect potential victims!

SpyRoom_15_03.value: This pedestal... it must have a purpose.

SpyRoom_15_05.value: I don’t know, but looking at it closer, I think the indentation matches the shape of the Boultonite Gem!

SpyRoom_15_06.value: Really? What do you think it does?

SpyRoom_15_07.value: I have no idea. But I think you’re supposed to place the gem on it!

SpyRoom_15_08.value: I guess it’s worth a shot. It can’t do anything bad, right?

SpyRoom_16_03.value: I need to find out who their tailor was....

SpyRoom_16_04.value: Look at this! The umbrella has an electric shock tip for self-defense!

SpyRoom_16_06.value: If you look closer, almost everything on these outfits has a hidden purpose. Look at these high heels.

SpyRoom_16_07.value: Wow, they have a glass breaker on the heel tip!

SpyRoom_16_08.value: Hmm... Probably smart not to touch anything, just in case.

SpyRoom_17_01.value: Well, that’s it. Yet I can’t help but feel like I’m left with even more questions!

SpyRoom_17_02.value: You mean who your grandparents were working for and what their mission was?

SpyRoom_17_03.value: Yeah, and I’m pretty sure if I’d asked Grandma about it, she probably would have denied it.

SpyRoom_17_04.value: She wouldn’t be a good spy if she wouldn’t!
She wouldn’t be a good spy if she didn’t!

SpyRoom_17_06.value: Do you think she’s STILL working as a spy?

SpyRoom_17_07.value: I... I don’t know. That research on the antidote looked somewhat fresh.

SpyRoom_17_08.value: True... But at least it’s an antidote and not a poison. I just need to trust her in this.
True... But at least it’s an antidote and not a poison. I just need to trust her on this.

SpyRoom_17_10.value: Maddie. I couldn't help but overhear a bit of your conversation with Arthur.

SpyRoom_17_11.value: And... You shouldn’t trust him. He’s bad news. You know this.

SpyRoom_17_12.value: Roddy, please trust me. I know what I’m doing.

SpyRoom_17_13.value: If you say so... Hey, should we head back to the tin can factory?

SpyRoom_17_14.value: Maybe it’s time to check out the hidden floor we discovered on the blueprints.

SpyRoom_17_15.value: Good idea! And we should check up on Julius and see how he’s holding up.

SpyRoom_CharacterTask1_01.value: Winston?! What are you doing... Wait. You don't look surprised at all! Did you know about this room already?

SpyRoom_CharacterTask1_02.value: What can I say, ma'am. I didn't know about it, but it falls squarely within my expectations for your family.

SpyRoom_CharacterTask1_03.value: But that's not why I'm here. Ahem... I've agreed to a social engagement, Madam.

SpyRoom_CharacterTask1_04.value: A date?! Winston, that's amazing! Is this the first... after Leonard?

SpyRoom_CharacterTask1_05.value: Indeed. It's been a significant interval. I'm afraid I'm not exactly up to date with current practices.

SpyRoom_CharacterTask1_06.value: The etiquette for 'swiping right' is entirely absent from my training.

SpyRoom_CharacterTask1_07.value: First of all, we never need to discuss you 'swiping right'. Ever.

SpyRoom_CharacterTask1_08.value: And second, being nervous just means you care. That's a good thing!

SpyRoom_CharacterTask1_09.value: A charitable interpretation. Thank you, Madam.

SpyRoom_CharacterTask2_01.value: There is a more practical dilemma left. My wardrobe. It is... very functional.

SpyRoom_CharacterTask2_02.value: We can fix it. Let's find you something that says "charming date", not "on duty".

SpyRoom_CharacterTask2_03.value: Very well. But I draw the line at anything called a "hoodie".

SpyRoom_CharacterTask2_04.value: Deal. We'll aim for classic and comfortable. Think relaxed, not stiff.

SpyRoom_CharacterTask2_05.value: A novel concept. I feel a fashion emergency coming on.

SpyRoom_CharacterTask2_06.value: It's not an emergency. It's an upgrade. Trust me.

SpyRoom_CharacterTask3_01.value: Done! You'll look great. Now, we need a small gift. A token. To show you thought of them.

SpyRoom_CharacterTask3_02.value: A token... I suppose flowers are the standard.

SpyRoom_CharacterTask3_03.value: Flowers are perfect. Everyone loves flowers.

SpyRoom_CharacterTask3_04.value: A safe choice. Is a bouquet enough? I still feel like I should bring more.

SpyRoom_CharacterTask3_05.value: How about a flower and a small box of chocolates? Cover all bases!

SpyRoom_CharacterTask3_06.value: Flowers and confectionery. A two-pronged approach to hospitality. I approve.

SpyRoom_CharacterTask4_01.value: The gifts are ready. And yet, my nerves persist. I feel... exposed.

SpyRoom_CharacterTask4_02.value: First-date jitters. That's totally normal, we need a confidence boost.

SpyRoom_CharacterTask4_03.value: Maybe a little self-care. A skincare routine!

SpyRoom_CharacterTask4_04.value: You wish to moisturize me into bravery?

SpyRoom_CharacterTask4_05.value: Exactly! And then we'll find a scent. Something new, for the new you.

SpyRoom_CharacterTask5_01.value: I must admit, I feel... noticeably improved. Lighter, somehow. Thank you, ma'am.

SpyRoom_CharacterTask5_02.value: You look fantastic. Seriously. You're going to be wonderful.

SpyRoom_CharacterTask5_03.value: Yes, I'll avoid discussing silver polish all evening. A firm rule.

SpyRoom_CharacterTask5_04.value: That's the spirit. Now go and have a nice time!

SpyRoom_CharacterTask5_05.value: I shall endeavor to do so. Good evening, Madam.

SpyRoom_Intro_01.value: Maddie, remember the other time we discovered a secret room together?

SpyRoom_Intro_02.value: I’m actually wondering about these flowers on the frame!
How could I forget? That dance floor mechanism that triggered the door was pretty cool!

SpyRoom_Intro_03.value: Notice how one of them is a lily?
We somehow always manage to figure it out together!

SpyRoom_Intro_04.value: Heh... we sure do, Maddie. I'm glad you see tha-

SpyRoom_Intro_05.value: That’s Grandma’s favourite flower! Something Grandpa always gave her.
That lily ornament we used to enter, I'm more convinced now that it could be Grandma's alias!

SpyRoom_Intro_06.value: Then I guess this other one would represent your grandfather?
Then I guess this other flower would represent your grandfather?

SpyRoom_Intro_07.value: I... I think so! I guess it means that whatever is in there was important to both of them.
I... I think so! I guess it means that whatever is in here was important to both of them.

SpyRoom_POI_Blueprint_01.value: Roddy, look at this. It's a blueprint of the Tin Can Factory!

SpyRoom_POI_Blueprint_02.value: The structural detailing is excellent. But... this doesn't match the public records.

SpyRoom_POI_Blueprint_03.value: Look here. This shows a whole sub-basement level. A secret floor?

SpyRoom_POI_Blueprint_04.value: A completely concealed level. What were they building there?

SpyRoom_POI_Blueprint_05.value: Or hiding? It holds the next secret. I just know it.

SpyRoom_POI_Briefcase_01.value: Hmm, it's interesting that this briefcase was hidden away when it looks so... normal?

SpyRoom_POI_Briefcase_02.value: Yeah, it looks like something my professor in university would use.

SpyRoom_POI_Briefcase_03.value: Ooh wait! Not just a simple briefcase, it seems. The lock is concealed!

SpyRoom_POI_Briefcase_05.value: One doesn't! Knowing Grandpa Charlie, it looks like it involves some elaborate lock picking!

SpyRoom_POI_FloorLights_01.value: Whoa! The entire floor just lit up!

SpyRoom_POI_FloorLights_02.value: Grandma and Grandpa really were serving style decades before it was cool!

SpyRoom_POI_FloorLights_03.value: I would expect nothing less from a room for spies!

SpyRoom_POI_RobotFish_01.value: Is that a... fish? With a camera lens for an eye?

SpyRoom_POI_RobotFish_02.value: An aquatic surveillance drone. It's built to look like a local species.

SpyRoom_POI_RobotFish_03.value: So my grandparents were spying on... fish? Or using fish to spy on people?

SpyRoom_POI_RobotFish_04.value: Harbors, docks, private boats. Waterfront meetings. This little guy could get footage no person could.

SpyRoom_POI_RobotFish_05.value: Huh. It's kind of adorable. In a deeply unsettling, invasive way.

StableDoor_02.value: Well, that hasn't stopped me before with the mansion.

StableDoor_03.value: I mean sure... It took a while, but I got in eventually!

StablesextIntro_01.value: Here we are, ma'am. The family ranch...

StablesextIntro_02.value: It's huge! How did I have no idea this existed?

StablesextIntro_03.value: It is a little ways away from the mansion, ma'am.

StablesextIntro_04.value: I have to say, it's been a long time since I've seen a horse in these parts.

StablesextIntro_05.value: I suppose that changes today. Ma'am, I'd like to introduce you to our mischievous culprit.

StablesextIntro_06.value: Aww, you're all covered in mud!

StablesextIntro_08.value: Well, that's what you get for mucking about in the garden.

StablesextIntro_10.value: Haha, she's a stubborn one isn't she?

StablesextIntro_11.value: That's one way to put it...

StablesextRanchbag_02.value: This should be enough mulch to grow some trees!

Stablesext_02_01.value: She's a Boulton Blue, after all.

Stablesext_02_03.value: They're a particularly rare breed that your great-grandparents bred for show jumping.

Stablesext_02_04.value: How do you know for certain, Winston?

Stablesext_02_05.value: It's the platinum mane, ma'am. That and the lean, muscular build.

Stablesext_02_06.value: And underneath all that mud, you'll find a supremely shiny coat!

Stablesext_02_07.value: I remember the Blues back in my younger days. They all had these very characteristics.

Stablesext_02_09.value: Unfortunately, they were all sold after Lenny- I mean, your great-uncle came under investigation...

Stablesext_02_10.value: Y-you know about the investigation? And how were the horses involved?

Stablesext_02_11.value: There was a, um, suspicion about race fixing, which-

Stablesext_02_12.value: Which isn't legal. Yeah, I get the gist.

Stablesext_03_01.value: That brings us back to this filly here, descendant of the great Boulton Blues.

Stablesext_03_02.value: I guess you could say she found her way back home.

Stablesext_03_04.value: Well, she certainly seems to agree with you!

Stablesext_03_05.value: Hello there, girl. My name is Maddie. What can I call you?

Stablesext_03_07.value: Not too keen on names, are we?

Stablesext_03_10.value: Okay okay, I get it!  What about something stronger to match your personality?

Stablesext_04_01.value: Now that that's settled, I'll leave you two to get better acquainted.

Stablesext_04_03.value: I'll keep an eye on the mansion, ma'am. As is my duty.

Stablesext_04_04.value: If there's anyone who can work with a stubborn Boulton Blue, it's you.

Stablesext_04_06.value: Well, he's right, you know. Us Boulton girls have to stick together!

Stablesext_05_01.value: You must be absolutely famished if you were after Grandma's petunias.

Stablesext_05_02.value: Poor thing, all alone and hungry-

Stablesext_05_03.value: Reggie loves head scratches, perhaps you do too?

Stablesext_05_05.value: Oh, maybe not yet. You're right, we need to get to know each other better!

Stablesext_05_06.value: Like, what's your favorite snack? Mine's chocolate. Is yours... carrots?

Stablesext_05_08.value: Haha, I don't like them too much either. Apples?

Stablesext_05_10.value: Brilliant! Here's a delicious apple, just for you.

Stablesext_06_01.value: You know, Babylon. I, too, found my way back here, to the mansion.

Stablesext_06_02.value: You and me have a lot more in common than you think...

Stablesext_06_03.value: I'm sure you had some trying times too, huh, girl?

Stablesext_06_05.value: People like Victoria and Mayor Bruno think they can prey on innocent folk...

Stablesext_06_06.value: I've had it! We'll show them! Right?

Stablesext_06_08.value: Sorry, girl, I got carried away.

Stablesext_06_09.value: Look at me rambling along when there's so much to do!

Stablesext_06_10.value: Let's get this ranch back up and running and get you cleaned up!

Stablesext_07_01.value: There's plenty of water here to get you all clean.

Stablesext_07_03.value: Oh come on, girl. Don't be like that. Wouldn't it be nice to get rid of all that mud?

Stablesext_07_05.value: I promise you'll thank me at the end of this!

Stablesext_07_07.value: Exactly, let's get this over with as quickly as possible.

Stablesext_07_08.value: A scrub here, and a scrub there, and let's not forget behind the ears!

Stablesext_07_10.value: Phew, that was a bit of an ordeal, but look at you, Babylon!

Stablesext_07_11.value: I can see what Winston meant about that shiny coat; you're practically glowing!

Stablesext_09_01.value: Alright! Let's get you across this bridge so that we can-

Stablesext_09_02.value: Um, why aren't you following me, Babylon?

Stablesext_09_05.value: What's wrong, girl? Oh, you don't like the bridge?

Stablesext_09_07.value: Ahh! You're afraid of the water! No wonder you hated getting scrubbed!

Stablesext_10_02.value: You're worried about what could happen, right? I'm going through the same thing.

Stablesext_10_03.value: I'm worried sick that my grandma, the only family I've ever known, will be put away for good!

Stablesext_10_04.value: I'm afraid I'm going to lose everything I care for!

Stablesext_10_05.value: But there is one thing she taught me that always helps me face my fears!

Stablesext_10_06.value: "Boulton girls never back away from a challenge!"

Stablesext_10_07.value: Last time I checked, you're a Boulton Blue! Practically family!

Stablesext_10_08.value: So, how about we both dig deep... and cross this bridge together!

Stablesext_11_04.value: Well done, girl! I knew you could! You deserve all the apples!

Stablesext_11_05.value: See, there's no challenge a Boulton can't face together!

Stablesext_11_07.value: Come to think of it... I can't keep handling things alone. I need to learn to ask for help...

Stablesext_11_09.value: Ha! Don't worry, girl. I was just talking to myself.

Stablesext_12_01.value: Here we are! The training ground.

Stablesext_12_02.value: Any of this look familiar, Babylon?

Stablesext_12_04.value: I wonder how many champions were trained here...

Stablesext_12_06.value: Oh, I see... You're planning on being the first?

Stablesext_13_01.value: I don't know about you, but I'm dead beat!

Stablesext_13_03.value: Well, lucky for you, I've made this wonderful hay bed for you.

Stablesext_13_04.value: Only the finest hay for a Boulton Girl...

Stablesext_13_06.value: Oh, don't give me that look. It's really comfy. I promise!

Stablesext_13_11.value: Sorry, Babylon, I have to go. I'll be back very soon. Promise me that you won't make a mess?

Stablesextcharactertask1_01.value: I should warn you, I may be good at renovating, but I'm a terrible cook!

Stablesextcharactertask2_01.value: Hmm... It looks like your braids are all tangled up. Let's fix those!

Stablesextcharactertask2_03.value: Hey! I promise, It's not going to hurt!

Stablesextcharactertask3_01.value: Geez, you're like a magnet for dust!

Stablesextcharactertask3_02.value: Looks like I'll be brushing you a lot.

Stablesextcharactertask4_01.value: Let's see what you got, girl!

Stablesextcharactertask5_02.value: You collect A LOT of dust and hay.

Stablesextcharactertask5_03.value: Looks like we're going to have to brush you again!

Stablesextcharactertask6_01.value: *Yaaawn!* Alrighty, I guess we can start calling it a day.

Stablesextcharactertask6_03.value: Horses have a lot more energy than I thought...

Stablesextcharactertask7_01.value: You know what they say, girl? An apple a day keeps the doctor away...

Stablesextcharactertask7_03.value: Haven't heard that one I suppose.

Stablesextcharactertask7_04.value: I'll make sure you're in the prime of health!

Stablesextranchbag2_01.value: Hmm I can use this mulch for much more!

Stablesextranchbag2_02.value: Maybe some veggies. Carrots and tomatoes would thrive here!

Stablesextranchreached_01.value: Wow, so this is the family ranch! I'm impressed!

Stablesextranchreached_02.value: Needs a little love and care, of course. But, I'm up for the challenge!

Stablesextranchreached_03.value: I guess I should start cleaning up a little before Winston gets here...

StablesexttravelIntro_01.value: I'm so glad Winston managed to find me this sweet ride! It's such a pretty color too!

StablesexttravelIntro_02.value: Who knew that Grandma's bike collection involved this cutie as well.

StablesexttravelIntro_03.value: According to Winston's directions, the ranch isn't too far from here, and he's supposed to meet me there.

StablesexttravelIntro_04.value: Alright, let's hope I still remember how to use one of these...

StablesexttravelIntro_05.value: Engine? Check. Mirror? Check. Helmet? Check.

Stablesinterior02_01.value: I tried to reason with them, Ma’am. But-

Stablesinterior02_03.value: Len... Mister Boulton, you must listen-

Stablesinterior02_04.value: I see you have taken sides with her lot.

Stablesinterior02_05.value: Sir... Miss Boulton truly wants the best for your family, if you would only-

Stablesinterior02_06.value: Don’t try to explain yourself. You were never a good judge of character, anyway.

Stablesinterior02_08.value: Shush, girl. The adults are talking.

Stablesinterior02_10.value: Hahaha! No wonder your family is in such shambles, Leonard.

Stablesinterior03_01.value: First you bring in your goons to the Mansion and now this?

Stablesinterior03_02.value: If you must know, Leonard invited me.

Stablesinterior03_03.value: He has graciously offered to include the stables and the land around it as a part of the Mansion grounds.

Stablesinterior03_05.value: Maddie... Why do you think we had this ranch built in the first place?

Stablesinterior03_06.value: Boulton Blues are purebred race horses after all...

Stablesinterior03_07.value: This is how we save the family, Maddie!

Stablesinterior03_08.value: Once the casino and racecourse are built, Mayor Bruno has agreed to let me run it!

Stablesinterior03_09.value: It’s a win-win, Maddie! Why can’t you see that?

Stablesinterior03_11.value: How can you be so blind?!

Stablesinterior04_01.value: No, you are the one that is blind, little girl.

Stablesinterior04_02.value: *Ahem!* You mentioned something about a Boulton Blue?

Stablesinterior04_03.value: Ah, yes. The horse that is currently being held here, Babylon, I believe, is a thoroughbred.

Stablesinterior04_04.value: She would be perfect for the racecourse.

Stablesinterior04_05.value: Outstanding! And I’m sure we could breed more?

Stablesinterior04_07.value: I don’t believe what I’m hearing!

Stablesinterior04_09.value: Don’t be shocked, Maddie. A healthy mare like Babylon will-

Stablesinterior04_11.value: Whatever you’re planning, it stops now!

Stablesinterior05_01.value: I don’t care what Leonard has promised you, but I want the both of you out of here.

Stablesinterior05_03.value: Little girl, you don’t tell me what to-

Stablesinterior05_04.value: Miss Boulton has asked you to leave the premises...

Stablesinterior05_05.value: Winnie, you too? Do you really think any of this will amount to anything?

Stablesinterior05_06.value: The deal is as good as done. Why don’t you just stop this foolish belief in her and help me here?

Stablesinterior06_02.value: There's hoof prints everywhere! It looks like a horse went on an angry rampage...

Stablesinterior06_03.value: Oh my. It couldn't have been you. Right, Babylon?

Stablesinterior06_04.value: Maybe it was one of the previous occupants...

Stablesinterior06_06.value: Well, worry not! We can fix this right up!

Stablesinterior07_01.value: Sorry you got caught up in that mess, girl. Are you alright?

Stablesinterior07_03.value: Aww, I know. That must have been quite stressful.

Stablesinterior07_04.value: You don't have to worry. I promise I won't let anything happen to you or the Ranch.

Stablesinterior07_05.value: No one is turning this into a racecourse. Not on my watch!

Stablesinterior08_01.value: Hmm... I know you don't like a lot of change, Babylon, but this place will be good for you!

Stablesinterior08_03.value: You can't see it now but there's comfy stalls here!

Stablesinterior08_04.value: A place for food, water and ooh look! There's even a spot for the ranch hands to relax!

Stablesinterior08_05.value: You're sure to love it, trust me.

Stablesinterior09_01.value: I might be quite the expert on repairing things at this point, but I have no idea about this equipment...

Stablesinterior09_03.value: In fact, what is the best way to set a stable up for a horse?

Stablesinterior09_04.value: I'm out of my depth. Wait a minute, wasn't Deb an expert equestrian?

Stablesinterior09_05.value: If I remember correctly, she won many dressage competitions...

Stablesinterior09_06.value: I should give her a call...

Stablesinterior10_03.value: Yes, dear. You seemed quite desperate on the phone. I had to come down here and-

Stablesinterior10_05.value: Oh, yes, this is her - this is Babylon!

Stablesinterior10_07.value: Oh my, I would recognize that coat anywhere! Aren't you a beauty!

Stablesinterior10_09.value: She's a big fan of compliments, this one.

Stablesinterior10_10.value: Deb... there's so much equipment and-

Stablesinterior10_11.value: Oh, don't you worry, darling! Debbie's here now. I practically ran this place back in its prime!

Stablesinterior11_01.value: I'm guessing this is some kind of grinder?

Stablesinterior11_03.value: You see, animal feed needs to be milled and mixed to make sure it provides the right nutrition!

Stablesinterior11_04.value: It's like giving them a balanced diet?

Stablesinterior11_06.value: Well, I better fix this up if we want to maintain Babylon's shiny coat!

Stablesinterior12_01.value: Ooh, look at all these shiny trophies!

Stablesinterior12_02.value: Ah yes, I believe you'll find that most of those are mine.

Stablesinterior12_03.value: They sure are! Wow, it must have felt amazing to be a champion!

Stablesinterior12_04.value: It did, but it was my love for horses that made me stay in that career for so long.

Stablesinterior12_05.value: I couldn't imagine going a day without meeting my horse, Bastion.

Stablesinterior12_06.value: It's important for both horse and rider to have a connection, you know, and a great deal of trust.

Stablesinterior12_07.value: It's what makes those jumps so effortless!

Stablesinterior13_01.value: Did you have to train your own horse, Deb?

Stablesinterior13_02.value: Most definitely! And it wasn't easy!

Stablesinterior13_03.value: Some of them can be quite stubborn.

Stablesinterior13_04.value: I've definitely experienced some of that...

Stablesinterior14_01.value: What is this workbench doing in the middle of the stables?

Stablesinterior14_02.value: Well, back in time, we had a farrier who would visit the stables.

Stablesinterior14_03.value: He was an expert in metal work and horseshoe making.

Stablesinterior14_04.value: He even made sure to trim the horses hooves and fit them with shoes.

Stablesinterior14_05.value: Wow! That sounds important. It seems like this place was thriving back in the days?

Stablesinterior14_06.value: Most definitely, darling! But, Leonard, he was responsible for its downfall.

Stablesinterior15_01.value: You see, Leonard was intent on turning this place into a racecourse.

Stablesinterior15_02.value: A plan I didn't agree with. So, I made sure all the Boulton horses moved to better homes.

Stablesinterior15_03.value: And without any horses, there could be no racing!

Stablesinterior15_04.value: Wow, Deb! You're like a superhero!

Stablesinterior15_05.value: Oh, I only did what was necessary dear.

Stablesinterior15_06.value: It seems like Leonard still has the same dream. He tried to coerce me into converting this place to a racecourse too.

Stablesinterior15_07.value: What?! That Leonard. How he can call himself a Boulton, I'll never know!

Stablesinterior15_08.value: Should I be worried? It seems like he has some powerful friends...

Stablesinterior16_01.value: Well, I've known him all my life, and he's always cared more about money than family.

Stablesinterior16_03.value: Yes, Winston was the only person who could bring out his soft side.

Stablesinterior16_04.value: But, with that gone, Leonard has nothing to lose.

Stablesinterior16_05.value: And a desperate man is capable of anything,

Stablesinterior16_06.value: However, you have to stand your ground with Leonard and he will back down.

Stablesinterior16_07.value: I see what you mean. Thank you, Debbie. For your advice and for all your help with reviving the stables!

Stablesinterior16_08.value: Oh, you flatter me, darling! Also, if you want to learn more about the family, try the library!

Stablesinterior_Bellows_01.value: You know... These bellows remind me a bit of Leonard.

Stablesinterior_Bellows_03.value: He too is full of hot air!

Stablesinterior_Furnace_01.value: There we go... Nice and toasty!

Stablesinterior_Furnace_02.value: I guess it gets pretty cold in here, doesn’t it, Babylon?

Stablesinterior_Groomingkit_02.value: It sure is and it has all the grooming and equipment you'll need to fix up the stables!

Stablesinterior_Horsestalls_01.value: Pretty comfy looking stalls, don’t you think, Babylon?

Stablesinterior_Horsestalls_03.value: Okay, okay, you can get the middle one. I'll even make it extra fancy for you!

Stablesinterior_Intro_01.value: -and this is where the paddocks should be!

Stablesinterior_Intro_02.value: Amazing! You’ve really thought this through.

Stablesinterior_Intro_03.value: Well, I’ve been dreaming about it since we built this ranch. Thanks to you, it may finally happen.

Stablesinterior_Intro_04.value: May? Mr. Boulton, this WILL happen!

Stablesinterior_Intro_05.value: What will happen?! What are you two talking about?

Stablesinterior_Intro_06.value: Ah, Maddie, a pleasure, as always. We were only discussing our plans for this area.

Stablesinterior_Intro_07.value: What do you mean? This isn’t even part of the Mansion?!

Stablesinterior_Intro_08.value: What on earth would you want here?

Stablesinterior_Maddiemomtrophy_01.value: Wait, a minute... Rebecca Boulton! MOM!

Stablesinterior_Maddiemomtrophy_03.value: Yes, she did! She was quite the equestrian herself, you know!

Stablesinterior_Maddiemomtrophy_04.value: She even won a few championships!

Stablesinterior_Maddiemomtrophy_05.value: Wow, I had no idea. I wonder if I can find some pictures of her and her horse back at the mansion...

Stablesinterior_Riderequipment_01.value: Ooh, these riding boots look expensive!

Stablesinterior_Riderequipment_02.value: By the finest boot-makers in Europe... I had mine tailor-made.

Stablesinterior_Saddle_03.value: Yes, indeed. Custom and quilted even!

Stablesinterior_Slowfeeder_01.value: An equine slow feeder, just so you don’t gorge yourself!

Stablesinterior_Slowfeeder_03.value: Now, Babylon, she's right. This feeder will help you slow down and aid digestion.

Stablesinterior_Slowfeeder_04.value: Why don't you try it out?

Stablesinterior_Slowfeeder_06.value: There you go! Not so bad, was it?

Stablesinterior_Toolbox_01.value: You know... I’ve gotten pretty good at recognizing tools...

Stablesinterior_Travel_01.value: I sure hope Winston can hold the fort down till I get there.

Stablesinterior_Travel_02.value: Leonard and Bruno teaming up has become my worst nightmare!

Stablesinterior_Travel_03.value: Time to hurry over there quickly and put an end to their plotting!

Stablesinterior_Watertrough_02.value: Now, you have one indoors too!

Stablesinterior_Workbench_01.value: Shoeing a horse looks like a tough job.

Stablesinterior_Workbench_02.value: It’s not a walk in the park, sweetie, but someone’s got to do it.

Stablesinterior_Workbench_03.value: But, don’t worry! I don’t think Babylon is a kicker.

Stablesinteriorcharactertask2_01.value: I’ve been working out in the field for quite some time, now...

Stablesinteriorcharactertask2_02.value: Are you sure this is necessary?!

Stablesinteriorcharactertask2_03.value: It’s a pasture, sweetie. And yes, VERY necessary!

Stablesinteriorcharactertask2_04.value: Babylon isn’t a regular carriage horse, you know! She’s a Boulton Blue!

Stablesinteriorcharactertask3_01.value: In order for us to have a champion, we need to make sure they’re properly taken care of, Maddie.

Stablesinteriorcharactertask3_03.value: Maddie! You understand that these beautiful creatures demand the utmost respect!

Stablesinteriorcharactertask3_04.value: That’s why we keep feeding Babylon flowers?

Stablesinteriorcharactertask4_01.value: Is the practice dressage arena ready?

Stablesinteriorcharactertask4_03.value: Ah... I see. Follow me. Bring the nails and paint.

Stablesinteriorcharactertask4_05.value: We’re building the practice arena, of course!

Stablesinteriorcharactertask5_03.value: For your first riding lesson, Maddie!

Stablesinteriorcharactertask5_05.value: Come now, sweetie. You can’t take care of a horse and not know the basics?!

Stablesinteriorcharactertask6_01.value: Hmph... I really wish you'd give horse riding a go. It could be in your blood!

Stablesinteriorcharactertask6_03.value: Oh no, of course not. She’s a beautiful horse...

Stablesinteriorcharactertask6_04.value: A shame she has no rider.

Stablesinteriorcharactertask6_07.value: In any case, you've done well, sweetie!

Stablesinteriorcharactertask6_08.value: I'm very confident that Babylon is in good hands.

Stablesinteriorcharactertask6_09.value: Like every Boulton lady should be!

Stablesinteriorcharactertaskintro_01.value: Now Maddie, if we are to reopen these stables...

Stablesinteriorcharactertaskintro_02.value: You need to know how to properly run it and how to take care of horses!

Stablesinteriorcharactertaskintro_03.value: But, never fear. Deb is here!

Stablesinteriorcharactertaskintro_04.value: I’ll show you the ropes, sweetie. You’ll be an equestrian in no time!

Statue_03.value: Actually, she looks a bit like you!

Statue_04.value: What? No, she... Wait a minute...

StrangeOutfits_01.value: These outfits remind me of my theater club at university.

StrangeOutfits_02.value: We had so many cool costumes to pick from!

StrangeOutfits_03.value: But these look well-designed, almost immaculate, like they’re not costumes and more like...

Study01Intro_01.value: Wow! This place is more trashed than the hallway!

Study01Intro_04.value: There must be something in here that could help Grandma!

Study02_01.value: A ha! The scene of the crime...

Study02_02.value: Hey, you’re not allowed to be in here!

Study02_03.value: The front door was open, so I assumed it was okay to enter... Besides, Victoria said I should take pictures.

Study02_04.value: Great... Now I got two reporters hounding me.

Study03_02.value: It looks like a ledger of some sort? But for what?

Study03_03.value: It’s Grandma’s handwriting... Hmm, something about Hopeberries and barrel orders.

Study03_05.value: Oh, sorry... I was just trying to take a photo of this nice desk!

Study03_07.value: That’s strange... These are orders for Hopeberry juice to be delivered to various locations in the city.

Study03_08.value: That’s a lot of money, but wait... These orders were made after your uncle squandered the family fortune!

Study03_09.value: I know... It’s almost as if she was a-

Study04_01.value: Holden! I thought I told you to back off!

Study04_03.value: I’m only doing my job! You can’t cover up the truth!

Study04_06.value: I don’t believe it... Did Grandma really run an underground bootlegging operation?!

Study04_07.value: It looks like she was only trying to make back the money your uncle lost.

Study04_08.value: Yes, but this isn’t helping her case! If anything, it’s making matters worse!

Study04_09.value: If this news was to get out... Jackie, I know you’re a reporter, but-

Study04_10.value: Maddie... Don’t worry. I’m not like that dimwit, Holden. Besides, we’re friends now.

Study05_01.value: Thanks Jackie! It’s kinda cool to have a reporter as a friend.

Study05_02.value: I’ll be honest though, all this would make for one heck of a story!

Study05_03.value: Do you think this is the reason Grandma didn’t want me to get into the mansion?

Study05_04.value: Maybe... But then, why leave it out?!

Study05_05.value: Perhaps someone else wanted me to find it?

Study05_06.value: Are you saying The Butler did it?

Study05_08.value: Ahem. Let’s keep looking around, shall we?

Study05_09.value: What have you got there, dearie?

Study06_02.value: Oh, it’s nothing, Ms. Boulton. We were just looking around an-

Study06_03.value: Please, call me Grandma, dearie! Everyone else does!

Study06_05.value: Now, what is it you have there, Maddie?

Study06_07.value: Oh, that old thing?! Ha! Haven’t seen that in ages! Never was much of a bookie, but it turned a tidy little profit.

Study07_01.value: Grandma, why did you do it?

Study07_02.value: I did what I had to dearie. For the family. Just like what you’re doing now.

Study07_04.value: Sometimes, you have to break a few eggs to bake a pie!

Study07_05.value: You’re not making it easy for me to clear your name...

Study07_06.value: Then let me give you some advice, dearie. Take that book-

Study07_09.value: Your grandma can be scary sometimes...

Study08_01.value: She... Wants me to burn it?

Study08_02.value: That’s what she said. I guess she doesn’t want people to know either.

Study08_03.value: Yes, but why burn the book?

Study08_04.value: I don’t know what you’re getting at?

Study08_05.value: Jackie, she openly admitted to me she was bootlegging! In front of you! She didn’t care about that! But why then tell me to burn the book?

Study08_06.value: There’s something else hidden in this ledger she doesn’t want me to find out!

Study08_08.value: Hmm... Most of it looks pretty legit. Well, as far as bootlegging goes, I guess.

Study08_09.value: What’s all that around the edges?

Study08_10.value: That’s strange! Some sort of code?

Studycomputerpassword_01_01.value: I did it! I figured it out!

Studycomputerpassword_01_05.value: Only one way to find out!

Studyledger_01_01.value: The edges of this book seem to be filled with some strange numbers!

Studyledger_01_02.value: ...and some pages are filled with gibberish.

Studyledger_01_03.value: None of this makes any sense!

Studynumbers_01_02.value: They look like some sort of code that is leading me to something!

Studypage_01_01.value: Oh boy... Some of these pages are filled with scribbles and random words!

Studypage_01_02.value: Should I be worried about Grandma?

Studypage_01_03.value: Hmm.... Some of these pages have cards attached to them...

Studypassword_01_01.value: A ha! If I cross reference the numbers with the pages, I find one of these... Uhm...

Studypassword_01_03.value: What am I supposed to do with these?!

Studypasswordcombi_01_01.value: Okay! I have to place the punch cards...

Studypasswordcombi_01_02.value: On top of each other and...

Studypasswordcombi_01_03.value: Presto! ... half a password. I think... Great.

SubGoal_MapItem_01_Dialogue_01.value: What's this -- a piece of a map?

SubGoal_MapItem_01_Dialogue_02.value: If you keep looking, I bet you will find more pieces.

SubGoal_MapItem_01_Dialogue_03.value: So I need to collect the map pieces. But what happens then?

SubGoal_MapItem_01_Dialogue_04.value: You get a reward for each piece, and if you follow the map, you might just solve the whole mystery!

SubGoal_RewardChest_Closed_01_Dialogue_0.value: The mystery is solved! I found the final piece of the map - and a treasure.

Suitcase_01.value: Hmm, this suitcase looks quite out of place here.

Suitcase_02.value: I wonder whose it is and whether I can open it...

Suitcase_03.value: Oh no, it needs a code!

Suitcase_04.value: I'll have to come back to this some other time...

TGE_Generic_Cherrybomb_Letter1_Text.value: “Grandma” seems to always be one step ahead of the guards. She could hide an elephant right under their noses and they’d never know...

TGE_Generic_Cherrybomb_Letter2_Text.value: “Grandma” just told us the wildest story about her time in Japan - action, romance, spies! It has to be made up!

TGE_Generic_Cherrybomb_Letter3_Text.value: I’m suspecting that “Grandma” is using a knitted decoy of herself during the evenings...

TGE_Generic_End_Popup_Desc.value: The Great Escape has ended. Be ready to help Grandma escape next time!

TGE_Generic_Grace_Letter1_Text.value: “Grandma” has been asking a lot of questions lately... I guess she wants to know more about us.

TGE_Generic_Grace_Letter2_Text.value: I told her about my sister and how she is a reporter. She said she knew her!

TGE_Generic_Grace_Letter3_Text.value: I tried asking her more questions, but she quickly changed the subject... What is “Grandma” hiding?

TGE_Generic_Info_Panel_Description.value:
The Great Escape is happening!
Discover all the jail mysteries and earn glorious rewards!

TGE_Generic_Isabella_Letter1_Text.value: We were in the kitchen today and I got to witness “Grandma’s” knife skills first hand. Wow! She’s like a ninja!

TGE_Generic_Isabella_Letter2_Text.value: Everyone in prison seems to love “Grandma”. I think she’s great, but I still don’t trust her 100%...

TGE_Generic_Isabella_Letter3_Text.value: There’s something about the way she smiles that sort of unsettles me...

TGE_Generic_Izzy_Letter1_Text.value: She taught us how to create incredibly realistic imitations of ourselves using paper mache. She even said we could sew one in a pinch!

TGE_Generic_Izzy_Letter2_Text.value: Someone has been sending her a lot of pies recently. I’m not sure, but it looks like the guards are gaining some weight.

TGE_Generic_Izzy_Letter3_Text.value: If she IS planning to escape, I hope she makes it!

TGE_Generic_Kitty_Letter1_Text.value: My time here has been interesting. We received a new cellmate, who we call “Grandma”.

TGE_Generic_Kitty_Letter2_Text.value: She knows a lot about escaping, almost too much. We should keep an eye on her.

TGE_Generic_Kitty_Letter3_Text.value: I’m surprised how well she can cook, even with the barest of ingredients! Who knew you could cook with biscuits?

TGE_Generic_Mama_Letter1_Text.value: “Grandma” talks a lot about her niece, Maddie. She seems like a nice person.
“Grandma” talks a lot about her granddaughter, Maddie. She seems like a nice person.

TGE_Generic_Mama_Letter2_Text.value: Something tells me that “Grandma” is up to something. I’ve seen her talking with some of the gang leaders...

TGE_Generic_Mama_Letter3_Text.value: The guards seem to let “Grandma” do just about anything... I wonder what she has on them?

TGE_Generic_Start_Popup_Desc.value: Discover the untold story of Grandma’s time in prison and help her escape!
Uh-oh, Grandma's back in jail! Use your wits to help her escape again!

Telescope_01.value: Amazing! I can see all of Hopewell Bay from here!

TennisCourtDialogueA_01.value: Hi Julius! What brings you round?
Hi, Julius! What brings you round?

TennisCourtDialogueA_02.value: In truth, I was taking a little tour of the grounds. I didn't expect anyone to be up here.

TennisCourtDialogueA_03.value: I thought that this area of the estate was well and truly closed.

TennisCourtDialogueA_04.value: Were you about to play a game?

TennisCourtDialogueA_05.value: I... well, I don't know how to play! Grandma never taught me. She says she doesn't like tennis.

TennisCourtDialogueA_06.value: Hey, look down there! I think there's a photo sticking out of the bush.

TennisCourtDialogueA_07.value: I don't believe it - this is Grandma and her sister Deb! And they're playing tennis! Why would she lie about hating it?

TennisCourtDialogueA_08.value: I, ahem, have no idea! Goodness, is that the time? I must dash...

TennisCourtDialogueA_09.value: Hmmm, that was strange! Grandma lied about tennis, and Julius ran away. I'm going to call Deb and find out more!

TennisCourtDialogueB_01.value: Great Aunt Deb! It's so good to see you. Thanks for coming over.

TennisCourtDialogueB_02.value: My pleasure. To be honest, I leapt at the chance - especially since Ursula hardly ever invites me round.

TennisCourtDialogueB_03.value: And I can see why she didn't want me to come here. Ha!

TennisCourtDialogueB_04.value: It's the scene of the crime, after all...

TennisCourtDialogueB_06.value: She didn't tell you, huh? Well, let's just say that your Grandma was a sore loser when it came to tennis!

TennisCourtDialogueB_07.value: Tell me, Maddie - what do you know about the family treasure?

TennisCourtDialogueB_08.value: Uh, nothing, but I'm all ears.

TennisCourtDialogueB_09.value: Well, I don't want to say too much, but I'm sure it's here. You should look for it - see if you can find my missing treasure!

TennisCourtDialogueC_01.value: Grandma! And Great Aunt Deb! I didn't expect to see both of you.

TennisCourtDialogueC_02.value: I heard that she came poking around, and decided that I should be here next time she visited!

TennisCourtDialogueC_03.value: You're just worried that I'll spill all your secrets! Like how you always used to lose at tennis...

TennisCourtDialogueC_04.value: That's a lie! Charlie and I always won. It was you and Julius that lost.

TennisCourtDialogueC_05.value: Wait, you used to play doubles with Grandpa and Julius?!

TennisCourtDialogueC_06.value: We sure did - and boy, was your Grandpa Charlie cute!

TennisCourtDialogueC_07.value: He was cute - and he was mine!

TennisCourtDialogueC_08.value: I don't get it. Why did you stop playing? And what does tennis have to do with treasure?

TennisCourtDialogueC_09.value: We stopped playing when the family treasure went missing. Who knows - if you find it, maybe we'll play again!

TennisCourtDialogueC_10.value: Hmmm. Alright - find the family treasure, Maddie, and you'll see the game of the century.

TennisCourtDialogueC_11.value: How can I say no to that?

TennisCourtDialogueD_01.value: I found something! Is this it - the family treasure?! A dirty old trophy with a note wrapped round it?

TennisCourtDialogueD_02.value: That's the treasure, alright! But what does that note say?

TennisCourtDialogueD_03.value: It says "Ursula and Deb - burying this seems like the only way to stop you fighting over it..."

TennisCourtDialogueD_04.value: The last time you played, Julius and I thought you were going to kill each other! Since you never agree who won, I thought everyone should lose this. Charlie.

TennisCourtDialogueD_05.value: My Charlie wrote that? Oh, no.

TennisCourtDialogueD_06.value: He wasn't wrong, was he? We did fight a lot until this thing went missing.

TennisCourtDialogueD_07.value: We sure did. Maybe we shouldn't have that rematch. How about a game of checkers and some cake instead?

TennisCourtDialogueD_09.value: This might not be the sort of treasure I was imagining, but it was fun to find.

TennisCourtDialogueD_10.value: I think I'd better bury this again though - it sounds like it was trouble!

TennisCourtDialogueD_11.value: But now to the Lighthouse! Since no-one is helping me to find it I'll just go to the shore and look for it myself!

TennisCourtIntro_01.value: Wow! I had no idea there was a whole tennis court here.

TennisCourtIntro_02.value: I've always wanted to play tennis. Do you know the rules?

TennisCourtIntro_03.value: Me? Nope. Sorry, dearie. I, uh, I never liked the game.

TennisCourtIntro_04.value: That's alright! I'm just excited to have found a place like this.

TennisCourtIntro_05.value: Talking about finding things - have you stumbled upon the family treasure yet?

TennisCourtIntro_06.value: What treasure? I've never heard of such a thing!

TennisCourtIntro_07.value: Well, I would advise you to look inside this tennis bag.

TennisCourtIntro_08.value: You'll find everything you need to work your way into another family secret!

TennisCourtIntro_09.value: Why is everyone talking in riddles and no one's telling me the truth!

TigerTalk_03.value: Hmmm... I wonder who that was?

Tomb01_01.value: Hmm, I remember hearing about some sort of tomb on the mansion grounds...

Tomb01_02.value: I can only think of it being here at the Cemetery.

Tomb01_03.value: Perhaps this mausoleum is hiding something. I never could figure out how to enter without a key back in the day.

Tomb01_04.value: Wait! This gate feels a little loose... maybe if I just push it in...

Tomb01_05.value: Something's happening! Oof, that's a lot of dust...

Tomb01_06.value: I- I think I see a staircase!

Tomb02_01.value: Did I just discover the elusive family tomb?! Wow, this place looks like it's been here for ages!

Tomb02_02.value: How could I have missed it?!

Tomb02_03.value: It seems like it's been overtaken by the elements though...

Tomb02_04.value: There's so much foliage and even some water damage.

Tomb02_05.value: I suppose there aren't a lot of visitors paying their respects.

Tomb02_06.value: Well, I'll have to change that and restore this place to its former glory!

Tomb02_07.value: There must be quite a story behind this place...

Tomb03_01.value: I see you've found the family tomb, dearie...

Tomb03_02.value: Grandma! You gave me a fright!

Tomb03_04.value: Of course, dearie. I know everything there is to know about the mansion.

Tomb03_05.value: Are there people buried here? Like the Cemetery?

Tomb03_06.value: Not at all, dearie. This place is more like a memorial.

Tomb03_07.value: You'll find statues of all your ancestors here...

Tomb03_08.value: Would you like me to tell you about them? Each one has quite the history.

Tomb04_01.value: This brave young man was Sergeant John Boulton!

Tomb04_02.value: He was the first of the Boultons to fight for the country at the age of eighteen.

Tomb04_03.value: Oh wow, Ignatius had a brother?

Tomb04_04.value: Yes, a brother he adored, but, John's first love was airplanes.

Tomb04_05.value: He joined the air force right out of university, and quickly climbed the ranks!

Tomb04_06.value: Unfortunately, on one of his missions, John’s plane was shot down.

Tomb04_07.value: He was laid to rest at the age of 26.

Tomb04_08.value: Ignatius was heartbroken and created a memorial for him...

Tomb04_09.value: Which now serves as a place to remember other past family members as well.

Tomb05_02.value: Celebrated philanthropist and co-founder of Hopewell Bay.

Tomb05_03.value: Wow... She really loved Hopewell Bay, always making sure it came first.

Tomb05_04.value: She was well loved in return. She truly was ahead of her times...

Tomb05_05.value: Incredible... I wonder what she would think of us now?

Tomb05_06.value: I'm sure she would be proud of you, dearie!

Tomb06_03.value: You said she died of a broken heart, right?

Tomb06_04.value: Yes, It's a sad story, dearie. She died soon after her betrothed sailed off.

Tomb06_06.value: What you didn't know was that he stole a large portion of her fortune too.

Tomb06_07.value: Supposedly sank somewhere off the coast. They never did find it. Good riddance, I say.

Tomb07_02.value: Yes, dearie. They said he was a sailor, but I think "pirate" would be a better moniker.

Tomb07_03.value: She loved the ocean and especially Hopewell Bay.

Tomb07_04.value: I guess that would explain her love of a sai- Er... Pirate.

Tomb07_05.value: Yes, well. We've all had that one person who wasn't right for us.

Tomb08_02.value: Incredible! I... I remember hearing about the "Family Tree" but I never realized it was an actual tree!

Tomb08_03.value: These must be Ignatius and Agatha! They look so happy.

Tomb08_04.value: Yes, they were really in love. She was brilliant, a natural born inventor and managed to steal his heart.

Tomb08_05.value: If it wasn't for a small accident, Ignatius would have never asked to stay the night in her family's barn.

Tomb08_06.value: Nor would he have ever met her. Funny how little things can have such a big impact.

Tomb09_01.value: You mentioned that Agatha was an inventor?

Tomb09_02.value: Oh yes, very prolific. She had a brilliant mind and practically ran the tin can operations!

Tomb09_03.value: But... Why isn't she as celebrated as Ignatius or Lindsay?

Tomb09_04.value: Well... It was unfortunately a different time, dearie.

Tomb09_05.value: Many of her inventions were put under Ignatius's name, "To keep things simple."

Tomb10_01.value: It's a heart! And it looks like it was fashioned out of tin!

Tomb10_04.value: To declare their love for each other, they had a vow renewal ceremony. I think we're looking at it.

Tomb10_05.value: Beautiful. A love set in stone...

Tomb11_02.value: I... Think I know what this represents...

Tomb11_05.value: He must have known about this place and hoped we would find it so he left us a message.

Tomb11_06.value: It's an hourglass, meaning he's still alive. But I think he's also saying that time is running out.

Tomb11_07.value: I guess the snakes mean we're in danger?

Tomb11_08.value: Perhaps... It could also mean eternal life. But that doesn't make sense.

Tomb11_09.value: Grandpa... What are you trying to say?

Tomb12_01.value: Sometimes, Charlie's a bit too secretive. But he clearly has a plan for us.

Tomb12_02.value: No offense, Grandma, but I don't like being pulled around like a puppet on a string.

Tomb12_03.value: Whatever plan he has, he could surely tell me IN PERSON. And everyone else for that matter.

Tomb12_04.value: You're being investigated for his disappearance for goodness sakes!

Tomb12_05.value: The police may not be the only people after him, dearie...

Tomb12_07.value: Yes. I fear this may have something to do with Crutchley and his mob...

Tomb13_01.value: I wish we knew more. We could help him!

Tomb13_03.value: Dearie, I wouldn't worry too much about Charlie. He can take care of himself.

Tomb13_06.value: But, there are dangers surrounding our family. And I trust that Charlie knows what he's doing.

Tomb14_03.value: One of mine too! While she was remembered for inventing the spray can she-

Tomb14_04.value: She was one heck of an adventurer!

Tomb14_05.value: I didn't know she travelled and explored so much. Just like you, Grandma!

Tomb14_06.value: I guess it runs in the family!

Tomb15_01.value: I know these two! Katie and Casey!

Tomb15_02.value: Hah, yes. Those two were real rascals and surprisingly adventurous.

Tomb15_03.value: They loved exploring, trying to find the best places to surf.

Tomb15_04.value: I guess their curiosity got the best of them.

Tomb15_06.value: Don't you know? They went on a maritime expedition one day, and were never seen again.

Tomb16_01.value: Dearie, I'm afraid I'll have to let you continue on your own.

Tomb16_03.value: This is starting to sound a lot like the early days but I'll give you the benefit of doubt.

Tomb16_04.value: Oh don't be silly, dearie! Toodles!

Tomb17_01.value: Well, I've nearly finished renovating but...

Tomb17_02.value: I can't seem to figure out how to get to that island in the center!

Tomb17_03.value: There's no path anywhere. And what exactly is under those vines?

Tomb17_04.value: Ugh, and what about that frog tile? It stands out and looks like it's slightly elevated.

Tomb17_05.value: Hey, wait a minute! If there's one thing I learnt from the Landing, it's that tiles can reveal paths.

Tomb17_06.value: Let's see if it works here too...

Tomb17_09.value: Hooray! Just as I expected! And what's that in the water?

Tomb17_11.value: I can finally get to the island!

Tomb18_05.value: It feels so strange to see them like this. Almost life-like.

Tomb18_06.value: Dad's sparkly eyes, Mom's warm smile - just like in the photos I have of them.

Tomb18_07.value: These statues capture their essence so perfectly...

Tomb18_08.value: It's almost as if they could step down from their pedestals and wrap me in their arms.

Tomb18_09.value: Wait a minute, these flowers. They couldn't have been left by Grandma, she said she hasn't been here in a while.

Tomb18_10.value: Lilies. Grandma once said Charlie used to call her Lily. Could there be a message for her?

Tomb18_12.value: That inscription on Charlie's memorial... I have a nagging feeling that I should take another look.

Tomb19_01.value: Grandma, how come you haven't visited the tomb?

Tomb19_02.value: Oh, I did, dearie. I was here all the time when I discovered it.

Tomb19_03.value: Back then, I even had some memorials commissioned.

Tomb19_04.value: But, it takes a toll on the mind and the heart and it was increasingly difficult to maintain.

Tomb19_05.value: I understand, it is quite... heavy.

Tomb19_06.value: Well, I'll make sure to fix it up now so we can visit more often!

Tomb20_Outro_01.value: Where lilies bloom... Wait! This inscription is meant for Grandma to understand!

Tomb20_Outro_02.value: It must be some sort of riddle! It talks about a serpent's gaze... Hey! The snake on this memorial!

Tomb20_Outro_03.value: It's looking at the seal on the floor! A glassy place!

Tomb20_Outro_05.value: What's this? A Journal? Charlie's journal! I think he meant to leave this for Grandma...

Tomb20_Outro_06.value: Hey, wait a minute! It's in code!

Tomb20_Outro_07.value: Gaah... What is it with my family and codes!

Tomb20_Outro_08.value: But there is something here that seems to mention another room in the mansion...

Tomb20_Outro_09.value: I think it's time I got some answers!

Tomb21_01.value: Hmm, there's some sort of special tile here...

Tomb21_02.value: A frog tile is a bit strange when it comes to decor but...

Tomb21_03.value: Stranger things have been found in this mansion.

Tomb21_04.value: I wonder if it's important though...

TombCharacterTask1_01.value: Oh no! There are leaks everywhere!

TombCharacterTask1_02.value: I should give Ash a call!

TombCharacterTask1_04.value: Maddie! How ya doin’? What do y-- Whooaaaaaaah!!

TombCharacterTask2_01.value: I can’t believe you broke your leg... Again!

TombCharacterTask2_02.value: What can I say... Plumbing is a dangerous business.

TombCharacterTask2_03.value: But, don’t you worry! We made an excellent team last time!

TombCharacterTask2_05.value: Attagirl. I’ll make a plumber out of you yet!

TombCharacterTask3_01.value: I must admit, Maddie. There’s some INTERESTING stuff down here!

TombCharacterTask3_02.value: You can say that again. I didn’t even know it existed until a little while ago.

TombCharacterTask3_03.value: No, I mean in the pipes. I’m finding all sorts of stuff clogging them up.

TombCharacterTask3_05.value: Balls of yarn, glass, ships in bottles, you name it!

TombCharacterTask3_06.value: If I can keep some of this stuff, I can call it my fee for this job?

TombCharacterTask4_01.value: So, you like the hot tub?

TombCharacterTask4_03.value: The hot tub I installed in the bathroom? Do. You. Like. it?

TombCharacterTask4_06.value: Well, after the smells in here... Maybe give it a go, okay?

TombCharacterTask5_03.value: Well, either we hit an old sewage pipe, or something died in this pipe.

TombCharacterTask5_04.value: But don’t you worry! We’ll get these pipes under control in no time.

TombCharacterTask6_02.value: Another job well done for Ash and Co!

TombCharacterTask6_04.value: Yeah! I really think you got what it takes, Maddie.

TombCharacterTask6_05.value: You and me! Taking on all the plumbing of Hopewell Bay!

TombCharacterTask6_07.value: I’ll take that as a, maybe!

TombPOI10_03.value: The truth that lies in a glassy place."

TombPOI11_02.value: The light from above is reflecting on Agatha's mirror and-

TombPOI11_03.value: Yes, the light is pointing to something...

TombPOI11_04.value: I think there's something behind that stone tile!

TombPOI1_01.value: This stained glass depicts a flower...

TombPOI1_02.value: Yes. Do you know why, dearie?

TombPOI1_03.value: I suppose it's in remembrance of those who served in the war. Like he did.

TombPOI2_01.value: A wreath... A sign of honor and victory!

TombPOI2_02.value: She was revolutionary, Maddie. Brilliant and full of knowledge.

TombPOI2_03.value: She quite literally put Hopewell Bay on the map!

TombPOI3_01.value: Ah, a butterfly... How sadly fitting.

TombPOI3_03.value: A flitting love, precious and delicate. But also short lived.

TombPOI4_01.value: Can't get more obvious than a tin can.

TombPOI4_02.value: He was always a very blunt man...

TombPOI4_03.value: I do wonder what the mirror represents, though?

TombPOI5_02.value: To represent a free spirit of the ocean, adventurous and playful!

TombPOI5_03.value: Much like they were, dearie. They loved the water.

TombPOI6_01.value: A torch for the trailblazer, Lindsay!

TombPOI6_02.value: She will forever be the explorer.

TombPOI7_01.value: A snake eating its own tail?

TombPOI7_02.value: An ouroboros. Symbol of infinity and the cycle of creation and destruction.

TombPOI7_04.value: It feels like Grandpa Charlie's trying to communicate to us...

TombPOI8_02.value: This frog here reminds me of dad.

TombPOI8_03.value: I remember distinctly how dad called me "his little frog".

TombPOI8_04.value: We would even have frog races, and he always let me cross the finish line first!

TombPOI9_03.value: Was someone visiting this memorial recently?

TombPOI9_04.value: I wonder who this could be...

Toolbag_01.value: You'll find all the tools you'll need in my tool bag.

Toolbag_02.value: Hmm... These tools look a bit... weird.

Toolbag_03.value: How much do you know about plumbing?

Toolbag_04.value: Well... not really that much, I suppose.

Toolbag_05.value: Then how do you know what REAL plumbing tools look like?!

Toolbag_06.value: But... some of these look like toys.

Toolbag_07.value: To the untrained eye, perhaps. But these tools are what the MASTERS use.

ToucanTalk_01.value: The toucan! One of my favorite birds.

ToucanTalk_02.value: I've always wished to see them in their natural habitat...

ToucanTalk_03.value: Hmm... Maybe after all this, I'll head south and do just that!

Trophy_01.value: Ooh, there's a trophy on display here!

Trophy_02.value: I can just about make out your name here, Deb!

Trophy_03.value: Oh yes, sweetie! Not long ago, I was considered quite the equestrian champion!

Trophy_04.value: In fact, we even kept some horses at a stable by the mansion so I could practice.
