Urn_01.value: I wonder whose ashes are in here...

Urn_02.value: Oh wait, there's a plaque and it says Mingus. Aww, Grandma's beloved old cat!

Urn_03.value: I heard he died under mysterious circumstances...

Valentine2022IntroPart2UrsulaAndMaddie_0.value: Whose love nest is this, grandma??
Oh me and… well you know, those are such good memories!
I know? Does that mean it used to be yours and grandpa Char--
I’m sorry, I really need to check on those cookies now.
Not the first time I smell a mystery…
And roses! Let's check if there are any romantic garden decorations for Valentine's Day!

ValentineCurrency_Desc.value: Special Event currency! Exclusive currency that can be used for different Event items!

ValentineDecoration_Description01.value: This flowerbed is protected by love <3

ValentineDecoration_Description02.value: Mmm… I love the smell of roses in the morning!

ValentineDecoration_Description04.value: When candle light is not enough, this will do!

ValentineDecoration_Description05.value: Watch out, or get struck by an arrow of love!

ValentineDecoration_Description06.value: On this Valentine’s Day, Ignatius is surrounded by roses!

ValentineDecoration_Description07.value: But the question is, for who two?

ValentineDecoration_Description09.value: Love is in the air – literally!

ValentineDecoration_Description10.value: But watch our for the spikes, if you try to sleep in it!

ValentineDecoration_Description12.value: Enter with a broken heart, exit with a fixed one <3

ValentineDecoration_Description13.value: First impression is everything – this should do!

ValentineDecoration_Description14.value: Passersby will know that it’s Valentine’s Day soon!

ValentineDecoration_Description15.value: If you give chocolates away, give them to statue and eat them yourself later!

ValentineDialogue_Intro_01.value: Valentine’s Day! Yay! Another good reason for garden decorations!

ValentineDialogue_Intro_02.value: That’s right, sweetheart. But work before play!

ValentineDialogue_Intro_03.value: The garden would look so beautiful if the side gate would be polished.

ValentineDialogue_Intro_04.value: But I’m already a bent, old woman…

ValentineDialogue_Intro_05.value: Don’t worry, grandma! I can clean the gate!

ValentineDialogue_decoration10_01.value: Roses are red, violets are blue…

ValentineDialogue_decoration10_02.value: …flowers are sweet and they brighten up my mood!

ValentineDialogue_decoration10_04.value: I’m not sure if I love anything more than flowers!

ValentineDialogue_decoration12_01.value: Pink pink pink! Pink is the new black!

ValentineDialogue_decoration12_02.value: It’s my favourite colour for one day every year

ValentineDialogue_decoration12_03.value: And for the remaining 364 days, I’ll go for yellow, of course!

WinstonCharacterIntro_01.value: What’s wrong, Winston? You look a bit flustered?

WinstonCharacterIntro_02.value: It’s nothing, ma’am. Just a little trifle of a matter... However...

WinstonCharacterIntro_03.value: ... You probably need my help with it?

WinstonCharacterIntro_04.value: If you would be so kind, yes! The Brotherhood of Butlers is having their annual “Bayside Butler’s Banquet” in town.

WinstonCharacterIntro_05.value: As a premier member, it's my turn to host! Unfortunately, with everything that has been going on lately, I’ve had little time to prepare...

WinstonCharacterIntro_06.value: A butler blowout?! This I gotta see!

WinstonCharacterIntro_08.value: Fine, I’ll still help you. But you’ll owe me one!

WinstonCharacterOutro_01.value: I am forever indebted to you, ma’am! You have helped me save face and allowed me to host the banquet!

WinstonCharacterOutro_02.value: No problem, Winston. I can see this means a lot to you.

WinstonCharacterOutro_03.value: It... It does, ma’am. Thank you...

WinstonCharacterTask2_01.value: Oh, my... This stain will not come off!

WinstonCharacterTask2_02.value: Hmm, I don’t think we will have enough time before the guests arrive. We need to paint over it.

WinstonCharacterTask2_04.value: Do you have a better plan, ma’am?

WinstonCharacterTask8_01.value: Looks like some of these benches need new covers.

WinstonCharacterTask8_02.value: Oh, dear... I only know how to patch a hole in clothes!

WinstonCharacterTask8_03.value: Don’t worry, Winston, I can patch these up for you with my trusty sewing kit!

Winstoncharactertask1_01.value: Winston... I don't have time for this.

Winstoncharactertask1_02.value: But ma'am, this is a matter of utmost urgency!

Winstoncharactertask1_03.value: So a few flowers got eaten! I'll plant some more. It's probably a hungry rabbit or gopher...

Winstoncharactertask1_04.value: According to my calculations, it would be a pretty hefty gopher...

Winstoncharactertask1_06.value: Judging from the size of the tracks, and how deep they were, and how much it has eaten... Oh, about 1,000 pounds, ma'am.

Winstoncharactertask2_02.value: Well, it does have a penchant for eating flowers and grazing the lawn.

Winstoncharactertask2_03.value: Are we sure it isn't some sort of moose or something?

Winstoncharactertask2_04.value: No moose in these areas, I'm afraid. However, I do have a theory...

Winstoncharactertask3_01.value: So, what do you think it is?

Winstoncharactertask3_02.value: Well... so far, I have deduced that it is a beast of great size.

Winstoncharactertask3_03.value: I've also found shimmery white strands of hair around the premises that, to my knowledge, don't belong to the local fauna.

Winstoncharactertask3_04.value: For a while, I even theorized that our robust lighthouse keeper may be the culprit...

Winstoncharactertask3_05.value: Heikki?! Why would he come here and eat flowers?

Winstoncharactertask3_06.value: To be perfectly frank, ma'am, I've seen him do MUCH stranger things...

Winstoncharactertask4_01.value: Ma'am, I have put a plan in place that will catch our destructive interloper!

Winstoncharactertask4_02.value: Wow. I've never seen you so excited before, Winston. What is it?

Winstoncharactertask4_03.value: I have devised a rather deceptive feast for the beast. A cornucopia of its favorite weeds, flowers, and foliage.

Winstoncharactertask4_04.value: It cannot resist it. It will not.

Winstoncharactertask4_05.value: I believe our garden menace's time has come to an end!

Winstoncharactertask4_06.value: Winston, this plan of yours will not harm the thing, right?

Winstoncharactertaskintro_01.value: Pardon me, ma'am, but I come with a peculiar predicament.

Winstoncharactertaskintro_03.value: Well, we seem to have an intruder in our midst!

Winstoncharactertaskintro_05.value: Yes, a rather guile and sneaky one too. If it weren't for my predilection for perfection, I may have missed them entirely.
Yes, a rather guileful and sneaky one too. If it weren't for my predilection for perfection, I may have missed them entirely.

Winstoncharactertaskintro_07.value: They seem to have eaten your grandmother's petunias, ma'am.

Winstoncharactertaskoutro_03.value: I... I come bearing grave news, ma'am. My plan has failed.

Winstoncharactertaskoutro_05.value: And in my vainglorious attempt to catch the culprit, I have managed to destroy the better part of the western fence.

Winstoncharactertaskoutro_07.value: I shall take the weekend to fix my folly, ma'am. Sincerest apologies...

WizardStatue_03.value: Yeah! Heikki, the lighthouse keeper. He’s a wizard... erm... Well... Sort of.

XmasDialogue_IntroPart2_02.value: I can’t remember the last time I climbed up here. It must--

XmasDialogue_IntroPart2_04.value: ...It must have been Christmas 1979, when we organised the Holiday Ball for the last time.

XmasDialogue_IntroPart2_07.value: Wow!! Maybe your decorations are still here – let’s look around!

XmasDialogue_Intro_04.value: Don’t worry! I can do the cleaning!

XmasDialogue_Intro_05.value: Ah, I knew I could trust you! Have fun!

XmasDialogue_Intro_06.value: Pretty quick exit for someone with a sore back!

XmasDialogue_Intro_07.value: Well, let’s start with those dusty curtains!

XmasDialogue_decoration10_02.value: That’s true! It’s so romantic when the snow falls quietly.

XmasDialogue_decoration10_03.value: When we had to escape to the North for a while, snow was actually pretty comforting.

XmasDialogue_decoration10_04.value: You escaped to the North? When, why??

XmasDialogue_decoration10_05.value: Oh, I mean… We paid a little visit there, yes.

XmasDialogue_decoration10_06.value: Now I’ll pay a little visit to our neighbors, to borrow some sugar.

XmasDialogue_decoration10_07.value: Grandma!! You can’t run away from these questions forever...

XmasDialogue_decoration11_01.value: “Jingle bells, jingle bells, jingle all the way!”

XmasDialogue_decoration11_02.value: “Oh what fun it is to ride, in a one-horse open sleigh--”

XmasDialogue_decoration11_03.value: Hey?! These bells have old carvings… It says trait-- traitor??

XmasDialogue_decoration11_05.value: ...Probably just some joke by the locals! Haha!

XmasDialogue_decoration11_06.value: Locals had a weird sense of humour, if that’s true...

XmasDialogue_decoration12_05.value: “O Christmas tree! O Christmas tree! How lovely are thy branches!"

XmasDialogue_decoration12_06.value: “O Grandma jokes, o grandma jokes, how passé are they every year… "

XmasDialogue_decoration13_01.value: Oh, did you hang that mistletoe for someone special?

XmasDialogue_decoration13_03.value: That inspector gentleman is very handsome indeed.

XmasDialogue_decoration13_04.value: You mean Roddie? What are you saying grandma…

XmasDialogue_decoration13_05.value: I’ll leave you to it! Just keep on decorating with love!

XmasDialogue_decoration14_01.value: Wow… I can’t believe that’s the same gate I ran over with my car!

XmasDialogue_decoration14_02.value: I’m glad you like it! Are you here to see grandma?

XmasDialogue_decoration14_03.value: Oh, Ursula? Yes, but just stopping by to wish her a merry Christmas!

XmasDialogue_decoration14_04.value: Hmm… Could that explain why she was so excited this morning?

XmasDialogue_decoration14_05.value: Well, it’s exciting to meet a good friend, right? I'd better go now.

XmasDialogue_decoration15_01.value: Where did you find grandpa Charlie’s Christmas sweater?

XmasDialogue_decoration15_02.value: It was tossed in with the decorations. Is it really grandpa Charlie’s?

XmasDialogue_decoration15_03.value: Yes, we had similar ones. We used to wear them every Christmas until…

XmasDialogue_decoration15_05.value: I must go check on the turkey in the oven.

XmasDialogue_decoration1_01.value: Who’s this fella, Maddie? Your new boyfriend?

XmasDialogue_decoration1_02.value: Roddy, you know I’m still dating Mr. A.

XmasDialogue_decoration1_03.value: Mr. A? Who... I didn’t know that you--

XmasDialogue_decoration1_04.value: Just kidding!! I’ve always preferred cool guys like... these two.

XmasDialogue_decoration1_05.value: Haha… Ok, well I'd better go build one for myself too!

XmasDialogue_decoration2_01.value: So, how did my gingerbread cookies do?

XmasDialogue_decoration2_02.value: I have never seen a gingerbread house this big!!

XmasDialogue_decoration2_03.value: It would be even bigger if you didn’t eat most of the cookie dough!

XmasDialogue_decoration2_04.value: Grandma! You know cookie dough is my guilty Christmas pleasure!

XmasDialogue_decoration4_02.value: Those lanterns also make a nice runway for Santa’s sleigh.

XmasDialogue_decoration4_03.value: That’s true! Did you wish for something special from Santa this year?

XmasDialogue_decoration4_04.value: I guess my only wish is an impossible one. Even for Santa.

XmasDialogue_decoration4_05.value: Really? What can be so hard to get?

XmasDialogue_decoration5_01.value: Oh that penguin and I go a loooong way…

XmasDialogue_decoration5_02.value: I think it makes a nice decoration!

XmasDialogue_decoration5_03.value: It does! Although we originally used it for smuggling… candy.

XmasDialogue_decoration5_04.value: Speaking of which, I'd better go and make sure we have some for Christmas.

XmasDialogue_decoration5_05.value: Smuggling candy? Inside a penguin? There’s something fishy here…

XmasDialogue_decoration6_01.value: These decorations will make the postman happy!

XmasDialogue_decoration6_02.value: Oh there are already some Christmas postcards for me!

XmasDialogue_decoration6_03.value: And dozens for grandma?! Who would send so many postcards to her?

XmasDialogue_decoration6_04.value: And why did they put a ‘Confidential’ stamp on each of them...

XmasDialogue_decoration7_02.value: Thank you! Do you already have a Christmas tree at your place?

XmasDialogue_decoration7_03.value: Not yet! But I definitely should get one!

XmasDialogue_decoration7_04.value: Although I have no one to dance around it with...

XmasDialogue_decoration7_05.value: I’m sure you’ll find a dancing partner before Christmas!

XmasDialogue_decoration7_06.value: Yes, well… I was thinking that maybe--

XmasDialogue_decoration7_07.value: Oh I forgot to water the spruce! Where was that watering can again...

XmasDialogue_decoration8_02.value: What is it, Rufus? Don’t you like reindeers?

XmasDialogue_decoration8_04.value: Don’t worry! You will always be my favorite pet <3

XmasDialogue_decoration9_01.value: Gifts are the best thing about Christmas!

XmasDialogue_decoration9_02.value: Or maybe it’s food. Or snow.

XmasDialogue_decoration9_03.value: Speaking of which… Whose footsteps are in the snow?

XmasDialogue_decoration9_04.value: Either grandma’s new shoes are way too big, or someone’s playing a trick on me...
